`README.md`:

```md
# NavroProxy

An anti-cheat proxy for Minecraft Bedrock Edition. NavroProxy runs between players and a backend server, tracks the world and player state, and checks movement and gameplay packets.

It runs on Windows and Linux with Java 21. Clients can connect over RakNet or through the separate NetherNet frontend.

## Build

Install JDK 21 or later, then run the Gradle wrapper.

Linux

```sh
bash gradlew distZip
```

Windows PowerShell

```powershell
.\gradlew.bat distZip
```

The distribution ZIP is written to `build/distributions/`. Extract the entire archive to keep the launcher and its dependencies together.

To build an unpacked distribution

```sh
bash gradlew installDist
```

## Run

Linux

```sh
bin/navro-proxy --listen 0.0.0.0:19132 --backend 127.0.0.1:19133 --mode detect
```

Windows PowerShell

```powershell
.\bin\navro-proxy.bat --listen 0.0.0.0:19132 --backend 127.0.0.1:19133 --mode detect
```

The backend must accept trusted proxy connections. The client and backend must use compatible Bedrock protocol versions.

Settings are stored in `plugins/Navro/`:

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `config.yml` | Movement tolerances, corrections, disabled checks and latency limits |
| `punishments.yml` | Check groups, recent violation windows and alert/log/kick thresholds |
| `messages.yml` | Prefix, alert format, command replies and disconnect messages |

All three files are bundled under `src/main/resources/` and included in the distribution. Missing files are created at startup; existing settings are preserved. A legacy prefix in `config.yml` moves to `messages.yml` when that file is first created. `/navro reload` reloads all three together; an invalid file leaves the previous configuration active.

Punishment rules use `threshold:interval action`. For example, `50:0 kick %player%` kicks at 50 recent violations, once until the group's window expires. `1:1 [alert]` reports each violation. Check selectors support exact names (`RotationPlace`, `Sprint-A`), check families (`Sprint`), `*` wildcards, and `!` exclusions. The default file has a separate section for each of the 22 implemented checks, so Timer, NegativeTimer and each Sprint type have independent counters. Each player's counters are also independent; reloading or reconnecting resets them. Default rules only alert. The proxy supports `[alert]`, `[log]`, and kicks; it does not execute arbitrary backend console commands.

Message placeholders include `%prefix%`, `%player%`, `%check_name%`, `%check%`, `%vl%` (recent group count), `%check_vl%` (individual check count), `%verbose%`, and `%message%` (the original detailed alert). Color codes use `&`.

- `detect` runs the registered checks.
- `inspect` observes protocol traffic.
- `--backend-type bds` selects the BDS adapter.
- `--block-palette` supplies a backend runtime palette for the NetherNet adapter.

Keep the backend on a private network or restrict it to connections from the proxy.

## Player commands

- `/navro alert` toggles alerts.
- `/navro reload` reloads configuration.
- `/navro debug` and `/navro debug2` control diagnostic output.

## NetherNet and backend adapters

The NetherNet frontend requires Go 1.26 or later and runs alongside the Java proxy.

- NetherNet frontend source: `nethernet/`.
- Geyser and Floodgate integration: `backend/geyser/`.
- Nukkit bridge source and build script: `backend/nukkit/`.
- PocketMine-MP 5 bridge source and build script: `backend/pocketmine-mp/`.

AirLiquidPlace and RotationPlace require a valid native server tick from the backend bridge. They automatically disable when samples are missing, stale, or reset; FarPlace and ordinary inventory validation remain active. RotationPlace timeouts use only backend ticks. Missing selection data skips local placement prediction without a confirmation wait or timeout cancellation.


## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

Input timing uses a server-owned counter that advances once per input. Client tick values are stored separately for correction frame matching. Negative frames disconnect the client; duplicate, backward and jumping frames do not add VL. BadPacketsC checks respawn requests (formerly BadPacketsD).

`backend/geyser/nethernet/NavroNetherNetGate.java`:

```java
package org.geysermc.geyser.network.bedrock.nethernet;

import io.netty.buffer.ByteBuf;
import io.netty.buffer.Unpooled;
import io.netty.channel.Channel;
import io.netty.channel.ChannelDuplexHandler;
import io.netty.channel.ChannelHandlerContext;
import io.netty.channel.ChannelPromise;
import io.netty.util.ReferenceCountUtil;
import io.netty.util.concurrent.DefaultThreadFactory;
import io.netty.util.concurrent.ScheduledFuture;
import org.cloudburstmc.netty.channel.nethernet.NetherNetChildChannel;
import org.geysermc.geyser.GeyserImpl;
import org.geysermc.geyser.network.bedrock.InvalidPacketHandler;
import org.geysermc.geyser.network.bedrock.nethernet.codec.NetherNetFrameCodec;
import org.geysermc.geyser.session.GeyserSession;
import org.geysermc.mcprotocollib.protocol.data.ProtocolState;

import java.io.BufferedInputStream;
import java.io.BufferedOutputStream;
import java.io.DataInputStream;
import java.io.DataOutputStream;
import java.io.EOFException;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.net.InetAddress;
import java.net.InetSocketAddress;
import java.net.Socket;
import java.nio.channels.ClosedChannelException;
import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.ArrayBlockingQueue;
import java.util.concurrent.Callable;
import java.util.concurrent.RejectedExecutionException;
import java.util.concurrent.ThreadPoolExecutor;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
import java.util.function.Consumer;
import java.util.function.Predicate;
import java.util.function.Supplier;

final class NavroNetherNetGate extends ChannelDuplexHandler {
    private static final int MAGIC = 0x4e564235;
    private static final int MAX_BATCH = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
    private static final int MAX_REPLY = 2 * MAX_BATCH;
    private static final int MAX_GROUP_COUNT = 64;
    private static final int MAX_GROUP_BYTES = 2 * 1024 * 1024;
    private static final int CLIENT = 0;
    private static final int BACKEND = 1;
    private static final int TICK = 2;
    private static final int HIGH_WATER_COUNT = 256;
    private static final int LOW_WATER_COUNT = 64;
    private static final int MAX_PENDING_COUNT = 4096;
    private static final int HIGH_WATER_BYTES = 2 * 1024 * 1024;
    private static final int LOW_WATER_BYTES = 512 * 1024;
    private static final int MAX_PENDING_BYTES = 3 * MAX_BATCH;
    private static final byte[] EMPTY = new byte[0];
    private static final ThreadPoolExecutor WORKERS = new ThreadPoolExecutor(4, 4, 0, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS,
            new ArrayBlockingQueue<>(64), new DefaultThreadFactory("Navro NetherNet checks", true));

    private final GeyserImpl geyser;
    private final Socket socket = new Socket();
    private final ArrayDeque<Pending> pending = new ArrayDeque<>();
    private DataInputStream input;
    private DataOutputStream output;
    private ScheduledFuture<?> ticks;
    private Predicate<Boolean> readPressure;
    private List<Pending> inFlight = List.of();
    private int pendingBytes;
    private boolean connected;
    private boolean pumpScheduled;
    private boolean tickPending;
    private boolean throttled;
    private boolean stopped;

    private NavroNetherNetGate(GeyserImpl geyser) {
        this.geyser = geyser;
    }

    static void install(Channel channel, GeyserImpl geyser) {
        install(channel, geyser, null);
    }

    static void install(Channel channel, GeyserImpl geyser, Predicate<Boolean> readPressure) {
        var gate = new NavroNetherNetGate(geyser);
        gate.readPressure = readPressure;
        channel.pipeline().addBefore(NetherNetFrameCodec.NAME, "navro-nethernet-checks", gate);
        if (channel.pipeline().get(InvalidPacketHandler.class) != null) {
            channel.pipeline().replace(InvalidPacketHandler.class, InvalidPacketHandler.NAME, new InvalidPacketHandler() {
                @Override
                public void setSession(GeyserSession session) {
                    super.setSession(session);
                    gate.readPressure = new JavaReadPressure(() -> {
                        var downstream = session.getDownstream();
                        return downstream == null || !downstream.isState(ProtocolState.GAME)
                                ? null : downstream.getSession().getChannel();
                    });
                    gate.updateBackpressure();
                }
            });
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void channelActive(ChannelHandlerContext context) {
        var player = context.channel().attr(NetherNetChildChannel.PLAYER_INFO).get();
        submit(context, () -> {
            var key = player == null ? null : player.clientPublicKey();
            byte[] encodedKey = key == null ? EMPTY : key.getEncoded();
            if (encodedKey == null || encodedKey.length == 0 || encodedKey.length > 512) {
                throw new IOException("Missing or invalid NetherNet transport identity");
            }
            int port = Integer.getInteger("navro.nethernet.adapter-port", 19138);
            socket.connect(new InetSocketAddress(InetAddress.getLoopbackAddress(), port), 1000);
            socket.setTcpNoDelay(true);
            socket.setSoTimeout(8000);
            input = new DataInputStream(new BufferedInputStream(socket.getInputStream()));
            output = new DataOutputStream(new BufferedOutputStream(socket.getOutputStream()));
            output.writeInt(MAGIC);
            output.writeInt(encodedKey.length);
            output.write(encodedKey);
            output.flush();
            if (input.readInt() != MAGIC) throw new IOException("Navro did not enable NetherNet checks");
            return true;
        }, ignored -> {
            connected = true;
            ticks = context.executor().scheduleWithFixedDelay(() -> enqueueTick(context), 50, 50, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
            context.fireChannelActive();
            schedulePump(context);
        });
    }

    @Override
    public void channelRead(ChannelHandlerContext context, Object message) {
        enqueue(context, CLIENT, message, null);
    }

    @Override
    public void write(ChannelHandlerContext context, Object message, ChannelPromise promise) {
        enqueue(context, BACKEND, message, promise);
    }

    @Override
    public void channelReadComplete(ChannelHandlerContext context) {
    }

    @Override
    public void channelInactive(ChannelHandlerContext context) {
        stop(new ClosedChannelException());
        context.fireChannelInactive();
    }

    @Override
    public void handlerRemoved(ChannelHandlerContext context) {
        stop(new ClosedChannelException());
    }

    private void enqueue(ChannelHandlerContext context, int direction, Object message, ChannelPromise promise) {
        try {
            if (stopped) throw new ClosedChannelException();
            if (!(message instanceof ByteBuf buffer) || !buffer.isReadable() || buffer.readableBytes() > MAX_BATCH) {
                throw new IOException("Invalid NetherNet batch");
            }
            int size = buffer.readableBytes();
            if (pendingCount() >= MAX_PENDING_COUNT || size > MAX_PENDING_BYTES - pendingBytes) {
                throw new IOException("NetherNet bridge backlog exceeded its safety limit ("
                        + pendingCount() + " queued, " + pendingBytes + " bytes, "
                        + inFlight.size() + " in flight, next batch " + size + " bytes)");
            }
            byte[] bytes = new byte[size];
            buffer.getBytes(buffer.readerIndex(), bytes);
            pending.addLast(new Pending(direction, bytes, promise));
            pendingBytes += size;
            updateBackpressure();
            schedulePump(context);
        } catch (Exception error) {
            if (promise != null) promise.tryFailure(error);
            fail(context, error);
        } finally {
            ReferenceCountUtil.release(message);
        }
    }

    private void enqueueTick(ChannelHandlerContext context) {
        if (stopped || tickPending || pendingCount() >= MAX_PENDING_COUNT) return;
        tickPending = true;
        pending.addLast(new Pending(TICK, EMPTY, null));
        schedulePump(context);
    }

    private int pendingCount() {
        return pending.size() + inFlight.size();
    }

    private void schedulePump(ChannelHandlerContext context) {
        if (stopped || !connected || pumpScheduled || !inFlight.isEmpty() || pending.isEmpty()) return;
        pumpScheduled = true;
        context.executor().execute(() -> pump(context));
    }

    private void pump(ChannelHandlerContext context) {
        pumpScheduled = false;
        if (stopped || pending.isEmpty()) return;
        List<Pending> group = new ArrayList<>();
        int size = 0;
        while (group.size() < MAX_GROUP_COUNT && !pending.isEmpty()) {
            Pending next = pending.peekFirst();
            if (!group.isEmpty() && next.bytes().length > MAX_GROUP_BYTES - size) break;
            group.add(pending.removeFirst());
            size += next.bytes().length;
            if (size > MAX_GROUP_BYTES) break;
        }
        inFlight = group;
        submit(context, () -> exchange(group), replies -> complete(context, group, replies));
    }

    private <Result> void submit(ChannelHandlerContext context, Callable<Result> task, Consumer<Result> complete) {
        try {
            WORKERS.execute(() -> {
                try {
                    Result result = task.call();
                    post(context, () -> complete.accept(result));
                } catch (Exception error) {
                    post(context, () -> fail(context, error));
                }
            });
        } catch (RejectedExecutionException error) {
            fail(context, new IOException("NetherNet bridge has too many active connections", error));
        }
    }

    private void post(ChannelHandlerContext context, Runnable completion) {
        try {
            context.executor().execute(() -> {
                if (stopped) return;
                try {
                    completion.run();
                } catch (Exception error) {
                    fail(context, error);
                }
            });
        } catch (RejectedExecutionException ignored) {
            closeSocket();
        }
    }

    private List<Reply> exchange(List<Pending> group) throws IOException {
        output.writeByte(group.size());
        for (Pending request : group) {
            output.writeByte(request.direction());
            output.writeInt(request.bytes().length);
            output.write(request.bytes());
        }
        output.flush();

        var limits = new ReplyLimits(MAX_PENDING_BYTES);
        var replies = new ArrayList<Reply>(group.size());
        for (Pending request : group) {
            Reply reply = readReply(limits);
            if (request.direction() == TICK && reply.forwarded() != null) throw new IOException("Unexpected forwarded tick batch");
            replies.add(reply);
        }
        return replies;
    }

    private Reply readReply(ReplyLimits limits) throws IOException {
        limits.replyBytes = MAX_REPLY;
        int size = input.readInt();
        byte[] forwarded = size == -1 ? null : readBatch(size, limits);
        return new Reply(forwarded, readOutputs(limits), readOutputs(limits));
    }

    private List<byte[]> readOutputs(ReplyLimits limits) throws IOException {
        int count = input.readInt();
        if (count < 0 || count > 4096) throw new IOException("Invalid Navro output count");
        List<byte[]> outputs = new ArrayList<>(count);
        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++) {
            outputs.add(readBatch(input.readInt(), limits));
        }
        return outputs;
    }

    private byte[] readBatch(int size, ReplyLimits limits) throws IOException {
        if (size <= 0 || size > MAX_BATCH || size > limits.replyBytes || size > limits.groupBytes) {
            throw new IOException("Invalid Navro batch size");
        }
        limits.replyBytes -= size;
        limits.groupBytes -= size;
        byte[] batch = input.readNBytes(size);
        if (batch.length != size) throw new EOFException("Incomplete Navro batch");
        return batch;
    }

    private static ByteBuf buffer(byte[] batch) {
        return Unpooled.wrappedBuffer(batch);
    }

    private void complete(ChannelHandlerContext context, List<Pending> group, List<Reply> replies) {
        boolean read = false;
        boolean wrote = false;
        for (int index = 0; index < group.size() && !stopped; index++) {
            Pending request = group.get(index);
            Reply reply = replies.get(index);
            pendingBytes -= request.bytes().length;
            if (request.direction() == TICK) tickPending = false;
            if (request.direction() == BACKEND) {
                if (reply.forwarded() == null) request.promise().trySuccess();
                else {
                    context.write(buffer(reply.forwarded()), request.promise());
                    wrote = true;
                }
            } else if (reply.forwarded() != null) {
                context.fireChannelRead(buffer(reply.forwarded()));
                read = true;
            }
            for (byte[] extra : reply.clientbound()) {
                if (stopped) break;
                context.write(buffer(extra), context.voidPromise());
                wrote = true;
            }
            for (byte[] extra : reply.backendbound()) {
                if (stopped) break;
                context.fireChannelRead(buffer(extra));
                read = true;
            }
        }
        if (stopped) return;
        if (wrote) context.flush();
        if (read) context.fireChannelReadComplete();
        inFlight = List.of();
        updateBackpressure();
        schedulePump(context);
    }

    private void updateBackpressure() {
        if (readPressure == null || stopped) return;
        int count = pendingCount();
        if (!throttled && (count >= HIGH_WATER_COUNT || pendingBytes >= HIGH_WATER_BYTES)) {
            setBackpressure(true);
        } else if (throttled && count <= LOW_WATER_COUNT && pendingBytes <= LOW_WATER_BYTES) {
            setBackpressure(false);
        }
    }

    private void setBackpressure(boolean pause) {
        if (throttled == pause || readPressure == null) return;
        boolean applied = readPressure.test(pause);
        throttled = pause && applied;
    }

    private void fail(ChannelHandlerContext context, Exception error) {
        if (stopped) return;
        stop(error);
        context.close();
        if (geyser != null) {
            geyser.getLogger().warning("Closing NetherNet session: Navro checks unavailable or rejected the batch ("
                    + error.getClass().getSimpleName() + ": " + error.getMessage() + ").");
        }
    }

    private void stop(Exception error) {
        if (stopped) return;
        stopped = true;
        if (ticks != null) ticks.cancel(false);
        closeSocket();
        try {
            setBackpressure(false);
        } catch (RejectedExecutionException ignored) {
        }
        inFlight.forEach(request -> request.fail(error));
        pending.forEach(request -> request.fail(error));
        pending.clear();
        inFlight = List.of();
    }

    private void closeSocket() {
        try {
            socket.close();
        } catch (IOException ignored) {
        }
    }

    private record Pending(int direction, byte[] bytes, ChannelPromise promise) {
        void fail(Exception error) {
            if (promise != null) promise.tryFailure(error);
        }
    }

    static final class JavaReadPressure implements Predicate<Boolean> {
        private final Supplier<Channel> downstreamChannel;
        private ReadPause pause;

        JavaReadPressure(Supplier<Channel> downstreamChannel) {
            this.downstreamChannel = downstreamChannel;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean test(Boolean requested) {
            if (requested) {
                if (pause != null) return true;
                Channel channel = downstreamChannel.get();
                if (channel == null || !channel.isActive()) return false;
                var next = new ReadPause(channel);
                next.apply(true);
                pause = next;
            } else if (pause != null) {
                pause.apply(false);
                pause = null;
            }
            return true;
        }

        private static final class ReadPause {
            private final Channel channel;
            private boolean ownsPause;

            private ReadPause(Channel channel) {
                this.channel = channel;
            }

            private void apply(boolean requested) {


                var loop = channel.eventLoop();
                if (loop.inEventLoop()) {
                    set(requested);
                } else {
                    loop.execute(() -> set(requested));
                }
            }

            private void set(boolean requested) {
                if (!channel.isActive()) return;
                if (requested && channel.config().isAutoRead()) {
                    channel.config().setAutoRead(false);
                    ownsPause = true;
                } else if (!requested && ownsPause) {
                    channel.config().setAutoRead(true);
                    ownsPause = false;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private static final class ReplyLimits {
        private int groupBytes;
        private int replyBytes;

        private ReplyLimits(int groupBytes) {
            this.groupBytes = groupBytes;
        }
    }

    private record Reply(byte[] forwarded, List<byte[]> clientbound, List<byte[]> backendbound) {
    }
}

```

`backend/geyser/src/main/java/org/geysermc/geyser/util/NavroForwardedLogin.java`:

```java
package org.geysermc.geyser.util;

import io.netty.util.NetUtil;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.auth.AuthPayload;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.auth.AuthType;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.auth.TokenPayload;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.util.EncryptionUtils;
import org.jose4j.jwa.AlgorithmConstraints;
import org.jose4j.jws.AlgorithmIdentifiers;
import org.jose4j.jwt.consumer.JwtConsumer;
import org.jose4j.jwt.consumer.JwtConsumerBuilder;

import java.net.InetAddress;
import java.net.InetSocketAddress;
import java.net.SocketAddress;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.security.PublicKey;
import java.util.UUID;

public final class NavroForwardedLogin {
    private final JwtConsumer consumer;

    public NavroForwardedLogin(PublicKey key) {
        consumer = new JwtConsumerBuilder()
                .setVerificationKey(key)
                .setJwsAlgorithmConstraints(AlgorithmConstraints.ConstraintType.PERMIT,
                        AlgorithmIdentifiers.ECDSA_USING_P384_CURVE_AND_SHA384)
                .setExpectedAudience(true, "urn:navro:floodgate-forwarding:1")
                .setRequireExpirationTime()
                .setRequireIssuedAt()
                .setIssuedAtRestrictions(5, 35)
                .setMaxFutureValidityInMinutes(1)
                .build();
    }

    public static NavroForwardedLogin configured() {
        return Configuration.INSTANCE;
    }

    private static final class Configuration {
        private static final NavroForwardedLogin INSTANCE = load();

        private static NavroForwardedLogin load() {
            String keyPath = System.getProperty("navro.floodgate.public-key");
            if (keyPath == null) {
                return null;
            }
            try {
                String pem = Files.readString(Path.of(keyPath)).strip();
                String begin = "-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----";
                String end = "-----END PUBLIC KEY-----";
                if (!pem.startsWith(begin) || !pem.endsWith(end)) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Expected an X.509 PEM public key");
                }
                var key = EncryptionUtils.parseKey(pem.substring(begin.length(), pem.length() - end.length())
                        .replaceAll("\\s", ""));
                if (key.getParams().getCurve().getField().getFieldSize() != 384) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Navro forwarding requires a P-384 public key");
                }
                return new NavroForwardedLogin(key);
            } catch (Exception ex) {
                throw new IllegalStateException("Cannot load navro.floodgate.public-key", ex);
            }
        }
    }

    public Identity verify(AuthPayload payload, SocketAddress peer) throws Exception {
        if (!(peer instanceof InetSocketAddress inet) || inet.getAddress() == null
                || !inet.getAddress().isLoopbackAddress()
                || !(payload instanceof TokenPayload token) || token.getAuthType() != AuthType.SELF_SIGNED) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid Navro forwarding transport or login type");
        }
        var claims = consumer.processToClaims(token.getToken());
        String xuid = claims.getStringClaimValue("xid");
        if (xuid == null || !xuid.matches("[1-9][0-9]{0,19}")) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid forwarded Bedrock XUID");
        }
        Long.parseUnsignedLong(xuid);
        String username = claims.getStringClaimValue("xname");
        String ip = claims.getStringClaimValue("ipt");
        byte[] address = ip == null ? null : NetUtil.createByteArrayFromIpAddressString(ip);
        if (address == null || username == null || username.isBlank()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing forwarded Bedrock identity");
        }
        return new Identity(username, UUID.fromString(claims.getStringClaimValue("leguuid")),
                xuid, claims.getStringClaimValue("mid"), claims.getIssuedAt().getValue(),
                new InetSocketAddress(InetAddress.getByAddress(address), 0),
                EncryptionUtils.parseKey(claims.getStringClaimValue("cpk")));
    }

    public record Identity(String username, UUID uuid, String xuid, String minecraftId, long issuedAt,
                           InetSocketAddress address, PublicKey sessionKey) {
    }
}

from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import zipfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
arguments = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Build the optional Nukkit-MOT bridge')
arguments.add_argument('--nukkit-jar', required=True, type=Path, help='Path to the actual Nukkit-MOT server JAR')
BACKEND = arguments.parse_args().nukkit_jar.resolve()
if not BACKEND.is_file():
    arguments.error('The Nukkit-MOT JAR does not exist: ' + str(BACKEND))
BUILD = ROOT / 'build'
CLASSES = BUILD / 'classes'
CLASSES.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

sources = sorted((ROOT / 'src/main/java').rglob('*.java'))
subprocess.run(['javac', '-J-XX:ActiveProcessorCount=2', '--release', '21', '-proc:none', '-cp', str(BACKEND),
                '-d', str(CLASSES), *map(str, sources)], check=True)
jar = BUILD / 'NavroBackendBridge.jar'
with zipfile.ZipFile(jar, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as archive:
    for base in [CLASSES, ROOT / 'src/main/resources']:
        for path in sorted(base.rglob('*')):
            if path.is_file():
                archive.write(path, path.relative_to(base))
(BUILD / 'NavroFireworkBridge.jar').unlink(missing_ok=True)
summary = {'backendJar': str(BACKEND), 'backendSha256': hashlib.sha256(BACKEND.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
           'pluginJar': str(jar), 'pluginSha256': hashlib.sha256(jar.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
(BUILD / 'validation.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))

`backend/nukkit/src/main/java/ac/navro/bridge/nukkit/NativeStateSync.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.bridge.nukkit;

import cn.nukkit.Player;
import cn.nukkit.inventory.*;
import cn.nukkit.inventory.request.NetworkMapping;
import cn.nukkit.inventory.transaction.action.SlotChangeAction;
import cn.nukkit.item.Item;
import cn.nukkit.event.*;
import cn.nukkit.event.server.*;
import cn.nukkit.event.inventory.InventoryTransactionEvent;
import cn.nukkit.network.protocol.*;
import cn.nukkit.network.protocol.types.AuthInputAction;
import cn.nukkit.network.protocol.types.ContainerIds;
import cn.nukkit.network.protocol.types.inventory.ContainerSlotType;
import cn.nukkit.network.protocol.types.inventory.itemstack.response.ItemStackResponseStatus;
import cn.nukkit.plugin.Plugin;
import java.util.*;


public final class NativeStateSync implements Listener {
    public static final String CHANNEL="navro:backend_sync_v1";
    private static final int CREATED_OUTPUT=PlayerUIComponent.CREATED_ITEM_OUTPUT_UI_SLOT;
    private final Map<Player,Session> sessions=new IdentityHashMap<>();
    private final Plugin plugin;

    NativeStateSync(Plugin plugin) { this.plugin=plugin; }
    private record Slot(int container,int index) { }
    private record Source(Inventory inventory,int nativeSlot) { }
    private record ResponseSlot(Source source,Item snapshot,boolean emptyConfirmed) { }
    private static final class Pending {
        final Source source;
        Item sent;
        Pending(Source source) { this.source=source; }
    }
    private static final class Session {
        final String nonce;
        long sequence;
        int lastTick;
        boolean tickSent;
        final Map<Slot,Pending> pending=new LinkedHashMap<>();
        long uiRevision;
        int due;
        Session(String nonce) { this.nonce=nonce; }
    }
    @EventHandler(priority=EventPriority.MONITOR,ignoreCancelled=false)
    public void onReceive(DataPacketReceiveEvent event) {
        var player=event.getPlayer();var packet=event.getPacket();
        if(packet instanceof ScriptMessagePacket message&&CHANNEL.equals(message.channel)) {
            event.setCancelled(true);
            String value=message.message;
            if(value==null||!value.startsWith("hello|")||value.length()!=42)return;
            String nonce=value.substring(6);
            try { UUID.fromString(nonce); } catch(IllegalArgumentException ex) { return; }
            sessions.put(player,new Session(nonce));sendTick(player);return;
        }
        if(!sessions.containsKey(player))return;
        if(packet instanceof ContainerClosePacket close && !event.isCancelled()) {
            forgetWindow(sessions.get(player),close.windowId);
        }
        boolean transaction=packet instanceof InventoryTransactionPacket
                ||packet instanceof ItemStackRequestPacket
                ||packet instanceof PlayerAuthInputPacket input && (
                    input.getInputData().contains(AuthInputAction.PERFORM_ITEM_INTERACTION)
                    ||input.getInputData().contains(AuthInputAction.PERFORM_ITEM_STACK_REQUEST));
        if(transaction)capture(player);
    }
    @EventHandler(priority=EventPriority.MONITOR,ignoreCancelled=false)
    public void onTransaction(InventoryTransactionEvent event) {
        Player player=event.getTransaction().getSource();
        Session session=sessions.get(player);
        if(session==null)return;
        for(var action:event.getTransaction().getActionList())if(action instanceof SlotChangeAction change) {
            var source=new Source(change.getInventory(),change.getSlot());
            var slot=wireSlot(player,source);
            if(slot!=null)track(player,session,slot,source,false);
        }
    }
    private void capture(Player player) {
        Session s=sessions.get(player);if(s==null)return;
        s.due=player.getServer().getTick()+1;


        Set<Inventory> inventories=Collections.newSetFromMap(new IdentityHashMap<>());
        for(int id=0;id<256;id++) { Inventory inv=player.getWindowById(id);if(inv!=null)inventories.add(inv); }
        if(player.getInventory()!=null)inventories.add(player.getInventory());
        if(player.getOffhandInventory()!=null)inventories.add(player.getOffhandInventory());
        if(player.getUIInventory()!=null)inventories.add(player.getUIInventory());
        if(player.getCraftingGrid()!=null)inventories.add(player.getCraftingGrid());
        for(Inventory inv:inventories) {
            if(inv==player.getUIInventory()) {
                track(player,s,new Slot(ContainerIds.UI,0),new Source(inv,0),true);
                track(player,s,new Slot(ContainerIds.UI,CREATED_OUTPUT),new Source(inv,CREATED_OUTPUT),true);
                continue;
            }
            if(inv instanceof PlayerCursorInventory)continue;
            int size=slotLimit(inv);
            for(int index=0;index<size;index++) {
                var source=new Source(inv,index);
                var slot=wireSlot(player,source);
                if(slot!=null&&isCurrent(player,slot,source))track(player,s,slot,source,true);
            }
        }
    }
    private static int slotLimit(Inventory inventory) {
        return inventory.getSize()+(inventory instanceof PlayerInventory?4:0);
    }
    private static Slot wireSlot(Player player,Source source) {
        Inventory inventory=source.inventory();
        int index=source.nativeSlot();
        if(index<0||index>=slotLimit(inventory))return null;
        if(inventory instanceof PlayerUIComponent component) {
            int uiIndex=componentSlot(component,index);
            return uiIndex<0?null:new Slot(ContainerIds.UI,uiIndex);
        }
        if(inventory==player.getInventory()) {
            return index<inventory.getSize()?new Slot(ContainerIds.INVENTORY,index)
                    :new Slot(ContainerIds.ARMOR,index-inventory.getSize());
        }
        if(inventory==player.getOffhandInventory())return new Slot(ContainerIds.OFFHAND,index);
        if(inventory==player.getUIInventory())return new Slot(ContainerIds.UI,index);
        int id=player.getWindowId(inventory);
        return id>=0&&id<=255?new Slot(id,index):null;
    }
    private static int componentSlot(PlayerUIComponent component,int index) {
        if(component instanceof PlayerCursorInventory)return index==0?0:-1;
        if(component instanceof BigCraftingGrid)return 32+index;
        if(component instanceof CraftingGrid)return 28+index;
        if(!(component instanceof FakeBlockUIComponent workstation))return -1;
        return switch(workstation.getFakeBlockType()) {
            case ANVIL -> index<2?AnvilInventory.ANVIL_INPUT_UI_SLOT+index:-1;
            case ENCHANT_TABLE -> EnchantInventory.ENCHANT_INPUT_ITEM_UI_SLOT+index;
            case BEACON -> 27+index;
            case LOOM -> index<3?LoomInventory.OFFSET+index:-1;
            case CARTOGRAPHY -> CartographyTableInventory.CARTOGRAPHY_INPUT_UI_SLOT+index;
            case GRINDSTONE -> index<2?GrindstoneInventory.GRINDSTONE_EQUIPMENT_UI_SLOT+index:-1;
            case STONECUTTER -> index==0?StonecutterInventory.STONECUTTER_INPUT_UI_SLOT:-1;
            case SMITHING_TABLE -> SmithingInventory.SMITHING_EQUIPMENT_UI_SLOT+index;
            default -> -1;
        };
    }
    private static Pending track(Player player,Session session,Slot slot,Source source,boolean refresh) {
        if(session.pending.isEmpty())session.due=player.getServer().getTick()+1;
        Pending previous=session.pending.get(slot);
        if(!refresh&&previous!=null&&previous.source.inventory()==source.inventory()
                &&previous.source.nativeSlot()==source.nativeSlot())return previous;
        var pending=new Pending(source);
        session.pending.put(slot,pending);
        return pending;
    }
    @EventHandler(priority=EventPriority.MONITOR,ignoreCancelled=true)
    public void onSend(DataPacketSendEvent event) {
        if(event.isCancelled())return;
        var player=event.getPlayer();Session s=sessions.get(player);if(s==null)return;
        var packet=event.getPacket();
        if(packet instanceof UpdateBlockPacket ||packet instanceof UpdateSubChunkBlocksPacket)sendTick(player);
        if(packet instanceof InventorySlotPacket slot) {
            observeSend(event,player,s,new Slot(slot.inventoryId,slot.slot),slot.item);
        } else if(packet instanceof InventoryContentPacket content && content.slots!=null) {
            for(int index=0;index<content.slots.length;index++)
                observeSend(event,player,s,new Slot(content.inventoryId,index),content.slots[index]);
        } else if(packet instanceof ItemStackResponsePacket response) {
            observeResponse(event,player,s,response);
        } else if(packet instanceof ContainerOpenPacket open) {
            PostSend.schedule(plugin, player, event, ()->forgetWindow(s,open.windowId));
        } else if(packet instanceof ContainerClosePacket close) {
            PostSend.schedule(plugin, player, event, ()->forgetWindow(s,close.windowId));
        } else if(packet instanceof ChangeDimensionPacket) {
            PostSend.schedule(plugin, player, event, ()-> {s.uiRevision++;s.pending.clear();});
        }
    }
    private static void forgetWindow(Session session,int id) {
        if(id==ContainerIds.INVENTORY||id==ContainerIds.OFFHAND||id==ContainerIds.ARMOR||id==ContainerIds.UI)return;
        session.uiRevision++;
        int windowId=id&0xff;
        session.pending.keySet().removeIf(slot->slot.container()==windowId
                ||slot.container()==ContainerIds.UI&&slot.index()!=0);
    }
    private void observeSend(DataPacketSendEvent event,Player player,Session session,Slot slot,Item item) {
        Pending pending=session.pending.get(slot);
        if(pending==null)return;
        Item snapshot=copy(item);
        PostSend.schedule(plugin, player, event, ()-> {
            if(sessions.get(player)==session&&session.pending.get(slot)==pending)pending.sent=snapshot;
        });
    }
    private void observeResponse(DataPacketSendEvent event,Player player,Session session,ItemStackResponsePacket packet) {
        Map<Slot,ResponseSlot> updates=new LinkedHashMap<>();
        long uiRevision=session.uiRevision;
        for(var response:packet.entries) {
            if(response==null||response.getResult()!=ItemStackResponseStatus.OK||response.getContainers()==null)continue;
            for(var container:response.getContainers()) {
                if(container==null||container.getItems()==null)continue;
                var name=container.getContainerName();
                var type=name==null?container.getContainer():name.getContainer();
                if(type==null||type==ContainerSlotType.DYNAMIC_CONTAINER||name!=null&&name.getDynamicId()!=null)continue;
                Inventory inventory;
                try { inventory=NetworkMapping.getInventory(player,type,null); }
                catch(RuntimeException ignored) { continue; }
                if(inventory==null)continue;
                if(type==ContainerSlotType.CURSOR&&inventory instanceof PlayerCursorInventory)inventory=player.getUIInventory();
                if(inventory==null)continue;
                for(var wire:container.getItems()) {
                    if(wire==null)continue;
                    var source=new Source(inventory,NetworkMapping.toInternalSlot(type,wire.getSlot()));
                    if(inventory instanceof FakeBlockUIComponent&&wire.getSlot()==CREATED_OUTPUT
                            &&isWorkstationResult(type)&&player.getTopWindow().orElse(null)==inventory
                            &&player.getUIInventory()!=null) {
                        source=new Source(player.getUIInventory(),CREATED_OUTPUT);
                    }
                    var slot=wireSlot(player,source);
                    if(slot==null||!isCurrent(player,slot,source))continue;
                    Item snapshot=copy(item(source));
                    boolean responseConfirmsEmpty=snapshot.isNull()&&wire.getCount()==0
                            &&wire.getStackNetworkId()==0&&wire.getSlot()==slot.index()
                            &&switch(type) {
                                case HOTBAR, INVENTORY, HOTBAR_AND_INVENTORY -> slot.container()==ContainerIds.INVENTORY;
                                case ARMOR -> slot.container()==ContainerIds.ARMOR;
                                case OFFHAND -> slot.container()==ContainerIds.OFFHAND;
                                default -> false;
                            };
                    updates.put(slot,new ResponseSlot(source,snapshot,responseConfirmsEmpty));
                }
            }
        }
        if(updates.isEmpty())return;
        PostSend.schedule(plugin, player, event, ()-> {
            for(var entry:updates.entrySet()) {
                Slot slot=entry.getKey();ResponseSlot update=entry.getValue();Source source=update.source();
                if(sessions.get(player)!=session||!isCurrent(player,slot,source))continue;
                if(slot.container()==ContainerIds.UI&&slot.index()!=0&&session.uiRevision!=uiRevision)continue;
                var pending=track(player,session,slot,source,true);
                if(!same(update.snapshot(),item(source)))continue;
                if(update.emptyConfirmed())pending.sent=update.snapshot();
                else sendSlot(player,slot,source);
            }
        });
    }
    private static boolean isWorkstationResult(ContainerSlotType type) {
        return switch(type) {
            case ANVIL_RESULT, STONECUTTER_RESULT, LOOM_RESULT, CARTOGRAPHY_RESULT,
                    GRINDSTONE_RESULT, SMITHING_TABLE_RESULT -> true;
            default -> false;
        };
    }
    private static Item copy(Item item) { return item==null||item.isNull()?Item.AIR_ITEM.clone():item.clone(); }
    private static Item item(Source source) { return source.inventory().getItem(source.nativeSlot()); }
    private static boolean isCurrent(Player player,Slot slot,Source source) {
        if(!slot.equals(wireSlot(player,source)))return false;
        return switch(slot.container()) {
            case ContainerIds.INVENTORY,ContainerIds.ARMOR -> player.getInventory()==source.inventory();
            case ContainerIds.OFFHAND -> player.getOffhandInventory()==source.inventory();
            case ContainerIds.UI -> isCurrentUi(player,source.inventory());
            default -> player.getWindowById(slot.container())==source.inventory();
        };
    }
    private static boolean isCurrentUi(Player player,Inventory inventory) {
        var ui=player.getUIInventory();
        if(ui==null)return false;
        if(inventory==ui||inventory==ui.getCursorInventory())return true;
        var top=player.getTopWindow().orElse(null);
        if(inventory instanceof CraftingGrid) {
            return top instanceof CraftingGrid?inventory==top:inventory==player.getCraftingGrid();
        }
        if(inventory instanceof FakeBlockUIComponent) {
            int id=player.getWindowId(inventory);
            return inventory==top&&id>=0&&player.getWindowById(id)==inventory;
        }
        return false;
    }
    private static void sendSlot(Player player,Slot slot,Source source) {
        if(slot.container()==ContainerIds.ARMOR&&source.inventory() instanceof PlayerInventory inventory)
            inventory.sendArmorSlot(source.nativeSlot(),player);
        else if(slot.container()==ContainerIds.UI||slot.container()==ContainerIds.OFFHAND)
            source.inventory().sendSlot(source.nativeSlot(),new Player[]{player});
        else source.inventory().sendSlot(source.nativeSlot(),player);
    }

    public void tick() {
        for(Player player:new ArrayList<>(sessions.keySet())) {
            if(!player.isOnline()){sessions.remove(player);continue;}
            sendTick(player);flushInventory(player);
        }
    }
    public void sendTick(Player player) {
        Session s=sessions.get(player);if(s==null)return;
        int tick=player.getServer().getTick();if(s.tickSent&&s.lastTick==tick)return;
        var packet=new ScriptMessagePacket();packet.channel=CHANNEL;
        packet.message="tick|"+s.nonce+"|"+s.sequence+"|"+tick;
        if(player.dataPacket(packet)){s.sequence++;s.lastTick=tick;s.tickSent=true;}
    }
    public void flushInventory(Player player) {
        Session s=sessions.get(player);if(s==null||s.pending.isEmpty()||player.getServer().getTick()-s.due<0)return;
        for(var entry:new ArrayList<>(s.pending.entrySet())) {
            Slot slot=entry.getKey();Pending pending=entry.getValue();Source source=pending.source;
            if(sessions.get(player)!=s||s.pending.get(slot)!=pending)continue;
            if(!isCurrent(player,slot,source)) {
                s.pending.remove(slot,pending);continue;
            }
            if(pending.sent==null||!same(pending.sent,item(source)))sendSlot(player,slot,source);
            if(pending.sent!=null&&same(pending.sent,item(source)))s.pending.remove(slot,pending);
        }
    }
    private static boolean same(Item a,Item b) {
        if(a==null||a.isNull())return b==null||b.isNull();
        return b!=null&&a.equalsExact(b)&&a.getStackNetId()==b.getStackNetId();
    }
    public void remove(Player player) { sessions.remove(player); }
    public void clear() { sessions.clear(); }
}

`backend/nukkit/src/main/java/ac/navro/bridge/nukkit/NavroFireworkBridge.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.bridge.nukkit;

import cn.nukkit.Player;
import cn.nukkit.entity.item.EntityElytraFirework;
import cn.nukkit.event.EventHandler;
import cn.nukkit.event.EventPriority;
import cn.nukkit.event.Listener;
import cn.nukkit.event.player.PlayerQuitEvent;
import cn.nukkit.event.server.DataPacketSendEvent;
import cn.nukkit.network.protocol.*;
import cn.nukkit.network.protocol.types.MovementEffectType;
import cn.nukkit.plugin.PluginBase;

import java.util.*;




public final class NavroFireworkBridge extends PluginBase implements Listener {
    private final NativeStateSync stateSync=new NativeStateSync(this);
    private final Map<Player, Set<Long>> rockets = new IdentityHashMap<>();
    private long starts, stops, filteredMotion, forwardedMotion;

    @Override public void onEnable() {
        getServer().getPluginManager().registerEvents(this, this);
        getServer().getPluginManager().registerEvents(stateSync, this);
        getServer().getScheduler().scheduleRepeatingTask(this,stateSync::tick,1);
        getServer().callDataPkSendEv=true;
        getLogger().info("NATIVE_STATE_SYNC_READY negotiated server tick and post-event inventory supplements");
        getLogger().info("FIREWORK_BRIDGE_READY standard GLIDE_BOOST; only direct native rocket motion is filtered");
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR, ignoreCancelled = true)
    public void onPacketSend(DataPacketSendEvent event) {
        if (event.isCancelled()) return;
        Player player = event.getPlayer();
        if (player.protocol < ProtocolInfo.v1_21_40) return;
        if (event.getPacket() instanceof AddEntityPacket add) {
            var entity = player.getLevel().getEntity(add.entityRuntimeId);
            if (!(entity instanceof EntityElytraFirework rocket)
                    || rocket.isClosed() || rocket.getFollowingPlayer() != player) return;
            long id = rocket.getId();

            PostSend.schedule(this, player, event, () -> {
                if (rocket.isClosed() || !player.isOnline()) return;
                Set<Long> active = rockets.computeIfAbsent(player, ignored -> new HashSet<>());
                if (!active.add(id)) return;
                if (!sendEffect(player, 1_000_000)) {
                    active.remove(id);
                    if (active.isEmpty()) rockets.remove(player);
                    return;
                }
                starts++;
            });
        } else if (event.getPacket() instanceof RemoveEntityPacket remove) {
            long id = remove.eid;
            PostSend.schedule(this, player, event, () -> {
                var active = rockets.get(player);
                if (active == null || !active.remove(id) || !active.isEmpty()) return;
                rockets.remove(player);
                if (player.isOnline() && sendEffect(player, 0)) stops++;
            });
        } else if (event.getPacket() instanceof SetEntityMotionPacket motion
                && motion.eid == player.getId()) {
            var active = rockets.get(player);
            if (active != null && !active.isEmpty() && directNativeRocketMotion()) {
                event.setCancelled(true);
                filteredMotion++;
            } else {
                forwardedMotion++;
            }
        }
    }





    private static boolean directNativeRocketMotion() {
        var frames = Thread.currentThread().getStackTrace();
        for (int i = 0; i + 1 < frames.length; i++) {
            if (frames[i].getClassName().equals(Player.class.getName())
                    && frames[i].getMethodName().equals("setMotion")) {
                return frames[i + 1].getClassName().equals(EntityElytraFirework.class.getName())
                        && frames[i + 1].getMethodName().equals("onUpdate");
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    private boolean sendEffect(Player player, int duration) {
        return player.dataPacket(new MovementEffectPacket(player.getId(),
                MovementEffectType.GLIDE_BOOST, duration, 0));
    }

    @EventHandler public void onQuit(PlayerQuitEvent event) { rockets.remove(event.getPlayer());stateSync.remove(event.getPlayer()); }

    @Override public void onDisable() {
        for (Player player : new ArrayList<>(rockets.keySet())) {
            if (player.isOnline()) sendEffect(player, 0);
        }
        rockets.clear();stateSync.clear();
        getLogger().info("FIREWORK_BRIDGE_STOPPED starts=" + starts + " stops=" + stops
                + " filteredPropulsion=" + filteredMotion + " preservedMotion=" + forwardedMotion);
    }
}

`backend/nukkit/src/main/java/ac/navro/bridge/nukkit/PostSend.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.bridge.nukkit;

import cn.nukkit.Player;
import cn.nukkit.event.server.DataPacketSendEvent;
import cn.nukkit.plugin.Plugin;

import java.lang.reflect.InvocationTargetException;
import java.lang.reflect.Method;

final class PostSend {
    private static final Method NATIVE_HOOK = nativeHook();

    private PostSend() { }

    static void schedule(Plugin plugin, Player player, DataPacketSendEvent event, Runnable action) {
        if (event.isCancelled()) return;
        if (NATIVE_HOOK != null) {
            try {
                NATIVE_HOOK.invoke(event, action);
                return;
            } catch (IllegalAccessException | InvocationTargetException exception) {
                throw new IllegalStateException("Cannot register post-send action", exception);
            }
        }
        player.getServer().getScheduler().scheduleDelayedTask(plugin, action, 1);
    }

    private static Method nativeHook() {
        try {
            return DataPacketSendEvent.class.getMethod("afterSend", Runnable.class);
        } catch (NoSuchMethodException ignored) {
            return null;
        }
    }
}

`backend/pocketmine-mp/src/ac/navro/bridge/FireworkBridge.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace ac\navro\bridge;

use pocketmine\entity\object\ElytraFireworkRocket;
use pocketmine\event\EventPriority;
use pocketmine\event\server\DataPacketSendEvent;
use pocketmine\network\mcpe\NetworkSession;
use pocketmine\network\mcpe\protocol\AddActorPacket;
use pocketmine\network\mcpe\protocol\MovementEffectPacket;
use pocketmine\network\mcpe\protocol\ProtocolInfo;
use pocketmine\network\mcpe\protocol\SetActorMotionPacket;
use pocketmine\network\mcpe\protocol\types\MovementEffectType;
use pocketmine\network\mcpe\protocol\types\entity\EntityIds;
use pocketmine\player\Player;
use pocketmine\scheduler\ClosureTask;
use WeakMap;

final class FireworkBridge{
    private const MIN_PROTOCOL = 748;
    private const BOOST_DURATION = 1_000_000;


    private WeakMap $active;

    private array $spawns = [];

    public function __construct(private readonly NativeStateSync $stateSync){
        $this->active = new WeakMap();
    }

    public static function isSupported() : bool{
        return class_exists(ElytraFireworkRocket::class) && class_exists(MovementEffectPacket::class)
            && defined(MovementEffectType::class . "::GLIDE_BOOST");
    }

    public function register(NavroBridge $plugin) : void{
        $manager = $plugin->getServer()->getPluginManager();
        $manager->registerEvent(DataPacketSendEvent::class, $this->filterRocketMotion(...), EventPriority::HIGHEST, $plugin);
        $manager->registerEvent(DataPacketSendEvent::class, $this->observeSpawns(...), EventPriority::MONITOR, $plugin);
        $plugin->getScheduler()->scheduleRepeatingTask(new ClosureTask($this->tick(...)), 1);
    }

    private function observeSpawns(DataPacketSendEvent $event) : void{
        foreach($event->getPackets() as $packet){
            if(!$packet instanceof AddActorPacket || $packet->type !== EntityIds::FIREWORKS_ROCKET){
                continue;
            }
            foreach($event->getTargets() as $session){
                $player = $session->getPlayer();
                if($player === null || !$this->stateSync->hasSession($session)){
                    continue;
                }
                $protocol = method_exists($session, "getProtocolId") ? $session->getProtocolId() : ProtocolInfo::CURRENT_PROTOCOL;
                if($protocol < self::MIN_PROTOCOL){
                    continue;
                }
                $rocket = $player->getWorld()->getEntity($packet->actorRuntimeId);
                if($rocket instanceof ElytraFireworkRocket && $rocket->getOwningEntityId() === $player->getId()){
                    $this->spawns[] = [$event, $packet, $session, $rocket];
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private function tick() : void{
        $spawns = $this->spawns;
        $this->spawns = [];
        foreach($spawns as [$event, $packet, $session, $rocket]){
            $player = $session->getPlayer();
            if(!$session->isConnected() || $player === null || $event->isCancelled()
                || !in_array($packet, $event->getPackets(), true) || !$this->isActiveRocket($rocket, $player)){
                continue;
            }
            $rockets = $this->active[$session] ?? [];
            if($rockets === [] && !$this->sendEffect($session, $player, self::BOOST_DURATION)){
                continue;
            }
            $rockets[$rocket->getId()] = true;
            $this->active[$session] = $rockets;
        }

        foreach($this->active as $session => $rockets){
            $player = $session->getPlayer();
            if(!$session->isConnected() || $player === null){
                unset($this->active[$session]);
                continue;
            }
            foreach($rockets as $id => $_){
                $rocket = $player->getWorld()->getEntity($id);
                if(!$rocket instanceof ElytraFireworkRocket || !$this->isActiveRocket($rocket, $player)){
                    unset($rockets[$id]);
                }
            }
            if($rockets === []){
                if($this->sendEffect($session, $player, 0)){
                    unset($this->active[$session]);
                }
            }else{
                $this->active[$session] = $rockets;
            }
        }
    }

    private function isActiveRocket(ElytraFireworkRocket $rocket, Player $player) : bool{
        return !$rocket->isClosed() && !$rocket->isFlaggedForDespawn() && $player->isAlive() && $player->isGliding()
            && $rocket->getWorld() === $player->getWorld() && $rocket->getOwningEntityId() === $player->getId();
    }

    private function filterRocketMotion(DataPacketSendEvent $event) : void{
        $targets = $event->getTargets();
        if(count($targets) !== 1){
            return;
        }
        $session = reset($targets);
        $player = $session->getPlayer();
        $rockets = $this->active[$session] ?? [];
        if($rockets === [] || $player === null){
            return;
        }
        $packets = $event->getPackets();
        $filtered = array_values(array_filter($packets, function($packet) use ($player, $rockets) : bool{
            if(!$packet instanceof SetActorMotionPacket || $packet->actorRuntimeId !== $player->getId()){
                return true;
            }
            $rocket = $this->directRocketCaller($player);
            return $rocket === null || !isset($rockets[$rocket->getId()]);
        }));
        if($filtered === []){
            $event->cancel();
        }elseif(count($filtered) !== count($packets)){
            $event->setPackets($filtered);
        }
    }

    private function directRocketCaller(Player $player) : ?ElytraFireworkRocket{
        $frames = debug_backtrace(DEBUG_BACKTRACE_PROVIDE_OBJECT | DEBUG_BACKTRACE_IGNORE_ARGS);
        foreach($frames as $index => $frame){
            if(($frame["object"] ?? null) === $player && $frame["function"] === "setMotion"){
                $caller = $frames[$index + 1] ?? [];
                $rocket = $caller["object"] ?? null;
                return $rocket instanceof ElytraFireworkRocket && ($caller["function"] ?? "") === "entityBaseTick" ? $rocket : null;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    private function sendEffect(NetworkSession $session, Player $player, int $duration) : bool{
        return $session->sendDataPacket(MovementEffectPacket::create($player->getId(), MovementEffectType::GLIDE_BOOST, $duration, 0));
    }

    public function clear() : void{
        foreach($this->active as $session => $_){
            $player = $session->getPlayer();
            if($session->isConnected() && $player !== null){
                $this->sendEffect($session, $player, 0);
            }
        }
        $this->active = new WeakMap();
        $this->spawns = [];
    }
}

`backend/pocketmine-mp/src/ac/navro/bridge/NativeStateSync.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace ac\navro\bridge;

use pocketmine\event\EventPriority;
use pocketmine\event\inventory\InventoryTransactionEvent;
use pocketmine\event\player\PlayerJoinEvent;
use pocketmine\event\server\DataPacketDecodeEvent;
use pocketmine\event\server\DataPacketReceiveEvent;
use pocketmine\event\server\DataPacketSendEvent;
use pocketmine\inventory\Inventory;
use pocketmine\inventory\transaction\action\SlotChangeAction;
use pocketmine\nbt\BigEndianNbtSerializer;
use pocketmine\nbt\tag\CompoundTag;
use pocketmine\nbt\tag\ListTag;
use pocketmine\nbt\TreeRoot;
use pocketmine\network\mcpe\NetworkSession;
use pocketmine\network\mcpe\protocol\ProtocolInfo;
use pocketmine\network\mcpe\protocol\ScriptMessagePacket;
use pocketmine\network\mcpe\protocol\StartGamePacket;
use pocketmine\network\mcpe\protocol\UpdateBlockPacket;
use pocketmine\network\mcpe\protocol\UpdateSubChunkBlocksPacket;
use pocketmine\scheduler\ClosureTask;
use pocketmine\Server;
use WeakMap;

final class NativeStateSync{
    private const CHANNEL = "navro:backend_sync_v1";
    private const MAX_ALERT_BYTES = 4096;
    private const MAX_PALETTE_BYTES = 512 * 1024;
    private const PALETTE_PART_BYTES = 30_000;


    private WeakMap $sessions;

    private WeakMap $palettes;

    public function __construct(private readonly NavroBridge $plugin){
        $this->sessions = new WeakMap();
        $this->palettes = new WeakMap();
    }

    public function register() : void{
        $plugin = $this->plugin;
        $server = $plugin->getServer();
        $manager = $server->getPluginManager();
        $manager->registerEvent(DataPacketDecodeEvent::class, $this->allowBridgePacket(...), EventPriority::HIGH, $plugin, true);
        $manager->registerEvent(DataPacketReceiveEvent::class, $this->receiveBridgePacket(...), EventPriority::HIGHEST, $plugin);
        $manager->registerEvent(InventoryTransactionEvent::class, $this->rememberSlots(...), EventPriority::MONITOR, $plugin, true);
        $manager->registerEvent(PlayerJoinEvent::class, $this->syncCommandsAfterJoin(...), EventPriority::MONITOR, $plugin);
        $manager->registerEvent(DataPacketSendEvent::class, $this->beforeWorldPacket(...), EventPriority::MONITOR, $plugin);
        $plugin->getScheduler()->scheduleRepeatingTask(new ClosureTask(function() use ($server) : void{
            $this->tick($server);
        }), 1);
    }

    public function hasSession(NetworkSession $session) : bool{
        return isset($this->sessions[$session]);
    }

    private function syncCommandsAfterJoin(PlayerJoinEvent $event) : void{
        $session = $event->getPlayer()->getNetworkSession();
        if(!$this->plugin->trusts($session)){
            return;
        }
        $this->plugin->getScheduler()->scheduleDelayedTask(new ClosureTask(function() use ($session) : void{
            if($session->isConnected()){
                $session->syncAvailableCommands();
            }
        }), 1);
    }

    private function allowBridgePacket(DataPacketDecodeEvent $event) : void{

        if($event->getPacketId() === ScriptMessagePacket::NETWORK_ID && $event->getOrigin()->getPlayer() !== null &&
            $this->plugin->trusts($event->getOrigin())){
            $buffer = $event->getPacketBuffer();
            if(strlen($buffer) <= self::MAX_ALERT_BYTES + 128 && str_contains($buffer, self::CHANNEL)){
                $event->uncancel();
            }
        }
    }

    private function receiveBridgePacket(DataPacketReceiveEvent $event) : void{
        $packet = $event->getPacket();
        if(!$packet instanceof ScriptMessagePacket || $packet->getMessageId() !== self::CHANNEL){
            return;
        }
        $event->cancel();
        $session = $event->getOrigin();
        $player = $session->getPlayer();
        if($player === null || !$this->plugin->trusts($session)){
            return;
        }
        $message = $packet->getValue();
        $state = $this->sessions[$session] ?? null;
        if($state !== null && str_starts_with($message, "alert|{$state->nonce}|")){
            $alert = substr($message, strlen("alert|{$state->nonce}|"));
            if(strlen($alert) <= self::MAX_ALERT_BYTES){
                $this->plugin->displayAlert($alert);
            }
            return;
        }
        if(preg_match('/\Ahello\|([0-9a-f]{8}(?:-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12})\z/', $message, $match) !== 1){
            return;
        }
        $state = new BackendPlayerSync($match[1]);
        $this->sessions[$session] = $state;
        $session->sendDataPacket(ScriptMessagePacket::create(self::CHANNEL, "pm_ready|{$state->nonce}"));
        $this->sendTick($session, $state, $player->getServer()->getTick());
    }

    private function rememberSlots(InventoryTransactionEvent $event) : void{
        $transaction = $event->getTransaction();
        $session = $transaction->getSource()->getNetworkSession();
        $state = $this->sessions[$session] ?? null;
        if($state === null){
            return;
        }
        foreach($transaction->getActions() as $action){
            if($action instanceof SlotChangeAction){
                $state->slotsDue ??= $transaction->getSource()->getServer()->getTick() + 1;
                $inventory = $action->getInventory();
                $slot = $action->getSlot();
                $state->slots[spl_object_id($inventory) . ":" . $slot] = [$inventory, $slot];
            }
        }
    }

    private function beforeWorldPacket(DataPacketSendEvent $event) : void{
        foreach($event->getPackets() as $packet){

            if($packet instanceof StartGamePacket && !$packet->blockNetworkIdsAreHashes){
                foreach($event->getTargets() as $session){
                    if($this->plugin->trusts($session)){
                        $this->sendRuntimePalette($session);
                    }
                }
            }
            if($packet instanceof UpdateBlockPacket || $packet instanceof UpdateSubChunkBlocksPacket){
                foreach($event->getTargets() as $session){
                    $state = $this->sessions[$session] ?? null;
                    $player = $session->getPlayer();
                    if($state !== null && $player !== null){
                        $this->sendTick($session, $state, $player->getServer()->getTick());
                    }
                }
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    private function sendRuntimePalette(NetworkSession $session) : void{
        $dictionary = $session->getTypeConverter()->getBlockTranslator()->getBlockStateDictionary();
        $protocol = method_exists($session, "getProtocolId") ? $session->getProtocolId() : ProtocolInfo::CURRENT_PROTOCOL;
        $states = $dictionary->getStates();
        $cached = $this->palettes[$dictionary][$protocol] ?? null;
        $message = $cached["message"] ?? "";
        if($cached === null || $cached["states"] !== $states){
            try{
                $ordered = $states;
                ksort($ordered, SORT_NUMERIC);
                if(!array_is_list($ordered) || count($ordered) > 131072){
                    throw new \RuntimeException("Invalid runtime block state table");
                }
                $serialized = array_map(static fn($entry) => $entry->generateStateData()->toNbt(), $ordered);
                $root = CompoundTag::create()->setInt("protocol", $protocol)->setTag("states", new ListTag($serialized));
                $compressed = gzencode((new BigEndianNbtSerializer())->write(new TreeRoot($root)));
                if($compressed === false){
                    throw new \RuntimeException("Could not compress runtime block palette");
                }
                $message = "palette|" . base64_encode($compressed);
                if(strlen($message) > self::MAX_PALETTE_BYTES){
                    throw new \RuntimeException("Runtime block palette exceeds the bridge limit");
                }
            }catch(\Throwable $error){
                $this->plugin->getLogger()->warning("Could not send the runtime block palette: " . $error->getMessage());
                $message = "";
            }
            $entries = $this->palettes[$dictionary] ?? [];
            $entries[$protocol] = ["states" => $states, "message" => $message];
            $this->palettes[$dictionary] = $entries;
        }
        if($message === ""){
            return;
        }
        if(strlen($message) <= self::PALETTE_PART_BYTES){
            $session->sendDataPacket(ScriptMessagePacket::create(self::CHANNEL, $message));
            return;
        }
        $parts = str_split($message, self::PALETTE_PART_BYTES);
        foreach($parts as $index => $part){
            if(!$session->sendDataPacket(ScriptMessagePacket::create(
                self::CHANNEL, "palette_part|" . $index . "|" . count($parts) . "|" . $part
            ))){
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    private function tick(Server $server) : void{
        $tick = $server->getTick();
        foreach($this->sessions as $session => $state){
            if(!$session->isConnected()){
                unset($this->sessions[$session]);
                continue;
            }
            $this->sendTick($session, $state, $tick);
            if($state->slotsDue === null || $state->slotsDue > $tick){
                continue;
            }
            $slots = $state->slots;
            $state->slots = [];
            $state->slotsDue = null;
            $manager = $session->getInvManager();
            if($manager === null){
                continue;
            }
            foreach($slots as [$inventory, $slot]){

                if($inventory->slotExists($slot) && $manager->getItemStackInfo($inventory, $slot) !== null){
                    $item = $session->getTypeConverter()->coreItemStackToNet($inventory->getItem($slot));
                    $manager->syncSlot($inventory, $slot, $item);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private function sendTick(NetworkSession $session, BackendPlayerSync $state, int $tick) : void{
        if($state->lastTick === $tick){
            return;
        }
        $state->lastTick = $tick;
        $session->sendDataPacket(ScriptMessagePacket::create(
            self::CHANNEL,
            "tick|{$state->nonce}|{$state->sequence}|$tick"
        ));
        ++$state->sequence;
    }
}

final class BackendPlayerSync{
    public int $sequence = 0;
    public ?int $lastTick = null;
    public ?int $slotsDue = null;

    public array $slots = [];

    public function __construct(public readonly string $nonce){}
}

`backend/pocketmine-mp/src/ac/navro/bridge/NavroBridge.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace ac\navro\bridge;

use pocketmine\command\Command;
use pocketmine\command\CommandSender;
use pocketmine\network\mcpe\NetworkSession;
use pocketmine\player\Player;
use pocketmine\plugin\PluginBase;
use pocketmine\utils\Config;
use pocketmine\utils\TextFormat;

final class NavroBridge extends PluginBase{

    private array $trustedProxies;
    private bool $consoleAlerts;
    private bool $staffChatAlerts;
    private Config $mutedPlayers;
    private ?FireworkBridge $fireworks = null;

    protected function onEnable() : void{
        $this->saveDefaultConfig();
        $config = $this->getConfig();
        $trusted = $config->get("trusted-proxy-addresses", ["127.0.0.1", "::1"]);
        $this->trustedProxies = is_array($trusted) ? array_values(array_filter($trusted, "is_string")) : [];
        $this->consoleAlerts = $config->get("console-alerts", true) === true;
        $this->staffChatAlerts = $config->get("staff-chat-alerts", true) === true;
        $this->mutedPlayers = new Config($this->getDataFolder() . "muted-alerts.json", Config::JSON);
        $stateSync = new NativeStateSync($this);
        $stateSync->register();
        if(FireworkBridge::isSupported()){
            $this->fireworks = new FireworkBridge($stateSync);
            $this->fireworks->register($this);
        }
    }

    protected function onDisable() : void{
        $this->fireworks?->clear();
        $this->fireworks = null;
    }

    public function onCommand(CommandSender $sender, Command $command, string $label, array $args) : bool{
        if($command->getName() !== "navroalerts" || $args !== []){
            return false;
        }
        if(!$sender instanceof Player){
            $sender->sendMessage("Run this command in game to toggle your chat alerts.");
            return true;
        }
        if(!$sender->hasPermission("navrobridge.alerts")){
            $sender->sendMessage("You do not have permission to receive Navro chat alerts.");
            return true;
        }
        if(!$this->staffChatAlerts){
            $sender->sendMessage("Navro chat alerts are disabled in the server configuration.");
            return true;
        }

        $uuid = $sender->getUniqueId()->toString();
        $enabled = $this->mutedPlayers->exists($uuid);
        if($enabled){
            $this->mutedPlayers->remove($uuid);
        }else{
            $this->mutedPlayers->set($uuid, true);
        }
        $this->mutedPlayers->save();
        $sender->sendMessage($enabled ? "Navro chat alerts enabled." : "Navro chat alerts disabled.");
        return true;
    }

    public function trusts(NetworkSession $session) : bool{
        return in_array($session->getIp(), $this->trustedProxies, true);
    }

    public function displayAlert(string $message) : void{
        $message = preg_replace('/\p{Cc}/u', ' ', $message);
        if($message === null || trim($message) === ""){
            return;
        }
        if($this->consoleAlerts){
            $this->getLogger()->info(TextFormat::clean($message));
        }
        if($this->staffChatAlerts){
            foreach($this->getServer()->getOnlinePlayers() as $player){
                if($player->hasPermission("navrobridge.alerts") &&
                    !$this->mutedPlayers->exists($player->getUniqueId()->toString())){
                    $player->sendMessage($message);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

`gradlew`:

```
#!/bin/sh




app_path=$0

while
    APP_HOME=${app_path%"${app_path##*/}"}
    [ -h "$app_path" ]
do
    ls=$( ls -ld "$app_path" )
    link=${ls#*' -> '}
    case $link in
      /*)   app_path=$link ;;
      *)    app_path=$APP_HOME$link ;;
    esac
done

APP_HOME=$( cd "${APP_HOME:-./}" && pwd -P ) || exit

APP_NAME="Gradle"
APP_BASE_NAME=${0##*/}

DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS='"-Xmx64m" "-Xms64m"'

MAX_FD=maximum

warn () {
    echo "$*"
} >&2

die () {
    echo
    echo "$*"
    echo
    exit 1
} >&2

cygwin=false
msys=false
darwin=false
nonstop=false
case "$( uname )" in
  CYGWIN* )         cygwin=true  ;;
  Darwin* )         darwin=true  ;;
  MSYS* | MINGW* )  msys=true    ;;
  NONSTOP* )        nonstop=true ;;
esac

CLASSPATH=$APP_HOME/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar


if [ -n "$JAVA_HOME" ] ; then
    if [ -x "$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/java" ] ; then
        JAVACMD=$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/java
    else
        JAVACMD=$JAVA_HOME/bin/java
    fi
    if [ ! -x "$JAVACMD" ] ; then
        die "ERROR: JAVA_HOME is set to an invalid directory: $JAVA_HOME

Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the
location of your Java installation."
    fi
else
    JAVACMD=java
    which java >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "ERROR: JAVA_HOME is not set and no 'java' command could be found in your PATH.

Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the
location of your Java installation."
fi

if ! "$cygwin" && ! "$darwin" && ! "$nonstop" ; then
    case $MAX_FD in
      max*)
        MAX_FD=$( ulimit -H -n ) ||
            warn "Could not query maximum file descriptor limit"
    esac
    case $MAX_FD in
      '' | soft) :;;
      *)
        ulimit -n "$MAX_FD" ||
            warn "Could not set maximum file descriptor limit to $MAX_FD"
    esac
fi


if "$cygwin" || "$msys" ; then
    APP_HOME=$( cygpath --path --mixed "$APP_HOME" )
    CLASSPATH=$( cygpath --path --mixed "$CLASSPATH" )

    JAVACMD=$( cygpath --unix "$JAVACMD" )

    for arg do
        if
            case $arg in
              -*)   false ;;
              /?*)  t=${arg#/} t=/${t%%/*}
                    [ -e "$t" ] ;;
              *)    false ;;
            esac
        then
            arg=$( cygpath --path --ignore --mixed "$arg" )
        fi
        shift
        set -- "$@" "$arg"
    done
fi


set -- \
        "-Dorg.gradle.appname=$APP_BASE_NAME" \
        -classpath "$CLASSPATH" \
        org.gradle.wrapper.GradleWrapperMain \
        "$@"


eval "set -- $(
        printf '%s\n' "$DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS $JAVA_OPTS $GRADLE_OPTS" |
        xargs -n1 |
        sed ' s~[^-[:alnum:]+,./:=@_]~\\&~g; ' |
        tr '\n' ' '
    )" '"$@"'

exec "$JAVACMD" "$@"

```bat

@if "%DEBUG%" == "" @echo off

if "%OS%"=="Windows_NT" setlocal

set DIRNAME=%~dp0
if "%DIRNAME%" == "" set DIRNAME=.
set APP_BASE_NAME=%~n0
set APP_HOME=%DIRNAME%
