`nethernet/inspect/main.go`:

```go
package main

import (
	"bufio"
	"context"
	"crypto/ecdsa"
	"crypto/elliptic"
	"crypto/rand"
	"crypto/x509"
	"encoding/binary"
	"errors"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"log/slog"
	"net"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"os/signal"
	"path/filepath"
	"syscall"
	"time"

	"github.com/helix-bedrock/nethernet"
	"github.com/helix-bedrock/nethernet/endpoint"
	"github.com/pion/webrtc/v4"
)

func rtcAPI(local string) (*webrtc.API, error) {
	var s webrtc.SettingEngine
	nethernet.ApplySettings(&s)
	s.SetIncludeLoopbackCandidate(true)
	s.SetNetworkTypes([]webrtc.NetworkType{webrtc.NetworkTypeUDP4})
	if local != "" {
		ip := net.ParseIP(local)
		if ip == nil || ip.To4() == nil || ip.IsUnspecified() {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("local-ip must be a local IPv4 address")
		}
		s.SetIPFilter(func(candidate net.IP) bool { return candidate.IsLoopback() || candidate.Equal(ip) })
	}
	if err := s.SetEphemeralUDPPortRange(19210, 19273); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return webrtc.NewAPI(webrtc.WithSettingEngine(s)), nil
}

func main() {
	listen := flag.String("listen", "0.0.0.0:19132", "Independent inspection HTTP/TCP signaling listener")
	backend := flag.String("backend", "http://127.0.0.1:19134", "NetherNet backend")
	adapter := flag.String("adapter", "127.0.0.1:19138", "Loopback Java native-batch adapter")
	local := flag.String("local-ip", "", "Optional local IPv4 filter for ICE candidates (default: automatic interface discovery)")
	keyPath := flag.String("identity", "keys/inspect-identity.pem", "Persistent public listener identity key")
	offline := flag.Bool("offline-backend", false, "Re-sign verified frontend login for a private offline NetherNet backend")
	stock := flag.Bool("stock-geyser-backend", false, "Use stock private NetherNet Geyser with WaterdogPE forwarding")
	detect := flag.Bool("detect", false, "Enable the existing Navro checks and corrections on this independent connection")
	flag.Parse()
	if err := run(*listen, *backend, *adapter, *local, *keyPath, *offline, *detect, *stock); err != nil {
		slog.Error("inspect stopped", "error", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}
func run(listen, backend, adapter, local, keyPath string, offline, detect, stock bool) error {
	if stock && (!detect || offline) {
		return errors.New("stock Geyser mode requires -detect and is separate from -offline-backend")
	}
	if detect && !offline && !stock {
		return errors.New("detection currently requires an explicitly private offline backend")
	}
	if offline || stock {
		u, err := url.Parse(backend)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		ip := net.ParseIP(u.Hostname())
		if ip == nil || !ip.IsLoopback() || (stock && (u.Scheme != "http" || u.Port() == "" || u.User != nil)) {
			return errors.New("private backend login requires an explicit loopback endpoint")
		}
	}
	host, _, err := net.SplitHostPort(adapter)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if ip := net.ParseIP(host); ip == nil || !ip.IsLoopback() {
		return fmt.Errorf("batch adapter must be loopback")
	}
	api, err := rtcAPI(local)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	backendAPI := api
	if stock {
		backendAPI, err = rtcAPI("127.0.0.1")
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	key, saved, err := nethernet.LoadOrGenerateIdentityKey(keyPath)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if !saved {
		if err = os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(keyPath), 0700); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err = nethernet.SaveIdentityKey(keyPath, key); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	h, err := endpoint.Serve(listen)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer h.Close()
	mode := "INSPECT"
	if detect {
		mode = "DETECT"
	}
	ctx, cancel := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM)
	defer cancel()
	go mirrorBackendStatus(ctx, h, backend)
	l, err := (nethernet.ListenConfig{API: api, DisableTrickleICE: true, AllowAnonymous: false,
		IssueServerIdentity: func(context.Context) (*nethernet.Identity, error) {
			return nethernet.ServerIdentity(key, "")
		},
	}).Listen(h)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer l.Close()
	go func() { <-ctx.Done(); l.Close(); h.Close() }()
	slog.Info("NETHERNET_TERMINATING_READY", "listen", listen, "backend", backend, "adapter", adapter, "mode", mode, "raknet", false)
	for {
		c, err := l.Accept()
		if err != nil {
			if ctx.Err() != nil {
				return nil
			}
			return err
		}
		go func(front *nethernet.Conn) {
			if err := session(front, backend, adapter, backendAPI, offline, detect, stock); err != nil {
				slog.Info("inspect_session_closed", "error", err)
			}
		}(c.(*nethernet.Conn))
	}
}

type event struct {
	backend bool
	batch   []byte
	err     error
	tick    bool
}

func session(front *nethernet.Conn, backend, adapter string, api *webrtc.API, offline, detect, stock bool) error {
	defer front.Close()
	if front.PublicKey() == nil {
		return errors.New("missing frontend DTLS identity")
	}
	ipc, err := net.DialTimeout("tcp", adapter, 5*time.Second)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer ipc.Close()
	public, err := x509.MarshalPKIXPublicKey(front.PublicKey())
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	key, err := ecdsa.GenerateKey(elliptic.P384(), rand.Reader)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	out := bufio.NewWriter(ipc)
	in := bufio.NewReader(ipc)
	magic := uint32(0x4e564231)
	if stock {
		magic = stockBridgeMagic
	} else if offline {
		magic = 0x4e564233
	}
	binary.Write(out, binary.BigEndian, magic)
	binary.Write(out, binary.BigEndian, uint32(len(public)))
	out.Write(public)
	if offline || stock {
		pub, err := x509.MarshalPKIXPublicKey(&key.PublicKey)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		priv, err := x509.MarshalPKCS8PrivateKey(key)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		binary.Write(out, binary.BigEndian, uint32(len(pub)))
		out.Write(pub)
		binary.Write(out, binary.BigEndian, uint32(len(priv)))
		out.Write(priv)
		clear(priv)
		if stock {
			ip := selectedIP(front)
			if ip == nil {
				return errors.New("missing frontend ICE address")
			}
			out.WriteByte(byte(len(ip)))
			out.Write(ip)
		} else if detect {
			out.WriteByte(1)
		} else {
			out.WriteByte(0)
		}
	}
	if err = out.Flush(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if stock {
		if err := ipc.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(10 * time.Second)); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		var accepted uint32
		if err := binary.Read(in, binary.BigEndian, &accepted); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("stock Geyser adapter handshake: %w", err)
		}
		if accepted != magic {
			return errors.New("stock Geyser adapter did not confirm detection")
		}
	}

	identity, err := nethernet.SelfSignedIdentity(key, "https://authorization.franchise.minecraft-services.net/")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 25*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	signaling := endpoint.NewClient()
	if stock {
		signaling = stockSignaling()
	}
	back, err := (nethernet.Dialer{API: api, Identity: identity, DisableTrickleICE: true}).DialContext(ctx, backend, signaling)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer back.Close()
	if stock {
		if !selectedIP(back).IsLoopback() {
			return errors.New("stock Geyser media is outside loopback")
		}
		return stockBridge(front, back, ipc, in, out)
	}
	events := make(chan event, 8)
	done := make(chan struct{})
	defer close(done)
	reader := func(c *nethernet.Conn, backend bool) {
		for {
			b, err := c.ReadPacket()
			select {
			case events <- event{backend: backend, batch: b, err: err}:
			case <-done:
				return
			}
			if err != nil {
				return
			}
		}
	}
	go reader(front, false)
	go reader(back, true)
	ticker := time.NewTicker(50 * time.Millisecond)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	for {
		var e event
		select {
		case <-front.Context().Done():
			return front.Context().Err()
		case <-back.Context().Done():
			return back.Context().Err()
		case e = <-events:
			if e.err != nil {
				return e.err
			}
		case <-ticker.C:
			if !offline {
				continue
			}
			e.tick = true
		}
		ipc.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(30 * time.Second))
		direction := byte(0)
		if e.backend {
			direction = 1
		}
		if e.tick {
			direction = 2
		}
		out.WriteByte(direction)
		binary.Write(out, binary.BigEndian, uint32(len(e.batch)))
		out.Write(e.batch)
		if err = out.Flush(); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		var size int32
		if err = binary.Read(in, binary.BigEndian, &size); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("native batch adapter: %w", err)
		}
		if size < -1 || size > 16<<20 {
			return errors.New("invalid adapter result length")
		}
		if size >= 0 {
			b := make([]byte, int(size))
			if _, err = io.ReadFull(in, b); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			dst := back
			if e.backend {
				dst = front
			}
			if _, err = dst.Write(b); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		var count uint32
		if err = binary.Read(in, binary.BigEndian, &count); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if count > 4096 {
			return errors.New("too many adapter outputs")
		}
		for range count {
			var n uint32
			if err = binary.Read(in, binary.BigEndian, &n); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if n == 0 || n > 16<<20 {
				return errors.New("invalid adapter output size")
			}
			b := make([]byte, int(n))
			if _, err = io.ReadFull(in, b); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if _, err = front.Write(b); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		if offline {
			if err = binary.Read(in, binary.BigEndian, &count); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if count > 4096 {
				return errors.New("too many deferred backend packets")
			}
			for range count {
				var n uint32
				if err = binary.Read(in, binary.BigEndian, &n); err != nil {
					return err
				}
				if n == 0 || n > 16<<20 {
					return errors.New("invalid backend packet size")
				}
				b := make([]byte, int(n))
				if _, err = io.ReadFull(in, b); err != nil {
					return err
				}
				if _, err = back.Write(b); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
```

```go
package main

import (
	"context"
	"time"

	"github.com/helix-bedrock/nethernet/endpoint"
)

func refreshBackendStatus(ctx context.Context, handler *endpoint.Handler, backend string) error {
	query, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 3*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	status, err := endpoint.NewClient().Status(query, backend)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	status.OnlineAuth = true
	status.SelfSignedAuth = false
	handler.Status(status)
	return nil
}

func mirrorBackendStatus(ctx context.Context, handler *endpoint.Handler, backend string) {
	ticker := time.NewTicker(5 * time.Second)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	for {
		_ = refreshBackendStatus(ctx, handler, backend)
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return
		case <-ticker.C:
		}
	}
}
```

`nethernet/inspect/stock.go`:

```go
package main

import (
	"bufio"
	"encoding/binary"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"time"

	"github.com/helix-bedrock/nethernet"
	"github.com/helix-bedrock/nethernet/endpoint"
)

const stockBridgeMagic = 0x4e564236

func selectedIP(conn *nethernet.Conn) net.IP {
	address, ok := conn.RemoteAddr().(*nethernet.Addr)
	if !ok || address.SelectedCandidate == nil {
		return nil
	}
	ip := net.ParseIP(address.SelectedCandidate.Address)
	if v4 := ip.To4(); v4 != nil {
		return v4
	}
	return ip
}

func stockSignaling() *endpoint.Client {
	return (endpoint.ClientConfig{HTTPClient: &http.Client{
		Transport: &http.Transport{
			DialContext:     (&net.Dialer{Timeout: 5 * time.Second}).DialContext,
			IdleConnTimeout: 5 * time.Second,
		},
		CheckRedirect: func(*http.Request, []*http.Request) error {
			return http.ErrUseLastResponse
		},
	}}).New()
}

func stockBridge(front, back *nethernet.Conn, ipc net.Conn, in *bufio.Reader, out *bufio.Writer) error {
	const maxGroupCount = 64
	const maxGroupBytes = 2 << 20


	events := make(chan event)
	done := make(chan struct{})
	defer close(done)
	read := func(conn *nethernet.Conn, backend bool) {
		for {
			batch, err := conn.ReadPacket()
			select {
			case events <- event{batch: batch, backend: backend, err: err}:
			case <-done:
				return
			}
			if err != nil {
				return
			}
		}
	}
	go read(front, false)
	go read(back, true)
	ticker := time.NewTicker(50 * time.Millisecond)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	group := make([]event, 0, maxGroupCount)
	var carry *event
	for {
		var first event
		if carry != nil {
			first, carry = *carry, nil
		} else {
			select {
			case <-front.Context().Done():
				return front.Context().Err()
			case <-back.Context().Done():
				return back.Context().Err()
			case <-ticker.C:
				first.tick = true
			case first = <-events:
			}
		}
		if first.err != nil {
			return first.err
		}
		group = append(group[:0], first)
		size := len(first.batch)
	drain:
		for len(group) < maxGroupCount && size < maxGroupBytes {
			select {
			case next := <-events:
				if next.err != nil || len(next.batch) > maxGroupBytes-size {
					carry = &next
					break drain
				}
				group = append(group, next)
				size += len(next.batch)
			default:
				break drain
			}
		}
		if err := exchangeStockGroup(front, back, ipc, in, out, group); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		clear(group)
	}
}

func exchangeStockGroup(front, back *nethernet.Conn, ipc net.Conn, in *bufio.Reader, out *bufio.Writer, group []event) error {
	const maxBatch = 16 << 20
	if err := ipc.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(30 * time.Second)); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := out.WriteByte(byte(len(group))); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, item := range group {
		if len(item.batch) > maxBatch || (len(item.batch) == 0) != item.tick {
			return errors.New("invalid NetherNet batch size")
		}
		direction := byte(0)
		if item.backend {
			direction = 1
		} else if item.tick {
			direction = 2
		}
		if err := out.WriteByte(direction); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := binary.Write(out, binary.BigEndian, uint32(len(item.batch))); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if _, err := out.Write(item.batch); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if err := out.Flush(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, item := range group {
		var size int32
		if err := binary.Read(in, binary.BigEndian, &size); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("stock Geyser adapter reply: %w", err)
		}
		if size != -1 {
			if item.tick {
				return errors.New("unexpected forwarded tick")
			}
			dst := back
			if item.backend {
				dst = front
			}
			if err := forwardStockBatch(in, dst, size); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		for _, dst := range []*nethernet.Conn{front, back} {
			var count uint32
			if err := binary.Read(in, binary.BigEndian, &count); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if count > 4096 {
				return errors.New("too many stock Geyser adapter outputs")
			}
			for range count {
				if err := binary.Read(in, binary.BigEndian, &size); err != nil {
					return err
				}
				if err := forwardStockBatch(in, dst, size); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func forwardStockBatch(in io.Reader, dst *nethernet.Conn, size int32) error {
	if size <= 0 || size > 16<<20 {
		return errors.New("invalid stock Geyser adapter output size")
	}
	batch := make([]byte, int(size))
	if _, err := io.ReadFull(in, batch); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, err := dst.Write(batch)
	return err
}
```

`nethernet/probe/main.go`:

```go
package main

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/ecdsa"
	"crypto/elliptic"
	"crypto/rand"
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/hex"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"time"

	"github.com/helix-bedrock/nethernet"
	"github.com/helix-bedrock/nethernet/endpoint"
	"github.com/pion/webrtc/v4"
)

func main() {
	address := flag.String("address", "http://127.0.0.1:19134", "NetherNet HTTP endpoint")
	protocol := flag.Int("protocol", 2225, "Bedrock protocol")
	identity := flag.Bool("identity", true, "Include a self-signed probe identity")
	flag.Parse()
	if err := run(*address, *protocol, *identity); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

func run(address string, protocol int, withIdentity bool) error {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 25*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	var settings webrtc.SettingEngine
	nethernet.ApplySettings(&settings)
	settings.SetIncludeLoopbackCandidate(true)
	settings.SetNetworkTypes([]webrtc.NetworkType{webrtc.NetworkTypeUDP4})
	api := webrtc.NewAPI(webrtc.WithSettingEngine(settings))
	d := nethernet.Dialer{DisableTrickleICE: true, API: api}
	if withIdentity {
		key, err := ecdsa.GenerateKey(elliptic.P384(), rand.Reader)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		d.Identity, err = nethernet.SelfSignedIdentity(key, "Navro transport probe")
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	c, err := d.DialContext(ctx, address, endpoint.NewClient())
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("NetherNet connect: %w", err)
	}
	defer c.Close()
	fmt.Println("NETHERNET_WEBRTC_READY")


	request := []byte{6, 0xc1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0}
	binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(request[3:], uint32(protocol))
	if _, err = c.Write(request); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	result := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() {
		b, err := c.ReadPacket()
		if err != nil {
			result <- err
			return
		}
		fmt.Println("BEDROCK_BATCH", hex.EncodeToString(b))
		if len(b) < 3 {
			result <- fmt.Errorf("unexpected Bedrock batch")
			return
		}
		_, size := binary.Uvarint(b)
		if size <= 0 {
			result <- fmt.Errorf("bad frame length")
			return
		}
		id, _ := binary.Uvarint(b[size:])
		if id&0x3ff != 143 {
			result <- fmt.Errorf("unexpected packet id %d", id&0x3ff)
			return
		}
		fmt.Println("RESULT NetworkSettingsPacket via independent NetherNet")
		result <- nil
	}()
	select {
	case err := <-result:
		return err
	case <-ctx.Done():
		return ctx.Err()
	}
}
```

`nethernet/relay.py`:

```py





from collections import deque
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
import argparse
import http.client
import ipaddress
import logging
import selectors
import signal
import socket
import threading
import time

LOG = logging.getLogger('nethernet')
MAX_SDP = 65536


def candidates(sdp):
    result = []
    for line in sdp.splitlines():
        if not line.startswith('a=candidate:'):
            continue
        words = line.split()
        if len(words) < 8 or words[1] != '1' or words[2].lower() != 'udp':
            continue
        try:
            ip = ipaddress.ip_address(words[4])
            port = int(words[5])
        except ValueError:
            continue
        if ip.version == 4 and not ip.is_unspecified and 0 < port < 65536:
            result.append((str(ip), port))
    return result


def rewrite_candidates(sdp, ip, port):

    lines = []
    inserted = False
    for line in sdp.splitlines():
        if line.startswith('a=candidate:'):
            words = line.split()
            if not inserted and len(words) >= 8 and words[1] == '1' and words[2].lower() == 'udp':
                lines.append(f'a=candidate:navro 1 UDP {words[3]} {ip} {port} typ host')
                inserted = True
            continue
        lines.append(line)
    if not inserted:
        raise ValueError('SDP has no supported UDP candidate')
    return '\r\n'.join(lines) + '\r\n'


class Session:
    def __init__(self, owner, peer_ip, destination_ip, offer):
        self.owner = owner
        self.peer_ip = peer_ip
        self.front = owner.allocate_media()
        self.back = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
        self.back.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
        self.backend_peer = None
        self.backend_allowed_ips = {owner.backend_ip}
        self.peer = next((p for p in candidates(offer) if p[0] == peer_ip), None)
        self.peer_locked = False
        self.advertised_ip = owner.advertise or destination_ip
        self.pending = deque(maxlen=32)
        self.closed = threading.Event()
        self.close_lock = threading.Lock()
        self.last_activity = time.monotonic()
        self.packets = [0, 0]
        self.bytes = [0, 0]
        self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self.run, daemon=True)
        self.thread.start()

    def answer(self, sdp):
        options = candidates(sdp)


        target = next((p for p in options if p[0] == self.owner.backend_ip), None)
        if target is None:



            for option in options:
                with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM) as check:
                    try:
                        check.bind((option[0], 0))
                        target = option
                        break
                    except OSError:
                        continue
        if target is None:
            LOG.info('upstream_candidates %s', options)
            raise ValueError('Backend SDP has no verified local candidate')
        self.backend_peer = target
        self.backend_allowed_ips.add(target[0])
        return rewrite_candidates(sdp, self.advertised_ip, self.front.getsockname()[1])

    def run(self):
        selector = selectors.DefaultSelector()
        try:
            selector.register(self.front, selectors.EVENT_READ, 0)
            selector.register(self.back, selectors.EVENT_READ, 1)
            while not self.closed.is_set():
                if time.monotonic() - self.last_activity > self.owner.idle:
                    break
                for key, _ in selector.select(.5):
                    data, source = key.fileobj.recvfrom(65536)
                    direction = key.data
                    if direction == 0:
                        if source[0] != self.peer_ip or self.peer_locked and source != self.peer:
                            continue
                        self.peer = source
                        self.peer_locked = True
                        if self.backend_peer is None:
                            continue
                        self.back.sendto(data, self.backend_peer)
                        while self.pending:
                            self.front.sendto(self.pending.popleft(), self.peer)
                    else:
                        if source[0] not in self.backend_allowed_ips:
                            continue
                        if self.backend_peer is not None and source != self.backend_peer:
                            continue


                        if self.peer is None:
                            self.pending.append(data)
                        else:
                            self.front.sendto(data, self.peer)
                    self.last_activity = time.monotonic()
                    self.packets[direction] += 1
                    self.bytes[direction] += len(data)
        except OSError as error:
            if not self.closed.is_set():
                LOG.info('media_closed port=%d reason=%s', self.front.getsockname()[1], error)
        finally:
            selector.close()
            self.close()

    def close(self):
        with self.close_lock:
            if self.closed.is_set():
                return
            self.closed.set()
            port = self.front.getsockname()[1]
            self.front.close()
            self.back.close()
        self.owner.remove(self)
        LOG.info('session_closed media=%d packets=%s bytes=%s', port, self.packets, self.bytes)


class Relay(ThreadingHTTPServer):
    daemon_threads = True
    def __init__(self, bind, backend, media, advertise='', idle=90):
        self.backend = backend
        self.backend_ip = socket.gethostbyname(backend[0])
        if not ipaddress.ip_address(self.backend_ip).is_loopback:
            raise ValueError('This relay currently supports a local NetherNet backend only')
        self.media = media
        self.advertise = advertise
        self.idle = idle
        self.sessions = set()
        self.lock = threading.Lock()
        super().__init__(bind, Handler)

    def allocate_media(self):
        for port in range(self.media[0], self.media[1] + 1):
            s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
            try:
                s.bind(('0.0.0.0', port))
                return s
            except OSError:
                s.close()
        raise OSError('No independent NetherNet media ports available')

    def add(self, session):
        with self.lock:
            self.sessions.add(session)

    def remove(self, session):
        with self.lock:
            self.sessions.discard(session)

    def server_close(self):
        with self.lock:
            sessions = list(self.sessions)
        for session in sessions:
            session.close()
        super().server_close()


class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = 'HTTP/1.1'
    def handle(self):
        self.connection.settimeout(15)
        try:
            prefix = self.connection.recv(2, socket.MSG_PEEK)
            if prefix == b'\x16\x03':
                self.connection.sendall(b'\x15\x03\x01\x00\x02\x02\x28')
                return
            super().handle()
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            return

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        LOG.info('http peer=%s %s', self.client_address[0], fmt % args)

    def do_GET(self):
        self.forward(b'')

    def do_POST(self):
        if not self.path.startswith('/v1/join/'):
            self.send_error(404)
            return
        try:
            length = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length', '-1'))
            if length <= 0 or length > MAX_SDP:
                raise ValueError('Missing or oversized SDP')
            body = self.rfile.read(length)
            if len(body) != length:
                raise ValueError('Truncated SDP')
            offer = body.decode('utf-8')
            if not candidates(offer):
                raise ValueError('Offer has no supported UDP candidate')
            session = Session(self.server, self.client_address[0], self.connection.getsockname()[0], offer)
            self.server.add(session)
            rewritten = rewrite_candidates(offer, '127.0.0.1', session.back.getsockname()[1]).encode()
        except (ValueError, OSError) as error:
            self.send_error(400, str(error))
            return


        self.forward(rewritten, session)

    def forward(self, body, session=None):
        backend = http.client.HTTPConnection(*self.server.backend, timeout=25)
        try:
            headers = {k: v for k, v in self.headers.items()
                       if k.lower() not in {'host', 'connection', 'content-length', 'transfer-encoding', 'expect'}}
            headers['Content-Length'] = str(len(body))
            headers['Connection'] = 'close'
            backend.request(self.command, self.path, body=body, headers=headers)
            response = backend.getresponse()
            data = response.read(MAX_SDP + 1)
            if len(data) > MAX_SDP:
                raise ValueError('Oversized upstream response')
            if session is not None:
                if response.status != 200 or not data.startswith(b'v=0'):
                    session.close()
                else:
                    data = session.answer(data.decode()).encode()
                    LOG.info('session_ready peer=%s media=%d upstream=%s',
                             self.client_address[0], session.front.getsockname()[1], session.backend_peer)
            self.send_response_only(response.status, response.reason)
            self.send_header('Content-Type', response.getheader('Content-Type', 'application/sdp'))
            self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(data)))
            self.send_header('Connection', 'close')
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(data)
            self.close_connection = True
        except (OSError, ValueError, http.client.HTTPException) as error:
            if session is not None:
                session.close()
            LOG.info('upstream_error %s', error)
            self.send_error(502, 'NetherNet upstream failed')
        finally:
            backend.close()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--listen', default='0.0.0.0:19136')
    parser.add_argument('--backend', default='127.0.0.1:19134')
    parser.add_argument('--media', default='19140-19203')
    parser.add_argument('--advertise', default='')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    listen_host, listen_port = args.listen.rsplit(':', 1)
    back_host, back_port = args.backend.rsplit(':', 1)
    low, high = map(int, args.media.split('-'))
    if not 0 < low <= high < 65536:
        parser.error('Invalid media port range')
    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format='%(asctime)s %(message)s')
    relay = Relay((listen_host, int(listen_port)), (back_host, int(back_port)), (low, high), args.advertise)
    for sig in [signal.SIGINT, signal.SIGTERM]:
        signal.signal(sig, lambda *_: threading.Thread(target=relay.shutdown, daemon=True).start())
    LOG.info('NETHERNET_RELAY_READY signaling=%s media=%s backend=%s encrypted_transport_only=true',
             args.listen, args.media, args.backend)
    try:
        relay.serve_forever()
    finally:
        relay.server_close()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/anticheat/collision/AcceptedPositionPhysics.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.anticheat.collision;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Box;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;
import java.util.List;





public final class AcceptedPositionPhysics {
    private AcceptedPositionPhysics() { }

    public static Box synchronize(final Box solved, final Vec3 accepted, final List<Box> collisions) {
        final Vec3 correction = accepted.subtract(solved.feetCenter());
        Box current = solved;
        for (final Vec3 segment : new Vec3[]{new Vec3(0, correction.y, 0),
                new Vec3(correction.x, 0, 0), new Vec3(0, 0, correction.z)}) {
            if (segment.x == 0 && segment.y == 0 && segment.z == 0) continue;
            final Box candidate = SweptMovement.computeMoveWithDepenetration(
                    new Vec3[]{segment}, current, collisions, Vec3.ZERO).aabb;


            if (!increasesPenetration(current, candidate, collisions)) current = candidate;
        }
        return current;
    }

    private static boolean increasesPenetration(final Box before, final Box after,
                                                final List<Box> collisions) {
        for (final Box shape : collisions) {
            if (penetration(after, shape) > penetration(before, shape)) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static float penetration(final Box actor, final Box shape) {
        if (!shape.isValid()) return 0;
        final float x = Math.min(actor.maxX - shape.minX, shape.maxX - actor.minX);
        final float y = Math.min(actor.maxY - shape.minY, shape.maxY - actor.minY);
        final float z = Math.min(actor.maxZ - shape.minZ, shape.maxZ - actor.minZ);
        return x > 0 && y > 0 && z > 0 ? Math.min(x, Math.min(y, z)) : 0;
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/anticheat/collision/CollisionQuery.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.anticheat.collision;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Box;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;


public final class CollisionQuery {
    private static final float MAX_MOVE_LENGTH_SQUARED = 256.0F;
    private static final float MAX_MOVE_LENGTH = 16.0F;
    private static final float EXTRA_DOWN = 0.200000003F;
    private static final float EXTRA_UP = 0.08F;
    private static final float SNEAK_SUPPORT_DISTANCE_SCALE = 1.01F;

    private CollisionQuery() {}

    public static Vec3 clamp(Vec3 movement) {
        float lengthSquared = movement.x * movement.x + movement.y * movement.y + movement.z * movement.z;
        if (!(lengthSquared > MAX_MOVE_LENGTH_SQUARED)) return movement.clone();
        float length = (float) Math.sqrt(lengthSquared);
        return new Vec3(movement.x / length * MAX_MOVE_LENGTH,
                movement.y / length * MAX_MOVE_LENGTH,
                movement.z / length * MAX_MOVE_LENGTH);
    }

    public static Box buildCollisionQuery(Box current, Vec3 delta, float maxAutoStep) {
        Box movementSweep = sweep(current, delta);
        Box supportSweep = buildHorizontalSupportSweep(current, delta, maxAutoStep);
        Box autoStepSweep = buildAutoStepSweep(current, delta, maxAutoStep);
        float minX = Math.min(movementSweep.minX, supportSweep.minX);
        float minY = Math.min(movementSweep.minY, supportSweep.minY);
        float minZ = Math.min(movementSweep.minZ, supportSweep.minZ);
        float maxX = Math.max(movementSweep.maxX, supportSweep.maxX);
        float maxY = Math.max(movementSweep.maxY, supportSweep.maxY);
        float maxZ = Math.max(movementSweep.maxZ, supportSweep.maxZ);
        minX = Math.min(minX, autoStepSweep.minX); minY = Math.min(minY, autoStepSweep.minY); minZ = Math.min(minZ, autoStepSweep.minZ);
        maxX = Math.max(maxX, autoStepSweep.maxX); maxY = Math.max(maxY, autoStepSweep.maxY); maxZ = Math.max(maxZ, autoStepSweep.maxZ);
        float paddedMinY = current.minY + (-EXTRA_DOWN - Math.abs(delta.y));
        float paddedMaxY = current.maxY + EXTRA_UP;
        minY = Math.min(minY, paddedMinY); maxY = Math.max(maxY, paddedMaxY);
        minX = Math.min(minX, current.minX); minZ = Math.min(minZ, current.minZ);
        maxX = Math.max(maxX, current.maxX); maxZ = Math.max(maxZ, current.maxZ);
        return new Box(minX, minY, minZ, maxX, maxY, maxZ);
    }

    private static Box sweep(Box box, Vec3 delta) {
        float minX=box.minX,minY=box.minY,minZ=box.minZ,maxX=box.maxX,maxY=box.maxY,maxZ=box.maxZ;
        if(delta.x<0)minX+=delta.x; else if(delta.x>0)maxX+=delta.x;
        if(delta.y<0)minY+=delta.y; else if(delta.y>0)maxY+=delta.y;
        if(delta.z<0)minZ+=delta.z; else if(delta.z>0)maxZ+=delta.z;
        return new Box(minX,minY,minZ,maxX,maxY,maxZ);
    }

    private static Box buildHorizontalSupportSweep(Box current, Vec3 delta, float maxAutoStep) {
        float xMid=(current.minX+current.maxX)*.5F,xMin=current.minX+.025F,xMax=current.maxX-.025F;
        if(xMin>xMax)xMin=xMax=xMid;
        float zMid=(current.minZ+current.maxZ)*.5F,zMin=current.minZ+.025F,zMax=current.maxZ-.025F;
        if(zMin>zMax)zMin=zMax=zMid;
        float supportDistance=maxAutoStep*SNEAK_SUPPORT_DISTANCE_SCALE,minY=current.minY-supportDistance,maxY=current.maxY-supportDistance;
        if(delta.x<0) xMin+=delta.x; else if(delta.x>0)xMax+=delta.x;
        if(delta.z<0) zMin+=delta.z; else if(delta.z>0)zMax+=delta.z;
        return new Box(xMin,minY,zMin,xMax,maxY,zMax);
    }

    private static Box buildAutoStepSweep(Box current, Vec3 delta, float maxAutoStep) {
        float minX=current.minX,maxX=current.maxX,minZ=current.minZ,maxZ=current.maxZ;
        if(delta.x<0)minX+=delta.x; else if(delta.x>0)maxX+=delta.x;
        if(delta.z<0)minZ+=delta.z; else if(delta.z>0)maxZ+=delta.z;
        float movedMinY=delta.y<0?current.minY+delta.y:current.minY,movedMaxY=delta.y>0?current.maxY+delta.y:current.maxY;
        float stepMinY=maxAutoStep<0?current.minY+maxAutoStep:current.minY,stepMaxY=maxAutoStep>0?current.maxY+maxAutoStep:current.maxY;
        float stepThenMoveY=maxAutoStep+delta.y,combinedMinY=stepThenMoveY<0?current.minY+stepThenMoveY:current.minY,combinedMaxY=stepThenMoveY>0?current.maxY+stepThenMoveY:current.maxY;
        return new Box(minX,Math.min(Math.min(movedMinY,stepMinY),combinedMinY),minZ,maxX,Math.max(Math.max(movedMaxY,stepMaxY),combinedMaxY),maxZ);
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/anticheat/collision/CollisionShapeRegistry.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.anticheat.collision;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Box;
import ac.navro.proxy.data.block.NetworkBlockStateRegistry;
import org.cloudburstmc.nbt.NbtList;
import org.cloudburstmc.nbt.NbtMap;
import org.cloudburstmc.nbt.NbtUtils;

import java.io.BufferedInputStream;
import java.io.DataInputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;





public final class CollisionShapeRegistry {
    private static final int MAGIC = 0x424F4152;
    private static final int FORMAT_VERSION = 2;
    private static final Map<Integer, CollisionShapeRegistry> REGISTRIES = new HashMap<>();

    private final Map<Integer, List<Box>> runtimeShapes;
    private final Map<StateKey, List<Box>> stateShapes;

    private CollisionShapeRegistry(int protocol) {
        Loaded loaded = load(protocol);
        this.runtimeShapes = loaded.runtimeShapes();
        this.stateShapes = loaded.stateShapes();
    }

    public static synchronized CollisionShapeRegistry forProtocol(int protocol) {
        return REGISTRIES.computeIfAbsent(protocol, CollisionShapeRegistry::new);
    }

    public List<Box> shape(int runtimeId) {
        return runtimeShapes.get(runtimeId);
    }

    public List<Box> shapeForState(NbtMap state) {
        return stateShapes.get(stateKey(state));
    }

    public boolean known(int runtimeId) {
        return runtimeShapes.containsKey(runtimeId);
    }

    public int mappedRuntimeIds() {
        return runtimeShapes.size();
    }

    private static Loaded load(int protocol) {
        Map<Integer, List<Box>> result = new HashMap<>();
        Map<StateKey, List<Box>> statesByShape = new HashMap<>();
        try (InputStream rawPalette = resource("navro/palette/runtime_block_states_" + NetworkBlockStateRegistry.paletteProtocol(protocol) + ".dat")) {
            if (rawPalette == null) return new Loaded(Map.of(), Map.of());
            Object root = NbtUtils.createGZIPReader(new BufferedInputStream(rawPalette)).readTag();
            if (!(root instanceof NbtList<?> states)) return new Loaded(Map.of(), Map.of());

            Map<Integer, List<Box>> shapeByLegacy = readCollisionMappings();
            for (Object value : states) {
                if (!(value instanceof NbtMap state)) continue;
                int runtimeId = state.getInt("runtimeId", Integer.MIN_VALUE);
                int blockId = state.getInt("id", -1);
                int blockData = (state.get("data") instanceof Number data ? data.shortValue() : 0) & 0x3F;
                if (runtimeId == Integer.MIN_VALUE || blockId < 0) continue;
                List<Box> shape = shapeByLegacy.get((blockId << 6) | blockData);
                if (shape != null) {
                    result.put(runtimeId, shape);
                    statesByShape.putIfAbsent(stateKey(state), shape);
                }
            }
        } catch (IOException | RuntimeException error) {


            return new Loaded(Map.of(), Map.of());
        }
        return new Loaded(Map.copyOf(result), Map.copyOf(statesByShape));
    }

    private static Map<Integer, List<Box>> readCollisionMappings() throws IOException {
        try (InputStream resource = resource("navro/geyser-collisions.bin")) {
            if (resource == null) throw new IOException("Missing navro/geyser-collisions.bin");
            DataInputStream input = new DataInputStream(new BufferedInputStream(resource));
            if (input.readInt() != MAGIC || input.readInt() != FORMAT_VERSION) {
                throw new IOException("Invalid Navro collision table");
            }
            int shapeCount = input.readUnsignedShort();
            List<List<Box>> shapes = new ArrayList<>(shapeCount);
            for (int shapeIndex = 0; shapeIndex < shapeCount; shapeIndex++) {
                int boxCount = input.readUnsignedShort();
                List<Box> boxes = new ArrayList<>(boxCount);
                for (int boxIndex = 0; boxIndex < boxCount; boxIndex++) {
                    boxes.add(new Box(input.readFloat(), input.readFloat(), input.readFloat(),
                            input.readFloat(), input.readFloat(), input.readFloat()));
                }
                shapes.add(List.copyOf(boxes));
            }
            Map<Integer, List<Box>> mapped = new HashMap<>();
            readMappings(input, mapped, shapes);
            return mapped;
        }
    }

    private static void readMappings(DataInputStream input, Map<Integer, List<Box>> result,
                                     List<List<Box>> shapes) throws IOException {
        int count = input.readInt();
        if (count < 0 || count > 2_000_000) throw new IOException("Invalid collision mapping count");
        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++) {
            int key = input.readInt();
            int shapeIndex = input.readUnsignedShort();
            if (shapeIndex >= shapes.size()) throw new IOException("Invalid collision shape index");
            result.put(key, shapes.get(shapeIndex));
        }


        int dynamicCount = input.readInt();
        if (dynamicCount < 0 || dynamicCount > 2_000_000) throw new IOException("Invalid dynamic mapping count");
        for (int index = 0; index < dynamicCount; index++) {
            input.readInt();
            int shapeIndex = input.readUnsignedShort();
            if (shapeIndex >= shapes.size()) throw new IOException("Invalid dynamic shape index");
        }
    }

    private static InputStream resource(String name) {
        return CollisionShapeRegistry.class.getClassLoader().getResourceAsStream(name);
    }

    private static StateKey stateKey(NbtMap state) {
        return state == null ? null : new StateKey(state.getString("name", ""), state.getCompound("states"));
    }

    private record StateKey(String identifier, NbtMap properties) { }

    private record Loaded(Map<Integer, List<Box>> runtimeShapes,
                          Map<StateKey, List<Box>> stateShapes) {}
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/anticheat/collision/ProtocolCollisionSolver.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.anticheat.collision;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Box;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;

import java.util.List;


public final class ProtocolCollisionSolver {
    private ProtocolCollisionSolver() {}

    public static SweptMovement.MoveResult solve(Vec3 movement, Box actor,
                                                 List<Box> shapes, Vec3 maxDepenetration,
                                                 boolean yxz) {
        Vec3 submitted = CollisionQuery.clamp(movement);
        if (yxz) return SweptMovement.computeYXZMoveWithDepenetration(submitted, actor, shapes, maxDepenetration);
        return SweptMovement.computeMoveWithDepenetration(new Vec3[]{submitted}, actor, shapes, maxDepenetration);
    }


    public static SweptMovement.MoveResult solveResolved(Vec3 movement, Box actor,
                                                         List<Box> shapes, Vec3 maxDepenetration,
                                                         float step, boolean canStep) {
        return solveResolvedDetailed(movement, actor, shapes, maxDepenetration, step, canStep).result();
    }

    public static SweptMovement.MoveResult solveResolved(Vec3 movement, Box actor,
                                                         List<Box> shapes, Vec3 maxDepenetration,
                                                         float step, boolean canStep, boolean resolveOverlaps) {
        return solveResolvedDetailed(movement, actor, shapes, maxDepenetration, step, canStep, resolveOverlaps).result();
    }

    public record ResolvedMove(SweptMovement.MoveResult result, float ordinaryOverlapDepth) { }


    public static ResolvedMove solveResolvedDetailed(Vec3 movement, Box actor,
                                                     List<Box> shapes, Vec3 maxDepenetration,
                                                     float step, boolean canStep) {
        return solveResolvedDetailed(movement, actor, shapes, maxDepenetration, step, canStep, false);
    }

    public static ResolvedMove solveResolvedDetailed(Vec3 movement, Box actor,
                                                     List<Box> shapes, Vec3 maxDepenetration,
                                                     float step, boolean canStep, boolean resolveOverlaps) {
        Vec3 submitted = CollisionQuery.clamp(movement);
        SweptMovement.MoveResult ordinary = SweptMovement.computeYXZMoveWithDepenetration(
                submitted, actor, shapes, maxDepenetration, resolveOverlaps);
        boolean horizontal = submitted.x != ordinary.movement.x || submitted.z != ordinary.movement.z;
        boolean downward = submitted.y < 0 && submitted.y != ordinary.movement.y;
        if (!(step > 0 && horizontal && (canStep || downward))) return new ResolvedMove(ordinary, ordinary.overlapDepth);
        List<Box> stepShapes = new java.util.ArrayList<>(shapes.size());
        for (Box shape : shapes) if (shape.minY < actor.maxY) stepShapes.add(shape);
        SweptMovement.MoveResult up = SweptMovement.computeMoveWithDepenetration(
                new Vec3[]{new Vec3(0, step, 0), new Vec3(submitted.x, 0, 0),
                        new Vec3(0, 0, submitted.z)}, actor, stepShapes, maxDepenetration, resolveOverlaps);
        SweptMovement.MoveResult down = SweptMovement.computeMoveWithDepenetration(
                new Vec3[]{new Vec3(0, -up.movement.y, 0)}, up.aabb, stepShapes, maxDepenetration, resolveOverlaps);
        Vec3 candidate = up.movement.add(down.movement);
        float overlapDepth = ordinary.overlapDepth + up.overlapDepth + down.overlapDepth;
        if (hasCollision(down.aabb, shapes) || !reasonable(candidate) || !reasonable(down.aabb)
                || candidate.horizontalLengthSquared() <= ordinary.movement.horizontalLengthSquared()) {
            return new ResolvedMove(new SweptMovement.MoveResult(ordinary.movement, overlapDepth, ordinary.aabb), ordinary.overlapDepth);
        }
        return new ResolvedMove(new SweptMovement.MoveResult(candidate, overlapDepth, down.aabb), ordinary.overlapDepth);
    }

    private static boolean hasCollision(Box box, List<Box> shapes) {
        for (int i = shapes.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (box.intersects(shapes.get(i))) return true;
        return false;
    }

    private static boolean reasonable(Vec3 value) {
        return reasonable(value.x) && reasonable(value.y) && reasonable(value.z);
    }

    private static boolean reasonable(Box value) {
        return value.isValid() && reasonable(value.minX) && reasonable(value.minY)
                && reasonable(value.minZ) && reasonable(value.maxX)
                && reasonable(value.maxY) && reasonable(value.maxZ);
    }

    private static boolean reasonable(float value) {
        return Float.isFinite(value) && Math.abs(value) <= 33554432.0F;
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/anticheat/collision/SneakEdgePhysics.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.anticheat.collision;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Box;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;
import java.util.List;


public final class SneakEdgePhysics {
    private static final float EPSILON = 1.1920929E-7F;
    private SneakEdgePhysics() { }


    public static boolean active(final Boolean moveInputSneaking, final boolean actorSneaking,
                                 final boolean onGround, final boolean flag6) {
        return onGround && (moveInputSneaking == null ? actorSneaking : moveInputSneaking) && !flag6;
    }

    public record Result(Vec3 movement, boolean clearX, boolean clearZ) {
        public Vec3 applyVelocity(final Vec3 velocity) {
            return new Vec3(clearX ? 0 : velocity.x, velocity.y, clearZ ? 0 : velocity.z);
        }
    }

    public static Result unchanged(final Vec3 movement) {
        return new Result(movement, false, false);
    }


    public static Result resolve(final Box box, final List<Box> collisions,
                                 final Vec3 submitted, final float maxAutoStep) {
        float x = submitted.x, z = submitted.z;
        final float distance = -(maxAutoStep * 1.01F);
        final Box inset = inset(box);
        while (x != 0 && !supported(inset, collisions, x, 0, distance)) x = approachZero(x);
        while (z != 0 && !supported(inset, collisions, 0, z, distance)) z = approachZero(z);
        while ((x != 0 || z != 0) && !supported(inset, collisions, x, z, distance)) {
            x = approachZero(x);
            z = approachZero(z);
        }


        return new Result(new Vec3(x, submitted.y, z), Math.abs(x) <= EPSILON, Math.abs(z) <= EPSILON);
    }

    private static float approachZero(final float value) {
        if (value < 0) {
            final float added = value + 0.05F;
            return added > 0 ? 0 : added > value ? added : value;
        }
        final float subtracted = value - 0.05F;
        return subtracted > value ? value : subtracted > 0 ? subtracted : 0;
    }

    private static Box inset(final Box box) {
        float minX = box.minX + 0.025F, maxX = box.maxX - 0.025F;
        float minZ = box.minZ + 0.025F, maxZ = box.maxZ - 0.025F;
        if (minX > maxX) minX = maxX = (box.minX + box.maxX) / 2F;
        if (minZ > maxZ) minZ = maxZ = (box.minZ + box.maxZ) / 2F;
        return new Box(minX, box.minY, minZ, maxX, box.maxY, maxZ);
    }

    private static boolean supported(final Box inset, final List<Box> collisions,
                                     final float x, final float z, final float y) {
        final Box shifted = new Box(inset.minX + x, inset.minY + y, inset.minZ + z,
                inset.maxX + x, inset.maxY + y, inset.maxZ + z);
        for (final Box collision : collisions) if (collision.intersects(shifted)) return true;
        return false;
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/anticheat/collision/SweptMovement.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.anticheat.collision;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Box;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Direction;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;

import java.util.List;





public final class SweptMovement {
    private static final float CONTACT_EPSILON = Box.COLLISION_EPSILON;

    private SweptMovement() {
    }

    public static final class MoveResult {
        public final Vec3 movement;
        public final float overlapDepth;
        public final Box aabb;

        MoveResult(Vec3 movement, float overlapDepth, Box aabb) {
            this.movement = movement;
            this.overlapDepth = overlapDepth;
            this.aabb = aabb;
        }
    }

    public static MoveResult computeYXZMoveWithDepenetration(
            Vec3 movement, Box movingAABB, List<Box> collisionShapes,
            Vec3 maxDepenetration) {
        return computeYXZMoveWithDepenetration(movement, movingAABB, collisionShapes, maxDepenetration, false);
    }

    public static MoveResult computeYXZMoveWithDepenetration(
            Vec3 movement, Box movingAABB, List<Box> collisionShapes,
            Vec3 maxDepenetration, boolean resolveOverlaps) {
        return computeMoveWithDepenetration(new Vec3[]{
                new Vec3(0.0F, movement.y, 0.0F),
                new Vec3(movement.x, 0.0F, 0.0F),
                new Vec3(0.0F, 0.0F, movement.z)
        }, movingAABB, collisionShapes, maxDepenetration, resolveOverlaps);
    }

    public static MoveResult computeMoveWithDepenetration(
            Vec3[] movementSegments, Box movingAABB,
            List<Box> collisionShapes, Vec3 maxDepenetration) {
        return computeMoveWithDepenetration(movementSegments, movingAABB, collisionShapes, maxDepenetration, false);
    }





    public static MoveResult computeMoveWithDepenetration(
            Vec3[] movementSegments, Box movingAABB,
            List<Box> collisionShapes, Vec3 maxDepenetration, boolean resolveOverlaps) {
        Vec3 totalMovement = Vec3.ZERO.clone();
        float overlapDepth = 0.0F;
        for (Vec3 input : movementSegments) {
            if (input == null) continue;
            Vec3 segment = input.clone();
            for (int index = collisionShapes.size() - 1; index >= 0; index--) {
                ClipCollideResult clip = clipCollide(collisionShapes.get(index), movingAABB, segment);
                overlapDepth += clip.overlapDepth;
                segment = resolveOverlaps || component(maxDepenetration, clip.axis) >= clip.overlapDepth
                        ? clip.depenetratedMovement : clip.movement;
            }
            totalMovement.x += segment.x;
            totalMovement.y += segment.y;
            totalMovement.z += segment.z;
            movingAABB = movingAABB.offset(segment);
        }
        return new MoveResult(totalMovement, overlapDepth, movingAABB);
    }

    private static ClipCollideResult clipCollide(Box stationary, Box moving, Vec3 velocity) {
        Vec3 clipped = velocity.clone();
        Vec3 depenetrated = velocity.clone();
        if (!valid(stationary)) return new ClipCollideResult(0.0F, clipped, depenetrated, Direction.Axis.X);

        AxisDistance x = axisDistance(stationary.minX, stationary.maxX, moving.minX, moving.maxX);
        AxisDistance y = axisDistance(stationary.minY, stationary.maxY, moving.minY, moving.maxY);
        AxisDistance z = axisDistance(stationary.minZ, stationary.maxZ, moving.minZ, moving.maxZ);
        int separatedAxes = (x.overlapping ? 0 : 1) + (y.overlapping ? 0 : 1) + (z.overlapping ? 0 : 1);
        if (separatedAxes > 1) return new ClipCollideResult(0.0F, clipped, depenetrated, Direction.Axis.X);

        if (separatedAxes == 1) {
            Direction.Axis axis;
            AxisDistance distance;
            if (!x.overlapping) { axis = Direction.Axis.X; distance = x; }
            else if (!y.overlapping) { axis = Direction.Axis.Y; distance = y; }
            else { axis = Direction.Axis.Z; distance = z; }
            float requested = component(velocity, axis);
            if (!(distance.distance - requested * distance.direction > 0.0F)) {
                return new ClipCollideResult(0.0F, clipped, depenetrated, Direction.Axis.X);
            }
            float limited = distance.distance * distance.direction;
            setComponent(clipped, axis, limited);
            setComponent(depenetrated, axis, limited);
            return new ClipCollideResult(0.0F, clipped, depenetrated, axis);
        }

        Direction.Axis axis = Direction.Axis.X;
        AxisDistance selected = x;
        if (y.distance < selected.distance) { axis = Direction.Axis.Y; selected = y; }
        if (z.distance < selected.distance) { axis = Direction.Axis.Z; selected = z; }
        float resolution = selected.distance * selected.direction;
        float requested = component(depenetrated, axis);
        setComponent(depenetrated, axis, resolution > 0.0F
                ? Math.max(requested, resolution) : Math.min(requested, resolution));
        return new ClipCollideResult(selected.distance, clipped, depenetrated, axis);
    }

    private static AxisDistance axisDistance(float stationaryMin, float stationaryMax,
                                              float movingMin, float movingMax) {
        float negativeDistance = normalize(movingMax - stationaryMin);
        float negativeDepth = Math.max(negativeDistance, 0.0F);
        if (negativeDepth == 0.0F) return new AxisDistance(negativeDistance, -1.0F, false);
        float positiveDistance = normalize(stationaryMax - movingMin);
        float positiveDepth = Math.max(positiveDistance, 0.0F);
        if (positiveDepth == 0.0F) return new AxisDistance(positiveDistance, 1.0F, false);
        return negativeDepth < positiveDepth
                ? new AxisDistance(negativeDepth, -1.0F, true)
                : new AxisDistance(positiveDepth, 1.0F, true);
    }

    private static float normalize(float value) {
        return Math.abs(value) <= CONTACT_EPSILON ? 0.0F : value;
    }

    private static boolean valid(Box value) {
        return value != null && value.minX < value.maxX && value.minY < value.maxY && value.minZ < value.maxZ;
    }

    private static float component(Vec3 vector, Direction.Axis axis) {
        return switch (axis) { case X -> vector.x; case Y -> vector.y; case Z -> vector.z; };
    }

    private static void setComponent(Vec3 vector, Direction.Axis axis, float value) {
        switch (axis) { case X -> vector.x = value; case Y -> vector.y = value; case Z -> vector.z = value; }
    }

    private record AxisDistance(float distance, float direction, boolean overlapping) {}
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/anticheat/collision/util/CuboidBlockIterator.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.anticheat.collision.util;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Box;

public class CuboidBlockIterator {
	private final int startX, startY, startZ;
	private final int sizeX, sizeY, sizeZ;
	private final int totalSize;
	private int blocksIterated;
	private int x, y, z;

	public CuboidBlockIterator(int startX, int startY, int startZ, int endX, int endY, int endZ) {
		this.startX = startX;
		this.startY = startY;
		this.startZ = startZ;
		this.sizeX = endX - startX + 1;
		this.sizeY = endY - startY + 1;
		this.sizeZ = endZ - startZ + 1;
		this.totalSize = this.sizeX * this.sizeY * this.sizeZ;
	}

	public boolean step() {
		if (this.blocksIterated == this.totalSize) {
			return false;
		} else {
			this.x = this.blocksIterated % this.sizeX;
			int i = this.blocksIterated / this.sizeX;
			this.y = i % this.sizeY;
			this.z = i / this.sizeY;
			this.blocksIterated++;
			return true;
		}
	}

	public int getX() {
		return this.startX + this.x;
	}

	public int getY() {
		return this.startY + this.y;
	}

	public int getZ() {
		return this.startZ + this.z;
	}

	public int getEdgeCoordinatesCount() {
		int i = 0;
		if (this.x == 0 || this.x == this.sizeX - 1) {
			i++;
		}

		if (this.y == 0 || this.y == this.sizeY - 1) {
			i++;
		}

		if (this.z == 0 || this.z == this.sizeZ - 1) {
			i++;
		}

		return i;
	}

	public static CuboidBlockIterator iterator(final Box box) {
		int i = (int) Math.floor(box.minX - 1.0E-7) - 1;
		int j = (int) Math.floor(box.maxX + 1.0E-7) + 1;
		int k = (int) Math.floor(box.minY - 1.0E-7) - 1;
		int l = (int) Math.floor(box.maxY + 1.0E-7) + 1;
		int m = (int) Math.floor(box.minZ - 1.0E-7) - 1;
		int n = (int) Math.floor(box.maxZ + 1.0E-7) + 1;
		return new CuboidBlockIterator(i, k, m, j, l, n);
	}
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/anticheat/data/EntityDimensions.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.anticheat.data;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Box;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;


public record EntityDimensions(float width, float height, float eyeHeight, boolean fixed) {
    private EntityDimensions(float width, float height, boolean fixed) {
        this(width, height, height * 0.85F, fixed);
    }

    public Box getBoxAt(Vec3 position) {
        return getBoxAt(position.x, position.y, position.z);
    }

    public Box getBoxAt(float x, float y, float z) {
        float halfWidth = width / 2.0F;
        return new Box(x - halfWidth, y, z - halfWidth, x + halfWidth, y + height, z + halfWidth);
    }

    public EntityDimensions hardScaled(float ratio) {
        return new EntityDimensions(width * ratio, height * ratio, eyeHeight, false);
    }

    public EntityDimensions scaled(float ratio) {
        return scaled(ratio, ratio);
    }

    public EntityDimensions scaled(float widthRatio, float heightRatio) {
        return !fixed && (widthRatio != 1.0F || heightRatio != 1.0F)
                ? new EntityDimensions(width * widthRatio, height * heightRatio, eyeHeight * heightRatio, false)
                : this;
    }

    public static EntityDimensions changing(float width, float height) {
        return new EntityDimensions(width, height, false);
    }

    public static EntityDimensions fixed(float width, float height) {
        return new EntityDimensions(width, height, true);
    }

    public EntityDimensions withEyeHeight(float value) {
        return new EntityDimensions(width, height, value, fixed);
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/anticheat/data/input/InputPosition.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.anticheat.data.input;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;


public record InputPosition(float x, float y, float z, float yOffset) {
    private static final long FIRST_FINITE = 0x00800000L;
    private static final long LAST_FINITE = 0xff7fffffL;

    public static InputPosition capture(org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector3f wire, float yOffset) {
        return new InputPosition(wire.getX(), wire.getY(), wire.getZ(), yOffset);
    }

    public Vec3 decoded() { return new Vec3(x, y - yOffset, z); }

    public Vec3 residual(Vec3 physical) {
        return new Vec3(x - physical.x, y - (physical.y + yOffset), z - physical.z);
    }

    public float squaredDistance(Vec3 physical) { return residual(physical).lengthSquared(); }
    public float distance(Vec3 physical) { return residual(physical).length(); }

    public Vec3 physicalTarget(Vec3 physical) {
        return new Vec3(x, physicalY(physical.y), z);
    }

    private float physicalY(float predicted) {
        if (predicted + yOffset == y) return predicted;
        if (!Float.isFinite(predicted) || !Float.isFinite(y) || !Float.isFinite(yOffset)) return y - yOffset;
        if (yOffset == 0) return y;
        long first = boundary(false), last = boundary(true) - 1;
        if (first > last) return y - yOffset;
        return value(Math.max(first, Math.min(last, key(predicted))));
    }

    private long boundary(boolean strict) {
        long low = FIRST_FINITE, high = LAST_FINITE + 1;
        while (low < high) {
            long middle = (low + high) >>> 1;
            float encoded = value(middle) + yOffset;
            if (encoded < y || strict && encoded == y) low = middle + 1;
            else high = middle;
        }
        return low;
    }

    private static long key(float value) {
        long bits = Integer.toUnsignedLong(Float.floatToRawIntBits(value));
        return (bits & 0x80000000L) != 0 ? (~bits) & 0xffffffffL : bits ^ 0x80000000L;
    }

    private static float value(long key) {
        return Float.intBitsToFloat((int) (key < 0x80000000L ? ~key : key ^ 0x80000000L));
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/anticheat/data/vanilla/AttributeInstance.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.anticheat.data.vanilla;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;


public class AttributeInstance implements Cloneable {
    private float baseValue;
    private float value;
    private boolean dirty = true;
    private final Map<String, AttributeModifierData> modifiers = new HashMap<>();

    public AttributeInstance(float baseValue) { this.baseValue = baseValue; }
    public float getBaseValue() { return baseValue; }
    public Map<String, AttributeModifierData> getModifiers() { return Map.copyOf(modifiers); }
    public float getValue() { if (dirty) { value = computeValue(); dirty = false; } return value; }
    public void setBaseValue(float value) { if (baseValue == value) return; baseValue = value; dirty = true; }
    public void setValue(float value) { this.value = value; dirty = false; }
    public void setDirty() { dirty = true; }
    public void clearModifiers() { if (!modifiers.isEmpty()) { modifiers.clear(); update(); } }
    public void removeModifier(String id) { if (modifiers.remove(id) != null) update(); }
    public void addTemporaryModifier(AttributeModifierData modifier) { if (modifiers.putIfAbsent(modifier.id(), modifier) == null) update(); }
    private void update() { value = computeValue(); }
    private float computeValue() {
        float base = baseValue;
        for (AttributeModifierData modifier : modifiers.values()) if (modifier.operation == AttributeOperation.ADDITION) base += modifier.amount;
        float result = base;
        for (AttributeModifierData modifier : modifiers.values()) if (modifier.operation == AttributeOperation.MULTIPLY_BASE) result += base * modifier.amount;
        for (AttributeModifierData modifier : modifiers.values()) if (modifier.operation == AttributeOperation.MULTIPLY_TOTAL) result *= 1.0F + modifier.amount;
        return result;
    }
    @Override public AttributeInstance clone() { AttributeInstance copy = new AttributeInstance(baseValue); copy.value=value; copy.dirty=dirty; copy.modifiers.putAll(modifiers); return copy; }
    public enum AttributeOperation { ADDITION, MULTIPLY_BASE, MULTIPLY_TOTAL }
    public record AttributeModifierData(String id, AttributeOperation operation, float amount) {}
}
```

```java
package ac.navro.anticheat.util;


public final class BdsTrigMath {
    private static final int TABLE_BITS=16,TABLE_SIZE=1<<TABLE_BITS,TABLE_MASK=TABLE_SIZE-1,COS_OFFSET=TABLE_SIZE/4;
    private static final float RADIANS_TO_INDEX=10430.3779296875F;
    private static final float[] SIN_TABLE=new float[TABLE_SIZE];
    static { for(int index=0;index<TABLE_SIZE;index++) SIN_TABLE[index]=ClientFloatMath.sinf((float)index/RADIANS_TO_INDEX); }
    private BdsTrigMath(){}
    public static float sin(float radians){return SIN_TABLE[((int)(radians*RADIANS_TO_INDEX))&TABLE_MASK];}
    public static float cos(float radians){return SIN_TABLE[((int)(radians*RADIANS_TO_INDEX+COS_OFFSET))&TABLE_MASK];}
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/anticheat/util/ClientFloatMath.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.anticheat.util;


public final class ClientFloatMath {
    private static final double HALF_PI=1.5707963267948966,TWO_OVER_PI=0.6366197723675814,LARGE_REDUCTION_SCALE=3.4061215800865545e-19;
    private static final double C1=-0.49999999725108224,C2=0.041666623324344516,C3=-0.001388676379437604,C4=2.4390450703564542e-05;
    private static final double S1=-0.16666654943701084,S2=0.008332178146138854,S3=-0.00019517298981385725;
    private static final int[] FOUR_OVER_PI={0xa2,0xa2f9,0xa2f983,0xa2f9836e,0xf9836e4e,0x836e4e44,0x6e4e4415,0x4e441529,0x441529fc,0x1529fc27,0x29fc2757,0xfc2757d1,0x2757d1f5,0x57d1f534,0xd1f534dd,0xf534ddc0,0x34ddc0db,0xddc0db62,0xc0db6295,0xdb629599,0x6295993c,0x95993c43,0x993c4390,0x3c439041};
    private ClientFloatMath(){}
    public static float sinf(float value){return trig(value,false);} public static float cosf(float value){return trig(value,true);}
    private static float trig(float value,boolean cosine){
        int bits=Float.floatToRawIntBits(value),top=(bits>>>20)&0x7ff; double x=value;
        if(top<0x3f4){if(top<0x398)return cosine?1F:value;return polynomial(x,x*x,false,cosine);}
        final double reduced; final int quadrant,signQuadrant;
        if(top<0x42f){double scaled=x*TWO_OVER_PI;quadrant=(int)Math.copySign(Math.floor(Math.abs(scaled)+.5D),scaled);reduced=Math.fma(-quadrant,HALF_PI,x);signQuadrant=quadrant;}
        else if(top<0x7f8){int index=(bits>>>26)&15,shift=(bits>>>23)&7;long mantissa=Integer.toUnsignedLong(((bits&0xffffff)|0x800000)<<shift);long high=mantissa*Integer.toUnsignedLong(FOUR_OVER_PI[index]),middle=mantissa*Integer.toUnsignedLong(FOUR_OVER_PI[index+4]),low=mantissa*Integer.toUnsignedLong(FOUR_OVER_PI[index+8]);long product=(low>>>32|high<<32)+middle;quadrant=(int)((product+(1L<<61))>>>62);long remainder=product-((long)quadrant<<62);reduced=(double)remainder*LARGE_REDUCTION_SCALE;signQuadrant=quadrant+(bits>>>31);}
        else return value-value;
        int phase=signQuadrant&3;double signed=phase==1||phase==2?-reduced:reduced;boolean cosinePolynomial=((quadrant^(cosine?1:0))&1)!=0;return polynomial(signed,reduced*reduced,(signQuadrant&2)!=0,cosinePolynomial);
    }
    private static float polynomial(double x,double squared,boolean negativeCosine,boolean cosine){
        if(!cosine){double cubed=x*squared,tail=Math.fma(squared,S3,S2),fifth=cubed*squared,leading=Math.fma(cubed,S1,x);return (float)Math.fma(fifth,tail,leading);}
        double c0=negativeCosine?-1:1,c1=negativeCosine?-C1:C1,c2=negativeCosine?-C2:C2,c3=negativeCosine?-C3:C3,c4=negativeCosine?-C4:C4;double fourth=squared*squared,tail=Math.fma(squared,c4,c3),leading=Math.fma(squared,c1,c0),sixth=squared*fourth,combined=Math.fma(fourth,c2,leading);return (float)Math.fma(sixth,tail,combined);
    }
}
```

```java
package ac.navro.anticheat.util;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;


public final class MathUtil {
    public static final float DEGREE_TO_RAD = 0.017453292F;
    private MathUtil() {}
    public static boolean isValid(org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector3f value) {
        return Float.isFinite(value.getX()) && Float.isFinite(value.getY()) && Float.isFinite(value.getZ());
    }
    public static boolean isValid(org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector2f value) {
        return Float.isFinite(value.getX()) && Float.isFinite(value.getY());
    }
    public static boolean sameDirection(Vec3 a, Vec3 b) { return sign(a.x)==sign(b.x)&&sign(a.y)==sign(b.y)&&sign(a.z)==sign(b.z); }
    public static boolean sameDirectionHorizontal(Vec3 a, Vec3 b) { return sign(a.x)==sign(b.x)&&sign(a.z)==sign(b.z); }
    public static Vec3 signAll(Vec3 v) { return new Vec3(sign(v.x),sign(v.y),sign(v.z)); }
    public static int sign(double value) { if(!Double.isFinite(value)) return 0; return value==0?0:value>0?1:-1; }
    public static float wrapDegrees(float f) { float g=f%360F; if(g>=180F)g-=360F; if(g<-180F)g+=360F; return g; }
    public static boolean equal(double a,double b) { return Math.abs(b-a)<1.0E-7D; }
    public static float lerp(float d,float start,float end){return start+d*(end-start);} public static double lerp(double d,double start,double end){return start+d*(end-start);}
    public static float square(float v){return v*v;}
    public static float clamp(float value,float min,float max){if(Float.isNaN(value)||Float.isInfinite(value))return 0;return value<min?min:Math.min(value,max);}
    public static float sqrt(float value){return (float)Math.sqrt(value);}
    public static Vec3 getRotationVector(float pitch,float yaw){
        final float negativePitch=-pitch*DEGREE_TO_RAD; final float shiftedYaw=-yaw*DEGREE_TO_RAD-3.1415927F;
        final float horizontal=-BdsTrigMath.cos(negativePitch);
        return new Vec3(BdsTrigMath.sin(shiftedYaw)*horizontal,BdsTrigMath.sin(negativePitch),BdsTrigMath.cos(shiftedYaw)*horizontal);
    }
    public static Vec3 getInputVector(Vec3 movementInput,float speed,float yaw){
        final float squared=movementInput.x*movementInput.x+movementInput.y*movementInput.y+movementInput.z*movementInput.z;
        if(squared<0.01F*0.01F)return Vec3.ZERO;
        final float length=(float)Math.sqrt(squared),scale=speed/Math.max(length,1F);
        final float localX=movementInput.x*scale,localY=movementInput.y*scale,localZ=movementInput.z*scale;
        final float radians=yaw*DEGREE_TO_RAD,sin=ClientFloatMath.sinf(radians),cos=ClientFloatMath.cosf(radians);
        return new Vec3(localX*cos-localZ*sin,localY,localZ*cos+localX*sin);
    }
    public static int blockPosition(int x,int y,int z){return (x<<8)|(z<<4)|y;}
    public static long chunkPositionToLong(int x,int z){return (x&0xFFFFFFFFL)|((z&0xFFFFFFFFL)<<32L);}
}
```

```java
package ac.navro.anticheat.util;


public final class NavroTrigMath {
    private static final double TWO_PI=2D*Math.PI;
    private static final int SIN_BITS=22,SIN_SIZE=1<<SIN_BITS,SIN_MASK=SIN_SIZE-1,COS_OFFSET=SIN_SIZE/4;
    private static final float[] SIN_TABLE=new float[SIN_SIZE];
    private static final double SIN_CONVERSION_FACTOR=SIN_SIZE/TWO_PI;
    static { for(int i=0;i<SIN_SIZE;i++) SIN_TABLE[i]=(float)Math.sin((i*TWO_PI)/SIN_SIZE); }
    private NavroTrigMath(){}
    public static float sin(double angle){return SIN_TABLE[floor(angle*SIN_CONVERSION_FACTOR)&SIN_MASK];}
    public static float cos(double angle){return SIN_TABLE[(floor(angle*SIN_CONVERSION_FACTOR)+COS_OFFSET)&SIN_MASK];}
    private static int floor(double value){int truncated=(int)value;return value<truncated?truncated-1:truncated;}
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/anticheat/util/math/Box.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.anticheat.util.math;

import java.util.Optional;


public class Box implements Cloneable {
    public static final Box EMPTY = new Box(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
    public static final float EPSILON = 1.0E-7F;
    public static final float COLLISION_EPSILON = 1.0E-6F;
    public final float minX, minY, minZ, maxX, maxY, maxZ;

    public Box(float x1, float y1, float z1, float x2, float y2, float z2) { this(x1,y1,z1,x2,y2,z2,true); }
    private Box(float x1,float y1,float z1,float x2,float y2,float z2,boolean normalize) {
        if (normalize) { minX=Math.min(x1,x2); minY=Math.min(y1,y2); minZ=Math.min(z1,z2); maxX=Math.max(x1,x2); maxY=Math.max(y1,y2); maxZ=Math.max(z1,z2); }
        else { minX=x1; minY=y1; minZ=z1; maxX=x2; maxY=y2; maxZ=z2; }
    }
    public Box(double x1,double y1,double z1,double x2,double y2,double z2) { this((float)x1,(float)y1,(float)z1,(float)x2,(float)y2,(float)z2); }



    public static Box fromNativeBounds(double minX,double minY,double minZ,double maxX,double maxY,double maxZ) {
        return new Box((float)minX,(float)minY,(float)minZ,(float)maxX,(float)maxY,(float)maxZ,false);
    }
    public static Box invalid() { return new Box(Float.MAX_VALUE,Float.MAX_VALUE,Float.MAX_VALUE,-Float.MAX_VALUE,-Float.MAX_VALUE,-Float.MAX_VALUE,false); }
    public boolean isValid() { return minX<maxX && minY<maxY && minZ<maxZ; }
    public Vec3 toVec3f(float width) { return new Vec3(minX+width/2F,minY,maxZ-width/2F); }
    public Vec3 feetCenter() { return new Vec3((minX+maxX)*.5F,minY,(minZ+maxZ)*.5F); }
    public static Box of(Vec3 c,float dx,float dy,float dz) { return new Box(c.x-dx/2F,c.y-dy/2F,c.z-dz/2F,c.x+dx/2F,c.y+dy/2F,c.z+dz/2F); }
    public boolean equals(Box b) { return minX==b.minX&&minY==b.minY&&minZ==b.minZ&&maxX==b.maxX&&maxY==b.maxY&&maxZ==b.maxZ; }
    public float chooseMin(Direction.Axis axis) { return axis==Direction.Axis.X?minX:axis==Direction.Axis.Y?minY:minZ; }
    public float chooseMax(Direction.Axis axis) { return axis==Direction.Axis.X?maxX:axis==Direction.Axis.Y?maxY:maxZ; }
    public boolean isOverlapped(Direction.Axis axis,Box o) {
        return switch(axis) { case X -> o.maxY-minY>0&&maxY-o.minY>0&&o.maxZ-minZ>0&&maxZ-o.minZ>0; case Y -> o.maxX-minX>0&&maxX-o.minX>0&&o.maxZ-minZ>0&&maxZ-o.minZ>0; default -> o.maxX-minX>0&&maxX-o.minX>0&&o.maxY-minY>0&&maxY-o.minY>0; };
    }
    public float calculateMaxDistance(Direction.Axis axis,Box other,float maxDist) {
        if (!isOverlapped(axis,other)||maxDist==0) return maxDist;
        if (maxDist>0) { float d=chooseMin(axis)-other.chooseMax(axis); if(d>=-COLLISION_EPSILON) maxDist=Math.min(maxDist,d); }
        else { float d=chooseMax(axis)-other.chooseMin(axis); if(d<=COLLISION_EPSILON) maxDist=Math.max(maxDist,d); }
        return maxDist;
    }
    public Optional<Vec3> clip(Vec3 from,Vec3 to) { return clip(minX,minY,minZ,maxX,maxY,maxZ,from,to); }
    public static Optional<Vec3> clip(float d,float e,float f,float g,float h,float i,Vec3 a,Vec3 b) {
        float[] ds={1F}; float j=b.x-a.x,k=b.y-a.y,l=b.z-a.z;
        Direction direction=getDirection(d,e,f,g,h,i,a,ds,null,j,k,l);
        return direction==null?Optional.empty():Optional.of(a.add(ds[0]*j,ds[0]*k,ds[0]*l));
    }
    private static Direction getDirection(float d,float e,float f,float g,float h,float i,Vec3 v,float[] ds,Direction dir,float j,float k,float l) {
        if(j>EPSILON) dir=clipPoint(ds,dir,j,k,l,d,e,h,f,i,Direction.WEST,v.x,v.y,v.z); else if(j<-EPSILON) dir=clipPoint(ds,dir,j,k,l,g,e,h,f,i,Direction.EAST,v.x,v.y,v.z);
        if(k>EPSILON) dir=clipPoint(ds,dir,k,l,j,e,f,i,d,g,Direction.DOWN,v.y,v.z,v.x); else if(k<-EPSILON) dir=clipPoint(ds,dir,k,l,j,h,f,i,d,g,Direction.UP,v.y,v.z,v.x);
        if(l>EPSILON) dir=clipPoint(ds,dir,l,j,k,f,d,g,e,h,Direction.NORTH,v.z,v.x,v.y); else if(l<-EPSILON) dir=clipPoint(ds,dir,l,j,k,i,d,g,e,h,Direction.SOUTH,v.z,v.x,v.y);
        return dir;
    }
    private static Direction clipPoint(float[] ds,Direction dir,float d,float e,float f,float g,float h,float i,float j,float k,Direction d2,float l,float m,float n) {
        float o=(g-l)/d,p=m+o*e,q=n+o*f;
        if(0<o&&o<ds[0]&&h-EPSILON<p&&p<i+EPSILON&&j-EPSILON<q&&q<k+EPSILON){ds[0]=o;return d2;} return dir;
    }
    public Box withMinX(float v){return new Box(v,minY,minZ,maxX,maxY,maxZ);} public Box withMinY(float v){return new Box(minX,v,minZ,maxX,maxY,maxZ);} public Box withMinZ(float v){return new Box(minX,minY,v,maxX,maxY,maxZ);}
    public Box withMaxX(float v){return new Box(minX,minY,minZ,v,maxY,maxZ);} public Box withMaxY(float v){return new Box(minX,minY,minZ,maxX,v,maxZ);} public Box withMaxZ(float v){return new Box(minX,minY,minZ,maxX,maxY,v);}
    public Box shrink(float x,float y,float z){return new Box(x<0?minX-x:x>0?minX:minX,y<0?minY-y:y>0?minY:minY,z<0?minZ-z:z>0?minZ:minZ,x>0?maxX-x:maxX,y>0?maxY-y:maxY,z>0?maxZ-z:maxZ);}
    public Box stretch(Vec3 s){return stretch(s.x,s.y,s.z);} public Box stretch(float x,float y,float z){return new Box(x<0?minX+x:minX,y<0?minY+y:minY,z<0?minZ+z:minZ,x>0?maxX+x:maxX,y>0?maxY+y:maxY,z>0?maxZ+z:maxZ);}
    public Box expand(float x,float y,float z){return new Box(minX-x,minY-y,minZ-z,maxX+x,maxY+y,maxZ+z);} public Box expand(float v){return expand(v,v,v);}
    public Box intersection(Box b){return new Box(Math.max(minX,b.minX),Math.max(minY,b.minY),Math.max(minZ,b.minZ),Math.min(maxX,b.maxX),Math.min(maxY,b.maxY),Math.min(maxZ,b.maxZ));}
    public Box union(Box b){return new Box(Math.min(minX,b.minX),Math.min(minY,b.minY),Math.min(minZ,b.minZ),Math.max(maxX,b.maxX),Math.max(maxY,b.maxY),Math.max(maxZ,b.maxZ));}
    public Box offset(float x,float y,float z){return new Box(minX+x,minY+y,minZ+z,maxX+x,maxY+y,maxZ+z);} public Box offset(double x,double y,double z){return offset((float)x,(float)y,(float)z);} public Box offset(Vec3 v){return offset(v.x,v.y,v.z);}
    public boolean intersects(Box b){return intersects(b.minX,b.minY,b.minZ,b.maxX,b.maxY,b.maxZ);} public boolean intersects(float a,float b,float c,float d,float e,float f){return minX<d&&maxX>a&&minY<e&&maxY>b&&minZ<f&&maxZ>c;}
    public boolean intersects(Vec3 a,Vec3 b){return intersects(Math.min(a.x,b.x),Math.min(a.y,b.y),Math.min(a.z,b.z),Math.max(a.x,b.x),Math.max(a.y,b.y),Math.max(a.z,b.z));}
    public boolean contains(Vec3 p){return contains(p.x,p.y,p.z);} public boolean contains(float x,float y,float z){return x>=minX&&x<maxX&&y>=minY&&y<maxY&&z>=minZ&&z<maxZ;}
    public Box contract(float x,float y,float z){return expand(-x,-y,-z);} public Box contract(float v){return expand(-v);} public Vec3 getMinPos(){return new Vec3(minX,minY,minZ);} public Vec3 getMaxPos(){return new Vec3(maxX,maxY,maxZ);}
    public float getAverageSideLength(){return (getLengthX()+getLengthY()+getLengthZ())/3;} public float getLengthX(){return maxX-minX;} public float getLengthY(){return maxY-minY;} public float getLengthZ(){return maxZ-minZ;}
    public boolean isNaN(){return Float.isNaN(minX)||Float.isNaN(minY)||Float.isNaN(minZ)||Float.isNaN(maxX)||Float.isNaN(maxY)||Float.isNaN(maxZ);}
    @Override public String toString(){return "AABB["+minX+", "+minY+", "+minZ+"] -> ["+maxX+", "+maxY+", "+maxZ+"]";}
    @Override public Box clone(){return new Box(minX,minY,minZ,maxX,maxY,maxZ,isValid());}
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/anticheat/util/math/Direction.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.anticheat.util.math;


public enum Direction {
    DOWN(Axis.Y, -1), UP(Axis.Y, 1), NORTH(Axis.Z, -1), SOUTH(Axis.Z, 1),
    WEST(Axis.X, -1), EAST(Axis.X, 1);

    public enum Axis { X, Y, Z }

    private final Axis axis;
    private final int step;

    Direction(Axis axis, int step) {
        this.axis = axis;
        this.step = step;
    }

    public Axis axis() { return axis; }
    public int step() { return step; }
    public int getXOffset() { return axis == Axis.X ? step : 0; }
    public int getYOffset() { return axis == Axis.Y ? step : 0; }
    public int getZOffset() { return axis == Axis.Z ? step : 0; }

    public Direction getOpposite() {
        return switch (this) {
            case DOWN -> UP;
            case UP -> DOWN;
            case NORTH -> SOUTH;
            case SOUTH -> NORTH;
            case WEST -> EAST;
            case EAST -> WEST;
        };
    }
}
```
