`src/main/java/ac/navro/anticheat/util/math/Vec3.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.anticheat.util.math;


public class Vec3 implements Cloneable {
    public static final Vec3 ZERO = new Vec3(0, 0, 0);
    public float x, y, z;

    public Vec3(float x, float y, float z) { this.x = x; this.y = y; this.z = z; }
    public Vec3(double x, double y, double z) { this((float) x, (float) y, (float) z); }
    public Vec3(org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector3f value) { this(value.getX(), value.getY(), value.getZ()); }

    public float getX() { return x; }
    public float getY() { return y; }
    public float getZ() { return z; }
    public float distToCenterSqr(Vec3 value) { return distToCenterSqr(value.x, value.y, value.z); }
    public float distToCenterSqr(float d, float e, float f) {
        float g = x + 0.5F - d, h = y + 0.5F - e, i = z + 0.5F - f;
        return g * g + h * h + i * i;
    }
    public org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector3f toVector3f() { return org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector3f.from(x, y, z); }
    public float squaredDistanceTo(Vec3 vec) { float d = vec.x - x, e = vec.y - y, f = vec.z - z; return d*d + e*e + f*f; }
    public float distanceTo(Vec3 vec) { return (float) Math.sqrt(squaredDistanceTo(vec)); }
    public float horizontalLength() { return (float) Math.sqrt(horizontalLengthSquared()); }
    public float horizontalLengthSquared() { return x*x + z*z; }
    public float lengthSquared() { return x*x + y*y + z*z; }
    public float length() { return (float) Math.sqrt(lengthSquared()); }
    public Vec3 add(float v) { return add(v, v, v); }
    public Vec3 add(Vec3 v) { return add(v.x, v.y, v.z); }
    public Vec3 add(float a, float b, float c) { return new Vec3(x+a, y+b, z+c); }
    public Vec3 add(double a, double b, double c) { return add((float)a, (float)b, (float)c); }
    public Vec3 subtract(Vec3 v) { return subtract(v.x, v.y, v.z); }
    public Vec3 subtract(float a, float b, float c) { return new Vec3(x-a, y-b, z-c); }
    public Vec3 subtract(double a, double b, double c) { return subtract((float)a, (float)b, (float)c); }
    public Vec3 multiply(float a) { return multiply(a, a, a); }
    public Vec3 multiply(float a, float b, float c) { return new Vec3(x*a, y*b, z*c); }
    public Vec3 multiply(double a, double b, double c) { return multiply((float)a, (float)b, (float)c); }
    public Vec3 multiply(Vec3 v) { return multiply(v.x, v.y, v.z); }
    public Vec3 divide(float a) { return divide(a, a, a); }
    public Vec3 divide(float a, float b, float c) { return new Vec3(x/a, y/b, z/c); }
    public Vec3 up(float a) { return new Vec3(x, y+a, z); }
    public Vec3 down(float a) { return new Vec3(x, y-a, z); }
    public Vec3 north(float a) { return new Vec3(x, y, z-a); }
    public Vec3 south(float a) { return new Vec3(x, y, z+a); }
    public Vec3 east(float a) { return new Vec3(x+a, y, z); }
    public Vec3 west(float a) { return new Vec3(x-a, y, z); }
    public Vec3 normalize() {
        float length = length();
        return Math.abs(length) < 1.1920929e-07F ? ZERO : new Vec3(x/length, y/length, z/length);
    }
    public String horizontalToString() { return "(" + x + ", " + z + ")"; }
    @Override public Vec3 clone() { return new Vec3(x, y, z); }
    @Override public String toString() { return "Vec3[" + x + ", " + y + ", " + z + "]"; }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/NavroProxy.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy;

import io.netty.bootstrap.ServerBootstrap;
import io.netty.channel.Channel;
import io.netty.channel.ChannelFuture;
import io.netty.channel.EventLoopGroup;
import io.netty.channel.nio.NioEventLoopGroup;
import io.netty.channel.socket.nio.NioDatagramChannel;
import org.cloudburstmc.netty.channel.raknet.RakChannelFactory;
import org.cloudburstmc.netty.channel.raknet.config.RakChannelOption;
import org.cloudburstmc.netty.channel.raknet.config.RakServerCookieMode;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.BedrockServerSession;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.netty.initializer.BedrockServerInitializer;

import java.net.InetSocketAddress;
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch;
import java.util.concurrent.ThreadLocalRandom;


public final class NavroProxy {
    private final ac.navro.proxy.alert.AlertManager alertManager;
    private final ac.navro.proxy.permission.ProxyPermissions permissions =
            new ac.navro.proxy.permission.ProxyPermissions(java.nio.file.Path.of("permissions.json"),System.out::println);
    public ac.navro.proxy.permission.ProxyPermissions permissions(){return permissions;}
    private final java.util.Map<java.util.UUID, java.util.function.Consumer<String>> onlineAlerts =
            new java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final ProxyConfig config;
    private ac.navro.proxy.protocol.FloodgateForwarding floodgateForwarding;
    private final ac.navro.proxy.command.CommandRuntime commands;
    public ac.navro.proxy.command.CommandRuntime commands(){return commands;}
    private final EventLoopGroup bossGroup = new NioEventLoopGroup(1);
    private final EventLoopGroup childGroup = new NioEventLoopGroup();
    private final EventLoopGroup backendGroup = new NioEventLoopGroup();
    private Channel serverChannel;
    private ac.navro.proxy.protocol.BackendAdvertisement backendAdvertisement;

    public NavroProxy(ProxyConfig config) {
        this.config = config;
        commands=new ac.navro.proxy.command.CommandRuntime(ac.navro.proxy.config.ConfigLoader.DEFAULT_FILE,config.smoothSetback(),config.maxBalanceAdvantageMs());
        java.nio.file.Path subscriptions = java.nio.file.Path.of("alert-subscriptions.json");
        boolean firstRun = !java.nio.file.Files.exists(subscriptions);
        alertManager = new ac.navro.proxy.alert.AlertManager(subscriptions, ()->commands.config().prefix(),
                System.out::println, () -> java.util.Map.copyOf(onlineAlerts));

        if (firstRun) alertManager.setAlert(ac.navro.proxy.alert.AlertManager.CONSOLE_UUID, true);
    }

    public ac.navro.proxy.alert.AlertManager getAlertManager() { return alertManager; }
    void registerAlertRecipient(java.util.UUID id, java.util.function.Consumer<String> recipient) {
        onlineAlerts.put(id, recipient);
    }
    void removeAlertRecipient(java.util.UUID id, java.util.function.Consumer<String> recipient) {
        onlineAlerts.remove(id, recipient);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        io.netty.util.internal.logging.InternalLoggerFactory.setDefaultFactory(
                io.netty.util.internal.logging.JdkLoggerFactory.INSTANCE);
        ProxyConfig config;
        try {
            config = ProxyConfig.parse(args);
        } catch (RuntimeException error) {
            System.err.println(error.getMessage());
            ProxyConfig.defaults();
            ProxyConfig.parse(new String[]{"--help"});
            return;
        }

        NavroProxy proxy = new NavroProxy(config);
        Runtime.getRuntime().addShutdownHook(new Thread(proxy::shutdown, "navro-proxy-shutdown"));
        try {
            proxy.start();
        } catch (Throwable error) {
            proxy.shutdown();
            throw error;
        }
        ac.navro.proxy.command.ConsoleCommands.start(proxy.commands(),proxy.getAlertManager());
        new CountDownLatch(1).await();
    }

    public ProxyConfig config() {
        return config;
    }

    ac.navro.proxy.protocol.FloodgateForwarding floodgateForwarding() {
        return floodgateForwarding;
    }

    EventLoopGroup backendGroup() {
        return backendGroup;
    }

    public void start() throws InterruptedException, java.io.IOException, java.security.GeneralSecurityException {
        if (config.floodgateForwardingKey() != null) {
            floodgateForwarding = ac.navro.proxy.protocol.FloodgateForwarding.load(config.floodgateForwardingKey());
        }
        if(config.mode()==ProxyConfig.Mode.DETECT)ac.navro.proxy.data.inventory.NativePredictionItems.initialize();
        long guid = ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextLong();
        backendAdvertisement = new ac.navro.proxy.protocol.BackendAdvertisement(guid);
        BedrockServerInitializer initializer = new BedrockServerInitializer() {
            @Override
            protected void postInitChannel(Channel channel) {
                PacketRelay.install(channel);
            }

            @Override
            protected void preInitChannel(Channel channel) throws Exception {

                channel.config().setOption(RakChannelOption.RAK_PROTOCOL_VERSION, 11);
                super.preInitChannel(channel);
            }
            @Override
            public void initSession(BedrockServerSession session) {
                log("accepted Bedrock session from " + session.getSocketAddress());
                new ProxySession(NavroProxy.this, session);
            }
        };

        ServerBootstrap bootstrap = new ServerBootstrap()
                .group(bossGroup, childGroup)
                .channelFactory(RakChannelFactory.server(NioDatagramChannel.class))
                .option(RakChannelOption.RAK_GUID, guid)
                .option(RakChannelOption.RAK_HANDLE_PING, true)
                .option(RakChannelOption.RAK_SERVER_COOKIE_MODE, RakServerCookieMode.INVALID)
                .childHandler(initializer);

        InetSocketAddress address = new InetSocketAddress(config.listenHost(), config.listenPort());
        ChannelFuture future = bootstrap.bind(address).sync();
        serverChannel = future.channel();
        backendAdvertisement.attach(serverChannel);
        backendAdvertisement.start(backendGroup, new InetSocketAddress(config.backendHost(), config.backendPort()));
        log("listening on " + address + ", backend " + config.backendHost() + ":" + config.backendPort()
                + ", fallback protocol " + config.fallbackProtocolVersion() + ", mode " + config.mode());
    }

    public void shutdown() {
        if (backendAdvertisement != null) backendAdvertisement.close();
        if (serverChannel != null) {
            serverChannel.close();
        }
        backendGroup.shutdownGracefully();
        childGroup.shutdownGracefully();
        bossGroup.shutdownGracefully();
    }

    void log(String message) {
        System.out.println("[NavroProxy] " + message);
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/PacketRelay.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy;

import io.netty.channel.Channel;
import io.netty.channel.ChannelHandlerContext;
import io.netty.channel.ChannelInboundHandlerAdapter;
import io.netty.util.AttributeKey;
import io.netty.util.ReferenceCountUtil;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.BedrockPeer;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.BedrockSession;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.netty.BedrockPacketWrapper;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.BedrockPacket;


final class PacketRelay extends ChannelInboundHandlerAdapter {
    private static final AttributeKey<BedrockPacketWrapper> CURRENT = AttributeKey.valueOf("navro.currentWirePacket");

    static void install(Channel channel) {
        channel.pipeline().addBefore(BedrockPeer.NAME, "navro-wire-relay", new PacketRelay());
    }

    @Override public void channelRead(ChannelHandlerContext ctx, Object msg) {
        if (!(msg instanceof BedrockPacketWrapper wrapper)) {
            ctx.fireChannelRead(msg);
            return;
        }
        ctx.channel().attr(CURRENT).set(wrapper);
        try {
            ctx.fireChannelRead(msg);
        } finally {
            ctx.channel().attr(CURRENT).set(null);
        }
    }

    static void forward(BedrockSession source, BedrockSession destination, BedrockPacket packet) {
        var wrapper = source.getPeer().getChannel().attr(CURRENT).get();
        if (wrapper != null && wrapper.getPacket() == packet) {
            destination.getPeer().sendPacket(wrapper.retain());
        } else {
            destination.sendPacket(ReferenceCountUtil.retain(packet));
        }
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/ProtocolDefinitions.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy;

import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.codec.BaseBedrockCodecHelper;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.codec.BedrockCodecHelper;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.EncodingSettings;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.definitions.BlockDefinition;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.definitions.ItemDefinition;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.BedrockPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.ItemComponentPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.StartGamePacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.common.DefinitionRegistry;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;


public final class ProtocolDefinitions {
    private final Map<Integer, ItemDefinition> itemsById = new HashMap<>();
    private final Map<String, ItemDefinition> itemsByName = new HashMap<>();
    private final Map<Integer, BlockDefinition> blocksById = new HashMap<>();

    private final DefinitionRegistry<ItemDefinition> items = new DefinitionRegistry<>() {
        @Override public ItemDefinition getDefinition(int id) { return itemsById.get(id); }
        @Override public ItemDefinition getDefinition(String name) { return itemsByName.get(name); }
        @Override public boolean isRegistered(ItemDefinition value) {
            return value != null && itemsById.get(value.getRuntimeId()) == value;
        }
    };

    private final DefinitionRegistry<BlockDefinition> blocks = new DefinitionRegistry<>() {
        @Override public BlockDefinition getDefinition(int id) {


            return blocksById.computeIfAbsent(id, WireBlockDefinition::new);
        }
        @Override public boolean isRegistered(BlockDefinition value) {
            return value != null && blocksById.get(value.getRuntimeId()) == value;
        }
    };


    public BlockDefinition blockDefinition(int networkId) {
        return blocks.getDefinition(networkId);
    }

    public void configure(BedrockCodecHelper helper, boolean readsBackend) {
        helper.setItemDefinitions(items);
        helper.setBlockDefinitions(blocks);
        if (readsBackend) {


            ((BaseBedrockCodecHelper) helper).setEncodingSettings(EncodingSettings.CLIENT);
        }
    }

    public void observeBackend(BedrockPacket packet) {
        if (packet instanceof StartGamePacket start && !start.getItemDefinitions().isEmpty()) {
            itemsById.clear();
            itemsByName.clear();
            register(start.getItemDefinitions());
        } else if (packet instanceof ItemComponentPacket component) {
            register(component.getItems());
        }
    }

    private void register(List<ItemDefinition> definitions) {
        for (ItemDefinition item : definitions) {
            ItemDefinition previous = itemsById.put(item.getRuntimeId(), item);
            if (previous != null) itemsByName.remove(previous.getIdentifier(), previous);
            itemsByName.put(item.getIdentifier(), item);
        }
    }

    private record WireBlockDefinition(int id) implements BlockDefinition {
        @Override public int getRuntimeId() { return id; }
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/ProxyConfig.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy;

import java.net.InetSocketAddress;
import java.nio.file.Path;


public record ProxyConfig(
        String listenHost,
        int listenPort,
        String backendHost,
        int backendPort,
        int fallbackProtocolVersion,
        long maxBalanceAdvantageMs,
        boolean debug,
        Mode mode,
        ac.navro.proxy.protocol.BackendType backendType,
        boolean smoothSetback,
        boolean encryptBackend,
        Path floodgateForwardingKey
) {
    public ProxyConfig {
        if (encryptBackend && !"127.0.0.1".equals(backendHost)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("--encrypt-backend requires an explicit 127.0.0.1 backend");
        }
        if (floodgateForwardingKey != null && !encryptBackend) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("--floodgate-forwarding-key requires --encrypt-backend");
        }
    }

    public ProxyConfig(String listenHost, int listenPort, String backendHost, int backendPort,
                       int protocol, long maxBalanceAdvantageMs, boolean debug, Mode mode,
                       ac.navro.proxy.protocol.BackendType backendType, boolean smoothSetback, boolean encryptBackend) {
        this(listenHost, listenPort, backendHost, backendPort, protocol, maxBalanceAdvantageMs,
                debug, mode, backendType, smoothSetback, encryptBackend, null);
    }

    public ProxyConfig(String listenHost, int listenPort, String backendHost, int backendPort,
                       int protocol, long maxBalanceAdvantageMs, boolean debug, Mode mode,
                       ac.navro.proxy.protocol.BackendType backendType, boolean smoothSetback) {
        this(listenHost, listenPort, backendHost, backendPort, protocol, maxBalanceAdvantageMs,
                debug, mode, backendType, smoothSetback, false);
    }

    public ProxyConfig(String listenHost, int listenPort, String backendHost, int backendPort,
                       int protocol, long maxBalanceAdvantageMs, boolean debug, Mode mode,
                       ac.navro.proxy.protocol.BackendType backendType) {
        this(listenHost, listenPort, backendHost, backendPort, protocol, maxBalanceAdvantageMs,
                debug, mode, backendType, false);
    }

    public ProxyConfig(String listenHost, int listenPort, String backendHost, int backendPort,
                       int protocol, long maxBalanceAdvantageMs, boolean debug, Mode mode) {
        this(listenHost, listenPort, backendHost, backendPort, protocol, maxBalanceAdvantageMs,
                debug, mode, ac.navro.proxy.protocol.BackendType.NAVRO);
    }

    public enum Mode {
        INSPECT, DETECT
    }

    public static ProxyConfig defaults() {
        return new ProxyConfig("0.0.0.0", 19132, "127.0.0.1", 19133, 898, 8500, false, Mode.DETECT);
    }

    public static ProxyConfig parse(String[] args) {
        ProxyConfig defaults = defaults();
        String listenHost = defaults.listenHost();
        int listenPort = defaults.listenPort();
        String backendHost = defaults.backendHost();
        int backendPort = defaults.backendPort();
        int protocol = defaults.fallbackProtocolVersion();
        long maxBalanceAdvantageMs = defaults.maxBalanceAdvantageMs();
        boolean debug = defaults.debug();
        Mode mode = defaults.mode();
        var backendType = defaults.backendType();
        boolean smoothSetback = defaults.smoothSetback();
        boolean encryptBackend = defaults.encryptBackend();
        Path floodgateForwardingKey = defaults.floodgateForwardingKey();

        for (int i = 0; i < args.length; i++) {
            String arg = args[i];
            switch (arg) {
                case "--listen" -> {
                    String value = requireValue(args, ++i, arg);
                    InetSocketAddress address = parseAddress(value, listenPort);
                    listenHost = address.getHostString();
                    listenPort = address.getPort();
                }
                case "--backend" -> {
                    String value = requireValue(args, ++i, arg);
                    InetSocketAddress address = parseAddress(value, backendPort);
                    backendHost = address.getHostString();
                    backendPort = address.getPort();
                }
                case "--backend-type" -> backendType = ac.navro.proxy.protocol.BackendType.parse(requireValue(args, ++i, arg));
                case "--protocol" -> protocol = Integer.parseInt(requireValue(args, ++i, arg));
                case "--max-balance-advantage-ms" -> maxBalanceAdvantageMs = Long.parseLong(requireValue(args, ++i, arg));
                case "--smooth-setback" -> smoothSetback = true;
                case "--encrypt-backend" -> encryptBackend = true;
                case "--floodgate-forwarding-key" -> floodgateForwardingKey = Path.of(requireValue(args, ++i, arg));
                case "--debug" -> debug = true;
                case "--mode" -> mode = Mode.valueOf(requireValue(args, ++i, arg).toUpperCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT));
                case "--inspect" -> mode = Mode.INSPECT;
                case "--detect" -> mode = Mode.DETECT;
                case "--help", "-h" -> {
                    printUsage();
                    System.exit(0);
                }
                default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown argument: " + arg);
            }
        }

        if (listenPort < 1 || listenPort > 65535 || backendPort < 1 || backendPort > 65535) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Ports must be between 1 and 65535");
        }
        return new ProxyConfig(listenHost, listenPort, backendHost, backendPort, protocol,
                maxBalanceAdvantageMs, debug, mode, backendType, smoothSetback, encryptBackend, floodgateForwardingKey);
    }

    private static String requireValue(String[] args, int index, String option) {
        if (index >= args.length) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing value for " + option);
        }
        return args[index];
    }

    private static InetSocketAddress parseAddress(String value, int defaultPort) {
        int separator = value.lastIndexOf(':');
        if (separator <= 0 || separator == value.length() - 1) {
            return new InetSocketAddress(value, defaultPort);
        }
        return new InetSocketAddress(value.substring(0, separator), Integer.parseInt(value.substring(separator + 1)));
    }

    private static void printUsage() {
        System.out.println("NavroProxy options:");
        System.out.println("  --listen host:port   listen address (default 0.0.0.0:19132)");
        System.out.println("  --backend host:port  Bedrock backend (default 127.0.0.1:19133)");
        System.out.println("  --backend-type navro|bds  movement semantics (default navro)");
        System.out.println("  --encrypt-backend    require Bedrock encryption with a trusted 127.0.0.1 backend");
        System.out.println("  --floodgate-forwarding-key path    PKCS#8 PEM signing key for the Geyser backend (RakNet only)");
        System.out.println("  --protocol version    fallback Bedrock protocol (default 898)");
        System.out.println("  --max-balance-advantage-ms milliseconds (default 8500, Navro Timer)");
        System.out.println("  --smooth-setback      use Boar-style soft corrections (default false; hard correction remains available)");
        System.out.println("  --debug               log packet summaries");
        System.out.println("  --mode detect|inspect    default detect; inspect observes without checks");
    }
}
```

```java
package ac.navro.proxy;

import ac.navro.proxy.listener.PacketListener;
import ac.navro.proxy.protocol.RakNetBackendEncryption;
import ac.navro.proxy.util.EntityBatchEncoder;
import ac.navro.proxy.packets.other.NetworkLatencyPackets;
import ac.navro.proxy.packets.server.ServerChunkPackets;
import io.netty.bootstrap.Bootstrap;
import io.netty.channel.ChannelFuture;
import io.netty.channel.ChannelOption;
import io.netty.channel.EventLoopGroup;
import io.netty.channel.socket.nio.NioDatagramChannel;
import io.netty.util.ReferenceCountUtil;
import com.google.gson.JsonParser;
import org.cloudburstmc.netty.channel.raknet.RakChannelFactory;
import org.cloudburstmc.netty.channel.raknet.config.RakChannelOption;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.BedrockClientSession;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.BedrockServerSession;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.codec.BedrockCodec;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PacketCompressionAlgorithm;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.auth.AuthType;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.netty.initializer.BedrockClientInitializer;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.BedrockPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.LoginPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.ClientToServerHandshakePacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.DisconnectPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.NetworkSettingsPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.RequestNetworkSettingsPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.ServerToClientHandshakePacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.NetworkStackLatencyPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.ServerboundLoadingScreenPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.util.ChainValidationResult;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.util.EncryptionUtils;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.common.PacketSignal;

import java.net.InetSocketAddress;
import java.security.KeyPair;
import java.security.PublicKey;
import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.Queue;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import javax.crypto.SecretKey;


public final class ProxySession {
    private final NavroProxy proxy;
    private final BedrockServerSession client;
    private final Queue<BedrockPacket> queuedClientPackets = new ArrayDeque<>();
    private final SessionState state;
    private final ProtocolDefinitions definitions = new ProtocolDefinitions();
    private final AtomicBoolean closed = new AtomicBoolean();
    private final ac.navro.proxy.util.block.BlockCorrectionSender blockCorrections;
    private final ac.navro.proxy.permission.ProtocolPermissions permissions=new ac.navro.proxy.permission.ProtocolPermissions();
    private final ac.navro.proxy.teleport.TeleportSender teleportSender;
    private BedrockCodec codec;
    private BedrockClientSession backend;
    private ChannelFuture backendConnect;
    private boolean clientEncryptionStarted;
    private LoginPacket pendingLogin;
    private boolean clientHandshakeAccepted;
    private boolean backendNetworkSettingsReceived;
    private boolean backendEncryptionReady;
    private RakNetBackendEncryption backendEncryption;
    private io.netty.util.concurrent.ScheduledFuture<?> backendEncryptionTimeout;
    private io.netty.util.concurrent.ScheduledFuture<?> serverTickTask;
    private java.util.UUID identity;
    private java.util.Set<String> proxyCommandNames = ac.navro.proxy.command.NavroCommand.NAMES;
    private final java.util.function.Consumer<String> alertRecipient = this::sendAlertMessage;

    public ProxySession(NavroProxy proxy, BedrockServerSession client) {
        this.proxy = proxy;
        this.state = new SessionState(proxy.config().backendType());
        this.client = client;
        state.setBackendSyncTransport(packet->{if(backendReady())backend.sendPacket(packet);});
        this.teleportSender=new ac.navro.proxy.teleport.TeleportSender(client,state,()->!closed.get()&&clientHandshakeAccepted);
        state.setTeleportTransport(teleportSender::send);
        state.setPredictionMotionTransport(teleportSender::sendMotion);
        state.setSoftCorrectionTransport(teleportSender::send);
        state.setSmoothSetback(proxy.config().smoothSetback());
        state.setCommandRuntime(proxy.commands());
        state.setClientStateCorrectionTransport(client::sendPacket);
        state.player().setTimerTeleport(teleportSender::teleportToLastValid);
        this.blockCorrections = new ac.navro.proxy.util.block.BlockCorrectionSender(client, definitions,
                state.player(), () -> !closed.get() && clientHandshakeAccepted, state::onProxyBlockCorrection);
        state.setBlockCorrectionTransport((position, blocks) ->
                blockCorrections.restoreCorrectBlock(position, blocks.layerZero(), blocks.layerOne()));
        var alerts = proxy.getAlertManager();
        state.player().setFormattedAlertSink(message -> {
            alerts.formattedAlert(message);
            state.forwardBackendAlert(message);
        });
        state.player().setAlertSink(message -> state.player().formattedAlert(alerts.getPrefix() + "§3" + message));
        state.player().setDisconnectSink(reason->client.getPeer().getChannel().eventLoop().execute(()->disconnect(reason)));
        state.player().setCorrectionRequestSink(this::log);
        state.player().setMaxBalanceAdvantageMs(proxy.config().maxBalanceAdvantageMs());
        state.setDetectionEnabled(proxy.config().mode() == ProxyConfig.Mode.DETECT);
        if(proxy.config().debug()){
            var trace=new ac.navro.proxy.diagnostics.WorldCollisionDiagnostics(state.player(),state.world(),java.util.UUID.randomUUID().toString(),ac.navro.proxy.diagnostics.WorldCollisionDiagnostics.fileSink());
            state.player().setWorldDiagnostics(trace);trace.event("session_open",ac.navro.proxy.diagnostics.WorldCollisionDiagnostics.fields("remote",client.getSocketAddress().toString()));
            log("world/collision diagnostics: "+ac.navro.proxy.diagnostics.WorldCollisionDiagnostics.logPath());
        }
        this.client.setLogging(proxy.config().debug());
        if (state.backendType() == ac.navro.proxy.protocol.BackendType.BDS) {
            var correctionAcknowledgments = new ac.navro.proxy.bds.BdsCorrectionAcknowledgments();
            state.setBdsCorrectionAcknowledgmentDispatcher(correctionAcknowledgments::defer);
            this.client.getPeer().getChannel().pipeline().addBefore(
                    org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.netty.codec.batch.BedrockBatchDecoder.NAME,
                    "navro-bds-inbound-correction-ack", correctionAcknowledgments);
        }
        this.client.setPacketHandler(new ClientPacketHandler());
        this.client.getPeer().getChannel().closeFuture().addListener(ignored -> close());
        state.placementPipeline().setTransports(packet->{
            if(closed.get()||!backendReady())return false;
            backend.sendPacket(packet);return true;
        },client::sendPacket);
        log("RakNet session created");
    }

    public SessionState state() {
        return state;
    }


    public void restoreCorrectBlock(org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector3i position,
                                    int layerZeroNetworkId, int layerOneNetworkId) {
        blockCorrections.restoreCorrectBlock(position, layerZeroNetworkId, layerOneNetworkId);
    }

    public void restoreCorrectBlock(org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector3i position, int networkId) {
        blockCorrections.restoreCorrectBlock(position, networkId);
    }

    public BedrockCodec codec() {
        return codec;
    }

    void handleClientPacket(BedrockPacket packet) {
        if(ac.navro.proxy.backend.BackendStateSync.privatePacket(packet))return;
        if (closed.get()) {
            return;
        }
        boolean ownLatency = false;
        if (packet instanceof NetworkStackLatencyPacket latency) {
            ownLatency = NetworkLatencyPackets.onPacket(state.player(), latency);
        } else if (packet instanceof ServerboundLoadingScreenPacket loading) {
            ServerChunkPackets.finishLoadingScreen(state.player(), loading);
        }
        if (!state.receiveClient(packet, proxy.config().maxBalanceAdvantageMs()) || state.player().disconnectRequested()) return;
        logPacket("client -> proxy", packet);
        if (ownLatency) return;

        if (packet instanceof RequestNetworkSettingsPacket request) {
            BedrockCodec requested = SupportedCodecs.forProtocol(request.getProtocolVersion());
            if (requested == null) {
                requested = SupportedCodecs.fallback(proxy.config().fallbackProtocolVersion());
                if (requested.getProtocolVersion() != request.getProtocolVersion()) {
                    disconnect("Unsupported Bedrock protocol " + request.getProtocolVersion());
                    return;
                }
            }
            codec = requested;
            state.setProtocolVersion(codec.getProtocolVersion());
            state.player().setProtocolVersion(codec.getProtocolVersion());
            client.getPeer().setCodec(codec);
            definitions.configure(client.getPeer().getCodecHelper(), false);
            log("negotiated Bedrock protocol " + request.getProtocolVersion());
            connectBackend(request);
            return;
        }

        if (packet instanceof LoginPacket login) {
            if (clientEncryptionStarted || codec == null) {
                disconnect("Unexpected Bedrock login packet");
                return;
            }
            pendingLogin = login;
            if (!startClientEncryption(login)) {
                return;
            }
            return;
        }

        if (packet instanceof ClientToServerHandshakePacket) {
            if (!clientEncryptionStarted || clientHandshakeAccepted || pendingLogin == null) {
                disconnect("Unexpected Bedrock encryption confirmation");
                return;
            }
            clientHandshakeAccepted = true;
            state.player().setEntityBatchEncoder(EntityBatchEncoder.install(client, state.player().getLatencyUtil()));
            if (proxy.config().encryptBackend()) {
                if (!backendNetworkSettingsReceived || backend == null || !backend.isConnected()) {
                    disconnect("Backend encryption requested before Bedrock network settings");
                    return;
                }
                backendEncryptionTimeout = backend.getPeer().getChannel().eventLoop().schedule(
                        () -> disconnect("Bedrock backend encryption handshake timed out"), 10, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
            }
            forwardToBackend(pendingLogin);
            pendingLogin = null;
            log("client encryption handshake confirmed");
            return;
        }

        if (!clientHandshakeAccepted) {
            disconnect("Game packet received before Bedrock login completed");
            return;
        }
        if (proxy.config().encryptBackend() && !backendEncryptionReady) return;
        if(packet instanceof org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.CommandRequestPacket command
                &&ac.navro.proxy.command.NavroCommand.handle(command.getCommand(),new ac.navro.proxy.command.NavroCommand.Sender(){
                    public java.util.UUID identity(){return identity;}
                    public String name(){return state.player().getName();}
                    public boolean hasPermission(String node){return proxy.permissions().hasPermission(identity,node,permissions.isOperator());}
                    public void sendMessage(String message){sendAlertMessage(message);}
                },proxy.getAlertManager(),proxy.commands(),proxyCommandNames))return;
        forwardToBackend(packet);
    }

    private void forwardToBackend(BedrockPacket packet) {
        state.onClientPacketForwarded(packet);


        if (backend == null || !backend.isConnected()) {
            ReferenceCountUtil.retain(packet);
            queuedClientPackets.add(packet);
            return;
        }
        if(state.detectionEnabled() && packet instanceof org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.PlayerAuthInputPacket)
            backend.sendPacket(packet);
        else PacketRelay.forward(client, backend, packet);
    }

    private boolean backendReady() {
        return backend != null && backend.isConnected()
                && (!proxy.config().encryptBackend() || backendEncryptionReady);
    }


    private boolean startClientEncryption(LoginPacket login) {
        try {
            if (login.getAuthPayload() == null || login.getAuthPayload().getAuthType() == AuthType.GUEST) {
                disconnect("Guest or missing Bedrock login is not accepted");
                return false;
            }

            ChainValidationResult chain = EncryptionUtils.validatePayload(login.getAuthPayload());
            if (!chain.signed()) {
                disconnect("Invalid Bedrock login chain");
                return false;
            }

            PublicKey identityKey = chain.identityClaims().parsedIdentityPublicKey();
            byte[] clientData = EncryptionUtils.verifyClientData(login.getClientJwt(), identityKey);
            if (clientData == null) {
                disconnect("Invalid Bedrock client data signature");
                return false;
            }
            var verifiedIdentity=ac.navro.proxy.protocol.LoginIdentity.fromVerifiedChain(chain);
            if (proxy.config().encryptBackend()) {
                backendEncryption = new RakNetBackendEncryption();
                var forwarding = proxy.floodgateForwarding();
                if (forwarding != null) {
                    pendingLogin = backendEncryption.forwardedLogin(login.getProtocolVersion(), chain, clientData,
                            (InetSocketAddress) client.getSocketAddress(), forwarding);
                } else {
                    pendingLogin = backendEncryption.login(login.getProtocolVersion(), verifiedIdentity,
                            chain.rawIdentityClaims(), clientData);
                }
            }
            state.player().setName(verifiedIdentity.displayName());
            identity=verifiedIdentity.uuid();
            state.setExemptionPermission(() -> proxy.permissions().hasPermission(identity,"navro.exempt",false));
            proxy.registerAlertRecipient(identity,alertRecipient);
            proxy.commands().attach(identity,state);
            try {
                int deviceOs = JsonParser.parseString(new String(clientData, StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
                        .getAsJsonObject().get("DeviceOS").getAsInt();
                state.player().setDeviceOs(deviceOs);
            } catch (RuntimeException ignored) {
                state.player().setDeviceOs(-1);
            }

            KeyPair serverKeyPair = EncryptionUtils.createKeyPair();
            byte[] token = EncryptionUtils.generateRandomToken();
            ServerToClientHandshakePacket handshake = new ServerToClientHandshakePacket();
            handshake.setJwt(EncryptionUtils.createHandshakeJwt(serverKeyPair, token));
            client.sendPacketImmediately(handshake);

            SecretKey encryptionKey = EncryptionUtils.getSecretKey(serverKeyPair.getPrivate(), identityKey, token);
            client.enableEncryption(encryptionKey);
            clientEncryptionStarted = true;
            log("client identity verified: "+state.player().getName()+" ("+identity+"); public encryption enabled");
            return true;
        } catch (Exception | LinkageError error) {
            error.printStackTrace();
            disconnect("Unable to validate Bedrock login: " + error.getMessage());
            return false;
        }
    }

    private void connectBackend(RequestNetworkSettingsPacket request) {
        if (backendConnect != null) {
            return;
        }

        InetSocketAddress target = new InetSocketAddress(proxy.config().backendHost(), proxy.config().backendPort());
        backendConnect = new Bootstrap()


                .group(client.getPeer().getChannel().eventLoop())
                .channelFactory(RakChannelFactory.client(NioDatagramChannel.class))
                .option(ChannelOption.CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MILLIS, 10_000)
                .option(RakChannelOption.RAK_PROTOCOL_VERSION, codec.getRaknetProtocolVersion())
                .handler(new BackendInitializer())
                .connect(target);
        backendConnect.addListener(future -> {
            if (!future.isSuccess()) {
                Throwable cause = future.cause();
                Throwable root = cause;
                while (root != null && root.getCause() != null && root.getCause() != root) {
                    root = root.getCause();
                }
                String detail = cause == null ? "connection failed without a cause"
                        : cause.getClass().getSimpleName() + ": " + String.valueOf(cause.getMessage());
                if (root != null && root != cause) {
                    detail += "; root=" + root.getClass().getSimpleName() + ": "
                            + String.valueOf(root.getMessage());
                }
                if (proxy.config().debug() && cause != null) cause.printStackTrace(System.err);
                disconnect("Unable to connect to Bedrock backend: " + detail);
            } else {
                log("connected to backend " + target);
            }
        });
    }

    private void attachBackend(BedrockClientSession session) {
        if (closed.get()) {
            session.disconnect("Proxy session closed");
            return;
        }
        backend = session;
        backend.setLogging(proxy.config().debug());
        backend.setCodec(codec);
        definitions.configure(backend.getPeer().getCodecHelper(), true);
        backend.getPeer().getChannel().closeFuture().addListener(ignored -> disconnect("Bedrock backend disconnected"));
        RequestNetworkSettingsPacket request = new RequestNetworkSettingsPacket();
        request.setProtocolVersion(codec.getProtocolVersion());
        backend.sendPacket(request);
        while (!queuedClientPackets.isEmpty()) {
            backend.sendPacket(queuedClientPackets.remove());
        }
    }

    void handleBackendPacket(BedrockPacket packet) {
        if (closed.get()) {
            return;
        }
        if (packet instanceof ServerToClientHandshakePacket handshake) {
            completeBackendEncryption(handshake);
            return;
        }
        if (proxy.config().encryptBackend() && !backendEncryptionReady
                && !(packet instanceof DisconnectPacket) && !(packet instanceof NetworkSettingsPacket)) {
            disconnect("Bedrock backend sent packets before completing the encryption handshake");
            return;
        }
        String backendViolation = state.validateBackend(packet);
        if (backendViolation != null) {
            disconnect("Invalid backend packet: " + backendViolation);
            return;
        }
        if(state.consumeBackendSync(packet))return;
        if (packet instanceof NetworkStackLatencyPacket latency) {
            NetworkLatencyPackets.onPacketSend(state.player(), latency);
        }
        PacketListener.onPacketSent(state.player(), packet);
        state.observeBackend(packet);
        if(packet instanceof org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.AvailableCommandsPacket commands)
            proxyCommandNames = state.isPocketMineBackend()
                    ? ac.navro.proxy.command.NavroCommand.unclaimedNames(commands)
                    : ac.navro.proxy.command.NavroCommand.advertise(commands);
        if (packet instanceof org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.StartGamePacket && serverTickTask == null) {
            serverTickTask = client.getPeer().getChannel().eventLoop().scheduleAtFixedRate(this::serverTick,
                    50, 50, java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
        }
        permissions.observe(state.player(),packet);
        definitions.observeBackend(packet);
        logPacket("backend -> proxy", packet);
        if (packet instanceof org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.ItemComponentPacket items) {
            log("registered " + items.getItems().size() + " backend item definitions");
        } else if (packet instanceof org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.CreativeContentPacket creative) {
            log("decoded creative contents: groups=" + creative.getGroups().size()
                    + ", items=" + creative.getContents().size());
        }

        if (packet instanceof NetworkSettingsPacket settings) {
            client.sendPacketImmediately(packet);
            client.setCompression(settings.getCompressionAlgorithm());
            backend.setCompression(settings.getCompressionAlgorithm());
            backendNetworkSettingsReceived = true;
            return;
        }
        if(state.detectionEnabled() && packet instanceof org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.SetEntityMotionPacket motion && motion.getRuntimeEntityId()==state.player().runtimeId()){
            client.sendPacket(motion);
        } else if(state.detectionEnabled() && packet instanceof org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.MovementEffectPacket effect
                &&effect.getEntityRuntimeId()==state.player().runtimeId()){
            client.sendPacket(effect);
        } else if (packet instanceof NetworkStackLatencyPacket latency) {

            client.sendPacket(latency.clone());
        } else if(packet instanceof org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.AvailableCommandsPacket commands
                && !state.isPocketMineBackend()){
            client.sendPacket(commands);
        } else if(packet instanceof org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.MovePlayerPacket move
                &&move.getRuntimeEntityId()==state.player().runtimeId()
                &&move.getMode()!=org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.MovePlayerPacket.Mode.HEAD_ROTATION){
            client.sendPacket(move);
        } else PacketRelay.forward(backend, client, packet);
        state.onBackendPacketQueued(packet);
    }

    private void completeBackendEncryption(ServerToClientHandshakePacket handshake) {
        if (!proxy.config().encryptBackend()) {
            disconnect("Backend requested Bedrock encryption. Use --encrypt-backend with a trusted private backend.");
            return;
        }
        if (backendEncryption == null || backendEncryptionTimeout == null || backendEncryptionReady) {
            disconnect("Unexpected Bedrock backend encryption handshake");
            return;
        }
        try {
            backendEncryption.complete(backend, handshake.getJwt());
            backendEncryptionReady = true;
            backendEncryption = null;
            backendEncryptionTimeout.cancel(false);
            backendEncryptionTimeout = null;
            log("Bedrock backend encryption handshake confirmed");
        } catch (Exception | LinkageError error) {
            if (proxy.config().debug()) error.printStackTrace();
            disconnect("Invalid Bedrock backend encryption handshake");
        }
    }

    public void disconnect(String reason) {
        if (!closed.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
            return;
        }
        log("disconnect: " + reason);
        try {
            if (client.isConnected()) client.disconnect(reason);
        } finally {
            closeBackend();
        }
    }

    private void close() {
        closed.set(true);
        while (!queuedClientPackets.isEmpty()) ReferenceCountUtil.safeRelease(queuedClientPackets.remove());
        if (backendConnect != null && !backendConnect.isDone()) backendConnect.cancel(false);
        closeBackend();
    }

    private void closeBackend() {
        if (backendEncryptionTimeout != null) backendEncryptionTimeout.cancel(false);
        backendEncryptionTimeout = null;
        backendEncryption = null;
        pendingLogin = null;
        state.closeBackendWorld();
        if(state.player().worldDiagnostics()!=null)state.player().worldDiagnostics().event("session_close",java.util.Map.of());
        if (identity != null) { proxy.removeAlertRecipient(identity, alertRecipient);proxy.commands().detach(identity,state); }
        if (serverTickTask != null) serverTickTask.cancel(false);
        if (state.player().getEntityBatchEncoder() != null) state.player().getEntityBatchEncoder().close();
        else state.player().getLatencyUtil().close();
        BedrockClientSession current = backend;
        if (current != null && current.isConnected()) {
            current.disconnect("Proxy session closed");
        }
    }

    private void serverTick() {
        state.placementTick();
        if (closed.get() || state.player().isExempted()) return;
        var latency = state.player().getLatencyUtil();
        var encoder = state.player().getEntityBatchEncoder();
        if (latency.sentQueue().isEmpty()) {
            if (encoder != null && encoder.hasPending()) return;
            if (encoder != null) encoder.keepalive();
            return;
        }
        if (System.currentTimeMillis() - latency.prevAcceptedTime > state.maxLatencyWait()) disconnect(state.configuredMessage("disconnect-timeout",java.util.Map.of()));
    }

    private void sendAlertMessage(String message) {
        Runnable send = () -> {
            if (closed.get()) return;
            var packet = new org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.TextPacket();
            packet.setType(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.TextPacket.Type.RAW);
            packet.setMessage(message);
            packet.setNeedsTranslation(false);
            packet.setSourceName("");
            packet.setXuid("");
            packet.setPlatformChatId("");
            client.sendPacket(packet);
        };
        var loop=client.getPeer().getChannel().eventLoop();
        if(loop.inEventLoop())send.run();else loop.execute(send);
    }

    private void logPacket(String direction, BedrockPacket packet) {
        if (proxy.config().debug()) {
            log(direction + " " + packet.getClass().getSimpleName());
        }
    }

    private void log(String message) {
        proxy.log("[" + client.getSocketAddress() + "] " + message);
    }

    private final class ClientPacketHandler implements org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.BedrockPacketHandler {
        @Override
        public PacketSignal handlePacket(BedrockPacket packet) {
            handleClientPacket(packet);
            return PacketSignal.HANDLED;
        }

        @Override
        public void onDisconnect(CharSequence reason) {
            close();
        }
    }

    private final class BackendPacketHandler implements org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.BedrockPacketHandler {
        @Override
        public PacketSignal handlePacket(BedrockPacket packet) {
            handleBackendPacket(packet);
            return PacketSignal.HANDLED;
        }

        @Override
        public void onDisconnect(CharSequence reason) {
            disconnect("Bedrock backend disconnected: " + reason);
        }
    }

    private final class BackendInitializer extends BedrockClientInitializer {
        @Override
        protected void postInitChannel(io.netty.channel.Channel channel) {
            PacketRelay.install(channel);
        }

        @Override
        public void initSession(BedrockClientSession session) {
            session.setCodec(codec);
            session.setPacketHandler(new BackendPacketHandler());
            attachBackend(session);
        }
    }
}
```

```java
    public SessionState(ac.navro.proxy.protocol.BackendType backendType) {
        this.backendType = java.util.Objects.requireNonNull(backendType);
        player.setNativeServerTickAvailable(world::hasNativeServerTick);
        player.setNativeSprintSynchronization(backendType == ac.navro.proxy.protocol.BackendType.BDS);
        player.getCheckHolder().put(ac.navro.proxy.check.impl.elytra.ElytraA.class,
                new ac.navro.proxy.check.impl.elytra.ElytraA(this));
        world.setCollisionActor(() -> new ac.navro.proxy.collision.BedrockCollision.Actor(
                player.boundingBox().minY, authInputPackets == null ? 0 : authInputPackets.context().fallDistance,
                player.inputData().contains(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData.SNEAKING)
                        || player.inputData().contains(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData.DESCEND),
                player.hasFlag(71),
                hasLeatherBoots()));
    }
    private boolean hasLeatherBoots() {
        var boots=inventory.armorContainer.get(3).getData();
        int protocol=player.protocolVersion()>0?player.protocolVersion():world.protocolVersion();
        return boots!=null&&!boots.isNull()&&protocol>0
                &&ac.navro.proxy.data.inventory.NativePredictionItems.resolve(protocol,boots).nativeId()==301;
    }

    public void onClientPacketForwarded(BedrockPacket packet) {
        boolean inventoryAction = packet instanceof ItemStackRequestPacket
                || packet instanceof InventoryTransactionPacket
                || packet instanceof PlayerAuthInputPacket input
                        && (input.getItemStackRequest() != null || input.getItemUseTransaction() != null);
        if (!inventoryAction) return;

        backendInventories.markAllPending();

        int hotbarSlot = -1;
        if (packet instanceof InventoryTransactionPacket transaction) {
            hotbarSlot = transaction.getHotbarSlot();
        } else if (packet instanceof PlayerAuthInputPacket input
                && input.getItemUseTransaction() != null) {
            hotbarSlot = input.getItemUseTransaction().getHotbarSlot();
        }
        if (hotbarSlot >= 0 && hotbarSlot <= 8) backendInventories.markPending(0, hotbarSlot);
    }
    public void onProxyInventoryCorrection(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.InventoryContentPacket packet) {

    public void restoreCorrectBlock(Vector3i position) {
        var blocks=acknowledgedTerrainGeneration==backendBlocks.generation()?backendBlocks.at(position):null;
        var log=player.worldDiagnostics();
        if(log!=null)log.event("block_break_correction",
                ac.navro.proxy.diagnostics.WorldCollisionDiagnostics.fields(
                        "position",position.toString(),"sourceKnown",blocks!=null,
                        "layerZero",blocks==null?null:blocks.layerZero(),
                        "layerOne",blocks==null?null:blocks.layerOne()));
        if(blocks!=null)blockCorrectionTransport.accept(position,blocks);
    }

    private void rejectInventoryInteraction(BedrockPacket packet) {
        var response = new org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.ItemStackResponsePacket();
        if (packet instanceof ItemStackRequestPacket requests) {
            for (var request : requests.getRequests()) rejectInventoryRequest(response, request);
        } else if (packet instanceof PlayerAuthInputPacket input) {
            rejectInventoryRequest(response, input.getItemStackRequest());
        }
        if (!response.getEntries().isEmpty()) clientStateCorrection.accept(response);

        var containers = new java.util.LinkedHashSet<Integer>(List.of(0, 119, 120, 124));
        if (inventory.openContainer != null) containers.add(Byte.toUnsignedInt(inventory.openContainer.getId()));
        for (int id : containers) {
            var content = backendInventories.fullPacket(id);
            if (content != null) clientStateCorrection.accept(content);
        }
    }

    private static void rejectInventoryRequest(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.ItemStackResponsePacket response,
            org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.itemstack.request.ItemStackRequest request) {
        if (request != null) response.getEntries().add(
                new org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.itemstack.response.ItemStackResponse(
                        org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.itemstack.response.ItemStackResponseStatus.ERROR,
                        request.getRequestId(), List.of()));
    }
    public void resyncGliding() {
        var metadata=new SetEntityDataPacket();metadata.setRuntimeEntityId(player.runtimeId());
        ac.navro.proxy.util.EntityMetadataUtil.writeFlags(metadata.getMetadata(),player.trackedFlags().cloneFlags());
        metadata.getMetadata().setFlag(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.entity.EntityFlag.GLIDING,false);
        clientStateCorrection.accept(metadata);


        var armor=backendInventories.fullPacket(120);
        if(armor!=null){onProxyInventoryCorrection(armor);clientStateCorrection.accept(armor);}
    }

    public ac.navro.proxy.teleport.data.TeleportData onProxyTeleport(MovePlayerPacket packet){
        var data=queueMovementTeleport(packet, false);
        recordEvent(WireEvent.Direction.PROXY,packet);
        packetCounts.merge("proxy:MovePlayerPacket",1,Integer::sum);
        return data;
    }
    private ac.navro.proxy.teleport.data.TeleportData queueMovementTeleport(MovePlayerPacket packet, boolean fromBackend){
        if(packet.getRuntimeEntityId()!=player.runtimeId()||packet.getMode()==MovePlayerPacket.Mode.HEAD_ROTATION)return null;
        if(packet.getMode()==null)packet.setMode(MovePlayerPacket.Mode.NORMAL);
        if(packet.getTeleportationCause()==null)packet.setTeleportationCause(MovePlayerPacket.TeleportationCause.UNKNOWN);
        var p=packet.getPosition();
        ac.navro.proxy.teleport.data.TeleportData data=predictionResetPackets.remove(packet);
        if(data==null){if(authInputPackets!=null)authInputPackets.velocityPackets().clearExternalMotion();data=new ac.navro.proxy.teleport.data.TeleportData(new Vec3(p),packet.isOnGround(),packet.getMode().ordinal());}
        var queued = data;
        boolean backendTeleport = fromBackend && packet.getMode() == MovePlayerPacket.Mode.TELEPORT;
        teleports.queue(queued, accept -> player.queueAcknowledgment(packet, () -> {
            accept.run();
            if (backendTeleport) teleports.supersedeHardCorrection(queued);
        }));
        return data;
    }

    public void applyCheckConfig() {
        if(commandRuntime==null)return;
        var config=commandRuntime.config();smoothSetback=config.smoothSetback();
        player.setMaxBalanceAdvantageMs(config.maxBalanceAdvantage());player.setDisabledChecks(config.disabledChecks());
        if(authInputPackets!=null) {
            var context=authInputPackets.context();context.maxOffset=config.acceptanceThreshold();
            context.alertThreshold=config.alertThreshold();context.disabledChecks=config.disabledChecks();
        }
    }

    public ac.navro.proxy.ack.types.MovementCorrectionAck onProxyPredictionCorrection(CorrectPlayerMovePredictionPacket packet) {
        teleports.syncBlocks(world, player.position(), player.tick(), this::restoreCorrectBlock);
        serverRewindPackets.syncCorrection(player, packet.getTick(), clientStateCorrection);
        var acknowledgment = teleports.addPendingCorrection(packet.getTick());
        player.queueAcknowledgment(packet, () -> {
            if (!teleports.removePendingCorrection(acknowledgment)) return;
            var diagnostics = player.worldDiagnostics();
            if (diagnostics != null) diagnostics.event("proxy_prediction_correction_acknowledged",
                    ac.navro.proxy.diagnostics.WorldCollisionDiagnostics.fields(
                            "sourceTick", acknowledgment.tick(), "ackId", player.getLatencyUtil().currentAcknowledgmentId(),
                            "backendType", backendType.name()));
        });
        recordEvent(WireEvent.Direction.PROXY, packet);
        packetCounts.merge("proxy:CorrectPlayerMovePredictionPacket", 1, Integer::sum);
        return acknowledgment;
    }

    private final java.util.NavigableMap<Long,ac.navro.proxy.teleport.data.RewindHistory> predictionHistory=new java.util.TreeMap<>();
    private final java.util.IdentityHashMap<MovePlayerPacket,ac.navro.proxy.teleport.data.CorrectionResetData> predictionResetPackets=new java.util.IdentityHashMap<>();
    private java.util.function.Function<org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.SetEntityMotionPacket,Boolean> predictionMotionTransport=packet->false;
    public void setPredictionMotionTransport(java.util.function.Function<org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.SetEntityMotionPacket,Boolean> transport){predictionMotionTransport=java.util.Objects.requireNonNull(transport);}
    public void cachePredictionFrame(ac.navro.proxy.prediction.live.PredictionContext context){
        var frame=ac.navro.proxy.teleport.data.RewindHistory.capture(context,context.tick,playerYOffset());
        predictionHistory.put(frame.tick(),frame);
        while(predictionHistory.size()>rewindHistorySize())predictionHistory.pollFirstEntry();
        teleports.setLastKnowValid(frame.position());
    }
    public void cacheRewindBaseline(long tick, float yOffset) {
        cacheRewindBaseline(tick,yOffset,player.simulationFrame());
    }
    public void cacheRewindBaseline(long tick,float yOffset,long simulationFrame) {
        var frame = new ac.navro.proxy.teleport.data.RewindHistory(tick, player.position().up(yOffset),
                new ac.navro.proxy.data.input.PredictionData(Vec3.ZERO.clone(), Vec3.ZERO.clone(), player.velocity().clone()),
                player.snapshotAabb(), yOffset, player.onGround(),simulationFrame);
        predictionHistory.put(tick, frame);
        teleports.setLastKnowValid(frame.position());
    }
    public void correctRejectedTimerInput() {
        if (player.disconnectRequested() || !spawned || awaitingBackendSpawnPosition || player.awaitingRespawnHealth()
                || teleports.isTeleporting() || teleports.hasPendingCorrection()
                || player.isMovementExempted() || predictionHistory.isEmpty()) return;
        var source = predictionHistory.lastEntry();
        rewindPrediction(source.getKey());
        if (player.worldDiagnostics() != null && (teleports.isTeleporting() || teleports.hasPendingCorrection()))
            player.worldDiagnostics().event("timer_movement_correction",
                    ac.navro.proxy.diagnostics.WorldCollisionDiagnostics.fields(
                            "sourceTick", source.getKey(), "clientFrame", player.simulationFrame(),
                            "hard", teleports.isHardTeleporting(), "target", source.getValue().position().toVector3f()));
    }

    public void rewindPrediction(long tick){
        if(teleports.isTeleporting() || teleports.hasPendingCorrection() || player.isMovementExempted())return;
        var frame=predictionHistory.get(tick);
        if(frame==null)return;
        if(smoothSetback || player.vehicleData != null) {
            teleports.correct(frame, player.vehicleData != null && player.vehicleData.canWeControlThisVehicle, softCorrectionTransport);
            return;
        }
        var prediction=authInputPackets();
        var reset=new ac.navro.proxy.teleport.data.CorrectionResetData(frame,player.flying()?null:prediction.velocityPackets().setbackVelocity(frame));
        reset.bindExternalMotion(prediction.velocityPackets().externalMotionSequence(),prediction.context().certainVelocity);
        var packet=teleports.hardCorrectionPacket(reset);
        predictionResetPackets.put(packet,reset);
        boolean sent;
        try{sent=teleportTransport.apply(packet);}finally{predictionResetPackets.remove(packet);}
        if(sent && reset.setbackVelocity()!=null){
            var motion=new SetEntityMotionPacket();motion.setRuntimeEntityId(player.runtimeId());motion.setMotion(reset.setbackVelocity().toVector3f());motion.setTick(0);
            if(predictionMotionTransport.apply(motion)){prediction.velocityPackets().consumeSetbackExternalMotion(reset);reset.motionSent();}
        }
    }
```
