```java
    private void refreshExemptionPermission() {
        if (detectionEnabled && exemptionPermission != null) player.setExempted(exemptionPermission.getAsBoolean());
    }


    public boolean receiveClient(BedrockPacket packet, long maxBalanceAdvantageMs) {
        if(player.disconnectRequested())return false;
        if(ac.navro.proxy.backend.BackendStateSync.privatePacket(packet))return false;
        refreshExemptionPermission();
        applyCheckConfig();
        if(commandRuntime!=null)maxBalanceAdvantageMs=commandRuntime.config().maxBalanceAdvantage();
        ac.navro.proxy.packets.input.PacketEvent event=null;
        if(detectionEnabled&&!player.isExempted()&&!(packet instanceof PlayerAuthInputPacket)) {
            event=placementPipeline().begin(packet);
            if(event.isCancelled()) {
                observeRejectedClient(packet,"placementAwaitingData","Waiting for exact placement facts");
                return placementPipeline().finish(event,false);
            }
        }
        ac.navro.proxy.packets.other.VehiclePackets.onPacketReceive(player, packet);
        final boolean checked = detectionEnabled && !player.isExempted();
        if (detectionEnabled && !ac.navro.proxy.listener.PacketListener.onPacketReceived(
                this, packet, maxBalanceAdvantageMs)) {
            if (packet instanceof PlayerAuthInputPacket input) {
                if (teleportHandler.processRejectedInput(input)) player.finishInput();
                else ac.navro.proxy.packets.input.PostAuthInputPackets.onPacket(this, input, true);
            }
            return event==null?false:placementPipeline().finish(event,false);
        }
        if(player.disconnectRequested())return false;
        if(event==null&&detectionEnabled&&!player.isExempted()) {
            event=placementPipeline().begin(packet);
            if(event.isCancelled()){observeRejectedClient(packet,"placementAwaitingData","Waiting for exact placement facts");return placementPipeline().finish(event,false);}
        }
        if (event != null && packet instanceof PlayerAuthInputPacket input
                && input.getItemUseTransaction() != null
                && input.getInputData().contains(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData.PERFORM_ITEM_INTERACTION)) {




            var embedded = placementPipeline().embeddedTransaction(input);
            boolean accepted = embedded != null && placementPipeline().handleTransaction(embedded);
            if (embedded != null && player.worldDiagnostics() != null) {
                authInputPackets().itemUse().traceTransaction(embedded, "auth_input", accepted ? "ACCEPTED" : "REJECTED");
            }
            if (!accepted) {
                observeRejectedClient(packet, "inventoryPredictionRejected", "Embedded item-use transaction rejected");
                event.setCancelled(true);
                return placementPipeline().finish(event, false);
            }
        }
        boolean accepted=observeClient(packet,checked);
        return event==null?accepted:placementPipeline().finish(event,accepted);
    }

    public void observeClient(BedrockPacket packet) {
        refreshExemptionPermission();
        ac.navro.proxy.packets.other.VehiclePackets.onPacketReceive(player, packet);
        observeClient(packet, false);
    }

    public void observePredictionSync(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.MovementPredictionSyncPacket packet) {
        boolean accepted = player.predictionSync().receive(packet, player.uniqueId(), player.tick());
        var log = player.worldDiagnostics();
        if (log != null) log.predictionSyncReceived(packet, accepted);
    }

    private void resolveStartGamePosition(PlayerAuthInputPacket input) {
        if (!spawned || pendingStartGamePosition == null || !finite(input.getPosition())) return;
        Vec3 start = pendingStartGamePosition;
        pendingStartGamePosition = null;
        if (awaitingBackendSpawnPosition || teleports.isTeleporting() || player.vehicleData != null) return;


        float inputFeetY = input.getPosition().getY() - playerYOffset();
        float zeroDistance = Math.abs(inputFeetY - start.y);
        float eyeDistance = Math.abs(inputFeetY - (start.y - 1.62001F));
        float offset = eyeDistance < zeroDistance ? 1.62001F : 0;
        if (offset != 0) {
            player.acceptPosition(start.down(offset));
            resetMovementHistory();
            teleports.setLastKnowValid(player.position().up(playerYOffset()));
        }
        if (player.worldDiagnostics() != null) player.worldDiagnostics().event("spawn_position_selected",
                ac.navro.proxy.diagnostics.WorldCollisionDiagnostics.fields(
                        "offset", offset, "zeroDistance", zeroDistance, "eyeDistance", eyeDistance,
                        "feet", player.position().toVector3f().toString()));
    }

    private boolean observeClient(BedrockPacket packet, boolean checked) {
        applyCheckConfig();
        if (!(packet instanceof PlayerAuthInputPacket) && !inventoryInteractions.onPacketReceive(packet, checked)) {
            rejectInventoryInteraction(packet);
            observeRejectedClient(packet, "MultiActions", "Rejected inventory interaction");
            return false;
        }
        boolean forward = true;
        if (detectionEnabled && !checked && !player.isExempted()
                && packet instanceof org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.MovementPredictionSyncPacket sync) {
            observePredictionSync(sync);
        }
        if(player.worldDiagnostics()!=null)player.worldDiagnostics().client(packet);
        if (packet instanceof org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.ItemStackRequestPacket request) {
            transactionValidator.handle(request);
            if(detectionEnabled)inventoryResponseSync.receive(request);
        }
        PlayerInventoryPackets.onPacketReceive(player, inventory, packet, item -> {
            if (detectionEnabled) authInputPackets().itemUse().onHeldItemChanged(item);
        });
        packetsFromClient++;
        packetCounts.merge("client:" + packet.getClass().getSimpleName(), 1, Integer::sum);
        long sequence = recordEvent(WireEvent.Direction.CLIENT, packet);
        if (packet instanceof PlayerAuthInputPacket input) {
            clientInputPackets++;
            clientPosition = input.getPosition();
            if (detectionEnabled && player.isExempted()) return true;
            if (detectionEnabled && !awaitingBackendSpawnPosition) authInputPackets().beforeInput(input);
            if (input.getTick() < 0) {
                recordAnomaly(WireEvent.Direction.CLIENT, sequence, "negativeInputTick", Long.toString(input.getTick()));
                return false;
            }
            lastInputTick = input.getTick();
            boolean movementCoordinates = ac.navro.proxy.packets.input.legacy.InputPositionDecoder
                    .usesMovementCoordinates(spawned, input.getInputData().contains(
                            org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData.HANDLE_TELEPORT));
            resolveStartGamePosition(input);
            if(detectionEnabled)authInputPackets();


            player.apply(input, world, detectionEnabled ? null : fluidState, movementCoordinates ? playerYOffset() : 0);
            if (!inventoryInteractions.onPacketReceive(input, checked)) {
                rejectInventoryInteraction(input);
                input.setItemStackRequest(null);
                input.getInputData().remove(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData.PERFORM_ITEM_STACK_REQUEST);
                recordAnomaly(WireEvent.Direction.CLIENT, sequence, "MultiActions", "Rejected embedded inventory interaction");
            }
            if(detectionEnabled)inventoryResponseSync.receive(input);
            if (spawned) {
                world.tickCollisionBlockActors();
                if(detectionEnabled)player.tickPredictionEffects();
                for (EntityCache entity : entities.values()) if (entity.getCurrent() != null) entity.getCurrent().tick();
            }
            boolean wasHardTeleporting=teleports.isHardTeleporting();
            boolean wasTeleporting=teleports.isTeleporting() && !teleports.hasPendingBackendRewind();
            boolean skipTravel=teleportHandler.processTeleport(input);
            if (spawned && !detectionEnabled) player.collisionPhysics.begin(world, entities, player.tick(), null);
            if(detectionEnabled && !teleports.isHardTeleporting()) {
                if(skipTravel || wasHardTeleporting || wasTeleporting) authInputPackets().finishTeleportConfirmation(input);
                else authInputPackets().run(input);
            }
            tickSnapshots.addLast(player.snapshot(fluidState));
            while (tickSnapshots.size() > (detectionEnabled ? 20 : 4096)) tickSnapshots.removeFirst();
            if(detectionEnabled && spawned && player.vehicleData==null && !player.predictionFlag(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.entity.EntityFlag.SLEEPING)){player.finishPredictionInput();authInputPackets().itemUse().finishInput();}
            if (detectionEnabled) forward = ac.navro.proxy.packets.input.PostAuthInputPackets.onPacket(this, input, false);
            else ac.navro.proxy.packets.input.PostAuthInputPackets.finishInput(player);
        }
        if(detectionEnabled && packet instanceof org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.InventoryTransactionPacket transaction) {
            var result=PlayerInventoryPackets.onTransactionReceive(this,transaction);
            if (player.worldDiagnostics() != null) {
                authInputPackets().itemUse().traceTransaction(transaction, "standalone", result.name());
            }
            if(result==PlayerInventoryPackets.TransactionResult.REJECTED) {
                forward=false;
                recordAnomaly(WireEvent.Direction.CLIENT,sequence,"inventoryPredictionRejected","Navro transaction validator rejected");
            }
        }
        if (packet instanceof NetworkStackLatencyPacket latency) {
            recordAcknowledgment(latency, WireEvent.Direction.CLIENT, sequence);
        }
        if (packet instanceof org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.SetLocalPlayerAsInitializedPacket) {
            spawned = true;
        }
        if (packet instanceof org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.InventoryTransactionPacket transaction
                && !detectionEnabled
                && transaction.getTransactionType() == org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.transaction.InventoryTransactionType.NORMAL) {
            boolean accepted = transactionValidator.handleNormal(transaction);
            if (!accepted) recordAnomaly(WireEvent.Direction.CLIENT, sequence, "inventoryPredictionRejected",
                    "Navro legacy drop prediction rejected; inspection forwarding unchanged");
        }
        return forward;
    }

    public void pollRewindHistory() {
        teleports.pollAuthInputHistory(rewindHistorySize());
        while (predictionHistory.size() > rewindHistorySize()) predictionHistory.pollFirstEntry();
        teleportMotionSeeds.removeIf(seed -> seed.inputTick() < player.tick() - rewindHistorySize());
    }

    public long observeRejectedClient(BedrockPacket packet, String check, String detail) {
        packetsFromClient++;
        packetCounts.merge("client:" + packet.getClass().getSimpleName(), 1, Integer::sum);
        long sequence = recordEvent(WireEvent.Direction.CLIENT, packet);
        if (packet instanceof PlayerAuthInputPacket input) {
            clientInputPackets++;
            var log=player.worldDiagnostics();
            if(log!=null)log.event("client_input_rejected",ac.navro.proxy.diagnostics.WorldCollisionDiagnostics.fields(
                    "inputTick",input.getTick(),"check",check,"detail",detail,
                    "handleTeleport",input.getInputData().contains(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData.HANDLE_TELEPORT),
                    "wirePosition",String.valueOf(input.getPosition()),"pendingTeleports",teleports.getQueuedTeleports().size()));
        }
        recordAnomaly(WireEvent.Direction.CLIENT, sequence, check, detail);
        return sequence;
    }


    public String validateClient(BedrockPacket packet) {
        if (!(packet instanceof PlayerAuthInputPacket input)) {
            return null;
        }
        if (input.getTick() < 0) {
            return "negative client tick";
        }
        if (!finite(input.getPosition()) || !finite(input.getRotation())) {
            return "non-finite client input vector";
        }
        return null;
    }

    public String validateBackend(BedrockPacket packet) {
        if (packet instanceof MovePlayerPacket move && !finite(move.getPosition())) {
            return "non-finite backend player position";
        }
        if (packet instanceof CorrectPlayerMovePredictionPacket correction && !finite(correction.getPosition())) {
            return "non-finite backend correction position";
        }
        if (packet instanceof CorrectPlayerMovePredictionPacket correction
                && (!finite(correction.getDelta()) || correction.getTick() < 0)) {
            return "invalid backend correction motion or tick";
        }
        return null;
    }


    public void onProxyBlockCorrection(UpdateBlockPacket packet) {
        serverChunkPackets.onPacket(packet);
        packetCounts.merge("proxy:" + packet.getClass().getSimpleName(), 1, Integer::sum);
        recordEvent(WireEvent.Direction.PROXY, packet);
    }

    public void observeBackend(BedrockPacket packet) {
        if(consumeBackendSync(packet))return;
        if (packet instanceof StartGamePacket) {
            var supplied = backendSync.takeRuntimePalette();
            var palette = supplied != null ? supplied : configuredRuntimePalette;
            world.setRuntimeBlockPalette(palette);
            backendBlocks.setRuntimeBlockPalette(palette);
            serverChunkPackets.resetPalette();
        }
        serverRewindPackets.capture(player, packet);
        backendBlocks.observe(packet);
        backendInventories.observe(packet);
        inventoryResponseSync.backend(packet);
        if(placementPipeline!=null)placementPipeline.observeBackend(packet);
        if(detectionEnabled){authInputPackets().itemUse().observeInventory(packet);if(packet instanceof SetEntityDataPacket data)authInputPackets().itemUse().observeMetadata(data);}
        ac.navro.proxy.packets.server.ServerDataPackets.onPacket(player, packet,
                backendType == ac.navro.proxy.protocol.BackendType.BDS);
        serverChunkPackets.onPacket(packet);
        serverEntityPackets.onPacket(packet);
        ac.navro.proxy.packets.other.VehiclePackets.onPacketSend(this, packet);
        PlayerInventoryPackets.onPacketSend(player, inventory, packet);
        inventoryInteractions.onPacketSend(packet);
        packetsFromBackend++;
        packetCounts.merge("backend:" + packet.getClass().getSimpleName(), 1, Integer::sum);
        long sequence = recordEvent(WireEvent.Direction.BACKEND, packet);
        if (packet instanceof StartGamePacket start) {
            if (backendType == ac.navro.proxy.protocol.BackendType.BDS) { awaitingBackendSpawnPosition = true; backendSpawnRevision++; }
            world.apply(start);
            acknowledgedTerrainGeneration = backendBlocks.generation();
            player.apply(start);
            pendingStartGamePosition = finite(start.getPlayerPosition()) ? player.position().clone() : null;
            teleports.setLastKnowValid(player.position().up(playerYOffset()));
            backendProfile = BackendProtocolProfile.from(start);
            backendSyncTransport.accept(backendSync.begin());
        } else if (backendType == ac.navro.proxy.protocol.BackendType.BDS && packet instanceof org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.RespawnPacket respawn
                && (respawn.getRuntimeEntityId() == 0 || respawn.getRuntimeEntityId() == player.runtimeId())) {
            pendingStartGamePosition = null;
            if (respawn.getState() == org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.RespawnPacket.State.SERVER_SEARCHING) {
                awaitingBackendSpawnPosition = true;
                backendSpawnRevision++;
            } else if (respawn.getState() == org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.RespawnPacket.State.SERVER_READY
                    && finite(respawn.getPosition())) {
                awaitingBackendSpawnPosition = true;
                final long revision = ++backendSpawnRevision;
                final Vec3 foot = new Vec3(respawn.getPosition()).down(playerYOffset());
                final var supersededTeleports = List.copyOf(teleports.getQueuedTeleports());


                if (authInputPackets != null) authInputPackets.velocityPackets().clearExternalMotion();
                player.queueAcknowledgment(packet, () -> {
                    if (revision != backendSpawnRevision) return;
                    player.acceptTeleport(foot, false);
                    if (authInputPackets != null) authInputPackets.reset();
                    fluidState.resetMovement();


                    teleports.getQueuedTeleports().removeAll(supersededTeleports);
                    teleports.clearInterpolation();
                    teleports.resetCorrection();
                    teleports.getAuthInputHistory().clear();
                    predictionHistory.clear();tickSnapshots.clear();motionSeeds.clear();teleportMotionSeeds.clear();
                    teleports.setLastKnowValid(foot.up(playerYOffset()));
                    awaitingBackendSpawnPosition = false;
                    var trace = player.worldDiagnostics();
                    if (trace != null) trace.event("backend_spawn_position_acknowledged",
                            ac.navro.proxy.diagnostics.WorldCollisionDiagnostics.fields("feet",foot.toVector3f().toString()));
                });
            }
        } else if (packet instanceof ChangeDimensionPacket change) {
            pendingStartGamePosition = null;
            if(authInputPackets!=null)authInputPackets.velocityPackets().clearExternalMotion();

            final ChangeDimensionPacket snapshot = change.clone();
            final long terrainGeneration = backendBlocks.generation();
            ac.navro.proxy.packets.input.AuthInputPackets.onPacketSend(player, world, change, () -> {
                world.changeDimension(snapshot.getDimension());
                acknowledgedTerrainGeneration = terrainGeneration;
                player.collisionPhysics.reset();
                player.apply(snapshot);
                teleports.setLastKnowValid(player.position().up(playerYOffset()));
                player.resetFlying();
                fluidState.reset();
                teleports.getQueuedTeleports().clear();
                teleports.clearInterpolation();
                teleports.resetCorrection();
                teleportMotionSeeds.clear();
                tickSnapshots.clear();
                motionSeeds.clear();
                predictionHistory.clear();
                teleports.getAuthInputHistory().clear();
                if(authInputPackets!=null)authInputPackets.reset();
            });
        } else if (packet instanceof LevelChunkPacket || packet instanceof SubChunkPacket) {
            backendChunkPackets++;
        } else if (packet instanceof UpdateBlockPacket || packet instanceof UpdateSubChunkBlocksPacket) {
            backendBlockUpdatePackets++;
        } else if (packet instanceof InventoryContentPacket || packet instanceof InventorySlotPacket) {
            backendInventoryPackets++;
        } else if (packet instanceof NetworkStackLatencyPacket) {
            backendAckPackets++;
            recordAcknowledgment((NetworkStackLatencyPacket) packet, WireEvent.Direction.BACKEND, sequence);
        } else if (packet instanceof SetEntityDataPacket data) {
            EntityCache cached = entities.get(data.getRuntimeEntityId());
            if (cached != null) {
                var snapshot = ac.navro.proxy.util.EntityMetadataUtil.copy(data.getMetadata());
                var properties = EntityCache.copyProperties(data.getProperties());
                player.queueAcknowledgment(data, () -> {
                    if (entities.get(cached.runtimeId()) != cached) return;
                    cached.metadata(snapshot);
                    cached.properties(properties);
                });
                cached.lastWireTick(data.getTick());
            }
        } else if (packet instanceof UpdateAttributesPacket attributes) {
            EntityCache cached = entities.get(attributes.getRuntimeEntityId());
            if (cached != null) {
                var snapshot = EntityCache.copyAttributes(attributes.getAttributes());
                player.queueAcknowledgment(attributes, () -> {
                    if (entities.get(cached.runtimeId()) == cached) cached.attributes(snapshot);
                });
                cached.lastWireTick(attributes.getTick());
            }
        } else if (packet instanceof MobEffectPacket effect) {
            EntityCache cached = entities.get(effect.getRuntimeEntityId());
            if (cached != null) cached.lastWireTick(effect.getTick());
        }


        if (packet instanceof MovePlayerPacket move
                && move.getRuntimeEntityId() == player.runtimeId()
                && move.getMode() != MovePlayerPacket.Mode.HEAD_ROTATION) {
            pendingStartGamePosition = null;
            serverPosition = move.getPosition();
            player.apply(move);
            queueMovementTeleport(move, true);
        } else if (packet instanceof CorrectPlayerMovePredictionPacket correction) {
            pendingStartGamePosition = null;
            backendCorrectionPackets++;
            lastCorrectionTick = correction.getTick();
            serverPosition = correction.getPosition();
            queueBackendPredictionCorrection(correction);
            var trace=player.worldDiagnostics();
            if(trace!=null){trace.beginMotionTrace();trace.event("backend_prediction_correction",ac.navro.proxy.diagnostics.WorldCollisionDiagnostics.fields(
                    "sourceTick",correction.getTick(),"position",String.valueOf(correction.getPosition()),
                    "delta",String.valueOf(correction.getDelta()),"onGround",correction.isOnGround(),
                    "predictionType",String.valueOf(correction.getPredictionType())));}
        } else if (packet instanceof SetEntityMotionPacket motion) {
            lastVelocityEntityId = motion.getRuntimeEntityId();
            serverVelocity = motion.getMotion();
            entityMotions.put(motion.getRuntimeEntityId(), motion.getMotion());
            EntityCache cached = entities.get(motion.getRuntimeEntityId());
            if (cached != null) {
                var snapshot = WireVec3.of(motion.getMotion());
                player.queueAcknowledgment(motion, () -> {
                    if (entities.get(cached.runtimeId()) == cached) cached.motion(snapshot);
                });
                cached.lastWireTick(motion.getTick());
            }
            if(detectionEnabled && motion.getRuntimeEntityId()==player.runtimeId())authInputPackets().velocityPackets().onPacketSend(motion);
            else player.apply(motion);
            if (motion.getRuntimeEntityId() == player.runtimeId() && motion.getMotion() != null) {
                motionSeeds.addLast(new WireMotionSeed("SetEntityMotionPacket", motion.getTick(),
                        new ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3(motion.getMotion()), true));
                while (motionSeeds.size() > 4096) motionSeeds.removeFirst();
            }
        }
        if (packet instanceof AddEntityPacket add) player.apply(add);
        if (packet instanceof SetEntityDataPacket data && player.vehicleData == null) {
            player.apply(data);
            if (data.getRuntimeEntityId() == player.runtimeId()) {
                long revision = player.latestPoseMetadataRevision();
                if (revision > player.acknowledgedPoseMetadataRevision()) {
                    player.queueAcknowledgment(data, () -> player.acknowledgePoseMetadata(revision));
                }
            }
        }
        if (packet instanceof UpdateAttributesPacket attributes) {
            if(detectionEnabled){


                var snapshot=new UpdateAttributesPacket();
                snapshot.setRuntimeEntityId(attributes.getRuntimeEntityId());snapshot.setTick(attributes.getTick());
                snapshot.getAttributes().addAll(attributes.getAttributes());
                var trace=player.worldDiagnostics();if(trace!=null)trace.movementAttributes("movement_attributes_queued",snapshot);
                player.queueAcknowledgment(packet,()->{
                    player.apply(snapshot);
                    if(trace!=null)trace.movementAttributes("movement_attributes_applied",snapshot);
                });
            }
            else player.apply(attributes);
        }
        if (packet instanceof MobEffectPacket effect) {
            if(detectionEnabled)ac.navro.proxy.packets.player.PlayerEffectPackets.onPacket(player, effect);
            else player.apply(effect);
        }
        if (packet instanceof MovementEffectPacket effect) {
            if(detectionEnabled && effect.getEntityRuntimeId()==player.runtimeId()
                    && effect.getEffectType()==org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.MovementEffectType.GLIDE_BOOST){
                effect.setTick(Integer.MIN_VALUE);var snapshot=effect.clone();player.queueAcknowledgment(packet,()->player.apply(snapshot));
            }else player.apply(effect);
        }
        if (detectionEnabled && smoothSetback) serverRewindPackets.onPacketSend(packet);
    }

    private ac.navro.proxy.teleport.data.RewindData queueBackendPredictionCorrection(
            CorrectPlayerMovePredictionPacket packet) {
        if (!detectionEnabled || packet.getPredictionType() == org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PredictionType.VEHICLE)
            return null;
        long includedMotion = backendType == ac.navro.proxy.protocol.BackendType.BDS
                ? authInputPackets().velocityPackets().externalMotionSequence() : -1;
        Long sourceTick=inputTickForSimulationFrame(packet.getTick());
        var rewind = new ac.navro.proxy.teleport.data.RewindData(packet.getTick(),
                new Vec3(packet.getPosition()), new Vec3(packet.getDelta()), packet.isOnGround(),
                sourceTick==null?null:predictionHistory.get(sourceTick), playerYOffset(), includedMotion,
                sourceTick==null?-1:sourceTick);
        teleports.queue(rewind, accept -> player.queueAcknowledgment(packet, () -> {
            Long ackId = player.getLatencyUtil().currentAcknowledgmentId();
            Runnable complete = () -> {
                accept.run();
                if (backendType == ac.navro.proxy.protocol.BackendType.BDS) teleports.supersedeHardCorrection(rewind);
                var diagnostics = player.worldDiagnostics();
                if (diagnostics != null) diagnostics.event(
                        "backend_prediction_correction_acknowledged",
                        ac.navro.proxy.diagnostics.WorldCollisionDiagnostics.fields(
                                "sourceTick", rewind.tick(), "ackId", ackId, "backendType", backendType.name()));
            };
            if (backendType == ac.navro.proxy.protocol.BackendType.BDS)
                bdsCorrectionAcknowledgmentDispatcher.accept(complete);
            else complete.run();
        }));
        return rewind;
    }
    public Long inputTickForSimulationFrame(long frame) {
        for(var entry:teleports.getAuthInputHistory().descendingMap().entrySet())
            if(entry.getValue().state().simulationFrame()==frame)return entry.getKey();
        return null;
    }

    public ProtocolEntityTolerance.Sample sampleEntityTolerance() {
        var state = player.collisionPhysics;
        if (state.active() && state.tolerance() != null) {
            var t = state.tolerance();
            return new ProtocolEntityTolerance.Sample(new ProtocolEntityTolerance.Tolerance(
                    t.boat(), t.happyGhast(), t.x(), t.y(), t.z()), state.enforceBoatStep());
        }
        ProtocolEntityTolerance.Sample sample = ProtocolEntityTolerance.sample(player.collisionPhysics.active()
                        ? player.collisionPhysics.actors() : ac.navro.proxy.collision.EntityCollisionPhysics.snapshotActors(entities),
                player.previousPosition(), player.boundingBox(),
                player.vehicleData==null?Long.MIN_VALUE:player.vehicleData.vehicleRuntimeId,
                player.vehicleData!=null, state.active() ? state.enforceBoatStep() : enforceBoatStep,
                player.unvalidatedTickEnd().y, state.active() ? state.selectedStartY() : player.velocity().y);
        enforceBoatStep = sample.enforceBoatStep();
        entityTolerance = sample.tolerance();
        player.setEntityTolerance(sample);
        var tolerance = sample.tolerance();
        player.collisionPhysics.setTolerance(new ac.navro.proxy.collision.EntityCollisionPhysics.ToleranceSample(
                new ac.navro.proxy.collision.EntityCollisionPhysics.Tolerance(tolerance.boat(), tolerance.happyGhast(),
                        tolerance.x(), tolerance.y(), tolerance.z()), sample.enforceBoatStep()));
        return sample;
    }

    public WireTickSnapshot snapshotAt(long tick) {
        for (WireTickSnapshot snapshot : tickSnapshots) {
            if (snapshot.tick() == tick) return snapshot;
        }
        return null;
    }

    public boolean restoreTick(long tick) {
        WireTickSnapshot snapshot = snapshotAt(tick);
        if (snapshot == null) return false;
        player.restore(snapshot, fluidState);
        entityTolerance = player.entityTolerance();
        enforceBoatStep = player.enforceBoatStep();
        return true;
    }

    public List<ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3> teleportStartVelocities(long tick) {
        List<ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3> result = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        for (ProtocolTeleportMotion seed : teleportMotionSeeds) result.addAll(seed.velocitiesForTick(tick));
        return List.copyOf(result);
    }

    public void resetMovementHistory() {
        predictionHistory.clear();
        teleports.getAuthInputHistory().clear();
        fluidState.resetMovement();
        tickSnapshots.clear();
        motionSeeds.clear();
        teleportMotionSeeds.clear();
    }

    public void rememberTeleportMotion(ProtocolTeleportMotion seed) {
        teleportMotionSeeds.addLast(seed);
    }


    public void acceptValidatedMovementBaseline(ac.navro.anticheat.data.MovementAabbSnapshot physical,float yOffset){
        teleports.setLastKnowValid(physical.box().feetCenter().up(yOffset));
    }

    private float playerYOffsetInternal() {
        if (player.vehicleData == null) return 1.62001F;
        EntityCache vehicle = entities.get(player.vehicleData.vehicleRuntimeId);
        if (vehicle != null && vehicle.boat()) return 0.375F;
        return 0.0F;
    }

    private long recordEvent(WireEvent.Direction direction, BedrockPacket packet) {
        long tick = -1;
        if (packet instanceof PlayerAuthInputPacket value) tick = value.getTick();
        else if (packet instanceof MovePlayerPacket value) tick = value.getTick();
        else if (packet instanceof CorrectPlayerMovePredictionPacket value) tick = value.getTick();
        else if (packet instanceof NetworkStackLatencyPacket value) tick = value.getTimestamp();
        WireEvent event = new WireEvent(++eventSequence, direction,
                packet.getClass().getSimpleName(), tick, System.nanoTime());
        eventJournal.addLast(event);
        while (eventJournal.size() > 16384) eventJournal.removeFirst();
        return event.sequence();
    }

    private void recordAcknowledgment(NetworkStackLatencyPacket packet,
                                      WireEvent.Direction direction, long sequence) {
        acknowledgments.addLast(new WireAcknowledgment(packet.getTimestamp(), packet.isFromServer(), direction, sequence));
        while (acknowledgments.size() > 4096) acknowledgments.removeFirst();
    }

    private void recordAnomaly(WireEvent.Direction direction, long sequence,
                               String kind, String detail) {
        anomalies.addLast(new WireAnomaly(sequence, direction, kind, detail));
        while (anomalies.size() > 4096) anomalies.removeFirst();
    }

    public int packetCount(String direction, String packetSimpleName) {
        return packetCounts.getOrDefault(direction + ":" + packetSimpleName, 0);
    }

    private static boolean finite(Vector3f value) {
        return value != null && Float.isFinite(value.getX())
                && Float.isFinite(value.getY()) && Float.isFinite(value.getZ());
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/SupportedCodecs.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy;

import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.codec.BedrockCodec;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.codec.v729.Bedrock_v729;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.codec.v776.Bedrock_v776;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.codec.v786.Bedrock_v786;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.codec.v800.Bedrock_v800;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.codec.v819.Bedrock_v819;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.codec.v860.Bedrock_v860;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.codec.v898.Bedrock_v898;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.codec.v924.Bedrock_v924;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.codec.v944.Bedrock_v944;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.codec.v975.Bedrock_v975;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.codec.v1001.Bedrock_v1001;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.codec.v2168.Bedrock_v2168;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.codec.v2169.Bedrock_v2169;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.codec.v2193.Bedrock_v2193;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.codec.v2225.Bedrock_v2225;

import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;


public final class SupportedCodecs {
    private static final List<BedrockCodec> CODECS = List.of(
            Bedrock_v729.CODEC,
            Bedrock_v776.CODEC,
            Bedrock_v786.CODEC,
            Bedrock_v800.CODEC,
            Bedrock_v819.CODEC,
            Bedrock_v860.CODEC,
            Bedrock_v898.CODEC,
            Bedrock_v924.CODEC,
            Bedrock_v944.CODEC,
            Bedrock_v975.CODEC,
            Bedrock_v1001.CODEC,
            Bedrock_v2168.CODEC,
            Bedrock_v2169.CODEC,
            Bedrock_v2193.CODEC,
            Bedrock_v2225.CODEC
    ).stream().map(SupportedCodecs::adapt)
            .sorted(Comparator.comparingInt(BedrockCodec::getProtocolVersion)).toList();

    private static BedrockCodec adapt(BedrockCodec codec) {
        var builder = codec.toBuilder();
        if (codec.getProtocolVersion() >= 776) {
            builder.updateSerializer(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.MovementPredictionSyncPacket.class,
                            new ac.navro.proxy.protocol.MovementPredictionSyncSerializer(codec.getProtocolVersion()))
                    .updateFactory(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.MovementPredictionSyncPacket.class,
                            ac.navro.proxy.packets.input.ClientMovementPredictionSyncPacket::new)
                    .aliasPacket(ac.navro.proxy.packets.input.ClientMovementPredictionSyncPacket.class,
                            org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.MovementPredictionSyncPacket.class);
        }
        if (codec.getProtocolVersion() >= 898) {
            builder.updateSerializer(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.AvailableCommandsPacket.class,
                    new ac.navro.proxy.protocol.LosslessAvailableCommandsSerializer(codec.getProtocolVersion()));
        }
        return builder.build();
    }

    private SupportedCodecs() {
    }

    public static BedrockCodec forProtocol(int protocolVersion) {


        if (protocolVersion == 2192) {
            return forProtocol(2193);
        }
        return CODECS.stream()
                .filter(codec -> codec.getProtocolVersion() == protocolVersion)
                .findFirst()
                .orElse(null);
    }

    public static BedrockCodec fallback(int protocolVersion) {
        BedrockCodec configured = forProtocol(protocolVersion);
        return configured != null ? configured : CODECS.get(CODECS.size() - 1);
    }

    public static int defaultRaknetProtocol() {
        return Bedrock_v898.CODEC.getRaknetProtocolVersion();
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/alert/AlertManager.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.alert;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.function.Consumer;
import java.util.function.Supplier;


public final class AlertManager {
    public static final UUID CONSOLE_UUID = new UUID(0, 0);
    private final AlertSubscriptions subscriptions;
    private final Consumer<String> console;
    private final Supplier<Map<UUID, Consumer<String>>> online;
    private final Supplier<String> prefix;

    public AlertManager(Path file, String prefix, Consumer<String> console,
                         Supplier<Map<UUID, Consumer<String>>> online) {
        this(file, () -> prefix, console, online);
    }

    public AlertManager(Path file, Supplier<String> prefix, Consumer<String> console,
                         Supplier<Map<UUID, Consumer<String>>> online) {
        this.console = console;
        this.online = online;
        this.prefix = prefix;
        AlertSubscriptions loaded;
        try { loaded = new AlertSubscriptions(file); }
        catch (IOException error) {
            console.accept("Could not load alert subscriptions: " + error.getMessage());
            loaded = AlertSubscriptions.empty(file);
        }
        subscriptions = loaded;
    }

    public void alert(String verbose) {
        String message = getPrefix() + "§3" + verbose;
        formattedAlert(message);
    }

    public void formattedAlert(String message) {
        subscriptions.forEachOnline(online.get(), recipient -> recipient.accept(message));
        if (subscriptions.has(CONSOLE_UUID)) console.accept(message);
    }

    public void alertToPlayers(List<Consumer<String>> sources, String verbose) {
        sources.forEach(source -> source.accept(getPrefix() + "§3" + verbose));
    }

    public String getPrefix() { return prefix.get().replace('&', '§'); }
    public boolean hasAlert(UUID id) { return subscriptions.has(id); }

    public boolean setAlert(UUID id, boolean enabled) {
        try { subscriptions.set(id, enabled); return true; }
        catch (IOException error) {
            console.accept("Could not save alert subscriptions: " + error.getMessage());
            return false;
        }
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/alert/AlertSubscriptions.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.alert;

import com.google.gson.Gson;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.AtomicMoveNotSupportedException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.function.Consumer;


final class AlertSubscriptions {
    private static final Gson JSON = new Gson();
    private final Path file;
    private final Set<UUID> enabled = ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet();

    AlertSubscriptions(Path file) throws IOException {
        this(file, Set.of());
        if (!Files.exists(this.file)) return;
        try {
            UUID[] ids = JSON.fromJson(Files.readString(this.file, StandardCharsets.UTF_8), UUID[].class);
            if (ids == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Expected a UUID array");
            for (UUID id : ids) {
                if (id == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Null subscriber UUID");
                enabled.add(id);
            }
        } catch (RuntimeException e) {
            throw new IOException("Invalid alert subscription file", e);
        }
    }

    private AlertSubscriptions(Path file, Set<UUID> initial) {
        this.file = file.toAbsolutePath();
        enabled.addAll(initial);
    }

    static AlertSubscriptions empty(Path file) {
        return new AlertSubscriptions(file, Set.of());
    }

    boolean has(UUID id) { return enabled.contains(id); }

    synchronized void set(UUID id, boolean subscribe) throws IOException {
        Set<UUID> next = new HashSet<>(enabled);
        if (!(subscribe ? next.add(id) : next.remove(id))) return;
        Files.createDirectories(file.getParent());
        Path temporary = Files.createTempFile(file.getParent(), "alert-subscriptions-", ".tmp");
        try {
            Files.writeString(temporary, JSON.toJson(next.stream().map(UUID::toString).sorted().toList()) + "\n",
                    StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            try {
                Files.move(temporary, file, StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
            } catch (AtomicMoveNotSupportedException e) {
                Files.move(temporary, file, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
            }
        } finally {
            Files.deleteIfExists(temporary);
        }

        if (subscribe) enabled.add(id); else enabled.remove(id);
    }

    <T> void forEachOnline(Map<UUID, T> online, Consumer<T> action) {
        for (UUID id : enabled) {
            T currentSession = online.get(id);
            if (currentSession != null) action.accept(currentSession);
        }
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/backend/BackendStateSync.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.backend;

import ac.navro.proxy.SessionState;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.*;
import ac.navro.proxy.data.block.NetworkBlockStateRegistry;
import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.Base64;
import java.util.UUID;


public final class BackendStateSync {
    public static final String CHANNEL="navro:backend_sync_v1";
    private static final int MAX_PALETTE_MESSAGE = 512 * 1024;
    private static final int PALETTE_PART_BYTES = 30_000;
    private static final int MAX_PALETTE_PARTS = (MAX_PALETTE_MESSAGE + PALETTE_PART_BYTES - 1) / PALETTE_PART_BYTES;
    private static final int MAX_ALERT_BYTES = 4096;
    private final SessionState state;
    private final java.util.function.LongSupplier clock;
    private String nonce;
    private long sequence=-1, receivedAt;
    private int tick;
    private boolean active;
    private boolean pocketMineAlerts;
    private NetworkBlockStateRegistry.RuntimePalette pendingPalette;
    private StringBuilder paletteParts;
    private int expectedPart, palettePartCount;
    public BackendStateSync(SessionState state) { this(state,System::nanoTime); }
    BackendStateSync(SessionState state,java.util.function.LongSupplier clock) {
        this.state=state;this.clock=clock;
    }
    public void reset() {
        nonce=null;sequence=-1;tick=0;active=false;pocketMineAlerts=false;receivedAt=0;
        pendingPalette = null;
        paletteParts = null;
        expectedPart = palettePartCount = 0;
        state.world().clearNativeServerClock();
    }
    public ScriptMessagePacket begin() {
        reset();nonce=UUID.randomUUID().toString();
        var hello=new ScriptMessagePacket();hello.setChannel(CHANNEL);hello.setMessage("hello|"+nonce);
        return hello;
    }
    public static boolean privatePacket(BedrockPacket packet) {
        return packet instanceof ScriptMessagePacket message && CHANNEL.equals(message.getChannel());
    }

    public ScriptMessagePacket alert(String message) {
        if (!pocketMineAlerts || !available() || message.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8).length > MAX_ALERT_BYTES)
            return null;
        var packet = new ScriptMessagePacket();
        packet.setChannel(CHANNEL);
        packet.setMessage("alert|" + nonce + "|" + message);
        return packet;
    }

    private void receivePalette(String message) {
        if (pendingPalette != null || message.length() > MAX_PALETTE_MESSAGE) return;
        try {
            byte[] compressed = Base64.getDecoder().decode(message.substring("palette|".length()));
            var palette = NetworkBlockStateRegistry.readRuntimePalette(new ByteArrayInputStream(compressed));
            if (palette.protocol() == state.world().protocolVersion()) {
                pendingPalette = palette;
            }
        } catch (IOException | IllegalArgumentException error) {
            System.err.println("[NavroProxy] Invalid PM block palette: " + error.getMessage());
        }
    }

    private void receivePalettePart(String message) {
        if (pendingPalette != null || message.length() > PALETTE_PART_BYTES + 32) return;
        String[] fields = message.split("\\|", 4);
        if (fields.length != 4) return;
        try {
            int index = Integer.parseInt(fields[1]);
            int count = Integer.parseInt(fields[2]);
            String part = fields[3];
            if (count < 2 || count > MAX_PALETTE_PARTS || index < 0 || index >= count
                    || part.isEmpty() || part.length() > PALETTE_PART_BYTES
                    || index < count - 1 && part.length() != PALETTE_PART_BYTES) {
                paletteParts = null;
                return;
            }
            if (index == 0) {
                paletteParts = new StringBuilder();
                palettePartCount = count;
                expectedPart = 0;
            }
            if (paletteParts == null || index != expectedPart || count != palettePartCount
                    || (long) paletteParts.length() + part.length() > MAX_PALETTE_MESSAGE) {
                paletteParts = null;
                return;
            }
            paletteParts.append(part);
            if (++expectedPart == count) {
                String complete = paletteParts.toString();
                paletteParts = null;
                if (complete.startsWith("palette|")) receivePalette(complete);
            }
        } catch (NumberFormatException ignored) {
            paletteParts = null;
        }
    }

    public boolean receive(BedrockPacket packet) {
        if(!privatePacket(packet))return false;
        var message=((ScriptMessagePacket)packet).getMessage();
        if (message == null) return true;
        if (message.startsWith("palette_part|")) {
            receivePalettePart(message);
            return true;
        }
        if (message.startsWith("palette|")) {
            receivePalette(message);
            return true;
        }
        if (nonce == null || message.length() > 256) return true;
        if (message.equals("pm_ready|" + nonce)) {
            pocketMineAlerts = true;
            return true;
        }
        String[] fields=message.split("\\|",-1);
        if(fields.length!=4||!"tick".equals(fields[0])||!nonce.equals(fields[1]))return true;
        try {
            long next=Long.parseLong(fields[2]);int sample=Integer.parseInt(fields[3]);
            if(next<0||next<=sequence || active && sample-tick<0)return true;
            sequence=next;tick=sample;receivedAt=clock.getAsLong();active=true;
            state.world().setNativeServerClock(this::tick,this::available);
            var log=state.player().worldDiagnostics();
            if(log!=null)log.event("backend_native_tick",ac.navro.proxy.diagnostics.WorldCollisionDiagnostics.fields(
                    "sequence",sequence,"serverTick",tick));
        } catch(NumberFormatException ignored) { }
        return true;
    }
    public boolean available() { return active&&clock.getAsLong()-receivedAt<1_000_000_000L; }
    public boolean isPocketMine() { return pocketMineAlerts; }
    public boolean hasRuntimePalette() { return pendingPalette != null; }
    public NetworkBlockStateRegistry.RuntimePalette takeRuntimePalette() {
        var palette = pendingPalette;
        pendingPalette = null;
        return palette;
    }
    public int tick() { return tick; }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/bds/BdsCorrectionAcknowledgments.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.bds;

import io.netty.channel.ChannelInboundHandlerAdapter;
import io.netty.channel.ChannelHandlerContext;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.netty.BedrockBatchWrapper;
import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.Queue;




public final class BdsCorrectionAcknowledgments extends ChannelInboundHandlerAdapter {
    private final Queue<Runnable> pending = new ArrayDeque<>();
    public void defer(Runnable task) { pending.add(task); }
    public void commit() {
        for (Runnable task; (task = pending.poll()) != null;) task.run();
    }
    @Override public void channelRead(ChannelHandlerContext context, Object message) throws Exception {
        if (!(message instanceof BedrockBatchWrapper)) {
            context.fireChannelRead(message);
            return;
        }
        try { context.fireChannelRead(message); }
        finally { commit(); }
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/check/api/Check.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.check.api;

import ac.navro.proxy.check.api.annotations.CheckInfo;
import ac.navro.proxy.check.api.annotations.Experimental;
import ac.navro.proxy.state.WirePlayerState;


public class Check {
    protected final WirePlayerState player;
    private final String name, type;
    private final boolean experimental;
    private int vl;
    private final double setbackVl, decay;
    private double setbackViolations;

    public Check(WirePlayerState player) {
        this.player = player;
        CheckInfo info = getClass().getDeclaredAnnotation(CheckInfo.class);
        name = info != null ? info.name() : getClass().getSimpleName();
        type = info != null ? info.type() : "";
        experimental = getClass().getDeclaredAnnotation(Experimental.class) != null;
        setbackVl = info == null ? 25 : info.setback();
        decay = info == null ? 0.05 : info.decay();
    }

    public Check(WirePlayerState player, String name, String type, boolean experimental) {
        this.player = player;
        this.name = name;
        this.type = type;
        this.experimental = experimental;
        setbackVl = 25;
        decay = 0.05;
    }

    public void fail() { fail(""); }

    protected final boolean flagWithSetback() {
        if (player.isExempted()) return false;
        fail();
        setbackViolations++;
        setbackIfAboveSetbackVL();
        return true;
    }

    protected final boolean setbackIfAboveSetbackVL() {
        if (setbackViolations <= setbackVl) return false;
        player.requestRewind(player.tick());
        return true;
    }

    protected final void reward() {
        setbackViolations = Math.max(0, setbackViolations - decay);
    }

    public void fail(String verbose) {
        if (player.isExempted() || player.disconnectRequested() || !player.checkEnabled(getClass())) return;
        vl++;
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder("§f").append(player.getName()).append("§7 failed§f ");
        if ("Bad Packet".equals(name)) builder.append("BadPackets").append(type);
        else {
            builder.append(name);
            if (!type.isBlank()) builder.append(" (").append(type).append(")");
        }
        if (experimental) builder.append(" §7(Experimental)");
        appendViolationDetails(builder, vl, verbose == null ? "" : verbose);
        String display="Bad Packet".equals(name)?"BadPackets"+type:name+(type.isBlank()?"":" ("+type+")");
        player.violation(new CheckViolation(type.isBlank()?name:name+"-"+type,name,display,vl,experimental,
                verbose==null?"":verbose,builder.toString()));
    }

    protected void appendViolationDetails(StringBuilder builder, int vl, String verbose) {
        builder.append(" §7x§a").append(vl).append(" §7").append(verbose);
    }

    protected final String getDisplayName() { return player.getName(); }
}
```

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.check.api.holder;

import ac.navro.proxy.check.impl.timer.NegativeTimer;
import ac.navro.proxy.check.impl.timer.Timer;
import ac.navro.proxy.check.impl.badpackets.BadPacketsC;
import ac.navro.proxy.check.impl.badpackets.BadPacketA;
import ac.navro.proxy.check.impl.badpackets.BadPacketB;
import ac.navro.proxy.check.impl.prediction.Prediction;
import ac.navro.proxy.check.impl.prediction.DebugOffsetA;
import ac.navro.proxy.check.impl.multiactions.MultiActionsA;
import ac.navro.proxy.check.impl.multiactions.MultiActionsB;
import ac.navro.proxy.check.impl.sprint.SprintA;
import ac.navro.proxy.check.impl.sprint.SprintB;
import ac.navro.proxy.check.impl.sprint.SprintC;
import ac.navro.proxy.check.impl.sprint.SprintD;
import ac.navro.proxy.check.api.Check;
import ac.navro.proxy.check.api.impl.PacketCheck;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.live.PredictionContext;
import ac.navro.proxy.state.WirePlayerState;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;


public final class CheckHolder extends LinkedHashMap<Class<?>, Check> {
    private final WirePlayerState player;
    public CheckHolder(WirePlayerState player) {
        this.player=player;
        put(Timer.class, new Timer(player));
        put(NegativeTimer.class, new NegativeTimer(player));
        put(BadPacketsC.class, new BadPacketsC(player));
        put(BadPacketA.class, new BadPacketA(player));
        put(BadPacketB.class, new BadPacketB(player));
        put(MultiActionsA.class, new MultiActionsA(player));
        put(MultiActionsB.class, new MultiActionsB(player));
    }

    public void registerPredictionHandlers(PredictionContext prediction) {
        put(SprintA.class, new SprintA(player, prediction));
        put(SprintB.class, new SprintB(player, prediction));
        put(SprintC.class, new SprintC(player, prediction));
        put(SprintD.class, new SprintD(player, prediction));
        put(Prediction.class, new Prediction(player, prediction));
        put(DebugOffsetA.class, new DebugOffsetA(player, prediction));
    }

    public boolean enabled(Class<?> type) { return player.checkEnabled(type); }
    public java.util.List<PacketCheck> packetChecks() {
        java.util.List<PacketCheck> result = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        for (Check check : values()) if (player.checkEnabled(check.getClass()) && check instanceof PacketCheck packetCheck) result.add(packetCheck);
        return result;
    }

    public void manuallyFail(Class<?> type, String verbose) {
        Check check = get(type);
        if (check != null) check.fail(verbose);
    }
}
```

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.check.api.impl;

import ac.navro.proxy.check.api.Check;
import ac.navro.proxy.state.WirePlayerState;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.PredictionSample;

public class OffsetHandlerCheck extends Check {
    protected final PredictionSample sample;
    private boolean predictionChecked;
    public OffsetHandlerCheck(WirePlayerState player,PredictionSample sample){super(player);this.sample=sample;}
    public void onPredictionComplete(float offset){ }
    public final void onPredictionComplete(float offset,boolean checked){predictionChecked=checked;onPredictionComplete(offset);}
    protected final boolean isPredictionChecked(){return predictionChecked;}
}
```

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.check.impl.badpackets;

import ac.navro.proxy.check.api.annotations.CheckInfo;
import ac.navro.proxy.check.api.impl.PacketCheck;
import ac.navro.proxy.state.WirePlayerState;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.MathUtil;
import org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector2f;
import org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector3f;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.BedrockPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.PlayerAuthInputPacket;

@CheckInfo(name = "Bad Packet", type = "A")
public class BadPacketA extends PacketCheck {
    public BadPacketA(WirePlayerState player) { super(player); }

    @Override public boolean onPacketReceive(BedrockPacket input, boolean cancelled) {
        if (input instanceof PlayerAuthInputPacket packet) {
            Vector3f pos = packet.getPosition();
            Vector3f delta = packet.getDelta();
            Vector2f rot = Vector2f.from(packet.getRotation().getY(), packet.getRotation().getX());
            if (!MathUtil.isValid(pos) || !MathUtil.isValid(rot) || !MathUtil.isValid(delta)) {
                fail("pos=" + pos + ", rot=" + rot + ", delta=" + delta);
            }
        }
        return cancelled;
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/check/impl/badpackets/BadPacketB.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.check.impl.badpackets;

import ac.navro.proxy.check.api.annotations.CheckInfo;
import ac.navro.proxy.check.api.impl.PacketCheck;
import ac.navro.proxy.state.WirePlayerState;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.MathUtil;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.BedrockPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.PlayerAuthInputPacket;

@CheckInfo(name = "Bad Packet", type = "B")
public class BadPacketB extends PacketCheck {
    public BadPacketB(WirePlayerState player) { super(player); }

    @Override public boolean onPacketReceive(BedrockPacket input, boolean cancelled) {
        if (!(input instanceof PlayerAuthInputPacket packet)) return cancelled;
        float yaw = packet.getRotation().getY();
        float pitch = packet.getRotation().getX();
        float wrappedY = MathUtil.wrapDegrees(yaw);
        float wrappedX = MathUtil.clamp(pitch, -90, 90);
        if (wrappedY != yaw) fail("claimedYaw=" + yaw + ", wrappedYaw=" + wrappedY);
        else if (wrappedX != pitch) fail("claimedPitch=" + pitch + ", wrappedPitch=" + wrappedX);
        return cancelled;
    }
}
```

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.check.impl.elytra;

import ac.navro.proxy.SessionState;
import ac.navro.proxy.check.api.annotations.CheckInfo;
import ac.navro.proxy.check.api.impl.PacketCheck;
import ac.navro.proxy.data.vanilla.GameType;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.entity.EntityFlag;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.*;


@CheckInfo(name="Elytra",type="A")
public final class ElytraA extends PacketCheck {
    private final SessionState session;
    private PlayerAuthInputPacket rejectedInput;
    public ElytraA(SessionState session){super(session.player());this.session=session;}
    @Override public boolean onPacketReceive(BedrockPacket packet,boolean cancelled){
        if(cancelled||!(packet instanceof PlayerAuthInputPacket input))return cancelled;
        if(input==rejectedInput)return cancelled;
        rejectedInput=null;
        if(player.isExempted()||!session.spawned()||player.inLoadingScreen
                ||player.gameType()==GameType.SPECTATOR
                ||!input.getInputData().contains(PlayerAuthInputData.START_GLIDING)
                ||session.hasElytraEquipped()
                ||session.authInputPackets().context().disabledChecks.contains("Elytra-A"))return cancelled;
        rejectedInput=input;
        input.getInputData().remove(PlayerAuthInputData.START_GLIDING);
        input.getInputData().add(PlayerAuthInputData.STOP_GLIDING);
        player.setPredictionFlag(EntityFlag.GLIDING,false);
        fail("started gliding without an equipped elytra");
        session.resyncGliding();
        return cancelled;
    }
    public boolean onPredictionComplete(PlayerAuthInputPacket input){
        if(input!=rejectedInput)return false;
        rejectedInput=null;
        player.requestRewind(player.tick());
        return true;
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/check/impl/multiactions/MultiActionsB.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.check.impl.multiactions;

import ac.navro.proxy.check.api.annotations.CheckInfo;
import ac.navro.proxy.check.api.impl.InventoryCheck;
import ac.navro.proxy.state.WirePlayerState;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData;

@CheckInfo(name = "MultiActions", type = "B")
public final class MultiActionsB extends InventoryCheck {
    public MultiActionsB(WirePlayerState player) {
        super(player);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onInventoryClick() {
        var motion = player.rawInputMotion();
        boolean moving = motion != null && motion.finite() && (motion.x() != 0 || motion.y() != 0);
        for (PlayerAuthInputData input : player.inputData()) {
            moving |= switch (input) {
                case UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT, UP_LEFT, UP_RIGHT, DOWN_LEFT, DOWN_RIGHT -> true;
                default -> false;
            };
        }
        if (moving) fail("input=true");
        return moving;
    }
}
```

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.check.impl.place;

import ac.navro.proxy.check.api.annotations.CheckInfo;
import ac.navro.proxy.check.api.impl.PacketCheck;
import ac.navro.proxy.state.WirePlayerState;
import ac.navro.proxy.data.vanilla.GameType;
import ac.navro.proxy.util.block.BlockPlacementPhysics;
import ac.navro.proxy.util.block.BlockUtil;
import org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector3i;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.ItemData;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.transaction.InventoryTransactionType;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.*;


@CheckInfo(name="AirLiquidPlace",requiresServerTick=true)
public final class AirLiquidPlace extends PacketCheck {
    public interface Context {
        boolean placeable(ItemData item);
        boolean validate(ItemData held,ItemData claimed);
        ItemData held();
        GameType serverGameType();
        boolean hadRecentPlacementSupport(Vector3i position);
        int clickedBlockId(Vector3i position);
        void restore(Vector3i position);
        void resendInventory();
        InventoryTransactionPacket embedded(PlayerAuthInputPacket input);
    }
    private final Context context;
    public AirLiquidPlace(WirePlayerState player,Context context){super(player);this.context=context;}
    public void onInput(PlayerAuthInputPacket input,boolean cancelled) {
        if(cancelled)return;var data=context.embedded(input);
        if(data==null||data.getTransactionType()!=InventoryTransactionType.ITEM_USE||data.getActionType()!=0||!validPlacement(data))return;
        var held=context.held();if(!context.validate(held,data.getItemInHand()))return;
        if(reject(data,held,context.clickedBlockId(data.getBlockPosition()))) {
            input.setItemUseTransaction(null);input.getInputData().remove(PlayerAuthInputData.PERFORM_ITEM_INTERACTION);
        }
    }
    public boolean reject(InventoryTransactionPacket data,ItemData held,int clickedId) {
        if(!player.checkEnabled(getClass())||!validPlacement(data)||!context.placeable(held)||player.isExempted()||context.serverGameType()==GameType.CREATIVE)return false;
        var pos=data.getBlockPosition();
        if(context.hadRecentPlacementSupport(pos)||!BlockPlacementPhysics.isAirOrLiquid(clickedId))return false;
        fail();context.restore(pos);context.restore(BlockUtil.getBlockPosition(pos,data.getBlockFace()));player.tickSinceBlockResync=5;
        context.resendInventory();return true;
    }
    private boolean validPlacement(InventoryTransactionPacket data) {
        return data.getClientInteractPrediction()!=null&&data.getClientInteractPrediction().ordinal()!=0&&data.getBlockPosition()!=null
                &&data.getBlockFace()>=0&&data.getBlockFace()<=5&&context.placeable(data.getItemInHand());
    }
}
```

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.check.impl.place;

import ac.navro.proxy.packets.player.PlacementPipeline;

import ac.navro.proxy.check.api.annotations.CheckInfo;
import ac.navro.proxy.check.api.impl.PacketCheck;
import ac.navro.proxy.state.WirePlayerState;
import ac.navro.proxy.util.block.BlockReachUtil;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.transaction.InventoryTransactionType;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.*;


@CheckInfo(name="FarPlace")
public final class FarPlace extends PacketCheck {
    private final PlacementPipeline context;
    public FarPlace(WirePlayerState player,PlacementPipeline context){super(player);this.context=context;}
    @Override protected void appendViolationDetails(StringBuilder builder,int vl,String verbose){super.appendViolationDetails(builder,vl,BlockReachUtil.distanceDetail(verbose));}
    public boolean onTransaction(InventoryTransactionPacket packet,boolean cancelled) {
        if(cancelled||player.vehicleData!=null)return cancelled;
        if(isFar(packet)){fail(BlockReachUtil.describe(player,packet.getBlockPosition()));resync(packet);return true;}return false;
    }
    public void onInput(PlayerAuthInputPacket input,boolean cancelled) {
        if(cancelled||player.vehicleData!=null)return;var transaction=context.embeddedTransaction(input);
        if(isFar(transaction)){fail(BlockReachUtil.describe(player,transaction.getBlockPosition()));input.setItemUseTransaction(null);
            input.getInputData().remove(PlayerAuthInputData.PERFORM_ITEM_INTERACTION);resync(transaction);}
    }
    private boolean isFar(InventoryTransactionPacket packet) {
        return packet!=null&&packet.getTransactionType()==InventoryTransactionType.ITEM_USE&&packet.getActionType()==0&&packet.getBlockPosition()!=null
                &&BlockReachUtil.isPlaceable(player.protocolVersion(),context.decodedClaim(packet.getItemInHand()))&&BlockReachUtil.isFar(player,packet.getBlockPosition());
    }
    private void resync(InventoryTransactionPacket packet){context.resyncFarPlacement(packet);}
}
```
