`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/check/impl/prediction/Prediction.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.check.impl.prediction;


import ac.navro.proxy.check.api.annotations.CheckInfo;
import ac.navro.proxy.check.api.impl.OffsetHandlerCheck;
import ac.navro.proxy.state.WirePlayerState;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.PredictionSample;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;

import java.util.function.BooleanSupplier;

@CheckInfo(name = "Prediction")
public class Prediction extends OffsetHandlerCheck {
    private final Phase phase;
    private final GroundSpoof groundSpoof;
    private final NoSlow noSlow;
    private final AntiKB antiKB;
    private final Collisions collisions;
    private final Horizonal horizonal;
    private final Vertical vertical;

    public Prediction(WirePlayerState player, PredictionSample sample) {
        super(player,sample);

        this.phase = new Phase(player,sample);
        this.groundSpoof = new GroundSpoof(player,sample);
        this.noSlow = new NoSlow(player,sample);
        this.antiKB = new AntiKB(player,sample);
        this.collisions = new Collisions(player,sample);
        this.horizonal = new Horizonal(player,sample);
        this.vertical = new Vertical(player,sample);
    }

    @Override
    public void onPredictionComplete(float offset) {

        if (sample.tick < 10 || offset < sample.getMaxOffset()) {
            return;
        }

        if (!shouldDoFail() || offset < sample.alertThreshold) {

            sample.getTeleportUtil().rewind(sample.tick);
            return;
        }

        Vec3 actual = sample.unvalidatedPosition.subtract(sample.prevUnvalidatedPosition);
        Vec3 predicted = sample.position.subtract(sample.prevUnvalidatedPosition);
        routeChecks(() -> phase.check(offset), () -> groundSpoof.check(offset),
                () -> noSlow.check(offset, actual, predicted), () -> antiKB.check(offset),
                () -> {
                    collisions.check(offset);
                    horizonal.check(offset, actual, predicted);
                    vertical.check(offset, actual, predicted);
                });
        sample.getTeleportUtil().rewind(sample.tick);
    }


    static void routeChecks(final BooleanSupplier phase, final BooleanSupplier groundSpoof,
                            final BooleanSupplier noSlow, final BooleanSupplier antiKB,
                            final Runnable genericChecks) {


        if (phase.getAsBoolean() || groundSpoof.getAsBoolean()
                || noSlow.getAsBoolean() || antiKB.getAsBoolean()) {
            return;
        }
        genericChecks.run();
    }

    public boolean shouldDoFail() {
        return sample.tickSinceBlockResync <= 0 && !sample.insideUnloadedChunk && !sample.getTeleportUtil().isTeleporting() && sample.sinceLoadingScreen > 5
                && sample.compensatedWorld.isChunkLoadedAt(sample.position.x, sample.position.z);
    }

}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/check/impl/prediction/PredictionSubCheck.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.check.impl.prediction;


import ac.navro.proxy.check.api.Check;
import ac.navro.proxy.state.WirePlayerState;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.PredictionSample;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.engine.data.VectorType;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;


abstract class PredictionSubCheck extends Check {
    protected final PredictionSample sample;
    private final String checkName;

    PredictionSubCheck(final WirePlayerState player, PredictionSample sample, final String checkName) {
        super(player, checkName, "", false);
        this.checkName = checkName;
        this.sample=sample;
    }

    final boolean canCheck(final float offset) {
        return canCheckState(offset)
                && sample.bestPossibility.getType() != VectorType.VELOCITY;
    }

    final boolean canCheckState(final float offset) {
        return sample.tick >= 10
                && Float.isFinite(offset)
                && offset >= sample.getMaxOffset()
                && sample.tickSinceBlockResync <= 0
                && !sample.insideUnloadedChunk
                && !sample.getTeleportUtil().isTeleporting()
                && sample.sinceLoadingScreen > 5
                && sample.compensatedWorld.isChunkLoadedAt(sample.position.x, sample.position.z);
    }

    final void failCheck(final String verbose) {
        if (sample.disabledChecks.contains(checkName)) {
            return;
        }

        fail(verbose);
    }

    static float horizontalError(final Vec3 actual, final Vec3 predicted) {
        return actual.subtract(predicted).horizontalLength();
    }

    static float verticalError(final Vec3 actual, final Vec3 predicted) {
        return Math.abs(actual.y - predicted.y);
    }
}
```

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.check.impl.sprint;

import ac.navro.proxy.check.api.annotations.CheckInfo;
import ac.navro.proxy.check.api.impl.OffsetHandlerCheck;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.live.PredictionContext;
import ac.navro.proxy.state.WirePlayerState;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.entity.EntityFlag;

@CheckInfo(name = "Sprint", type = "B", setback = 5)
public final class SprintB extends OffsetHandlerCheck {
    private final PredictionContext prediction;

    public SprintB(WirePlayerState player, PredictionContext prediction) {
        super(player, prediction);
        this.prediction = prediction;
    }

    @Override
    public void onPredictionComplete(float offset) {
        if (!isPredictionChecked()) return;
        final boolean sneaking = player.predictionFlag(EntityFlag.SNEAKING)
                || prediction.getInputData().contains(PlayerAuthInputData.STOP_SNEAKING);
        final var pose = player.fluidPrediction();
        final boolean crawling = pose.inputActive ? pose.wasCrawling
                : player.predictionFlag(EntityFlag.CRAWLING);
        final float multiplier = 0.3F + (prediction.ticksSinceCanSlowdown > 2 ? prediction.sneakingAttributeModifier : 0F);
        if (!(sneaking || crawling) || multiplier >= 0.8F) return;
        if (player.predictionSprinting()) flagWithSetback();
        else reward();
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/check/impl/timer/NegativeTimer.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.check.impl.timer;

import ac.navro.proxy.check.api.annotations.CheckInfo;
import ac.navro.proxy.state.WirePlayerState;
import ac.navro.proxy.util.LatencyUtil;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.PlayerAuthInputPacket;

import java.util.function.Consumer;
import java.util.function.LongSupplier;


@CheckInfo(name = "NegativeTimer", setback = 0)
public final class NegativeTimer extends Timer {
    static final long DRIFT_NS = 1_200_000_000L;
    private boolean awaitFirstInputAfterLifecycle;

    public NegativeTimer(final WirePlayerState player) {
        this(player, System::nanoTime, null);
    }

    NegativeTimer(final WirePlayerState player, final LongSupplier clock, final Consumer<String> report) {
        super(player, clock, report);
    }

    @Override
    public void onLatencyAccepted(final LatencyUtil.Latency latency) {
        budget.acknowledgeNegative(latency.ns(), clock.getAsLong());
    }

    public void onDeath() {
        resetAfterLifecycle();
    }

    public void onRespawn() {
        resetAfterLifecycle();
    }

    private void resetAfterLifecycle() {
        awaitFirstInputAfterLifecycle = true;
        budget.resetNegative(clock.getAsLong(), player.tick(), DRIFT_NS);
    }


    public void onAuthInput(final PlayerAuthInputPacket input) {
        final long now = clock.getAsLong();
        if (needsTimerReset() || !player.isAlive()) {
            budget.resetNegative(now, player.tick(), DRIFT_NS);
            awaitFirstInputAfterLifecycle = true;
            return;
        }
        if (awaitFirstInputAfterLifecycle) {
            budget.resetNegative(now, player.tick(), DRIFT_NS);
            awaitFirstInputAfterLifecycle = false;
            return;
        }
        final TimerBudget.NegativeAccounting accounting = budget.accountNegative(
                now, player.tick(), DRIFT_NS, timerGrace());
        if (accounting.flag()) {
            report.accept(formatTimerMillis(accounting.evaluatedBalance()));
            pullBack();
        }
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/check/impl/timer/Timer.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.check.impl.timer;

import ac.navro.proxy.check.api.annotations.CheckInfo;
import ac.navro.proxy.check.api.annotations.Experimental;
import ac.navro.proxy.check.api.impl.PingBasedCheck;
import ac.navro.proxy.state.WirePlayerState;
import ac.navro.proxy.util.LatencyUtil;

import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.function.Consumer;
import java.util.function.LongSupplier;

@Experimental
@CheckInfo(name = "Timer")
public class Timer extends PingBasedCheck {
    protected final TimerBudget budget = new TimerBudget();
    protected final LongSupplier clock;
    protected final Consumer<String> report;
    protected final LongSupplier wallClock;

    public Timer(final WirePlayerState player) {
        this(player, System::nanoTime, null);
    }

    protected Timer(final WirePlayerState player, final LongSupplier clock, final Consumer<String> report) {
        this(player,clock,report,System::currentTimeMillis);
    }
    protected Timer(final WirePlayerState player,final LongSupplier clock,final Consumer<String> report,LongSupplier wallClock) {
        super(player);
        this.wallClock=wallClock;
        this.clock = clock;
        this.report = report == null ? this::fail : report;
    }

    @Override
    public void onLatencyAccepted(LatencyUtil.Latency latency) {
        if (!budget.beforeAuthInput) return;
        budget.beforeAuthInput = false;
        if (latency.ns() > clock.getAsLong() + budget.balance) {
            long distance = (latency.ns() - (clock.getAsLong() + budget.balance))
                    - (TimerBudget.TICK_NS / 2);
            budget.balance += distance;
            budget.loseBalance = Math.max(0, budget.loseBalance - distance);
        }
    }

    public boolean isInvalid() {
        return isInvalid(player.tick());
    }


    public boolean isInvalid(long ignoredClientTick) {
        final boolean skipLoadingScreen = player.inLoadingScreen
                ? wallClock.getAsLong() - player.loadingScreenStartMs < 10_000L
                : player.sinceLoadingScreen < 200;
        if (budget.lastNS == 0 || skipLoadingScreen) {
            budget.resetBoar(clock.getAsLong());
            return false;
        }

        boolean valid = true;
        long distance = clock.getAsLong() - budget.lastNS;
        if (budget.balance > TimerBudget.LIMIT_NS) {
            if (budget.balance - budget.loseBalance <= TimerBudget.LIMIT_NS) {
                budget.loseBalance -= TimerBudget.TICK_NS;
            } else {
                report.accept("balance=" + budget.balance);
            }
            budget.balance -= TimerBudget.TICK_NS;
            valid = false;
        } else {
            long maximum = (long) Math.max(0, player.maxBalanceAdvantageMs() * 1e6);
            if (budget.balance <= -Math.abs(maximum + TimerBudget.TICK_NS)
                    && player.maxBalanceAdvantageMs() > 0) {
                budget.loseBalance = Math.abs(budget.balance);
                budget.balance = -TimerBudget.TICK_NS;
            }
        }
        budget.balance -= distance - TimerBudget.TICK_NS;
        budget.lastNS = Math.max(budget.lastNS, clock.getAsLong());
        budget.beforeAuthInput = true;
        return !valid;
    }

    protected final void pullBack() {
        player.requestTeleportToLastValid();
    }

    protected final boolean needsTimerReset() {
        return budget.lastNS == 0 || player.inLoadingScreen;
    }

    protected final boolean timerGrace() {
        return player.sinceLoadingScreen < 20;
    }

    protected static String formatTimerMillis(final long nanos) {
        return String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%dms", nanos / 1_000_000L);
    }


    static final class TimerBudget {
        static final long TICK_NS = 50_000_000L;
        static final long LIMIT_NS = 63_000_000L;
        long lastNS, balance, prevTick, loseBalance;
        boolean beforeAuthInput;
        long lastMovementPlayerClock;

        void resetBoar(long now) {
            lastNS=now;
            balance=0;
        }

        void resetNegative(final long now, final long tick, final long driftNS) {
            lastNS = now;
            prevTick = tick;
            balance = driftNS;
            lastMovementPlayerClock = now - 60_000_000_000L;
            beforeAuthInput = false;
        }

        record NegativeAccounting(long evaluatedBalance, boolean flag) { }

        NegativeAccounting accountNegative(final long now, final long tick,
                                           final long driftNS, final boolean reset) {
            if (reset) {
                resetNegative(now, tick, driftNS);
                return new NegativeAccounting(driftNS, false);
            }
            if (tick <= prevTick) {
                return new NegativeAccounting(balance - (now - lastNS), false);
            }
            balance += TICK_NS - (now - lastNS);
            lastNS = now;
            prevTick = tick;
            beforeAuthInput = true;
            final long evaluated = balance;
            final boolean flag = now + evaluated < lastMovementPlayerClock - driftNS;
            if (flag) balance += TICK_NS;
            final long lowerBound = lastMovementPlayerClock - driftNS - now;
            balance = Math.max(balance, lowerBound);
            return new NegativeAccounting(evaluated, flag);
        }

        void acknowledgeNegative(final long sentNS, final long now) {
            if (!beforeAuthInput || sentNS > now) return;
            lastMovementPlayerClock = Math.max(lastMovementPlayerClock, sentNS);
            beforeAuthInput = false;
        }
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/collision/BedrockCollision.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.collision;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Box;
import ac.navro.proxy.compensated.world.base.CompensatedWorld;
import ac.navro.proxy.data.block.NetworkBlockState;
import ac.navro.proxy.data.block.NetworkBlockStateRegistry;
import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.zip.GZIPInputStream;





public final class BedrockCollision {
    private BedrockCollision() { }
    public record Actor(float minY, float fallDistance, boolean descending,
                        boolean descendScaffolding, boolean leatherBoots) { }
    private record Key(String name, org.cloudburstmc.nbt.NbtMap properties) { }
    private record Shape(int kind, List<Box> boxes) { }
    private static final Map<Integer,Map<Key,Shape>> TABLES = new HashMap<>();

    private static Key key(NetworkBlockState state) {
        return new Key(state.identifier(),state.stateTag().getCompound("states"));
    }
    private static synchronized Map<Key,Shape> table(int protocol) {
        return TABLES.computeIfAbsent(protocol,
                version -> load(NetworkBlockStateRegistry.paletteProtocol(version)));
    }
    private static Map<Key,Shape> load(int palette) {
        if(palette<0)return Map.of();
        var resource=BedrockCollision.class.getResourceAsStream("/navro/bedrock-collisions-"+palette+".bin.gz");
        if(resource==null)throw new IllegalStateException("Missing Bedrock collision overrides: "+palette);
        var states=NetworkBlockStateRegistry.forProtocol(palette,false);
        var result=new HashMap<Key,Shape>();
        try(var in=new DataInputStream(new GZIPInputStream(resource))){
            if(in.readInt()!=0x4e424331)throw new IOException("Invalid Bedrock collision table");
            int count=in.readInt();
            for(int i=0;i<count;i++){
                var state=states.resolve(in.readInt());int kind=in.readUnsignedByte(),n=in.readUnsignedShort();
                var boxes=new ArrayList<Box>(n);
                for(int j=0;j<n;j++)boxes.add(new Box(in.readFloat(),in.readFloat(),in.readFloat(),in.readFloat(),in.readFloat(),in.readFloat()));
                if(state==null)throw new IOException("Override state missing from palette");
                if(kind!=0)result.put(key(state),new Shape(kind,List.copyOf(boxes)));
            }
            if(in.read()!=-1)throw new IOException("Trailing override data");
        }catch(IOException e){throw new IllegalStateException("Cannot read Bedrock collision overrides",e);}
        return Map.copyOf(result);
    }


    public static List<Box> getCollisionBox(CompensatedWorld world, int x,int y,int z,
                                           NetworkBlockState state, Actor actor) {
        if(state==null||state.stateTag()==null)return null;
        Shape shape=table(world.protocolVersion()).get(key(state));
        if(shape==null)return null;
        return resolveCollision(world,x,y,z,state,actor,shape.kind(),shape.boxes());
    }

    public static List<Box> resolveCollision(CompensatedWorld world,int x,int y,int z,
                                             NetworkBlockState state,Actor actor,int kind,List<Box> boxes) {
        return switch(kind){
            case 1 -> boxes;
            case 2 -> door(world,x,y,z,state);
            case 3 -> actor!=null&&actor.minY()>=y+1F-Box.COLLISION_EPSILON&&!actor.descendScaffolding()
                    ? List.of(new Box(0,.875F,0,1,1,1)):List.of();
            case 4 -> powder(y,actor);
            default -> null;
        };
    }
    private static List<Box> powder(int y,Actor a){
        if(a==null||a.minY()<y+1F-Math.ulp(1F)||a.descending())return List.of();
        if(a.fallDistance()>2.5F)return List.of(new Box(0,0,0,1,.9F,1));
        return a.leatherBoots()?List.of(new Box(0,0,0,1,1,1)):List.of();
    }
    private static List<Box> door(CompensatedWorld w,int x,int y,int z,NetworkBlockState state){
        boolean top=state.booleanProperty("upper_block_bit",(state.blockData()&8)!=0);
        var other=w.networkBlockState(w.getRawBlockAt(x,y+(top?-1:1),z,0));
        boolean paired=other!=null&&state.identifier().equals(other.identifier());
        var lower=top&&paired?other:state;var upper=!top&&paired?other:state;
        String cardinal=lower.stringProperty("minecraft:cardinal_direction",lower.stringProperty("cardinal_direction",""));
        int direction=switch(cardinal){case "north"->3;case "east"->0;case "south"->1;case "west"->2;
            default->(lower.intProperty("direction",lower.blockData()&3)+1)&3;};
        boolean open=lower.booleanProperty("open_bit",(lower.blockData()&4)!=0);
        boolean right=upper.booleanProperty("door_hinge_bit",(upper.blockData()&1)!=0);

        int side=switch(direction){case 2->!open?0:right?3:1;case 3->!open?1:right?0:2;
            case 0->!open?2:right?1:3;default->!open?3:right?2:0;};
        return List.of(switch(side){case 0->new Box(0,0,0,1,1,.1825F);
            case 1->new Box(.8175F,0,0,1,1,1);case 2->new Box(0,0,.8175F,1,1,1);
            default->new Box(0,0,0,.1825F,1,1);});
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/collision/Collider.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.collision;

import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.live.PredictionContext;

import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.live.*;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.*;
import ac.navro.anticheat.collision.*;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.MathUtil;


import ac.navro.anticheat.collision.CollisionQuery;
import ac.navro.anticheat.collision.ProtocolCollisionSolver;
import ac.navro.anticheat.collision.SneakEdgePhysics;
import ac.navro.anticheat.collision.SweptMovement;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Box;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;
import ac.navro.proxy.state.WirePlayerState;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;


public final class Collider {
    private Collider() { }
    private static float stepHeight(WirePlayerState player) { return player.wasdControlled() ? 1.0625F : 0.5625F; }

    public static boolean canFallAtLeast(WirePlayerState player, ProtocolCollisionWorld world, float x, float z, float distance) {
        Box support = supportBox(player.boundingBox(), x, z, distance);
        return world.collectColliders(world.entityCollisions(support, player.boundingBox()), support).isEmpty();
    }
    public static Vec3 maybeBackOffFromEdge(WirePlayerState player, ProtocolCollisionWorld world, Vec3 movement) {
        return backOffFromEdge(player, world, movement).movement();
    }
    public static SneakEdgePhysics.Result backOffFromEdge(WirePlayerState player, ProtocolCollisionWorld world, Vec3 movement) {
        Vec3 submitted = CollisionQuery.clamp(movement);
        boolean inputSneaking = player.inputData().contains(PlayerAuthInputData.SNEAK_DOWN);
        if (!SneakEdgePhysics.active(inputSneaking, player.sneaking(), player.onGround(), player.flag6()))
            return SneakEdgePhysics.unchanged(submitted);
        float step = stepHeight(player);
        Box query = CollisionQuery.buildCollisionQuery(player.boundingBox(), submitted, step);
        return SneakEdgePhysics.resolve(player.boundingBox(), world.collectColliders(
                world.entityCollisions(query, player.boundingBox()), query), submitted, step);
    }
    private static Box supportBox(Box box, float x, float z, float distance) {
        float minX = box.minX + 0.025F, maxX = box.maxX - 0.025F;
        float minZ = box.minZ + 0.025F, maxZ = box.maxZ - 0.025F;
        if (minX > maxX) minX = maxX = (box.minX + box.maxX) * 0.5F;
        if (minZ > maxZ) minZ = maxZ = (box.minZ + box.maxZ) * 0.5F;
        return new Box(minX + x, box.minY - distance, minZ + z, maxX + x, box.maxY - distance, maxZ + z);
    }

    public static void acceptInputPosition(WirePlayerState player, ProtocolCollisionWorld world, Vec3 accepted) {
        Box current = player.boundingBox();
        if (player.usesVehiclePosition() || !current.isValid()) {
            player.acceptInputPosition(accepted, List.of());
            return;
        }
        Vec3 correction = accepted.subtract(current.feetCenter());
        if (correction.x == 0 && correction.y == 0 && correction.z == 0) {
            player.acceptInputPosition(accepted, List.of());
            return;
        }
        Box query = CollisionQuery.buildCollisionQuery(current, correction, 0);
        List<Box> collisions = new ArrayList<>();
        for (CollisionShapeEntry entry : world.movementEntries(query)) collisions.add(entry.shape());
        collisions.addAll(world.nearbyEntityShapes(current));
        player.acceptInputPosition(accepted, collisions);
    }

    public static Vec3 collide(WirePlayerState player, ProtocolCollisionWorld world, Vec3 movement) {
        return collideMove(player, world, movement).movement;
    }
    public static SweptMovement.MoveResult collideMove(WirePlayerState player, ProtocolCollisionWorld world, Vec3 movement) {
        return resolve(player, world, movement, false, false).result();
    }
    public static Vec3 collideAndUpdate(WirePlayerState player, ProtocolCollisionWorld world, Vec3 movement) {
        return collideAndUpdateMove(player, world, movement).movement;
    }
    public static SweptMovement.MoveResult collideAndUpdateMove(WirePlayerState player, ProtocolCollisionWorld world, Vec3 movement) {
        var move = resolve(player, world, movement, true, true);
        updatePenetration(player, move.ordinaryOverlapDepth());
        return move.result();
    }
    public static SweptMovement.MoveResult collideBlockPush(WirePlayerState player, ProtocolCollisionWorld world, Vec3 movement) {
        var move = resolve(player, world, movement, false, true);
        updatePenetration(player, move.ordinaryOverlapDepth());
        return move.result();
    }
    private static void updatePenetration(WirePlayerState player, float ordinaryOverlapDepth) {
        player.setCollisionPenetratingFrames(ordinaryOverlapDepth >= Box.COLLISION_EPSILON
                ? Math.min(2, player.collisionPenetratingFrames() + 1) : 0);
        player.collisionPhysics.updatePushTowardsClosestSpace(player.pushTowardsClosestSpace());
        player.collisionPhysics.requestClosestSpace(player.pushTowardsClosestSpace(), ordinaryOverlapDepth >= Box.COLLISION_EPSILON);
        player.collisionPhysics.finishOverlapResolution();
    }
    private static ProtocolCollisionSolver.ResolvedMove resolve(WirePlayerState player, ProtocolCollisionWorld world,
                                                                Vec3 movement, boolean commitShapes, boolean commitState) {
        Vec3 submitted = CollisionQuery.clamp(movement);
        Box box = player.boundingBox();
        float step = stepHeight(player);
        Box query = CollisionQuery.buildCollisionQuery(box, submitted, step);
        List<CollisionShapeEntry> entries = new ArrayList<>(world.movementEntries(query));
        if (commitShapes) player.collisionPhysics.commitMovement(query, entries);
        List<Box> collisions = new ArrayList<>(entries.size());
        for (CollisionShapeEntry entry : entries) collisions.add(entry.shape());
        List<Box> nearby = world.nearbyEntityShapes(box);
        for (Box shape : nearby) {
            collisions.add(shape);
            entries.add(new CollisionShapeEntry(shape, null));
        }
        if (commitShapes) player.setMovementCollisionEntries(entries);
        boolean rememberedOneWay = player.collisionPhysics.hasOneWayCollision(box, commitState);
        boolean oneWay = player.collisionPenetratingFrames() >= 2 || rememberedOneWay;
        Vec3 minimum = oneWay ? nearby.isEmpty() ? Vec3.ZERO : EntityCollisionPhysics.SOLID_DEPENETRATION.clone() : new Vec3(1, 1, 1);


        return ProtocolCollisionSolver.solveResolvedDetailed(submitted, box, collisions, minimum, step,
                player.onGround() || player.flying());
    }

 public static Vec3 maybeBackOffFromEdge(PredictionContext p,Vec3 v){p.syncWire();return ac.navro.proxy.collision.Collider.maybeBackOffFromEdge(p.wire,p.session.collisionWorld(),v);}
 public static SneakEdgePhysics.Result backOffFromEdge(PredictionContext p,Vec3 v){p.syncWire();return ac.navro.proxy.collision.Collider.backOffFromEdge(p.wire,p.session.collisionWorld(),v);}
 public static SweptMovement.MoveResult collideMove(PredictionContext p,Vec3 v){p.syncWire();return ac.navro.proxy.collision.Collider.collideMove(p.wire,p.session.collisionWorld(),v);}
 public static Vec3 collide(PredictionContext p,Vec3 v){return collideMove(p,v).movement;}
 public static SweptMovement.MoveResult collideAndUpdateMove(PredictionContext p,Vec3 v){p.syncWire();var r=ac.navro.proxy.collision.Collider.collideAndUpdateMove(p.wire,p.session.collisionWorld(),v);p.movementCollisionEntries=p.wire.movementCollisionEntries();return r;}

}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/collision/CollisionPhysicsState.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.collision;

import ac.navro.proxy.collision.block.ShulkerCollisionState;
import ac.navro.proxy.compensated.world.base.CompensatedWorld;
import ac.navro.proxy.compensated.cache.entity.EntityCache;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Box;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.function.Supplier;


public final class CollisionPhysicsState {
    private long inputTick = Long.MIN_VALUE;
    private boolean active, replaying, enforceBoatStep, collidedPreviousTick;
    private float selectedStartY;
    private EntityCollisionPhysics.Tolerance tolerance;
    private List<EntityCollisionPhysics.Actor> actors = List.of();
    private List<ShulkerCollisionState.Frame> shulkers = List.of();
    private Map<Query, List<CollisionShapeEntry>> blockQueries = new HashMap<>();
    private List<CollisionShapeEntry> movementEntries = List.of();
    private Box movementQuery;
    private Vec3 blockPush = Vec3.ZERO.clone();
    private List<Box> oneWayBlocks = List.of();
    private boolean pushTowardsClosestSpace;
    private boolean closestSpaceRequested, inputStartClosestSpaceRequested;
    private boolean resolveAcceptedOverlaps, inputStartResolveAcceptedOverlaps;

    public record Query(float minX, float minY, float minZ, float maxX, float maxY, float maxZ) {
        static Query of(final Box box) {
            return new Query(box.minX, box.minY, box.minZ, box.maxX, box.maxY, box.maxZ);
        }
    }

    public record Snapshot(long inputTick, List<EntityCollisionPhysics.Actor> actors,
                           List<ShulkerCollisionState.Frame> shulkers,
                           Map<Query, List<CollisionShapeEntry>> blockQueries,
                           List<CollisionShapeEntry> movementEntries, Box movementQuery,
                           EntityCollisionPhysics.Tolerance tolerance, boolean enforceBoatStep,
                           float selectedStartY, Vec3 blockPush,
                           List<Box> oneWayBlocks, boolean pushTowardsClosestSpace,
                           boolean inputStartResolveAcceptedOverlaps,
                           boolean resolveAcceptedOverlaps,
                           boolean closestSpaceRequested, boolean inputStartClosestSpaceRequested) {
        public Snapshot {
            actors = List.copyOf(actors);
            shulkers = List.copyOf(shulkers);
            Map<Query, List<CollisionShapeEntry>> queries = new HashMap<>();
            blockQueries.forEach((query, entries) -> queries.put(query, List.copyOf(entries)));
            blockQueries = Map.copyOf(queries);
            movementEntries = List.copyOf(movementEntries);
            blockPush = blockPush.clone();
            oneWayBlocks = List.copyOf(oneWayBlocks);
        }
        @Override public Vec3 blockPush() { return blockPush.clone(); }
    }

    public void begin(final CompensatedWorld world, final Map<Long, EntityCache> entities, final long tick, final Snapshot saved) {
        collidedPreviousTick = inputTick == tick - 1 && tolerance != null && tolerance.collided();
        inputTick = tick;
        active = true;
        replaying = saved != null;
        beginOverlapResolutionInput(saved);
        beginClosestSpaceInput(saved);
        tolerance = saved == null ? null : saved.tolerance();
        actors = saved == null ? EntityCollisionPhysics.snapshotActors(entities) : saved.actors();
        shulkers = saved == null ? world.snapshotShulkerFrames() : saved.shulkers();
        blockQueries = saved == null ? new HashMap<>() : new HashMap<>(saved.blockQueries());
        movementEntries = saved == null ? List.of() : saved.movementEntries();
        movementQuery = saved == null ? null : saved.movementQuery();
        blockPush = Vec3.ZERO.clone();
        if (saved != null) {
            enforceBoatStep = saved.enforceBoatStep();
            selectedStartY = saved.selectedStartY();
        }
    }

    public List<CollisionShapeEntry> blocks(final Box query,
                                            final Supplier<List<CollisionShapeEntry>> fetch) {
        if (!active) return fetch.get();
        final Query key = Query.of(query);
        final List<CollisionShapeEntry> saved = blockQueries.get(key);
        if (saved != null) return saved;
        final List<CollisionShapeEntry> shapes = List.copyOf(fetch.get());
        blockQueries.put(key, shapes);
        return shapes;
    }


    public List<CollisionShapeEntry> movementBlocks(final Box query,
                                                   final Supplier<List<CollisionShapeEntry>> fetch) {
        if (active && contains(movementQuery, query)) return movementEntries;
        return blocks(query, fetch);
    }

    public void commitMovement(final Box query, final List<CollisionShapeEntry> entries) {

        if (contains(movementQuery, query)) return;
        movementQuery = query;
        movementEntries = List.copyOf(entries);
    }

    public Snapshot snapshot() {
        return new Snapshot(inputTick, actors, shulkers, Map.copyOf(blockQueries),
                movementEntries, movementQuery, tolerance, enforceBoatStep, selectedStartY, blockPush.clone(),
                oneWayBlocks, pushTowardsClosestSpace, inputStartResolveAcceptedOverlaps, resolveAcceptedOverlaps,
                closestSpaceRequested, inputStartClosestSpaceRequested);
    }

    public void restore(final Snapshot snapshot) {
        reset();
        if (snapshot == null) return;
        inputTick = snapshot.inputTick();
        actors = snapshot.actors();
        shulkers = snapshot.shulkers();
        blockQueries = new HashMap<>(snapshot.blockQueries());
        movementEntries = snapshot.movementEntries();
        movementQuery = snapshot.movementQuery();
        tolerance = snapshot.tolerance();
        enforceBoatStep = snapshot.enforceBoatStep();
        selectedStartY = snapshot.selectedStartY();
        blockPush = snapshot.blockPush().clone();
        oneWayBlocks = snapshot.oneWayBlocks();
        pushTowardsClosestSpace = snapshot.pushTowardsClosestSpace();
        inputStartResolveAcceptedOverlaps = snapshot.inputStartResolveAcceptedOverlaps();
        resolveAcceptedOverlaps = snapshot.resolveAcceptedOverlaps();
        closestSpaceRequested = snapshot.closestSpaceRequested();
        inputStartClosestSpaceRequested = snapshot.inputStartClosestSpaceRequested();
    }

    public void reset() {
        inputTick = Long.MIN_VALUE;
        active = replaying = enforceBoatStep = collidedPreviousTick = false;
        selectedStartY = 0;
        tolerance = null;
        actors = List.of();
        shulkers = List.of();
        blockQueries = new HashMap<>();
        movementEntries = List.of();
        movementQuery = null;
        blockPush = Vec3.ZERO.clone();
        oneWayBlocks = List.of();
        pushTowardsClosestSpace = false;
        closestSpaceRequested = inputStartClosestSpaceRequested = false;
        inputStartResolveAcceptedOverlaps = resolveAcceptedOverlaps = false;
    }






    public void acceptClientPosition() { resolveAcceptedOverlaps = true; }

    void beginOverlapResolutionInput(final Snapshot saved) {


        inputStartResolveAcceptedOverlaps = saved == null
                ? resolveAcceptedOverlaps : saved.inputStartResolveAcceptedOverlaps();
        resolveAcceptedOverlaps = inputStartResolveAcceptedOverlaps;
    }

    public boolean resolveAcceptedOverlaps() { return resolveAcceptedOverlaps; }


    public void finishOverlapResolution() { resolveAcceptedOverlaps = false; }

    public void addInsideOneWay(final Box box) {
        if (box == null || !box.isValid()
                || oneWayBlocks.stream().anyMatch(saved -> Query.of(saved).equals(Query.of(box)))) return;
        final var boxes = new java.util.ArrayList<>(oneWayBlocks);
        boxes.add(box);
        oneWayBlocks = List.copyOf(boxes);
    }


    public boolean hasOneWayCollision(final Box actor, final boolean commit) {
        final List<Box> retained = oneWayBlocks.stream().filter(box -> box.intersects(actor)).toList();
        if (commit) oneWayBlocks = retained;
        return pushTowardsClosestSpace || !retained.isEmpty();
    }

    public void updatePushTowardsClosestSpace(final boolean value) { pushTowardsClosestSpace = value; }


    public void requestClosestSpace(final boolean enabled, final boolean penetrating) {
        closestSpaceRequested |= enabled && penetrating;
    }

    public boolean consumeClosestSpaceRequest() {
        final boolean requested = closestSpaceRequested;
        closestSpaceRequested = false;
        return requested;
    }

    void beginClosestSpaceInput(final Snapshot saved) {
        inputStartClosestSpaceRequested = saved == null ? closestSpaceRequested : saved.inputStartClosestSpaceRequested();
        closestSpaceRequested = inputStartClosestSpaceRequested;
    }

    public void setTolerance(final EntityCollisionPhysics.ToleranceSample sample) {
        tolerance = sample.tolerance();
        enforceBoatStep = sample.enforceBoatStep();
    }
    public boolean active() { return active; }
    public void endInput() { active = false; replaying = false; }
    public boolean replaying() { return replaying; }
    public boolean enforceBoatStep() { return enforceBoatStep; }
    public boolean collidedPreviousTick() { return collidedPreviousTick; }
    public long inputTick() { return inputTick; }
    public EntityCollisionPhysics.Tolerance tolerance() { return tolerance; }
    public float selectedStartY() { return selectedStartY; }
    public void selectedStartY(final float value) {

        if (!replaying || tolerance == null) selectedStartY = value;
    }
    public List<EntityCollisionPhysics.Actor> actors() { return actors; }
    public List<ShulkerCollisionState.Frame> shulkers() { return shulkers; }
    public void addBlockPush(final Vec3 applied) { blockPush = blockPush.add(applied); }
    public boolean pushedByBlock() { return active && blockPush.lengthSquared() > 1.0E-12F; }

    public static boolean contains(final Box outer, final Box inner) {
        return outer != null && outer.isValid() && outer.minX <= inner.minX
                && outer.minY <= inner.minY && outer.minZ <= inner.minZ
                && outer.maxX >= inner.maxX && outer.maxY >= inner.maxY && outer.maxZ >= inner.maxZ;
    }
}
```

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.collision;

import ac.navro.proxy.compensated.cache.entity.EntityCache;
import java.util.Map;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Box;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;


public final class EntityCollisionPhysics {
    public static final int STACKABLE = 37;
    public static final int COLLIDABLE = 121;
    public static final Vec3 SOLID_DEPENETRATION = new Vec3(0.1F, 0.1F, 0.1F);
    private EntityCollisionPhysics() { }

    public record Actor(long runtimeId, int dimension, boolean collidable, boolean stackable,
                        boolean fallingBlock, boolean boat, boolean happyGhast,
                        Vec3 position, Box current, Box past) {
        public Actor { position = position == null ? null : position.clone(); }
        @Override public Vec3 position() { return position == null ? null : position.clone(); }
    }

    public static List<Actor> snapshotActors(final Map<Long, EntityCache> entities) {
        final List<Actor> actors = new ArrayList<>();
        for (final EntityCache cache : entities.values()) {
            if (cache == null || cache.getCurrent() == null) continue;
            actors.add(new Actor(cache.runtimeId(), cache.dimension(),
                    Boolean.TRUE.equals(cache.collidableFlag()), cache.stackable(),
                    cache.fallingBlock(), cache.boat(), cache.happyGhast(),
                    cache.getCurrent().getPos().clone(), cache.getCurrent().getBoundingBox(),
                    null));
        }
        return List.copyOf(actors);
    }

    public static List<Box> nearbyShapes(final List<Actor> actors, final Box target,
                                        final long targetId, final int dimension,
                                        final boolean targetStackable) {
        final Box query = target.expand(2.0F);
        final List<Box> shapes = new ArrayList<>();
        for (final Actor actor : actors) {
            if (actor.runtimeId() == targetId || actor.dimension() != dimension
                    || actor.current() == null || !actor.current().isValid()
                    || !query.intersects(actor.current())) continue;
            if (!(actor.collidable() || actor.stackable() && targetStackable)) continue;

            if (actor.fallingBlock() && actor.current().maxY > target.minY) continue;
            shapes.add(actor.current());
        }
        return List.copyOf(shapes);
    }

    public record Tolerance(boolean boat, boolean happyGhast, float x, float y, float z) {
        public static final Tolerance NONE = new Tolerance(false, false, 0, 0, 0);
        public boolean collided() { return boat || happyGhast; }
    }

    public record ToleranceSample(Tolerance tolerance, boolean enforceBoatStep) { }

    public static ToleranceSample sample(final List<Actor> actors, final Vec3 verifiedPosition,
                                         final Box movementBox, final long ridingId,
                                         final boolean riding, final boolean enforceBoatStep,
                                         final float actualY, final float baseMotionY) {
        boolean boat = false, happyGhast = false;
        final Box expanded = movementBox.expand(1.0F);
        for (final Actor actor : actors) {
            if (actor.runtimeId() == ridingId) continue;
            if (actor.boat() && actor.position() != null
                    && verifiedPosition.distanceTo(actor.position()) < 2.0F) boat = true;
            if (actor.happyGhast() && (actor.current() != null && expanded.intersects(actor.current())
                    || actor.past() != null && expanded.intersects(actor.past()))) happyGhast = true;
        }
        boolean enforce = enforceBoatStep;
        float boatY = 0;
        if (boat && !riding) {
            if (actualY < 0.605F) {
                if (enforce) {
                    if (actualY < 0.1F) boatY = 1.0F;
                    enforce = false;
                } else if (baseMotionY <= 0.0F) {
                    boatY = 1.0F;
                    if (actualY > 0.42F) enforce = true;
                }
            }
        } else if (!boat) {
            enforce = false;
        }
        return new ToleranceSample(new Tolerance(boat, happyGhast,
                boat || happyGhast ? 0.4F : 0,
                Math.max(boatY, happyGhast ? 0.4F : 0),
                boat || happyGhast ? 0.4F : 0), enforce);
    }


    public static float adjustedMotionOffset(final Vec3 predicted, final Vec3 actual,
                                             final Tolerance tolerance) {
        final float x = Math.max(0, Math.abs(actual.x - predicted.x) - tolerance.x());
        final float y = Math.max(0, Math.abs(actual.y - predicted.y) - tolerance.y());
        final float z = Math.max(0, Math.abs(actual.z - predicted.z) - tolerance.z());
        return Math.max(x, Math.max(y, z));
    }

    public static Vec3 clampAccepted(final Vec3 predicted, final Vec3 client,
                                     final Tolerance tolerance) {
        if (tolerance == null || !tolerance.collided()) return predicted.clone();
        return new Vec3(predicted.x + clamp(client.x - predicted.x, tolerance.x()),
                predicted.y + clamp(client.y - predicted.y, tolerance.y()),
                predicted.z + clamp(client.z - predicted.z, tolerance.z()));
    }

    private static float clamp(final float difference, final float allowance) {
        if (!Float.isFinite(difference)) return 0;
        final float limit = Math.max(0, allowance);
        return Math.max(-limit, Math.min(limit, difference));
    }

}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/collision/MoveTowardsClosestSpace.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.collision;

import ac.navro.proxy.state.WirePlayerState;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Box;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;


public final class MoveTowardsClosestSpace {
    private static final float QUERY_EXPANSION = 1.0F;
    private static final float PUSH_MAGNITUDE = 0.1F;
    private static final float DIRECTION_EPSILON = 1.1920929E-7F;
    private static final float MIN_LENGTH = 1.0E-4F;
    private MoveTowardsClosestSpace() { }


    public static void prepare(final WirePlayerState player, final ProtocolCollisionWorld world,
                               final boolean trackedVehicle) {
        prepare(player, trackedVehicle, () -> {
            final Box actor = player.boundingBox();
            final Box query = new Box(actor.minX - QUERY_EXPANSION, actor.minY,
                    actor.minZ - QUERY_EXPANSION, actor.maxX + QUERY_EXPANSION,
                    actor.maxY, actor.maxZ + QUERY_EXPANSION);
            return world.collectColliders(List.of(), query);
        });
    }

    static void prepare(final WirePlayerState player, final boolean trackedVehicle,
                        final java.util.function.Supplier<List<Box>> fetch) {
        if (!player.collisionPhysics.consumeClosestSpaceRequest()
                || !player.hasCollision()
                || trackedVehicle) return;
        player.setVelocity(apply(player.boundingBox(), fetch.get(), player.velocity()));
    }

    public static Vec3 apply(final Box actor, final List<Box> queried, final Vec3 velocity) {
        final List<Box> collisions = new ArrayList<>();
        for (final Box collision : queried) {
            if (collision.intersects(actor)) {
                collisions.add(collision);
            }
        }
        if (collisions.isEmpty()) {
            return velocity.clone();
        }

        float averageX = 0.0F;
        float averageZ = 0.0F;
        for (final Box collision : collisions) {
            averageX += (collision.minX + collision.maxX) * 0.5F;
            averageZ += (collision.minZ + collision.maxZ) * 0.5F;
        }
        averageX /= collisions.size();
        averageZ /= collisions.size();

        final float halfWidth = (actor.maxX - actor.minX) * 0.5F;
        final float halfDepth = (actor.maxZ - actor.minZ) * 0.5F;
        final float actorCenterX = (actor.minX + actor.maxX) * 0.5F;
        final float actorCenterZ = (actor.minZ + actor.maxZ) * 0.5F;

        float directionX = actorCenterX - averageX;
        float directionZ = actorCenterZ - averageZ;
        if (Math.abs(directionX) < DIRECTION_EPSILON
                && Math.abs(directionZ) < DIRECTION_EPSILON) {
            directionX = 1.0F;
            directionZ = 1.0F;
        }

        directionX = selectOpenDirectionX(
                directionX,
                averageX,
                averageZ,
                halfWidth,
                halfDepth,
                actor.minY,
                actor.maxY,
                collisions);
        directionZ = selectOpenDirectionZ(
                directionZ,
                averageX,
                averageZ,
                halfWidth,
                halfDepth,
                actor.minY,
                actor.maxY,
                collisions);

        if (Math.abs(directionX) < DIRECTION_EPSILON
                && Math.abs(directionZ) < DIRECTION_EPSILON) {
            return velocity.clone();
        }

        final float length = (float) Math.sqrt(
                directionX * directionX + directionZ * directionZ);
        final float pushX = directionX / length * PUSH_MAGNITUDE;
        final float pushZ = directionZ / length * PUSH_MAGNITUDE;

        final Vec3 delta = velocity.clone();
        delta.x = applyHorizontalPush(delta.x, pushX, length);
        delta.z = applyHorizontalPush(delta.z, pushZ, length);
        return delta;
    }

    private static float selectOpenDirectionX(
            final float direction,
            final float centerX,
            final float centerZ,
            final float halfWidth,
            final float halfDepth,
            final float minY,
            final float maxY,
            final List<Box> collisions) {
        final float sign = Math.signum(direction);
        if (sign == 0.0F) {
            return 0.0F;
        }

        final float baseMinX = centerX - halfWidth;
        final float baseMaxX = centerX + halfWidth;
        final float baseMinZ = centerZ - halfDepth;
        final float baseMaxZ = centerZ + halfDepth;
        final Box forward = new Box(
                baseMinX + sign,
                minY,
                baseMinZ,
                baseMaxX + sign,
                maxY,
                baseMaxZ);
        if (!intersectsAny(forward, collisions)) {
            return direction;
        }

        final Box reverse = new Box(
                baseMinX - sign,
                minY,
                baseMinZ,
                baseMaxX - sign,
                maxY,
                baseMaxZ);
        return intersectsAny(reverse, collisions) ? 0.0F : -direction;
    }

    private static float selectOpenDirectionZ(
            final float direction,
            final float centerX,
            final float centerZ,
            final float halfWidth,
            final float halfDepth,
            final float minY,
            final float maxY,
            final List<Box> collisions) {
        final float sign = Math.signum(direction);
        if (sign == 0.0F) {
            return 0.0F;
        }

        final float baseMinX = centerX - halfWidth;
        final float baseMaxX = centerX + halfWidth;
        final float baseMinZ = centerZ - halfDepth;
        final float baseMaxZ = centerZ + halfDepth;
        final Box forward = new Box(
                baseMinX,
                minY,
                baseMinZ + sign,
                baseMaxX,
                maxY,
                baseMaxZ + sign);
        if (!intersectsAny(forward, collisions)) {
            return direction;
        }

        final Box reverse = new Box(
                baseMinX,
                minY,
                baseMinZ - sign,
                baseMaxX,
                maxY,
                baseMaxZ - sign);
        return intersectsAny(reverse, collisions) ? 0.0F : -direction;
    }

    private static boolean intersectsAny(final Box test, final List<Box> collisions) {
        for (final Box collision : collisions) {
            if (collision.intersects(test)) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static float applyHorizontalPush(
            final float current,
            final float push,
            final float directionLength) {
        final float absolutePush = directionLength < MIN_LENGTH
                ? 0.0F
                : Math.abs(push);
        if (absolutePush <= Math.abs(current)) {
            return current;
        }
        return Math.max(-absolutePush, Math.min(absolutePush, current + push));
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/collision/PlantCollision.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.collision;

import ac.navro.proxy.data.block.NetworkBlockState;
import ac.navro.proxy.data.block.NativePlantProperties;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Box;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;
import org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector3i;
import java.util.List;


public final class PlantCollision {
    private PlantCollision() { }

    public static List<Box> bamboo(final Vector3i position, final NetworkBlockState state) {
        final boolean thick = state.hasProperty("bamboo_stalk_thickness")
                ? "thick".equals(state.stringProperty("bamboo_stalk_thickness", "thin"))
                : NativePlantProperties.bambooThick(state);
        final float max = thick ? 0.6875F : 0.625F;
        return List.of(new Box(0.5F, 0, 0.5F, max, 1, max)
                .offset(horizontalOffset(position, 0.25F)));
    }

    public static List<Box> pointedDripstone(final Vector3i position, final NetworkBlockState state) {
        final String thickness = state.stringProperty("dripstone_thickness",
                NativePlantProperties.dripstoneThickness(state));
        final boolean hanging = state.booleanProperty("hanging",
                NativePlantProperties.dripstoneHanging(state));
        final Box shape = switch (thickness) {
            case "frustum" -> new Box(0.25F, 0, 0.25F, 0.75F, 1, 0.75F);
            case "middle" -> new Box(0.1875F, 0, 0.1875F, 0.8125F, 1, 0.8125F);
            case "base" -> new Box(0.125F, 0, 0.125F, 0.875F, 1, 0.875F);
            case "merge", "tip_merge" -> new Box(0.3125F, 0, 0.3125F, 0.6875F, 1, 0.6875F);
            default -> new Box(0.3125F, hanging ? 0.3125F : 0, 0.3125F,
                    0.6875F, hanging ? 1 : 0.6875F, 0.6875F);
        };
        return List.of(shape.offset(horizontalOffset(position, 0.125F)));
    }

    private static Vec3 horizontalOffset(final Vector3i position, final float limit) {


        long seed = (long) (position.getX() * 3129871) ^ position.getZ() * 116129781L;
        seed = (int) ((seed * (seed * 42317861L + 11L)) >>> 16);
        final OffsetRandom random = new OffsetRandom(seed);
        final float x = quantize(random.nextFloat(), limit);
        random.nextFloat();
        final float z = quantize(random.nextFloat(), limit);
        return new Vec3(x, 0, z);
    }

    private static float quantize(final float value, final float limit) {
        return -limit + (int) (value * 16F) * ((limit + limit) / 15F);
    }


    private static final class OffsetRandom {
        private long low, high;

        private OffsetRandom(final long seed) {
            final long initial = seed ^ 0x6A09E667F3BCC909L;
            low = mix(initial);
            high = mix(initial + 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15L);
            if ((low | high) == 0) {
                low = 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15L;
                high = 0x6A09E667F3BCC909L;
            }
        }

        private float nextFloat() {
            final long value = Long.rotateLeft(low + high, 17) + low;
            final long difference = low ^ high;
            low = Long.rotateLeft(low, 49) ^ difference ^ difference << 21;
            high = Long.rotateLeft(difference, 28);
            return (value >>> 40) * 5.9604645e-08F;
        }

        private static long mix(long value) {
            value = (value ^ value >>> 30) * 0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9L;
            value = (value ^ value >>> 27) * 0x94D049BB133111EBL;
            return value ^ value >>> 31;
        }
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/collision/ProtocolCollisionWorld.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.collision;

import ac.navro.anticheat.collision.CollisionQuery;
import ac.navro.anticheat.collision.ProtocolCollisionSolver;
import ac.navro.anticheat.collision.SweptMovement;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Box;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;
import ac.navro.proxy.compensated.cache.entity.EntityCache;
import ac.navro.proxy.compensated.world.base.CompensatedWorld;

import java.util.List;


public final class ProtocolCollisionWorld {
    private final CompensatedWorld world;
    private final int dimension;
    private final java.util.Map<Long, EntityCache> entities;
    private final long localRuntimeId;
    private final boolean localStackable;
    private final CollisionPhysicsState collisionPhysics;

    public ProtocolCollisionWorld(CompensatedWorld world, int dimension) {
        this(world, dimension, java.util.Map.of());
    }

    public ProtocolCollisionWorld(CompensatedWorld world, int dimension,
                                  java.util.Map<Long, EntityCache> entities) {
        this(world, dimension, entities, -1L);
    }

    public ProtocolCollisionWorld(CompensatedWorld world, int dimension,
                                  java.util.Map<Long, EntityCache> entities,
                                  long localRuntimeId) {
        this(world, dimension, entities, localRuntimeId, false);
    }

    public ProtocolCollisionWorld(CompensatedWorld world, int dimension,
                                  java.util.Map<Long, EntityCache> entities,
                                  long localRuntimeId, boolean localStackable) {
        this(world, dimension, entities, localRuntimeId, localStackable, world.collisionPhysics());
    }

    private ProtocolCollisionWorld(CompensatedWorld world, int dimension,
                                    java.util.Map<Long, EntityCache> entities,
                                    long localRuntimeId, boolean localStackable, CollisionPhysicsState collisionPhysics) {
        this.world = world;
        this.dimension = dimension;
        this.entities = entities;
        this.localRuntimeId = localRuntimeId;
        this.localStackable = localStackable;
        this.collisionPhysics = collisionPhysics;
    }

    public List<Box> collect(Box query) {
        return collect(query, query);
    }

    public List<Box> collect(Box query, Box actor) {
        java.util.ArrayList<Box> result = new java.util.ArrayList<>(blockEntries(query).stream().map(CollisionShapeEntry::shape).toList());
        result.addAll(nearbyEntityShapes(actor));
        return List.copyOf(result);
    }

    public List<Box> collectMovement(Box query, Box actor) {
        java.util.ArrayList<Box> result = new java.util.ArrayList<>(movementEntries(query).stream().map(CollisionShapeEntry::shape).toList());
        result.addAll(nearbyEntityShapes(actor));
        return List.copyOf(result);
    }


    public List<Box> collectColliders(List<Box> entities, Box query) {
        var result = new java.util.ArrayList<>(entities);
        for (var entry : blockEntries(query)) result.add(entry.shape());
        return List.copyOf(result);
    }
    public List<Box> entityCollisions(Box query, Box actor) {
        var result = new java.util.ArrayList<Box>();
        for (Box shape : nearbyEntityShapes(actor)) if (query.expand(1.0E-7F).intersects(shape)) result.add(shape);
        return List.copyOf(result);
    }

    public List<Box> nearbyEntityShapes(Box actor) {
        return EntityCollisionPhysics.nearbyShapes(collisionPhysics.active() ? collisionPhysics.actors()
                : EntityCollisionPhysics.snapshotActors(entities), actor, localRuntimeId, dimension, localStackable);
    }

    public List<CollisionShapeEntry> blockEntries(Box query) {
        return world.collisionEntries(query, dimension, collisionPhysics);
    }
    public List<CollisionShapeEntry> movementEntries(Box query) {
        return world.movementCollisionEntries(query, dimension, collisionPhysics);
    }
    public CollisionPhysicsState collisionPhysics() { return collisionPhysics; }


    public ProtocolCollisionWorld replay(long tick, CollisionPhysicsState.Snapshot saved) {
        CollisionPhysicsState state = new CollisionPhysicsState();
        state.restore(saved);
        state.begin(world, entities, tick, saved);
        return new ProtocolCollisionWorld(world, dimension, entities, localRuntimeId, localStackable, state);
    }

    public CompensatedWorld world() {
        return world;
    }

    public int dimension() {
        return dimension;
    }

    public SweptMovement.MoveResult solve(Box actor, Vec3 movement,
                                          float maxDepenetration, boolean yxz) {
        Vec3 submitted = CollisionQuery.clamp(movement);
        Box query = CollisionQuery.buildCollisionQuery(actor, submitted, 0.5625F);
        return ProtocolCollisionSolver.solve(submitted, actor, collect(query, actor),
                new Vec3(maxDepenetration, maxDepenetration, maxDepenetration), yxz);
    }
}
```

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.collision;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Box;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;
import ac.navro.proxy.compensated.cache.entity.EntityCache;

import java.util.Map;


public final class ProtocolEntityTolerance {
    private ProtocolEntityTolerance() {}

    public static Sample sample(Map<Long, EntityCache> entities, Vec3 verifiedPosition,
                                Box movementBox, long ridingId, boolean riding,
                                boolean enforceBoatStep, float actualY, float baseMotionY) {
        return sample(EntityCollisionPhysics.snapshotActors(entities), verifiedPosition, movementBox,
                ridingId, riding, enforceBoatStep, actualY, baseMotionY);
    }

    public static Sample sample(java.util.List<EntityCollisionPhysics.Actor> actors, Vec3 verifiedPosition,
                                Box movementBox, long ridingId, boolean riding,
                                boolean enforceBoatStep, float actualY, float baseMotionY) {
        var sample = EntityCollisionPhysics.sample(actors, verifiedPosition, movementBox, ridingId,
                riding, enforceBoatStep, actualY, baseMotionY);
        var t = sample.tolerance();
        return new Sample(new Tolerance(t.boat(), t.happyGhast(), t.x(), t.y(), t.z()), sample.enforceBoatStep());
    }

    public static float adjustedMotionOffset(Vec3 predicted, Vec3 actual, Tolerance tolerance) {
        float x=Math.max(0,Math.abs(actual.x-predicted.x)-tolerance.x());
        float y=Math.max(0,Math.abs(actual.y-predicted.y)-tolerance.y());
        float z=Math.max(0,Math.abs(actual.z-predicted.z)-tolerance.z());
        return Math.max(x,Math.max(y,z));
    }

    public static Vec3 clampAccepted(Vec3 predicted, Vec3 client, Tolerance tolerance) {
        if (tolerance == null || !tolerance.collided()) return predicted.clone();
        return new Vec3(predicted.x+clamp(client.x-predicted.x,tolerance.x()),
                predicted.y+clamp(client.y-predicted.y,tolerance.y()),
                predicted.z+clamp(client.z-predicted.z,tolerance.z()));
    }

    private static float clamp(float difference,float allowance) {
        if (!Float.isFinite(difference)) return 0;
        float limit=Math.max(0,allowance);
        return Math.max(-limit,Math.min(limit,difference));
    }

    public record Tolerance(boolean boat,boolean happyGhast,float x,float y,float z) {
        public boolean collided(){return boat||happyGhast;}
    }
    public record Sample(Tolerance tolerance,boolean enforceBoatStep) {}
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/collision/ScaffoldingCollision.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.collision;

import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.live.PredictionContext;

import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.engine.data.VectorType;
import ac.navro.proxy.collision.CollisionShapeEntry;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;
import java.util.Set;


public final class ScaffoldingCollision {
    public static final int DESCEND_THROUGH_BLOCK_FLAG = 71;
    private ScaffoldingCollision() { }


    public static void prepareInput(PredictionContext player) {
        player.scaffoldingSneakDown = player.getInputData().contains(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData.SNEAK_DOWN);
        player.scaffoldingSneaking = player.getInputData().contains(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData.SNEAKING);
        final int oldTicks = player.scaffoldingSneakHoldTicks;
        if (player.inputMode == org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.InputMode.GAMEPAD
                && player.getInputData().contains(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData.SNEAK_TOGGLE_DOWN)) {
            player.scaffoldingSneakHoldTicks = oldTicks + 1;
            if (oldTicks >= 5) {
                player.scaffoldingSneakDown = true;
                player.scaffoldingSneaking = true;
            }
        } else {
            if (oldTicks >= 6) {
                player.scaffoldingSneakDown = false;
                player.scaffoldingSneaking = false;
            }
            player.scaffoldingSneakHoldTicks = 0;
        }
        player.scaffoldDescend = shouldDescend(
                player.getFlagTracker().has("OVER_DESCENDABLE_BLOCK"),
                player.inputMode, player.scaffoldingSneaking,
                player.getInputData().contains(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData.DESCEND_BLOCK),
                player.getInputData().contains(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData.SNEAK_TOGGLE_DOWN),
                player.scaffoldingSneakDown);
        player.getFlagTracker().set(DESCEND_THROUGH_BLOCK_FLAG, player.scaffoldDescend);
    }

    public static Vec3 applyAcceptedDescend(PredictionContext player, Vec3 velocity) {
        if (!player.getFlagTracker().has(DESCEND_THROUGH_BLOCK_FLAG)) return velocity;
        return new Vec3(velocity.x, -0.15F, velocity.z);
    }

    public static boolean shouldDescend(final PredictionContext player) {
        return player.getFlagTracker().has(DESCEND_THROUGH_BLOCK_FLAG);
    }

    static boolean shouldDescend(boolean overDescendable, org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.InputMode mode,
                                 boolean sneaking, Set<org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData> actions) {
        return shouldDescend(overDescendable, mode, sneaking,
                actions.contains(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData.DESCEND_BLOCK),
                actions.contains(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData.SNEAK_TOGGLE_DOWN),
                actions.contains(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData.SNEAK_DOWN));
    }

    private static boolean shouldDescend(boolean overDescendable, org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.InputMode mode,
                                         boolean sneaking, boolean descendBlock,
                                         boolean sneakToggle, boolean sneakDown) {
        if (!overDescendable) return false;
        if (mode == org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.InputMode.MOUSE) return sneaking;

        if (mode == org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.InputMode.TOUCH) return descendBlock;
        if (mode == org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.InputMode.GAMEPAD) return sneaking && sneakToggle && sneakDown;
        return false;
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/collision/ShulkerPushPhysics.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.collision;

import ac.navro.proxy.collision.block.ShulkerCollisionState;
import ac.navro.anticheat.collision.SweptMovement;
import ac.navro.proxy.state.WirePlayerState;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Box;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Direction;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;


public final class ShulkerPushPhysics {
    private ShulkerPushPhysics() { }


    public static void finish(final WirePlayerState player, final ProtocolCollisionWorld world,
                              final boolean trackedVehicle) {
        if (player.isMovementExempted() || trackedVehicle) return;
        for (final ShulkerCollisionState.Frame frame : player.collisionPhysics.shulkers()) {
            final Box actor = player.boundingBox();
            final Box shulker = frame.shape();
            if (frame.openness() == 0 || !shulker.contract(1.0E-6F).intersects(actor)) continue;
            final Direction facing = face(frame.facing());
            final Vec3 outward = axisInside(shulker, actor, facing);
            final Box moved = actor.offset(outward);
            final List<Box> collisions = new ArrayList<>();
            for (final CollisionShapeEntry entry : world.blockEntries(moved)) {
                if (!entry.shape().equals(shulker)) collisions.add(entry.shape());
            }
            final Vec3 request = calculateMovement(actor, shulker, facing, collisions);
            if (request.lengthSquared() == 0) continue;
            final SweptMovement.MoveResult result = Collider.collideBlockPush(player, world,
                    Collider.maybeBackOffFromEdge(player, world, request));
            final Vec3 resolvedPosition = result.aabb.feetCenter();
            final Vec3 applied = resolvedPosition.subtract(player.position());
            player.setResolvedPosition(resolvedPosition, result.aabb, false, trackedVehicle);
            player.setAfterCollision(player.afterCollision().add(applied));
            player.collisionPhysics.addBlockPush(applied);
            final float epsilon = 1.1920929E-7F;
            final boolean horizontalCollision = Math.abs(request.x - result.movement.x) > epsilon
                    || Math.abs(request.z - result.movement.z) > epsilon;
            final boolean verticalCollision = Math.abs(request.y - result.movement.y) > epsilon;
            final boolean onGround = verticalCollision ? request.y < 0
                    : request.y == 0 && player.onGround();
            player.setCollisionResult(horizontalCollision, verticalCollision, onGround);
        }
    }

    public static Vec3 calculateMovement(final Box actor, final Box shulker,
                                         final Direction facing, final List<Box> collisions) {
        if (actor == null || !actor.isValid() || shulker == null || !shulker.isValid()) {
            return Vec3.ZERO.clone();
        }
        final Vec3 outward = axisInside(shulker, actor, facing);
        if (collisions.isEmpty()) return outward;
        if (facing == Direction.UP) return Vec3.ZERO.clone();
        final Box moved = actor.offset(outward);
        Vec3 correction = Vec3.ZERO.clone();
        for (final Box collision : collisions) {
            final Vec3 candidate = axisInside(collision, moved, facing.getOpposite());
            if (candidate.subtract(correction).lengthSquared() > 0) correction = candidate;
        }
        return outward.add(correction);
    }

    static Vec3 axisInside(final Box collider, final Box actor, final Direction axis) {
        return switch (axis) {
            case EAST -> new Vec3(collider.maxX - actor.minX, 0, 0);
            case WEST -> new Vec3(collider.minX - actor.maxX, 0, 0);
            case UP -> new Vec3(0, collider.maxY - actor.minY, 0);
            case DOWN -> new Vec3(0, collider.minY - actor.maxY, 0);
            case SOUTH -> new Vec3(0, 0, collider.maxZ - actor.minZ);
            case NORTH -> new Vec3(0, 0, collider.minZ - actor.maxZ);
        };
    }

    private static Direction face(final int value) {
        return switch (value) {
            case 1 -> Direction.UP;
            case 2 -> Direction.NORTH;
            case 3 -> Direction.SOUTH;
            case 4 -> Direction.WEST;
            case 5 -> Direction.EAST;
            default -> Direction.DOWN;
        };
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/collision/block/PistonArmBlock.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.collision.block;

import ac.navro.proxy.data.block.NetworkBlockState;
import ac.navro.proxy.compensated.world.base.CompensatedWorld;
import ac.navro.proxy.util.NbtNumber;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Box;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Direction;
import org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector3i;
import org.cloudburstmc.nbt.NbtMap;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;


public final class PistonArmBlock {
    private static final float ARM_MIN = 0.3125F;
    private static final float ARM_MAX = 0.6875F;
    private PistonArmBlock() { }

    public static CollisionBoxes _getCollisions(final Direction facingDir) {
        final Direction face = facingDir == null ? Direction.UP : facingDir;
        return switch (face) {
            case NORTH -> new CollisionBoxes(
                    new Box(ARM_MIN, ARM_MIN, 1.0F, ARM_MAX, ARM_MAX, 1.25F),
                    new Box(ARM_MIN, ARM_MIN, 0.25F, ARM_MAX, ARM_MAX, 1.0F),
                    new Box(0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 0.25F));
            case SOUTH -> new CollisionBoxes(
                    new Box(ARM_MIN, ARM_MIN, -0.25F, ARM_MAX, ARM_MAX, 0.0F),
                    new Box(ARM_MIN, ARM_MIN, 0.0F, ARM_MAX, ARM_MAX, 0.75F),
                    new Box(0, 0, 0.75F, 1, 1, 1));
            case WEST -> new CollisionBoxes(
                    new Box(1.0F, ARM_MIN, ARM_MIN, 1.25F, ARM_MAX, ARM_MAX),
                    new Box(0.25F, ARM_MIN, ARM_MIN, 1.0F, ARM_MAX, ARM_MAX),
                    new Box(0, 0, 0, 0.25F, 1, 1));
            case EAST -> new CollisionBoxes(
                    new Box(-0.25F, ARM_MIN, ARM_MIN, 0.0F, ARM_MAX, ARM_MAX),
                    new Box(0.0F, ARM_MIN, ARM_MIN, 0.75F, ARM_MAX, ARM_MAX),
                    new Box(0.75F, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1));
            case DOWN -> new CollisionBoxes(
                    new Box(ARM_MIN, 1.0F, ARM_MIN, ARM_MAX, 1.25F, ARM_MAX),
                    new Box(ARM_MIN, 0.25F, ARM_MIN, ARM_MAX, 1.0F, ARM_MAX),
                    new Box(0, 0, 0, 1, 0.25F, 1));
            default -> new CollisionBoxes(
                    new Box(ARM_MIN, -0.25F, ARM_MIN, ARM_MAX, 0.0F, ARM_MAX),
                    new Box(ARM_MIN, 0.0F, ARM_MIN, ARM_MAX, 0.75F, ARM_MAX),
                    new Box(0, 0.75F, 0, 1, 1, 1));
        };
    }

    public static List<Box> getCollisionShape(final CompensatedWorld world,
                                              final Vector3i pos,
                                              final NetworkBlockState state,
                                              final Direction face) {
        final List<Box> staticShape = _getCollisions(face).asList();
        if (world == null || pos == null || face == null) return staticShape;
        final NbtMap tag = world.getBlockEntityTag(
                pos.getX() - face.getXOffset(), pos.getY() - face.getYOffset(),
                pos.getZ() - face.getZOffset());
        if (tag == null || !tag.containsKey("State")) return staticShape;
        final int pistonState = NbtNumber.getByte(tag, "State");
        if (pistonState == 0) return List.of();
        if (pistonState != 1 && pistonState != 3) return staticShape;
        final String progressKey = pistonState == 1 ? "LastProgress" : "Progress";
        if (!tag.containsKey(progressKey)) return staticShape;
        final float progress = NbtNumber.getFloat(tag, progressKey);
        return Float.isFinite(progress)
                ? animatedLocalCollisionShape(face, Math.max(0, Math.min(1, progress)))
                : staticShape;
    }

    private static List<Box> animatedLocalCollisionShape(final Direction face,
                                                         final float progress) {
        final CollisionBoxes base = _getCollisions(face);
        final ArrayList<Box> result = new ArrayList<>(3);
        if (base.armBaseAABB() != null && base.armBaseAABB().isValid()) {
            result.add(base.armBaseAABB());
        }

        final Box arm = animatedArm(base.armAABB(), face, progress);
        if (arm != null && arm.isValid()) {
            result.add(arm);
        }

        final Box front = base.frontAABB();
        if (front != null && front.isValid()) {
            final float translate = progress - 1.0F;
            result.add(front.offset(
                    translate * face.getXOffset(),
                    translate * face.getYOffset(),
                    translate * face.getZOffset()));
        }
        return List.copyOf(result);
    }

    private static Box animatedArm(final Box arm,
                                   final Direction face,
                                   final float progress) {
        if (arm == null || !arm.isValid()) {
            return Box.invalid();
        }
        final float extension = Math.max(0.0F, progress - 0.25F);
        if (extension <= 1.0E-6F) {
            return Box.invalid();
        }
        return switch (face) {
            case EAST -> new Box(arm.minX, arm.minY, arm.minZ,
                    arm.minX + extension, arm.maxY, arm.maxZ);
            case WEST -> new Box(arm.maxX - extension, arm.minY, arm.minZ,
                    arm.maxX, arm.maxY, arm.maxZ);
            case UP -> new Box(arm.minX, arm.minY, arm.minZ,
                    arm.maxX, arm.minY + extension, arm.maxZ);
            case DOWN -> new Box(arm.minX, arm.maxY - extension, arm.minZ,
                    arm.maxX, arm.maxY, arm.maxZ);
            case SOUTH -> new Box(arm.minX, arm.minY, arm.minZ,
                    arm.maxX, arm.maxY, arm.minZ + extension);
            default -> new Box(arm.minX, arm.minY, arm.maxZ - extension,
                    arm.maxX, arm.maxY, arm.maxZ);
        };
    }

    public record CollisionBoxes(Box armBaseAABB, Box armAABB, Box frontAABB) {
        public List<Box> asList() {
            final ArrayList<Box> result = new ArrayList<>(3);
            if (armBaseAABB != null && armBaseAABB.isValid()) result.add(armBaseAABB);
            if (armAABB != null && armAABB.isValid()) result.add(armAABB);
            if (frontAABB != null && frontAABB.isValid()) result.add(frontAABB);
            return List.copyOf(result);
        }
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/collision/block/ShulkerCollisionState.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.collision.block;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Box;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Direction;
import org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector3i;
import org.cloudburstmc.nbt.NbtMap;


public final class ShulkerCollisionState {
    private final Vector3i position;
    private int facing = 1;
    private boolean open;
    private float openness;
    private Box shape;

    public ShulkerCollisionState(final Vector3i position, final NbtMap tag) {
        this.position = position;
        load(tag);
        calculateBox();
    }

    public void load(final NbtMap tag) {
        if (tag != null && tag.containsKey("facing")) {
            final int value = ac.navro.proxy.util.NbtNumber.getInt(tag, "facing");
            facing = value >= 0 && value <= 5 ? value : 0;
        }
    }

    public void setOpenCount(final int count) { open = count > 0; }
    public Box shape() { return shape; }


    public record Frame(int x, int y, int z, int facing, float openness, Box shape) { }

    public Frame snapshot() {
        return new Frame(position.getX(), position.getY(), position.getZ(), facing, openness, shape);
    }

    public void tick() {

        calculateBox();
        openness = open ? Math.min(1, openness + 0.05F) : Math.max(0, openness - 0.05F);
    }

    private void calculateBox() {
        final float inverse = 1.0F - openness;
        final float extension = 0.5F * (1.0F - inverse * inverse * inverse);
        float minX = position.getX(), minY = position.getY(), minZ = position.getZ();
        float maxX = minX + 1, maxY = minY + 1, maxZ = minZ + 1;
        switch (face()) {
            case DOWN -> minY -= extension;
            case UP -> maxY += extension;
            case NORTH -> minZ -= extension;
            case SOUTH -> maxZ += extension;
            case WEST -> minX -= extension;
            case EAST -> maxX += extension;
        }
        shape = new Box(minX, minY, minZ, maxX, maxY, maxZ);
    }

    private Direction face() {
        return switch (facing) {
            case 1 -> Direction.UP;
            case 2 -> Direction.NORTH;
            case 3 -> Direction.SOUTH;
            case 4 -> Direction.WEST;
            case 5 -> Direction.EAST;
            default -> Direction.DOWN;
        };
    }
}
```
