`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/command/CommandArguments.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.command;
import java.util.ArrayList;


public final class CommandArguments {
    private CommandArguments() { }
    public static ArrayList<String> parseArguments(String cmdLine) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(cmdLine);
        ArrayList<String> args = new ArrayList<>();
        boolean notQuoted = true;
        int curlyBraceCount = 0;
        int start = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < sb.length(); i++) {
            if ((sb.charAt(i) == '{' && curlyBraceCount >= 1) || (sb.charAt(i) == '{' && (i == 0 || sb.charAt(i - 1) == ' ') && curlyBraceCount == 0)) {
                curlyBraceCount++;
            } else if (sb.charAt(i) == '}' && curlyBraceCount > 0) {
                curlyBraceCount--;
                if (curlyBraceCount == 0) {
                    args.add(sb.substring(start, i + 1));
                    start = i + 1;
                }
            }
            if (curlyBraceCount == 0) {
                if (sb.charAt(i) == ' ' && notQuoted) {
                    String arg = sb.substring(start, i);
                    if (!arg.isEmpty()) {
                        args.add(arg);
                    }
                    start = i + 1;
                } else if (sb.charAt(i) == '"') {
                    sb.deleteCharAt(i);
                    --i;
                    notQuoted = !notQuoted;
                }
            }
        }

        String arg = sb.substring(start);
        if (!arg.isEmpty()) {
            args.add(arg);
        }
        return args;
    }

}
```

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.command;

import ac.navro.proxy.SessionState;
import ac.navro.proxy.config.*;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;


public final class CommandRuntime {
    public record Target(UUID identity,SessionState state) { }
    private final Map<UUID,Target> targets=new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final Path configFile;
    private CheckConfig defaults;
    private volatile RuntimeConfiguration settings;
    private final Map<SessionState,PunishmentTracker> punishments=new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final java.util.function.LongSupplier clock;
    public CommandRuntime(Path file, boolean smooth, long maxBalance) {
        this(file,smooth,maxBalance,System::currentTimeMillis);
    }
    public CommandRuntime(Path file, boolean smooth, long maxBalance,java.util.function.LongSupplier clock) {
        this.clock=clock;configFile=file;defaults=CheckConfig.defaults(smooth,maxBalance);
        settings=new RuntimeConfiguration(defaults,MessageConfig.defaults(defaults.prefix()),PunishmentConfig.defaults());
        try { settings=ConfigLoader.loadAll(configFile,defaults); }
        catch(java.io.IOException e) { System.err.println(e.getMessage()); }
    }
    public CheckConfig config() { return settings.checks(); }
    public MessageConfig messages() { return settings.messages(); }
    public String message(String key,Map<String,?> values){return settings.messages().format(key,values);}
    public void useStartupDefaults(boolean smooth,long maxBalance) {
        defaults=CheckConfig.defaults(smooth,maxBalance);
        try { settings=ConfigLoader.loadAll(configFile,defaults); }
        catch(java.io.IOException e) { System.err.println(e.getMessage()); }
    }
    public String reload() throws java.io.IOException {
        RuntimeConfiguration loaded=ConfigLoader.loadAll(configFile,defaults);settings=loaded;return loaded.checks().toString();
    }
    public void violation(SessionState session,ac.navro.proxy.check.api.CheckViolation violation) {
        RuntimeConfiguration snapshot=settings;
        var values=new HashMap<String,Object>();
        values.put("player",session.player().getName());values.put("check_name",violation.displayName());
        values.put("check",violation.key());values.put("check_vl",violation.checkVl());
        values.put("experimental",violation.experimental()?" (Experimental)":"");
        values.put("verbose",violation.verbose());values.put("message",violation.legacyMessage());
        punishments.computeIfAbsent(session,ignored->new PunishmentTracker()).record(snapshot,violation,clock.getAsLong(),(command,count)->{
            values.put("vl",count);
            switch(command.action()) {
                case ALERT -> session.player().formattedAlert(snapshot.messages().format("alerts-format",values));
                case LOG -> session.player().punishmentLog(snapshot.messages().format("alerts-format",values));
                case KICK -> session.player().requestDisconnect(command.text().isBlank()
                        ?snapshot.messages().format("kick-message",values):snapshot.messages().render(command.text(),values));
            }
        });
    }
    public void attach(UUID id,SessionState state) {
        targets.put(id,new Target(id,state));
        state.setCommandRuntime(this);
    }
    public void detach(UUID id,SessionState state) {
        boolean removed=targets.remove(id,new Target(id,state));state.clearDebugSubscriptions();
        punishments.remove(state);
        if(!removed)return;

        targets.values().forEach(t->t.state().removeDebugSubscriber(id));
    }
    public Target find(String name) {
        return targets.values().stream().filter(t->t.state().player().getName().equalsIgnoreCase(name)).findFirst().orElse(null);
    }
}
```

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.command;

import ac.navro.proxy.alert.AlertManager;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.UUID;


public final class ConsoleCommands {
    private ConsoleCommands() { }
    public static void start(CommandRuntime runtime,AlertManager alerts) {
        var sender=new NavroCommand.Sender() {
            public UUID identity(){return AlertManager.CONSOLE_UUID;}
            public boolean hasPermission(String node){return true;}
            public void sendMessage(String text){System.out.println(text);}
            public boolean isPlayer(){return false;}
        };
        Thread thread=new Thread(()-> {
            try(var input=new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in,StandardCharsets.UTF_8))) {
                for(String line;(line=input.readLine())!=null;) NavroCommand.handle(line,sender,alerts,runtime);
            } catch(IOException e) { System.err.println("Console command input closed: "+e.getMessage()); }
        },"navro-console-commands");
        thread.setDaemon(true);thread.start();
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/command/NavroCommand.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.command;

import ac.navro.proxy.alert.AlertManager;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.command.*;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.AvailableCommandsPacket;
import java.util.*;


public final class NavroCommand {
    public static final Set<String> NAMES = Set.of("navro", "navro:navro");
    private NavroCommand() { }
    public interface Sender {
        UUID identity();
        boolean hasPermission(String node);
        void sendMessage(String message);
        default boolean isPlayer() { return !AlertManager.CONSOLE_UUID.equals(identity()); }
        default String name() { return ""; }
    }
    public static Set<String> advertise(AvailableCommandsPacket packet) {

        packet.getCommands().removeIf(c->"navro".equalsIgnoreCase(c.getName()));
        var subcommand=new CommandParamData();subcommand.setName("subcommand");subcommand.setOptional(true);
        var values=new LinkedHashMap<String,Set<CommandEnumConstraint>>();
        for(String name:List.of("alert","reload","debug","debug2"))values.put(name,Set.of());
        subcommand.setEnumData(new CommandEnumData("NavroSubcommand",values,false));
        var player=new CommandParamData();player.setName("player");player.setType(CommandParam.STRING);player.setOptional(true);
        packet.getCommands().add(new CommandData("navro","Navro anticheat management",Set.of(),
                CommandPermission.ANY,null,List.of(),new CommandOverloadData[]{
                new CommandOverloadData(false,new CommandParamData[]{subcommand,player})}));
        return NAMES;
    }

    public static Set<String> unclaimedNames(AvailableCommandsPacket packet) {
        var proxyNames = new HashSet<>(NAMES);
        for (var command : packet.getCommands()) {
            proxyNames.remove(command.getName().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT));
            var aliases = command.getAliases();
            if (aliases != null) aliases.getValues().keySet().forEach(alias -> proxyNames.remove(alias.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)));
        }
        return Set.copyOf(proxyNames);
    }
    public static boolean handle(String command,Sender sender,AlertManager manager,CommandRuntime runtime) {
        return handle(command, sender, manager, runtime, NAMES);
    }

    public static boolean handle(String command,Sender sender,AlertManager manager,CommandRuntime runtime,Set<String> names) {
        if(command==null)return false;
        var args=CommandArguments.parseArguments(command.startsWith("/")?command.substring(1):command);
        if(args.isEmpty()||!names.contains(args.get(0).toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)))return false;
        args.remove(0);
        if(args.isEmpty()){usage(sender,manager,runtime);return true;}
        String sub=args.get(0);
        if("alert".equalsIgnoreCase(sub)) {
            if(!permission(sender,"navro.alert",manager,runtime))return true;
            boolean enabled=!manager.hasAlert(sender.identity());
            if(!manager.setAlert(sender.identity(),enabled))reply(sender,manager,runtime,"alerts-save-failed",Map.of());
            else reply(sender,manager,runtime,enabled?"alerts-enabled":"alerts-disabled",Map.of());
            return true;
        }
        if("reload".equalsIgnoreCase(sub)) {
            if(!permission(sender,"navro.reload",manager,runtime))return true;
            try { String config=runtime.reload();reply(sender,manager,runtime,"reloaded",Map.of("config",config)); }
            catch(java.io.IOException e) { reply(sender,manager,runtime,"reload-failed",Map.of("error",e.getMessage())); }
            return true;
        }
        if("debug".equalsIgnoreCase(sub)||"debug2".equalsIgnoreCase(sub)) {
            if(!permission(sender,"navro.debug",manager,runtime))return true;
            boolean second="debug2".equalsIgnoreCase(sub);String mode=second?"debug2":"debug";
            if(args.size()<2&&(!second||!sender.isPlayer())) {
                reply(sender,manager,runtime,"usage",Map.of("usage",mode+" <player>"));return true;
            }
            String name=args.size()>=2?args.get(1):sender.name();var target=runtime.find(name);
            if(target==null){reply(sender,manager,runtime,"player-not-found",Map.of());return true;}
            boolean enabled=target.state().toggleDebugSubscriber(second,sender.identity(),sender::sendMessage);
            reply(sender,manager,runtime,enabled?"debug-enabled":"debug-disabled",Map.of("mode",mode,"player",target.state().player().getName()));
            return true;
        }
        reply(sender,manager,runtime,"unknown-subcommand",Map.of());usage(sender,manager,runtime);return true;
    }
    private static boolean permission(Sender sender,String node,AlertManager manager,CommandRuntime runtime) {
        if(sender.hasPermission(node))return true;
        reply(sender,manager,runtime,"no-permission",Map.of());return false;
    }
    private static void usage(Sender sender,AlertManager manager,CommandRuntime runtime) {
        for(String line:List.of("alert","reload","debug <player>","debug2 [player]"))
            reply(sender,manager,runtime,"usage",Map.of("usage",line));
    }
    private static void reply(Sender sender,AlertManager manager,CommandRuntime runtime,String key,Map<String,?> values) {
        sender.sendMessage(runtime==null?ac.navro.proxy.config.MessageConfig.defaults(manager.getPrefix()).format(key,values)
                :runtime.message(key,values));
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/command/PunishmentTracker.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.command;

import ac.navro.proxy.check.api.CheckViolation;
import ac.navro.proxy.config.PunishmentConfig;
import ac.navro.proxy.config.RuntimeConfiguration;
import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.function.BiConsumer;

final class PunishmentTracker {
    private static final class Window {
        final ArrayDeque<Long> violations=new ArrayDeque<>();
        final Set<Integer> executed=new HashSet<>();
        final Map<Integer,Long> lastExecution=new HashMap<>();
        long sequence;
    }
    private RuntimeConfiguration current;
    private final Map<String,Window> windows=new HashMap<>();
    void record(RuntimeConfiguration settings,CheckViolation violation,long now,
                BiConsumer<PunishmentConfig.Command,Integer> execute) {
        if(current!=settings){windows.clear();current=settings;}
        for(var group:settings.punishments().groups()) {
            if(!group.matches(violation.key(),violation.baseName(),violation.displayName()))continue;
            Window window=windows.computeIfAbsent(group.name(),ignored->new Window());
            while(!window.violations.isEmpty() && now-window.violations.peekFirst()>=group.windowMillis())window.violations.removeFirst();
            if(window.violations.isEmpty()){window.executed.clear();window.lastExecution.clear();window.sequence=0;}
            window.violations.addLast(now);
            window.sequence++;
            int count=window.violations.size();
            for(int index=0;index<group.commands().size();index++) {
                var command=group.commands().get(index);
                if(count<command.threshold())continue;
                if(command.interval()==0) {
                    if(!window.executed.add(index))continue;
                } else {
                    Long previous=window.lastExecution.get(index);
                    if(previous!=null && window.sequence-previous<command.interval())continue;
                    window.lastExecution.put(index,window.sequence);
                }
                execute.accept(command,count);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/compensated/BackendInventorySnapshots.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.compensated;

import ac.navro.proxy.compensated.cache.container.ContainerCache;
import ac.navro.proxy.util.ItemUtil;

import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.ItemData;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.*;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;


public final class BackendInventorySnapshots {
    private record SlotKey(int containerId, int slot) {}

    private final Map<Integer, Map<Integer, ItemData>> containers = new HashMap<>();
    private final Set<Integer> completeContainers = new HashSet<>();
    private final Set<SlotKey> invalidatedSlots = new HashSet<>();
    private final Map<Integer, InventoryContentPacket> templates = new HashMap<>();
    private final Map<SlotKey, Long> fullSlotRevisions = new HashMap<>();
    private final Map<Integer, Long> fullContainerRevisions = new HashMap<>();
    private long generation;
    private long wireRevision;

    public long generation() {
        return generation;
    }

    public void observe(BedrockPacket packet) {
        if (packet instanceof StartGamePacket || packet instanceof ChangeDimensionPacket) {
            resetForNewWorld();
        } else if (packet instanceof ContainerOpenPacket open) {
            forgetDynamicContainer(Byte.toUnsignedInt(open.getId()));
        } else if (packet instanceof ContainerClosePacket close && close.getId() != -1) {
            forgetDynamicContainer(Byte.toUnsignedInt(close.getId()));
        } else if (packet instanceof InventoryContentPacket content) {
            observeContent(content);
        } else if (packet instanceof InventorySlotPacket slot) {
            observeSlot(slot);
        }
    }

    private void resetForNewWorld() {
        generation++;
        containers.clear();
        completeContainers.clear();
        invalidatedSlots.clear();
        templates.clear();
        fullSlotRevisions.clear();
        fullContainerRevisions.clear();
    }

    private void forgetDynamicContainer(int containerId) {
        if (isPlayerContainer(containerId)) return;
        containers.remove(containerId);
        completeContainers.remove(containerId);
        templates.remove(containerId);
        fullContainerRevisions.remove(containerId);
        fullSlotRevisions.keySet().removeIf(key -> key.containerId() == containerId);
        invalidatedSlots.removeIf(key -> key.containerId() == containerId);
    }

    private static boolean isPlayerContainer(int containerId) {
        return containerId == 0 || containerId == 119 || containerId == 120 || containerId == 124;
    }

    void forgetWindowUi() {
        int containerId = ContainerCache.UI;
        var slots = containers.get(containerId);
        if (slots != null) slots.keySet().removeIf(slot -> slot != 0);
        invalidatedSlots.removeIf(key -> key.containerId() == containerId && key.slot() != 0);
        completeContainers.remove(containerId);
        templates.remove(containerId);
        fullContainerRevisions.remove(containerId);
        fullSlotRevisions.keySet().removeIf(key -> key.containerId() == containerId && key.slot() != 0);
    }

    private void observeContent(InventoryContentPacket content) {
        if (content.getContents() == null) return;

        int containerId = content.getContainerId();
        Map<Integer, ItemData> snapshot = new HashMap<>();
        for (int slot = 0; slot < content.getContents().size(); slot++) {
            snapshot.put(slot, ItemUtil.copy(content.getContents().get(slot)));
        }

        containers.put(containerId, snapshot);
        fullContainerRevisions.put(containerId, ++wireRevision);
        fullSlotRevisions.keySet().removeIf(key -> key.containerId() == containerId);
        completeContainers.add(containerId);
        invalidatedSlots.removeIf(key -> key.containerId() == containerId);

        InventoryContentPacket template = content.clone();
        template.setContents(new ArrayList<>(contents(containerId)));
        template.setStorageItem(ItemUtil.copy(content.getStorageItem()));
        templates.put(containerId, template);
    }

    private void observeSlot(InventorySlotPacket packet) {
        int containerId = packet.getContainerId();
        int slot = packet.getSlot();
        containers
                .computeIfAbsent(containerId, ignored -> new HashMap<>())
                .put(slot, ItemUtil.copy(packet.getItem()));
        var key = new SlotKey(containerId, slot);
        invalidatedSlots.remove(key);
        fullSlotRevisions.put(key, ++wireRevision);
    }

    void confirmSlot(int containerId, int slot, ItemData item) {
        containers.computeIfAbsent(containerId, ignored -> new HashMap<>()).put(slot, ItemUtil.copy(item));
        invalidatedSlots.remove(new SlotKey(containerId, slot));
    }

    long wireRevision() {
        return wireRevision;
    }

    long fullRevision(int containerId, int slot) {
        return Math.max(fullContainerRevisions.getOrDefault(containerId, 0L),
                fullSlotRevisions.getOrDefault(new SlotKey(containerId, slot), 0L));
    }



    ItemData lastKnownSlot(int containerId, int slot) {
        var items = containers.get(containerId);
        return items == null || !items.containsKey(slot) ? null : ItemUtil.copy(items.get(slot));
    }

    public ItemData slot(int containerId, int slot) {
        if (invalidatedSlots.contains(new SlotKey(containerId, slot))) return null;
        Map<Integer, ItemData> contents = containers.get(containerId);
        if (contents == null || !contents.containsKey(slot)) return null;
        return ItemUtil.copy(contents.get(slot));
    }

    public List<ItemData> contents(int containerId) {
        if (!completeContainers.contains(containerId) || hasInvalidatedSlots(containerId))
            return null;
        Map<Integer, ItemData> contents = containers.get(containerId);
        if (contents == null) return null;

        List<ItemData> ordered = new ArrayList<>(contents.size());
        for (int slot = 0; slot < contents.size(); slot++) {
            ItemData item = contents.get(slot);
            if (item == null) return null;
            ordered.add(ItemUtil.copy(item));
        }
        return List.copyOf(ordered);
    }

    private boolean hasInvalidatedSlots(int containerId) {
        return invalidatedSlots.stream().anyMatch(key -> key.containerId() == containerId);
    }

    public InventoryContentPacket fullPacket(int containerId) {
        List<ItemData> contents = contents(containerId);
        InventoryContentPacket template = templates.get(containerId);
        if (contents == null || template == null) return null;

        InventoryContentPacket packet = template.clone();
        packet.setContents(contents);
        packet.setStorageItem(ItemUtil.copy(template.getStorageItem()));
        return packet;
    }

    public void markPending(int containerId, int slot) {
        invalidatedSlots.add(new SlotKey(containerId, slot));
    }

    public boolean pending(int containerId, int slot) {
        return invalidatedSlots.contains(new SlotKey(containerId, slot));
    }


    public void markAllPending() {
        containers.forEach(
                (containerId, slots) ->
                        slots.keySet().forEach(slot -> markPending(containerId, slot)));
    }
}
```

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.compensated;

import ac.navro.proxy.compensated.cache.container.ContainerCache;
import ac.navro.proxy.compensated.cache.container.impl.ArmorContainerCache;
import ac.navro.proxy.compensated.cache.container.impl.PlayerContainerCache;
import ac.navro.proxy.data.inventory.ItemCache;
import ac.navro.proxy.data.inventory.NativeItemDecoder;
import ac.navro.proxy.data.inventory.NativePredictionItems;
import ac.navro.proxy.util.ItemUtil;
import ac.navro.proxy.inventory.InventoryType;
import ac.navro.proxy.state.WirePlayerState;
import org.cloudburstmc.nbt.NbtMap;
import org.cloudburstmc.nbt.NbtType;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.ItemData;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.crafting.PotionMixData;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.crafting.recipe.RecipeData;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public class CompensatedInventory {
    private final WirePlayerState player;
    private boolean nativeItemDecoding;
    private Map<Integer, RecipeData> craftingData = new HashMap<>();
    private Map<Integer, ItemData> creativeData = new HashMap<>();
    private List<PotionMixData> potionMixData = new ArrayList<>();
    public int heldItemSlot;
    public final PlayerContainerCache inventoryContainer = new PlayerContainerCache(this);
    public final ContainerCache offhandContainer = new ContainerCache(this, ContainerCache.OFFHAND, InventoryType.PLAYER, null, -1L);
    public final ContainerCache armorContainer = new ArmorContainerCache(this);
    public final ContainerCache hudContainer = new ContainerCache(this, ContainerCache.UI, InventoryType.PLAYER, null, -1L);
    public ContainerCache openContainer;
    private final Map<Integer, ItemCache> bundleCache = new HashMap<>();

    public CompensatedInventory(WirePlayerState player) { this.player = player; }
    public WirePlayerState getPlayer() { return player; }

    public void setNativeItemDecoding(boolean enabled) { nativeItemDecoding = enabled; }
    public ItemData nativeItem(ItemData item) { return nativeItem(item, NativeItemDecoder.Format.INVENTORY); }
    public ItemData nativeItem(ItemData item, NativeItemDecoder.Format format) {
        return nativeItemDecoding ? NativeItemDecoder.decode(player.protocolVersion(), item, format) : item;
    }
    public boolean nativeIsNull(ItemData item) { return nativeIsNull(item, NativeItemDecoder.Format.INVENTORY); }
    public boolean nativeIsNull(ItemData item, NativeItemDecoder.Format format) {
        if (item == null || item.getCount() <= 0) return true;
        return nativeItemDecoding
                ? NativePredictionItems.resolve(player.protocolVersion(), nativeItem(item, format)).positiveNull()
                : item.isNull();
    }
    public boolean sameDefinition(ItemData predicted, ItemData claimed) {
        return sameDefinition(predicted, claimed, NativeItemDecoder.Format.INVENTORY);
    }
    public boolean sameDefinition(ItemData predicted, ItemData claimed, NativeItemDecoder.Format claimedFormat) {
        return ItemUtil.sameDefinition(nativeItem(predicted), nativeItem(claimed, claimedFormat));
    }
    public Map<Integer, RecipeData> getCraftingData() { return craftingData; }
    public void setCraftingData(Map<Integer, RecipeData> value) { craftingData = value; }
    public Map<Integer, ItemData> getCreativeData() { return creativeData; }
    public void setCreativeData(Map<Integer, ItemData> value) { creativeData = value; }
    public List<PotionMixData> getPotionMixData() { return potionMixData; }
    public void setPotionMixData(List<PotionMixData> value) { potionMixData = value; }
    public Map<Integer, ItemCache> getBundleCache() { return bundleCache; }

    public ContainerCache getContainer(byte id) {
        if (id == inventoryContainer.getId()) return inventoryContainer;
        if (id == offhandContainer.getId()) return offhandContainer;
        if (id == armorContainer.getId()) return armorContainer;
        if (id == hudContainer.getId()) return hudContainer;
        if (openContainer != null && id == openContainer.getId()) return openContainer;
        return null;
    }


    public static Map<Integer, Integer> getEnchantments(ItemData data) {
        if (data == null || data.getTag() == null || !data.getTag().containsKey("ench")) return Map.of();
        Map<Integer, Integer> result = new HashMap<>();
        for (NbtMap enchantment : data.getTag().getList("ench", NbtType.COMPOUND)) {
            if (!enchantment.containsKey("id") || !enchantment.containsKey("lvl")) continue;
            result.put((int) ac.navro.proxy.util.NbtNumber.getShort(enchantment, "id"),
                    (int) ac.navro.proxy.util.NbtNumber.getShort(enchantment, "lvl"));
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static int getEnchantmentLevel(ItemData data, int enchantmentId) {
        if (data == null || data.isNull()) return 0;

        if (data.getTag() != null) {
            for (NbtMap enchantment : data.getTag().getList("ench", NbtType.COMPOUND)) {
                if (ac.navro.proxy.util.NbtNumber.getShort(enchantment, "id") == (short) (enchantmentId & 0xffff)) {
                    int nativeLevel = ac.navro.proxy.util.NbtNumber.getShort(enchantment, "lvl");
                    if (nativeLevel > 0) return nativeLevel;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        return getEnchantments(data).getOrDefault(enchantmentId, 0);
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/compensated/InventoryResponseSync.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.compensated;

import ac.navro.proxy.SessionState;
import ac.navro.proxy.compensated.cache.container.ContainerCache;
import ac.navro.proxy.data.inventory.ItemCache;
import ac.navro.proxy.data.vanilla.GameType;
import ac.navro.proxy.util.ItemUtil;
import ac.navro.proxy.inventory.InventoryType;

import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.ContainerSlotType;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.FullContainerName;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.ItemData;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.itemstack.request.ItemStackRequest;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.itemstack.request.ItemStackRequestSlotData;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.itemstack.request.action.*;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.itemstack.response.ItemStackResponseContainer;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.itemstack.response.ItemStackResponseSlot;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.itemstack.response.ItemStackResponseStatus;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.*;

import java.util.Collection;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;


public final class InventoryResponseSync {
    public record PendingSlot(
            int requestId,
            ContainerSlotType type,
            int slot,
            int count,
            int stackId,
            String customName,
            int durabilityCorrection,
            String filteredCustomName) {}

    private record PendingKey(ContainerSlotType container, ContainerSlot address) {}

    private record ContainerSlot(int containerId, int slot) {}

    private record Request(long world, long window, long wireRevision, long sequence,
                           ItemStackRequestAction[] actions, Map<ContainerSlot, ItemData> before,
                           Map<Integer, ItemData> creativeItems) {}

    private record SlotResult(int requestId, long sequence, long fullRevision) {}

    private final SessionState state;
    private final LinkedHashMap<Integer, Request> requests = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    private final Map<ContainerSlot, SlotResult> slotResults = new HashMap<>();
    private long requestSequence;
    private final Map<PendingKey, PendingSlot> pendingSlots = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    private long windowGeneration;
    private int openWindow = -1;
    private InventoryType openWindowType;

    public InventoryResponseSync(SessionState state) {
        this.state = state;
    }

    public void receive(ItemStackRequestPacket packet) {
        packet.getRequests().forEach(this::receive);
    }

    public void receive(PlayerAuthInputPacket packet) {
        if (packet.getItemStackRequest() != null) receive(packet.getItemStackRequest());
    }

    private void receive(ItemStackRequest request) {
        if (requests.containsKey(request.getRequestId())) return;
        if (requests.size() >= 256) requests.pollFirstEntry();
        var actions = request.getActions();
        if (actions == null || actions.length > 64) actions = new ItemStackRequestAction[0];
        var before = new HashMap<ContainerSlot, ItemData>();
        var creativeItems = new HashMap<Integer, ItemData>();
        for (var action : actions) {
            if (action instanceof TransferItemStackRequestAction transfer) {
                capture(before, transfer.getSource());
                capture(before, transfer.getDestination());
            } else if (action instanceof SwapAction swap) {
                capture(before, swap.getSource());
                capture(before, swap.getDestination());
            } else if (action instanceof DropAction drop) {
                capture(before, drop.getSource());
            } else if (action instanceof DestroyAction destroy) {
                capture(before, destroy.getSource());
            } else if (action instanceof CraftCreativeAction creative && state.player().gameType() == GameType.CREATIVE) {
                int id = creative.getCreativeItemNetworkId();
                ItemData item = state.inventory().getCreativeData().get(id);
                if (item != null) creativeItems.put(id, ItemUtil.copy(item));
            }
        }
        requests.put(request.getRequestId(), new Request(state.backendInventories().generation(),
                windowGeneration, state.backendInventories().wireRevision(), ++requestSequence,
                actions.clone(), before, creativeItems));
    }

    private void capture(Map<ContainerSlot, ItemData> before, ItemStackRequestSlotData ref) {
        ContainerSlot slot = requestSlot(ref);
        if (slot == null || isUnresolved(slot)) return;
        ItemData item = state.backendInventories().lastKnownSlot(slot.containerId(), slot.slot());
        if (item != null) before.put(slot, item);
    }

    private boolean isUnresolved(ContainerSlot slot) {
        return pendingSlots.keySet().stream().anyMatch(key -> key.address().equals(slot));
    }

    private ContainerSlot requestSlot(ItemStackRequestSlotData ref) {
        if (ref == null) return null;
        var name = ref.getContainerName();
        var type = name != null ? name.getContainer() : ref.getContainer();
        if (!isTrackable(type, name) || isWindowScoped(type)) return null;
        int container = containerId(type), slot = physicalSlot(type, ref.getSlot());
        var cache = state.inventory().getContainer((byte) container);
        if (cache == null || slot < cache.getOffset() || slot >= cache.getContainerSize()) return null;
        return new ContainerSlot(container, slot);
    }

    private static boolean createdOutput(ItemStackRequestSlotData ref) {
        if (ref == null) return false;
        var name = ref.getContainerName();
        return (name != null ? name.getContainer() : ref.getContainer()) == ContainerSlotType.CREATED_OUTPUT
                && (name == null || name.getDynamicId() == null)
                && ref.getSlot() == 50;
    }



    private Map<ContainerSlot, ItemData> replay(Request request) {
        if (request == null) return Map.of();
        var working = new HashMap<ContainerSlot, ItemData>();
        ItemData creativeOutput = null;
        for (var action : request.actions()) {
            if (action instanceof CraftCreativeAction creative) {
                creativeOutput = request.creativeItems().get(creative.getCreativeItemNetworkId());
                if (creativeOutput == null || creativeOutput.isNull()) return Map.of();
                continue;
            }
            if (action instanceof CraftResultsDeprecatedAction && creativeOutput != null) continue;
            if (action instanceof SwapAction swap) {
                var source = requestSlot(swap.getSource());
                var destination = requestSlot(swap.getDestination());
                if (source == null || destination == null || source.equals(destination)) return Map.of();
                var from = read(request, working, source, swap.getSource().getStackNetworkId());
                var to = read(request, working, destination, swap.getDestination().getStackNetworkId());
                if (from == null || to == null) return Map.of();
                working.put(source, to);
                working.put(destination, from);
                continue;
            }
            if (action instanceof TransferItemStackRequestAction transfer
                    && (action instanceof TakeAction || action instanceof PlaceAction)) {
                int count = transfer.getCount();
                boolean creative = createdOutput(transfer.getSource());
                var source = requestSlot(transfer.getSource());
                var destination = requestSlot(transfer.getDestination());
                if (count <= 0 || destination == null || destination.equals(source)) return Map.of();
                var from = creative ? creativeOutput : read(request, working, source,
                        transfer.getSource().getStackNetworkId());
                var to = read(request, working, destination, transfer.getDestination().getStackNetworkId());
                if (from == null || from.isNull() || to == null || (!creative && count > from.getCount())) return Map.of();
                if (!to.isNull() && !sameStackKind(from, to)) return Map.of();
                if (!creative) working.put(source, withCount(from, from.getCount() - count));
                working.put(destination, withCount(to.isNull() ? from : to, to.getCount() + count));
                continue;
            }
            ItemStackRequestSlotData sourceRef;
            int count;
            if (action instanceof DropAction drop) {
                sourceRef = drop.getSource();
                count = drop.getCount();
            } else if (action instanceof DestroyAction destroy) {
                sourceRef = destroy.getSource();
                count = destroy.getCount();
            } else {
                return Map.of();
            }
            var source = requestSlot(sourceRef);
            if (source == null) return Map.of();
            var item = read(request, working, source, sourceRef.getStackNetworkId());
            if (item == null || count <= 0 || count > item.getCount()) return Map.of();
            working.put(source, withCount(item, item.getCount() - count));
        }
        return working;
    }

    private ItemData read(Request request, Map<ContainerSlot, ItemData> working,
                          ContainerSlot slot, int stackId) {
        if (slot == null) return null;
        var result = slotResults.get(slot);
        if (result != null && result.sequence() > request.sequence()) return null;
        if (working.containsKey(slot)) {
            var item = working.get(slot);
            return stackId <= 0 || item.getNetId() == stackId ? item : null;
        }
        var backend = state.backendInventories();
        var known = backend.lastKnownSlot(slot.containerId(), slot.slot());
        if (result != null && result.fullRevision() == backend.fullRevision(slot.containerId(), slot.slot())
                && result.sequence() < request.sequence()) {
            if (!isUnresolved(slot)
                    && (stackId < 0 ? stackId == result.requestId() : matchesStack(known, stackId))) {
                return known;
            }
            return null;
        }
        var before = request.before().get(slot);
        if (matchesStack(before, stackId)) return before;


        if (stackId == 0 && before == null && known == null && slot.containerId() == ContainerCache.UI
                && slot.slot() == 0 && !isUnresolved(slot)) return ItemData.AIR;
        return null;
    }

    private static boolean matchesStack(ItemData item, int stackId) {
        return item != null && (item.isNull() ? stackId == 0 : stackId > 0 && item.getNetId() == stackId);
    }

    private static boolean sameStackKind(ItemData first, ItemData second) {
        return first.toBuilder().count(1).netId(0).usingNetId(false).build().equals(
                second.toBuilder().count(1).netId(0).usingNetId(false).build());
    }

    private static ItemData withCount(ItemData item, int count) {
        return count == 0 ? ItemData.AIR : item.toBuilder().count(count).build();
    }

    private static boolean matchesResponse(ItemData item, ItemStackResponseSlot slot) {
        if (item == null || item.getCount() != slot.getCount()) return false;
        return matchesStack(item, slot.getStackNetworkId());
    }

    private static boolean confirmsIdentity(ItemData item, ItemStackResponseSlot slot) {
        if (item == null || item.isNull() || slot.getStackNetworkId() <= 0 || item.getCount() != slot.getCount()) {
            return false;
        }
        var tag = item.getTag();
        String name = tag != null && tag.get("display") instanceof org.cloudburstmc.nbt.NbtMap display
                ? display.getString("Name", "") : "";
        if (slot.getCustomName() != null && !slot.getCustomName().isEmpty() && !slot.getCustomName().equals(name)) {
            return false;
        }
        return slot.getDurabilityCorrection() == 0 || slot.getDurabilityCorrection() == item.getDamage()
                || (tag != null && slot.getDurabilityCorrection() == tag.getInt("Damage", -1));
    }

    public void backend(BedrockPacket packet) {
        if (packet instanceof StartGamePacket || packet instanceof ChangeDimensionPacket) {
            requests.clear();
            slotResults.clear();
            pendingSlots.clear();
            openWindow = -1;
            openWindowType = null;
            return;
        }
        if (packet instanceof ContainerOpenPacket open) {
            setOpenWindow(Byte.toUnsignedInt(open.getId()), UiInventorySlots.windowType(open.getType()));
            return;
        }
        if (packet instanceof ContainerClosePacket close) {
            if (close.getId() == -1 || Byte.toUnsignedInt(close.getId()) == openWindow) {
                setOpenWindow(-1, null);
            }
            return;
        }
        if (packet instanceof InventoryContentPacket content) {
            if (content.getContents() != null) clearPending(content.getContainerId(), null);
            return;
        }
        if (packet instanceof InventorySlotPacket slot) {
            clearPending(slot.getContainerId(), slot.getSlot());
            return;
        }
        if (packet instanceof ItemStackResponsePacket response) {
            processResponse(response);
        }
    }

    private void setOpenWindow(int window, InventoryType type) {
        openWindow = window;
        openWindowType = type;
        windowGeneration++;
        pendingSlots.keySet().removeIf(key -> isWindowScoped(key.container()));
        state.backendInventories().forgetWindowUi();
    }

    private void processResponse(ItemStackResponsePacket response) {
        Map<ContainerSlot, Runnable> commits = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        Set<Integer> failed = new HashSet<>();
        for (var entry : response.getEntries()) {
            if (entry != null && entry.getResult() != ItemStackResponseStatus.OK) failed.add(entry.getRequestId());
        }

        for (var entry : response.getEntries()) {
            if (entry == null) continue;

            var request = requests.remove(entry.getRequestId());
            if ((request != null
                            && request.world() != state.backendInventories().generation())
                    || failed.contains(entry.getRequestId())
                    || entry.getContainers() == null) {
                continue;
            }

            var predicted = replay(request);
            for (var container : entry.getContainers()) {
                if (container == null || container.getItems() == null) continue;
                ContainerSlotType type = resolvedType(container);
                if (!isTrackable(type, container.getContainerName())) continue;
                if (isWindowScoped(type) && request != null
                        && request.window() != windowGeneration) continue;

                boolean workstation = UiInventorySlots.workstation(type) != null;
                int containerId = workstation ? ContainerCache.UI : containerId(type);
                var target =
                        containerId < 0 ? null : state.inventory().getContainer((byte) containerId);
                for (var slot : container.getItems()) {
                    if (slot == null) continue;
                    int index = workstation ? UiInventorySlots.responseSlot(type, openWindowType, slot.getSlot())
                            : physicalSlot(type, slot.getSlot());
                    if (index < 0) continue;
                    ContainerSlot key = new ContainerSlot(containerId, index);
                    var backend = state.backendInventories();
                    long revision = backend.fullRevision(containerId, index);
                    if (request != null && revision > request.wireRevision()) {

                        if (matchesResponse(backend.lastKnownSlot(containerId, index), slot)) {
                            clearPending(containerId, index);
                            slotResults.put(key, new SlotResult(entry.getRequestId(), request.sequence(), revision));
                        }
                        continue;
                    }
                    ItemData item = predicted.get(key);
                    if (isConfirmedEmpty(slot.getCount(), slot.getStackNetworkId(), target, index)) {
                        acceptConfirmedSlot(target, key, isWindowScoped(type), workstation, ItemData.AIR, commits);
                    } else if (target != null && confirmsIdentity(item, slot)) {
                        var confirmed = item.toBuilder().netId(slot.getStackNetworkId()).usingNetId(true).build();
                        acceptConfirmedSlot(target, key, isWindowScoped(type), workstation, confirmed, commits);
                    } else {
                        commits.remove(key);
                        recordUnknownIdentity(
                                request != null,
                                entry.getRequestId(),
                                type,
                                key,
                                slot.getCount(),
                                slot.getStackNetworkId(),
                                slot.getCustomName(),
                                slot.getDurabilityCorrection(),
                                slot.getFilteredCustomName());
                    }
                    if (request != null) {
                        slotResults.put(key, new SlotResult(entry.getRequestId(), request.sequence(), revision));
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        commits
                .values()
                .forEach(commit -> state.player().queueAcknowledgment(response, commit));
    }

    private static ContainerSlotType resolvedType(ItemStackResponseContainer container) {
        var name = container.getContainerName();
        return name == null ? container.getContainer() : name.getContainer();
    }

    private static boolean isTrackable(ContainerSlotType type, FullContainerName name) {
        return type != null
                && type != ContainerSlotType.DYNAMIC_CONTAINER
                && (name == null || name.getDynamicId() == null);
    }

    private boolean isConfirmedEmpty(int count, int stackId, ContainerCache target, int slot) {
        if (count != 0 || stackId != 0 || target == null) return false;
        return slot >= target.getOffset() && slot < target.getContainerSize();
    }

    private void acceptConfirmedSlot(
            ContainerCache target,
            ContainerSlot key,
            boolean windowScoped,
            boolean workstation,
            ItemData item,
            Map<ContainerSlot, Runnable> commits) {
        clearPending(key.containerId(), key.slot());
        state.backendInventories().confirmSlot(key.containerId(), key.slot(), item);

        long worldEpoch = state.world().getBlockBreakEpoch();
        long responseWindow = windowGeneration;
        boolean persistentContainer = isPersistentContainer(target);
        commits.put(
                key,
                () -> {
                    if (worldEpoch != state.world().getBlockBreakEpoch()) return;
                    if (windowScoped && responseWindow != windowGeneration) return;
                    if (!persistentContainer && state.inventory().openContainer != target) return;
                    if (workstation) UiInventorySlots.apply(state.inventory(), key.slot(), item);
                    else if (item.isNull()) target.set(key.slot(), ItemCache.AIR);
                    else target.set(key.slot(), item);
                });
    }

    private boolean isPersistentContainer(ContainerCache container) {
        var inventory = state.inventory();
        return container == inventory.inventoryContainer
                || container == inventory.armorContainer
                || container == inventory.offhandContainer
                || container == inventory.hudContainer;
    }

    private void recordUnknownIdentity(
            boolean knownRequest,
            int requestId,
            ContainerSlotType type,
            ContainerSlot address,
            int count,
            int stackId,
            String customName,
            int durabilityCorrection,
            String filteredCustomName) {
        pendingSlots.put(
                new PendingKey(type, address),
                new PendingSlot(
                        requestId,
                        type,
                        address.slot(),
                        count,
                        stackId,
                        customName,
                        durabilityCorrection,
                        filteredCustomName));

        if (address.containerId() >= 0) state.backendInventories().markPending(address.containerId(), address.slot());

        var trace = state.player().worldDiagnostics();
        if (trace != null) {
            trace.event(
                    "inventory_response_pending_identity",
                    ac.navro.proxy.diagnostics.WorldCollisionDiagnostics.fields(
                            "requestId", requestId,
                            "knownRequest", knownRequest,
                            "container", type.name(),
                            "slot", address.slot(),
                            "count", count,
                            "stackId", stackId));
        }
    }

    private void clearPending(int containerId, Integer slot) {
        pendingSlots
                .keySet()
                .removeIf(
                        key ->
                                key.address().containerId() == containerId
                                        && (slot == null || key.address().slot() == slot));
    }

    private static boolean isWindowScoped(ContainerSlotType type) {
        return switch (type) {
            case HOTBAR, INVENTORY, HOTBAR_AND_INVENTORY, ARMOR, OFFHAND, CURSOR -> false;
            default -> true;
        };
    }

    private static int physicalSlot(ContainerSlotType type, int networkSlot) {
        return switch (type) {
            case CURSOR, OFFHAND -> 0;
            case CREATED_OUTPUT -> 50;
            default -> networkSlot;
        };
    }

    private int containerId(ContainerSlotType type) {
        if (type == null) return -1;
        return switch (type) {
            case HOTBAR, INVENTORY, HOTBAR_AND_INVENTORY -> 0;
            case ARMOR -> 120;
            case OFFHAND -> 119;
            case CURSOR, CREATED_OUTPUT -> 124;
            default -> openWindow;
        };
    }

    public Collection<PendingSlot> pending() {
        return List.copyOf(pendingSlots.values());
    }

    public Set<Integer> requests() {
        return Set.copyOf(requests.keySet());
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/compensated/UiInventorySlots.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.compensated;

import ac.navro.proxy.compensated.cache.container.ContainerCache;
import ac.navro.proxy.inventory.InventoryType;

import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.ContainerSlotType;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.ContainerType;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.ItemData;

public final class UiInventorySlots {
    private UiInventorySlots() { }

    public static InventoryType windowType(ContainerType type) {
        if (type == null) return null;
        return type.getId() == InventoryType.WORKBENCH.getNetworkType()
                ? InventoryType.WORKBENCH : InventoryType.from(type.getId());
    }

    public static InventoryType workstation(ContainerSlotType type) {
        return switch (type) {
            case ANVIL_INPUT, ANVIL_MATERIAL, ANVIL_RESULT -> InventoryType.ANVIL;
            case ENCHANTING_INPUT, ENCHANTING_MATERIAL -> InventoryType.ENCHANT_TABLE;
            case BEACON_PAYMENT -> InventoryType.BEACON;
            case LOOM_INPUT, LOOM_DYE, LOOM_MATERIAL, LOOM_RESULT -> InventoryType.LOOM;
            case CARTOGRAPHY_INPUT, CARTOGRAPHY_ADDITIONAL, CARTOGRAPHY_RESULT -> InventoryType.CARTOGRAPHY;
            case GRINDSTONE_INPUT, GRINDSTONE_ADDITIONAL, GRINDSTONE_RESULT -> InventoryType.GRINDSTONE;
            case STONECUTTER_INPUT, STONECUTTER_RESULT -> InventoryType.STONECUTTER;
            case SMITHING_TABLE_INPUT, SMITHING_TABLE_MATERIAL, SMITHING_TABLE_TEMPLATE,
                    SMITHING_TABLE_RESULT -> InventoryType.SMITHING_TABLE;
            case CRAFTING_INPUT, CRAFTING_OUTPUT -> InventoryType.WORKBENCH;
            default -> null;
        };
    }

    public static int responseSlot(ContainerSlotType type, InventoryType window, int slot) {
        InventoryType workstation = workstation(type);
        if (workstation == InventoryType.WORKBENCH) {
            int offset = window == InventoryType.WORKBENCH ? 32 : 28;
            int index = slot >= 32 && slot <= 40 ? slot - 32 : slot >= 28 && slot <= 31 ? slot - 28 : slot;
            return index >= 0 && index < (offset == 32 ? 9 : 4) ? offset + index : -1;
        }
        if (workstation == null || workstation != window) return -1;
        if (type == ContainerSlotType.BEACON_PAYMENT) return 27;
        if (slot == 50 && isWorkstationResult(type)) return 50;
        int offset = ContainerCache.offsetFor(workstation);
        int lastAlias = switch (workstation) {
            case ANVIL, CARTOGRAPHY, GRINDSTONE -> offset + 2;
            case STONECUTTER -> offset + 1;
            case LOOM, SMITHING_TABLE -> offset + 3;
            default -> offset + 1;
        };
        int index = slot >= offset && slot <= lastAlias ? slot - offset : slot;
        return index >= 0 && index < ContainerCache.sizeFor(workstation) ? offset + index : -1;
    }

    private static boolean isWorkstationResult(ContainerSlotType type) {
        return switch (type) {
            case ANVIL_RESULT, STONECUTTER_RESULT, LOOM_RESULT, CARTOGRAPHY_RESULT,
                    GRINDSTONE_RESULT, SMITHING_TABLE_RESULT -> true;
            default -> false;
        };
    }

    public static void apply(CompensatedInventory inventory, int slot, ItemData item) {
        inventory.hudContainer.set(slot, item);
        ContainerCache open = inventory.openContainer;
        if (open == null || open.getOffset() == 0 || open.getType() == InventoryType.TRADING) return;
        if (slot >= open.getOffset() && slot < open.getContainerSize()) open.set(slot, item);
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/compensated/cache/container/ContainerCache.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.compensated.cache.container;

import ac.navro.proxy.compensated.CompensatedInventory;
import ac.navro.proxy.data.inventory.ItemCache;
import ac.navro.proxy.inventory.InventoryType;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.ItemData;
import org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector3i;

import java.util.Arrays;

public class ContainerCache {
    public static final byte OFFHAND = (byte) 119;
    public static final byte UI = (byte) 124;

    protected final CompensatedInventory inventory;

    private final byte id;
    private final InventoryType type;
    private final Vector3i blockPosition;
    private final long uniqueEntityId;

    private final int containerSize;
    private final int offset;
    private final ItemCache[] contents;

    public ContainerCache(CompensatedInventory inventory, byte id, InventoryType type,
                          Vector3i blockPosition, long uniqueEntityId) {
        this.inventory = inventory;
        this.id = id;
        this.type = type;
        this.blockPosition = blockPosition;
        this.uniqueEntityId = uniqueEntityId;
        this.offset = offsetFor(type);
        this.containerSize = id == UI ? 54 : sizeFor(type);




        this.contents = new ItemCache[Math.max(0, this.containerSize)];
        Arrays.fill(this.contents, ItemCache.AIR);
    }

    public static int offsetFor(final InventoryType type) {
        if (type == null) {
            return 0;
        }
        return switch (type) {
            case ENCHANT_TABLE -> 14;
            case LOOM -> 9;
            case WORKBENCH -> 32;
            case BEACON -> 27;
            case ANVIL -> 1;
            case STONECUTTER -> 3;
            case CARTOGRAPHY -> 12;
            case SMITHING_TABLE -> 51;
            case GRINDSTONE -> 16;
            case TRADING -> 4;
            default -> 0;
        };
    }

    public static int sizeFor(final InventoryType type) {
        if (type == null) {
            return 36;
        }
        return switch (type) {
            case FURNACE, BLAST_FURNACE, SMOKER, LOOM, SMITHING_TABLE -> 3;
            case BREWING_STAND, HOPPER, MINECART_HOPPER -> 5;
            case DROPPER, DISPENSER, WORKBENCH, CRAFTER -> 9;
            case ENCHANT_TABLE, ANVIL, HORSE, CARTOGRAPHY, GRINDSTONE -> 2;
            case BEACON, STONECUTTER -> 1;
            case COMMAND_BLOCK -> 0;
            case MINECART_CHEST, CHEST_BOAT -> 26;
            case CHEST, ENDER_CHEST, DOUBLE_CHEST, SHULKER_BOX, BARREL -> 56;
            case TRADING -> 2;
            case ENTITY_ARMOR -> 4;
            default -> 36;
        };
    }

    public byte getId() { return id; }
    public InventoryType getType() { return type; }
    public Vector3i getBlockPosition() { return blockPosition; }
    public long getUniqueEntityId() { return uniqueEntityId; }
    public int getOffset() { return offset; }
    public ItemCache[] getContents() { return contents; }

    public int getContainerSize() {
        return this.containerSize + this.offset;
    }

    public ItemCache get(final int slot) {
        final int index = slot - this.offset;
        if (this.contents == null || index < 0 || index >= this.contents.length) {
            return ItemCache.AIR;
        }

        final ItemCache cache = this.contents[index];
        return cache == null ? ItemCache.AIR : cache;
    }

    public void set(final int slot, final ItemData raw) {
        this.set(slot, raw, true);
    }

    public void set(final int slot, final ItemCache raw) {
        this.set(slot, raw, true);
    }

    public void set(final int slot, final ItemData raw, final boolean offset) {
        this.set(slot, ItemCache.build(this.inventory, raw), offset);
    }

    public void set(final int slot, final ItemCache cache, final boolean offset) {
        final int index = offset ? slot - this.offset : slot;
        if (this.contents == null || index < 0 || index >= this.contents.length) {
            return;
        }

        this.contents[index] = cache == null ? ItemCache.AIR : cache;
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/compensated/cache/container/impl/ArmorContainerCache.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.compensated.cache.container.impl;

import ac.navro.proxy.compensated.CompensatedInventory;
import ac.navro.proxy.compensated.cache.container.ContainerCache;
import ac.navro.proxy.data.inventory.ItemCache;
import ac.navro.proxy.inventory.InventoryType;
import java.util.Map;

public class ArmorContainerCache extends ContainerCache {
    public static final byte ARMOR_ID = 120;
    private static final int SWIFT_SNEAK = 37;

    public ArmorContainerCache(CompensatedInventory inventory) {
        super(inventory, ARMOR_ID, InventoryType.PLAYER, null, -1L);
    }

    @Override public void set(int slot, ItemCache cache, boolean offset) {
        if (slot == 2) {
            ItemCache old = get(2);
            Map<Integer, Integer> oldEnchantments = CompensatedInventory.getEnchantments(old.getData());
            Map<Integer, Integer> newEnchantments = CompensatedInventory.getEnchantments(cache.getData());
            if (!newEnchantments.containsKey(SWIFT_SNEAK)) inventory.getPlayer().sneakingAttributeModifier = 0;
            else if (!oldEnchantments.containsKey(SWIFT_SNEAK)) {
                int level = newEnchantments.get(SWIFT_SNEAK);
                inventory.getPlayer().sneakingAttributeModifier = 0.15F + 0.15F * (float) (level - 1);
            }
        }
        super.set(slot, cache, offset);
    }
}
```

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.compensated.cache.container.impl;

    public PlayerContainerCache(final CompensatedInventory inventory) {
        super(inventory, INVENTORY_ID, InventoryType.PLAYER, null, -1L);
    }

    public ItemCache getHeldItemCache() {
        return this.getItemFromSlot(this.inventory.heldItemSlot);
    }

    public ItemData getHeldItemData() {
        return this.getItemFromSlot(this.inventory.heldItemSlot).getData();
    }

    public ItemData getHeldItem() {
        return getHeldItemData();
    }

    public ItemCache getItemFromSlot(final int slot) {
        if (slot < 0 || slot > 8 || slot >= this.getContainerSize()) {
            return ItemCache.AIR;
        }

        return this.get(slot);
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/compensated/cache/entity/EntityCache.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.compensated.cache.entity;

import ac.navro.anticheat.data.EntityDimensions;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Box;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;
import ac.navro.proxy.compensated.cache.entity.state.CachedEntityState;
import ac.navro.proxy.state.WirePlayerState;
import ac.navro.proxy.state.WireVec3;
import ac.navro.proxy.util.EntityMetadataUtil;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.AttributeData;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.entity.EntityDataMap;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.entity.EntityDataTypes;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.entity.EntityFlag;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.entity.EntityProperties;

import java.util.EnumMap;
import java.util.List;


public final class EntityCache {
    private final WirePlayerState player;
    private final long runtimeId, uniqueId;
    private final int entityType, dimension;
    private final String identifier;
    private final float definitionWidth, definitionHeight, definitionOffset;
    private EntityDimensions dimensions;
    private Vec3 serverPosition = Vec3.ZERO;
    private boolean inVehicle;
    private EntityDataMap metadata = new EntityDataMap();
    private final EnumMap<EntityFlag, Boolean> collisionFlags = new EnumMap<>(EntityFlag.class);
    private boolean hasCollisionFlags;
    private EntityProperties properties = new EntityProperties();
    private List<AttributeData> attributes = List.of();
    private long lastWireTick, queuedPositionUpdateSequence, appliedPositionUpdateSequence;
    private CachedEntityState current;
    public boolean affectedByOffset;

    public EntityCache(WirePlayerState player, long runtimeId, long uniqueId, int entityType,
                        String identifier, float definitionWidth, float definitionHeight,
                        float definitionOffset, boolean affectedByOffset, int dimension) {
        this.player = player;
        this.runtimeId = runtimeId;
        this.uniqueId = uniqueId;
        this.entityType = entityType;
        this.identifier = identifier;
        this.definitionWidth = definitionWidth;
        this.definitionHeight = definitionHeight;
        this.definitionOffset = definitionOffset;
        this.affectedByOffset = affectedByOffset;
        this.dimension = dimension;
        dimensions = EntityDimensions.fixed(definitionWidth, definitionHeight);
    }

    public void metadata(EntityDataMap update) {
        if (update == null) return;
        if (update.getFlags() != null) {
            collisionFlags.putAll(update.getFlags());
            hasCollisionFlags = true;
        }
        metadata = new EntityDataMap();
        update.forEach((type, value) -> metadata.put(type, value instanceof EnumMap<?, ?> flags ? flags.clone() : value));
        Float width = EntityMetadataUtil.getFloat(update, EntityDataTypes.WIDTH);
        Float height = EntityMetadataUtil.getFloat(update, EntityDataTypes.HEIGHT);
        Float scale = EntityMetadataUtil.getFloat(update, EntityDataTypes.SCALE);
        if (width != null) dimensions = EntityDimensions.fixed(width, definitionHeight);
        if (height != null) dimensions = EntityDimensions.fixed(definitionWidth, height);
        if (boat()) dimensions = EntityDimensions.fixed(definitionWidth, definitionHeight);
        if (scale != null) dimensions = dimensions.hardScaled(scale);
    }

    public Boolean collidableFlag() { return hasCollisionFlags ? Boolean.TRUE.equals(collisionFlags.get(EntityFlag.COLLIDABLE)) : null; }
    public boolean stackable() { return Boolean.TRUE.equals(collisionFlags.get(EntityFlag.STACKABLE)); }
    public boolean fallingBlock() { return "minecraft:falling_block".equalsIgnoreCase(identifier); }
    public boolean happyGhast() { return "minecraft:happy_ghast".equalsIgnoreCase(identifier); }
    public boolean isPlayerEntity() { return "minecraft:player".equalsIgnoreCase(identifier); }
    public boolean boat() {
        return entityType == 90 || entityType == 218 || "minecraft:boat".equalsIgnoreCase(identifier)
                || "minecraft:chest_boat".equalsIgnoreCase(identifier);
    }
    public boolean isBoat() { return boat(); }
    public boolean isMinecart() { return entityType == 84 || entityType == 98 || entityType == 96 || entityType == 97 || entityType == 100; }
    public float getYOffset() { return affectedByOffset ? definitionOffset : 0; }
    public EntityDimensions getDimensions() { return dimensions; }
    public CachedEntityState getCurrent() { return current; }
    public Vec3 getServerPosition() { return serverPosition; }
    public void setServerPosition(Vec3 value) { serverPosition = value; }
    public void init() { current = new CachedEntityState(player, this); }
    public void interpolate(Vec3 position, boolean lerp) {
        if (!lerp) current.setTeleportPos(position);
        else if (current.getInterpolator() != null) current.getInterpolator().refreshPositionAndAngles(position);
    }
    public long nextPositionUpdateSequence() { return ++queuedPositionUpdateSequence; }
    public void interpolate(Vec3 position, boolean lerp, long sequence) {
        interpolate(position, lerp);
        appliedPositionUpdateSequence = sequence;
    }
    public long queuedPositionUpdateSequence() { return queuedPositionUpdateSequence; }
    public long appliedPositionUpdateSequence() { return appliedPositionUpdateSequence; }
    public long runtimeId() { return runtimeId; }
    public long uniqueId() { return uniqueId; }
    public int entityType() { return entityType; }
    public int dimension() { return dimension; }
    public String identifier() { return identifier; }
    public WireVec3 position() { return current == null ? null : wire(current.getPos()); }
    public WireVec3 previousPosition() { return current == null ? null : wire(current.getPrevPos()); }
    public Box collisionBox() { return current == null ? null : current.getBoundingBox(); }
    public Box previousCollisionBox() { return current == null ? null : current.getBoundingBox(0); }
    private static WireVec3 wire(Vec3 value) { return new WireVec3(value.x, value.y, value.z); }
    public EntityDataMap metadata() { return metadata; }
    public EntityProperties properties() { return properties; }
    public void properties(EntityProperties value) {
        if (value == null) return;
        var integers = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<Integer, org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.entity.IntEntityProperty>();
        var floats = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<Integer, org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.entity.FloatEntityProperty>();
        for (var property : properties.getIntProperties()) integers.put(property.getIndex(), property);
        for (var property : properties.getFloatProperties()) floats.put(property.getIndex(), property);
        for (var property : value.getIntProperties()) integers.put(property.getIndex(), property);
        for (var property : value.getFloatProperties()) floats.put(property.getIndex(), property);
        var updated = new EntityProperties();
        updated.getIntProperties().addAll(integers.values());
        updated.getFloatProperties().addAll(floats.values());
        properties = updated;
    }
    public static EntityProperties copyProperties(EntityProperties value) {
        var copy = new EntityProperties();
        if (value != null) {
            copy.getIntProperties().addAll(value.getIntProperties());
            copy.getFloatProperties().addAll(value.getFloatProperties());
        }
        return copy;
    }
    public List<AttributeData> attributes() { return attributes; }
    public void attributes(List<AttributeData> value) {
        var updated = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<String, AttributeData>();
        for (var attribute : attributes) updated.put(attribute.getName(), attribute);
        for (var attribute : copyAttributes(value)) updated.put(attribute.getName(), attribute);
        attributes = List.copyOf(updated.values());
    }
    public static List<AttributeData> copyAttributes(List<AttributeData> value) {
        if (value == null) return List.of();
        return value.stream().map(attribute -> new AttributeData(attribute.getName(), attribute.getMinimum(),
                attribute.getMaximum(), attribute.getValue(), attribute.getDefaultMinimum(), attribute.getDefaultMaximum(),
                attribute.getDefaultValue(), attribute.getModifiers() == null ? null : List.copyOf(attribute.getModifiers()))).toList();
    }
    public WireVec3 motion() { return motion; }
    private WireVec3 motion;
    public void motion(WireVec3 value) { motion = value; }
    public long lastWireTick() { return lastWireTick; }
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/compensated/cache/entity/state/CachedEntityState.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.compensated.cache.entity.state;

import ac.navro.proxy.compensated.cache.entity.EntityCache;
import ac.navro.proxy.state.WirePlayerState;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.MathUtil;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Box;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;
import ac.navro.proxy.util.reach.PositionInterpolator;

public final class CachedEntityState {
    private final WirePlayerState player;
    private final EntityCache entity;
    private Vec3 prevPos = Vec3.ZERO;
    private Vec3 pos = Vec3.ZERO;
    private PositionInterpolator interpolator;

    public CachedEntityState(WirePlayerState player, EntityCache entity) {
        this.player = player;
        this.entity = entity;

        this.interpolator = new PositionInterpolator(this);
    }

    public WirePlayerState getPlayer() { return player; }
    public EntityCache getEntity() { return entity; }
    public Vec3 getPrevPos() { return prevPos; }
    public void setPrevPos(Vec3 value) { prevPos = value; }
    public Vec3 getPos() { return pos; }
    public void setPos(Vec3 value) { pos = value; }
    public PositionInterpolator getInterpolator() { return interpolator; }
    public void setInterpolator(PositionInterpolator value) { interpolator = value; }

    public void tick() {
        if (this.isInterpolating()) {
            this.interpolator.tick();
        } else {
            this.prevPos = this.pos.clone();
        }
    }

    public boolean isInterpolating() {
        return this.getInterpolator() != null && this.getInterpolator().isInterpolating();
    }

    public Box getBoundingBox() {
        return this.calculateBoundingBox();
    }

    public Box getBoundingBox(float f) {
        if (Math.abs(1 - f) <= 1.0E-3) {
            return this.calculateBoundingBox();
        }

        float x = MathUtil.lerp(f, this.prevPos.x, this.pos.x);
        float y = MathUtil.lerp(f, this.prevPos.y, this.pos.y);
        float z = MathUtil.lerp(f, this.prevPos.z, this.pos.z);
        return this.calculateBoundingBox(new Vec3(x, y, z));
    }

    public Box calculateBoundingBox() {
        return this.entity.getDimensions().getBoxAt(this.pos);
    }

    public Box calculateBoundingBox(Vec3 vec3) {
        return this.entity.getDimensions().getBoxAt(vec3);
    }

    public void setTeleportPos(Vec3 pos) {
        this.prevPos = this.pos = pos;
    }

    @Override
    public CachedEntityState clone() {
        final CachedEntityState state = new CachedEntityState(player, entity);
        state.setPos(this.pos.clone());
        state.setPrevPos(this.prevPos.clone());
        state.setInterpolator(this.interpolator == null ? null : this.interpolator.clone());

        return state;
    }
}
```

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.compensated.world;

import ac.navro.proxy.compensated.world.base.CompensatedWorld;
import ac.navro.proxy.data.block.NetworkBlockStateRegistry.RuntimePalette;
import ac.navro.proxy.packets.server.ServerChunkPackets;
import ac.navro.proxy.state.WirePlayerState;
import org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector3i;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.*;





public final class BackendBlockSnapshots {
    public record Blocks(int layerZero, int layerOne) { }
    private final CompensatedWorld world = new CompensatedWorld();
    private final ServerChunkPackets packets = new ServerChunkPackets(new WirePlayerState(), world);
    private long generation;

    public void setProtocolVersion(int protocol) { world.setProtocolVersion(protocol); }
    public void setRuntimeBlockPalette(RuntimePalette palette) { world.setRuntimeBlockPalette(palette); }
    public long generation() { return generation; }
    public void clear() { generation++; packets.resetPalette(); world.clear(); }

    public void observe(BedrockPacket packet) {
        if (packet instanceof StartGamePacket start) {
            generation++;
            packets.resetPalette();
            world.apply(start);
        } else if (packet instanceof ChangeDimensionPacket change) {
            generation++;
            world.changeDimension(change.getDimension());
        } else {
            packets.onPacket(packet);
        }
    }

    public Blocks at(Vector3i position) {
        int x=position.getX(), y=position.getY(), z=position.getZ();
        if (y < world.getMinY() || y >= world.getHeightY() || !world.isSectionKnown(x,y,z)) return null;
        return new Blocks(world.getRawBlockAt(x,y,z,0), world.getRawBlockAt(x,y,z,1));
    }
}
```

```java
 public boolean noCollision(Box query){

 }
 private List<Box> blockShapes(Vector3i pos,Box actor){
  return world.collisionCellFragments(pos.getX(),pos.getY(),pos.getZ(),null,context.collisionPhysics).stream().map(CollisionShapeEntry::shape).toList();
 }
 public static Vector3i blockPosition(Vec3 v){return Vector3i.from((int)Math.floor(v.x),(int)Math.floor(v.y),(int)Math.floor(v.z));}
    public org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector3i getStandingBlockPosition(Box actorBox) {
        final float queryY = actorBox.minY - 0.2F;
        final List<Box> candidates = new ArrayList<>();
        final int minX = (int) Math.floor(actorBox.minX);
        final int maxX = (int) Math.floor(actorBox.maxX + 1.0F);
        final int minZ = (int) Math.floor(actorBox.minZ);
        final int maxZ = (int) Math.floor(actorBox.maxZ + 1.0F);
        for (int chunkX = minX >> 4; chunkX <= (maxX >> 4); chunkX++) {
            for (int chunkZ = minZ >> 4; chunkZ <= (maxZ >> 4); chunkZ++) {
                final int x = chunkX << 4, z = chunkZ << 4;
                if (!isChunkLoaded(x, z)) candidates.add(new Box(x, -100000, z, x + 16, 100000, z + 16));
            }
        }
        if (getMinY() > queryY) {
            candidates.add(new Box(actorBox.minX, -Float.MAX_VALUE, actorBox.minZ,
                    actorBox.maxX, getMinY() - 40.0F, actorBox.maxZ));
        }
        for (int x = minX; x <= maxX; x++) {
            for (int z = minZ; z <= maxZ; z++) {
                if (!isChunkLoaded(x, z)) continue;
                for (int y = (int) Math.ceil(queryY + 1.0F) - 1;
                        y >= (int) Math.floor(queryY - 1.0F); y--) {
                    final org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector3i pos = org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector3i.from(x, y, z);
                    final List<Box> fragments = blockShapes(pos, actorBox);
                    if (fragments.isEmpty()) continue;
                    Box shape = fragments.get(0);
                    for (int i = 1; i < fragments.size(); i++) shape = shape.union(fragments.get(i));
                    candidates.add(shape);
                }
            }
        }
        final Box selected = StickyBlockPhysics.selectStandingShape(actorBox, candidates);
        return selected == null ? blockPosition(context.position)
                : org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector3i.from((int) Math.floor(selected.minX), (int) Math.floor(selected.minY),
                        (int) Math.floor(selected.minZ));
    }
}
```
