```java
package ac.navro.proxy.data.block;

import ac.navro.proxy.util.Hash;
import ac.navro.proxy.util.ItemUtil;
import org.cloudburstmc.nbt.NbtList;
import org.cloudburstmc.nbt.NbtMap;
import org.cloudburstmc.nbt.NbtType;
import org.cloudburstmc.nbt.NbtUtils;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.StartGamePacket;
import java.io.BufferedInputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;


public final class NetworkBlockStateRegistry {
    private static final Map<Integer, Tables> REGISTRIES = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final Tables tables;
    private final boolean hashed;
    private final NetworkBlockComponents components;
    private ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Box declaredBounds;
    private final Map<Integer, NetworkBlockState> declaredStates = new HashMap<>();

    private NetworkBlockStateRegistry(Tables tables, boolean hashed) {
        this(tables, hashed, new NetworkBlockComponents(java.util.List.of()));
    }

    private NetworkBlockStateRegistry(Tables tables, boolean hashed, NetworkBlockComponents components) {
        this.tables = tables;
        this.hashed = hashed;
        this.components = components;
    }


    public static int paletteProtocol(int protocol) {
        if (NetworkBlockStateRegistry.class.getResource("/navro/palette/runtime_block_states_" + protocol + ".dat") == null)
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("No built-in block palette for protocol " + protocol);
        return protocol;
    }

    public static NetworkBlockStateRegistry forProtocol(int protocol, boolean hashed) {
        int palette = paletteProtocol(protocol);
        return new NetworkBlockStateRegistry(REGISTRIES.computeIfAbsent(palette, NetworkBlockStateRegistry::load), hashed);
    }

    public static NetworkBlockStateRegistry fromStartGame(int protocol, StartGamePacket packet) {
        return fromStartGame(protocol, packet, null);
    }

    public static NetworkBlockStateRegistry fromStartGame(int protocol, StartGamePacket packet, RuntimePalette supplied) {
        boolean hashed = packet.isBlockNetworkIdsHashed();
        var components = new NetworkBlockComponents(packet.getBlockProperties(), protocol);
        NbtList<NbtMap> definitions = packet.getBlockPalette();
        Tables tables;
        if (definitions != null && !definitions.isEmpty()) tables = orderedTables(definitions, knownLegacy(protocol));
        else if (supplied != null && supplied.protocol() == protocol) tables = supplied.tables;
        else {
            tables = forProtocol(protocol, hashed).tables;
        }
        if (hashed && !packet.getBlockProperties().isEmpty()) {
            var hashes = new HashMap<>(tables.hashStates);
            for (var state : components.states()) {
                int hash = Hash.hashBlock(state);
                var previous = hashes.putIfAbsent(hash, new NetworkBlockState(hash, -1, state));
                if (previous != null && !StateKey.of(previous.stateTag()).equals(StateKey.of(state))) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Ambiguous custom block state hash: " + hash);
                }
            }
            tables = new Tables(tables.runtimeStates, Map.copyOf(hashes), tables.airRuntime, tables.airHash,
                    tables.legacyRuntime, tables.legacyHashes);
        }
        return new NetworkBlockStateRegistry(tables, hashed, components);
    }

    public boolean hasComponents(NetworkBlockState state) { return state != null && components.contains(state.identifier()); }
    public java.util.List<ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Box> declaredCollision(NetworkBlockState state) { return components.collision(state); }


    public ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Box declaredCollisionQuery(ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Box query) {
        if (components.isEmpty()) return query;
        if (declaredBounds == null) {
            var bounds = new ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Box(0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1);
            for (var state : states().values()) {
                if (!hasComponents(state)) continue;
                var boxes = components.collision(state);
                if (boxes != null) for (var box : boxes) bounds = bounds.union(box);
            }
            declaredBounds = bounds;
        }
        return new ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Box(
                query.minX - Math.max(0F, declaredBounds.maxX - 1F),
                query.minY - Math.max(0F, declaredBounds.maxY - 1F),
                query.minZ - Math.max(0F, declaredBounds.maxZ - 1F),
                query.maxX + Math.max(0F, -declaredBounds.minX),
                query.maxY + Math.max(0F, -declaredBounds.minY),
                query.maxZ + Math.max(0F, -declaredBounds.minZ));
    }

    private static Map<StateKey, Integer> knownLegacy(int protocol) {
        Map<StateKey, Integer> legacy = new HashMap<>();
        forProtocol(protocol, false).tables.runtimeStates.values().stream()
                .filter(state -> state.legacyFullId() >= 0)
                .sorted(java.util.Comparator.comparingInt(NetworkBlockState::networkId))
                .forEach(state -> legacy.putIfAbsent(StateKey.of(state.stateTag()), state.legacyFullId()));
        return legacy;
    }


    public static RuntimePalette readRuntimePalette(Path path) throws IOException {
        try (var input = new BufferedInputStream(Files.newInputStream(path))) {
            return readRuntimePalette(input);
        }
    }

    public static RuntimePalette readRuntimePalette(InputStream compressed) throws IOException {
        try (var input = NbtUtils.createGZIPReader(compressed, 24L * 1024 * 1024)) {
            if (!(input.readTag() instanceof NbtMap root))
                throw new IOException("Expected a palette compound");
            int protocol = root.getInt("protocol", -1);
            var states = root.getList("states", NbtType.COMPOUND);
            if (protocol <= 0 || states.isEmpty() || states.size() > 131072)
                throw new IOException("Invalid palette protocol or state count");
            if (states.stream().anyMatch(state -> state.getString("name").isBlank()))
                throw new IOException("Unnamed block state");
            Map<StateKey, Integer> legacy = knownLegacy(protocol);
            var tables = orderedTables(states, legacy);
            if (tables.airRuntime == Integer.MIN_VALUE)
                throw new IOException("Missing air entry in palette");
            return new RuntimePalette(protocol, tables);
        }
    }

    public static final class RuntimePalette {
        private final int protocol;
        private final Tables tables;

        private RuntimePalette(int protocol, Tables tables) {
            this.protocol = protocol;
            this.tables = tables;
        }

        public int protocol() { return protocol; }
        public int size() { return tables.runtimeStates.size(); }
    }

    private record StateKey(String name, NbtMap properties) {
        static StateKey of(NbtMap tag) {
            return new StateKey(tag.getString("name"), tag.getCompound("states"));
        }
    }

    private static Tables orderedTables(Iterable<NbtMap> definitions, Map<StateKey, Integer> knownLegacy) {
        Map<Integer, NetworkBlockState> runtime = new HashMap<>(), hashes = new HashMap<>();
        Map<Integer, Integer> legacyRuntime = new HashMap<>(), legacyHashes = new HashMap<>();
        var overloads = new java.util.ArrayList<ForwardState>();
        int airRuntime = Integer.MIN_VALUE, airHash = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
        int runtimeId = 0;
        for (NbtMap source : definitions) {
            NbtMap state = networkTag(source);
            int hash = Hash.hashBlock(state);
            int legacy = source.containsKey("id") ? legacyId(source) : knownLegacy.getOrDefault(StateKey.of(state), -1);
            runtime.putIfAbsent(runtimeId, new NetworkBlockState(runtimeId, legacy, state));
            hashes.putIfAbsent(hash, new NetworkBlockState(hash, legacy, state));
            if (legacy >= 0) registerForward(source, legacy, runtimeId, hash, legacyRuntime, legacyHashes, overloads);
            if ("minecraft:air".equals(state.getString("name"))) { airRuntime = runtimeId; airHash = hash; }
            runtimeId++;
        }
        finishOverloads(overloads, legacyRuntime, legacyHashes);
        return new Tables(Map.copyOf(runtime), Map.copyOf(hashes), airRuntime, airHash,
                Map.copyOf(legacyRuntime), Map.copyOf(legacyHashes));
    }

    public NetworkBlockState resolve(int networkId) {
        NetworkBlockState state = (hashed ? tables.hashStates : tables.runtimeStates).get(networkId);
        if (state == null) state = (hashed ? tables.runtimeStates : tables.hashStates).get(networkId);
        if (hasComponents(state)) {
            var observed = state;
            return declaredStates.computeIfAbsent(state.networkId(), ignored -> new NetworkBlockState(observed.networkId(),
                    observed.legacyFullId(), observed.stateTag(), components.slipperiness(observed)));
        }
        return state;
    }
    public int airNetworkId() { return hashed ? tables.airHash : tables.airRuntime; }
    public boolean hashed() { return hashed; }
    public Map<Integer, NetworkBlockState> states() { return hashed ? tables.hashStates : tables.runtimeStates; }


    public int networkIdForLegacy(int legacyFullId) {
        Map<Integer, Integer> values = hashed ? tables.legacyHashes : tables.legacyRuntime;
        int blockId = legacyFullId >> BlockStateEncoding.DATA_BITS;
        int meta = legacyFullId & BlockStateEncoding.DATA_MASK;
        int networkId = values.getOrDefault(legacyFullId, -1);
        if (networkId == -1 && meta > 0x07)
            networkId = values.getOrDefault(blockId << BlockStateEncoding.DATA_BITS | meta & 0x0f, -1);
        if (networkId == -1 && meta > 0x03)
            networkId = values.getOrDefault(blockId << BlockStateEncoding.DATA_BITS | meta & 0x07, -1);
        if (networkId == -1) networkId = values.getOrDefault(blockId << BlockStateEncoding.DATA_BITS, -1);
        if (networkId == -1) networkId = values.getOrDefault(248 << BlockStateEncoding.DATA_BITS, -1);
        return networkId;
    }

    private static Tables load(int protocol) {
        Map<Integer, NetworkBlockState> runtime = new HashMap<>(), hashes = new HashMap<>();
        Map<Integer, Integer> legacyRuntime = new HashMap<>(), legacyHashes = new HashMap<>();
        var overloads = new java.util.ArrayList<ForwardState>();
        int airRuntime = Integer.MIN_VALUE, airHash = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
        String resource = "/navro/palette/runtime_block_states_" + protocol + ".dat";
        try (var raw = NetworkBlockStateRegistry.class.getResourceAsStream(resource)) {
            if (raw == null) throw new IllegalStateException("Missing protocol block states: " + resource);
            try (var reader = NbtUtils.createGZIPReader(new BufferedInputStream(raw))) {
                Object root = reader.readTag();
                if (!(root instanceof NbtList<?> states)) throw new IllegalStateException("Invalid protocol block states: " + resource);
                for (Object value : states) {
                    if (!(value instanceof NbtMap source)) continue;
                    int legacy = source.containsKey("id") ? legacyId(source) : -1;
                    int runtimeId = source.getInt("runtimeId");
                    NbtMap state = networkTag(source);
                    int hash = Hash.hashBlock(state);
                    runtime.putIfAbsent(runtimeId, new NetworkBlockState(runtimeId, legacy, state));
                    hashes.putIfAbsent(hash, new NetworkBlockState(hash, legacy, state));
                    if (legacy >= 0) registerForward(source, legacy, runtimeId, hash, legacyRuntime, legacyHashes, overloads);
                    if ("minecraft:air".equals(state.getString("name"))) { airRuntime = runtimeId; airHash = hash; }
                }
            }
        } catch (IOException error) { throw new IllegalStateException("Unable to load protocol block states: " + resource, error); }
        finishOverloads(overloads, legacyRuntime, legacyHashes);
        return new Tables(Map.copyOf(runtime), Map.copyOf(hashes), airRuntime, airHash,
                Map.copyOf(legacyRuntime), Map.copyOf(legacyHashes));
    }
    private static int legacyId(NbtMap source) {

        int id = ac.navro.proxy.util.NbtNumber.getInt(source, "id");
        int data = ac.navro.proxy.util.NbtNumber.getShort(source, "data");
        return BlockStateEncoding.fullId(id, data);
    }

    private record ForwardState(int legacy, int runtime, int hash) { }
    private static void registerForward(NbtMap source, int legacy, int runtime, int hash,
                                        Map<Integer, Integer> runtimes, Map<Integer, Integer> hashes,
                                        java.util.List<ForwardState> overloads) {
        var entry = new ForwardState(legacy, runtime, hash);
        if (ac.navro.proxy.util.NbtNumber.getInt(source, "stateOverload") != 0) overloads.add(entry);
        else registerForward(entry, runtimes, hashes);
    }
    private static void registerForward(ForwardState entry, Map<Integer, Integer> runtimes, Map<Integer, Integer> hashes) {

        runtimes.put(entry.legacy(), entry.runtime());
        hashes.putIfAbsent(entry.legacy(), entry.hash());
    }
    private static void finishOverloads(java.util.List<ForwardState> overloads,
                                        Map<Integer, Integer> runtimes, Map<Integer, Integer> hashes) {
        for (var entry : overloads) registerForward(entry, runtimes, hashes);
    }
    private static NbtMap networkTag(NbtMap source) {
        var tag = ItemUtil.copyTag(source).toBuilder();
        tag.remove("id"); tag.remove("data"); tag.remove("runtimeId"); tag.remove("stateOverload");
        return tag.build();
    }
    private record Tables(Map<Integer, NetworkBlockState> runtimeStates, Map<Integer, NetworkBlockState> hashStates,
                          int airRuntime, int airHash, Map<Integer, Integer> legacyRuntime,
                          Map<Integer, Integer> legacyHashes) { }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/data/block/StateCondition.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.data.block;

import org.cloudburstmc.nbt.NbtMap;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.function.Supplier;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

final class StateCondition {
    private static final Pattern NUMBER = Pattern.compile("(?:[0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]*)?|\\.[0-9]+)(?:[eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?");
    private final String expression;
    private final NbtMap states;
    private final boolean rightAssociativeConditional;
    private final boolean modernPrecedence;
    private final boolean fixedNegativeDivision;
    private int offset;
    private int depth;
    private int conditionalDepth;
    private boolean evaluating = true;

    private StateCondition(String expression, NbtMap states, boolean rightAssociativeConditional,
                           boolean modernPrecedence, boolean fixedNegativeDivision) {
        this.expression = expression;
        this.states = states;
        this.rightAssociativeConditional = rightAssociativeConditional;
        this.modernPrecedence = modernPrecedence;
        this.fixedNegativeDivision = fixedNegativeDivision;
    }

    static Boolean evaluate(String expression, NbtMap states) {
        return evaluate(expression, states, true, true, true);
    }

    static Boolean evaluate(String expression, NbtMap states, Integer version, int protocol) {
        if (version == null) {
            Boolean result = evaluate(expression, states, false, false, false);
            if (result == null) return null;
            for (int boundary = 5; boundary <= 7; boundary++) {
                Boolean candidate = evaluate(expression, states, boundary, 2225);
                if (!result.equals(candidate)) return null;
            }
            return result;
        }
        int shift = protocol >= 2207 ? 0 : 1;
        return evaluate(expression, states, version >= 5 + shift, version >= 6 + shift, version >= 7 + shift);
    }

    private static Boolean evaluate(String expression, NbtMap states, boolean rightAssociativeConditional,
                                    boolean modernPrecedence, boolean fixedNegativeDivision) {
        if (expression.length() > 4096) return null;
        try {
            var parser = new StateCondition(expression, states, rightAssociativeConditional,
                    modernPrecedence, fixedNegativeDivision);
            Object result = parser.conditional();
            parser.whitespace();
            return parser.offset == expression.length() ? truth(result) : null;
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException error) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private Object conditional() {
        if (++conditionalDepth > 64) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
        try {
            Object value = or();
            while (take("?")) {
                boolean selectTrue = evaluating && truth(value);
                Object whenTrue = parseWhen(selectTrue, rightAssociativeConditional ? this::conditional : this::or);
                require(":");
                Object whenFalse = parseWhen(!selectTrue, rightAssociativeConditional ? this::conditional : this::or);
                value = evaluating ? selectTrue ? whenTrue : whenFalse : 0F;
                if (rightAssociativeConditional) break;
            }
            return value;
        } finally {
            conditionalDepth--;
        }
    }

    private Object parseWhen(boolean selected, Supplier<Object> parser) {
        boolean previous = evaluating;
        evaluating = previous && selected;
        try {
            return parser.get();
        } finally {
            evaluating = previous;
        }
    }

    private Object or() {
        if (!modernPrecedence) return legacyLogical();
        Object value = and();
        while (take("||")) {
            boolean first = evaluating && truth(value);
            Object next = parseWhen(!first, this::and);
            value = evaluating && (first || truth(next)) ? 1F : 0F;
        }
        return value;
    }

    private Object and() {
        Object value = comparison();
        while (take("&&")) {
            boolean first = evaluating && truth(value);
            Object next = parseWhen(first, this::comparison);
            value = evaluating && first && truth(next) ? 1F : 0F;
        }
        return value;
    }

    private Object legacyLogical() {
        Object value = comparison();
        while (true) {
            if (take("||")) {
                boolean first = evaluating && truth(value);
                Object next = parseWhen(!first, this::comparison);
                value = evaluating && (first || truth(next)) ? 1F : 0F;
            } else if (take("&&")) {
                boolean first = evaluating && truth(value);
                Object next = parseWhen(first, this::comparison);
                value = evaluating && first && truth(next) ? 1F : 0F;
            } else return value;
        }
    }

    private Object comparison() {
        Object value = modernPrecedence ? relation() : sum();
        String operator;
        while ((operator = comparisonOperator()) != null) {
            Object right = modernPrecedence ? relation() : sum();
            value = evaluating ? compare(value, right, operator) : 0F;
        }
        return value;
    }

    private String comparisonOperator() {
        String[] operators = modernPrecedence ? new String[]{"==", "!="} : new String[]{"==", "!=", "<=", ">=", "<", ">"};
        for (String operator : operators) if (take(operator)) return operator;
        return null;
    }

    private Object relation() {
        Object value = sum();
        String operator;
        while ((operator = relationOperator()) != null) {
            Object right = sum();
            value = evaluating ? compare(value, right, operator) : 0F;
        }
        return value;
    }

    private String relationOperator() {
        for (String operator : new String[]{"<=", ">=", "<", ">"}) if (take(operator)) return operator;
        return null;
    }

    private static float compare(Object left, Object right, String operator) {
        boolean result;
        if (left instanceof String first && right instanceof String second) {
            if (!operator.equals("==") && !operator.equals("!=")) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
            if (!first.equals(second) && first.equalsIgnoreCase(second)) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
            result = first.equals(second);
            if (operator.equals("!=")) result = !result;
        } else {
            float first = number(left), second = number(right);
            result = switch (operator) {
                case "==" -> first == second;
                case "!=" -> first != second;
                case "<=" -> first <= second;
                case ">=" -> first >= second;
                case "<" -> first < second;
                case ">" -> first > second;
                default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException();
            };
        }
        return result ? 1F : 0F;
    }

    private Object sum() {
        Object value = product();
        while (true) {
            if (take("+")) {
                Object next = product();
                value = evaluating ? finite(number(value) + number(next)) : 0F;
            } else if (take("-")) {
                Object next = product();
                value = evaluating ? finite(number(value) - number(next)) : 0F;
            } else return value;
        }
    }

    private Object product() {
        Object value = primary();
        while (true) {
            if (take("*")) {
                Object next = primary();
                value = evaluating ? finite(number(value) * number(next)) : 0F;
            } else if (take("/")) {
                Object next = primary();
                if (!evaluating) {
                    value = 0F;
                    continue;
                }
                float denominator = number(next);
                if (denominator == 0F || denominator < 0F && !fixedNegativeDivision) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
                value = finite(number(value) / denominator);
            } else return value;
        }
    }

    private Object primary() {
        if (++depth > 64) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
        try {
            if (take("!")) {
                Object value = primary();
                return evaluating && !truth(value) ? 1F : 0F;
            }
            if (take("-")) {
                Object value = primary();
                return evaluating ? -number(value) : 0F;
            }
            if (take("+")) {
                Object value = primary();
                return evaluating ? number(value) : 0F;
            }
            if (take("(")) {
                Object value = conditional();
                require(")");
                return value;
            }
            whitespace();
            if (offset < expression.length() && expression.charAt(offset) == '\'') return string();
            var matcher = NUMBER.matcher(expression).region(offset, expression.length());
            if (matcher.lookingAt()) {
                float value = finite(Float.parseFloat(matcher.group()));
                offset = matcher.end();
                return value;
            }
            String name = identifier();
            if (name.equals("true")) return 1F;
            if (name.equals("false")) return 0F;
            if (name.equals("q.block_state") || name.equals("query.block_state")
                    || name.equals("q.block_property") || name.equals("query.block_property")) {
                require("(");
                String property = string();
                require(")");
                if (!evaluating) return 0F;
                Object value = states.get(property);
                if (value instanceof String || value instanceof Byte || value instanceof Integer) return value;
                throw new IllegalArgumentException();
            }
            if (take("(")) return function(name);
            if (!evaluating) return 0F;
            throw new IllegalArgumentException();
        } finally {
            depth--;
        }
    }

    private Object function(String name) {
        var arguments = new ArrayList<Object>();
        if (!take(")")) {
            do {
                arguments.add(conditional());
            } while (take(","));
            require(")");
        }
        int arity = switch (name) {
            case "math.abs", "math.ceil", "math.floor" -> 1;
            case "math.min", "math.max" -> 2;
            case "math.clamp" -> 3;
            default -> -1;
        };
        if (arity >= 0 && arguments.size() != arity) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
        if (!evaluating) return 0F;
        if (arity < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
        float first = number(arguments.get(0));
        return switch (name) {
            case "math.abs" -> Math.abs(first);
            case "math.ceil" -> (float) Math.ceil(first);
            case "math.floor" -> (float) Math.floor(first);
            case "math.min" -> Math.min(first, number(arguments.get(1)));
            case "math.max" -> Math.max(first, number(arguments.get(1)));
            case "math.clamp" -> clamp(first, arguments);
            default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException();
        };
    }

    private static float clamp(float value, List<Object> arguments) {
        float minimum = number(arguments.get(1)), maximum = number(arguments.get(2));
        if (minimum > maximum) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
        return Math.min(Math.max(value, minimum), maximum);
    }

    private String identifier() {
        whitespace();
        int start = offset;
        if (offset == expression.length()) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
        char first = expression.charAt(offset);
        if (!(first >= 'a' && first <= 'z' || first >= 'A' && first <= 'Z' || first == '_')) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException();
        }
        while (offset < expression.length()) {
            char value = expression.charAt(offset);
            if (!(value >= 'a' && value <= 'z' || value >= 'A' && value <= 'Z'
                    || value >= '0' && value <= '9' || value == '_' || value == '.')) break;
            offset++;
        }
        String name = expression.substring(start, offset).toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        if (name.endsWith(".") || name.contains("..")) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
        return name;
    }

    private String string() {
        whitespace();
        require("'");
        int start = offset;
        while (offset < expression.length() && expression.charAt(offset) != '\'') {
            if (expression.charAt(offset) == '\\') throw new IllegalArgumentException();
            offset++;
        }
        if (offset == expression.length()) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
        return expression.substring(start, offset++);
    }

    private static float number(Object value) {
        if (value instanceof Number number) return number.floatValue();
        throw new IllegalArgumentException();
    }

    private static float finite(float value) {
        if (!Float.isFinite(value)) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
        return value;
    }

    private static boolean truth(Object value) { return number(value) != 0F; }
    private void require(String token) { if (!take(token)) throw new IllegalArgumentException(); }

    private boolean take(String token) {
        whitespace();
        if (!expression.startsWith(token, offset)) return false;
        offset += token.length();
        return true;
    }

    private void whitespace() {
        while (offset < expression.length() && Character.isWhitespace(expression.charAt(offset))) offset++;
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/data/entity/NetworkEntityRegistry.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.data.entity;

import org.cloudburstmc.nbt.NbtMap;
import org.cloudburstmc.nbt.NbtType;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

public final class NetworkEntityRegistry {
    private Map<String, Integer> types = Map.of();

    public void replace(NbtMap identifiers) {
        if (identifiers == null) return;
        var replacement = new HashMap<String, Integer>();
        for (var entry : identifiers.getList("idlist", NbtType.COMPOUND)) {
            Object identifier = entry.get("id");
            Object runtimeType = entry.get("rid");
            if (!(identifier instanceof String name) || name.isBlank() || !(runtimeType instanceof Integer type)) continue;
            Integer previous = replacement.putIfAbsent(name, type);
            if (previous != null && !previous.equals(type)) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Conflicting entity registry entry: " + name);
            }
        }
        types = Map.copyOf(replacement);
    }

    public int type(String identifier, int fallback) {
        return types.getOrDefault(identifier, fallback);
    }
}
```

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.data.input;

import ac.navro.anticheat.data.MovementAabbSnapshot;
import ac.navro.proxy.SessionState;
import ac.navro.proxy.data.ItemUseTracker;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.RiptidePhysics;
import ac.navro.proxy.state.WireTickSnapshot;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.ItemData;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.PlayerAuthInputPacket;
import java.util.Set;





public record TickData(PlayerAuthInputPacket packet, WireTickSnapshot state,
                       Set<Integer> itemUseFlags, ItemUseTracker.Snapshot<ItemData> itemUseSnapshot,
                       float fallDistance, float swimSpeedMultiplier, float waterDrag,
                       RiptidePhysics.Snapshot riptideStartState, RiptidePhysics.Snapshot riptideEndState,
                       MovementAabbSnapshot inputAabb, MovementAabbSnapshot endAabb) {
    public TickData {
        packet = snapshotPacket(packet);
        itemUseFlags = Set.copyOf(itemUseFlags);
    }

    public static TickData capture(SessionState session, PlayerAuthInputPacket packet) {
        var wire = session.player();
        var context = session.authInputPackets().context();
        var tracker = session.authInputPackets().itemUse().getItemUseTracker();
        var state = wire.snapshot(session.fluidState());
        return new TickData(packet, state, tracker.snapshotPredictionFlags(wire.tick()), tracker.snapshot(),
                context.fallDistance, context.fluidPrediction.swimSpeedMultiplier, context.fluidPrediction.waterDrag,
                context.riptideTickStartState, RiptidePhysics.snapshot(context),
                state.inputAabb() == null ? wire.snapshotAabb() : state.inputAabb(), wire.snapshotAabb());
    }


    public static PlayerAuthInputPacket snapshotPacket(PlayerAuthInputPacket source) {
        var copy = new PlayerAuthInputPacket();
        copy.setRotation(source.getRotation());
        copy.setTick(source.getTick());
        copy.setPosition(source.getPosition());
        copy.setDelta(source.getDelta());
        copy.setMotion(source.getMotion());
        copy.getInputData().addAll(source.getInputData());
        copy.setInputMode(source.getInputMode());
        copy.setInputInteractionModel(source.getInputInteractionModel());
        copy.setPlayMode(source.getPlayMode());
        if (source.getCameraOrientation() != null) copy.setCameraOrientation(source.getCameraOrientation());
        if (source.getRawMoveVector() != null) copy.setRawMoveVector(source.getRawMoveVector());
        if (source.getInteractRotation() != null) copy.setInteractRotation(source.getInteractRotation());
        return copy;
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/data/inventory/BundleData.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.data.inventory;

import ac.navro.proxy.compensated.CompensatedInventory;
import java.util.Arrays;

public final class BundleData {
    private final CompensatedInventory inventory;
    private final ItemCache[] contents = new ItemCache[64];
    private int bundleId = -1;
    public int count;

    public BundleData(CompensatedInventory inventory) {
        this.inventory = inventory;
        Arrays.fill(contents, ItemCache.AIR);
    }
    public ItemCache[] getContents() { return contents; }
    public int getBundleId() { return bundleId; }
    public void setBundleId(int value) { bundleId = value; }

    public boolean add(int slot, ItemCache cache) {
        ItemCache current = contents[slot];

        if (!inventory.nativeIsNull(current.getData()) && !inventory.sameDefinition(cache.getData(), current.getData())) return false;
        if (count + cache.count() > 64) return false;
        if (inventory.nativeIsNull(current.getData())) contents[slot] = cache.clone();
        else {
            current.count(current.count() + cache.count());
            contents[slot] = current;
        }
        count += cache.count();
        return true;
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/data/inventory/ItemCache.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.data.inventory;

import ac.navro.proxy.compensated.CompensatedInventory;
import ac.navro.proxy.util.ItemUtil;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.ItemData;


public class ItemCache {
    public static final ItemCache AIR = new ItemCache(ItemData.AIR, null);
    private final CompensatedInventory inventory;
    private ItemData data;
    private BundleData bundle;

    private ItemCache(ItemData data, CompensatedInventory inventory) { this.data = data; this.inventory = inventory; }
    public ItemData getData() { return data; }
    public ItemData getNativeData() { return inventory == null ? data : inventory.nativeItem(data); }
    public void setData(ItemData value) { data = value; }
    public BundleData getBundle() { return bundle; }
    public void setBundle(BundleData value) { bundle = value; }
    public ItemCache count(int count) { data = data.toBuilder().count(count).build(); return this; }
    public int count() { return data.getCount(); }
    public boolean isEmpty() { return inventory == null ? data == null || data.getCount() <= 0 || data.isNull() : inventory.nativeIsNull(data); }

    @Override public ItemCache clone() {
        ItemCache cache = new ItemCache(ItemUtil.copy(data), inventory);
        cache.setBundle(bundle);
        return cache;
    }

    public static ItemCache build(CompensatedInventory inventory, ItemData data) {
        ItemData item = ItemUtil.copy(data);
        ItemCache cache = new ItemCache(item, inventory);
        ItemData nativeItem = cache.getNativeData();
        if (!ItemUtil.isBundle(nativeItem)) return cache;
        int id = -1;
        try {
            if (nativeItem.getTag() != null) id = ac.navro.proxy.util.NbtNumber.getInt(nativeItem.getTag(), "bundle_id");
        } catch (Exception ignored) { }
        if (id == -1 || inventory.getBundleCache().containsKey(id)) return cache;
        BundleData bundle = new BundleData(inventory);
        bundle.setBundleId(id);
        cache.setBundle(bundle);
        inventory.getBundleCache().put(id, cache);
        return cache;
    }
}
```

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.data.inventory;

import ac.navro.proxy.util.ItemUtil;
import ac.navro.proxy.util.NbtNumber;
import org.cloudburstmc.nbt.NbtMap;
import org.cloudburstmc.nbt.NbtType;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.definitions.ItemDefinition;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.ItemData;
import java.io.*;
import java.security.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.zip.GZIPInputStream;


public final class NativeItemDecoder {
    public enum Format { INVENTORY, TRANSACTION, SLOT, DESCRIPTOR }
    private record Binding(int factory,int fixedDamage){}
    private record Protocol(boolean inventoryDescriptor,boolean transactionDescriptor,boolean slotDescriptor,
                            Map<String,Binding> bindings,Map<Integer,Integer> forward,
                            Map<Integer,String> reverse,Map<String,Integer> named){
        boolean descriptor(Format format){return switch(format){
            case INVENTORY,DESCRIPTOR->inventoryDescriptor;case TRANSACTION->transactionDescriptor;case SLOT->slotDescriptor;};}
    }
    private record Factory(int base,Integer number,String name,boolean statefulDefault,int[] nbtEnds,NbtMap[] nbtTags,int mode,int constant,int[] damage,int[] exceptions,
                           int[] namespaceEnds,String[] namespaces,byte[] extra){
        NbtMap defaultTag(int raw){if(raw<0||raw>65535)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Native constructor damage is not exported: "+raw);int i=Arrays.binarySearch(nbtEnds,raw);return nbtTags[i>=0?i:-i-1];}
        int damage(int raw){return switch(mode){case 0->raw;case 1->constant;case 2->damage[raw];case 3->{int i=Arrays.binarySearch(exceptions,raw);yield i>=0?damage[i]:raw;}default->throw new AssertionError(mode);};}
        String namespace(int raw){int i=Arrays.binarySearch(namespaceEnds,raw);return namespaces[i>=0?i:-i-1];}
    }
    private record Table(int enchantmentCount,Map<Integer,Protocol> protocols,Factory[] factories,Map<Integer,Integer> numeric,Map<String,Integer> named){}
    private record ExtraRow(int[] ends,NativePredictionItems.Traits[] traits){}
    private static final Map<Integer,ExtraRow> EXTRA_CACHE=new LinkedHashMap<>(16,.75F,true){
        @Override protected boolean removeEldestEntry(Map.Entry<Integer,ExtraRow> entry){return size()>4;}
    };
    private static final NativePredictionItems.Traits AIR=new NativePredictionItems.Traits(0,true,false,0,false,"","");
    private static final NativePredictionItems.Traits SERVER_ITEM =
            new NativePredictionItems.Traits(-1, false, false, 0, false, "", "");
    private static final NativeItemPlacementProperties.Properties SERVER_PLACEMENT =
            new NativeItemPlacementProperties.Properties(false, false, 0, 0, 0);
    private static final Table TABLE=load();
    private NativeItemDecoder(){}


    private record Definition(int protocol,int factory,int rawDamage,String identifier,int runtimeId,
                              ItemDefinition wire) implements ItemDefinition {
        public String getIdentifier(){return identifier;}
        public int getRuntimeId(){return runtimeId;}
        public boolean isComponentBased(){return wire!=null&&wire.isComponentBased();}
        public NbtMap getComponentData(){return wire==null?null:wire.getComponentData();}
    }
    public static void initialize(){if(TABLE.factories.length==0)throw new IllegalStateException("Empty native item decoder");}

    public static ItemData constructNumeric(int protocol,int id,int rawDamage,int count) {
        Protocol version=Objects.requireNonNull(TABLE.protocols.get(protocol),"Native constructor protocol");
        int factory=numeric(id);Factory constructor=TABLE.factories[factory];
        if(constructor.statefulDefault)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Stateful constructor requires authoritative NBT");
        if(rawDamage<0||rawDamage>65535)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Native constructor damage is not exported: "+rawDamage);
        var traits=traits(factory,rawDamage);int damage=constructor.damage(rawDamage);String namespace=constructor.namespace(rawDamage);int runtime;
        if(namespace!=null)runtime=version.named.getOrDefault(namespace,-1);
        else{int full=((short)traits.nativeId()<<16)|((damage&0x7fff)<<1);
            runtime=version.forward.getOrDefault(full,version.forward.getOrDefault((short)traits.nativeId()<<16,Integer.MIN_VALUE));
            namespace=traits.nativeId()==0?"minecraft:air":version.reverse.get(runtime);}
        return ItemData.builder().definition(new Definition(protocol,factory,rawDamage,namespace,runtime,null))
                .damage(damage).count(count).tag(ItemUtil.copyTag(constructor.defaultTag(rawDamage))).build();
    }
    public static ItemData decode(int protocol,ItemData wire){return decode(protocol,wire,Format.INVENTORY);}
    public static ItemData decode(int protocol,ItemData wire,Format format){
        if(wire==null)return null;
        if(wire.getDefinition() instanceof Definition decoded){
            if(decoded.protocol()!=protocol)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Decoded item belongs to another protocol");
            return wire;
        }
        Protocol version=TABLE.protocols.get(protocol);
        if(version==null)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Native item decoding is not exported for protocol "+protocol);
        boolean descriptor=version.descriptor(format);
        if(wire.getDefinition()==null || (!descriptor&&wire.getDefinition().getRuntimeId()==0))return canonicalAir(protocol);
        Binding binding=wire.getDefinition().getRuntimeId()==0?new Binding(numeric(0),-1):version.bindings.get(wire.getDefinition().getIdentifier());
        if (binding == null && isCustomDefinition(wire.getDefinition())) return wire;
        if(binding==null)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Native item definition is not exported: "+wire.getDefinition().getIdentifier());
        int factory=binding.factory(),rawDamage=binding.fixedDamage()>=0?binding.fixedDamage():wire.getDamage();
        NbtMap tag=ItemUtil.copyTag(wire.getTag());
        if(tag!=null&&!tag.isEmpty()){
            var tags=tag.toBuilder();
            if(tag.containsKey("Damage")){rawDamage=NbtNumber.getInt(tag,"Damage");tags.remove("Damage");}
            if(tag.containsKey("__DamageConflict__")){tags.put("Damage",tag.get("__DamageConflict__"));tags.remove("__DamageConflict__");}
            tag=tags.build();
            if(!descriptor&&tag.get("ench") instanceof org.cloudburstmc.nbt.NbtList<?> ench&&ench.size()>TABLE.enchantmentCount*1.5)
                throw new RuntimeException("Too many enchantment: "+ench.size());
        }
        Factory constructor=TABLE.factories[factory];
        boolean restore=tag!=null&&tag.containsKey("mv_origin_id")&&tag.containsKey("mv_origin_meta")
                &&(descriptor||Objects.equals(constructor.number,248));
        if(restore){
            int id=NbtNumber.getInt(tag,"mv_origin_id");rawDamage=NbtNumber.getInt(tag,"mv_origin_meta");
            factory=id==255&&tag.containsKey("mv_origin_namespace")?named(string(tag,"mv_origin_namespace")):numeric(id);
            constructor=TABLE.factories[factory];
            if(tag.containsKey("mv_origin_nbt"))tag=(NbtMap)tag.get("mv_origin_nbt");
            else {if(constructor.statefulDefault)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Stateful native map constructor requires origin NBT");tag=constructor.defaultTag(rawDamage);}
        }else{
            if(constructor.statefulDefault&&constructor.number!=null&&(tag==null||tag.isEmpty()))
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Stateful native map constructor requires decoded NBT");
            if(constructor.number!=null&&(tag==null||tag.isEmpty()))tag=constructor.defaultTag(rawDamage);
            if(!descriptor&&constructor.number==null&&wire.getDamage()>32767)throw new NumberFormatException("Value out of range. Value:\""+wire.getDamage()+"\" Radix:10");
            var tags=tag==null?NbtMap.builder():tag.toBuilder();
            if(wire.getCanBreak()!=null&&wire.getCanBreak().length>0)tags.putList("CanDestroy",NbtType.STRING,wire.getCanBreak());
            if(wire.getCanPlace()!=null&&wire.getCanPlace().length>0)tags.putList("CanPlaceOn",NbtType.STRING,wire.getCanPlace());
            tag=tags.build();
        }
        if(rawDamage<0||rawDamage>65535)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Native constructor damage is not exported: "+rawDamage);
        var traits=traits(factory,rawDamage);int damage=constructor.damage(rawDamage);
        String namespace=constructor.namespace(rawDamage);int runtime;
        if(namespace!=null)runtime=version.named.getOrDefault(namespace,-1);
        else{
            int full=((short)traits.nativeId()<<16)|((damage&0x7fff)<<1);
            runtime=version.forward.getOrDefault(full,version.forward.getOrDefault((short)traits.nativeId()<<16,Integer.MIN_VALUE));
            namespace=traits.nativeId()==0?"minecraft:air":version.reverse.get(runtime);
        }
        int netId=descriptor?(wire.getNetId()>0?wire.getNetId():0):wire.getNetId();
        ItemData result=wire.toBuilder().definition(new Definition(protocol,factory,rawDamage,namespace,runtime,restore?null:wire.getDefinition()))
                .damage(damage).count(wire.getCount()).tag(tag==null||tag.isEmpty()?null:ItemUtil.copyTag(tag))
                .canPlace(new String[0]).canBreak(new String[0]).netId(netId).usingNetId(netId>0).build();



        boolean namedTagSetter=restore || (wire.getCanPlace()!=null&&wire.getCanPlace().length>0)
                || (wire.getCanBreak()!=null&&wire.getCanBreak().length>0);
        if(namedTagSetter&&ItemUtil.isBundle(result)&&result.getTag()!=null&&result.getTag().containsKey("bundle_id"))
            NbtNumber.getInt(result.getTag(),"bundle_id");
        return result;
    }
    private static ItemData canonicalAir(int protocol){return ItemData.AIR.toBuilder()
            .definition(new Definition(protocol,numeric(0),0,"minecraft:air",TABLE.protocols.get(protocol).forward.getOrDefault(0,Integer.MIN_VALUE),null)).build();}
    private static int numeric(int id){Integer value=TABLE.numeric.get(id);if(value==null)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Native numeric constructor is not exported: "+id);return value;}
    private static int named(String name){
        String normalized=name.trim().replace(' ','_').toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        if(normalized.indexOf(':')<0)normalized="minecraft:"+normalized;
        Integer value=TABLE.named.get(normalized);
        if(value==null)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Native named constructor is not exported: "+name);
        return value;
    }
    private static String string(NbtMap tag,String key){Object value=tag.get(key);return value==null?"":value instanceof Number?String.valueOf(value):(String)value;}

    private static boolean isCustomDefinition(ItemDefinition definition) {
        String identifier = definition.getIdentifier();
        return identifier != null && identifier.indexOf(':') > 0 && !identifier.startsWith("minecraft:");
    }

    public static boolean usesBackendDefinition(int protocol, ItemData item) {
        if (item == null || item.getDefinition() == null || item.getDefinition().getRuntimeId() == 0
                || !isCustomDefinition(item.getDefinition())) return false;
        Protocol version = TABLE.protocols.get(protocol);
        return version != null && !version.bindings.containsKey(item.getDefinition().getIdentifier());
    }

    public static NativePredictionItems.Traits traits(int protocol,ItemData item){
        if(item==null)return AIR;
        ItemData decoded=decode(protocol,item);
        if (!(decoded.getDefinition() instanceof Definition definition)) return SERVER_ITEM;
        return traits(definition.factory,definition.rawDamage);
    }



    public static NativeItemPlacementProperties.Properties placement(int protocol,ItemData item){
        return placement(protocol,item,Format.INVENTORY);
    }
    public static NativeItemPlacementProperties.Properties placement(int protocol,ItemData item,Format format){
        ItemData decoded=Objects.requireNonNull(decode(protocol,item,format),"Native placement item");
        if (!(decoded.getDefinition() instanceof Definition definition)) return SERVER_PLACEMENT;
        Factory constructor=TABLE.factories[definition.factory];
        return constructor.number!=null
                ?NativeItemPlacementProperties.forNumeric(constructor.number,definition.rawDamage)
                :NativeItemPlacementProperties.forIdentifier(constructor.name,definition.rawDamage);
    }
    private static NativePredictionItems.Traits traits(int factory,int damage){
        Factory constructor=TABLE.factories[factory];
        if(constructor.base>=0)return NativePredictionItems.factoryTraits(constructor.base,damage);
        synchronized(EXTRA_CACHE){
            ExtraRow row=EXTRA_CACHE.get(factory);
            if(row==null){
                try(var in=new DataInputStream(new GZIPInputStream(new ByteArrayInputStream(constructor.extra)))){
                    int size=in.readInt();int[] ends=new int[size];var traits=new NativePredictionItems.Traits[size];
                    for(int i=0;i<size;i++){ends[i]=in.readUnsignedShort();traits[i]=NativePredictionItems.readTraits(in);}
                    row=new ExtraRow(ends,traits);EXTRA_CACHE.put(factory,row);
                }catch(IOException e){throw new IllegalStateException("Invalid native constructor traits",e);}
            }
            int index=Arrays.binarySearch(row.ends,damage);return row.traits[index>=0?index:-index-1];
        }
    }
    private static int count(int value,int min,int max)throws IOException{if(value<min||value>max)throw new IOException("Invalid native decoder count: "+value);return value;}
    private static void ranges(int[] ends)throws IOException{
        if(ends.length==0||ends[ends.length-1]!=65535)throw new IOException("Incomplete native metadata range");
        for(int i=1;i<ends.length;i++)if(ends[i]<=ends[i-1])throw new IOException("Unordered native metadata range");
    }
    private static Factory readFactory(DataInputStream in,int index,Map<Integer,Integer> numeric,Map<String,Integer> named,Map<NbtMap,NbtMap> defaults)throws IOException{
                    int base=in.readInt();Integer number=null;String name=null;
                    if(in.readBoolean()){number=in.readInt();if(numeric.putIfAbsent(number,index)!=null)throw new IOException("Duplicate numeric constructor");}else{name=in.readUTF();if(named.putIfAbsent(name,index)!=null)throw new IOException("Duplicate named constructor");}
                    boolean stateful=in.readBoolean();int nbtCount=count(in.readInt(),1,65536);int[] nbtEnds=new int[nbtCount];NbtMap[] nbtTags=new NbtMap[nbtCount];
                    for(int j=0;j<nbtCount;j++){nbtEnds[j]=in.readUnsignedShort();int nbtSize=count(in.readInt(),0,32*1024*1024);
                        if(nbtSize>0){try(var nbt=org.cloudburstmc.nbt.NbtUtils.createReaderLE(new ByteArrayInputStream(in.readNBytes(nbtSize)))){NbtMap parsed=(NbtMap)nbt.readTag();nbtTags[j]=defaults.computeIfAbsent(parsed,key->key);}}}
                    ranges(nbtEnds);
                    int mode=count(in.readUnsignedByte(),0,3),constant=mode==1?in.readInt():0;int[] damage=null;
                    int[] exceptions=null;
                    if(mode==2){damage=new int[65536];for(int j=0;j<damage.length;j++)damage[j]=in.readInt();}
                    if(mode==3){int size=count(in.readInt(),0,65536);exceptions=new int[size];damage=new int[size];for(int j=0;j<size;j++){exceptions[j]=in.readUnsignedShort();damage[j]=in.readInt();}}
                    int size=count(in.readInt(),1,65536);int[] ends=new int[size];String[] namespaces=new String[size];
                    for(int j=0;j<size;j++){ends[j]=in.readUnsignedShort();if(in.readBoolean())namespaces[j]=in.readUTF();}
                    ranges(ends);
                    if(base < -1||base>=NativePredictionItems.factoryCount())throw new IOException("Invalid base constructor");
                    byte[] extra=base<0?in.readNBytes(count(in.readInt(),1,32*1024*1024)):null;
                    return new Factory(base,number,name,stateful,nbtEnds,nbtTags,mode,constant,damage,exceptions,ends,namespaces,extra);
    }
    private static Factory[] supplementaryBindings(Map<Integer,Protocol> versions,Factory[] baseFactories,Map<Integer,Integer> numeric,Map<String,Integer> named,Map<NbtMap,NbtMap> defaults)throws IOException,NoSuchAlgorithmException{
        try(var resource=NativeItemDecoder.class.getResourceAsStream("/navro/item-runtime-bindings.bin.gz")){
            if(resource==null)throw new IOException("Missing supplementary native runtime bindings");
            try(var in=new DataInputStream(new GZIPInputStream(resource))){
                if(in.readInt()!=0x4e494232)throw new IOException("Invalid supplementary native runtime bindings");
                byte[] digest=in.readNBytes(32);
                try(var directory=NativeItemDecoder.class.getResourceAsStream("/navro/item-decoder.bin.gz")){
                    if(directory==null||!Arrays.equals(digest,MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(directory.readAllBytes())))throw new IOException("Native runtime bindings directory digest mismatch");
                }
                int protocols=count(in.readInt(),1,100);if(protocols!=versions.size())throw new IOException("Native runtime binding protocol count mismatch");
                record Pending(Protocol version,String wireName,Integer number,String name,int fixed){}
                var pending=new ArrayList<Pending>();Set<Integer> seen=new HashSet<>();
                for(int p=0;p<protocols;p++){
                    int protocol=in.readInt();Protocol version=versions.get(protocol);
                    if(version==null||!seen.add(protocol))throw new IOException("Invalid native runtime binding protocol");
                    int size=count(in.readInt(),0,100000);
                    for(int i=0;i<size;i++){
                        String wireName=in.readUTF();Integer number=null;String name=null;
                        if(in.readBoolean())number=in.readInt();else name=in.readUTF();
                        pending.add(new Pending(version,wireName,number,name,in.readInt()));
                    }
                }
                var factories=new ArrayList<Factory>(Arrays.asList(baseFactories));int extras=count(in.readInt(),0,100000);
                for(int i=0;i<extras;i++){Factory factory=readFactory(in,factories.size(),numeric,named,defaults);if(factory.base()!=-1)throw new IOException("Invalid supplementary constructor traits");factories.add(factory);}
                for(var binding:pending){
                    Integer factory=binding.number()!=null?numeric.get(binding.number()):named.get(binding.name());
                    if(factory==null)throw new IOException("Unexported supplementary native constructor: "+binding.wireName());
                    if(binding.version().bindings.putIfAbsent(binding.wireName(),new Binding(factory,binding.fixed()))!=null)throw new IOException("Duplicate native wire binding: "+binding.wireName());
                }
                if(in.read()!=-1)throw new IOException("Trailing supplementary native runtime bindings");return factories.toArray(Factory[]::new);
            }
        }
    }
    private static Table load(){
        try(var resource=NativeItemDecoder.class.getResourceAsStream("/navro/item-decoder.bin.gz")){
            if(resource==null)throw new IOException("Missing native item decoder");
            try(var in=new DataInputStream(new GZIPInputStream(resource))){
                if(in.readInt()!=0x4e494434)throw new IOException("Invalid native item decoder");
                int enchantmentCount=in.readInt();
                byte[] digest=in.readNBytes(32);
                try(var base=NativeItemDecoder.class.getResourceAsStream("/navro/prediction-items.bin.gz")){
                    if(base==null||!Arrays.equals(digest,MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(base.readAllBytes())))throw new IOException("Native constructor traits digest mismatch");
                }
                if(in.readInt()!=NativePredictionItems.factoryCount())throw new IOException("Native constructor count mismatch");
                int protocols=in.readInt();var versions=new HashMap<Integer,Protocol>();
                for(int p=0;p<protocols;p++){
                    int protocol=in.readInt();boolean inventory=in.readBoolean(),transaction=in.readBoolean(),slot=in.readBoolean();
                    int size=in.readInt();var bindings=new HashMap<String,Binding>();for(int i=0;i<size;i++)bindings.put(in.readUTF(),new Binding(in.readInt(),in.readInt()));
                    size=in.readInt();var forward=new HashMap<Integer,Integer>();for(int i=0;i<size;i++)forward.put(in.readInt(),in.readInt());
                    size=in.readInt();var reverse=new HashMap<Integer,String>();for(int i=0;i<size;i++)reverse.put(in.readInt(),in.readUTF());
                    size=in.readInt();var named=new HashMap<String,Integer>();for(int i=0;i<size;i++)named.put(in.readUTF(),in.readInt());
                    versions.put(protocol,new Protocol(inventory,transaction,slot,bindings,forward,reverse,named));
                }
                int count=in.readInt();Factory[] factories=new Factory[count];var defaults=new HashMap<NbtMap,NbtMap>();var numeric=new HashMap<Integer,Integer>();var named=new HashMap<String,Integer>();
                for(int i=0;i<count;i++){
                    factories[i]=readFactory(in,i,numeric,named,defaults);
                }
                if(in.read()!=-1)throw new IOException("Trailing native item decoder data");
                Factory[] all=supplementaryBindings(versions,factories,numeric,named,defaults);
                return new Table(enchantmentCount,versions,all,numeric,named);
            }
        }catch(IOException|NoSuchAlgorithmException e){throw new IllegalStateException("Cannot load native item decoder",e);}
    }
}
```

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.data.inventory;

import java.io.DataInputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.zip.GZIPInputStream;





public final class NativeItemPlacementProperties {
    public record Properties(boolean canBePlaced, boolean hasMappedBlock, int blockId,
                             int defaultBlockId, int defaultLegacyFullId) { }
    private record Row(int[] ends, Properties[] values) { }
    private record Table(Map<Integer, Row> numeric, Map<String, Row> named) { }
    private static final Table TABLE=load();
    private NativeItemPlacementProperties() { }

    public static Set<Integer> numericIds() { return TABLE.numeric.keySet(); }
    public static Set<String> identifiers() { return TABLE.named.keySet(); }
    public static Properties forNumeric(int nativeItemId, int constructorDamage) {
        return resolve(TABLE.numeric.get(nativeItemId), constructorDamage);
    }
    public static Properties forIdentifier(String identifier, int setterDamage) {
        String normalized=identifier.trim().replace(' ','_').toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        if(!normalized.contains(":"))normalized="minecraft:"+normalized;
        return resolve(TABLE.named.get(normalized), setterDamage);
    }
    private static Properties resolve(Row row, int damage) {
        if(damage<0||damage>65535)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Expected an explicitly decoded 16-bit native item damage");
        if(row==null)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Native item factory is not exported; its registered implementation is required");
        int index=Arrays.binarySearch(row.ends,damage);return row.values[index>=0?index:-index-1];
    }
    private static boolean bool(DataInputStream in)throws IOException {
        int value=in.readUnsignedByte();if(value>1)throw new IOException("Invalid native item property flag");return value!=0;
    }
    private static Row row(DataInputStream in)throws IOException {
        int count=in.readInt();if(count<1||count>65536)throw new IOException("Invalid native item property row length");
        int[] ends=new int[count];Properties[] values=new Properties[count];
        for(int i=0;i<count;i++) {
            ends[i]=in.readUnsignedShort();boolean canPlace=bool(in),mapped=bool(in);
            if(i>0&&ends[i]<=ends[i-1]||canPlace&&!mapped)throw new IOException("Invalid native item property range");
            values[i]=new Properties(canPlace,mapped,in.readInt(),in.readInt(),in.readInt());
        }
        if(ends[count-1]!=65535)throw new IOException("Incomplete native item damage coverage");return new Row(ends,values);
    }
    private static Table load() {
        var resource=NativeItemPlacementProperties.class.getResourceAsStream("/navro/item-placement.bin.gz");
        if(resource==null)throw new IllegalStateException("Missing native item placement properties");
        try(var in=new DataInputStream(new GZIPInputStream(resource))) {
            if(in.readInt()!=0x4E495031||in.readInt()!=65536)throw new IOException("Incompatible native item placement properties");
            int count=in.readInt();if(count<1||count>100000)throw new IOException("Invalid native item factory count");
            var numeric=new HashMap<Integer,Row>();var named=new HashMap<String,Row>();
            for(int i=0;i<count;i++) {
                if(bool(in)){int id=in.readInt();if(numeric.put(id,row(in))!=null)throw new IOException("Duplicate native numeric item factory");}
                else{String id=in.readUTF();if(named.put(id,row(in))!=null)throw new IOException("Duplicate native named item factory");}
            }
            if(in.read()!=-1)throw new IOException("Trailing native item placement properties");
            var extra=NativeItemPlacementProperties.class.getResourceAsStream("/navro/item-placement-decoder-extra.bin.gz");
            if(extra==null)throw new IOException("Missing native decoder placement constructors");
            try(var added=new DataInputStream(new GZIPInputStream(extra))) {
                if(added.readInt()!=0x4E495032||added.readInt()!=65536)throw new IOException("Incompatible extra placement properties");
                int extraCount=added.readInt();if(extraCount<1||extraCount>100000)throw new IOException("Invalid extra factory count");
                for(int i=0;i<extraCount;i++) {
                    if(bool(added)){int id=added.readInt();if(numeric.putIfAbsent(id,row(added))!=null)throw new IOException("Duplicate extra numeric factory");}
                    else{String id=added.readUTF();if(named.putIfAbsent(id,row(added))!=null)throw new IOException("Duplicate extra named factory");}
                }
                if(added.read()!=-1)throw new IOException("Trailing extra placement properties");
            }
            return new Table(Map.copyOf(numeric),Map.copyOf(named));
        }catch(IOException error){throw new IllegalStateException("Cannot load native item placement properties",error);}
    }
}
```

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.data.inventory;

import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.ItemData;
import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.zip.GZIPInputStream;


public final class NativePredictionItems {
    public record Traits(int nativeId,boolean positiveNull,boolean canRelease,int duration,boolean food,String durationError,String foodError){}
    private record Binding(int factory,int fixedDamage){}
    private record Row(int[] ends,int[] offsets,byte[] data){}
    private record Key(int factory,int damage){}
    private static final Map<Key,Traits> CACHE=new LinkedHashMap<>(256,.75F,true){
        @Override protected boolean removeEldestEntry(Map.Entry<Key,Traits> entry){return size()>2048;}
    };
    private record Table(Map<Integer,Map<String,Binding>> protocols,Row[] factories){}
    private static final Table TABLE=load();
    private NativePredictionItems(){}
    public static void initialize(){if(TABLE.factories.length==0)throw new IllegalStateException("Empty prediction item traits");NativeItemDecoder.initialize();}
    public static Traits resolve(int protocol,ItemData item){return NativeItemDecoder.traits(protocol,item);}
    static int factoryCount(){return TABLE.factories.length;}
    static Traits factoryTraits(int factory,int damage){
        if(damage<0 || damage>65535)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Expected decoded native item damage");
        Row row=TABLE.factories[factory];int index=Arrays.binarySearch(row.ends,damage);
        int selected=index>=0?index:-index-1;Key key=new Key(factory,selected);
        synchronized(CACHE){
            Traits value=CACHE.get(key);if(value!=null)return value;
            try(var in=new DataInputStream(new ByteArrayInputStream(row.data,row.offsets[selected],row.data.length-row.offsets[selected]))){
                value=readTraits(in);CACHE.put(key,value);return value;
            }catch(IOException e){throw new IllegalStateException("Invalid detached item traits",e);}
        }
    }
    static Traits readTraits(DataInputStream in)throws IOException{
        return new Traits(in.readInt(),in.readBoolean(),in.readBoolean(),in.readInt(),in.readBoolean(),in.readUTF(),in.readUTF());
    }
    private static Table load(){
        var resource=NativePredictionItems.class.getResourceAsStream("/navro/prediction-items.bin.gz");
        if(resource==null)throw new IllegalStateException("Missing exact prediction item properties");
        try(var in=new DataInputStream(new GZIPInputStream(resource))){
            if(in.readInt()!=0x4e505531)throw new IOException("Invalid prediction item properties");
            int count=in.readInt();if(count<1 || count>100)throw new IOException("Invalid protocol count");
            var protocols=new HashMap<Integer,Map<String,Binding>>();
            for(int i=0;i<count;i++){
                int protocol=in.readInt(),size=in.readInt();if(size<1 || size>100000)throw new IOException("Invalid item count");
                var names=new HashMap<String,Binding>();for(int j=0;j<size;j++)names.put(in.readUTF(),new Binding(in.readInt(),in.readInt()));
                protocols.put(protocol,Map.copyOf(names));
            }
            int size=in.readInt();if(size<1 || size>100000)throw new IOException("Invalid factory count");Row[] rows=new Row[size];
            for(int i=0;i<size;i++){
                int length=in.readInt();if(length<1 || length>65536)throw new IOException("Invalid metadata range count");
                int[] ends=new int[length],offsets=new int[length];var data=new ByteArrayOutputStream();var bytes=new DataOutputStream(data);
                for(int j=0;j<length;j++){
                    ends[j]=in.readUnsignedShort();if(j>0&&ends[j]<=ends[j-1])throw new IOException("Invalid metadata range");
                    offsets[j]=data.size();bytes.write(in.readNBytes(11));
                    for(int error=0;error<2;error++){int utfLength=in.readUnsignedShort();bytes.writeShort(utfLength);bytes.write(in.readNBytes(utfLength));}
                }
                if(ends[length-1]!=65535)throw new IOException("Incomplete native item metadata");rows[i]=new Row(ends,offsets,data.toByteArray());
            }
            for(var names:protocols.values())for(var binding:names.values())if(binding.factory()<0||binding.factory()>=rows.length)throw new IOException("Invalid factory binding");
            if(in.read()!=-1)throw new IOException("Trailing prediction item data");return new Table(Map.copyOf(protocols),rows);
        }catch(IOException e){throw new IllegalStateException("Cannot load exact prediction item properties",e);}
    }
}
```

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.data.vanilla;

import com.google.gson.JsonParser;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Set;


public final class NativeStatusEffects {
    private static final Set<Integer> IDS = load();
    private NativeStatusEffects() { }

    public static boolean contains(int id) { return IDS.contains(id); }

    private static Set<Integer> load() {
        var resource = NativeStatusEffects.class.getResourceAsStream("/navro/status-effects.json");
        if (resource == null) throw new IllegalStateException("Missing native status effect registry");
        try (var reader = new InputStreamReader(resource, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
            var ids = new HashSet<Integer>();
            for (var value : JsonParser.parseReader(reader).getAsJsonArray()) ids.add(value.getAsInt());
            if (ids.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalStateException("Empty native status effect registry");
            return Set.copyOf(ids);
        } catch (IOException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Cannot load native status effect registry", e);
        }
    }
}
```

```java
    }

    private static Map<String, Object> predictionReport(ac.navro.proxy.prediction.PredictionSyncState.Report report) {

    private long record(String event,Map<String,Object> data,boolean emit){
        var entry=fields("time",java.time.Instant.now().toString(),"session",session,"seq",++sequence,

    }
    public void client(BedrockPacket packet){
        try{
            if(packet instanceof PlayerAuthInputPacket input){
                synchronized(this){rawInput=fields("tick",input.getTick(),"position",input.getPosition().toString(),"delta",String.valueOf(input.getDelta()),"input",input.getInputData().toString(),
                        "motion",String.valueOf(input.getMotion()),"rawMoveVector",String.valueOf(input.getRawMoveVector()),"rotation",String.valueOf(input.getRotation()));
                    recentInputs.addLast(Map.copyOf(rawInput));while(recentInputs.size()>8)recentInputs.removeFirst();
                    if(motionTraceInputs>0){event("motion_input_raw",fields("rawInput",rawInput));motionTraceInputs--;}}
                if(input.getPlayerActions()!=null&&!input.getPlayerActions().isEmpty())event("client_block_actions",fields("actions",input.getPlayerActions().toString()));
            }else if(packet instanceof NetworkStackLatencyPacket latency){
                synchronized(this){if(motionTraceInputs>0)event("motion_latency_response",fields("timestamp",latency.getTimestamp()));}
            }else if(packet instanceof PlayerActionPacket action){
                event("client_action",fields("action",String.valueOf(action.getAction()),"position",String.valueOf(action.getBlockPosition()),"face",action.getFace()));
            }else if(packet instanceof InventoryTransactionPacket transaction){
                event("client_transaction",fields("type",String.valueOf(transaction.getTransactionType()),"action",transaction.getActionType(),"position",String.valueOf(transaction.getBlockPosition())));
            }
        }catch(Throwable ignored){}
    }
    private Map<String,Object> movement(PredictionSample sample,float offset){
        var data=fields("offset",number(offset),"maxOffset",number(sample.getMaxOffset()),"rawInput",rawInput,
                "oldBox",box(sample.predictionStartBoundingBox),"clientBox",box(sample.boxAtProjectedPosition(sample.unvalidatedPosition)),
                "predictedBox",box(sample.boundingBox),"position",vec(sample.position),"clientFeet",vec(sample.unvalidatedPosition),
                "requested",vec(sample.beforeCollision),"resolved",vec(sample.afterCollision),"velocity",vec(sample.velocity),
                "clientDelta",vec(sample.unvalidatedTickEnd),"onGround",sample.onGround,"verticalCollision",sample.verticalCollision,

                "worldMinY",world.getMinY(),"worldMaxY",world.getHeightY(),"airNetworkId",world.airNetworkId(),"insideUnloaded",sample.insideUnloadedChunk,"candidate",sample.bestPossibility==null?null:sample.bestPossibility.getType().toString(),
                "disabledChecks",sample.disabledChecks.toString(),"input",sample.inputData.toString(),"encoderAttached",player.getEntityBatchEncoder()!=null);
        var pending=new ArrayList<Object>();int count=0;for(var ack:player.getLatencyUtil().sentQueue()){
            if(count++==12)break;pending.add(fields("id",ack.id(),"ours",ack.ours(),"ageMs",System.currentTimeMillis()-ack.ms()));
        }
        data.put("movementState",movementState());data.put("pendingAcks",pending);var previous=player.getLatencyUtil().prevAcceptedLatency;
        data.put("lastAcceptedAck",previous==null?null:previous.id());return data;
    }
    public synchronized void terrainWait(PredictionSample sample){
        try{record("collision_wait_terrain",movement(sample,Float.NaN),true);}catch(Throwable ignored){}
    }
    public synchronized void frame(PredictionSample sample,float offset){
        try{
            Map<String,Object> data=movement(sample,offset);boolean emit=offset>=sample.getMaxOffset()
                    || sample.beforeCollision.squaredDistanceTo(sample.afterCollision)>1.0E-10F || motionTraceInputs>0;
            if(emit)data.put("selectedShapes",shapes(sample.movementCollisionEntries,24));
            record("collision_frame",data,emit);
        }catch(Throwable ignored){}
    }
    public synchronized void phase(PredictionSample sample,String reason,float offset,CollisionShapeEntry hit){
        try{
            Map<String,Object> data=movement(sample,offset);data.put("reason",reason);data.put("hit",shape(hit));
            data.put("selectedShapes",shapes(sample.movementCollisionEntries,64));data.put("nearClient",near(sample.unvalidatedPosition));
            data.put("nearPredicted",near(sample.position));var recent=new ArrayList<>(history);data.put("history",recent.subList(Math.max(0,recent.size()-48),recent.size()));

            var entry=fields("time",java.time.Instant.now().toString(),"session",session,"seq",++sequence,
                    "event","phase_hit","player",player.getName(),"tick",sample.tick,"dimension",world.dimension(),"epoch",world.getBlockBreakEpoch());
            entry.putAll(data);sink.accept(entry);
        }catch(Throwable ignored){}
    }
    private List<Object> near(Vec3 position){
        var result=new ArrayList<Object>();if(!Float.isFinite(position.x)||!Float.isFinite(position.y)||!Float.isFinite(position.z))return result;
        long bx=(long)Math.floor(position.x),by=(long)Math.floor(position.y),bz=(long)Math.floor(position.z);
        for(int dy=-1;dy<=2;dy++)for(int dx=-1;dx<=1;dx++)for(int dz=-1;dz<=1;dz++){
            long x=bx+dx,y=by+dy,z=bz+dz;if(x<Integer.MIN_VALUE||x>Integer.MAX_VALUE||y<Integer.MIN_VALUE||y>Integer.MAX_VALUE||z<Integer.MIN_VALUE||z>Integer.MAX_VALUE)continue;
            int id=world.getRawBlockAt((int)x,(int)y,(int)z,0);
            var cell=fields("position",List.of(x,y,z),"networkId",id,"columnLoaded",world.isChunkLoaded((int)x,(int)z),"sectionKnown",world.isSectionKnown((int)x,(int)y,(int)z));
            try{cell.put("state",state(world.networkBlockState(id)));}catch(RuntimeException error){cell.put("stateError",error.toString());}
            result.add(cell);
        }
        return result;
    }
    private static List<Object> shapes(List<CollisionShapeEntry> entries,int limit){var result=new ArrayList<Object>();for(var entry:entries){if(result.size()==limit)break;result.add(shape(entry));}return result;}
    private static Map<String,Object> shape(CollisionShapeEntry entry){return fields("box",box(entry.shape()),"block",state(entry.block()));}
    private static Map<String,Object> state(NetworkBlockState state){return state==null?null:fields("networkId",state.networkId(),"name",state.identifier(),"legacyFullId",state.legacyFullId(),"metadata",state.blockData(),"state",state.stateTag());}
    private static Object number(float f){return Float.isFinite(f)?f:Float.toString(f);}
    private static List<Object> vec(Vec3 v){return List.of(number(v.x),number(v.y),number(v.z));}
    private static List<Object> box(Box b){return List.of(number(b.minX),number(b.minY),number(b.minZ),number(b.maxX),number(b.maxY),number(b.maxZ));}


    private static final class FileSink {
        static final Path PATH=Path.of(System.getProperty("navro.worldCollisionLog","logs/world-collision.jsonl"));
        static final FileSink INSTANCE=new FileSink();
        final ArrayBlockingQueue<Map<String,Object>> queue=new ArrayBlockingQueue<>(256);
        final AtomicLong dropped=new AtomicLong();final Thread worker;volatile boolean stopping;
        FileSink(){worker=new Thread(this::run,"navro-world-collision-log");worker.setDaemon(true);worker.start();Runtime.getRuntime().addShutdownHook(new Thread(()->{stopping=true;try{worker.join(3000);}catch(InterruptedException ignored){Thread.currentThread().interrupt();}},"navro-world-log-close"));}
        void offer(Map<String,Object> entry){if(!queue.offer(entry)){
            dropped.incrementAndGet();if("phase_hit".equals(entry.get("event"))){queue.poll();if(!queue.offer(entry))dropped.incrementAndGet();}
        }}
        void run(){
            Gson gson=new Gson();BufferedWriter writer=null;long size=0;
            try{
                Files.createDirectories(PATH.toAbsolutePath().getParent());size=Files.exists(PATH)?Files.size(PATH):0;
                writer=Files.newBufferedWriter(PATH,StandardCharsets.UTF_8,StandardOpenOption.CREATE,StandardOpenOption.APPEND);
                while(!stopping||!queue.isEmpty()){
                    Map<String,Object> entry=queue.poll(250,TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);if(entry==null){writer.flush();continue;}
                    long lost=dropped.getAndSet(0);if(lost>0){entry=new LinkedHashMap<>(entry);entry.put("droppedLogRecords",lost);}
                    String line=gson.toJson(entry);long bytes=line.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8).length+1L;
                    if(size+bytes>8L*1024*1024){writer.close();Path one=Path.of(PATH+".1"),two=Path.of(PATH+".2");if(Files.exists(one))Files.move(one,two,StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);if(Files.exists(PATH))Files.move(PATH,one,StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);writer=Files.newBufferedWriter(PATH,StandardCharsets.UTF_8,StandardOpenOption.CREATE,StandardOpenOption.TRUNCATE_EXISTING);size=0;}
                    writer.write(line);writer.newLine();size+=bytes;if(queue.isEmpty())writer.flush();
                }
            }catch(Exception error){System.err.println("[NavroProxy] World/collision diagnostic output failed: "+error);}
            finally{if(writer!=null)try{writer.close();}catch(IOException ignored){}}
        }
    }
}
```
