`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/listener/PacketListener.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.listener;

import ac.navro.proxy.SessionState;
import ac.navro.proxy.check.impl.timer.NegativeTimer;
import ac.navro.proxy.check.impl.timer.Timer;
import ac.navro.proxy.packets.input.AuthInputClock;
import ac.navro.proxy.check.api.impl.PacketCheck;
import ac.navro.proxy.state.WirePlayerState;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.AttributeData;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerActionType;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.BedrockPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.DeathInfoPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.PlayerActionPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.PlayerAuthInputPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.RespawnPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.SetHealthPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.UpdateAttributesPacket;



public final class PacketListener {
    private PacketListener() { }

    public static boolean onPacketReceived(SessionState state, BedrockPacket packet,
                                            long maxBalanceAdvantageMS) {
        WirePlayerState player = state.player();
        NegativeTimer negativeTimer = (NegativeTimer) player.getCheckHolder().get(NegativeTimer.class);
        if ((packet instanceof RespawnPacket respawn && respawn.getState() == RespawnPacket.State.CLIENT_READY
                || packet instanceof PlayerActionPacket action && action.getAction() == PlayerActionType.RESPAWN)
                && player.acknowledgedDead) {
            negativeTimer.onRespawn();
        }
        if(packet instanceof PlayerAuthInputPacket input && !AuthInputClock.begin(state,input))return false;
        if (player.isExempted()) return true;
        if (packet instanceof org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.MovementPredictionSyncPacket sync) {
            state.observePredictionSync(sync);
        }
        player.setMaxBalanceAdvantageMs(maxBalanceAdvantageMS);
        if (packet instanceof PlayerAuthInputPacket input) {
            Timer timer = (Timer) player.getCheckHolder().get(Timer.class);
            if (player.checkEnabled(Timer.class) && timer.isInvalid()) {
                state.observeRejectedClient(packet, "Timer", "rejected tick=" + input.getTick());
                state.correctRejectedTimerInput();
                return false;
            }
            if(player.checkEnabled(NegativeTimer.class))negativeTimer.onAuthInput(input);
        }
        for (PacketCheck check : player.getCheckHolder().packetChecks()) {
            if (check.onPacketReceive(packet, false)) {
                state.observeRejectedClient(packet, check.getClass().getSimpleName(), "cancelled by packet check");
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static void onPacketSent(WirePlayerState player, BedrockPacket packet) {
        if (packet instanceof DeathInfoPacket
                || packet instanceof RespawnPacket respawn && respawn.getState() == RespawnPacket.State.SERVER_SEARCHING) {
            player.queueAcknowledgment(packet, () -> onDeath(player));
        } else if (packet instanceof RespawnPacket respawn && respawn.getState() == RespawnPacket.State.SERVER_READY) {
            player.queueAcknowledgment(packet, () -> onRespawn(player));
        } else if (packet instanceof SetHealthPacket health) {
            int value = health.getHealth();
            player.queueAcknowledgment(packet, () -> onHealth(player, value));
        } else if (packet instanceof UpdateAttributesPacket attributes
                && attributes.getRuntimeEntityId() == player.runtimeId()) {
            for (AttributeData attribute : attributes.getAttributes()) {
                if (!"minecraft:health".equals(attribute.getName())) continue;
                float value = attribute.getValue();
                player.queueAcknowledgment(packet, () -> onHealth(player, value));
            }
        }
    }

    private static void onDeath(WirePlayerState player) {
        player.acknowledgedDead = true;
        player.acknowledgeMovementHealth(false);
        var timer = player.getCheckHolder().get(NegativeTimer.class);
        if (timer instanceof NegativeTimer negativeTimer) negativeTimer.onDeath();
    }

    private static void onHealth(WirePlayerState player, float value) {
        if (value <= 0) {
            onDeath(player);
        } else {
            player.acknowledgeMovementHealth(true);
            onRespawn(player);
        }
    }

    private static void onRespawn(WirePlayerState player) {
        if (!player.acknowledgedDead) return;
        player.acknowledgedDead = false;
        var timer = player.getCheckHolder().get(NegativeTimer.class);
        if (timer instanceof NegativeTimer negativeTimer) negativeTimer.onRespawn();
    }

}
```

```java
    NetherNetBatchSession(PublicKey transportKey, KeyPair backendKey, boolean detect,
                          ac.navro.proxy.protocol.BackendType backendType, boolean smoothSetback,
                          boolean backendStateSync, InetAddress forwardedPeer) {
        this.forwardedPeer = forwardedPeer;
        this.state = new SessionState(backendType);
        state.setSmoothSetback(smoothSetback);
        this.transportKey=transportKey;this.backendKey=backendKey;this.detect=detect;
        state.setDetectionEnabled(detect);
        if (backendStateSync) state.setBackendSyncTransport(this::queueBackend);
        if (backendType == ac.navro.proxy.protocol.BackendType.BDS)
            state.setBdsCorrectionAcknowledgmentDispatcher(correctionAcknowledgments::defer);
        state.player().setTransportAcknowledgment((packet,task)->pending.add(task));
        if(detect){
            state.player().setFormattedAlertSink(message -> {
                NetherNetAlerts.ALERTS.formattedAlert(message);
                state.forwardBackendAlert(message);
            });
            state.player().setAlertSink(message -> state.player().formattedAlert(NetherNetAlerts.ALERTS.getPrefix() + "§3" + message));
            state.player().setDisconnectSink(this::kick);
            state.player().setCorrectionRequestSink(message->System.out.println("[NetherNet] "+message));
            state.player().setMaxBalanceAdvantageMs(8500);
            state.setTeleportTransport(packet->{
                if(!ready())return false;
                state.onProxyTeleport(packet);queueClient(packet);return true;
            });
            state.setPredictionMotionTransport(packet->{if(!ready())return false;queueClient(packet);return true;});
            state.setSoftCorrectionTransport(packet->{
                if(!ready())return false;
                state.onProxyPredictionCorrection(packet);queueClient(packet);return true;
            });
            state.player().setTimerTeleport(()->state.teleports().teleport(state.teleports().getLastKnowValid()));
            state.setClientStateCorrectionTransport(this::queueClient);
            state.setBlockCorrectionTransport((position,blocks)->ac.navro.proxy.util.block.BlockUtil.restoreCorrectBlock(
                    packet->{state.onProxyBlockCorrection(packet);queueClient(packet);},position,
                    definitions.blockDefinition(blocks.layerZero()),definitions.blockDefinition(blocks.layerOne())));
            state.placementPipeline().setTransports(packet->{
                state.onClientPacketForwarded(packet);queueBackend(packet);return true;
            },this::queueClient);
            state.player().setWorldDiagnostics(new ac.navro.proxy.diagnostics.WorldCollisionDiagnostics(
                    state.player(),state.world(),UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
                    ac.navro.proxy.diagnostics.WorldCollisionDiagnostics.fileSink()));
        }
    }
    private boolean ready(){return !closed&&codec!=null&&state.player().runtimeId()>=0;}
    public SessionState state(){return state;}
    public Map<String,Long> counts(){return Map.copyOf(counts);}
    public boolean authenticated(){return authenticated;}
    public String backendDisconnect(){return backendDisconnect;}
    public String mode(){return detect?"DETECT":"INSPECT";}
    void setRuntimePalettes(Map<Integer, RuntimePalette> palettes) { runtimePalettes = palettes; }
    void setOperatorCommandTable(boolean restrict) { operatorCommandTable = restrict; }
    private void protocol(int version)throws IOException{
        codec=SupportedCodecs.forProtocol(version);
        if(codec==null)throw new IOException("Unsupported NetherNet Bedrock protocol "+version);
        state.setProtocolVersion(version);state.player().setProtocolVersion(version);
        state.setRuntimeBlockPalette(runtimePalettes.get(version));
        clientHelper=codec.createHelper();backendHelper=codec.createHelper();
        definitions.configure(clientHelper,false);definitions.configure(backendHelper,true);
    }
    public Result process(boolean backend,byte[] batch)throws Exception{
        if(closed)throw new IOException("Session closed");
        if(state.player().disconnectRequested())throw new IOException("Player disconnected by Navro punishment");
        byte[] payload=unpack(batch);
        var stream=Unpooled.wrappedBuffer(payload);var kept=Unpooled.buffer();
        var names=new ArrayList<String>();boolean changed=false;
        byte[] forwarded;
        try{
            while(stream.isReadable()){
                if(state.player().disconnectRequested()){changed=true;break;}
                int size=VarInts.readUnsignedInt(stream);
                if(size<=0||size>stream.readableBytes())throw new IOException("Invalid NetherNet packet frame size");
                var frame=stream.readSlice(size);var original=frame.duplicate();boolean keep=true;
                byte[] replacement=null, commandTableUpdate=null;
                int header=VarInts.readUnsignedInt(frame),id=header&1023;
                if((header>>>10)!=0)throw new IOException("NetherNet subclients are not supported yet");
                if(codec==null){
                    if(backend||id!=193||frame.readableBytes()!=4)throw new IOException("Expected RequestNetworkSettings first");
                    protocol(frame.getInt(frame.readerIndex()));
                }
                var packet=codec.tryDecode(backend?backendHelper:clientHelper,frame,id);
                try{
                    if(frame.isReadable())throw new IOException("Trailing bytes in "+packet.getClass().getSimpleName());
                    names.add(packet.getClass().getSimpleName());
                    counts.merge((backend?"backend:":"client:")+packet.getClass().getSimpleName(),1L,Long::sum);
                    if(ac.navro.proxy.backend.BackendStateSync.privatePacket(packet)) {
                        if(backend)state.consumeBackendSync(packet);
                        keep=false;
                    }else if(backend){
                        if (packet instanceof StartGamePacket start && !runtimePalettes.isEmpty()
                                && !start.isBlockNetworkIdsHashed() && (start.getBlockPalette() == null || start.getBlockPalette().isEmpty())
                                && !runtimePalettes.containsKey(state.world().protocolVersion()) && !state.backendSync().hasRuntimePalette())
                            throw new IOException("No runtime block palette for protocol " + state.world().protocolVersion());
                        String violation=state.validateBackend(packet);
                        if(violation!=null)throw new IOException("Invalid backend packet: "+violation);
                        if(packet instanceof DisconnectPacket disconnect)
                            backendDisconnect=String.valueOf(disconnect.getReason())+": "+disconnect.getKickMessage();
                        if(packet instanceof NetworkSettingsPacket settings){
                            if(settings.getCompressionAlgorithm()!=PacketCompressionAlgorithm.ZLIB)
                                throw new IOException("NetherNet adapter requires ZLIB compression");
                            compressed=true;
                        }
                        if(packet instanceof NetworkStackLatencyPacket latency)NetworkLatencyPackets.onPacketSend(state.player(),latency);
                        definitions.observeBackend(packet);
                        PacketListener.onPacketSent(state.player(),packet);
                        state.observeBackend(packet);state.onBackendPacketQueued(packet);
                        commandTableUpdate = observeCommandPermissions(packet);
                        if (packet instanceof AvailableCommandsPacket commands) {
                            if (detect) proxyCommandNames = state.isPocketMineBackend()
                                    ? NavroCommand.unclaimedNames(commands) : NavroCommand.advertise(commands);
                            if (operatorCommandTable && !state.isPocketMineBackend()) {
                                keep = permissions.isOperator();
                                commandTableVisible = keep;
                                if (!keep) withheldCommandTable = encodeFrame(commands);
                            }
                        }
                        if(keep&&(packet instanceof NetworkStackLatencyPacket||detect&&(
                                packet instanceof AvailableCommandsPacket && !state.isPocketMineBackend()
                                ||
                                packet instanceof MovePlayerPacket move&&move.getRuntimeEntityId()==state.player().runtimeId()
                                ||packet instanceof SetEntityMotionPacket motion&&motion.getRuntimeEntityId()==state.player().runtimeId()
                                ||packet instanceof MovementEffectPacket effect&&effect.getEntityRuntimeId()==state.player().runtimeId())))
                            replacement=encodeFrame(packet);
                    }else{
                        if(forwardedPeer!=null&&!authenticated&&!(packet instanceof LoginPacket)
                                &&!(packet instanceof RequestNetworkSettingsPacket))
                            throw new IOException("NetherNet packet received before frontend login");




                        if (packet instanceof ClientCacheStatusPacket cache) {
                            cache.setSupported(false);
                            replacement=encodeFrame(packet);
                        }
                        if(packet instanceof LoginPacket login){var translated=verifyLogin(login);if(translated!=null)replacement=encodeFrame(translated);}
                        boolean ownLatency=packet instanceof NetworkStackLatencyPacket latency&&NetworkLatencyPackets.onPacket(state.player(),latency);
                        if(packet instanceof ServerboundLoadingScreenPacket loading)ServerChunkPackets.finishLoadingScreen(state.player(),loading);
                        if(detect){
                            keep=state.receiveClient(packet,8500)&&!ownLatency;
                            if(keep&&packet instanceof CommandRequestPacket command&&identity!=null){
                                keep=!NavroCommand.handle(command.getCommand(),new NavroCommand.Sender(){
                                    public UUID identity(){return identity;}
                                    public String name(){return state.player().getName();}
                                    public boolean hasPermission(String node){return NetherNetAlerts.PERMISSIONS.hasPermission(identity,node,permissions.isOperator());}
                                    public void sendMessage(String message){NetherNetBatchSession.this.sendMessage(message);}
                                },NetherNetAlerts.ALERTS,NetherNetAlerts.commands(),proxyCommandNames);
                            }
                            if(state.player().disconnectRequested())keep=false;
                            if(keep){
                                state.onClientPacketForwarded(packet);
                                if(packet instanceof PlayerAuthInputPacket||packet instanceof InventoryTransactionPacket)replacement=encodeFrame(packet);
                            }
                        }else{state.observeClient(packet);keep=!ownLatency;}
                    }
                }finally{ReferenceCountUtil.safeRelease(packet);}
                if(replacement!=null)changed=true;
                if(!keep){changed=true;continue;}
                if(detect&&!backend){


                    byte[] bytes=replacement;
                    if(bytes==null){bytes=new byte[size];original.readBytes(bytes);}
                    backendQueue.add(wrapFrame(bytes));changed=true;
                }else{
                    VarInts.writeUnsignedInt(kept,replacement==null?size:replacement.length);
                    if(replacement==null)kept.writeBytes(original);else kept.writeBytes(replacement);
                    if (commandTableUpdate != null) {
                        VarInts.writeUnsignedInt(kept, commandTableUpdate.length);
                        kept.writeBytes(commandTableUpdate);
                        changed = true;
                    }
                }
            }
            if(state.player().disconnectRequested())backendQueue.clear();
            correctionAcknowledgments.commit();
            if(!changed)forwarded=batch;
            else if(!kept.isReadable())forwarded=null;
            else{
                forwarded=new byte[kept.readableBytes()+(compressed?1:0)];
                if(compressed)forwarded[0]=(byte)255;
                kept.readBytes(forwarded,compressed?1:0,kept.readableBytes());
            }
        }finally{stream.release();kept.release();}
        return flush(forwarded,names,false);
    }
    private byte[] observeCommandPermissions(BedrockPacket packet) throws Exception {
        boolean wasOperator = permissions.isOperator();
        permissions.observe(state.player(), packet);
        if (!operatorCommandTable || state.isPocketMineBackend()) return null;
        if (packet instanceof StartGamePacket) {
            withheldCommandTable = null;
            commandTableVisible = false;
            return null;
        }
        boolean isOperator = permissions.isOperator();
        if (isOperator == wasOperator) return null;
        if (isOperator && withheldCommandTable != null) {
            byte[] table = withheldCommandTable;
            withheldCommandTable = null;
            commandTableVisible = true;
            return table;
        }
        if (!isOperator && commandTableVisible) {
            commandTableVisible = false;
            return encodeFrame(new AvailableCommandsPacket());
        }
        return null;
    }


    public Result tick()throws Exception{
        if(closed)throw new IOException("Session closed");
        if(state.player().disconnectRequested())throw new IOException("Player disconnected by Navro punishment");
        if(detect&&authenticated&&ready()){
            state.placementTick();
            var oldest=state.player().getLatencyUtil().sentQueue().peekFirst();long now=System.currentTimeMillis();
            if(oldest!=null&&now-oldest.ms()>state.maxLatencyWait()
                    &&now-state.player().getLatencyUtil().prevAcceptedTime>state.maxLatencyWait())
                state.player().requestDisconnect(state.configuredMessage("disconnect-timeout",Map.of()));
        }
        return flush(null,List.of(),detect&&authenticated&&ready()&&state.player().getLatencyUtil().sentQueue().isEmpty());
    }
    private Result flush(byte[] forwarded,List<String> names,boolean keepalive)throws Exception{
        var extra=new ArrayList<>(clientQueue);clientQueue.clear();
        for(String message;(message=messages.poll())!=null;){
            var packet=new TextPacket();packet.setType(TextPacket.Type.RAW);packet.setMessage(message);packet.setNeedsTranslation(false);
            packet.setSourceName("");packet.setXuid("");packet.setPlatformChatId("");extra.add(encode(packet));
        }
        if(!state.player().disconnectRequested()&&codec!=null&&(!pending.isEmpty()||!extra.isEmpty()||keepalive)){
            var tasks=List.copyOf(pending);pending.clear();
            long id=MARKER.updateAndGet(v->v>=999_000_000L?700_000_000L:v+1);
            state.player().getLatencyUtil().queue(id,true,()->tasks.forEach(Runnable::run));
            var marker=new NetworkStackLatencyPacket();marker.setTimestamp(id);marker.setFromServer(true);extra.add(encode(marker));
        }
        var upstream=List.copyOf(backendQueue);backendQueue.clear();
        return new Result(forwarded,List.copyOf(extra),upstream,List.copyOf(names),authenticated);
    }
    private void queueClient(BedrockPacket packet){try{clientQueue.add(encode(packet));}catch(Exception e){throw new IllegalStateException("Cannot encode NetherNet correction",e);}}
    private void queueBackend(BedrockPacket packet){try{backendQueue.add(encode(packet));}catch(Exception e){throw new IllegalStateException("Cannot encode deferred NetherNet transaction",e);}}
    private void sendMessage(String message){
        messages.add(message);
    }
    private void kick(String reason){
        var packet=new DisconnectPacket();
        packet.setReason(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.DisconnectFailReason.KICKED);
        packet.setMessageSkipped(false);packet.setKickMessage(reason);
        backendQueue.clear();clientQueue.clear();messages.clear();pending.clear();
        queueClient(packet);
    }
    private LoginPacket verifyLogin(LoginPacket login)throws Exception{
        if(authenticated||transportKey==null||login.getAuthPayload()==null||login.getAuthPayload().getAuthType()==AuthType.GUEST)
            throw new IOException("NetherNet login has no authenticated transport identity");
        var chain=EncryptionUtils.validatePayload(login.getAuthPayload());
        if(!chain.signed())throw new IOException("Invalid NetherNet login signature");
        var key=chain.identityClaims().parsedIdentityPublicKey();
        if(!MessageDigest.isEqual(key.getEncoded(),transportKey.getEncoded()))throw new IOException("NetherNet transport public key differs from login key");
        byte[] clientData=EncryptionUtils.verifyClientData(login.getClientJwt(),key);
        if(clientData==null)throw new IOException("Invalid NetherNet client data signature");
        var verified=ac.navro.proxy.protocol.LoginIdentity.fromVerifiedChain(chain);
        identity=verified.uuid();state.player().setName(verified.displayName());authenticated=true;
        state.setExemptionPermission(() -> NetherNetAlerts.PERMISSIONS.hasPermission(identity,"navro.exempt",false));
        try{state.player().setDeviceOs(com.google.gson.JsonParser.parseString(new String(clientData,java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8)).getAsJsonObject().get("DeviceOS").getAsInt());}
        catch(RuntimeException e){state.player().setDeviceOs(-1);}
        if(detect){NetherNetAlerts.register(identity,alertRecipient);NetherNetAlerts.commands().attach(identity,state);}
        if(backendKey==null)return null;
        if(forwardedPeer!=null){
            String xuid=chain.identityClaims().extraData.xuid;
            if(xuid==null||!xuid.matches("[0-9]{1,20}"))throw new IOException("Verified login is missing a valid XUID");
            var data=com.google.gson.JsonParser.parseString(new String(clientData,java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8)).getAsJsonObject();
            data.addProperty("Waterdog_XUID",xuid);
            data.addProperty("Waterdog_IP",forwardedPeer.getHostAddress());
            clientData=data.toString().getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        }
        return ac.navro.proxy.protocol.PrivateBackendLogin.encode(login.getProtocolVersion(),verified,chain.rawIdentityClaims(),clientData,backendKey);
    }
    private byte[] unpack(byte[] batch)throws IOException,DataFormatException{
        if(batch.length==0||batch.length>MAX_BATCH)throw new IOException("Invalid NetherNet batch length");
        if(!compressed)return batch;
        int type=Byte.toUnsignedInt(batch[0]);
        if(type==255)return Arrays.copyOfRange(batch,1,batch.length);
        if(type!=0)throw new IOException("Unsupported NetherNet compression prefix "+type);
        var inflater=new Inflater(true);inflater.setInput(batch,1,batch.length-1);
        try(var out=new ByteArrayOutputStream()){
            byte[] block=new byte[8192];
            while(!inflater.finished()){
                int n=inflater.inflate(block);if(n==0)throw new IOException("Truncated/invalid NetherNet compressed batch");
                if(out.size()+n>MAX_BATCH)throw new IOException("NetherNet decompressed batch exceeds limit");out.write(block,0,n);
            }
            if(inflater.getRemaining()!=0)throw new IOException("Trailing NetherNet compressed data");return out.toByteArray();
        }finally{inflater.end();}
    }
    public byte[] encode(BedrockPacket packet)throws Exception{return wrapFrame(encodeFrame(packet));}
    private byte[] wrapFrame(byte[] frame){
        var batch=Unpooled.buffer();try{
            if(compressed)batch.writeByte(255);VarInts.writeUnsignedInt(batch,frame.length);batch.writeBytes(frame);
            byte[] result=new byte[batch.readableBytes()];batch.readBytes(result);return result;
        }finally{batch.release();}
    }
    private byte[] encodeFrame(BedrockPacket packet)throws Exception{
        var frame=Unpooled.buffer();try{
            VarInts.writeUnsignedInt(frame,codec.getPacketDefinition(packet.getClass()).getId());codec.tryEncode(backendHelper,frame,packet);
            byte[] result=new byte[frame.readableBytes()];frame.readBytes(result);return result;
        }finally{frame.release();}
    }
    @Override public void close(){
        closed=true;withheldCommandTable=null;state.closeBackendWorld();state.player().getLatencyUtil().close();pending.clear();clientQueue.clear();backendQueue.clear();messages.clear();
        if(identity!=null&&detect){NetherNetAlerts.remove(identity,alertRecipient);NetherNetAlerts.commands().detach(identity,state);}
    }
}
```

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.nethernet;

import com.google.gson.Gson;
import ac.navro.proxy.data.block.NetworkBlockStateRegistry;
import ac.navro.proxy.data.block.NetworkBlockStateRegistry.RuntimePalette;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.io.*;
import java.net.*;
import java.security.KeyFactory;
import java.security.spec.X509EncodedKeySpec;
import java.security.spec.PKCS8EncodedKeySpec;
import java.security.KeyPair;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.concurrent.*;


public final class NetherNetInspectServer {
    private static final int DETECT_BRIDGE_MAGIC = 0x4e564234;
    private static final int GROUPED_BRIDGE_MAGIC = 0x4e564235;
    private static final int STOCK_BACKEND_MAGIC = 0x4e564236;
    private static final int MAX_GROUP_COUNT = 64;
    private static final int MAX_GROUP_BYTES = 2 * 1024 * 1024;

    public static void main(String[] args)throws Exception{
        if(System.getProperty("navro.worldCollisionLog")==null)
            System.setProperty("navro.worldCollisionLog","logs/world-collision-nethernet.jsonl");
        int port=args.length==0?19138:Integer.parseInt(args[0]);
        var backendType = ac.navro.proxy.protocol.BackendType.NAVRO;
        boolean smoothSetback = false;
        boolean stockBackend = false;
        boolean operatorCommandTable = false;
        boolean backendStateSync = false;
        var palettes = new HashMap<Integer, RuntimePalette>();
        for (int i = 1; i < args.length; i++) {
            switch(args[i]) {
                case "--backend-type" -> {
                    if(++i >= args.length) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing backend type");
                    backendType = ac.navro.proxy.protocol.BackendType.parse(args[i]);
                }
                case "--smooth-setback" -> smoothSetback = true;
                case "--stock-geyser-backend" -> stockBackend = true;
                case "--operator-command-table" -> operatorCommandTable = true;
                case "--backend-state-sync" -> backendStateSync = true;
                case "--block-palette" -> {
                    if (++i >= args.length) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing block palette path");
                    var palette = NetworkBlockStateRegistry.readRuntimePalette(Path.of(args[i]));
                    if (palettes.putIfAbsent(palette.protocol(), palette) != null)
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate block palette for protocol " + palette.protocol());
                    System.out.println("NETHERNET_PALETTE_LOADED protocol=" + palette.protocol() + " states=" + palette.size());
                }
                default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown adapter option: " + args[i]);
            }
        }
        ac.navro.proxy.SupportedCodecs.forProtocol(2225);
        ac.navro.proxy.data.inventory.NativePredictionItems.initialize();
        NetherNetAlerts.configure(smoothSetback);
        ac.navro.proxy.command.ConsoleCommands.start(NetherNetAlerts.commands(),NetherNetAlerts.ALERTS);
        final var selectedBackend = backendType;
        final boolean selectedSmoothSetback = smoothSetback;
        final boolean allowStockBackend = stockBackend;
        final boolean restrictCommandTable = operatorCommandTable;
        final boolean allowBackendStateSync = backendStateSync;
        var selectedPalettes = Map.copyOf(palettes);
        var pool=new ThreadPoolExecutor(0,32,30,TimeUnit.SECONDS,new SynchronousQueue<>(),
                new ThreadPoolExecutor.AbortPolicy());
        try(var server=new ServerSocket()){
            server.bind(new InetSocketAddress(InetAddress.getLoopbackAddress(),port));
            System.out.println("NETHERNET_ADAPTER_READY loopback="+server.getLocalSocketAddress()+" mode=per_connection backendType="+backendType);
            while(true){var socket=server.accept();try{pool.execute(()->handle(socket, selectedBackend, selectedSmoothSetback, allowStockBackend, selectedPalettes, restrictCommandTable, allowBackendStateSync));}
                catch(RejectedExecutionException e){socket.close();}}
        }finally{pool.shutdownNow();}
    }
    private static void handle(Socket socket, ac.navro.proxy.protocol.BackendType backendType, boolean smoothSetback, boolean allowStockBackend, Map<Integer, RuntimePalette> palettes, boolean restrictCommandTable, boolean allowBackendStateSync){
        var gson=new Gson();
        try(socket;var in=new DataInputStream(new BufferedInputStream(socket.getInputStream()));
            var out=new DataOutputStream(new BufferedOutputStream(socket.getOutputStream()))){
            socket.setSoTimeout(30000);
            int magic=in.readInt();
            boolean stockBackend=magic==STOCK_BACKEND_MAGIC;
            if(stockBackend&&!allowStockBackend)throw new IOException("Stock Geyser backend mode is disabled");
            boolean grouped=stockBackend||magic==GROUPED_BRIDGE_MAGIC;
            boolean detectBridge=grouped||magic==DETECT_BRIDGE_MAGIC;
            boolean duplex=magic==0x4e564233||detectBridge;
            if(magic!=0x4e564231&&magic!=0x4e564232&&!duplex)throw new IOException("Invalid NetherNet IPC handshake");
            if(detectBridge)socket.setTcpNoDelay(true);
            int n=in.readInt();if(n<0||n>512)throw new IOException("Invalid transport key size");
            if(detectBridge&&n==0)throw new IOException("Missing verified NetherNet transport key");
            var key=n==0?null:KeyFactory.getInstance("EC").generatePublic(new X509EncodedKeySpec(in.readNBytes(n)));
            KeyPair backendKey=null;
            if(stockBackend||magic==0x4e564232||magic==0x4e564233){
                int publicSize=in.readInt();if(publicSize<1||publicSize>512)throw new IOException("Invalid backend public key size");
                var publicKey=KeyFactory.getInstance("EC").generatePublic(new X509EncodedKeySpec(in.readNBytes(publicSize)));
                int privateSize=in.readInt();if(privateSize<1||privateSize>1024)throw new IOException("Invalid backend private key size");
                byte[] privateBytes=in.readNBytes(privateSize);
                var privateKey=KeyFactory.getInstance("EC").generatePrivate(new PKCS8EncodedKeySpec(privateBytes));
                java.util.Arrays.fill(privateBytes,(byte)0);
                backendKey=new KeyPair(publicKey,privateKey);
            }
            InetAddress peerAddress=null;
            if(stockBackend){
                int addressLength=in.readUnsignedByte();
                if(addressLength!=4&&addressLength!=16)throw new IOException("Invalid frontend address size");
                peerAddress=InetAddress.getByAddress(in.readNBytes(addressLength));
                if(peerAddress.isAnyLocalAddress()||peerAddress.isMulticastAddress())
                    throw new IOException("Invalid frontend address");
            }
            boolean detect=detectBridge||magic==0x4e564233&&in.readBoolean();
            try(var session=new NetherNetBatchSession(key,backendKey,detect,backendType,smoothSetback,!detectBridge || stockBackend && allowBackendStateSync,peerAddress)){
                session.setRuntimePalettes(palettes);
                session.setOperatorCommandTable(restrictCommandTable);
                if(detectBridge){out.writeInt(magic);out.flush();}
                Set<String> observed=new HashSet<>();
                boolean verbose=!grouped||Boolean.getBoolean("navro.nethernet.trace-batches");
                long groups=0, requests=0;
                int largestGroup=0;
                try {
                    for(int lead;(lead=in.read())>=0;){
                        List<BridgeBatch> group=grouped?readBridgeGroup(in,lead)
                                :List.of(readBatch(in,lead,duplex,NetherNetBatchSession.MAX_BATCH));
                        groups++;
                        requests+=group.size();
                        largestGroup=Math.max(largestGroup,group.size());
                        for(BridgeBatch batch:group){
                            int direction=batch.direction();
                            var result=direction==2?session.tick():session.process(direction==1,batch.payload());
                            writeReply(out,result,duplex);
                            if(direction!=2&&(verbose||firstSeen(observed,direction,result.packets()))){
                                System.out.println(gson.toJson(Map.of("event","nethernet_batch","backend",direction==1,
                                        "packets",result.packets(),"authenticated",result.authenticated(),"mode",session.mode(),
                                        "clientPackets",result.clientbound().size(),"backendPackets",result.backendbound().size())));
                            }
                            if(direction==1&&result.packets().contains("DisconnectPacket")){
                                System.out.println(gson.toJson(Map.of("event","nethernet_backend_disconnect",
                                        "reason",session.backendDisconnect())));
                            }
                        }
                        out.flush();
                    }
                }finally{
                    System.out.println(gson.toJson(Map.of("event","nethernet_session_close","counts",session.counts(),
                            "ipcVersion",(magic&255)-'0',"groups",groups,"requests",requests,"largestGroup",largestGroup)));
                }
            }
        }catch(Exception|LinkageError e){

            var trace=new java.util.ArrayList<String>();
            for(Throwable cause=e;cause!=null&&trace.size()<24;cause=cause.getCause()){
                trace.add(cause.getClass().getSimpleName());
                for(var frame:cause.getStackTrace()){
                    if(trace.size()>=24)break;
                    trace.add(frame.getClassName()+"."+frame.getMethodName()+":"+frame.getLineNumber());
                }
            }
            System.out.println(gson.toJson(Map.of("event","nethernet_session_error","type",e.getClass().getSimpleName(),
                    "detail",e instanceof IOException?String.valueOf(e.getMessage()):"Native packet decode or identity validation failed","trace",trace)));
        }
    }

    static List<BridgeBatch> readBridgeGroup(DataInputStream in,int count)throws IOException{
        if(count<1||count>MAX_GROUP_COUNT)throw new IOException("Invalid NetherNet bridge group count");
        int remaining=count==1?NetherNetBatchSession.MAX_BATCH:MAX_GROUP_BYTES;
        var group=new ArrayList<BridgeBatch>(count);
        for(int index=0;index<count;index++){
            var batch=readBatch(in,in.readUnsignedByte(),true,remaining);
            remaining-=batch.payload().length;
            group.add(batch);
        }
        return group;
    }

    private static BridgeBatch readBatch(DataInputStream in,int direction,boolean duplex,int remaining)throws IOException{
        if(direction>2||direction==2&&!duplex)throw new IOException("Invalid batch direction");
        int size=in.readInt();
        if(size<0||(size==0)!=(direction==2)||size>remaining)throw new IOException("Invalid IPC batch size");
        byte[] batch=in.readNBytes(size);
        if(batch.length!=size)throw new EOFException("Incomplete IPC batch");
        return new BridgeBatch(direction,batch);
    }

    private static void writeReply(DataOutputStream out,NetherNetBatchSession.Result result,boolean duplex)throws IOException{
        out.writeInt(result.forwarded()==null?-1:result.forwarded().length);
        if(result.forwarded()!=null)out.write(result.forwarded());
        writeOutputs(out,result.clientbound());
        if(duplex)writeOutputs(out,result.backendbound());
    }

    private static void writeOutputs(DataOutputStream out,List<byte[]> outputs)throws IOException{
        out.writeInt(outputs.size());
        for(byte[] batch:outputs){out.writeInt(batch.length);out.write(batch);}
    }

    private static boolean firstSeen(Set<String> observed,int direction,List<String> packets){
        boolean first=false;
        for(String packet:packets)first|=observed.add(direction+packet);
        return first;
    }

    record BridgeBatch(int direction,byte[] payload) { }
}
```

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.packets.input;

import ac.navro.proxy.SessionState;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.PlayerAuthInputPacket;


public final class AuthInputClock {
    private AuthInputClock() { }
    public static boolean begin(SessionState session,PlayerAuthInputPacket input) {
        if(input.getTick()<0) {
            session.player().requestDisconnect(session.configuredMessage("disconnect-invalid-tick",
                    java.util.Map.of("tick",input.getTick())));
            session.observeRejectedClient(input,"invalidInputTick","negative client frame="+input.getTick());
            return false;
        }
        session.player().advanceInputClock(input);
        return true;
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/packets/input/AuthInputPackets.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.packets.input;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.live.PredictionContext;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.live.PredictionItemUse;
import ac.navro.proxy.packets.player.PlayerVelocityPackets;
import ac.navro.proxy.packets.input.legacy.LegacyAuthInputPackets;
import ac.navro.proxy.validator.blockbreak.ServerBreakBlockValidator;
import ac.navro.proxy.compensated.world.base.CompensatedWorld;
import ac.navro.proxy.state.WirePlayerState;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.ChangeDimensionPacket;

import ac.navro.proxy.data.input.PredictionData;


import ac.navro.proxy.collision.Collider;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.PredictionRunner;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.engine.data.Vector;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.fluid.FluidMovement;
import ac.navro.proxy.data.vanilla.GameType;
import ac.navro.proxy.check.api.impl.OffsetHandlerCheck;


import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.*;
import ac.navro.proxy.SessionState;
import ac.navro.proxy.collision.ProtocolEntityTolerance;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.PlayerAuthInputPacket;


public final class AuthInputPackets {
    private final SessionState session;
    private final PredictionContext player;
    private final PredictionItemUse itemUse;
    private Result lastResult;
    private final PlayerVelocityPackets velocityPackets;
    private final ServerBreakBlockValidator blockBreakValidator;

    public AuthInputPackets(SessionState session) {
        this.session=session;
        this.player=new PredictionContext(session);
        this.velocityPackets=new PlayerVelocityPackets(session, player);
        this.blockBreakValidator=new ServerBreakBlockValidator(new ServerBreakBlockValidator.Context() {
            public CompensatedWorld world(){return session.world();}
            public Vec3 position(){return session.player().position();}
            public ac.navro.proxy.data.vanilla.GameType gameType(){return session.player().gameType();}
            public String name(){return session.player().getName();}
            public void restoreCorrectBlock(org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector3i position){session.restoreCorrectBlock(position);}
        });
        this.itemUse=new PredictionItemUse(session);
        this.player.phaseObserver=(sample,reason,offset,entry)->{var trace=session.player().worldDiagnostics();if(trace!=null)trace.phase(sample,reason,offset,entry);};
        session.player().setPredictionInputHandler(input -> LegacyAuthInputPackets.processAuthInput(player, itemUse, input));
        session.player().setMovementMetadataContext(new ac.navro.proxy.state.MovementMetadataAdapter(session, itemUse));
        session.player().setPredictionRewind(session::rewindPrediction);
        session.player().getCheckHolder().registerPredictionHandlers(player);
    }
    public PredictionContext context(){return player;}
    public Result lastResult(){return lastResult;}

    public PredictionItemUse itemUse(){return itemUse;}
    public void reset(){
        player.uncertainVelocity=player.certainVelocity=null;
        player.stuckSpeedMultiplier=Vec3.ZERO.clone();player.lastTickFinalVelocity=session.player().velocity().clone();
        player.climbJumpDelay=player.scaffoldingSneakHoldTicks=player.ticksSinceCanSlowdown=0;
        player.bounceGravityCorrection=null;
        player.stopRiptide();
        player.beforeCollision=player.afterCollision=Vec3.ZERO.clone();
        player.velocity=session.player().velocity().clone();
        player.position=session.player().position().clone();player.boundingBox=session.player().boundingBox().clone();player.dimensions=session.player().dimensions();
        player.predictionStartBoundingBox=player.boundingBox.clone();
        player.predictionResult=new PredictionData(Vec3.ZERO.clone(),Vec3.ZERO.clone(),player.velocity.clone());
        player.bestPossibility=new Vector(ac.navro.proxy.prediction.engine.data.VectorType.NORMAL,Vec3.ZERO.clone());
        lastResult=null;
    }

    public void run(PlayerAuthInputPacket input){
        if (session.player().awaitingRespawnHealth() || session.awaitingBackendSpawnPosition()) return;
        player.begin();
        if(session.teleports().isTeleporting() || session.teleports().hasPendingBackendRewind() || !session.spawned())return;
        if(player.vehicleData!=null){
            session.player().setResolvedPosition(player.unvalidatedPosition,player.boundingBox,false,true);
            return;
        }
        if(session.player().predictionFlag(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.entity.EntityFlag.SLEEPING))return;
        if(session.player().isMovementExempted()){
            session.teleports().finishCorrectionCooldown();
            processExemptedMovement(session.player());
        }else if((!session.player().inLoadingScreen && session.player().sinceLoadingScreen>=2)
                || player.unvalidatedTickEnd.lengthSquared()>0){
            new PredictionRunner(player).run();
            player.syncWire();
        }else{
            player.velocity=Vec3.ZERO.clone();
            player.syncWire();
        }
        finishPrediction(input);
    }

    public void processExemptedMovement(){
        var wire=session.player();
        if (session.teleports().isTeleporting() || wire.awaitingRespawnHealth() || session.awaitingBackendSpawnPosition() || !session.spawned()
                || wire.vehicleData!=null || wire.predictionFlag(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.entity.EntityFlag.SLEEPING)) return;
        player.begin();
        processExemptedMovement(wire);
    }

    private void processExemptedMovement(WirePlayerState wire){
        if(!wire.inLoadingScreen && player.boundingBox.isValid() && !player.noClip()
                && wire.gameType()!=GameType.SPECTATOR && !wire.flying() && !wire.wasFlying()){
            new PredictionRunner(player).run();
            Vec3 target=wire.inputPositionTarget();
            if(player.inputPositionDistance(player.position)<player.maxOffset)
                Collider.acceptInputPosition(wire,session.collisionWorld(),target);
            else wire.rebasePosition(target,false);
            player.lastTickFinalVelocity=player.unvalidatedTickEnd.clone();
            player.predictionResult=new PredictionData(player.beforeCollision.clone(),player.afterCollision.clone(),
                    player.unvalidatedTickEnd.clone());
        }else{
            wire.setCollisionPenetratingFrames(0);
            player.collisionPhysics.reset();
            player.fallDistance=0;
            FluidMovement.finishInput(player);
            session.fluidState().resetMovement();
            player.fluidPrediction.load(session.fluidState());
            player.fluidPrediction.inputActive=false;
            player.fluidPrediction.swimSpeedMultiplier=1F;
            player.fluidPrediction.waterDrag=0.8F;
            player.bounceGravityCorrection=null;
            player.movementCollisionEntries=java.util.List.of();
            wire.setMovementCollisionEntries(java.util.List.of());
            wire.acceptPosition(player.unvalidatedPosition.clone());
            player.inBlockState=null;
            Vec3 after=player.velocity.y<0 && player.hasInput(PlayerAuthInputData.VERTICAL_COLLISION)
                    ? new Vec3(0,1,0) : Vec3.ZERO.clone();
            player.predictionResult=new PredictionData(Vec3.ZERO.clone(),after,player.unvalidatedTickEnd.clone());
        }
        player.position=wire.position().clone();
        player.boundingBox=wire.boundingBox().clone();
        player.certainVelocity=null;
        player.velocity=player.unvalidatedTickEnd.clone();
        wire.setVelocity(player.velocity);
        player.bestPossibility=Vector.NONE;
    }


    public void finishTeleportConfirmation(PlayerAuthInputPacket input) {
        player.begin();
        finishPrediction(input);
    }

    private void finishPrediction(PlayerAuthInputPacket input) {
        if(!session.spawned()) return;
        player.insideUnloadedChunk=!player.compensatedWorld.isChunkLoadedAt(player.position.x,player.position.z);
        if(player.insideUnloadedChunk){
            if(session.player().worldDiagnostics()!=null)session.player().worldDiagnostics().terrainWait(player);
            session.teleports().teleport(session.teleports().getLastKnowValid());
        }
        if(session.teleports().isTeleporting() || session.player().inLoadingScreen)return;

        session.cachePredictionFrame(player);
        float raw=player.inputPositionDistance(player.position),offset=raw;
        player.entityTolerance=session.sampleEntityTolerance().tolerance();
        if(player.entityTolerance.collided() && offset>=player.maxOffset)
            offset=ProtocolEntityTolerance.adjustedMotionOffset(player.lastTickFinalVelocity,player.unvalidatedTickEnd,player.entityTolerance);
        if(session.player().worldDiagnostics()!=null)session.player().worldDiagnostics().frame(player,offset);
        if(session.player().isMovementExempted()){
            session.player().completePredictionInput();
            lastResult=new Result(player.tick,raw,offset,player.position.clone(),player.lastTickFinalVelocity.clone(),true);
            return;
        }
        var elytra=(ac.navro.proxy.check.impl.elytra.ElytraA)session.player().getCheckHolder().get(
                ac.navro.proxy.check.impl.elytra.ElytraA.class);
        if(elytra!=null&&session.player().checkEnabled(elytra.getClass())&&elytra.onPredictionComplete(input)){
            LegacyAuthInputPackets.correctInputData(session.player(),input);
            session.player().completePredictionInput();
            lastResult=new Result(player.tick,raw,offset,player.position.clone(),player.lastTickFinalVelocity.clone(),false);
            return;
        }
        boolean checked=!player.insideUnloadedChunk && player.vehicleData==null
                && session.player().gameType()!=GameType.SPECTATOR && !session.teleports().isTeleporting();
        for(var check:session.player().getCheckHolder().values()){
            if(check instanceof OffsetHandlerCheck handler && session.player().checkEnabled(check.getClass()))
                handler.onPredictionComplete(offset,checked);
        }
        boolean blockPush=player.collisionPhysics.pushedByBlock();
        boolean canAcceptClientMovement=session.teleports().canAcceptClientMovement();
        if(player.entityTolerance.collided()){
            if(canAcceptClientMovement&&!blockPush){
                Vec3 position=ProtocolEntityTolerance.clampAccepted(player.position,player.unvalidatedPosition,player.entityTolerance);
                Vec3 motion=ProtocolEntityTolerance.clampAccepted(player.lastTickFinalVelocity,player.unvalidatedTickEnd,player.entityTolerance);
                session.player().rebasePosition(position,false);session.player().setVelocity(motion);
                player.collisionPhysics.acceptClientPosition();player.velocity=motion.clone();player.lastTickFinalVelocity=motion.clone();
                session.acceptValidatedMovementBaseline(session.player().snapshotAabb(),session.playerYOffset());
            }
        }else if(canAcceptClientMovement && player.velocity.distanceTo(player.unvalidatedTickEnd)<player.maxOffset){
            player.velocity=player.unvalidatedTickEnd.clone();session.player().setVelocity(player.velocity);
        }
        LegacyAuthInputPackets.correctInputData(session.player(), input);
        if(!player.entityTolerance.collided() && offset<player.maxOffset && canAcceptClientMovement)
            ac.navro.proxy.collision.Collider.acceptInputPosition(session.player(),session.collisionWorld(),session.player().inputPositionTarget());
        session.teleports().finishCorrectionCooldown();
        session.player().completePredictionInput();
        lastResult=new Result(player.tick,raw,offset,player.position.clone(),player.lastTickFinalVelocity.clone(),!session.teleports().isTeleporting());
    }
    public record Result(long tick,float rawOffset,float checkedOffset,Vec3 predictedPosition,Vec3 predictedVelocity,boolean accepted){}
    public PlayerVelocityPackets velocityPackets(){return velocityPackets;}


    public void beforeInput(PlayerAuthInputPacket input){
        boolean digging=input.getInputData().contains(PlayerAuthInputData.PERFORM_BLOCK_ACTIONS);
        long revision=session.world().bucketPredictionRevision();
        blockBreakValidator.handle(input);
        var log=session.player().worldDiagnostics();
        if(digging && log!=null)log.event("block_break_validated",
                ac.navro.proxy.diagnostics.WorldCollisionDiagnostics.fields(
                        "inputTick",input.getTick(),"actions",input.getPlayerActions().toString(),
                        "revisionBefore",revision,"revisionAfter",session.world().bucketPredictionRevision()));
        var report = session.player().predictionSync().consume();
        if (report != null && log != null) log.predictionSyncAtInput(input.getTick(), report);
    }

    public static void onPacketSend(WirePlayerState player, CompensatedWorld world,
                                     ChangeDimensionPacket packet, Runnable acknowledgedReset) {
        final int dimension = packet.getDimension();
        final Integer loadingScreenId = packet.getLoadingScreenId();
        player.queueAcknowledgment(packet, () -> {
            if (dimension != world.dimension()) {
                player.currentLoadingScreen = loadingScreenId;
                player.inLoadingScreen = true;
                player.loadingScreenStartMs=System.currentTimeMillis();
            }

            acknowledgedReset.run();
        });
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/packets/input/ClientMovementPredictionSyncPacket.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.packets.input;

import ac.navro.proxy.util.EntityMetadataUtil;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.MovementPredictionSyncPacket;

import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Set;

public final class ClientMovementPredictionSyncPacket extends MovementPredictionSyncPacket {
    private Set<Integer> unknownFlags = Set.of();

    public void captureFlags(Set<Integer> flags) {
        getFlags().clear();
        var unknown = new HashSet<Integer>();
        for (int flagId : flags) {
            var flag = EntityMetadataUtil.nativeFlag(flagId);
            if (flag == null) unknown.add(flagId);
            else getFlags().add(flag);
        }
        unknownFlags = Set.copyOf(unknown);
    }

    public static Set<Integer> copyFlags(MovementPredictionSyncPacket packet) {
        var flags = packet instanceof ClientMovementPredictionSyncPacket nativePacket
                ? new HashSet<>(nativePacket.unknownFlags) : new HashSet<Integer>();
        for (var flag : packet.getFlags()) {
            int flagId = EntityMetadataUtil.nativeFlagId(flag);
            if (flagId >= 0) flags.add(flagId);
        }
        return Set.copyOf(flags);
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/packets/input/PostAuthInputPackets.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.packets.input;

import ac.navro.proxy.state.WirePlayerState;
import ac.navro.proxy.SessionState;
import ac.navro.proxy.data.input.TickData;
import ac.navro.proxy.packets.input.legacy.LegacyAuthInputPackets;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.PlayerAuthInputPacket;


public final class PostAuthInputPackets {
    private PostAuthInputPackets() { }
    public static boolean onPacket(SessionState session, PlayerAuthInputPacket packet, boolean cancelled) {
        var player = session.player();
        if (player.isExempted()) return !cancelled;
        player.finishInput();
        if (!session.spawned()) return trace(session, packet, false, "not_spawned");
        if (session.awaitingBackendSpawnPosition()) return trace(session, packet, false, "awaiting_backend_spawn_position");


        if (player.awaitingRespawnHealth()) return trace(session, packet, false, "awaiting_respawn_health");

        if(!cancelled)session.teleports().getAuthInputHistory().put(player.tick(), TickData.capture(session, packet));
        var context = session.authInputPackets().context();
        context.thisTickRiptideLevel = 0;
        context.riptideTickStartState = null;
        context.thisTickSpinAttack = false;
        context.thisTickOnGroundSpinAttack = false;
        player.doingInventoryAction = false;
        context.hasDepthStrider = false;

        var pendingTarget = player.vehicleData == null ? session.teleports().pendingTeleportPosition() : null;
        packet.setPosition(pendingTarget != null ? pendingTarget.toVector3f()
                : player.position().up(session.playerYOffset()).toVector3f());
        LegacyAuthInputPackets.correctInputData(player, packet);
        if (session.teleports().isHardTeleporting()) return trace(session, packet, false, "hard_teleport");
        if (session.teleports().isTeleporting()) return !cancelled;
        if (player.tickSinceBlockResync > 0) player.tickSinceBlockResync--;
        session.pollRewindHistory();
        return !cancelled;
    }

    private static boolean trace(SessionState session, PlayerAuthInputPacket packet, boolean accepted, String reason) {
        var log = session.player().worldDiagnostics();
        if (log != null) log.event("post_input_cancelled", ac.navro.proxy.diagnostics.WorldCollisionDiagnostics.fields(
                "inputTick", packet.getTick(), "reason", reason, "position", String.valueOf(packet.getPosition()),
                "blockResync", session.player().tickSinceBlockResync));
        return accepted;
    }


    public static void finishInput(WirePlayerState player) {
        player.doingInventoryAction = false;
    }
}
```

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.packets.input.legacy;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;
import org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector3f;


public final class InputPositionDecoder {
    public static boolean usesMovementCoordinates(final boolean spawned, final boolean handleTeleport) {


        return spawned || handleTeleport;
    }

    static Vec3 decode(final Vector3f position, final float movementYOffset,
                       final boolean movementCoordinates) {
        return new Vec3(position.getX(), position.getY() - (movementCoordinates ? movementYOffset : 0),
                position.getZ());
    }
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/packets/input/legacy/LegacyAuthInputPackets.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.packets.input.legacy;

import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.live.PredictionContext;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.live.PredictionItemUse;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.PlayerAuthInputPacket;


public final class LegacyAuthInputPackets {
    private LegacyAuthInputPackets() { }
    public static void correctInputData(ac.navro.proxy.state.WirePlayerState player, PlayerAuthInputPacket packet) {
        if (player.isMovementExempted()) return;
        var flags = packet.getInputData();
        flags.remove(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData.HORIZONTAL_COLLISION);
        flags.remove(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData.VERTICAL_COLLISION);
        if (player.horizontalCollision()) flags.add(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData.HORIZONTAL_COLLISION);
        if (player.verticalCollision()) flags.add(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData.VERTICAL_COLLISION);
        packet.setDelta(player.velocity().toVector3f());
    }
    public static void processAuthInput(PredictionContext player, PredictionItemUse itemUse, PlayerAuthInputPacket input){
        var wire=player.wire;var iterator=input.getInputData().iterator();
        while(iterator.hasNext()){
            var action=iterator.next();switch(action){
                case START_SPRINTING->{boolean forward=wire.input().z>0;wire.setPredictionSprintingAction(forward);if(!forward)iterator.remove();}
                case STOP_SPRINTING->wire.setPredictionSprintingAction(false);
                case START_SNEAKING->wire.setPredictionFlag(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.entity.EntityFlag.SNEAKING,true);
                case STOP_SNEAKING->wire.setPredictionFlag(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.entity.EntityFlag.SNEAKING,false);
                case START_SWIMMING->wire.applySwimmingAction(true);
                case STOP_SWIMMING->wire.applySwimmingAction(false);
                case START_FLYING->wire.setFlying(wire.abilities().contains(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.Ability.MAY_FLY)
                        || wire.abilities().contains(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.Ability.FLYING));
                case STOP_FLYING->wire.setFlying(false);
                case START_GLIDING->{var chest=player.session.inventory().armorContainer.get(1).getData();boolean allowed=chest!=null&&!itemUse.isNull(chest)&&itemUse.nativeItemId(chest)==444;wire.setPredictionFlag(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.entity.EntityFlag.GLIDING,allowed);if(!allowed)iterator.remove();}
                case STOP_GLIDING->wire.setPredictionFlag(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.entity.EntityFlag.GLIDING,false);
                case START_CRAWLING->wire.setPredictionFlag(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.entity.EntityFlag.CRAWLING,true);
                case STOP_CRAWLING->wire.setPredictionFlag(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.entity.EntityFlag.CRAWLING,false);
                case STOP_SPIN_ATTACK->{if(player.dirtySpinStop){player.stopRiptide();wire.setVelocity(wire.velocity().multiply(-0.2F));}else iterator.remove();}
                default->{}
            }
        }
        wire.updateInputPose();
        itemUse.beginInput(input);player.dirtySpinStop=false;
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/packets/input/teleport/TeleportHandler.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.packets.input.teleport;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;
import ac.navro.proxy.SessionState;
import ac.navro.proxy.teleport.PredictionRewind;
import ac.navro.proxy.teleport.ProtocolTeleportMotion;
import ac.navro.proxy.teleport.data.CorrectionResetData;
import ac.navro.proxy.teleport.data.RewindData;
import ac.navro.proxy.teleport.data.TeleportData;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.PlayerAuthInputPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.MovePlayerPacket;

public final class TeleportHandler {
    private final SessionState session;

    public TeleportHandler(SessionState session) {
        this.session = session;
    }

    public boolean processTeleport(PlayerAuthInputPacket input) {
        var teleports = session.teleports();
        var log = session.player().worldDiagnostics();
        if (log != null && teleports.isTeleporting()) {
            var head = teleports.getQueuedTeleports().peek();
            log.event("pendingTeleportInput", ac.navro.proxy.diagnostics.WorldCollisionDiagnostics.fields(
                    "inputTick", input.getTick(), "handleTeleport", input.getInputData().contains(PlayerAuthInputData.HANDLE_TELEPORT),
                    "wirePosition", String.valueOf(input.getPosition()), "pendingTeleports", teleports.getQueuedTeleports().size(),
                    "headType", head == null ? null : head.getClass().getSimpleName(),
                    "headAccepted", head != null && head.isAccepted(), "headTarget", head == null ? null : head.getPosition().toVector3f()));
        }
        boolean[] skipTravel = {false};
        for(var queued:teleports.getQueuedTeleports()) {
            if(queued instanceof RewindData rewind)
                rewind.observeInputFrame(session.player().tick(),session.player().simulationFrame());
        }
        teleports.drainReadyTeleports(input, session.player().vehicleData == null, session.player().tick(),data -> {
            if (data instanceof RewindData rewind) PredictionRewind.process(session, rewind);
            else if (data instanceof CorrectionResetData reset) {
                applyHardCorrection(reset, input, true);
                skipTravel[0] = true;
            } else if (applyTeleport(data)) skipTravel[0] = true;
        });
        var player = session.player();
        if (player.vehicleData == null) {
            float offset = session.playerYOffset();
            Vec3 step = teleports.stepInterpolation(player.position().up(offset));
            if (step != null) {
                player.rebasePosition(step.down(offset), true);
                player.setVelocity(Vec3.ZERO.clone());
                teleports.setLastKnowValid(step);
            }
        }
        return skipTravel[0];
    }

    public boolean processRejectedInput(PlayerAuthInputPacket input) {
        if (!session.spawned() || session.awaitingBackendSpawnPosition() || session.player().awaitingRespawnHealth()) return false;
        var pending = session.teleports().getQueuedTeleports();
        if (pending.peek() instanceof CorrectionResetData reset && reset.confirmedBy(input) && pending.remove(reset)) {
            applyHardCorrection(reset, input, false);
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private boolean applyTeleport(TeleportData data) {
        var player = session.player();
        var teleports = session.teleports();
        float offset = session.playerYOffset();
        Vec3 target = data.getPosition();
        boolean normal = data.getMode() == MovePlayerPacket.Mode.NORMAL.ordinal();
        boolean interpolate = normal && session.world().isChunkLoaded((int) Math.floor(target.x), (int) Math.floor(target.z));
        Vec3 origin = player.position().clone();
        if (interpolate) teleports.startInterpolation(target);
        else teleports.clearInterpolation();
        var prediction = session.detectionEnabled() ? session.authInputPackets() : null;
        var external = prediction == null ? null : prediction.context().certainVelocity;
        player.acceptTeleport(interpolate ? origin : target.down(offset), data.isOnGround());
        if (normal && !interpolate) player.setVelocity(target.subtract(origin.up(offset)));
        if (prediction != null) {
            prediction.reset();
            prediction.context().certainVelocity = external;
        }
        session.resetMovementHistory();
        teleports.setLastKnowValid(player.position().up(offset));
        return data.getMode() == MovePlayerPacket.Mode.TELEPORT.ordinal();
    }

    private void applyHardCorrection(CorrectionResetData reset, PlayerAuthInputPacket input, boolean acceptedInput) {
        var player = session.player();
        var teleports = session.teleports();
        float offset = session.playerYOffset();
        var prediction = session.authInputPackets();
        var external = prediction.context().certainVelocity;
        if (external == reset.includedExternalImpulse()) external = null;
        player.acceptTeleport(reset.nativeTargetFoot(), reset.isOnGround());
        if (reset.deliveredVelocity() != null) player.setVelocity(reset.deliveredVelocity());
        player.acceptInputPosition(reset.confirmedFoot(input), java.util.List.of());
        player.resetCorrectionObservation();
        prediction.reset();
        prediction.context().certainVelocity = external;
        prediction.velocityPackets().consumeSetbackExternalMotion(reset);
        session.resetMovementHistory();
        teleports.setLastKnowValid(player.position().up(offset));
        if (acceptedInput && !teleports.isTeleporting() && reset.deliveredVelocity() == null) {
            Vec3 expected = reset.isOnGround() && input.getInputData().contains(PlayerAuthInputData.START_JUMPING)
                    && player.predictionSprinting() && !player.flying()
                    ? ProtocolTeleportMotion.sprintJumpImpulse(input.getRotation().getY()) : null;
            var seed = ProtocolTeleportMotion.fromConfirmation(player.tick(), new Vec3(input.getDelta()), expected);
            if (seed != null) session.rememberTeleportMotion(seed);
        }
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/packets/other/NetworkLatencyPackets.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.packets.other;

import ac.navro.proxy.state.WirePlayerState;
import ac.navro.proxy.util.LatencyUtil;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.NetworkStackLatencyPacket;


public final class NetworkLatencyPackets {
    public static final long LATENCY_MAGNITUDE = 1_000_000L;
    public static final long PS5_LATENCY_MAGNITUDE = 1_000L;
    private static final int DEVICE_OS_PLAYSTATION = 11;
    private static final int V1_19_60 = 567;

    private NetworkLatencyPackets() { }

    public static void onPacketSend(WirePlayerState player, NetworkStackLatencyPacket packet) {
        LatencyUtil latency = player.getLatencyUtil();
        if (player.getEntityBatchEncoder() != null) {
            packet.setFromServer(true);
            return;
        }
        boolean alreadyQueuedAsOurs = latency.hasPending(packet.getTimestamp(), true);
        packet.setFromServer(true);
        if (!alreadyQueuedAsOurs) latency.queue(packet.getTimestamp(), false);
    }

    public static boolean onPacket(WirePlayerState player, NetworkStackLatencyPacket packet) {
        LatencyUtil latency = player.getLatencyUtil();
        long id = responseId(player,packet);
        return player.protocolVersion() < V1_19_60
                ? latency.onOrderedResponse() : latency.onResponse(id);
    }

    public static long responseId(WirePlayerState player, NetworkStackLatencyPacket packet) {
        long magnitude = player.deviceOs() == DEVICE_OS_PLAYSTATION
                ? PS5_LATENCY_MAGNITUDE : LATENCY_MAGNITUDE;
        return packet.getTimestamp() / magnitude;
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/packets/other/VehiclePackets.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.packets.other;

import ac.navro.proxy.SessionState;
import ac.navro.proxy.player.data.VehicleData;
import ac.navro.proxy.state.WirePlayerState;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.entity.EntityLinkData;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.BedrockPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.InteractPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.SetEntityLinkPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.AddEntityPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.AddPlayerPacket;


public final class VehiclePackets {
    private VehiclePackets() { }

    public static void onPacketReceive(WirePlayerState player, BedrockPacket packet) {
        if (packet instanceof InteractPacket interact && interact.getRuntimeEntityId() == player.runtimeId()
                && interact.getAction() == InteractPacket.Action.LEAVE_VEHICLE) player.vehicleData = null;
    }

    public static void onPacketSend(SessionState state, BedrockPacket packet) {
        if (packet instanceof SetEntityLinkPacket link)
            state.player().queueAcknowledgment(packet, () -> applySetEntityLink(state, link));
        var links = packet instanceof AddEntityPacket entity ? entity.getEntityLinks()
                : packet instanceof AddPlayerPacket player ? player.getEntityLinks() : null;
        if (links != null && !links.isEmpty()) {
            var snapshot = java.util.List.copyOf(links);
            state.player().queueAcknowledgment(packet, () -> snapshot.forEach(link ->
                    applyLink(state, link.getFrom(), link.getTo(), link.getType())));
        }
    }

    private static void applySetEntityLink(SessionState state, SetEntityLinkPacket packet) {
        var link = packet.getEntityLink();

        applyLink(state, link.getFrom(), link.getTo(), link.getType());
    }

    private static void applyLink(SessionState state, long vehicleUniqueId, long riderUniqueId, EntityLinkData.Type type) {
        var player = state.player();
        Long vehicleRuntime = state.entityRuntimeIdByUniqueId(vehicleUniqueId);


        boolean localRider = riderUniqueId == player.runtimeId();
        Long riderRuntime = localRider ? player.runtimeId() : state.entityRuntimeIdByUniqueId(riderUniqueId);
        if (!localRider && riderRuntime != null) {
            var rider = state.entity(riderRuntime);
            if (rider != null) rider.inVehicle(type != EntityLinkData.Type.REMOVE);
        }
        if (!localRider) return;
        var linkedVehicle = vehicleRuntime == null ? null : state.entity(vehicleRuntime);
        if (linkedVehicle == null) return;
        state.teleports().getQueuedTeleports().clear();
        if (type == EntityLinkData.Type.REMOVE) {
            player.vehicleData = null;
            return;
        }
        var data = new VehicleData();
        data.vehicleRuntimeId = vehicleRuntime;
        player.vehicleData = data;
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/packets/player/InventoryInteractionPackets.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.packets.player;

import ac.navro.proxy.check.api.impl.InventoryCheck;
import ac.navro.proxy.state.WirePlayerState;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.ContainerSlotType;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.itemstack.request.ItemStackRequest;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.itemstack.request.ItemStackRequestSlotData;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.itemstack.request.action.*;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.transaction.InventorySource;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.transaction.InventoryTransactionType;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.*;

public final class InventoryInteractionPackets {
    private final WirePlayerState player;
    private boolean open;
    private int window = -1;
    private boolean openingGrace;
    private boolean openingAcknowledged;
    private long revision;

    public InventoryInteractionPackets(WirePlayerState player) {
        this.player = player;
    }

    public boolean onPacketReceive(BedrockPacket packet, boolean checked) {
        boolean rejected = false;
        if (packet instanceof InteractPacket interact && interact.getAction() == InteractPacket.Action.OPEN_INVENTORY) {
            open = true;
            window = 0;
        }
        if (checked && !openingGrace && isInventoryClick(packet)) {
            for (var check : player.getCheckHolder().values()) {
                if (check instanceof InventoryCheck inventoryCheck && player.checkEnabled(check.getClass())) {
                    rejected |= inventoryCheck.onInventoryClick();
                }
            }
        }
        if (packet instanceof PlayerAuthInputPacket && openingAcknowledged) openingGrace = false;
        if (packet instanceof ContainerClosePacket close && (close.getId() == -1 || close.getId() == window)) {
            reset();
        }
        return !rejected;
    }

    public void onPacketSend(BedrockPacket packet) {
        if (packet instanceof StartGamePacket || packet instanceof ChangeDimensionPacket
                || packet instanceof RespawnPacket respawn && respawn.getState() == RespawnPacket.State.SERVER_SEARCHING) {
            reset();
        } else if (packet instanceof ContainerOpenPacket container) {
            long current = ++revision;
            open = true;
            window = container.getId();
            openingGrace = true;
            openingAcknowledged = false;
            player.queueAcknowledgment(packet, () -> {
                if (revision == current) openingAcknowledged = true;
            });
        } else if (packet instanceof ContainerClosePacket close && (close.getId() == -1 || close.getId() == window)) {
            long current = revision;
            player.queueAcknowledgment(packet, () -> {
                if (revision == current) reset();
            });
        }
    }

    private void reset() {
        revision++;
        open = false;
        window = -1;
        openingGrace = false;
        openingAcknowledged = false;
    }

    private boolean isInventoryClick(BedrockPacket packet) {
        if (packet instanceof ItemStackRequestPacket requests) {
            return requests.getRequests().stream().anyMatch(this::isInventoryClick);
        }
        if (packet instanceof PlayerAuthInputPacket input) {
            return input.getInputData().contains(PlayerAuthInputData.PERFORM_ITEM_STACK_REQUEST)
                    && isInventoryClick(input.getItemStackRequest());
        }
        if (packet instanceof InventoryTransactionPacket transaction) {
            if (transaction.getTransactionType() != InventoryTransactionType.NORMAL) return false;
            boolean containerAction = false;
            boolean worldAction = false;
            for (var action : transaction.getActions()) {
                if (action == null || action.getSource() == null) continue;
                InventorySource source = action.getSource();
                if (source.getType() == InventorySource.Type.WORLD_INTERACTION
                        && source.getFlag() != InventorySource.Flag.DROP_ITEM) return false;
                containerAction |= source.getType() == InventorySource.Type.CONTAINER
                        || source.getType() == InventorySource.Type.UNTRACKED_INTERACTION_UI
                        || source.getType() == InventorySource.Type.CREATIVE;
                worldAction |= source.getType() == InventorySource.Type.WORLD_INTERACTION;
            }
            return containerAction && (open || !worldAction);
        }
        return false;
    }

    private boolean isInventoryClick(ItemStackRequest request) {
        if (request == null || request.getActions() == null) return false;
        for (ItemStackRequestAction action : request.getActions()) {
            if (action == null) continue;
            if (action instanceof TransferItemStackRequestAction transfer
                    && (open || cursor(transfer.getSource()) || cursor(transfer.getDestination()))) return true;
            if (action instanceof SwapAction swap
                    && (open || cursor(swap.getSource()) || cursor(swap.getDestination()))) return true;
            if (action instanceof DropAction drop && (open || cursor(drop.getSource()))) return true;
            if (action instanceof DestroyAction destroy && (open || cursor(destroy.getSource()))) return true;
            if (switch (action.getType()) {
                case CRAFT_RECIPE, CRAFT_RECIPE_AUTO, CRAFT_CREATIVE, CRAFT_RECIPE_OPTIONAL,
                        CRAFT_REPAIR_AND_DISENCHANT, CRAFT_LOOM, LAB_TABLE_COMBINE, BEACON_PAYMENT -> true;
                default -> false;
            }) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static boolean cursor(ItemStackRequestSlotData slot) {
        return slot != null && (slot.getContainer() == ContainerSlotType.CURSOR
                || slot.getContainerName() != null && slot.getContainerName().getContainer() == ContainerSlotType.CURSOR);
    }
}
```
