`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/packets/player/PlacementPipeline.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.packets.player;

import static ac.navro.proxy.util.block.PlacementContext.*;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.*;
import ac.navro.proxy.SessionState;
import ac.navro.proxy.check.impl.place.AirLiquidPlace;
import ac.navro.proxy.check.impl.place.FarPlace;
import ac.navro.proxy.check.impl.place.RotationPlace;
import ac.navro.proxy.util.block.PlacementContext;
import ac.navro.proxy.data.block.*;
import ac.navro.proxy.data.inventory.*;
import ac.navro.proxy.data.vanilla.GameType;
import ac.navro.proxy.packets.input.PacketEvent;
import ac.navro.proxy.util.ItemUtil;
import ac.navro.proxy.validator.inventory.ItemTransactionValidator;

import org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector3i;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.entity.EntityFlag;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.ItemData;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.transaction.*;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.*;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.*;






public final class PlacementPipeline
        implements PlacementContext,
                ItemTransactionValidator.ClickBlockContext,
                ItemTransactionValidator.TransactionContext {
    public static final class MissingFact extends RuntimeException {
        public MissingFact(String message) {
            super(message);
        }
    }

    private final SessionState state;
    private final RotationPlace rotation;
    private final AirLiquidPlace air;
    private final FarPlace far;
    private final IdentityHashMap<InventoryTransactionPacket, UseItemData> views =
            new IdentityHashMap<>();
    private final IdentityHashMap<PlayerAuthInputPacket, InventoryTransactionPacket> embedded =
            new IdentityHashMap<>();
    private final ArrayList<Expiry> expiries = new ArrayList<>();
    private final Set<InventoryTransactionPacket> skippedPredictions = Collections.newSetFromMap(new IdentityHashMap<>());
    private final Set<Integer> pendingSlotCorrections = new LinkedHashSet<>();
    private final Map<Cell, Cell> pendingBlockCorrections = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    private final Object[] level = {new Object()};
    private record Expiry(int due, Runnable task) {}

    private Function<InventoryTransactionPacket, Boolean> forward = packet -> false;
    private Consumer<BedrockPacket> sendClient = packet -> {};
    private PacketEvent current;

    public PlacementPipeline(SessionState state) {
        this.state = state;
        rotation = new RotationPlace(state.player(), this);
        far = new FarPlace(state.player(), this);
        air =
                new AirLiquidPlace(
                        state.player(),
                        new AirLiquidPlace.Context() {
                            public boolean placeable(ItemData item) {
                                if (item == null || nativeIsNull(decodedClaim(item))) return false;
                                var p =
                                        NativeItemDecoder.placement(
                                                state.player().protocolVersion(),
                                                decodedClaim(item));
                                return p.canBePlaced() && p.blockId() != 0;
                            }

                            public boolean validate(ItemData held, ItemData claimed) {
                                return PlacementPipeline.this.validate(held, claimed);
                            }

                            public ItemData held() {
                                return state.inventory().inventoryContainer.getHeldItemData();
                            }

                            public GameType serverGameType() {
                                return gameType();
                            }

                            public boolean hadRecentPlacementSupport(Vector3i p) {
                                return world().hadRecentPlacementSupport(p);
                            }

                            public int clickedBlockId(Vector3i p) {
                                var block =
                                        world().networkBlockState(
                                                        world().getRawBlockAt(
                                                                        p.getX(), p.getY(),
                                                                        p.getZ(), 0));
                                return block == null
                                        ? 0
                                        : NativeBlockProperties.forState(block).blockId();
                            }

                            public void restore(Vector3i p) {
                                restoreCorrectBlock(p);
                            }

                            public void resendInventory() {
                                resyncSlot(state.inventory().heldItemSlot);
                            }

                            public InventoryTransactionPacket embedded(
                                    PlayerAuthInputPacket input) {
                                return embeddedTransaction(input);
                            }
                        });
    }

    public RotationPlace rotation() {
        return rotation;
    }

    public void setTransports(
            Function<InventoryTransactionPacket, Boolean> forward,
            Consumer<BedrockPacket> sendClient) {
        this.forward = Objects.requireNonNull(forward);
        this.sendClient = Objects.requireNonNull(sendClient);
    }


    private boolean airLiquidCheckAvailable() {
        return state.player().checkEnabled(AirLiquidPlace.class);
    }

    private boolean rotationCheckAvailable() {
        if (state.player().checkEnabled(RotationPlace.class)) return true;
        rotation.disable();
        expiries.clear();
        return false;
    }

    public PacketEvent begin(BedrockPacket packet) {
        current = new PacketEvent(packet);
        try {
            if (packet instanceof PlayerAuthInputPacket input) {
                if(state.player().checkEnabled(FarPlace.class))far.onInput(input, false);
                if(airLiquidCheckAvailable())air.onInput(input, false);
            }
            if(rotationCheckAvailable())rotation.onPacketReceive(current);
        } catch (MissingFact missing) {
            skipIncompletePrediction(packet, missing);
        }
        return current;
    }

    public boolean handleTransaction(InventoryTransactionPacket packet) {
        if (skippedPredictions.contains(packet)) return true;
        if (current != null && current.getPacket() == packet && current.isCancelled()) return false;
        try {
            boolean accepted = state.transactionValidator().handle(packet, this);
            if (!accepted && packet.getTransactionType() == InventoryTransactionType.ITEM_USE
                    && packet.getActionType() == 0) {
                restoreTransaction(packet);
            }
            return accepted;
        } catch (MissingFact missing) {
            skipIncompletePrediction(packet, missing);
            return true;
        }
    }

    public boolean finish(PacketEvent event, boolean accepted) {
        if (!accepted) event.setCancelled(true);
        if (event.getPacket() instanceof InventoryTransactionPacket transaction
                && !state.player().isExempted() && state.player().checkEnabled(FarPlace.class))
            event.setCancelled(far.onTransaction(transaction, event.isCancelled()));
        if(rotationCheckAvailable())rotation.finishPacket(event);
        views.clear();
        embedded.clear();
        skippedPredictions.clear();
        current = null;
        return !event.isCancelled();
    }

    private void skipIncompletePrediction(BedrockPacket packet, MissingFact missing) {
        if (current != null) rotation.skipPacket(current);
        if (packet instanceof InventoryTransactionPacket transaction) skippedPredictions.add(transaction);
        else if (packet instanceof PlayerAuthInputPacket input) {
            var transaction = embeddedTransaction(input);
            if (transaction != null) skippedPredictions.add(transaction);
        }
        var trace = state.player().worldDiagnostics();
        if (trace != null)
            trace.event(
                    "placement_prediction_skipped",
                    ac.navro.proxy.diagnostics.WorldCollisionDiagnostics.fields(
                            "reason", missing.getMessage()));
    }

    private void restoreTransaction(InventoryTransactionPacket packet) {
        var pos = packet.getBlockPosition();
        if (pos != null) {
            Cell target = cell(pos);
            int face = packet.getBlockFace();
            if (face >= 0 && face <= 5) {
                var known = state.backendBlocksAt(pos);
                var placed = known == null
                        ? adjacent(target, face)
                        : cell(ac.navro.proxy.util.block.BlockPlacementPhysics.target(
                                pos, face, world().networkBlockState(known.layerZero())));
                resyncPlacement(target, placed);
            } else {
                resyncPlacement(target, target);
            }
        }
        resyncSlot(packet.getHotbarSlot());
    }

    public void tick() {
        if (rotationCheckAvailable()) {
            int now = world().nativeServerTick();
            var due = expiries.stream().filter(e -> now - e.due >= 0).toList();
            expiries.removeAll(due);
            due.forEach(e -> e.task.run());
        }
        flushCorrections();
    }

    public void close() {
        expiries.clear();
        skippedPredictions.clear();
        views.clear();
        embedded.clear();
        pendingSlotCorrections.clear();
        pendingBlockCorrections.clear();
    }

    public void observeBackend(BedrockPacket packet) {
        if (packet instanceof StartGamePacket || packet instanceof ChangeDimensionPacket)
            level[0] = new Object();
        rotation.onPacketSend(new PacketEvent(packet));
        flushCorrections();
    }

    public int pendingSlotCorrectionCount() {
        return pendingSlotCorrections.size();
    }

    public long epoch() {
        return state.world().getBlockBreakEpoch();
    }

    public Object levelIdentity() {
        return level[0];
    }

    public boolean available() {
        return state.spawned()
                && !state.player().predictionFlag(EntityFlag.SLEEPING)
                && !state.player().inLoadingScreen
                && state.player().vehicleData == null
                && state.player().gameType() != GameType.SPECTATOR
                && !state.teleports().isTeleporting();
    }

    public long runtimeId() {
        return state.player().runtimeId();
    }

    public Vec3 acceptedMotion() {
        return state.player().velocity();
    }

    public GameType gameType() {
        return state.player().gameType();
    }

    public int minY() {
        return state.world().getMinY();
    }

    public int maxY() {
        return state.world().getHeightY();
    }

    public boolean chunkLoaded(int x, int z) {
        return state.world().isChunkLoaded(x, z);
    }

    public BlockView block(Cell position) {
        if (isInWorld(position.y())
                && !world().isSectionKnown(position.x(), position.y(), position.z())) {
            throw new MissingFact("unknown_selection_section");
        }
        var network =
                world().networkBlockState(
                                world().getRawBlockAt(position.x(), position.y(), position.z(), 0));
        if (network == null) throw new MissingFact("unknown_block_definition");
        if (network.legacyFullId() < 0) throw new MissingFact("unknown_native_block_behavior");

        var facts = NativeSelectionProperties.get(network.blockId(), network.blockData());
        Box outline;
        boolean sturdy;
        if (facts.known()) {
            outline = facts.outline(position.x(), position.y(), position.z());
            sturdy = facts.sturdy();
        } else if (NativeWallVineSelection.supported(network.blockId())) {
            NativeWallVineSelection.Selection selection;
            try {
                selection =
                        NativeWallVineSelection.selection(
                                network.blockId(),
                                network.blockData(),
                                position.x(),
                                position.y(),
                                position.z(),
                                side -> wallVineNeighbor(position, side));
            } catch (NativeConnectedSelection.UnknownProperty missing) {
                throw new MissingFact(missing.getMessage());
            }
            outline = selection.outline();
            sturdy = selection.sturdy();
        } else if (NativeConnectedSelection.supported(network.blockId())) {
            var selection = connectedSelection(network, position);
            outline = selection.outline();
            sturdy = selection.sturdy();
        } else if (NativeDoorSelection.supported(network.blockId())) {
            outline =
                    NativeDoorSelection.outline(
                            position.x(),
                            position.y(),
                            position.z(),
                            facts.damage(),
                            offset -> doorNeighbor(position, offset));
            sturdy = NativeDoorSelection.sturdy(network.blockId(), network.blockData());
        } else {
            throw new MissingFact("native_selection_requires_world_state");
        }

        boolean air =
                facts.known()
                        && (network.is("minecraft:air")
                                || network.is("minecraft:cave_air")
                                || network.is("minecraft:void_air")
                                || facts.id() == 0);
        return new BlockView(
                network,
                facts.id(),
                facts.damage(),
                air,
                NativePlacementProperties.canBeReplaced(network),
                facts.slab(),
                sturdy,
                outline);
    }

    private boolean isInWorld(int y) {
        return y >= minY() && y < maxY();
    }

    private NativeConnectedSelection.Selection connectedSelection(
            NetworkBlockState block, Cell position) {
        try {
            return NativeConnectedSelection.selection(
                    block.blockId(),
                    block.blockData(),
                    position.x(),
                    position.y(),
                    position.z(),
                    side -> connectionNeighbor(position, side));
        } catch (NativeConnectedSelection.UnknownProperty missing) {
            throw new MissingFact(missing.getMessage());
        }
    }

    private NativeConnectedSelection.Neighbor connectionNeighbor(Cell position, int side) {
        int x = position.x() + (side == 2 ? -1 : side == 3 ? 1 : 0);
        int z = position.z() + (side == 0 ? -1 : side == 1 ? 1 : 0);
        if (!world().isSectionKnown(x, position.y(), z)) {
            throw new MissingFact("unknown_connection_neighbor_section");
        }
        var neighbor = world().networkBlockState(world().getRawBlockAt(x, position.y(), z, 0));
        if (neighbor == null) throw new MissingFact("unknown_connection_neighbor_definition");
        return NativeConnectedSelection.neighbor(neighbor.blockId(), neighbor.blockData());
    }

    private NativeWallVineSelection.State wallVineNeighbor(Cell position, int side) {
        int x = position.x() + (side == 2 ? -1 : side == 3 ? 1 : 0);
        int y = position.y() + (side == 4 ? 1 : 0);
        int z = position.z() + (side == 0 ? -1 : side == 1 ? 1 : 0);
        if (isInWorld(y) && !world().isSectionKnown(x, y, z)) {
            throw new MissingFact(
                    side == 4 ? "unknown_vine_upper_section" : "unknown_wall_neighbor_section");
        }
        var neighbor = world().networkBlockState(world().getRawBlockAt(x, y, z, 0));
        if (neighbor == null) {
            throw new MissingFact(
                    side == 4
                            ? "unknown_vine_upper_definition"
                            : "unknown_wall_neighbor_definition");
        }
        return new NativeWallVineSelection.State(neighbor.blockId(), neighbor.blockData());
    }

    private NativeSelectionProperties.Facts doorNeighbor(Cell position, int offset) {
        int y = position.y() + offset;
        if (isInWorld(y) && !world().isSectionKnown(position.x(), y, position.z())) {
            throw new MissingFact("unknown_door_neighbor_section");
        }
        var neighbor =
                world().networkBlockState(world().getRawBlockAt(position.x(), y, position.z(), 0));
        if (neighbor == null || neighbor.blockId() < 0 || neighbor.blockId() >= 2048) {
            throw new MissingFact("unknown_door_neighbor_definition");
        }
        return NativeSelectionProperties.get(neighbor.blockId(), neighbor.blockData());
    }

    public UseItemData placementData(InventoryTransactionPacket packet) {
        if (views.containsKey(packet)) return views.get(packet);
        var item = packet.getItemInHand();
        ItemView itemView = null;
        if (item != null) {
            var decoded =
                    NativeItemDecoder.decode(
                            state.player().protocolVersion(),
                            item,
                            NativeItemDecoder.Format.TRANSACTION);
            var traits = NativePredictionItems.resolve(state.player().protocolVersion(), decoded);
            var props = NativeItemDecoder.placement(state.player().protocolVersion(), decoded);
            boolean placeable =
                    decoded.getCount() > 0 && !traits.positiveNull() && props.canBePlaced();
            boolean slab = NativeSelectionProperties.get(props.blockId(), 0).slab();
            itemView =
                    new ItemView(
                            traits.nativeId(),
                            decoded.getDamage(),
                            placeable,
                            props.hasMappedBlock(),
                            props.blockId(),
                            slab);
        }
        var view =
                new UseItemData(
                        packet.getBlockPosition() == null ? null : cell(packet.getBlockPosition()),
                        face(packet.getBlockFace()),
                        itemView,
                        packet.getActionType(),
                        packet.getClientInteractPrediction() == null
                                ? 0
                                : packet.getClientInteractPrediction().ordinal(),
                        packet.getTriggerType() == null ? 0 : packet.getTriggerType().ordinal(),
                        packet.getHotbarSlot(),
                        packet.getClickPosition() == null
                                ? null
                                : new Vec3(packet.getClickPosition()),
                        packet.getPlayerPosition() == null
                                ? null
                                : new Vec3(packet.getPlayerPosition()));
        views.put(packet, view);
        return view;
    }

    public InventoryTransactionPacket embeddedTransaction(PlayerAuthInputPacket input) {
        var data = input.getItemUseTransaction();
        if (data == null) return null;
        return embedded.computeIfAbsent(
                input,
                ignored -> {
                    var p = new InventoryTransactionPacket();
                    p.setTransactionType(InventoryTransactionType.ITEM_USE);
                    p.setActionType(data.getActionType());
                    p.setBlockPosition(data.getBlockPosition());
                    p.setBlockFace(data.getBlockFace());
                    p.setHotbarSlot(data.getHotbarSlot());
                    p.setItemInHand(data.getItemInHand());
                    p.setPlayerPosition(data.getPlayerPosition());
                    p.setClickPosition(data.getClickPosition());
                    p.setBlockDefinition(data.getBlockDefinition());
                    p.setClientInteractPrediction(data.getClientInteractPrediction());
                    p.setTriggerType(data.getTriggerType());
                    p.getActions().addAll(data.getActions());
                    return p;
                });
    }

    public void scheduleExpiry(Runnable task, int delay) {
        if (state.player().checkEnabled(RotationPlace.class))
            expiries.add(new Expiry(world().nativeServerTick() + delay, task));
    }

    public void applyPlacement(InventoryTransactionPacket packet) {
        if (!forward.apply(packet))
            throw new IllegalStateException("Deferred placement was not sent");
        state.onClientPacketForwarded(packet);
    }

    public void resyncPlacement(Cell target, Cell placed) {
        pendingBlockCorrections.put(target, placed);
        flushCorrections();
    }

    public void resyncSlot(int slot) {
        if (slot >= 0 && slot <= 8) {
            pendingSlotCorrections.add(slot);
            flushCorrections();
        }
    }

    public void resyncFarPlacement(InventoryTransactionPacket packet) {
        var pos = packet.getBlockPosition();
        restoreCorrectBlock(pos);
        if (packet.getBlockFace() >= 0 && packet.getBlockFace() <= 5) {
            var clicked =
                    world().networkBlockState(
                                    world().getRawBlockAt(pos.getX(), pos.getY(), pos.getZ(), 0));
            var placed =
                    ac.navro.proxy.util.block.BlockPlacementPhysics.target(
                            pos, packet.getBlockFace(), clicked);
            if (!placed.equals(pos)) restoreCorrectBlock(placed);
        }
        resyncSlot(state.inventory().heldItemSlot);
    }

    private void flushCorrections() {
        for (var entry : List.copyOf(pendingBlockCorrections.entrySet())) {
            boolean ready =
                    state.backendBlocksAt(vector(entry.getKey())) != null
                            && state.backendBlocksAt(vector(entry.getValue())) != null;
            if (!ready) continue;
            for (Cell p :
                    entry.getKey().equals(entry.getValue())
                            ? List.of(entry.getKey())
                            : List.of(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue())) {
                var blocks = state.backendBlocksAt(vector(p));
                state.world().predictBucketNetworkBlock(p.x(), p.y(), p.z(), 0, blocks.layerZero());
                state.world().predictBucketNetworkBlock(p.x(), p.y(), p.z(), 1, blocks.layerOne());
                state.restoreCorrectBlock(vector(p));
            }
            state.player().tickSinceBlockResync = 5;
            pendingBlockCorrections.remove(entry.getKey());
        }
        for (int slot : List.copyOf(pendingSlotCorrections)) {
            var authoritative = state.backendInventories().slot(0, slot);
            var packet = state.backendInventories().fullPacket(0);
            if (authoritative == null || packet == null) continue;
            state.inventory().inventoryContainer.set(slot, authoritative);
            state.onProxyInventoryCorrection(packet);
            sendClient.accept(packet);
            pendingSlotCorrections.remove(slot);
        }
    }

    public boolean debugEnabled() {
        return state.player().worldDiagnostics() != null;
    }

    public void debug(String message) {
        var trace = state.player().worldDiagnostics();
        if (trace != null) trace.event("rotation_place_debug", Map.of("message", message));
    }

    public ac.navro.proxy.compensated.world.base.CompensatedWorld world() {
        return state.world();
    }

    public Integer resolvedFace(InventoryTransactionPacket packet) {
        return packet.getBlockFace() >= 0 && packet.getBlockFace() <= 5
                ? packet.getBlockFace()
                : null;
    }

    public boolean sneaking() {
        return state.player()
                .inputData()
                .contains(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData.SNEAKING);
    }

    public ItemTransactionValidator.PlacementChecks checks() {
        return checks;
    }

    private final ItemTransactionValidator.PlacementChecks checks =
            new ItemTransactionValidator.PlacementChecks() {
                public ItemTransactionValidator.AirLiquidPlaceCheck airLiquidPlace() {
                    if(!airLiquidCheckAvailable())return null;
                    return (packet, held, clicked) ->
                            air.reject(
                                    packet,
                                    held,
                                    NativeBlockProperties.forState(clicked).blockId());
                }

                public ItemTransactionValidator.PlacementObserver rotationPlace() {
                    if(!rotationCheckAvailable())return null;
                    return (data, target, id) ->
                            rotation.predictedPlacement(placementData(data), cell(target), id);
                }
            };

    public ItemTransactionValidator.ActivationObserver trapdoorSampler() {
        return (position, before, after, stage, trace) -> {
            var log = state.player().worldDiagnostics();
            return log == null
                    ? 0
                    : log.event(
                            "localToggle",
                            ac.navro.proxy.diagnostics.WorldCollisionDiagnostics.fields(
                                    "position",
                                    position.toString(),
                                    "before",
                                    before,
                                    "after",
                                    after,
                                    "phase",
                                    stage,
                                    "trace",
                                    trace));
        };
    }

    public boolean nativeCanBePlaced(ItemData item) {
        return placementProperties(item).canBePlaced();
    }

    public NativeItemPlacementProperties.Properties placementProperties(ItemData item) {
        return NativeItemDecoder.placement(state.player().protocolVersion(), item);
    }

    public void restoreCorrectBlock(Vector3i pos) {
        state.restoreCorrectBlock(pos);
    }

    public boolean validate(ItemData predicted, ItemData claim) {

    }

    public int nativeItemId(ItemData item) {

    }

    private static Cell cell(Vector3i p) {
        return new Cell(p.getX(), p.getY(), p.getZ());
    }

    private static Vector3i vector(Cell p) {
        return Vector3i.from(p.x(), p.y(), p.z());
    }

    private static Direction face(int f) {
        return f >= 0 && f < 6 ? Direction.values()[f] : null;
    }

    private static Cell adjacent(Cell p, int f) {
        var face = face(f);
        return face == null
                ? p
                : new Cell(
                        p.x() + face.getXOffset(),
                        p.y() + face.getYOffset(),
                        p.z() + face.getZOffset());
    }
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/packets/player/PlayerEffectPackets.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.packets.player;

import ac.navro.proxy.state.WirePlayerState;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.BedrockPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.MobEffectPacket;


public final class PlayerEffectPackets {
    private PlayerEffectPackets() { }

    public static void onPacket(WirePlayerState player, BedrockPacket packet) {
        if (!(packet instanceof MobEffectPacket effect) || effect.getRuntimeEntityId() != player.runtimeId()) return;

        final var event = effect.getEvent();
        final int effectId = effect.getEffectId();
        final int amplifier = effect.getAmplifier();
        final int rawDuration = effect.getDuration();
        final int duration = rawDuration < 0 || rawDuration == Integer.MAX_VALUE
                ? Integer.MAX_VALUE : rawDuration + 1;
        player.queueAcknowledgment(packet, () -> {
            switch (event) {
                case ADD, MODIFY -> player.addEffect(effectId, amplifier, duration);
                case REMOVE -> player.removeEffect(effectId);
                default -> { }
            }
        });
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/packets/player/PlayerInventoryPackets.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.packets.player;

import ac.navro.proxy.compensated.CompensatedInventory;
import ac.navro.proxy.compensated.UiInventorySlots;
import ac.navro.proxy.compensated.cache.container.ContainerCache;
import ac.navro.proxy.compensated.cache.container.impl.TradeContainerCache;
import ac.navro.proxy.data.inventory.ItemCache;
import ac.navro.proxy.inventory.InventoryType;
import ac.navro.proxy.state.WirePlayerState;
import ac.navro.proxy.util.ItemUtil;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.BedrockPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.ContainerClosePacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.ContainerOpenPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.CraftingDataPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.CreativeContentPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.InventoryContentPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.InventorySlotPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.MobEquipmentPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.PlayerHotbarPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.UpdateTradePacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.ItemData;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.CreativeItemData;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.crafting.recipe.RecipeData;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.crafting.recipe.NetworkRecipeData;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;


public final class PlayerInventoryPackets {
    private PlayerInventoryPackets() { }

    public enum TransactionResult { UNHANDLED, ACCEPTED, REJECTED, EXCEPTION }


    public static TransactionResult onTransactionReceive(ac.navro.proxy.SessionState state,
            org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.InventoryTransactionPacket packet) {
        try {
            boolean block=packet.getTransactionType()==org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.transaction.InventoryTransactionType.ITEM_USE&&packet.getActionType()==0;
            boolean accepted=block?state.placementPipeline().handleTransaction(packet):state.transactionValidator().handle(packet,state.authInputPackets().itemUse());
            return accepted?TransactionResult.ACCEPTED:TransactionResult.REJECTED;
        } catch (Exception exception) {


            var trace=state.player().worldDiagnostics();
            if(trace!=null)trace.event("inventory_transaction_exception",
                    ac.navro.proxy.diagnostics.WorldCollisionDiagnostics.fields(
                            "errorClass",exception.getClass().getName(),"error",exception.getMessage()));
            return TransactionResult.EXCEPTION;
        }
    }

    public static void onPacketReceive(WirePlayerState player, CompensatedInventory inventory, BedrockPacket input) {
        onPacketReceive(player, inventory, input, item -> { });
    }

    public static void onPacketReceive(WirePlayerState player, CompensatedInventory inventory, BedrockPacket input,
                                       java.util.function.Consumer<ItemData> onHeldItemChanged) {
        if (input instanceof ContainerClosePacket packet) {
            if (inventory.openContainer == null) return;
            if (packet.getId() != inventory.openContainer.getId() && packet.getId() != -1) return;
            inventory.openContainer = null;
        }
        if (input instanceof MobEquipmentPacket packet) {
            int newSlot = packet.getHotbarSlot();
            if (packet.getRuntimeEntityId() != player.runtimeId()) return;
            if (newSlot < 0 || newSlot > 8 || packet.getContainerId() != 0 || inventory.heldItemSlot == newSlot) return;
            inventory.heldItemSlot = newSlot;
            onHeldItemChanged.accept(inventory.inventoryContainer.getHeldItemData());
        }
    }

    public static void onPacketSend(WirePlayerState player, CompensatedInventory inventory, BedrockPacket input) {
        if (input instanceof CreativeContentPacket packet) {
            List<CreativeItemData> entries = new ArrayList<>();
            for (CreativeItemData item : packet.getContents()) {
                entries.add(new CreativeItemData(ItemUtil.copy(item.getItem()), item.getNetId(), item.getGroupId()));
            }
            player.queueAcknowledgment(packet, () -> {
                inventory.getCreativeData().clear();
                for (CreativeItemData entry : entries) inventory.getCreativeData().put(entry.getNetId(), entry.getItem());
            });
        }
        if (input instanceof CraftingDataPacket packet) {
            List<RecipeData> recipes = List.copyOf(packet.getCraftingData());
            var mixes = List.copyOf(packet.getPotionMixData());
            player.queueAcknowledgment(packet, () -> {
                inventory.getCraftingData().clear();
                for (RecipeData recipe : recipes) {
                    switch (recipe.getType()) {
                        case MULTI, SHAPED, SHAPELESS, SMITHING_TRANSFORM, SMITHING_TRIM -> {
                            if (recipe instanceof NetworkRecipeData identified) {
                                inventory.getCraftingData().put(identified.getNetId(), recipe);
                            }
                        }
                        default -> { }
                    }
                }
                inventory.setPotionMixData(new ArrayList<>(mixes));
            });
        }
        if (input instanceof ContainerOpenPacket packet) {
            InventoryType type = UiInventorySlots.windowType(packet.getType());
            if (type == null) return;
            byte windowId = packet.getId();
            var position = packet.getBlockPosition();
            long entityId = packet.getUniqueEntityId();
            player.queueAcknowledgment(packet, () -> {
                ContainerCache existing = inventory.getContainer(windowId);
                if (existing == inventory.openContainer
                        && existing != inventory.inventoryContainer
                        && existing != inventory.armorContainer
                        && existing != inventory.offhandContainer
                        && existing != inventory.hudContainer) existing = null;
                inventory.openContainer = Objects.requireNonNullElseGet(existing,
                        () -> new ContainerCache(inventory, windowId, type, position, entityId));
            });
        }
        if (input instanceof ContainerClosePacket packet) {
            byte windowId = packet.getId();
            player.queueAcknowledgment(packet, () -> {
                var current = inventory.openContainer;
                if (current != null && (windowId == -1 || current.getId() == windowId)) {
                    inventory.openContainer = null;
                }
            });
        }
        if (input instanceof InventorySlotPacket packet) {
            int containerId = packet.getContainerId(), slot = packet.getSlot();
            ItemData item = ItemUtil.copy(packet.getItem()), storageItem = ItemUtil.copy(packet.getStorageItem());
            player.queueAcknowledgment(packet, () -> {
                if (containerId == 125) {
                    ItemCache cache = bundleCacheForStorage(inventory, storageItem);
                    if (cache == null) return;
                    ItemCache[] contents = cache.getBundle().getContents();
                    if (slot < 0 || slot >= contents.length) return;
                    contents[slot] = ItemCache.build(inventory, item);
                    return;
                }
                if (containerId == ContainerCache.UI) {
                    UiInventorySlots.apply(inventory, slot, item);
                    return;
                }
                ContainerCache container = inventory.getContainer((byte) containerId);
                if (container == null || slot < 0 || slot >= container.getContainerSize()) return;
                container.set(slot, item);
            });
        }
        if (input instanceof UpdateTradePacket packet) {
            InventoryType type = packet.getContainerType() == null ? null
                    : InventoryType.from(packet.getContainerType().getId());
            if (packet.getPlayerUniqueEntityId() != player.runtimeId() || type != InventoryType.TRADING) return;
            var offers = ItemUtil.copyTag(packet.getOffers());
            byte windowId = (byte) packet.getContainerId();
            long traderId = packet.getTraderUniqueEntityId();
            player.queueAcknowledgment(packet, () -> {
                try {
                    inventory.openContainer = new TradeContainerCache(inventory, offers, windowId, type,
                            org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector3i.ZERO, traderId);
                } catch (Exception ignored) { }
            });
        }
        if (input instanceof InventoryContentPacket packet) {
            int containerId = packet.getContainerId();
            ItemData storageItem = ItemUtil.copy(packet.getStorageItem());
            List<ItemData> items = packet.getContents() == null ? null
                    : packet.getContents().stream().map(ItemUtil::copy).toList();
            player.queueAcknowledgment(packet, () -> {
                if (items == null) return;
                if (containerId == 125) {
                    ItemCache cache = bundleCacheForStorage(inventory, storageItem);
                    if (cache == null) return;
                    ItemCache[] contents = cache.getBundle().getContents();
                    int length = Math.min(items.size(), contents.length);
                    for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) contents[i] = ItemCache.build(inventory, items.get(i));
                    return;
                }
                if (containerId == ContainerCache.UI) {
                    for (int slot = 0; slot < items.size(); slot++) UiInventorySlots.apply(inventory, slot, items.get(slot));
                    return;
                }
                ContainerCache container = inventory.getContainer((byte) containerId);
                if (container == null) return;
                ItemCache[] contents = container.getContents();
                if (contents == null || contents.length == 0) return;
                int length = Math.min(items.size(), contents.length);
                for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) container.set(i, items.get(i), false);
            });
        }
        if (input instanceof PlayerHotbarPacket packet) {
            if (packet.getContainerId() != inventory.inventoryContainer.getId() || !packet.isSelectHotbarSlot()) return;
            int slot = packet.getSelectedHotbarSlot();
            if (slot >= 0 && slot < 9) player.queueAcknowledgment(packet, () -> inventory.heldItemSlot = slot);
        }
    }

    private static ItemCache bundleCacheForStorage(CompensatedInventory inventory, ItemData storageItem) {
        storageItem = inventory.nativeItem(storageItem);
        int id;
        try { id = ac.navro.proxy.util.NbtNumber.getInt(Objects.requireNonNull(storageItem.getTag()), "bundle_id"); }
        catch (Exception ignored) { return null; }
        return inventory.getBundleCache().get(id);
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/packets/player/PlayerVelocityPackets.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.packets.player;

import ac.navro.proxy.SessionState;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.live.PredictionContext;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.engine.data.Vector;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;


public final class PlayerVelocityPackets {
    private final SessionState session;
    private final PredictionContext player;
    public PlayerVelocityPackets(SessionState session, PredictionContext player) {
        this.session=session;
        this.player=player;
    }
    private Vec3 pendingExternalMotion;
    private long externalMotionSequence,consumedExternalMotionSequence=-1;
    private long latestMotionPacketTick;

    private static final class Motion {
        final long sequence, packetTick;
        final Vector candidate;
        boolean acknowledged, superseded;
        Motion(long sequence, long packetTick, Vector candidate) {
            this.sequence = sequence; this.packetTick = packetTick; this.candidate = candidate;
        }
    }
    private final java.util.List<Motion> bdsMotions = new java.util.ArrayList<>();

    public void clearExternalMotion() {
        pendingExternalMotion = null;
        consumedExternalMotionSequence = ++externalMotionSequence;
        bdsMotions.clear();
    }
    public long externalMotionSequence() { return externalMotionSequence; }


    public void consumeBdsCorrectedExternalMotion(long included, long correctionTick) {
        if (session.backendType() != ac.navro.proxy.protocol.BackendType.BDS || included < 0) return;
        if (externalMotionSequence <= included && latestMotionPacketTick <= correctionTick)
            pendingExternalMotion = null;
        bdsMotions.removeIf(motion -> {
            boolean includedInBaseline = motion.sequence <= included && motion.packetTick <= correctionTick;
            if (includedInBaseline) {
                motion.superseded = true;
                if (player.certainVelocity == motion.candidate) player.certainVelocity = null;
                if (player.uncertainVelocity == motion.candidate) player.uncertainVelocity = null;
            }
            return includedInBaseline || motion.acknowledged
                    && player.certainVelocity != motion.candidate && player.uncertainVelocity != motion.candidate;
        });
    }
    public Vec3 setbackVelocity(ac.navro.proxy.teleport.data.RewindHistory frame){
        if(pendingExternalMotion!=null)return pendingExternalMotion.clone();
        return player.certainVelocity!=null?player.certainVelocity.getVelocity().clone():frame.data().tickEnd();
    }
    public void consumeSetbackExternalMotion(ac.navro.proxy.teleport.data.CorrectionResetData correction){
        long included=correction.externalMotionSequence();consumedExternalMotionSequence=Math.max(consumedExternalMotionSequence,included);
        if(externalMotionSequence<=included)pendingExternalMotion=null;
        if(player.certainVelocity==correction.includedExternalImpulse())player.certainVelocity=null;
    }
    public void onPacketSend(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.SetEntityMotionPacket packet){
        long backendTick=packet.getTick();
        latestMotionPacketTick=backendTick;
        packet.setTick(0);
        final Vec3 motion=new Vec3(packet.getMotion());pendingExternalMotion=motion.clone();long sequence=++externalMotionSequence;
        if(session.player().worldDiagnostics()!=null)session.player().worldDiagnostics().beginMotionTrace();
        trace("external_motion_queued",backendTick,sequence,motion);
        if(motion.x==0 && motion.y==0 && motion.z==0){
            session.player().queueAcknowledgment(packet,()->{if(sequence==externalMotionSequence)pendingExternalMotion=null;});return;
        }
        var velocity=new Vector(ac.navro.proxy.prediction.engine.data.VectorType.VELOCITY,motion);
        var origin = new Motion(sequence, backendTick, velocity);
        if (session.backendType() == ac.navro.proxy.protocol.BackendType.BDS) {
            bdsMotions.removeIf(m -> m.acknowledged && player.certainVelocity != m.candidate
                    && player.uncertainVelocity != m.candidate);
            bdsMotions.add(origin);
        }
        session.player().queueAcknowledgment(packet,()->{
            origin.acknowledged = true;
            if(sequence==externalMotionSequence)pendingExternalMotion=null;
            if(sequence>consumedExternalMotionSequence&&!origin.superseded){player.certainVelocity=velocity;trace("external_motion_acknowledged",backendTick,sequence,motion);}
        });
    }
    private void trace(String event,long packetTick,long sequence,Vec3 motion){
        var diagnostics=session.player().worldDiagnostics();
        if(diagnostics!=null)diagnostics.event(event,ac.navro.proxy.diagnostics.WorldCollisionDiagnostics.fields(
                "packetTick",packetTick,"motionSequence",sequence,"motion",motion.toVector3f(),
                "ackId",session.player().getLatencyUtil().currentAcknowledgmentId()));
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/packets/server/ServerChunkPackets.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.packets.server;

import ac.navro.proxy.compensated.world.base.CompensatedWorld;
import ac.navro.proxy.state.WirePlayerState;
import ac.navro.proxy.util.ItemUtil;
import io.netty.buffer.ByteBuf;
import org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector3i;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.BlockChangeEntry;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.ServerboundLoadingScreenPacketType;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.*;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.common.util.VarInts;

import java.util.*;
import ac.navro.proxy.diagnostics.WorldCollisionDiagnostics;
import io.netty.buffer.Unpooled;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.SubChunkRequestResult;


public final class ServerChunkPackets {
    private final WirePlayerState player;
    private final CompensatedWorld world;
    private record SectionKey(int dimension,int x,int y,int z){}
    private record Cell(int x,int y,int z,int layer){}
    private record Overlay(BlockUpdate update,long revision){}
    private static final class Pending {
        final long hash,revision,epoch;final Map<Cell,Overlay> overlays=new LinkedHashMap<>();
        Pending(long hash,long revision,long epoch){this.hash=hash;this.revision=revision;this.epoch=epoch;}
    }
    private final LinkedHashMap<Long,byte[]> blobs=new LinkedHashMap<>(16,.75F,true);
    private final LinkedHashMap<SectionKey,Pending> pending=new LinkedHashMap<>();
    private int blobBytes,overlayCount;
    private long paletteGeneration;
    private static final int MAX_BLOB_BYTES=16*1024*1024,MAX_PENDING=4096;
    private void trace(String event,Object... values){var log=player.worldDiagnostics();if(log!=null)log.event(event,WorldCollisionDiagnostics.fields(values));}
    private void queueAck(BedrockPacket packet,Map<String,Object> fields,Runnable task){
        long generation = paletteGeneration;
        String kind=packet.getClass().getSimpleName();fields.put("packet",kind);fields.put("encoderAttached",player.getEntityBatchEncoder()!=null);
        var log=player.worldDiagnostics();long id=log==null?-1:log.event("world_queued",fields);
        player.queueAcknowledgment(packet,()->{
            if (generation != paletteGeneration) return;
            trace("world_ack","worldEvent",id,"packet",kind,"ackId",player.getLatencyUtil().currentAcknowledgmentId());
            try{task.run();}catch(RuntimeException|Error error){trace("world_task_error","worldEvent",id,"error",error.toString());throw error;}
        });
    }
    private void acceptBlob(long hash,byte[] bytes){
        if(bytes.length>MAX_BLOB_BYTES)return;
        byte[] old=blobs.put(hash,bytes);if(old!=null)blobBytes-=old.length;blobBytes+=bytes.length;
        for(var waiting:new ArrayList<>(pending.entrySet()))if(waiting.getValue().hash==hash)resolvePending(waiting.getKey(),waiting.getValue(),bytes);
        while(blobBytes>MAX_BLOB_BYTES){var first=blobs.entrySet().iterator().next();blobBytes-=first.getValue().length;blobs.remove(first.getKey());}
    }
    private void removePending(SectionKey key){Pending removed=pending.remove(key);if(removed!=null)overlayCount-=removed.overlays.size();}
    private void clearPendingColumn(int x,int z){for(var key:new ArrayList<>(pending.keySet()))if(key.x()==x&&key.z()==z)removePending(key);}
    private void cleanupPending(){for(var entry:new ArrayList<>(pending.entrySet()))if(entry.getKey().dimension()!=world.dimension()||entry.getValue().epoch!=world.getBlockBreakEpoch())removePending(entry.getKey());}


    public ServerChunkPackets(WirePlayerState player, CompensatedWorld world) {
        this.player = player;
        this.world = world;
    }

    public void resetPalette() {
        paletteGeneration++;
        blobs.clear();
        pending.clear();
        blobBytes = 0;
        overlayCount = 0;
    }

    public void onPacket(BedrockPacket packet) {
        if (packet instanceof DimensionDataPacket dimensions) {

            world.apply(dimensions);trace("world_registry","kind","DimensionData");
        } else if (packet instanceof ChunkRadiusUpdatedPacket radius) {
            final int value = radius.getRadius();
            queueAck(packet,WorldCollisionDiagnostics.fields("radius",value), () -> world.setRadius(value));
        } else if (packet instanceof NetworkChunkPublisherUpdatePacket publisher) {
            final Vector3i position = publisher.getPosition();
            final int radius = publisher.getRadius();
            queueAck(packet,WorldCollisionDiagnostics.fields("center",String.valueOf(position),"radius",radius), () -> {
                world.setRadiusCenter(position);
                world.setRadius(radius);


            });
        } else if(packet instanceof ClientCacheMissResponsePacket response){
            var snapshots=new LinkedHashMap<Long,byte[]>();
            for(var entry:response.getBlobs().long2ObjectEntrySet()){
                ByteBuf data=entry.getValue();if(data.readableBytes()>MAX_BLOB_BYTES){trace("blob_oversize","hash",entry.getLongKey(),"bytes",data.readableBytes());continue;}
                byte[] bytes=new byte[data.readableBytes()];data.getBytes(data.readerIndex(),bytes);snapshots.put(entry.getLongKey(),bytes);
            }
            queueAck(packet,WorldCollisionDiagnostics.fields("blobs",snapshots.size()),()->{
                cleanupPending();for(var entry:snapshots.entrySet())acceptBlob(entry.getKey(),entry.getValue());
            });
        } else if (packet instanceof LevelChunkPacket chunk) {
            final int dimension = world.protocolVersion() >= 649 ? chunk.getDimension() : world.dimension();
            if (dimension < 0 || dimension > 2) return;
            final long revision=world.bucketPredictionRevision();final int x=chunk.getChunkX(),z=chunk.getChunkZ();
            if(chunk.isRequestSubChunks()){
                queueAck(packet,WorldCollisionDiagnostics.fields("dimension",dimension,"chunk",List.of(x,z),"partial",true),()->{
                    if(dimension!=world.dimension()){trace("world_discard_dimension","dimension",dimension);return;}
                    cleanupPending();world.ensurePartialColumn(x,z);trace("column_announced","chunk",List.of(x,z));
                });return;
            }
            final int count=chunk.getSubChunksLength();
            final CompensatedWorld.CachedChunk snapshot;
            final long[] hashes=chunk.getBlobIds().toLongArray();
            if(chunk.isCachingEnabled()){
                snapshot=CompensatedWorld.CachedChunk.network(world.minY(dimension),world.maxY(dimension),(world.maxY(dimension)-world.minY(dimension))>>4,world.airNetworkId());
                for(int i=0;i<Math.max(0,count);i++)snapshot.invalidateSection(i);
            }else snapshot=readLevelChunk(chunk,world.minY(dimension),world.maxY(dimension),world.airNetworkId(),error->trace("level_chunk_parse_error","chunk",List.of(x,z),"error",error));
            queueAck(packet,WorldCollisionDiagnostics.fields("dimension",dimension,"chunk",List.of(x,z),"sections",count,"cached",chunk.isCachingEnabled(),"sentRevision",revision),()->{
                if(dimension!=world.dimension()){trace("world_discard_dimension","dimension",dimension);return;}
                snapshot.markLoaded(player.tick());
                cleanupPending();clearPendingColumn(x,z);world.putAcknowledgedChunk(x,z,snapshot,revision);
                trace("chunk_applied","chunk",List.of(x,z),"sections",count,"sentRevision",revision);
                for(int i=0;i<Math.max(0,count)&&i<hashes.length;i++){
                    if(!snapshot.isSectionKnown(i))section(new SectionKey(dimension,x,(world.getMinY()>>4)+i,z),null,hashes[i],revision);
                }
            });
        } else if(packet instanceof SubChunkPacket subChunks){
            final int dimension=subChunks.getDimension();final var center=subChunks.getCenterPosition();
            if(center==null||dimension<0||dimension>2)return;
            final long revision=world.bucketPredictionRevision();
            record Snapshot(SectionKey key,int[][] layers,Long hash,byte[] inline,SubChunkRequestResult result){}
            var snapshots=new ArrayList<Snapshot>();
            for(var data:subChunks.getSubChunks()){
                if(data.getPosition()==null)continue;
                final SectionKey key;
                try{key=new SectionKey(dimension,Math.addExact(center.getX(),data.getPosition().getX()),Math.addExact(center.getY(),data.getPosition().getY()),Math.addExact(center.getZ(),data.getPosition().getZ()));}
                catch(ArithmeticException invalid){trace("subchunk_invalid_position","center",center.toString());continue;}
                if(data.getResult()!=SubChunkRequestResult.SUCCESS&&data.getResult()!=SubChunkRequestResult.SUCCESS_ALL_AIR){trace("subchunk_result","section",List.of(key.x(),key.y(),key.z()),"result",String.valueOf(data.getResult()));continue;}
                int[][] layers=data.getResult()==SubChunkRequestResult.SUCCESS_ALL_AIR?airSection(world.airNetworkId()):readSection(data.getData(),key.y());
                byte[] inline=null;
                if(data.getResult()==SubChunkRequestResult.SUCCESS&&layers!=null&&data.getBlobId()!=null&&data.getData()!=null&&data.getData().isReadable()&&data.getData().readableBytes()<=MAX_BLOB_BYTES){inline=new byte[data.getData().readableBytes()];data.getData().getBytes(data.getData().readerIndex(),inline);}
                snapshots.add(new Snapshot(key,layers,data.getBlobId(),inline,data.getResult()));
            }
            queueAck(packet,WorldCollisionDiagnostics.fields("dimension",dimension,"sectionCount",snapshots.size(),"sections",snapshots.stream().limit(64).map(snap->WorldCollisionDiagnostics.fields("position",List.of(snap.key().x(),snap.key().y(),snap.key().z()),"result",snap.result().toString(),"inlineKnown",snap.layers()!=null,"blob",snap.hash())).toList(),"sentRevision",revision),()->{
                if(dimension!=world.dimension()){trace("world_discard_dimension","dimension",dimension);return;}
                cleanupPending();for(var snapshot:snapshots){if(snapshot.inline()!=null)acceptBlob(snapshot.hash(),snapshot.inline());section(snapshot.key(),snapshot.layers(),snapshot.hash(),revision);}
            });
        } else if (packet instanceof UpdateBlockPacket update) {
            if (update.getBlockPosition() == null || update.getDefinition() == null) return;
            final Vector3i position = update.getBlockPosition();
            queueUpdates(packet, List.of(new BlockUpdate(position.getX(), position.getY(), position.getZ(),
                    update.getDataLayer(), update.getDefinition().getRuntimeId())));
        } else if (packet instanceof UpdateSubChunkBlocksPacket update) {
            final List<BlockUpdate> updates = new ArrayList<>();
            collectUpdates(update.getStandardBlocks(), 0, updates);
            collectUpdates(update.getExtraBlocks(), 1, updates);
            queueUpdates(packet, updates);
        } else if (packet instanceof BlockEventPacket event) {
            final Vector3i position = event.getBlockPosition();
            final int type = event.getEventType(), data = event.getEventData();
            if (position != null && type == 1) queueAck(packet,WorldCollisionDiagnostics.fields("position",position.toString(),"type",type,"data",data), () ->
                    world.handleCollisionBlockEvent(position.getX(), position.getY(), position.getZ(), type, data));
        } else if (packet instanceof BlockEntityDataPacket entity) {
            final Vector3i position = entity.getBlockPosition();
            final var tag = ItemUtil.copyTag(entity.getData());
            if (position != null && tag != null) queueAck(packet,WorldCollisionDiagnostics.fields("position",position.toString()), () ->
                    world.updateBlockEntityTag(position.getX(), position.getY(), position.getZ(), tag));
        }
    }

    private void queueUpdates(BedrockPacket packet, List<BlockUpdate> updates) {
        final long revision = world.bucketPredictionRevision();
        final int dimension = world.dimension();
        queueAck(packet,WorldCollisionDiagnostics.fields("dimension",dimension,"updateCount",updates.size(),"updates",updates.stream().limit(64).map(update->List.of(update.x,update.y,update.z,update.layer,update.networkId)).toList(),"sentRevision",revision), () -> {
            if(dimension!=world.dimension()){trace("world_discard_dimension","dimension",dimension);return;}
            cleanupPending();
            for(BlockUpdate update:updates){
                var key=new SectionKey(dimension,update.x>>4,update.y>>4,update.z>>4);Pending waiting=pending.get(key);
                if(waiting!=null){var cell=new Cell(update.x,update.y,update.z,update.layer);if(!waiting.overlays.containsKey(cell))overlayCount++;waiting.overlays.put(cell,new Overlay(update,revision));}
                int previous=world.getRawBlockAt(update.x,update.y,update.z,update.layer);
                boolean applied=world.applyAcknowledgedBlock(update.x,update.y,update.z,update.layer,update.networkId,revision);
                trace("block_applied","position",List.of(update.x,update.y,update.z),"layer",update.layer,"from",previous,"to",update.networkId,"accepted",applied,"stored",world.getRawBlockAt(update.x,update.y,update.z,update.layer),"sentRevision",revision);
                while(overlayCount>4096&&!pending.isEmpty()){var oldest=pending.keySet().iterator().next();removePending(oldest);trace("subchunk_pending_evicted","section",oldest.toString(),"reason","overlay_limit");}
            }
        });
    }

    private static int[][] airSection(int air){int[][] layers=new int[2][4096];for(int[] layer:layers)Arrays.fill(layer,air);return layers;}
    private int[][] readSection(ByteBuf bytes,int expectedY){
        if(bytes==null||!bytes.isReadable())return null;
        try{
            ByteBuf data=bytes.duplicate();int version=data.readUnsignedByte();if(version!=8&&version!=9)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown section format "+version);
            int count=data.readUnsignedByte();if(version==9&&data.readByte()!=expectedY)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Section Y does not match packet position");
            int[][] layers=new int[count][];for(int i=0;i<count;i++)layers[i]=readLayer(data,world.airNetworkId());return layers;
        }catch(RuntimeException invalid){trace("subchunk_parse_error","sectionY",expectedY,"bytes",bytes.readableBytes(),"error",invalid.toString());return null;}
    }
    private int[][] readBlob(byte[] bytes,int y){ByteBuf data=Unpooled.wrappedBuffer(bytes);try{return readSection(data,y);}finally{data.release();}}
    private void section(SectionKey key,int[][] layers,Long hash,long revision){
        if(key.y()<(world.getMinY()>>4)||key.y()>=(world.getHeightY()>>4)){trace("subchunk_out_of_bounds","section",key.toString());return;}
        removePending(key);
        if(layers==null&&hash!=null){byte[] data=blobs.get(hash);if(data!=null)layers=readBlob(data,key.y());}
        boolean applied=world.applyAcknowledgedSection(key.x(),key.y(),key.z(),layers,revision);
        if (applied && layers != null) world.getChunk(key.x(), key.z()).markLoaded(player.tick());
        trace("subchunk_applied","section",List.of(key.x(),key.y(),key.z()),"known",layers!=null,"accepted",applied,"blob",hash,"sentRevision",revision);
        if(layers==null&&hash!=null){pending.put(key,new Pending(hash,revision,world.getBlockBreakEpoch()));while(pending.size()>MAX_PENDING){var first=pending.keySet().iterator().next();removePending(first);trace("subchunk_pending_evicted","section",first.toString(),"reason","pending_limit");}}
    }
    private void resolvePending(SectionKey key,Pending waiting,byte[] data){
        int[][] layers=readBlob(data,key.y());if(layers==null){trace("blob_invalid","blob",waiting.hash,"section",key.toString());return;}
        if (world.applyAcknowledgedSection(key.x(),key.y(),key.z(),layers,waiting.revision))
            world.getChunk(key.x(), key.z()).markLoaded(player.tick());
        for(var overlay:waiting.overlays.values()){var u=overlay.update();world.applyAcknowledgedBlock(u.x,u.y,u.z,u.layer,u.networkId,overlay.revision());}
        trace("subchunk_blob_resolved","section",List.of(key.x(),key.y(),key.z()),"blob",waiting.hash,"overlays",waiting.overlays.size());removePending(key);
    }

    private static void collectUpdates(List<BlockChangeEntry> entries, int layer, List<BlockUpdate> output) {
        for (BlockChangeEntry entry : entries) {
            final Vector3i position = entry.getPosition();

            output.add(new BlockUpdate(position.getX(), position.getY(), position.getZ(), layer,
                    entry.getDefinition().getRuntimeId()));
        }
    }

    public static CompensatedWorld.CachedChunk readLevelChunk(LevelChunkPacket packet, int dimension, int air) {
        final int minY = CompensatedWorld.minYForDimension(dimension);
        final int maxY = CompensatedWorld.maxYForDimension(dimension);
        return readLevelChunk(packet, minY, maxY, air);
    }

    public static CompensatedWorld.CachedChunk readLevelChunk(LevelChunkPacket packet, int minY, int maxY, int air) {
        return readLevelChunk(packet,minY,maxY,air,error->{});
    }
    private static CompensatedWorld.CachedChunk readLevelChunk(LevelChunkPacket packet,int minY,int maxY,int air,java.util.function.Consumer<String> errors){
        final CompensatedWorld.CachedChunk chunk = CompensatedWorld.CachedChunk.network(
                minY, maxY, (maxY - minY) >> 4, air);
        if (packet.getData() == null || !packet.getData().isReadable() || packet.getSubChunksLength() <= 0
                || packet.isRequestSubChunks()) return chunk;
        final ByteBuf stream = packet.getData().duplicate();
        try {
            for (int sectionY = 0; sectionY < packet.getSubChunksLength(); sectionY++) {
                final int formatVersion = stream.readUnsignedByte();
                final int layerCount = stream.readUnsignedByte();
                final int cacheSection = formatVersion >= 9 ? stream.readByte() - (minY >> 4) : sectionY;
                final int[][] layers = new int[layerCount][];
                for (int layer = 0; layer < layerCount; layer++) layers[layer] = readLayer(stream, air);
                chunk.setNetworkSection(cacheSection, layers);
            }
        } catch (RuntimeException ignored) {
            errors.accept(ignored.toString());

        }
        return chunk;
    }

    private static int[] readLayer(ByteBuf stream, int air) {
        final int versionId = stream.readUnsignedByte() >> 1;
        if (versionId == 127) return null;
        final int entriesPerWord = switch (versionId) {
            case 0 -> 0;
            case 1 -> 32;
            case 2 -> 16;
            case 3 -> 10;
            case 4 -> 8;
            case 5 -> 6;
            case 6 -> 5;
            case 8 -> 4;
            case 16 -> 2;
            default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported bit array version: " + versionId);
        };
        final int[] words = new int[versionId == 0 ? 0 : (4096 + entriesPerWord - 1) / entriesPerWord];
        for (int i = 0; i < words.length; i++) words[i] = stream.readIntLE();
        final int paletteSize = versionId == 0 ? 1 : VarInts.readInt(stream);
        if (paletteSize > stream.readableBytes()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Truncated block palette");
        final int[] palette = new int[Math.max(1, paletteSize)];
        for (int i = 0; i < paletteSize; i++) palette[i] = VarInts.readInt(stream);
        if (paletteSize == 0) palette[0] = air;
        final int[] blocks = new int[4096];
        for (int i = 0; i < blocks.length; i++) {
            final int paletteIndex = versionId == 0 ? 0
                    : (words[i / entriesPerWord] >>> ((i % entriesPerWord) * versionId)) & ((1 << versionId) - 1);
            blocks[i] = paletteIndex >= 0 && paletteIndex < palette.length ? palette[paletteIndex] : air;
        }
        return blocks;
    }

    public static boolean finishLoadingScreen(WirePlayerState player, ServerboundLoadingScreenPacket packet) {
        if (packet.getType() != ServerboundLoadingScreenPacketType.END_LOADING_SCREEN
                || !player.inLoadingScreen
                || !Objects.equals(player.currentLoadingScreen, packet.getLoadingScreenId())) return false;
        player.currentLoadingScreen = null;
        player.inLoadingScreen = false;
        player.sinceLoadingScreen = 0;
        return true;
    }

    private record BlockUpdate(int x, int y, int z, int layer, int networkId) { }
}
```

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.packets.server;

import ac.navro.proxy.state.WirePlayerState;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.Ability;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.BedrockPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.UpdateAbilitiesPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.StartGamePacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.UpdatePlayerGameTypePacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.SetPlayerGameTypePacket;
import ac.navro.proxy.data.vanilla.GameType;
import java.util.EnumSet;
import java.util.Set;


public final class ServerDataPackets {
    private ServerDataPackets() { }
    public static void onPacket(WirePlayerState player, BedrockPacket packet) {
        onPacket(player, packet, false);
    }

    public static void onPacket(WirePlayerState player, BedrockPacket packet, boolean uniqueAbilityEntityId) {
        if (packet instanceof StartGamePacket start) {

            player.queueAcknowledgment(packet, () -> player.acknowledgeGameType(start.getPlayerGameType() == null
                    ? GameType.from(0) : nativeGameType(start.getPlayerGameType())));
        } else if (packet instanceof UpdateAbilitiesPacket update) {
            long entityId = uniqueAbilityEntityId ? player.uniqueId() : player.runtimeId();
            if (update.getUniqueEntityId() != entityId) return;
            Set<Ability> values = EnumSet.noneOf(Ability.class);
            for (var layer : update.getAbilityLayers()) values.addAll(layer.getAbilityValues());
            Set<Ability> snapshot = Set.copyOf(values);
            player.queueAcknowledgment(packet, () -> player.acknowledgeAbilities(snapshot));
        } else if (packet instanceof UpdatePlayerGameTypePacket update) {
            if (update.getEntityId() != player.runtimeId() || update.getGameType() == null) return;
            player.gameTypeEvent("gameTypeUpdateQueued", "gameMode", nativeGameType(update.getGameType()),
                    "source", "update-player-game-type");
            player.queueAcknowledgment(packet, () -> player.acknowledgeGameType(nativeGameType(update.getGameType())));
        } else if (packet instanceof SetPlayerGameTypePacket update) {
            player.gameTypeEvent("gameTypeUpdateQueued", "gameMode", update.getGamemode());
            player.queueAcknowledgment(packet, () -> {
                player.acknowledgeGameType(GameType.from(update.getGamemode()));
                player.gameTypeEvent("gameTypeUpdateAcknowledged", "gameMode", update.getGamemode());
            });
        }
    }

    private static GameType nativeGameType(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.GameType value) {
        return value == null ? null : GameType.from(value.ordinal());
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/packets/server/ServerEntityPackets.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.packets.server;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;
import ac.navro.proxy.compensated.cache.entity.EntityCache;
import ac.navro.proxy.state.WirePlayerState;
import ac.navro.proxy.state.WireVec3;
import ac.navro.proxy.compensated.world.base.CompensatedWorld;
import ac.navro.proxy.util.EntityMetadataUtil;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.entity.EntityDataMap;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.entity.EntityDataTypes;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.*;

import java.util.IdentityHashMap;
import java.util.Map;


public final class ServerEntityPackets {
    private final WirePlayerState player;
    private final CompensatedWorld world;
    private final Map<Long, EntityCache> entities;
    private final Map<Long, Long> uniqueIdToRuntimeId;
    private final ac.navro.proxy.data.entity.NetworkEntityRegistry registry = new ac.navro.proxy.data.entity.NetworkEntityRegistry();
    private final Map<BedrockPacket, Runnable> queuedCallbacks = new IdentityHashMap<>();

    public ServerEntityPackets(WirePlayerState player, CompensatedWorld world, Map<Long, EntityCache> entities,
                              Map<Long, Long> uniqueIdToRuntimeId) {
        this.player = player;
        this.world = world;
        this.entities = entities;
        this.uniqueIdToRuntimeId = uniqueIdToRuntimeId;
    }

    public void onPacket(BedrockPacket packet) {
        if (packet instanceof AvailableEntityIdentifiersPacket identifiers) {
            registry.replace(identifiers.getIdentifiers());
        }
        if (packet instanceof AddEntityPacket add) {
            EntityCache entity = addToCache(add.getRuntimeEntityId(), add.getUniqueEntityId(), add.getEntityType(),
                    add.getIdentifier(), add.getMetadata(), false);
            if (entity == null) return;
            Vec3 position = new Vec3(add.getPosition()).add(0, -entity.getYOffset(), 0);
            entity.setServerPosition(position);
            entity.init();
            entity.interpolate(position, false);
            entity.metadata(add.getMetadata());
            entity.motion(WireVec3.of(add.getMotion()));
            entity.properties(add.getProperties());
            entity.attributes(add.getAttributes());
        }
        if (packet instanceof AddPlayerPacket add) {
            EntityCache entity = addToCache(add.getRuntimeEntityId(), add.getUniqueEntityId(), 63,
                    "minecraft:player", add.getMetadata(), true);
            if (entity == null) return;
            Vec3 position = new Vec3(add.getPosition());
            entity.setServerPosition(position);
            entity.init();
            entity.interpolate(position, false);
            entity.metadata(add.getMetadata());
            entity.motion(WireVec3.of(add.getMotion()));
            entity.properties(add.getProperties());
        }
        if (packet instanceof MoveEntityDeltaPacket move) {
            EntityCache entity = entities.get(move.getRuntimeEntityId());
            if (entity == null) return;
            boolean hasX = move.getFlags().contains(MoveEntityDeltaPacket.Flag.HAS_X);
            boolean hasY = move.getFlags().contains(MoveEntityDeltaPacket.Flag.HAS_Y);
            boolean hasZ = move.getFlags().contains(MoveEntityDeltaPacket.Flag.HAS_Z);
            if (!hasX && !hasY && !hasZ) return;
            float x = hasX ? move.getX() : entity.getServerPosition().x;
            float y = hasY ? move.getY() - entity.getYOffset() : entity.getServerPosition().y;
            float z = hasZ ? move.getZ() : entity.getServerPosition().z;
            queuePositionUpdate(packet, entity, new Vec3(x, y, z), true, false);
            entity.lastWireTick(move.getTicks());
        }
        if (packet instanceof MoveEntityAbsolutePacket move) {
            EntityCache entity = entities.get(move.getRuntimeEntityId());
            if (entity != null) queuePositionUpdate(packet, entity, new Vec3(move.getPosition()), false);
        }
        if (packet instanceof MovePlayerPacket move && move.getRuntimeEntityId() != player.runtimeId()
                && move.getMode() != MovePlayerPacket.Mode.HEAD_ROTATION) {
            EntityCache entity = entities.get(move.getRuntimeEntityId());
            if (entity != null && entity.getYOffset() == 0F) {
                queuePositionUpdate(packet, entity, new Vec3(move.getPosition()), move.getMode() == MovePlayerPacket.Mode.NORMAL);
                entity.lastWireTick(move.getTick());
            }
        }
        if (packet instanceof RemoveEntityPacket remove) {
            player.queueAcknowledgment(packet, () -> {


                if (player.vehicleData != null && player.vehicleData.vehicleRuntimeId == remove.getUniqueEntityId())
                    player.vehicleData = null;
                Long key = uniqueIdToRuntimeId.remove(remove.getUniqueEntityId());
                if (key != null) entities.remove(key);
            });
        }
    }

    private EntityCache addToCache(long runtimeId, long uniqueId, int type, String identifier,
                                    EntityDataMap metadata, boolean playerEntity) {
        if (runtimeId == player.runtimeId()) return null;
        if (playerEntity) identifier = "minecraft:player";

        if (identifier == null || identifier.isBlank()) return null;
        type = registry.type(identifier, type);
        Float width = EntityMetadataUtil.getFloat(metadata, EntityDataTypes.WIDTH);
        Float height = EntityMetadataUtil.getFloat(metadata, EntityDataTypes.HEIGHT);
        boolean boat = "minecraft:boat".equalsIgnoreCase(identifier) || "minecraft:chest_boat".equalsIgnoreCase(identifier);
        if (!playerEntity && !boat && (width == null || height == null)) return null;
        float definitionWidth = playerEntity ? 0.6F : boat ? 1.4F : width;
        float definitionHeight = playerEntity ? 1.8F : boat ? 0.455F : height;
        float definitionOffset = playerEntity ? 1.62001F : boat ? 0.375F : 0F;
        EntityCache entity = new EntityCache(player, runtimeId, uniqueId, type, identifier, definitionWidth,
                definitionHeight, definitionOffset, playerEntity || boat, world.dimension());
        entities.put(runtimeId, entity);
        uniqueIdToRuntimeId.put(uniqueId, runtimeId);
        return entity;
    }

    private void queuePositionUpdate(BedrockPacket packet, EntityCache entity, Vec3 raw, boolean lerp) {
        queuePositionUpdate(packet, entity, raw, lerp, true);
    }

    private void queuePositionUpdate(BedrockPacket packet, EntityCache entity, Vec3 raw, boolean lerp, boolean applyYOffset) {
        Vec3 position = applyYOffset ? raw.add(0, -entity.getYOffset(), 0) : raw;
        float distance = entity.getServerPosition().squaredDistanceTo(position);
        if (distance < 1.0E-15F) return;
        long[] sequence = {0};
        player.queueAcknowledgment(packet, () -> {
            if (entities.get(entity.runtimeId()) != entity) return;
            entity.interpolate(position, lerp && distance < 4096, sequence[0]);
        });
        queuedCallbacks.put(packet, () -> {
            if (entities.get(entity.runtimeId()) != entity) return;
            entity.setServerPosition(position);
            sequence[0] = entity.nextPositionUpdateSequence();
        });
    }

    public void afterSend(BedrockPacket packet) {
        Runnable callback = queuedCallbacks.remove(packet);
        if (callback != null) callback.run();
    }
}
```
