`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/packets/server/ServerRewindPackets.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.packets.server;

import ac.navro.proxy.state.WirePlayerState;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.AttributeData;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.attribute.AttributeModifierData;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.attribute.AttributeOperation;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.entity.EntityFlag;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.BedrockPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.MobEffectPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.MovePlayerPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.SetEntityDataPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.SetEntityMotionPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.UpdateAttributesPacket;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.EnumMap;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.function.Consumer;

public final class ServerRewindPackets {
    private static final String MOVEMENT = "minecraft:movement";
    private static final String SPRINT_MODIFIER = "D208FC00-42AA-4AAD-9276-D5446530DE43";
    private final EnumMap<EntityFlag, Boolean> serverFlags = new EnumMap<>(EntityFlag.class);
    private AttributeData serverMovement;

    public void capture(WirePlayerState player, BedrockPacket packet) {
        if (packet instanceof SetEntityDataPacket metadata && metadata.getRuntimeEntityId() == player.runtimeId()) {
            var flags = metadata.getMetadata().getFlags();
            if (flags != null) serverFlags.putAll(flags);
        } else if (packet instanceof UpdateAttributesPacket attributes && attributes.getRuntimeEntityId() == player.runtimeId()) {
            for (var attribute : attributes.getAttributes()) {
                if (MOVEMENT.equals(attribute.getName())) serverMovement = attribute;
            }
        }
    }

    public void onPacketSend(BedrockPacket packet) {
        switch (packet) {
            case MobEffectPacket value -> value.setTick(0L);
            case MovePlayerPacket value -> value.setTick(0L);
            case SetEntityDataPacket value -> value.setTick(0L);
            case SetEntityMotionPacket value -> value.setTick(0L);
            case UpdateAttributesPacket value -> value.setTick(0L);
            default -> { }
        }
    }

    public void syncCorrection(WirePlayerState player, long tick, Consumer<BedrockPacket> send) {
        if (player.vehicleData != null) return;
        if (!serverFlags.isEmpty()) {
            var flags = new EnumMap<>(serverFlags);
            flags.put(EntityFlag.SPRINTING, player.predictionSprinting());
            flags.put(EntityFlag.SNEAKING, player.sneaking());
            flags.put(EntityFlag.USING_ITEM, player.predictionFlag(EntityFlag.USING_ITEM));
            var metadata = new SetEntityDataPacket();
            metadata.setRuntimeEntityId(player.runtimeId());
            metadata.setTick(tick);
            metadata.getMetadata().putFlags(flags);
            send.accept(metadata);
        }
        var movement = player.attributes().get(MOVEMENT);
        if (movement == null) return;
        var rawModifiers = new HashMap<String, AttributeModifierData>();
        if (serverMovement != null) {
            for (var modifier : serverMovement.getModifiers()) rawModifiers.put(modifier.getId(), modifier);
        }
        var modifiers = new ArrayList<AttributeModifierData>();
        for (var modeled : movement.getModifiers().values()) {
            if (SPRINT_MODIFIER.equals(modeled.id())) {
                modifiers.add(new AttributeModifierData(modeled.id(), "Sprinting speed boost", modeled.amount(),
                        AttributeOperation.MULTIPLY_TOTAL, 2, false));
            } else if (rawModifiers.containsKey(modeled.id())) {
                modifiers.add(rawModifiers.get(modeled.id()));
            } else {
                return;
            }
        }
        float minimum = serverMovement == null ? 0F : serverMovement.getMinimum();
        float maximum = serverMovement == null ? Float.MAX_VALUE : serverMovement.getMaximum();
        var attributes = new UpdateAttributesPacket();
        attributes.setRuntimeEntityId(player.runtimeId());
        attributes.setTick(tick);
        attributes.getAttributes().add(new AttributeData(MOVEMENT, minimum, maximum, movement.getValue(),
                serverMovement == null ? minimum : serverMovement.getDefaultMinimum(),
                serverMovement == null ? maximum : serverMovement.getDefaultMaximum(), movement.getBaseValue(), modifiers));
        send.accept(attributes);
    }
}
```

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.permission;

import ac.navro.proxy.state.WirePlayerState;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerPermission;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.*;


public final class ProtocolPermissions {
    private volatile boolean operator;
    public boolean isOperator(){return operator;}
    public void observe(WirePlayerState player,BedrockPacket packet){
        if(packet instanceof StartGamePacket){operator=false;return;}
        if(packet instanceof UpdateAbilitiesPacket p&&p.getUniqueEntityId()==player.uniqueId()){

            operator=p.getPlayerPermission()==PlayerPermission.OPERATOR
                    ||p.getCommandPermission()!=null&&p.getCommandPermission().ordinal()==1;
        }else if(packet instanceof AdventureSettingsPacket p&&p.getUniqueEntityId()==player.uniqueId()){
            operator=p.getPlayerPermission()==PlayerPermission.OPERATOR
                    ||p.getCommandPermission()!=null&&p.getCommandPermission().ordinal()==1;
        }
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/permission/ProxyPermissions.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.permission;

import com.google.gson.*;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.Consumer;


public final class ProxyPermissions {
    private final Path file;
    private final Consumer<String> log;
    public ProxyPermissions(Path file, Consumer<String> log) {
        this.file=file;this.log=log;
        try { if(!Files.exists(file))Files.writeString(file,"{\n  \"players\": {}\n}\n",StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW); }
        catch(IOException e){log.accept("Could not load permissions: "+e.getMessage());}
    }
    public boolean hasPermission(UUID identity,String node,boolean operator) {
        if(identity==null)return false;
        try {
            JsonObject root=JsonParser.parseString(Files.readString(file)).getAsJsonObject();
            JsonObject players=root.getAsJsonObject("players");
            if(players!=null&&players.has(identity.toString())) {
                JsonObject nodes=players.getAsJsonObject(identity.toString());
                if(nodes.has(node)) {
                    JsonElement value=nodes.get(node);
                    if(!value.isJsonPrimitive()||!value.getAsJsonPrimitive().isBoolean())throw new IOException("Permission value must be boolean");
                    return value.getAsBoolean();
                }
            }
            return operator&&Set.of("navro.alert","navro.reload","navro.debug").contains(node);
        } catch(IOException|RuntimeException e) {log.accept("Could not load permissions: "+e.getMessage());return false;}
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/player/data/tracker/FlagTracker.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.player.data.tracker;

import ac.navro.proxy.data.ItemUseTracker;

import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Set;


public final class FlagTracker<I> {
    public interface Context<I> {
        ItemUseTracker<I> getItemUseTracker();
        I airItem();
    }

          
    public static final int USING_ITEM = -1;

    private final Set<Integer> flags = new HashSet<>();
    private boolean flying, wasFlying;

    public boolean isFlying() { return flying; }
    public boolean isWasFlying() { return wasFlying; }

    public void flying(boolean flying) {
        this.flying = this.wasFlying = flying;
    }

    public void setFlying(boolean flying) {
        this.wasFlying = this.flying;
        this.flying = flying;
    }

    public void clear() {
        this.flags.clear();
    }

    public void set(final Context<I> player, final Set<Integer> flags) {
        this.set(player, flags, true);
    }

    public void set(final Context<I> player, final Set<Integer> flags, boolean server) {
        boolean sneaking = this.has(1);
        boolean swimming = this.has(57);
        boolean wasUsing = this.has(USING_ITEM);

        this.clear();
        this.flags.addAll(flags);

        if (server) {
            this.set(1, sneaking);
            this.set(57, swimming);
        }

        boolean oldUsingItem = player.getItemUseTracker().getUsedItem() != player.airItem();
        if (this.has(USING_ITEM)) {
            this.set(USING_ITEM, oldUsingItem);
            if (!oldUsingItem) {
                player.getItemUseTracker().setDirtyUsing(ItemUseTracker.DirtyUsing.METADATA);
            } else {



                player.getItemUseTracker().setDirtyUsing(ItemUseTracker.DirtyUsing.NONE);
            }
        } else {
            player.getItemUseTracker().setDirtyUsing(ItemUseTracker.DirtyUsing.NONE);
        }

        player.getItemUseTracker().onMetadataUseStateChanged(wasUsing, this.has(USING_ITEM));

    }

    public void set(final int flag, boolean value) {
        if (value) {
            this.flags.add(flag);
        } else {
            this.flags.remove(flag);
        }
    }

    public boolean has(final int flag) {
        return flags.contains(flag);
    }

    public Set<Integer> cloneFlags() {
        return new HashSet<>(this.flags);
    }


    public void restoreFlags(final Set<Integer> snapshot) {
        this.flags.clear();
        this.flags.addAll(snapshot);
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/prediction/ClimbableBlockPhysics.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.prediction;

import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.live.PredictionContext;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.live.NativeIds;


import ac.navro.proxy.collision.ScaffoldingCollision;
import ac.navro.proxy.compensated.world.CompensatedWorldImpl;
import ac.navro.proxy.data.block.NavroBlockState;

import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.engine.data.VectorType;
import ac.navro.proxy.collision.CollisionShapeEntry;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Box;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;


public final class ClimbableBlockPhysics {
    private ClimbableBlockPhysics() { }
    private static int floor(float value){return (int)Math.floor(value);}

    public static NavroBlockState blockAtFeet(PredictionContext player, CompensatedWorldImpl world) {
        final int x = floor(player.position.x);
        final int y = floor(player.boundingBox.minY);
        final int z = floor(player.position.z);
        return world.isChunkLoaded(x, z) ? world.getBlockState(x, y, z, 0) : null;
    }

    public static boolean isClimbing(PredictionContext player) {
        return isClimbing(player, player.compensatedWorld);
    }

    static boolean isClimbing(PredictionContext player, CompensatedWorldImpl world) {
        if (player.getFlagTracker().has("WALLCLIMBING")) return true;
        if (!player.getFlagTracker().has("CAN_CLIMB")) return false;
        final NavroBlockState feet = blockAtFeet(player, world);
        return feet != null && feet.hasClimbableProperty();
    }

    public static boolean hasClimbHaltAtFeet(PredictionContext player) {
        final NavroBlockState feet = blockAtFeet(player, player.compensatedWorld);
        return feet != null && feet.hasClimbHaltProperty();
    }

    public static Vec3 clampDownwardMovement(PredictionContext player, Vec3 velocity) {
        final NavroBlockState feet = blockAtFeet(player, player.compensatedWorld);
        final boolean powderSnow = feet != null && isPowderSnow(feet)
                && player.canStandOnSnow();
        return clampDownwardMovement(velocity, isClimbing(player), powderSnow,
                player.getFlagTracker().has("SNEAKING"),
                feet != null && feet.hasClimbHaltProperty());
    }

    static Vec3 clampDownwardMovement(Vec3 velocity, boolean climbing, boolean powderSnow,
                                     boolean sneaking, boolean haltAtFeet) {
        if (!climbing && !powderSnow) return velocity;
        float y = Math.max(velocity.y, -0.2F);
        if (y < 0 && sneaking && haltAtFeet) y = 0;
        return new Vec3(velocity.x, y, velocity.z);
    }


    public static void applyAutoClimb(PredictionContext player) {
        if (player.horizontalCollision && isClimbing(player)) player.velocity.y = 0.2F;
    }

    public static boolean isJumping(PredictionContext player) {
        return !player.getFlagTracker().isFlying()
                && (player.getInputData().contains(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData.JUMPING)
                || player.getInputData().contains(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData.AUTO_JUMPING_IN_WATER)
                || player.getInputData().contains(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData.ASCEND_BLOCK));
    }

    static boolean isAscending(PredictionContext player) {
        return isJumping(player)
                && !player.getFlagTracker().has(ScaffoldingCollision.DESCEND_THROUGH_BLOCK_FLAG)
                && (player.getFlagTracker().has("IN_SCAFFOLDING")
                || player.getFlagTracker().has("IN_ASCENDABLE_BLOCK"));
    }


    public static Vec3 applyBlockJump(PredictionContext player, Vec3 velocity, boolean climbing) {
        if (!isJumping(player)) return null;
        if (isAscending(player)) return new Vec3(velocity.x, 0.15F, velocity.z);
        if (climbing) return new Vec3(velocity.x, 0.2F, velocity.z);
        return null;
    }

    public static void recordAcceptedJump(PredictionContext player) {
        if (isAscending(player)) player.climbJumpDelay = 10;
    }

    public static void refreshFlags(PredictionContext player) {
        refreshFlags(player, player.compensatedWorld, player.canStandOnSnow());
    }

    static void refreshFlags(PredictionContext player, CompensatedWorldImpl world, boolean canStandOnSnow) {
        final Box box = player.boundingBox;
        final int inY = floor(box.minY);
        final int overY = floor(box.minY - 1.0F);
        player.getFlagTracker().set("IN_SCAFFOLDING",
                anyBlock(world, box, inY, false, canStandOnSnow));
        player.getFlagTracker().set("OVER_SCAFFOLDING",
                anyBlock(world, box, overY, false, canStandOnSnow));
        player.getFlagTracker().set("IN_ASCENDABLE_BLOCK",
                anyBlock(world, box, inY, true, canStandOnSnow));
        player.getFlagTracker().set("OVER_DESCENDABLE_BLOCK",
                anyBlock(world, box, overY, true, canStandOnSnow));
    }

    private static boolean anyBlock(CompensatedWorldImpl world, Box box, int y,
                                    boolean ascendable, boolean canStandOnSnow) {
        for (int x = floor(box.minX); x <= floor(box.maxX); x++) {
            for (int z = floor(box.minZ); z <= floor(box.maxZ); z++) {
                if (!world.isChunkLoaded(x, z)) continue;
                final NavroBlockState state = world.getBlockState(x, y, z, 0);
                if (ascendable && isPowderSnow(state)) {
                    if (canStandOnSnow) return true;
                    continue;
                }
                if (!state.isScaffolding()) continue;
                if (!ascendable) return true;
                final NavroBlockState below = world.getBlockState(x, y - 1, z, 0);
                if (!below.isAir() && !below.isWater()
                        && !NavroBlockState.isWater(below.nativeId())
                        && !below.getNetworkState().is("minecraft:water")
                        && !below.getNetworkState().is("minecraft:flowing_water")) return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static boolean isPowderSnow(NavroBlockState state) {
        return state.nativeId() == NativeIds.BlockID.POWDER_SNOW
                || state.getNetworkState().is("minecraft:powder_snow");
    }
}
```

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.prediction;

public final class GlidingState {
    private GlidingState() {}


    public static boolean filterInvalidState(final PredictionContext player) {
        if (!player.getFlagTracker().has("GLIDING")
                || !(player.onGround || player.vehicleData != null
                || player.hasEffect(NativeIds.Effect.LEVITATION))) {

        FluidMovement.updatePose(player);
        return true;
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/prediction/GroundTravelPhysics.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.prediction;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.engine.data.VectorType;
import ac.navro.proxy.collision.CollisionShapeEntry;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;


public final class GroundTravelPhysics {
    private static final float SLOW_BLOCK_MULTIPLIER = 1.225F;
    private static final float FRICTION_SCALE = 0.91F;
    private static final float DEFAULT_DAMPING = 0.54600006F;

    private GroundTravelPhysics() { }

    public static org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector3i frictionPosition(Vec3 position) {
        return org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector3i.from(floor(position.x), floor(position.y - 0.1F), floor(position.z));
    }

    public static float movementSpeed(float speed, float friction, boolean soulSand, boolean soulSpeed) {
        float adjustedFriction = friction;
        if (soulSand && !soulSpeed) adjustedFriction *= SLOW_BLOCK_MULTIPLIER;
        float damping = adjustedFriction * FRICTION_SCALE;
        if (damping == 0.0F) damping = DEFAULT_DAMPING;
        final float ratio = DEFAULT_DAMPING / damping;
        final float ratioSquared = ratio * ratio;
        final float ratioCubed = ratioSquared * ratio;
        return speed * ratioCubed;
    }

    private static int floor(float value) {
        final int truncated = (int) value;
        return value < truncated ? truncated - 1 : truncated;
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/prediction/PredictionRunner.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.prediction;

import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.live.PredictionContext;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.live.NativeIds;


import ac.navro.proxy.collision.Collider;
import ac.navro.proxy.collision.ScaffoldingCollision;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.engine.base.PredictionEngine;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.engine.data.Vector;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.engine.impl.GlidingPredictionEngine;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.engine.impl.GroundAndAirPredictionEngine;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.engine.impl.fluid.LavaPredictionEngine;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.engine.impl.fluid.WaterPredictionEngine;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.fluid.FluidMovement;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.ticker.impl.PlayerTicker;

import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.engine.data.VectorType;
import ac.navro.proxy.collision.CollisionShapeEntry;

import ac.navro.proxy.data.input.PredictionData;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.MathUtil;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;

public class PredictionRunner {
    private final PredictionContext player;

    public PredictionRunner(final PredictionContext player) {
        this.player = player;
    }

    public void run() {
        run(player.tick, null);
    }

    public void run(final long inputTick,
                    final ac.navro.proxy.collision.CollisionPhysicsState.Snapshot replayFrame) {

        player.movementSampler.decision("predictionStart", "predictionInputTick", inputTick,
                "historicalFrame", replayFrame != null);
        player.trapdoorSampler.decision("predictionStart", "predictionInputTick", inputTick,
                "historicalFrame", replayFrame != null);
        player.predictionStartBoundingBox = player.boundingBox.clone();
        player.collisionPhysics.begin(player.session.world(), player.session.entities(), inputTick, replayFrame);
        player.swimDebug.stage("PREDICTION_START","predictionInputTick",inputTick,"historicalFrame",replayFrame!=null);
        player.itemUseDebug.stage("PREDICTION_START","predictionInputTick",inputTick,"historicalFrame",replayFrame!=null);
        player.bounceGravityCorrection = null;
        player.movementCollisionEntries = List.of();
        player.prepareClosestSpace();
        player.riptideTickStartState = RiptidePhysics.snapshot(player);
        player.riptideWasInWater = player.fluidPrediction.wasInWater;
        FluidMovement.prepare(player);
        player.lavaSampler.stage("liquidSensing");
        player.ceilingSampler.stage("liquidSensing");
        player.collisionSampler.stage("liquidSensing");
        player.trapdoorSampler.stage("liquidSensing");
        player.movementSampler.stage("liquidSensing");

        ClimbableBlockPhysics.refreshFlags(player);
        ScaffoldingCollision.prepareInput(player);
        if (player.climbJumpDelay > 0) --player.climbJumpDelay;
        GlidingState.filterInvalidState(player);
        RiptidePhysics.prepare(player);
        if (player.thisTickSpinAttack) {
            FluidMovement.sampleTravelLiquids(player,
                    null);
        }
        if (!this.findBestTickStartVelocity(inputTick)) {
            FluidMovement.finishInput(player);
            return;
        }

        new PlayerTicker(player).tick();
        collectInsideOneWayBlocks();
        player.finishShulkerPush();
        player.predictionResult = new PredictionData(player.beforeCollision.clone(), player.afterCollision.clone(), player.velocity.clone());
        player.lastTickFinalVelocity = player.velocity.clone();
        FluidMovement.finishInput(player);
        player.lavaSampler.stage("predictionComplete");
        player.ceilingSampler.stage("predictionComplete");
        player.collisionSampler.stage("predictionComplete");
        player.trapdoorSampler.stage("predictionComplete");
        player.movementSampler.stage("predictionComplete");
        player.swimDebug.stage("TRAVEL_RESULT","predictionInputTick",inputTick);
        player.itemUseDebug.stage("TRAVEL_RESULT","predictionInputTick",inputTick);

    }

    private void collectInsideOneWayBlocks() {

        final var box = player.boundingBox;
        for (int x = (int) Math.floor(box.minX); x <= (int) Math.floor(Math.nextDown(box.maxX)); x++) {
            for (int y = (int) Math.floor(box.minY); y <= (int) Math.floor(Math.nextDown(box.maxY)); y++) {
                for (int z = (int) Math.floor(box.minZ); z <= (int) Math.floor(Math.nextDown(box.maxZ)); z++) {
                    final var state = player.compensatedWorld.getBlockState(x, y, z, 0);
                    if (state.nativeId() == NativeIds.BlockID.SCAFFOLDING
                            || state.getNetworkState().is("minecraft:scaffolding")) {
                        player.collisionPhysics.addInsideOneWay(new ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Box(
                                x, y, z, x + 1, y + 1, z + 1));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private boolean findBestTickStartVelocity(final long inputTick) {
        final PredictionEngine engine;

        if (player.isInLava()) {
            engine = new LavaPredictionEngine(player);
        } else if (player.fluidPrediction.waterTravel) {
            engine = new WaterPredictionEngine(player);
        } else if (player.getFlagTracker().has("GLIDING")) {
            engine = new GlidingPredictionEngine(player);
        } else {
            engine = new GroundAndAirPredictionEngine(player);
        }

        final List<Vector> possibleVelocities = new ArrayList<>();
        player.swimDebug.stage("BDS_PHYSICS_ENGINE","engine",engine.getClass().getSimpleName());
        player.itemUseDebug.stage("PHYSICS_ENGINE","engine",engine.getClass().getSimpleName());


        if (player.uncertainVelocity != null) {
            possibleVelocities.add(player.uncertainVelocity);
            if (player.uncertainVelocity.isTwice()) {

                player.uncertainVelocity = null;
            }
        }
        final Vector canonicalVelocity = Objects.requireNonNullElseGet(player.certainVelocity,
                () -> new Vector(VectorType.NORMAL, player.velocity.clone()));
        possibleVelocities.add(canonicalVelocity);

        final List<Vec3> teleportVelocities = player.getTeleportUtil().getTeleportStartVelocities(inputTick);
        if (canonicalVelocity.getType() == VectorType.NORMAL) {
            for (final Vec3 teleportVelocity : teleportVelocities) {
                if (possibleVelocities.stream().noneMatch(candidate ->
                        teleportVelocity.squaredDistanceTo(candidate.getVelocity()) <= 1.0E-12F)) {


                    possibleVelocities.add(new Vector(VectorType.NORMAL, teleportVelocity));
                }
            }
        }
        player.movementSampler.decision("velocityCandidates", "predictionInputTick", inputTick,
                "engine", engine.getClass().getSimpleName(),
                "teleportSeeds", teleportVelocities.stream().map(Vec3::toVector3f).toList(),
                "candidates", possibleVelocities.stream().map(value -> java.util.Map.of(
                        "type", value.getType().name(), "velocity", value.getVelocity().toVector3f())).toList());
        player.trapdoorSampler.decision("velocityCandidates", "predictionInputTick", inputTick,
                "engine", engine.getClass().getSimpleName(),
                "teleportSeeds", teleportVelocities.stream().map(Vec3::toVector3f).toList(),
                "candidates", possibleVelocities.stream().map(value -> java.util.Map.of(
                        "type", value.getType().name(), "velocity", value.getVelocity().toVector3f())).toList());
        player.certainVelocity = null;

        float closetDistance = Float.MAX_VALUE;

        if (possibleVelocities.size() == 1) {

            player.bestPossibility = possibleVelocities.get(0);
        } else {
            final Vec3 oldInput = player.input.clone();



            for (Vector possibility : possibleVelocities) {
                player.input = PlayerTicker.scaleMovementInput(player, oldInput, false);
                Vec3 vec3 = RiptidePhysics.applyImpulse(player, possibility.getVelocity().clone());
                vec3 = FluidMovement.prepareVelocity(player, vec3);
                vec3 = ScaffoldingCollision.applyAcceptedDescend(player, vec3);
                vec3 = player.jump(vec3);
                vec3 = FluidMovement.swimControl(player, vec3);
                vec3 = engine.travel(vec3);

                if (player.stuckSpeedMultiplier.lengthSquared() > 1.0E-7) {
                    vec3 = vec3.multiply(player.stuckSpeedMultiplier);
                }

                final var solved = Collider.collideMove(player, Collider.maybeBackOffFromEdge(player, vec3));
                Vec3 vec32 = solved.movement;
                boolean horizontal = !MathUtil.equal(vec3.x, vec32.x) || !MathUtil.equal(vec3.z, vec32.z);
                boolean vertical = vec3.y != vec32.y;

                float distance = player.inputPositionResidual(solved.aabb.feetCenter()).lengthSquared();


                if (horizontal != player.hasInput(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData.HORIZONTAL_COLLISION)) {
                    distance += 1.0E-6f;
                }
                if (vertical != player.hasInput(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData.VERTICAL_COLLISION)) {
                    distance += 1.0E-6f;
                }

                player.ceilingSampler.trial(possibility.getType().name(), possibility.getVelocity(), vec3, vec32, distance);
                player.collisionSampler.trial(possibility.getType().name(), possibility.getVelocity(), vec3, vec32, distance);
                player.trapdoorSampler.trial(possibility.getType().name(), possibility.getVelocity(), vec3, vec32, distance);
                player.movementSampler.trial(possibility.getType().name(), possibility.getVelocity(), vec3, vec32, distance);

                if (distance < closetDistance) {
                    closetDistance = distance;
                    player.bestPossibility = possibility;
                } else if (distance == closetDistance && possibility == player.uncertainVelocity) {
                    player.uncertainVelocity.setTwice(true);
                }
            }

            player.input = oldInput;
        }

        if (player.bestPossibility == null) {
            return false;
        }

        if (player.bestPossibility == player.uncertainVelocity && !player.uncertainVelocity.isTwice()) {

            player.uncertainVelocity = null;
        }



        player.velocity = player.bestPossibility.getVelocity().clone();
        if(player.bestPossibility.getType()==VectorType.VELOCITY && player.wire.worldDiagnostics()!=null)
            player.wire.worldDiagnostics().event("external_motion_prediction_consumed",
                    ac.navro.proxy.diagnostics.WorldCollisionDiagnostics.fields("predictionInputTick",inputTick,
                            "motion",player.velocity.toVector3f(),"wireInputTick",player.wire.tick()));

        player.collisionPhysics.selectedStartY(player.velocity.y);
        player.movementSampler.decision("selectedStartVelocity", "predictionInputTick", inputTick,
                "type", player.bestPossibility.getType().name(), "velocity", player.velocity.toVector3f());
        player.trapdoorSampler.decision("selectedStartVelocity", "predictionInputTick", inputTick,
                "type", player.bestPossibility.getType().name(), "velocity", player.velocity.toVector3f());

        return true;
    }

}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/prediction/PredictionSyncState.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.prediction;

import ac.navro.proxy.packets.input.ClientMovementPredictionSyncPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.MovementPredictionSyncPacket;

import java.util.Set;

public final class PredictionSyncState {
    private Report pending;
    private long sequence;

    public record Report(long sequence, long receivedAfterTick, long uniqueEntityId, Set<Integer> flags,
                         float scale, float width, float height, float speed, float underwaterSpeed,
                         float lavaSpeed, float jumpStrength, float health, float hunger,
                         float unknown1, float unknown2, float unknown3, boolean flying) {
        public Report { flags = Set.copyOf(flags); }
    }

    public boolean receive(MovementPredictionSyncPacket packet, long expectedUniqueId, long tick) {
        if (packet.getUniqueEntityId() == -1 || packet.getUniqueEntityId() != expectedUniqueId || pending != null) return false;
        var dimensions = packet.getBoundingBox();
        pending = new Report(++sequence, tick, packet.getUniqueEntityId(), ClientMovementPredictionSyncPacket.copyFlags(packet),
                dimensions.getX(), dimensions.getY(), dimensions.getZ(), packet.getSpeed(), packet.getUnderwaterSpeed(),
                packet.getLavaSpeed(), packet.getJumpStrength(), packet.getHealth(), packet.getHunger(),
                packet.getUnknown1(), packet.getUnknown2(), packet.getUnknown3(), packet.isFlying());
        return true;
    }

    public Report pending() { return pending; }

    public Report consume() {
        final Report report = pending;
        pending = null;
        return report;
    }

    public void clear() { pending = null; }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/prediction/ProtocolBlockEffects.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.prediction;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Box;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;
import ac.navro.proxy.compensated.world.base.CompensatedWorld;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;


public final class ProtocolBlockEffects {
    private static final float DOWN_ACCELERATION = -0.03F;
    private static final float ABOVE_DOWN_CAP = -0.9F;
    private static final float ABOVE_UP_ACCELERATION = 0.1F;
    private static final float ABOVE_UP_CAP = 1.8F;
    private static final float INSIDE_DOWN_CAP = -0.3F;
    private static final float INSIDE_UP_ACCELERATION = 0.06F;
    private static final float INSIDE_UP_CAP = 0.7F;

    private ProtocolBlockEffects() {}

    public static List<BubbleContact> bubbleContacts(CompensatedWorld world, Box actor, int dimension) {
        List<BubbleContact> contacts = new ArrayList<>();
        int minX=(int)Math.floor(actor.minX), minY=(int)Math.floor(actor.minY), minZ=(int)Math.floor(actor.minZ);
        int maxX=(int)Math.floor(Math.nextDown(actor.maxX)), maxY=(int)Math.floor(Math.nextDown(actor.maxY)), maxZ=(int)Math.floor(Math.nextDown(actor.maxZ));
        for(int x=minX;x<=maxX;x++) for(int y=minY;y<=maxY;y++) for(int z=minZ;z<=maxZ;z++) {
            if (!"minecraft:bubble_column".equals(world.blockIdentifierAt(x,y,z,dimension,0))) continue;
            boolean dragDown = world.blockBooleanPropertyAt(x,y,z,dimension,0,"drag_down",
                    world.blockBooleanPropertyAt(x,y,z,dimension,0,"drag_down_bit",false));
            ContactState state = world.isAirAt(x,y+1,z,dimension) ? ContactState.ABOVE : ContactState.INSIDE;
            contacts.add(new BubbleContact(x,y,z,dragDown,state));
        }
        return List.copyOf(contacts);
    }

    public static Vec3 applyBubble(Vec3 velocity, List<BubbleContact> contacts) {
        Vec3 result = velocity.clone();
        for (BubbleContact contact : contacts) {
            float candidate;
            float cap;
            if (contact.dragDown()) {
                candidate = result.y + DOWN_ACCELERATION;
                cap = contact.state() == ContactState.ABOVE ? ABOVE_DOWN_CAP : INSIDE_DOWN_CAP;
                result.y = cap > candidate ? cap : candidate;
            } else {
                candidate = result.y + (contact.state() == ContactState.ABOVE
                        ? ABOVE_UP_ACCELERATION : INSIDE_UP_ACCELERATION);
                cap = contact.state() == ContactState.ABOVE ? ABOVE_UP_CAP : INSIDE_UP_CAP;
                result.y = cap < candidate ? cap : candidate;
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static HoneyResult applyHoney(Vec3 velocity, Vec3 position, float width,
                                         CompensatedWorld world, Box actor, int dimension) {
        Vec3 result = velocity.clone();
        boolean resetFallDistance = false;
        for (int x=(int)Math.floor(actor.minX); x<=(int)Math.floor(Math.nextDown(actor.maxX)); x++)
            for (int y=(int)Math.floor(actor.minY); y<=(int)Math.floor(Math.nextDown(actor.maxY)); y++)
                for (int z=(int)Math.floor(actor.minZ); z<=(int)Math.floor(Math.nextDown(actor.maxZ)); z++)
                    if ("minecraft:honey_block".equals(world.blockIdentifierAt(x,y,z,dimension,0))) {
                        result.x *= 0.4F;
                        result.y = -0.12F > result.y ? -0.12F : result.y;
                        result.z *= 0.4F;
                        if (position.y <= y + 0.9375F && result.y < 0) {
                            float sideLimit = width * 0.5F + 0.4312500059604645F;
                            resetFallDistance = Math.abs(x + 0.5F - position.x) > sideLimit
                                    || Math.abs(z + 0.5F - position.z) > sideLimit;
                        }
                    }
        return new HoneyResult(result, resetFallDistance);
    }

    public record BubbleContact(int x, int y, int z, boolean dragDown, ContactState state) {}
    public record HoneyResult(Vec3 velocity, boolean resetFallDistance) {}
    public enum ContactState { ABOVE, INSIDE }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/prediction/ProtocolGlidingPrediction.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.prediction;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.BdsTrigMath;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.MathUtil;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;


public final class ProtocolGlidingPrediction {
    private static final float PI = (float) Math.PI, LOOK_LENGTH_SCALE = 0.4F, LIFT_FACTOR = 0.75F;
    private static final float FALL_CONVERSION = -0.1F, DIVE_CONVERSION = 0.04F, DIVE_VERTICAL_FACTOR = 3.2F;
    private static final float STEERING_FACTOR = 0.1F, BOOST_TARGET_SPEED = 1.5F, BOOST_BLEND = 0.5F;
    private static final float BOOST_FORWARD = 0.1F, HORIZONTAL_DRAG = 0.99F, VERTICAL_DRAG = 0.98F;
    private ProtocolGlidingPrediction() {}

    public static Vec3 travel(Vec3 movement, float previousPitch, float pitch, float previousYaw,
                              float yaw, float gravity, int glideBoostTicks) {
        float unwrappedPitch = unwrap(previousPitch, pitch), unwrappedYaw = unwrap(previousYaw, yaw);
        float pitchRadians = unwrappedPitch * MathUtil.DEGREE_TO_RAD;
        float negativePitchRadians = unwrappedPitch * -MathUtil.DEGREE_TO_RAD;
        float shiftedYawRadians = unwrappedYaw * -MathUtil.DEGREE_TO_RAD - PI;
        float negativePitchCos = -BdsTrigMath.cos(negativePitchRadians);
        Vec3 look = new Vec3(negativePitchCos * BdsTrigMath.sin(shiftedYawRadians),
                BdsTrigMath.sin(negativePitchRadians), negativePitchCos * BdsTrigMath.cos(shiftedYawRadians));
        Vec3 velocity = movement.clone();
        float horizontalLook = (float)Math.sqrt(look.x*look.x + look.z*look.z);
        float horizontalSpeed = (float)Math.sqrt(velocity.x*velocity.x + velocity.z*velocity.z);
        float lookLength = (float)Math.sqrt(look.x*look.x + look.y*look.y + look.z*look.z);
        float pitchCos = BdsTrigMath.cos(pitchRadians);
        float liftShape = pitchCos*pitchCos*Math.min(1.0F, lookLength/LOOK_LENGTH_SCALE);
        velocity.y += gravity * (LIFT_FACTOR*liftShape - 1.0F);
        if (velocity.y < 0 && horizontalLook > 0) {
            float converted=velocity.y*FALL_CONVERSION*liftShape;
            velocity.x += look.x*converted/horizontalLook; velocity.y += converted; velocity.z += look.z*converted/horizontalLook;
        }
        if (pitchRadians < 0 && horizontalLook > 0) {
            float converted=horizontalSpeed * -BdsTrigMath.sin(pitchRadians) * DIVE_CONVERSION;
            velocity.x -= look.x*converted/horizontalLook; velocity.y += converted*DIVE_VERTICAL_FACTOR; velocity.z -= look.z*converted/horizontalLook;
        }
        if (horizontalLook > 0) {
            velocity.x += (look.x/horizontalLook*horizontalSpeed - velocity.x)*STEERING_FACTOR;
            velocity.z += (look.z/horizontalLook*horizontalSpeed - velocity.z)*STEERING_FACTOR;
        }
        if (glideBoostTicks > 0) {
            velocity.x += (look.x*BOOST_TARGET_SPEED-velocity.x)*BOOST_BLEND + look.x*BOOST_FORWARD;
            velocity.y += (look.y*BOOST_TARGET_SPEED-velocity.y)*BOOST_BLEND + look.y*BOOST_FORWARD;
            velocity.z += (look.z*BOOST_TARGET_SPEED-velocity.z)*BOOST_BLEND + look.z*BOOST_FORWARD;
        }
        return velocity.multiply(HORIZONTAL_DRAG, VERTICAL_DRAG, HORIZONTAL_DRAG);
    }

    private static float unwrap(float previous, float current) {
        float remainder=(current-previous+180.0F)%360.0F;
        if (remainder < 0) remainder += 360.0F;
        return previous + remainder - 180.0F;
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/prediction/ProtocolGroundAirPhysics.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.prediction;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;


public final class ProtocolGroundAirPhysics {
    private static final float SLOW_BLOCK_MULTIPLIER = 1.225F;
    private static final float FRICTION_SCALE = 0.91F;
    private static final float DEFAULT_DAMPING = 0.54600006F;
    private ProtocolGroundAirPhysics() {}

    public static float movementSpeed(float speed, float friction,
                                      boolean soulSand, boolean soulSpeed) {
        float adjusted = friction;
        if (soulSand && !soulSpeed) adjusted *= SLOW_BLOCK_MULTIPLIER;
        float damping = adjusted * FRICTION_SCALE;
        if (damping == 0.0F) damping = DEFAULT_DAMPING;
        float ratio = DEFAULT_DAMPING / damping;
        float squared = ratio * ratio;
        float cubed = squared * ratio;
        return speed * cubed;
    }

    public static float airSpeed(boolean sprinting) {
        return sprinting ? 0.026F : 0.02F;
    }

    public static Vec3 applyGravity(Vec3 velocity, float gravity) {
        return new Vec3(velocity.x, velocity.y + gravity, velocity.z);
    }

    public static Vec3 applyDrag(Vec3 velocity, float slipperiness) {
        float horizontal = slipperiness * 0.91F;
        return velocity.multiply(horizontal, 0.98F, horizontal);
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/prediction/ProtocolGroundAirPrediction.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.prediction;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.BdsTrigMath;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.MathUtil;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;






public final class ProtocolGroundAirPrediction {
    private ProtocolGroundAirPrediction() {}

    public static Vec3 travel(Vec3 velocity, Vec3 input, float baseSpeed,
                               float slipperiness, boolean onGround,
                               boolean sprinting, boolean soulSand,
                               boolean soulSpeed, float yaw) {
        float speed = onGround
                ? ProtocolGroundAirPhysics.movementSpeed(baseSpeed, slipperiness, soulSand, soulSpeed)
                : ProtocolGroundAirPhysics.airSpeed(sprinting);
        return velocity.add(MathUtil.getInputVector(input, speed, yaw));
    }

    public static Vec3 jump(Vec3 velocity, boolean flying, boolean onGround,
                            boolean startJumping, int climbJumpDelay,
                            float blockJumpFactor, Integer jumpBoostAmplifier,
                            boolean sprinting, float yaw) {
        if (flying || !onGround || !startJumping || climbJumpDelay != 0) return velocity;
        float jumpBoost = jumpBoostAmplifier == null
                ? 0.0F : 0.1F * (jumpBoostAmplifier + 1.0F);
        float jumpPower = 0.42F * blockJumpFactor + jumpBoost;
        if (jumpPower <= 1.0E-5F) return velocity;
        Vec3 result = new Vec3(velocity.x, Math.max(jumpPower, velocity.y), velocity.z);
        return sprinting ? applySprintJump(result, yaw) : result;
    }

    public static Vec3 applySprintJump(Vec3 velocity, float yaw) {
        float radians = yaw * MathUtil.DEGREE_TO_RAD;
        return velocity.add(-BdsTrigMath.sin(radians) * 0.2F, 0,
                BdsTrigMath.cos(radians) * 0.2F);
    }

    public static Vec3 finalizeMovement(Vec3 velocity, Integer levitationAmplifier,
                                        float gravityDelta, float slipperiness) {
        Vec3 next = velocity;
        if (levitationAmplifier != null) {
            float target = 0.05F * (levitationAmplifier + 1);
            next = new Vec3(next.x, next.y + (target - next.y) * 0.2F, next.z);
        } else {
            next = new Vec3(next.x, next.y + gravityDelta, next.z);
        }
        next = new Vec3(next.x, next.y * 0.98F, next.z);
        float horizontal = slipperiness * 0.91F;
        return next.multiply(horizontal, 1.0F, horizontal);
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/prediction/ProtocolInputMath.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.prediction;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.MathUtil;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;
import ac.navro.proxy.state.WireVec2;


public final class ProtocolInputMath {
    private ProtocolInputMath() {}

    public static Vec3 normalize(WireVec2 rawMove, WireVec2 motion, boolean inventoryAction) {
        if (inventoryAction || rawMove == null || motion == null
                || (motion.x() == 0 && motion.y() == 0)) return Vec3.ZERO.clone();
        float x = MathUtil.clamp(rawMove.x(), -1, 1);
        float z = MathUtil.clamp(rawMove.y(), -1, 1);
        Vec3 input = new Vec3(x, 0, z);
        if (MathUtil.sign(input.x) == input.x && MathUtil.sign(input.z) == input.z
                && input.x != 0 && input.z != 0) return input.multiply(0.70710677F);
        float length = input.horizontalLength();
        return length >= 1 ? new Vec3(input.x / length, 0, input.z / length) : input;
    }

    public static Vec3 scale(Vec3 raw, boolean sprinting, boolean swimming,
                              boolean inventoryAction, boolean sneaking,
                              boolean crawling, boolean gliding, int slowdownTicks,
                              float swiftSneakModifier, float itemSlowdown) {
        Vec3 input = raw;
        if (sprinting && !swimming && !inventoryAction && input.z <= 0) {
            float forward = 1.0F;
            double length = Math.sqrt((double) input.x * input.x + forward * forward);
            input = new Vec3((float) (input.x / length), input.y, (float) (forward / length));
        }
        input = input.multiply(0.98F);
        if ((sneaking || crawling || gliding) && !swimming) {
            int ticks = slowdownTicks + 1;
            if (ticks > 0) {
                float multiplier = 0.3F + (ticks > 2 ? swiftSneakModifier : 0);
                input = input.multiply(MathUtil.clamp(multiplier, 0, 1));
            }
        }
        return itemSlowdown == 1.0F ? input : input.multiply(itemSlowdown);
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/prediction/ProtocolPredictionReplay.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.prediction;

import ac.navro.anticheat.collision.ProtocolCollisionSolver;
import ac.navro.anticheat.collision.SneakEdgePhysics;
import ac.navro.anticheat.collision.SweptMovement;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Box;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;
import ac.navro.proxy.collision.ProtocolCollisionWorld;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.fluid.ProtocolFluidPrediction;
import ac.navro.proxy.state.WireTickSnapshot;
import ac.navro.proxy.teleport.ProtocolTeleportMotion;

import java.util.List;






public final class ProtocolPredictionReplay {
    private final ProtocolCollisionWorld collisionWorld;
    private WireTickSnapshot replayInput;
    private ProtocolCollisionWorld replayWorld;

    private ProtocolCollisionWorld collisionContext(WireTickSnapshot snapshot) {
        if (snapshot.collisionState() == null || snapshot.collisionState().inputTick() != snapshot.tick()) return collisionWorld;
        if (replayInput != snapshot) {
            replayInput = snapshot;
            replayWorld = collisionWorld.replay(snapshot.tick(), snapshot.collisionState());
        }
        return replayWorld;
    }

    public ProtocolPredictionReplay(ProtocolCollisionWorld collisionWorld) {
        this.collisionWorld = collisionWorld;
    }

    public CandidateResult solveCandidate(WireTickSnapshot snapshot,
                                          Vec3 requestedMovement,
                                          Vec3 maxDepenetration,
                                          boolean yxz) {
        if (snapshot == null || snapshot.boundingBox() == null
                || !snapshot.boundingBox().isValid() || requestedMovement == null) {
            return CandidateResult.unavailable(snapshot == null ? -1 : snapshot.tick());
        }
        Box actor = snapshot.boundingBox();
        requestedMovement = ac.navro.anticheat.collision.CollisionQuery.clamp(requestedMovement);
        float step = snapshot.wasdControlled() ? 1.0625F : 0.5625F;
        ProtocolCollisionWorld context = collisionContext(snapshot);
        if (SneakEdgePhysics.active(snapshot.inputData().contains(
                org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData.SNEAK_DOWN), snapshot.sneaking(),
                snapshot.onGround(), snapshot.flag6())) {
            Box supportQuery = ac.navro.anticheat.collision.CollisionQuery.buildCollisionQuery(actor, requestedMovement, step);
            List<Box> support = context.collectColliders(context.entityCollisions(supportQuery, actor), supportQuery);
            requestedMovement = SneakEdgePhysics.resolve(actor, support, requestedMovement, step).movement();
        }
        Box query = ac.navro.anticheat.collision.CollisionQuery.buildCollisionQuery(actor, requestedMovement, step);
        List<Box> collisions = context.collectMovement(query, actor);
        boolean oneWay = snapshot.oneWayCollision() || snapshot.collisionPenetratingFrames() >= 2
                || context.collisionPhysics().hasOneWayCollision(actor, false);
        Vec3 depenetration = oneWay
                ? context.nearbyEntityShapes(actor).isEmpty() ? Vec3.ZERO : new Vec3(0.1F, 0.1F, 0.1F)
                : maxDepenetration;
        SweptMovement.MoveResult result = ProtocolCollisionSolver.solveResolved(
                requestedMovement, actor, collisions, depenetration, step,
                snapshot.onGround() || snapshot.flying());
        Vec3 postCollisionVelocity = applyInsideEffects(snapshot, result);
        return new CandidateResult(snapshot.tick(), result, collisions.size(), postCollisionVelocity);
    }

    private Vec3 applyInsideEffects(WireTickSnapshot snapshot, SweptMovement.MoveResult result) {
        Vec3 velocity = snapshot.velocity() == null ? result.movement.clone() : snapshot.velocity();
        List<ProtocolBlockEffects.BubbleContact> bubbles = ProtocolBlockEffects.bubbleContacts(
                collisionWorld.world(), result.aabb, collisionWorld.dimension());
        velocity = ProtocolBlockEffects.applyBubble(velocity, bubbles);
        ProtocolBlockEffects.HoneyResult honey = ProtocolBlockEffects.applyHoney(
                velocity, result.aabb.feetCenter(), snapshot.dimensions().width(),
                collisionWorld.world(), result.aabb, collisionWorld.dimension());
        return honey.velocity();
    }





    public CandidateResult solveGroundAir(WireTickSnapshot snapshot,
                                          float baseSpeed, float slipperiness,
                                          boolean soulSand, boolean soulSpeed,
                                          Integer jumpBoostAmplifier,
                                          Integer levitationAmplifier,
                                          float blockJumpFactor,
                                          float gravityDelta,
                                          int climbJumpDelay) {
        if (snapshot == null || snapshot.boundingBox() == null
                || !snapshot.boundingBox().isValid()) {
            return CandidateResult.unavailable(snapshot == null ? -1 : snapshot.tick());
        }
        Vec3 velocity = ProtocolGroundAirPrediction.jump(snapshot.velocity(), snapshot.flying(),
                snapshot.onGround(), snapshot.inputData().contains(
                        org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData.START_JUMPING),
                climbJumpDelay, blockJumpFactor, jumpBoostAmplifier,
                snapshot.predictionSprinting(), snapshot.inputRotation() == null
                        ? 0.0F : snapshot.inputRotation().y());
        velocity = ProtocolGroundAirPrediction.travel(velocity, snapshot.input(), baseSpeed,
                slipperiness, snapshot.onGround(), snapshot.predictionSprinting(), soulSand,
                soulSpeed, snapshot.inputRotation() == null ? 0.0F : snapshot.inputRotation().y());
        velocity = ProtocolGroundAirPrediction.finalizeMovement(velocity,
                levitationAmplifier, gravityDelta, slipperiness);
        return solveCandidate(snapshot, velocity, new Vec3(1, 1, 1), true);
    }

    public CandidateResult solveWater(WireTickSnapshot snapshot,
                                      int depthLevel,
                                      float movementSpeed, float underwaterSpeed,
                                      float swimMultiplier, float waterDrag,
                                      boolean jumping, boolean breathingLiquid,
                                      boolean breathingAir, boolean wantDownSlow,
                                      float yaw) {
        if (snapshot == null) return CandidateResult.unavailable(-1);
        ProtocolFluidPrediction.WaterParameters parameters = ProtocolFluidPrediction.waterParameters(
                depthLevel, snapshot.onGround(), movementSpeed,
                underwaterSpeed, swimMultiplier, snapshot.predictionSprinting(), waterDrag);
        Vec3 velocity = ProtocolFluidPrediction.moveRelative(snapshot.velocity(), snapshot.input(),
                parameters.strength(), yaw);
        Vec3 view = snapshot.inputRotation() == null ? null
                : ac.navro.anticheat.util.MathUtil.getRotationVector(
                        snapshot.inputRotation().x(), snapshot.inputRotation().y());
        velocity = ProtocolFluidPrediction.swimControl(velocity,
                view == null ? 0 : view.y,
                snapshot.predictionSwimming(), jumping, snapshot.flying(), breathingLiquid,
                breathingAir, wantDownSlow);
        velocity = new Vec3(velocity.x * parameters.horizontalDrag(), velocity.y * 0.8F,
                velocity.z * parameters.horizontalDrag());
        return solveCandidate(snapshot, velocity, new Vec3(1, 1, 1), true);
    }

    public CandidateResult solveLava(WireTickSnapshot snapshot, float lavaSpeed,
                                     boolean climbing, boolean sneaking,
                                     boolean climbHaltAtFeet, float yaw) {
        if (snapshot == null) return CandidateResult.unavailable(-1);
        Vec3 velocity = ProtocolFluidPrediction.moveRelative(snapshot.velocity(), snapshot.input(), lavaSpeed, yaw);
        velocity = new Vec3(velocity.x,
                ProtocolFluidPrediction.lavaClimbVelocity(velocity.y, climbing, sneaking, climbHaltAtFeet),
                velocity.z);
        velocity = new Vec3(velocity.x * 0.5F, velocity.y, velocity.z * 0.5F);
        return solveCandidate(snapshot, velocity, new Vec3(1, 1, 1), true);
    }

    public CandidateResult solveGliding(WireTickSnapshot snapshot, WireTickSnapshot previous,
                                        float gravity) {
        if (snapshot == null || previous == null || !snapshot.gliding()) {
            return CandidateResult.unavailable(snapshot == null ? -1 : snapshot.tick());
        }
        float pitch = snapshot.inputRotation() == null ? 0 : snapshot.inputRotation().x();
        float yaw = snapshot.inputRotation() == null ? 0 : snapshot.inputRotation().y();
        float previousPitch = previous.inputRotation() == null ? pitch : previous.inputRotation().x();
        float previousYaw = previous.inputRotation() == null ? yaw : previous.inputRotation().y();
        Vec3 velocity = ProtocolGlidingPrediction.travel(snapshot.velocity(), previousPitch, pitch,
                previousYaw, yaw, gravity, snapshot.glideBoostTicks());
        return solveCandidate(snapshot, velocity, new Vec3(1, 1, 1), true);
    }

    public CandidateResult solveRiptide(WireTickSnapshot snapshot, int riptideLevel,
                                        boolean wasInWater, boolean headInWater) {
        if (snapshot == null || riptideLevel <= 0) return CandidateResult.unavailable(snapshot == null ? -1 : snapshot.tick());
        float pitch = snapshot.inputRotation() == null ? 0 : snapshot.inputRotation().x();
        float yaw = snapshot.inputRotation() == null ? 0 : snapshot.inputRotation().y();
        Vec3 velocity = ProtocolRiptidePrediction.impulse(snapshot.velocity(), pitch, yaw,
                riptideLevel, snapshot.onGround(), wasInWater, headInWater);
        return solveCandidate(snapshot, velocity, new Vec3(1, 1, 1), true);
    }


    public Selection selectCandidate(WireTickSnapshot snapshot, List<VelocityCandidate> candidates,
                                     Vec3 maxDepenetration) {
        if (snapshot == null || candidates == null || candidates.isEmpty()) {
            return new Selection(snapshot == null ? -1 : snapshot.tick(), null, Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY);
        }
        VelocityCandidate best = null;
        CandidateResult bestResult = null;
        float closest = Float.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
        for (VelocityCandidate candidate : candidates) {
            CandidateResult result = solveCandidate(snapshot, candidate.velocity(), maxDepenetration, true);
            if (!result.available()) continue;
            Vec3 feet = result.result().aabb.feetCenter();
            float distance = wireResidualSquared(snapshot, feet, candidate.yOffset());
            boolean horizontal = !ac.navro.anticheat.util.MathUtil.equal(result.result().movement.x, candidate.velocity().x)
                    || !ac.navro.anticheat.util.MathUtil.equal(result.result().movement.z, candidate.velocity().z);
            boolean vertical = result.result().movement.y != candidate.velocity().y;
            if (horizontal != snapshot.horizontalCollision()) distance += 1.0E-6F;
            if (vertical != snapshot.verticalCollision()) distance += 1.0E-6F;
            if (distance < closest) {
                closest = distance;
                best = candidate;
                bestResult = result;
            }
        }
        return new Selection(snapshot.tick(), bestResult == null ? null : new SelectedCandidate(best, bestResult), closest);
    }

    public Selection selectWithMotionSeeds(WireTickSnapshot snapshot,
                                           List<WireMotionSeed> seeds,
                                           float yOffset,
                                           Vec3 maxDepenetration) {
        return selectWithMotionSeeds(snapshot, seeds, List.of(), yOffset, maxDepenetration);
    }

    public Selection selectWithMotionSeeds(WireTickSnapshot snapshot,
                                           List<WireMotionSeed> seeds,
                                           List<ProtocolTeleportMotion> teleportSeeds,
                                           float yOffset,
                                           Vec3 maxDepenetration) {
        if (snapshot == null) return new Selection(-1, null, Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY);
        List<VelocityCandidate> candidates = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        if (snapshot.velocity() != null) candidates.add(new VelocityCandidate("NORMAL", snapshot.velocity(), yOffset));
        if (seeds != null) for (WireMotionSeed seed : seeds) {
            if (seed != null && seed.velocity() != null) {
                addDistinct(candidates, new VelocityCandidate(seed.source(), seed.velocity(), yOffset));
            }
        }
        if (teleportSeeds != null) for (ProtocolTeleportMotion seed : teleportSeeds) {
            if (seed == null) continue;
            for (Vec3 velocity : seed.velocitiesForTick(snapshot.tick())) {
                addDistinct(candidates, new VelocityCandidate("TELEPORT", velocity, yOffset));
            }
        }
        return selectCandidate(snapshot, candidates, maxDepenetration);
    }

    private static void addDistinct(List<VelocityCandidate> candidates, VelocityCandidate candidate) {
        for (VelocityCandidate existing : candidates) {
            if (candidate.velocity().squaredDistanceTo(existing.velocity()) <= 1.0E-12F) return;
        }
        candidates.add(candidate);
    }

    private static float wireResidualSquared(WireTickSnapshot snapshot, Vec3 feet, float yOffset) {
        if (snapshot.inputPosition() == null || feet == null) return Float.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
        ac.navro.anticheat.data.input.InputPosition observation = snapshot.observedPosition();
        if (observation == null) observation = new ac.navro.anticheat.data.input.InputPosition(
                snapshot.inputPosition().x(), snapshot.inputPosition().y(), snapshot.inputPosition().z(), yOffset);
        return observation.residual(feet).lengthSquared();
    }

    public record CandidateResult(long tick, SweptMovement.MoveResult result,
                                  int collisionCount, Vec3 postCollisionVelocity) {
        public boolean available() { return result != null; }
        static CandidateResult unavailable(long tick) { return new CandidateResult(tick, null, 0, null); }
    }

    public record VelocityCandidate(String type, Vec3 velocity, float yOffset) {}
    public record SelectedCandidate(VelocityCandidate candidate, CandidateResult result) {}
    public record Selection(long tick, SelectedCandidate selected, double distanceSquared) {}
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/prediction/ProtocolRiptidePrediction.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.prediction;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.BdsTrigMath;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;


public final class ProtocolRiptidePrediction {
    private static final float DEGREES_TO_RADIANS = 0.017453292F;
    private static final float NORMALIZATION_EPSILON = 0.0001F;
    private ProtocolRiptidePrediction() {}

    public static Vec3 impulse(Vec3 velocity, float pitch, float yaw, int level,
                               boolean onGround, boolean wasInWater, boolean headInWater) {
        if (level <= 0) return velocity;
        float pitchRadians=pitch*DEGREES_TO_RADIANS,yawRadians=yaw*DEGREES_TO_RADIANS;
        float negativeSinYaw=-BdsTrigMath.sin(yawRadians),cosPitch=BdsTrigMath.cos(pitchRadians);
        float x=negativeSinYaw*cosPitch,sinPitch=BdsTrigMath.sin(pitchRadians),z=cosPitch*BdsTrigMath.cos(yawRadians);
        float length=(float)Math.sqrt(z*z+sinPitch*sinPitch+x*x);
        float y;
        if(length<NORMALIZATION_EPSILON){x=y=z=0.0F;}else{x/=length;y=-sinPitch/length;z/=length;}
        float magnitude=(level+1.0F)*0.25F*3.0F;
        x*=magnitude;y*=magnitude;z*=magnitude;
        if(onGround){if(!(wasInWater&&!headInWater)){y+=0.08F;}else{y/=0.8F;y*=0.98F;}}
        return new Vec3(x+velocity.x,y+velocity.y,z+velocity.z);
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/prediction/RiptidePhysics.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.prediction;

import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.live.PredictionContext;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.live.NativeIds;


import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.fluid.FluidMovement;

import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.engine.data.VectorType;
import ac.navro.proxy.collision.CollisionShapeEntry;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.BdsTrigMath;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;


public final class RiptidePhysics {
    private static final float DEGREES_TO_RADIANS = 0.017453292F;
    private static final float NORMALIZATION_EPSILON = 0.0001F;

    private RiptidePhysics() { }

    public static int level(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.ItemData item) {
        return item != null && !item.isNull() && item.getDefinition()!=null && "minecraft:trident".equals(item.getDefinition().getIdentifier())
                ? ac.navro.proxy.compensated.CompensatedInventory.getEnchantmentLevel(item, NativeIds.Enchantment.ID_TRIDENT_RIPTIDE) : 0;
    }


    public static void prepare(PredictionContext player) {
        player.thisTickRiptideLevel = player.dirtyRiptide ? level(player.riptideItem) : 0;
        player.dirtyRiptide = false;
        player.riptideItem = org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.ItemData.AIR;
        player.thisTickSpinAttack = player.thisTickRiptideLevel > 0;
        player.thisTickOnGroundSpinAttack = player.thisTickSpinAttack && player.onGround;
        if (!player.thisTickSpinAttack) return;
        player.autoSpinAttackTicks = 20;
        player.getFlagTracker().set("SPIN_ATTACK", true);
        FluidMovement.updatePose(player);
    }

    public static Vec3 applyImpulse(PredictionContext player, Vec3 velocity) {
        if (player.thisTickRiptideLevel <= 0) return velocity;
        return impulse(velocity, player.pitch, player.yaw, player.thisTickRiptideLevel,
                player.thisTickOnGroundSpinAttack, player.riptideWasInWater,
                player.fluidPrediction.headInWater);
    }

    public static Vec3 impulse(Vec3 velocity, float pitch, float yaw, int level,
                               boolean onGround, boolean wasInWater, boolean headInWater) {
        final float pitchRadians = pitch * DEGREES_TO_RADIANS;
        final float yawRadians = yaw * DEGREES_TO_RADIANS;
        final float negativeSinYaw = -BdsTrigMath.sin(yawRadians);
        final float cosPitch = BdsTrigMath.cos(pitchRadians);
        float x = negativeSinYaw * cosPitch;
        final float sinPitch = BdsTrigMath.sin(pitchRadians);
        float z = cosPitch * BdsTrigMath.cos(yawRadians);
        final float xSquared = x * x;
        final float ySquared = sinPitch * sinPitch;
        final float xySquared = ySquared + xSquared;
        final float zSquared = z * z;
        final float length = StickyBlockPhysics.sqrtf(zSquared + xySquared);
        float y;
        if (length < NORMALIZATION_EPSILON) {
            x = y = z = 0.0F;
        } else {
            x = x / length;
            y = -sinPitch;
            y = y / length;
            z = z / length;
        }
        float magnitude = (float) level;
        magnitude = magnitude + 1.0F;
        magnitude = magnitude * 0.25F;
        magnitude = magnitude * 3.0F;
        x = x * magnitude;
        y = y * magnitude;
        z = z * magnitude;
        if (onGround) {
            if (!(wasInWater && !headInWater)) {
                y = y + 0.08F;
            } else {
                y = y / 0.8F;
                y = y * 0.98F;
            }
        }
        return new Vec3(x + velocity.x, y + velocity.y, z + velocity.z);
    }

    public record Snapshot(boolean pending, boolean stopRequested, int ticks, org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.ItemData item) { }

    public static Snapshot snapshot(PredictionContext player) {
        return new Snapshot(player.dirtyRiptide, player.dirtySpinStop,
                player.autoSpinAttackTicks, ac.navro.proxy.util.ItemUtil.copy(player.riptideItem));
    }

    public static void restore(PredictionContext player, Snapshot state) {
        player.dirtyRiptide = state != null && state.pending();
        player.dirtySpinStop = state != null && state.stopRequested();
        player.autoSpinAttackTicks = state == null ? 0 : state.ticks();
        player.riptideItem = state == null ? org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.ItemData.AIR : ac.navro.proxy.util.ItemUtil.copy(state.item());
        player.thisTickRiptideLevel = 0;
        player.thisTickSpinAttack = player.thisTickOnGroundSpinAttack = false;
        player.getFlagTracker().set("SPIN_ATTACK", player.autoSpinAttackTicks > 0);
        FluidMovement.updatePose(player);
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/prediction/SneakInputPhysics.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.prediction;

import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.live.PredictionContext;

import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.engine.data.VectorType;
import ac.navro.proxy.collision.CollisionShapeEntry;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.MathUtil;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;


public final class SneakInputPhysics {
    private SneakInputPhysics() { }

    public static boolean shouldScale(final PredictionContext player) {
        final boolean sneaking = player.getFlagTracker().has("SNEAKING")
                || player.getInputData().contains(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData.STOP_SNEAKING);


        final boolean crawling = player.fluidPrediction.inputActive ? player.fluidPrediction.wasCrawling
                : player.getFlagTracker().has("CRAWLING");

        return (sneaking || crawling
                || player.getFlagTracker().has("GLIDING")) && !player.fluidPrediction.waterTravel;
    }

    public static Vec3 scale(final PredictionContext player, final Vec3 input,
                             final boolean swiftSneak, final boolean commit) {
        final int ticks = shouldScale(player) ? player.ticksSinceCanSlowdown + 1 : 0;
        if (commit) player.ticksSinceCanSlowdown = ticks;
        if (ticks == 0) return input;
        final float multiplier = 0.3F + (ticks > 2 && swiftSneak ? player.sneakingAttributeModifier : 0);
        return input.multiply(MathUtil.clamp(multiplier, 0, 1));
    }
}
```

```java
        final float radians = yaw * MathUtil.DEGREE_TO_RAD;
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/prediction/StickyBlockPhysics.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.prediction;

import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.live.PredictionContext;


import ac.navro.proxy.data.block.NavroBlockState;

import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.engine.data.VectorType;
import ac.navro.proxy.collision.CollisionShapeEntry;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Box;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;
import java.util.List;


public final class StickyBlockPhysics {
    private static final float EPSILON = 1.1920929E-7F;
    private static final float MIN_DOWNWARD_IMPACT = 0.08000011742115021F;

    private StickyBlockPhysics() { }

    public record GravityCorrection(float requestedY, float resolvedY) { }
    public record Restitution(Vec3 velocity, GravityCorrection gravityCorrection) { }

    public static Restitution restitute(Box actorBox, List<CollisionShapeEntry> entries,
                                       Vec3 velocity, Vec3 requested, Vec3 resolved,
                                       boolean collisionX, boolean collisionY, boolean collisionZ,
                                       boolean sneaking) {
        final Vec3 output = new Vec3(collisionX ? 0 : velocity.x,
                collisionY ? 0 : velocity.y, collisionZ ? 0 : velocity.z);
        float bounceY = 0;

        if (collisionY && !sneaking && velocity.y < 0 && Math.abs(velocity.y) >= MIN_DOWNWARD_IMPACT) {
            final CollisionShapeEntry support = selectRestitutionShape(actorBox, entries);
            final float coefficient = support == null || support.block() == null
                    ? 0 : new NavroBlockState(support.block()).getBlockBounciness();
            if (Float.isFinite(coefficient) && Math.abs(coefficient) > EPSILON
                    && coefficient != -1.0F) {
                bounceY = Math.max(0, -velocity.y * coefficient);
                output.y += bounceY;
            }
        }
        final GravityCorrection correction = Math.abs(bounceY) > EPSILON
                && Math.abs(resolved.y) > EPSILON
                ? new GravityCorrection(requested.y, resolved.y) : null;
        return new Restitution(output, correction);
    }

    public static CollisionShapeEntry selectRestitutionShape(Box actorBox,
                                                            List<CollisionShapeEntry> entries) {
        if (actorBox == null || !actorBox.isValid() || entries == null) return null;
        final float targetX = midpoint(actorBox.minX, actorBox.maxX);
        final float targetY = actorBox.minY - 0.20000000298023224F;
        final float targetZ = midpoint(actorBox.minZ, actorBox.maxZ);
        CollisionShapeEntry selected = null;
        float verticalDistance = Float.MAX_VALUE, distanceSquared = Float.MAX_VALUE;
        for (CollisionShapeEntry entry : entries) {
            if (entry == null || !entry.shape().isValid()) continue;
            final Box candidate = entry.shape();
            final float candidateVerticalDistance = targetY - midpoint(candidate.minY, candidate.maxY);
            if (candidateVerticalDistance < 0) continue;
            final float candidateDistanceSquared = restitutionDistanceSquared(targetX, targetY, targetZ, candidate);
            if (selected == null || candidateVerticalDistance < verticalDistance
                    || candidateVerticalDistance == verticalDistance && candidateDistanceSquared < distanceSquared) {
                selected = entry;
                verticalDistance = candidateVerticalDistance;
                distanceSquared = candidateDistanceSquared;
            }
        }
        return selected;
    }


    public static float resolveGravityDelta(PredictionContext player, float ordinaryGravityDelta) {
        final GravityCorrection correction = player.bounceGravityCorrection;
        player.bounceGravityCorrection = null;
        return resolveGravityDelta(correction, ordinaryGravityDelta);
    }

    public static float resolveGravityDelta(GravityCorrection correction, float ordinaryGravityDelta) {
        if (correction == null || Math.abs(correction.resolvedY()) <= EPSILON
                || Math.abs(ordinaryGravityDelta) <= EPSILON) return ordinaryGravityDelta;
        final float gravityMagnitude = Math.abs(ordinaryGravityDelta);
        final float requestedSquared = correction.requestedY() * correction.requestedY();
        final float radicand = (gravityMagnitude + gravityMagnitude)
                * Math.abs(correction.resolvedY()) + requestedSquared;
        final float impactSpeed = sqrtf(radicand);
        final float impactFraction = (Math.abs(correction.requestedY()) - impactSpeed) / ordinaryGravityDelta;
        final float remainingTick = 1.0F - Math.abs(impactFraction);
        final float sign = correction.requestedY() > 0 ? 1 : correction.requestedY() < 0 ? -1 : 0;
        return gravityMagnitude * remainingTick * sign;
    }

    public static void standOn(PredictionContext player) {
        applyStandOn(player.velocity, player.getFlagTracker().has("SNEAKING"));
    }

    public static void applyStandOn(Vec3 velocity, boolean sneaking) {
        if (sneaking || velocity.y >= 0.1F) return;
        final float scale = 0.4F + Math.abs(velocity.y) * 0.2F;
        velocity.x *= scale;
        velocity.z *= scale;
    }


    public static boolean insideHoney(Vec3 velocity, Vec3 position, float width, org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector3i block) {
        velocity.x *= 0.4F;

        velocity.y = -0.12F > velocity.y ? -0.12F : velocity.y;
        velocity.z *= 0.4F;
        if (position.y > block.getY() + 0.9375F || velocity.y >= 0) return false;
        final float sideLimit = width * 0.5F + 0.4312500059604645F;
        return Math.abs(block.getX() + 0.5F - position.x) > sideLimit
                || Math.abs(block.getZ() + 0.5F - position.z) > sideLimit;
    }


    public static Box selectStandingShape(Box actor, List<Box> candidates) {
        final float targetX = (actor.minX + actor.maxX) * 0.5F;
        final float targetY = actor.minY - 0.2F;
        final float targetZ = (actor.minZ + actor.maxZ) * 0.5F;
        Box selected = null;
        float distance = Float.MAX_VALUE;
        for (Box candidate : candidates) {
            if (candidate == null || !candidate.isValid()
                    || !(actor.minX < candidate.maxX && candidate.minX < actor.maxX
                    && targetY < candidate.maxY && candidate.minY < targetY
                    && actor.minZ < candidate.maxZ && candidate.minZ < actor.maxZ)) continue;
            final float candidateDistance = distanceSquared(targetX, targetY, targetZ, candidate);
            if (selected == null || candidate.maxY > selected.maxY
                    || candidate.maxY == selected.maxY && candidateDistance < distance) {
                selected = candidate;
                distance = candidateDistance;
            }
        }
        return selected;
    }

    static float sqrtf(float value) {
        if (Float.isNaN(value) || value < 0) return Float.NaN;
        if (value == 0 || value == Float.POSITIVE_INFINITY) return value;
        float candidate = (float) StrictMath.sqrt((double) value);
        final double exactInput = value;
        while (true) {
            final float lower = Math.nextDown(candidate);
            final double lowerMidpoint = ((double) lower + candidate) * 0.5D;
            final boolean odd = (Float.floatToRawIntBits(candidate) & 1) != 0;
            final double lowerBoundary = lowerMidpoint * lowerMidpoint;
            if (exactInput < lowerBoundary || exactInput == lowerBoundary && odd) {
                candidate = lower;
                continue;
            }
            final float upper = Math.nextUp(candidate);
            final double upperMidpoint = ((double) candidate + upper) * 0.5D;
            final double upperBoundary = upperMidpoint * upperMidpoint;
            if (exactInput > upperBoundary || exactInput == upperBoundary && odd) {
                candidate = upper;
                continue;
            }
            return candidate;
        }
    }

    private static float restitutionDistanceSquared(float x, float y, float z, Box box) {
        final float dx = midpoint(box.minX, box.maxX) - x;
        final float dy = midpoint(box.minY, box.maxY) - y;
        final float dz = midpoint(box.minZ, box.maxZ) - z;
        return dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz;
    }

    private static float midpoint(float min, float max) { return (max - min) * 0.5F + min; }

    private static float distanceSquared(float x, float y, float z, Box box) {
        final float dx = (box.minX + box.maxX) * 0.5F - x;
        final float dy = (box.minY + box.maxY) * 0.5F - y;
        final float dz = (box.minZ + box.maxZ) * 0.5F - z;
        return dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz;
    }
}
```

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.prediction.engine.base;

import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.live.PredictionContext;


import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.ClimbableBlockPhysics;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.MathUtil;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;


public abstract class PredictionEngine {
    protected final PredictionContext player;
    protected PredictionEngine(PredictionContext player){this.player=player;}

    public abstract Vec3 travel(Vec3 vec3);
    public abstract void finalizeMovement();

    protected final Vec3 moveRelative(Vec3 delta, float f) {
        return delta.add(MathUtil.getInputVector(player.input, f, player.yaw));
    }

    protected final Vec3 applyClimbingSpeed(final Vec3 motion) {
        return ClimbableBlockPhysics.clampDownwardMovement(player, motion);
    }
}
```
