`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/prediction/engine/impl/GlidingPredictionEngine.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.prediction.engine.impl;

import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.live.PredictionContext;


import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.engine.base.PredictionEngine;

import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.engine.data.VectorType;
import ac.navro.proxy.collision.CollisionShapeEntry;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.BdsTrigMath;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.MathUtil;

public class GlidingPredictionEngine extends PredictionEngine {
    private static final float PI = (float) Math.PI;
    private static final float LOOK_LENGTH_SCALE = 0.4F;
    private static final float LIFT_FACTOR = 0.75F;
    private static final float FALL_CONVERSION = -0.1F;
    private static final float DIVE_CONVERSION = 0.04F;
    private static final float DIVE_VERTICAL_FACTOR = 3.2F;
    private static final float STEERING_FACTOR = 0.1F;
    private static final float BOOST_TARGET_SPEED = 1.5F;
    private static final float BOOST_BLEND = 0.5F;
    private static final float BOOST_FORWARD = 0.1F;
    private static final float HORIZONTAL_DRAG = 0.99F;
    private static final float VERTICAL_DRAG = 0.98F;

    public GlidingPredictionEngine(final PredictionContext player) {
        super(player);
    }

    @Override
    public Vec3 travel(final Vec3 movement) {

        final float pitch = unwrapDegrees(player.prevPitch, player.pitch);
        final float yaw = unwrapDegrees(player.prevYaw, player.yaw);
        final float pitchRadians = pitch * MathUtil.DEGREE_TO_RAD;
        final float negativePitchRadians = pitch * -MathUtil.DEGREE_TO_RAD;
        final float shiftedYawRadians = yaw * -MathUtil.DEGREE_TO_RAD - PI;
        final float negativePitchCos = -BdsTrigMath.cos(negativePitchRadians);
        final Vec3 look = new Vec3(
                negativePitchCos * BdsTrigMath.sin(shiftedYawRadians),
                BdsTrigMath.sin(negativePitchRadians),
                negativePitchCos * BdsTrigMath.cos(shiftedYawRadians)
        );


        final Vec3 velocity = movement.clone();
        final float horizontalLook = (float) Math.sqrt(
                look.x * look.x + look.z * look.z);
        final float horizontalSpeed = (float) Math.sqrt(
                velocity.x * velocity.x + velocity.z * velocity.z);
        final float lookLength = (float) Math.sqrt(
                look.x * look.x + look.y * look.y + look.z * look.z);
        final float pitchCos = BdsTrigMath.cos(pitchRadians);
        final float liftShape = pitchCos * pitchCos
                * Math.min(1.0F, lookLength / LOOK_LENGTH_SCALE);
        final float gravity = player.getEffectiveGravity(movement);
        velocity.y += gravity * (LIFT_FACTOR * liftShape - 1.0F);

        if (velocity.y < 0.0F && horizontalLook > 0.0F) {
            final float converted = velocity.y * FALL_CONVERSION * liftShape;
            velocity.x += look.x * converted / horizontalLook;
            velocity.y += converted;
            velocity.z += look.z * converted / horizontalLook;
        }

        if (pitchRadians < 0.0F && horizontalLook > 0.0F) {
            final float converted = horizontalSpeed
                    * -BdsTrigMath.sin(pitchRadians)
                    * DIVE_CONVERSION;
            velocity.x -= look.x * converted / horizontalLook;
            velocity.y += converted * DIVE_VERTICAL_FACTOR;
            velocity.z -= look.z * converted / horizontalLook;
        }

        if (horizontalLook > 0.0F) {
            velocity.x += (look.x / horizontalLook * horizontalSpeed
                    - velocity.x) * STEERING_FACTOR;
            velocity.z += (look.z / horizontalLook * horizontalSpeed
                    - velocity.z) * STEERING_FACTOR;
        }

        if (player.glideBoostTicks > 0) {
            velocity.x += (look.x * BOOST_TARGET_SPEED - velocity.x)
                    * BOOST_BLEND + look.x * BOOST_FORWARD;
            velocity.y += (look.y * BOOST_TARGET_SPEED - velocity.y)
                    * BOOST_BLEND + look.y * BOOST_FORWARD;
            velocity.z += (look.z * BOOST_TARGET_SPEED - velocity.z)
                    * BOOST_BLEND + look.z * BOOST_FORWARD;
        }

        velocity.x *= HORIZONTAL_DRAG;
        velocity.y *= VERTICAL_DRAG;
        velocity.z *= HORIZONTAL_DRAG;

        return velocity;
    }

    private static float unwrapDegrees(final float previous, final float current) {
        return previous + positiveModulo(current - previous + 180.0F, 360.0F)
                - 180.0F;
    }

    private static float positiveModulo(final float value, final float modulus) {
        final float remainder = value % modulus;
        return remainder < 0.0F ? remainder + modulus : remainder;
    }

    @Override
    public void finalizeMovement() {}
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/prediction/engine/impl/GroundAndAirPredictionEngine.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.prediction.engine.impl;

import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.live.PredictionContext;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.live.NativeIds;


import ac.navro.proxy.collision.ScaffoldingCollision;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.ClimbableBlockPhysics;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.StickyBlockPhysics;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.engine.base.PredictionEngine;

import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.engine.data.VectorType;
import ac.navro.proxy.collision.CollisionShapeEntry;

import ac.navro.anticheat.data.vanilla.StatusEffect;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;


public class GroundAndAirPredictionEngine extends PredictionEngine {
    private float prevSlipperiness = 0.6F;

    public GroundAndAirPredictionEngine(PredictionContext player) {
        super(player);
    }

    @Override
    public Vec3 travel(Vec3 vec3) {
        org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector3i blockPos = player.getBlockPosBelowThatAffectsMyMovement();
        this.prevSlipperiness = player.onGround ? player.compensatedWorld.getBlockState(blockPos, 0).getFriction() : 1.0f;

        final Vec3 result = this.halfRelativeMovementCalculate(vec3, this.prevSlipperiness);

        return result;
    }

    @Override
    public void finalizeMovement() {

        final StatusEffect effect = player.getEffect(NativeIds.Effect.LEVITATION);
        if (effect != null) {
            player.velocity.y += (0.05f * (effect.amplifier() + 1) - player.velocity.y) * 0.2f;
        } else if (!(player.getFlagTracker().has(ScaffoldingCollision.DESCEND_THROUGH_BLOCK_FLAG)
                && (player.getFlagTracker().has("IN_SCAFFOLDING")
                || player.getFlagTracker().has("OVER_SCAFFOLDING")))) {
            player.velocity.y += StickyBlockPhysics.resolveGravityDelta(player, -player.getEffectiveGravity());
        }

        player.bounceGravityCorrection = null;
        player.velocity.y *= 0.98F;

        ClimbableBlockPhysics.applyAutoClimb(player);

        float g = this.prevSlipperiness * 0.91F;
        player.velocity = player.velocity.multiply(g, 1, g);

    }

    private Vec3 halfRelativeMovementCalculate(Vec3 vec3, float f) {
        vec3 = this.moveRelative(vec3, player.getFrictionInfluencedSpeed(f));
        return this.applyClimbingSpeed(vec3);
    }
}
```

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.prediction.engine.impl.fluid;

import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.live.PredictionContext;


import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.ClimbableBlockPhysics;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.StickyBlockPhysics;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.engine.base.PredictionEngine;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.fluid.FluidMovement;

import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.engine.data.VectorType;
import ac.navro.proxy.collision.CollisionShapeEntry;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;

public class LavaPredictionEngine extends PredictionEngine {
    public LavaPredictionEngine(PredictionContext player) { super(player); }

    @Override public Vec3 travel(Vec3 velocity) {
        final Vec3 moved = FluidMovement.moveRelative(velocity, player.input, player.getLavaSpeed(), player.yaw);
        final boolean halt = ClimbableBlockPhysics.hasClimbHaltAtFeet(player);
        return new Vec3(moved.x, FluidMovement.lavaClimbVelocity(moved.y, FluidMovement.isClimbing(player),
                player.getFlagTracker().has("SNEAKING"), halt), moved.z);
    }

    @Override public void finalizeMovement() {
        player.velocity = player.velocity.multiply(0.5F);
        final float gravity = player.getEffectiveGravity();
        if (gravity != 0) {
            player.velocity.y += StickyBlockPhysics.resolveGravityDelta(player, -gravity / 4.0F);
        }
        player.bounceGravityCorrection = null;
        player.fallDistance = 0;
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/prediction/engine/impl/fluid/WaterPredictionEngine.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.prediction.engine.impl.fluid;

import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.live.PredictionContext;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.live.NativeIds;


import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.StickyBlockPhysics;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.engine.base.PredictionEngine;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.fluid.FluidMovement;

import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.engine.data.VectorType;
import ac.navro.proxy.collision.CollisionShapeEntry;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;
import java.util.Map;

public class WaterPredictionEngine extends PredictionEngine {
    private float depthRatio;
    public WaterPredictionEngine(PredictionContext player) { super(player); }

    @Override public Vec3 travel(Vec3 velocity) {
        final org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.ItemData boots = player.compensatedInventory.armorContainer.get(3).getData();
        final Map<Integer, Integer> enchantments = ac.navro.proxy.compensated.CompensatedInventory.getEnchantments(player.nativeItem(boots));
        final Integer depthType = NativeIds.Enchantment.getEnchantment(NativeIds.Enchantment.ID_WATER_WALKER);
        final int level = depthType == null ? 0 : Math.max(0, enchantments.getOrDefault(depthType, 0));
        final var parameters = FluidMovement.waterParameters(level, player.onGround,
                player.getSpeed(), player.getUnderwaterSpeed(), player.fluidPrediction.swimSpeedMultiplier,
                player.isPredictionSprinting(), player.fluidPrediction.waterDrag);
        depthRatio = parameters.depthRatio();
        player.hasDepthStrider = depthRatio > 0;
        return FluidMovement.moveRelative(velocity, player.input, parameters.strength(), player.yaw);
    }

    @Override public void finalizeMovement() {
        final float base = player.isPredictionSprinting() ? 0.9F
                : Float.isFinite(player.fluidPrediction.waterDrag) ? player.fluidPrediction.waterDrag : 0.8F;
        final float drag = player.fluidPrediction.swimSpeedMultiplier > 1 ? base
                : base + (0.54600006F - base) * depthRatio;
        player.velocity = player.velocity.multiply(drag, 0.8F, drag);
        if (player.hasEffect(NativeIds.Effect.LEVITATION)) {
            final float target = (player.getEffect(NativeIds.Effect.LEVITATION).amplifier() + 1) * 0.05F;
            player.velocity.y += (target - player.velocity.y) * 0.2F;
        } else {
            final float gravity = player.getEffectiveGravity();
            if (gravity != 0 && !player.isPredictionSwimming()) {
                player.velocity.y += StickyBlockPhysics.resolveGravityDelta(player, -gravity / 16.0F);
            }
        }
        player.bounceGravityCorrection = null;
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/prediction/fluid/FluidBlockCollision.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.prediction.fluid;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Box;
import ac.navro.proxy.compensated.world.base.CompensatedWorld;
import ac.navro.proxy.data.block.*;
import ac.navro.proxy.data.block.NativeFluidBlockProperties.Properties;
import static ac.navro.proxy.data.block.NativeFluidBlockProperties.*;
import ac.navro.proxy.collision.BedrockCollision;
import ac.navro.proxy.collision.PlantCollision;
import org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector3i;
import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;




public final class FluidBlockCollision {
    private FluidBlockCollision() { }
    static final class Context {
        final WorldAccess compensatedWorld;
        Context(CompensatedWorld world){compensatedWorld=new WorldAccess(world);}
    }
    static final class WorldAccess {
        final CompensatedWorld world;
        WorldAccess(CompensatedWorld world){this.world=world;}
        State getBlockState(int x,int y,int z,int layer){return state(world,world.networkBlockState(world.getRawBlockAt(x,y,z,layer)));}
    }
    static final class State {
        private final NetworkBlockState network;
        private final Properties nativeState;
        State(NetworkBlockState network,Properties nativeState){this.network=network;this.nativeState=nativeState;}
        NetworkBlockState getNetworkState(){return network;}
        Properties getBlock(){return nativeState;}
        boolean isFaceSturdy(Context player){return nativeState.has(STURDY);}
    }
    private static State state(CompensatedWorld world,NetworkBlockState network){
        Properties properties=NativeFluidBlockProperties.forState(world.protocolVersion(),network);
        if(properties==null)throw new IllegalStateException("Fluid collision needs the original native implementation for "+(network==null?"uninitialized palette":network.identifier()));
        return new State(network,properties);
    }
    public static boolean isFaceSturdy(CompensatedWorld world,NetworkBlockState network){return state(world,network).nativeState.has(STURDY);}

    public static List<Box> movementCollision(CompensatedWorld world,Vector3i pos,NetworkBlockState network){
        Properties properties=NativeFluidBlockProperties.forState(world.protocolVersion(),network);
        if(properties==null)return null;
        if(properties.has(PASS_THROUGH))return List.of();
        if(!properties.has(FENCE|PANE|STAIRS|WALL|CHORUS)
                && !network.identifier().endsWith("_fence") && !network.identifier().endsWith("_wall"))return null;
        return FluidDynamicCollision.getCollisionBox(new Context(world),pos,new State(network,properties));
    }
    public static boolean blocksMotion(CompensatedWorld world,NetworkBlockState network){
        State block=state(world,network);
        if(block.nativeState.has(PASS_THROUGH)||block.nativeState.has(BAMBOO_SAPLING))return false;
        List<Box> boxes=findCollision(new Context(world),block);
        if(boxes.isEmpty())return false;
        Box box=new Box(0,0,0,0,0,0);
        for(Box fragment:boxes)box=fragment.union(box);
        return box.getAverageSideLength()>=0.7291666666666666 || box.getLengthY()>=1.0;
    }
    private static List<Box> findCollision(Context player,State state){
        CompensatedWorld world=player.compensatedWorld.world;
        NetworkBlockState network=state.network;
        if(world.getMinY()-41==0)return List.of(new Box(0,0,0,1,1,1));
        if(NativePistonProperties.isMovingBlock(network))return List.of();
        if(state.nativeState.has(SHULKER)||network.identifierContains("shulker_box"))
            return world.getShulkerCollision(Vector3i.ZERO);
        if(state.nativeState.has(PASS_THROUGH))return List.of();
        List<Box> collisions=FluidDynamicCollision.getCollisionBox(player,Vector3i.ZERO,state);
        if(collisions==null){


            if(network.is("minecraft:bamboo"))collisions=PlantCollision.bamboo(Vector3i.ZERO,network);
            else if(network.is("minecraft:pointed_dripstone"))collisions=PlantCollision.pointedDripstone(Vector3i.ZERO,network);
            else collisions=BedrockCollision.resolveCollision(world,0,0,0,network,world.fluidCollisionActor(),
                    state.nativeState.bedrockKind(),state.nativeState.bedrockShape());
        }
        return collisions==null?state.nativeState.generic():collisions;
    }
    private static final class DynamicShapes {
        static final Map<Integer,List<Box>> SHAPES=load();
        private static Map<Integer,List<Box>> load(){
            try(var in=new DataInputStream(new BufferedInputStream(Objects.requireNonNull(
                    FluidBlockCollision.class.getResourceAsStream("/navro/geyser-collisions.bin"))))){
                if(in.readInt()!=0x424f4152||in.readInt()!=2)throw new IOException("Invalid original Geyser collisions");
                int n=in.readUnsignedShort();var shapes=new ArrayList<List<Box>>(n);
                for(int i=0;i<n;i++){
                    int count=in.readUnsignedShort();var boxes=new ArrayList<Box>(count);
                    for(int j=0;j<count;j++)boxes.add(new Box(in.readFloat(),in.readFloat(),in.readFloat(),in.readFloat(),in.readFloat(),in.readFloat()));
                    shapes.add(List.copyOf(boxes));
                }
                int staticCount=in.readInt();for(int i=0;i<staticCount;i++){in.readInt();in.readUnsignedShort();}
                int dynamicCount=in.readInt();var result=new HashMap<Integer,List<Box>>(dynamicCount);
                for(int i=0;i<dynamicCount;i++)result.put(in.readInt(),shapes.get(in.readUnsignedShort()));
                if(in.read()!=-1)throw new IOException("Trailing original Geyser collisions");
                return Map.copyOf(result);
            }catch(IOException e){throw new IllegalStateException("Cannot read original dynamic collision shapes",e);}
        }
    }
    static List<Box> dynamicShape(int type,int state){return DynamicShapes.SHAPES.get(type<<24|state);}
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/prediction/fluid/FluidDynamicCollision.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.prediction.fluid;

import ac.navro.proxy.data.block.NetworkBlockState;
import ac.navro.proxy.data.block.NativeFluidBlockProperties.Properties;
import static ac.navro.proxy.data.block.NativeFluidBlockProperties.*;
import ac.navro.proxy.data.block.NativePistonProperties;
import ac.navro.proxy.collision.block.PistonBlock;
import ac.navro.proxy.collision.block.PistonArmBlock;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Box;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Direction;
import org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector3i;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.fluid.FluidBlockCollision.Context;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.fluid.FluidBlockCollision.State;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;




public final class FluidDynamicCollision {
    private FluidDynamicCollision() {
    }

    public static List<Box> getCollisionBox(Context player, Vector3i pos, State blockState) {
        final Properties state = blockState.getBlock();
        final NetworkBlockState network = blockState.getNetworkState();

        if (state.has(FENCE)
                || network.identifier().endsWith("_fence")) {
            final int mask = fenceConnectionMask(player, pos, blockState);
            return fenceShape((mask & 1) != 0, (mask & 2) != 0, (mask & 4) != 0, (mask & 8) != 0);
        }

        if (isPane(state)) {
            final int mask = paneConnectionMask(player, pos);
            return paneShape((mask & 1) != 0, (mask & 2) != 0,
                    (mask & 4) != 0, (mask & 8) != 0);
        }

        if (state.has(STAIRS)) {
            return stairShape(blockState, getStairShape(player, pos, blockState));
        }

        if (state.has(WALL) || network.identifier().endsWith("_wall")) {
            return wallShape(network, state);
        }

        if (NativePistonProperties.isPiston(network)) {
            return PistonBlock.from(network).getCollisionShape();
        }
        if (NativePistonProperties.isPistonHead(network)) {
            return PistonArmBlock.getCollisionShape(player.compensatedWorld.world, pos, network,
                    NativePistonProperties.headFacing(network));
        }

        if (state.has(CHORUS) || network.is("minecraft:chorus_plant")) {
            return chorusShape(player, pos, network);
        }

        return null;
    }

    static List<Box> fenceShape(boolean north, boolean east, boolean south, boolean west) {
        return FluidBlockCollision.dynamicShape(1,
                connectionMask(north, east, south, west));
    }

    static List<Box> paneShape(boolean north, boolean east, boolean south, boolean west) {

        final java.util.ArrayList<Box> shape = new java.util.ArrayList<>(2);
        if (north || south) {
            final float minZ = north ? 0.0F : 0.5F;
            final float maxZ = south ? 1.0F : 0.5F;
            shape.add(new Box(0.4375F, 0, minZ, 0.5625F, 1, maxZ));
        }
        if (east || west) {
            final float minX = west ? 0.0F : 0.5F;
            final float maxX = east ? 1.0F : 0.5F;
            shape.add(new Box(minX, 0, 0.4375F, maxX, 1, 0.5625F));
        }
        if (shape.isEmpty()) {
            shape.add(new Box(0.4375F, 0, 0.4375F, 0.5625F, 1, 0.5625F));
        }
        return List.copyOf(shape);
    }

    static List<Box> stairShape(State state, StairShape shape) {
        int key = direction(stairDirection(state));
        key |= (stairTop(state) ? 1 : 0) << 2;
        key |= shape.ordinal() << 3;
        return FluidBlockCollision.dynamicShape(3, key);
    }

    private static List<Box> wallShape(NetworkBlockState network, Properties wall) {
        final boolean hasPacketState = network.hasProperty("wall_post_bit")
                || network.hasProperty("wall_connection_type_north");
        final boolean post;
        final boolean north;
        final boolean east;
        final boolean south;
        final boolean west;
        if (hasPacketState) {
            post = network.booleanProperty("wall_post_bit", false);
            north = wall(network.stringProperty("wall_connection_type_north", "none")) != 0;
            east = wall(network.stringProperty("wall_connection_type_east", "none")) != 0;
            south = wall(network.stringProperty("wall_connection_type_south", "none")) != 0;
            west = wall(network.stringProperty("wall_connection_type_west", "none")) != 0;
        } else {
            return wall.wall();
        }

        float minZ = north ? 0.0F : 0.25F;
        float maxZ = south ? 1.0F : 0.75F;
        float minX = west ? 0.0F : 0.25F;
        float maxX = east ? 1.0F : 0.75F;

        if (north && south && !west && !east && !post) {
            minX = 0.3125F;
            maxX = 0.6875F;
        } else if (!north && !south && west && east && !post) {
            minZ = 0.3125F;
            maxZ = 0.6875F;
        }

        return List.of(new Box(minX, 0, minZ, maxX, 1.5F, maxZ));
    }

    private static int wall(String type) {
        if ("short".equalsIgnoreCase(type)) return 1;
        if ("tall".equalsIgnoreCase(type)) return 2;
        return 0;
    }

    private static Direction pistonFacingDirection(NetworkBlockState state, Direction fallback) {
        String direction = state.stringProperty("minecraft:cardinal_direction",
                state.stringProperty("cardinal_direction", ""));
        Direction horizontal = horizontalFace(direction);
        if (horizontal != null) {
            return horizontal;
        }
        if (!state.hasProperty("facing_direction")) {
            return fallback;
        }
        return switch (state.intProperty("facing_direction", -1)) {
            case 0 -> Direction.DOWN;
            case 1 -> Direction.UP;
            case 2 -> Direction.SOUTH;
            case 3 -> Direction.NORTH;
            case 4 -> Direction.EAST;
            case 5 -> Direction.WEST;
            default -> fallback;
        };
    }

    private static int pistonDirection(Direction face) {
        return switch (face) {
            case DOWN -> 0;
            case UP -> 1;
            case NORTH -> 2;
            case SOUTH -> 3;
            case WEST -> 4;
            case EAST -> 5;
            default -> 0;
        };
    }

    private static List<Box> chorusShape(Context player, Vector3i pos, NetworkBlockState state) {
        final boolean packetConnections = state.hasProperty("down") || state.hasProperty("up")
                || state.hasProperty("north") || state.hasProperty("east")
                || state.hasProperty("south") || state.hasProperty("west");
        int key;
        if (packetConnections) {
            key = state.booleanProperty("down", false) ? 1 : 0;
            key |= (state.booleanProperty("up", false) ? 1 : 0) << 1;
            key |= (state.booleanProperty("north", false) ? 1 : 0) << 2;
            key |= (state.booleanProperty("east", false) ? 1 : 0) << 3;
            key |= (state.booleanProperty("south", false) ? 1 : 0) << 4;
            key |= (state.booleanProperty("west", false) ? 1 : 0) << 5;
        } else {
            key = connectsChorus(player, pos, Direction.DOWN, true) ? 1 : 0;
            key |= (connectsChorus(player, pos, Direction.UP, false) ? 1 : 0) << 1;
            key |= (connectsChorus(player, pos, Direction.NORTH, false) ? 1 : 0) << 2;
            key |= (connectsChorus(player, pos, Direction.EAST, false) ? 1 : 0) << 3;
            key |= (connectsChorus(player, pos, Direction.SOUTH, false) ? 1 : 0) << 4;
            key |= (connectsChorus(player, pos, Direction.WEST, false) ? 1 : 0) << 5;
        }
        return FluidBlockCollision.dynamicShape(5, key);
    }

    private static boolean connectsChorus(Context player, Vector3i pos,
                                          Direction face, boolean endStone) {
        Properties block = player.compensatedWorld.getBlockState(
                pos.getX() + face.getXOffset(), pos.getY() + face.getYOffset(),
                pos.getZ() + face.getZOffset(), 0).getBlock();
        return block.has(CHORUS) || block.has(CHORUS_FLOWER)
                || endStone && block.getId() == 121;
    }

    private static int connectionMask(boolean north, boolean east, boolean south, boolean west) {
        return (north ? 1 : 0) | (east ? 2 : 0) | (south ? 4 : 0) | (west ? 8 : 0);
    }


    public static int fenceConnectionMask(Context player, Vector3i pos, State state) {
        final NetworkBlockState network = state.getNetworkState();



        if (network.hasProperty("minecraft:connection_north")
                || network.hasProperty("minecraft:connection_east")
                || network.hasProperty("minecraft:connection_south")
                || network.hasProperty("minecraft:connection_west")) {
            return connectionMask(network.booleanProperty("minecraft:connection_north", false),
                    network.booleanProperty("minecraft:connection_east", false),
                    network.booleanProperty("minecraft:connection_south", false),
                    network.booleanProperty("minecraft:connection_west", false));
        }
        final Properties current = state.getBlock();
        return connectionMask(connectsFence(player, pos, current, Direction.NORTH),
                connectsFence(player, pos, current, Direction.EAST),
                connectsFence(player, pos, current, Direction.SOUTH),
                connectsFence(player, pos, current, Direction.WEST));
    }

    private static int direction(Direction face) {
        return switch (face) {
            case EAST -> 1;
            case SOUTH -> 2;
            case WEST -> 3;
            default -> 0;
        };
    }

    private static boolean connectsFence(Context player, Vector3i pos, Properties current, Direction face) {
        State neighbourState = neighbour(player, pos, face);
        Properties neighbour = neighbourState.getBlock();
        return (!neighbour.has(CONNECTION_EXCEPTION) && neighbourState.isFaceSturdy(player))
                || (neighbour.has(MAPPED_FENCE)
                && (neighbour.getId() == 113)
                == (current.getId() == 113))
                || connectsToDirection(neighbour, face.getOpposite());
    }

    private static boolean connectsPane(Context player, Vector3i pos, Direction face) {
        State neighbourState = neighbour(player, pos, face);
        Properties neighbour = neighbourState.getBlock();
        final boolean sturdy = neighbourState.isFaceSturdy(player);
        final String neighbourIdentifier = neighbourState.getNetworkState().identifier();
        return (!neighbour.has(CONNECTION_EXCEPTION) && sturdy)
                || isPane(neighbour)
                || neighbour.has(MAPPED_WALL)
                || neighbour.has(WALL)
                || neighbourIdentifier.endsWith("_wall");
    }

    public static int paneConnectionMask(Context player, Vector3i pos) {
        return connectionMask(
                connectsPane(player, pos, Direction.NORTH),
                connectsPane(player, pos, Direction.EAST),
                connectsPane(player, pos, Direction.SOUTH),
                connectsPane(player, pos, Direction.WEST));
    }

    public static boolean isPane(Properties state) {
        return state.has(PANE);
    }

    private static StairShape getStairShape(Context player, Vector3i pos, State state) {
        Direction direction = stairDirection(state);
        State forward = neighbour(player, pos, direction);
        if (sameHalfStair(state, forward)) {
            Direction other = stairDirection(forward);
            if (other.axis() != direction.axis()
                    && isDifferentOrientation(player, state, pos, other.getOpposite())) {
                return other == rotateYCCW(direction) ? StairShape.OUTER_LEFT : StairShape.OUTER_RIGHT;
            }
        }

        State behind = neighbour(player, pos, direction.getOpposite());
        if (sameHalfStair(state, behind)) {
            Direction other = stairDirection(behind);
            if (other.axis() != direction.axis()
                    && isDifferentOrientation(player, state, pos, other)) {
                return other == rotateYCCW(direction) ? StairShape.INNER_LEFT : StairShape.INNER_RIGHT;
            }
        }
        return StairShape.STRAIGHT;
    }

    private static boolean isDifferentOrientation(Context player, State state,
                                                  Vector3i pos, Direction direction) {
        State adjacent = neighbour(player, pos, direction);
        return !sameHalfStair(state, adjacent) || stairDirection(adjacent) != stairDirection(state);
    }

    private static boolean sameHalfStair(State first, State second) {
        return second.getBlock().has(STAIRS)
                && stairTop(first) == stairTop(second);
    }

    private static boolean stairTop(State state) {
        NetworkBlockState network = state.getNetworkState();
        return network.booleanProperty("upside_down_bit", (state.getBlock().getDamage() & 4) != 0);
    }

    private static Direction stairDirection(State state) {
        NetworkBlockState network = state.getNetworkState();
        String cardinal = network.stringProperty("minecraft:cardinal_direction",
                network.stringProperty("cardinal_direction", ""));
        Direction fromString = horizontalFace(cardinal);
        if (fromString != null) {
            return fromString;
        }
        return switch (network.intProperty("weirdo_direction", state.getBlock().getDamage() & 3)) {
            case 0 -> Direction.EAST;
            case 1 -> Direction.WEST;
            case 2 -> Direction.SOUTH;
            default -> Direction.NORTH;
        };
    }

    static Direction facingDirection(NetworkBlockState state, Direction fallback) {
        String direction = state.stringProperty("minecraft:cardinal_direction",
                state.stringProperty("cardinal_direction", ""));
        Direction horizontal = horizontalFace(direction);
        if (horizontal != null) {
            return horizontal;
        }
        return switch (state.intProperty("facing_direction", pistonDirection(fallback))) {
            case 0 -> Direction.DOWN;
            case 1 -> Direction.UP;
            case 2 -> Direction.NORTH;
            case 3 -> Direction.SOUTH;
            case 4 -> Direction.WEST;
            case 5 -> Direction.EAST;
            default -> fallback;
        };
    }

    static Direction horizontalFace(String value) {
        if (value == null) return null;
        return switch (value.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)) {
            case "north" -> Direction.NORTH;
            case "south" -> Direction.SOUTH;
            case "west" -> Direction.WEST;
            case "east" -> Direction.EAST;
            default -> null;
        };
    }

    private static State neighbour(Context player, Vector3i pos, Direction face) {
        return player.compensatedWorld.getBlockState(
                pos.getX() + face.getXOffset(), pos.getY(), pos.getZ() + face.getZOffset(), 0);
    }

    private static Direction rotateYCCW(Direction face) {
        return switch(face){case NORTH -> Direction.WEST;case WEST -> Direction.SOUTH;
            case SOUTH -> Direction.EAST;case EAST -> Direction.NORTH;default -> face;};
    }

    private static boolean connectsToDirection(Properties state,Direction direction) {
        if(!state.has(FENCE_GATE)) return false;
        Direction gateFace=state.gateFace();
        return (gateFace.getXOffset()!=0 && direction.getXOffset()==0)
                || (gateFace.getZOffset()!=0 && direction.getZOffset()==0);
    }

    enum StairShape {
        STRAIGHT,
        INNER_LEFT,
        INNER_RIGHT,
        OUTER_LEFT,
        OUTER_RIGHT
    }
}
```

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.prediction.fluid;

import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.live.PredictionContext;


import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.ClimbableBlockPhysics;

import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.live.*;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.*;
import ac.navro.anticheat.collision.*;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.MathUtil;


import ac.navro.anticheat.data.EntityDimensions;
import ac.navro.anticheat.data.MovementAabbSnapshot;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Box;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;


public final class FluidMovement {
    private FluidMovement() { }






    public interface Context {
        FluidPoseState fluidPrediction();
        EntityDimensions dimensions();
        Box boundingBox();
        MovementAabbSnapshot snapshotAabb();
        void restoreAabb(MovementAabbSnapshot saved, Vec3 target);
        void applyDimensions(EntityDimensions dimensions);
        boolean hasFlag(int nativeFlag);
        void setClientSwimming(boolean swimming);
        boolean isLivePlayer();
        void movementSamplerPoseDimensions(EntityDimensions before, Box boxBefore, boolean horizontal);
        void trapdoorSamplerPoseDimensions(EntityDimensions before, Box boxBefore, boolean horizontal);
        void trace(String name, Object... values);
    }

    public static void beginInput(Context player) {
        player.trace("POSE_INPUT_BEGIN_BEFORE");
        finishInput(player);


        if (player.fluidPrediction().pendingPoseDimensions != null) {
            player.fluidPrediction().readyPoseDimensions = player.fluidPrediction().pendingPoseDimensions;
            player.fluidPrediction().readyPoseBeforeMovement = false;
        }
        player.fluidPrediction().pendingPoseDimensions = null;
        player.fluidPrediction().captureInputState(
                player.hasFlag(57),
                player.hasFlag(114));
        player.fluidPrediction().inputDimensions = player.dimensions();
        player.fluidPrediction().inputAabb = player.snapshotAabb();
        player.fluidPrediction().inputHorizontalPoseApplied = player.fluidPrediction().horizontalPoseApplied;
        player.fluidPrediction().inputStandingDimensions = player.fluidPrediction().dimensionsBeforeHorizontalPose;
        player.fluidPrediction().inputNonCrawlingHorizontal = nonCrawlingHorizontal(player);
        player.fluidPrediction().inputActive = true;
        player.fluidPrediction().inputReadyPoseDimensions = player.fluidPrediction().readyPoseDimensions;
        player.fluidPrediction().inputReadyPoseBeforeMovement = player.fluidPrediction().readyPoseBeforeMovement;
        player.trace("POSE_INPUT_BEGIN_AFTER");
    }

    private static boolean nonCrawlingHorizontal(Context player) {
        return player.hasFlag(57)
                || player.hasFlag(32)
                || player.hasFlag(56);
    }

    public static void applySwimmingAction(Context player, boolean swimming) {
        player.trace("SWIM_ACTION_BEFORE","requestedSwimming",swimming);

        player.setClientSwimming(swimming);
        updatePose(player);
        player.trace("SWIM_ACTION_AFTER","requestedSwimming",swimming);
    }

    public static void updatePose(Context player) {
        updatePose(player, false);
    }


    public static void updatePoseForMetadata(Context player) {
        updatePose(player, true);
    }

    private static void updatePose(Context player, boolean fromMetadata) {
        player.trace("POSE_UPDATE_BEGIN","fromMetadata",fromMetadata);
        final EntityDimensions dimensionsBefore = player.dimensions();
        final var boxBefore = player.boundingBox();
        final boolean horizontal = player.hasFlag(57)
                || player.hasFlag(114)
                || player.hasFlag(32)
                || player.hasFlag(56);
        final FluidPoseState state = player.fluidPrediction();
        final boolean metadataCrawlRequest = fromMetadata && hasCrawlingSizeRequest(player);





        final boolean preserveClientPhysicalHeight = player.isLivePlayer()
                && nonCrawlingHorizontal(player);
        final EntityDimensions requested = horizontalPose(state,
                state.pendingPoseDimensions != null ? state.pendingPoseDimensions
                        : state.readyPoseDimensions != null ? state.readyPoseDimensions : player.dimensions(),
                horizontal, preserveClientPhysicalHeight);
        final boolean crawlingChanged = state.wasCrawling != player.hasFlag(114);
        player.trace("POSE_REQUEST_COMPUTED","fromMetadata",fromMetadata,
                "requestedDimensions",requested,"horizontalRequested",horizontal,
                "crawlingChanged",crawlingChanged,"metadataCrawlRequest",metadataCrawlRequest);


        if ((metadataCrawlRequest || state.inputActive && crawlingChanged || state.readyPoseDimensions != null
                || state.pendingPoseDimensions != null) && !state.inputNonCrawlingHorizontal
                && !nonCrawlingHorizontal(player)) {
            if (state.inputActive && crawlingChanged && state.readyPoseDimensions != null) {


                state.readyPoseDimensions = requested;
                state.pendingPoseDimensions = null;
                player.trace("POSE_CACHE_REPLACED","reason","crawlingChangedWithReadyRequest");
            } else {
                state.pendingPoseDimensions = requested.equals(state.readyPoseDimensions) ? null : requested;
                player.trace("POSE_CACHE_STAGED","reason","pendingRequestComparedWithReadyRequest");
            }
            if (state.inputActive && state.readyPoseBeforeMovement && state.readyPoseDimensions != null) {
                player.trace("POSE_COMMIT_BEGIN","reason","readyBeforeMovement",
                        "committedDimensions",state.readyPoseDimensions);
                player.applyDimensions(state.readyPoseDimensions);
                state.readyPoseDimensions = null;
                state.readyPoseBeforeMovement = false;
                player.trace("POSE_COMMIT_END","reason","readyBeforeMovement");
            }
        } else {
            player.trace("POSE_COMMIT_BEGIN","reason","immediatePoseBranch",
                    "committedDimensions",requested);
            state.pendingPoseDimensions = null;
            state.readyPoseDimensions = null;
            state.readyPoseBeforeMovement = false;
            player.applyDimensions(requested);
            player.trace("POSE_COMMIT_END","reason","immediatePoseBranch");
        }
        if (!fromMetadata && (dimensionsBefore.width() != player.dimensions().width()
                || dimensionsBefore.height() != player.dimensions().height()) && player.isLivePlayer()) {
            player.movementSamplerPoseDimensions(dimensionsBefore, boxBefore, horizontal);
            player.trapdoorSamplerPoseDimensions(dimensionsBefore, boxBefore, horizontal);
        }
        player.trace("POSE_UPDATE_END","fromMetadata",fromMetadata);
    }


    public static void finishInput(Context player) {
        final FluidPoseState state = player.fluidPrediction();
        if (!state.inputActive) return;
        player.trace("POSE_FINISH_BEGIN");
        final EntityDimensions pending = state.readyPoseDimensions;
        state.inputActive = false;
        state.readyPoseDimensions = null;
        state.readyPoseBeforeMovement = false;
        if (pending != null) {
            player.trace("POSE_COMMIT_BEGIN","reason","finishInput","committedDimensions",pending);
            final EntityDimensions before = player.dimensions();
            final var boxBefore = player.boundingBox();
            player.applyDimensions(pending);
            if (player.isLivePlayer()) {
                player.movementSamplerPoseDimensions(before, boxBefore, state.horizontalPoseApplied);
                player.trapdoorSamplerPoseDimensions(before, boxBefore, state.horizontalPoseApplied);
            }
            player.trace("POSE_COMMIT_END","reason","finishInput");
        }
        player.trace("POSE_FINISH_END");
    }

    public static void acknowledgeDimensions(Context player) {
        player.trace("POSE_CACHE_CLEAR_BEGIN","reason","acknowledgeDimensions");

        player.fluidPrediction().pendingPoseDimensions = null;
        player.fluidPrediction().readyPoseDimensions = null;
        player.fluidPrediction().readyPoseBeforeMovement = false;
        player.trace("POSE_CACHE_CLEAR_END","reason","acknowledgeDimensions");
    }

    public static boolean hasCrawlingSizeRequest(Context player) {
        final var state = player.fluidPrediction();
        return !nonCrawlingHorizontal(player) && (player.hasFlag(114)
                || state.wasCrawling || state.pendingPoseDimensions != null || state.readyPoseDimensions != null);
    }


    public static void queueMetadataPose(Context player, EntityDimensions requested) {
        player.trace("POSE_METADATA_QUEUE_BEGIN","requestedDimensions",requested);
        final var state = player.fluidPrediction();
        state.pendingPoseDimensions = null;
        state.readyPoseDimensions = requested;
        state.readyPoseBeforeMovement = true;
        player.trace("POSE_METADATA_QUEUE_END","requestedDimensions",requested);
    }



    public static boolean finishMetadataPose(Context player, MovementAabbSnapshot physicalBefore,
                                             boolean crawlingBefore, Float width, Float height, Float scale,
                                             boolean flagsAcknowledged) {
        if (!(crawlingBefore || hasCrawlingSizeRequest(player) || flagsAcknowledged)
                || player.fluidPrediction().horizontalPoseApplied) return false;
        final var state = player.fluidPrediction();
        final boolean explicitHeight = height != null && Float.isFinite(height) && height > 0F
                || scale != null && Float.isFinite(scale) && scale > 0F;
        EntityDimensions requested = explicitHeight ? player.dimensions()
                : state.pendingPoseDimensions != null ? state.pendingPoseDimensions
                : state.readyPoseDimensions != null ? state.readyPoseDimensions : player.dimensions();
        final boolean explicitWidth = width != null && Float.isFinite(width) && width > 0F;
        final float acknowledgedWidth = player.dimensions().width();
        if (explicitWidth) requested = withWidth(requested, acknowledgedWidth);
        player.restoreAabb(physicalBefore, physicalBefore.position());


        if (explicitWidth) player.applyDimensions(withWidth(player.dimensions(), acknowledgedWidth));
        queueMetadataPose(player, requested);
        return true;
    }

    public static void acknowledgeWidth(Context player) {
        final FluidPoseState state = player.fluidPrediction();
        if (state.pendingPoseDimensions != null) state.pendingPoseDimensions = withWidth(
                state.pendingPoseDimensions, player.dimensions().width());
        if (state.readyPoseDimensions != null) state.readyPoseDimensions = withWidth(
                state.readyPoseDimensions, player.dimensions().width());
    }

    private static EntityDimensions withWidth(EntityDimensions dimensions, float width) {
        return new EntityDimensions(width, dimensions.height(), dimensions.eyeHeight(), dimensions.fixed());
    }


    public static EntityDimensions horizontalPose(FluidPoseState state,
                                                   EntityDimensions dimensions, boolean horizontal) {
        return horizontalPose(state, dimensions, horizontal, false);
    }

    public static EntityDimensions horizontalPose(FluidPoseState state,
                                                   EntityDimensions dimensions, boolean horizontal,
                                                   boolean preservePhysicalHeight) {
        if (horizontal) {
            if (!state.horizontalPoseApplied) {
                state.dimensionsBeforeHorizontalPose = dimensions;
                state.horizontalPoseApplied = true;
                if (preservePhysicalHeight) return dimensions.withEyeHeight(0.42F);
                return EntityDimensions.fixed(dimensions.width(), 0.6F).withEyeHeight(0.42F);
            }

            return dimensions.withEyeHeight(0.42F);
        }
        if (!state.horizontalPoseApplied) return dimensions;
        final EntityDimensions previous = state.dimensionsBeforeHorizontalPose;
        state.horizontalPoseApplied = false;
        state.dimensionsBeforeHorizontalPose = null;
        return EntityDimensions.fixed(dimensions.width(), previous == null ? 1.8F : previous.height())
                .withEyeHeight(previous == null ? 1.62F : previous.eyeHeight());
    }


 public static void prepare(PredictionContext p){
     p.wire.prepareFluidInput(p.session.world(),p.session.fluidState(),p.position);
     p.fluidPrediction.load(p.session.fluidState());
     p.boundingBox=p.wire.boundingBox().clone();p.dimensions=p.wire.dimensions();
 }
 public static void finishInput(PredictionContext p){p.syncWire();p.wire.finishInput();p.dimensions=p.wire.dimensions();p.boundingBox=p.wire.boundingBox().clone();p.position=p.wire.position().clone();p.fluidPrediction.inputActive=false;}
 public static void updatePose(PredictionContext p){p.wire.updateInputPose();p.boundingBox=p.wire.boundingBox().clone();p.dimensions=p.wire.dimensions();}
 public static void sampleTravelLiquids(PredictionContext p,Object unused){
     p.session.fluidState().sampleTravelLiquids(p.session.world(),p.boundingBox,p.wire.flying());
     p.fluidPrediction.load(p.session.fluidState());
 }
    public static Vec3 prepareVelocity(PredictionContext player, Vec3 velocity) {
        Vec3 prepared = velocity.add(player.fluidPrediction.liquids.selectedPush());
        if (!player.getFlagTracker().isFlying() && player.fluidPrediction.wasInWater && !player.isInLava()
                && (player.getInputData().contains(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData.WANT_DOWN_SLOW)
                || player.getInputData().contains(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData.WANT_DOWN))) {
            prepared = prepared.add(0, -0.04F, 0);
        }
        return prepared;
    }

    public static boolean jumpingInLiquid(PredictionContext player) {
        return player.getInputData().contains(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData.JUMPING)
                || player.getInputData().contains(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData.AUTO_JUMPING_IN_WATER);
    }

    public static Vec3 swimControl(PredictionContext player, Vec3 velocity) {
        final FluidPredictionState state = player.fluidPrediction;


        if (!state.wasInWater) return velocity;
        return swimControl(velocity, MathUtil.getRotationVector(player.pitch, player.yaw).y,
                player.isPredictionSwimming(), jumpingInLiquid(player), player.getFlagTracker().isFlying(),
                state.breathingInLiquid, state.breathingInAir,
                player.getInputData().contains(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData.WANT_DOWN_SLOW));
    }

    public static Vec3 swimControl(Vec3 velocity, float targetY, boolean swimming, boolean jumping,
                                  boolean flying, boolean breathingLiquid, boolean breathingAir,
                                  boolean wantDownSlow) {
        if (!swimming || jumping) return velocity;
        if (targetY > 0 && !breathingLiquid && (!flying || breathingAir && !wantDownSlow)) {
            return new Vec3(velocity.x, 0, velocity.z);
        }
        final float response = flying ? 1.3F : targetY < -0.2F ? 0.085F : 0.06F;
        return new Vec3(velocity.x, velocity.y + (targetY - velocity.y) * response, velocity.z);
    }





    public static Vec3 swimmingJump(Vec3 velocity, boolean inWater, boolean swimming,
                                    boolean headInWater, float swimAmount) {
        if (!(swimming && !headInWater) && !(swimAmount > 0 && swimAmount < 1)) return null;
        return inWater ? new Vec3(velocity.x, 0, velocity.z) : velocity;
    }

    public static Vec3 liquidJump(Vec3 velocity, boolean inWater, boolean touchingLava,
                                  boolean jumping, boolean flying) {
        if (flying || !jumping || !(inWater || touchingLava)) return velocity;
        return velocity.add(0, 0.04F, 0);
    }

    public record WaterParameters(float strength, float depthRatio, float horizontalDrag) { }

    public static WaterParameters waterParameters(int depthLevel, boolean onGround, float movementSpeed,
                                                   float underwaterSpeed, float swimMultiplier,
                                                   boolean sprinting, float waterDrag) {
        float ratio = Math.min(Math.max(0, depthLevel), 3) / 3.0F;
        final float strength;
        if (swimMultiplier > 1) {
            strength = underwaterSpeed * swimMultiplier * (0.7F + 0.3F * ratio);
        } else {
            if (!onGround) ratio *= 0.5F;
            strength = underwaterSpeed + (movementSpeed - underwaterSpeed) * ratio;
        }
        final float baseDrag = sprinting ? 0.9F : Float.isFinite(waterDrag) ? waterDrag : 0.8F;
        final float drag = swimMultiplier > 1 ? baseDrag : baseDrag + (0.54600006F - baseDrag) * ratio;
        return new WaterParameters(strength, ratio, drag);
    }

    public static Vec3 moveRelative(Vec3 velocity, Vec3 input, float strength, float yaw) {
        final float lengthSquared = input.lengthSquared();
        if (lengthSquared < 0.0001F) return velocity;
        return velocity.add(MathUtil.getInputVector(input, strength, yaw));
    }

    public static boolean isClimbing(PredictionContext player) {
        return ClimbableBlockPhysics.isClimbing(player);
    }

    public static float lavaClimbVelocity(float vertical, boolean climbing, boolean sneaking,
                                          boolean climbHaltAtFeet) {
        if (!climbing) return vertical;
        vertical = Math.max(vertical, -0.2F);
        return vertical < 0 && sneaking && climbHaltAtFeet ? 0 : vertical;
    }


}
```

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.prediction.fluid;

import ac.navro.anticheat.data.EntityDimensions;
import ac.navro.anticheat.data.MovementAabbSnapshot;


public final class FluidPoseState {
    public boolean wasSwimming, wasCrawling;
    public boolean horizontalPoseApplied;
    public EntityDimensions dimensionsBeforeHorizontalPose;
    public EntityDimensions inputDimensions;
    public MovementAabbSnapshot inputAabb;
    public boolean inputHorizontalPoseApplied;
    public EntityDimensions inputStandingDimensions;
    public boolean inputNonCrawlingHorizontal;

    public EntityDimensions readyPoseDimensions, inputReadyPoseDimensions;
    public boolean readyPoseBeforeMovement, inputReadyPoseBeforeMovement;

    public void captureInputState(boolean swimming, boolean crawling) {
        wasSwimming = swimming;
        wasCrawling = crawling;
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/prediction/fluid/LiquidPhysics.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.prediction.fluid;

import ac.navro.proxy.data.FluidState;
import ac.navro.proxy.data.FluidState.Type;
import ac.navro.proxy.compensated.world.base.CompensatedWorld;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Box;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;
import org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector3i;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;


public final class LiquidPhysics {
    public static final float WATER_PUSH = 0.014F;
    public static final float LAVA_PUSH = 0.0035F;
    private static final float MIN_FLOW_LENGTH_SQUARED = 0.0001F * 0.0001F;
    private LiquidPhysics() { }

    public interface WorldAccess {
        boolean hasChunksAt(int minX, int minZ, int maxX, int maxZ);
        FluidState fluidAt(int x, int y, int z);
        boolean isAirAt(int x, int y, int z);
        Vec3 flowAt(int x, int y, int z, FluidState state);
    }

    public static Result sample(CompensatedWorld world, Box actor, boolean flying, int dimension) {
        return sampleLiquids(actor, flying, new WorldAccess() {
            public boolean hasChunksAt(int minX,int minZ,int maxX,int maxZ) {
                return world.hasChunksAt(minX,minZ,maxX,maxZ,dimension);
            }
            public FluidState fluidAt(int x,int y,int z) { return world.fluidAt(x,y,z,dimension); }
            public boolean isAirAt(int x,int y,int z) { return world.isAirAt(x,y,z,dimension); }
            public Vec3 flowAt(int x,int y,int z,FluidState fluid) { return world.flowAt(x,y,z,dimension); }
        });
    }

    public static Result sampleLiquids(Box actor, boolean flying, WorldAccess world) {
        final Sample lava = sample(actor, world, Type.LAVA, LAVA_PUSH, 0.1F, 0.4F);
        final Sample water = sample(actor, world, Type.WATER, WATER_PUSH, 0.001F, 0.401F);
        final Type selected = lava.touching() ? Type.LAVA
                : water.touching() ? Type.WATER : Type.EMPTY;
        final Vec3 push = flying ? Vec3.ZERO : selected == Type.LAVA ? lava.appliedPush()
                : selected == Type.WATER ? water.appliedPush() : Vec3.ZERO;
        return new Result(water, lava, selected, push);
    }

    private static Sample sample(Box actor, WorldAccess world, Type type,
                                 float strength, float horizontal, float vertical) {
        final Box region = actor.expand(1);
        if (!world.hasChunksAt((int) Math.floor(region.minX), (int) Math.floor(region.minZ),
                (int) Math.ceil(region.maxX), (int) Math.ceil(region.maxZ))) return Sample.EMPTY;
        final Box box = contractedQueryBox(actor, horizontal, vertical);
        final int minX = (int) Math.floor(box.minX), maxX = (int) Math.floor(box.maxX + 1.0D);
        final int minY = (int) Math.floor(box.minY), maxY = (int) Math.floor(box.maxY + 1.0D);
        final int minZ = (int) Math.floor(box.minZ), maxZ = (int) Math.floor(box.maxZ + 1.0D);
        boolean touching = false, downwardFlow = false, hasPositiveDepth = false;
        float highestSurface = -Float.MAX_VALUE;
        final List<Vector3i> cells = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int x = minX; x < maxX; x++) {
            for (int y = minY; y < maxY; y++) {
                for (int z = minZ; z < maxZ; z++) {
                    final FluidState fluid = world.fluidAt(x, y, z);
                    if (fluid.type() != type) continue;
                    touching = true;
                    highestSurface = Math.max(highestSurface, y + 1.0F);
                    cells.add(Vector3i.from(x, y, z));
                    hasPositiveDepth |= fluid.level() > 0
                            || positiveDepth(world, type, x - 1, y, z)
                            || positiveDepth(world, type, x + 1, y, z)
                            || positiveDepth(world, type, x, y, z - 1)
                            || positiveDepth(world, type, x, y, z + 1);
                }
            }
        }
        Vec3 accumulatedFlow = Vec3.ZERO;
        if (hasPositiveDepth) {
            for (Vector3i cell : cells) {
                final FluidState fluid = world.fluidAt(cell.getX(), cell.getY(), cell.getZ());
                final Vec3 flow = world.flowAt(cell.getX(), cell.getY(), cell.getZ(), fluid);
                accumulatedFlow = accumulatedFlow.add(flow);
                downwardFlow |= flow.y < 0;
            }
        }
        final float lengthSquared = accumulatedFlow.lengthSquared();
        final Vec3 applied = touching && lengthSquared >= MIN_FLOW_LENGTH_SQUARED
                ? accumulatedFlow.multiply(strength / (float) Math.sqrt(lengthSquared)) : Vec3.ZERO;
        return new Sample(touching, touching ? highestSurface : 0, downwardFlow,
                accumulatedFlow, applied, box);
    }

    private static boolean positiveDepth(WorldAccess world, Type type, int x, int y, int z) {
        final FluidState fluid = world.fluidAt(x, y, z);
        return fluid.type() == type && fluid.level() > 0;
    }

    static Box contractedQueryBox(Box source, float horizontal, float vertical) {
        float minX = source.minX + horizontal, maxX = source.maxX - horizontal;
        float minY = source.minY + vertical, maxY = source.maxY - vertical;
        float minZ = source.minZ + horizontal, maxZ = source.maxZ - horizontal;
        if (minX > maxX) minX = maxX = (source.minX + source.maxX) * 0.5F;
        if (minY > maxY) minY = maxY = (source.minY + source.maxY) * 0.5F;
        if (minZ > maxZ) minZ = maxZ = (source.minZ + source.maxZ) * 0.5F;
        return new Box(minX, minY, minZ, maxX, maxY, maxZ);
    }

    public record Sample(boolean touching, float surfaceHeight, boolean downwardFlow,
                         Vec3 accumulatedFlow, Vec3 appliedPush, Box queryBox) {
        public static final Sample EMPTY = new Sample(false, 0, false, Vec3.ZERO, Vec3.ZERO, Box.EMPTY);
    }
    public record Result(Sample water, Sample lava, Type selectedType, Vec3 selectedPush) {
        public static final Result EMPTY = new Result(Sample.EMPTY, Sample.EMPTY, Type.EMPTY, Vec3.ZERO);
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/prediction/fluid/ProtocolFluidPrediction.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.prediction.fluid;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.MathUtil;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;


public final class ProtocolFluidPrediction {
    private ProtocolFluidPrediction() {}

    public static float nextSwimAmount(float amount, boolean horizontal) {
        return horizontal ? Math.min(1, amount + 0.1F) : Math.max(0, amount - 0.1F);
    }

    public record WaterParameters(float strength, float depthRatio, float horizontalDrag) {}

    public static WaterParameters waterParameters(int depthLevel, boolean onGround,
                                                   float movementSpeed, float underwaterSpeed,
                                                   float swimMultiplier, boolean sprinting,
                                                   float waterDrag) {
        float ratio = Math.min(Math.max(0, depthLevel), 3) / 3.0F;
        float strength;
        if (swimMultiplier > 1) {
            strength = underwaterSpeed * swimMultiplier * (0.7F + 0.3F * ratio);
        } else {
            if (!onGround) ratio *= 0.5F;
            strength = underwaterSpeed + (movementSpeed - underwaterSpeed) * ratio;
        }
        float baseDrag = sprinting ? 0.9F : Float.isFinite(waterDrag) ? waterDrag : 0.8F;
        float drag = swimMultiplier > 1 ? baseDrag : baseDrag + (0.54600006F - baseDrag) * ratio;
        return new WaterParameters(strength, ratio, drag);
    }

    public static Vec3 moveRelative(Vec3 velocity, Vec3 input, float strength, float yaw) {
        return input.lengthSquared() < 0.0001F ? velocity
                : velocity.add(MathUtil.getInputVector(input, strength, yaw));
    }

    public static Vec3 prepareVelocity(Vec3 velocity, Vec3 selectedPush,
                                       boolean flying, boolean wasInWater,
                                       boolean inLava, boolean wantDown) {
        Vec3 prepared = velocity.add(selectedPush);
        if (!flying && wasInWater && !inLava && wantDown) prepared = prepared.add(0, -0.04F, 0);
        return prepared;
    }

    public static Vec3 swimControl(Vec3 velocity, float targetY, boolean swimming,
                                   boolean jumping, boolean flying, boolean breathingLiquid,
                                   boolean breathingAir, boolean wantDownSlow) {
        if (!swimming || jumping) return velocity;
        if (targetY > 0 && !breathingLiquid && (!flying || breathingAir && !wantDownSlow)) {
            return new Vec3(velocity.x, 0, velocity.z);
        }
        float response = flying ? 1.3F : targetY < -0.2F ? 0.085F : 0.06F;
        return new Vec3(velocity.x, velocity.y + (targetY - velocity.y) * response, velocity.z);
    }

    public static Vec3 liquidJump(Vec3 velocity, boolean inWater, boolean touchingLava,
                                  boolean jumping, boolean flying) {
        if (flying || !jumping || !(inWater || touchingLava)) return velocity;
        return velocity.add(0, 0.04F, 0);
    }

    public static Vec3 swimmingJump(Vec3 velocity, boolean inWater, boolean swimming,
                                    boolean headInWater, float swimAmount) {
        if (!(swimming && !headInWater) && !(swimAmount > 0 && swimAmount < 1)) return null;
        return inWater ? new Vec3(velocity.x, 0, velocity.z) : velocity;
    }

    public static float lavaClimbVelocity(float vertical, boolean climbing,
                                          boolean sneaking, boolean climbHaltAtFeet) {
        if (!climbing) return vertical;
        vertical = Math.max(vertical, -0.2F);
        return vertical < 0 && sneaking && climbHaltAtFeet ? 0 : vertical;
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/prediction/fluid/ProtocolFluidStateTracker.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.prediction.fluid;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.MathUtil;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Box;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;
import ac.navro.anticheat.data.EntityDimensions;
import ac.navro.anticheat.data.MovementAabbSnapshot;
import ac.navro.proxy.data.FluidState;
import ac.navro.proxy.compensated.world.base.CompensatedWorld;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData;


public final class ProtocolFluidStateTracker {
    private float swimAmount;
    private boolean wasSwimming;
    private boolean wasCrawling;
    private boolean swimming;
    private boolean wasInWater;
    private boolean waterTravel;
    private boolean headInWater;
    private boolean breathingInAir;
    private boolean breathingInLiquid;
    private LiquidPhysics.Result liquids = LiquidPhysics.Result.EMPTY;
    private EntityDimensions inputDimensions;
    private Box inputBox = Box.EMPTY;
    private MovementAabbSnapshot inputAabb;
    private boolean inputHorizontalPose;

    public void beginInput(CompensatedWorld world, MovementAabbSnapshot inputAabb,
                           Box liveBox, EntityDimensions liveDimensions, Vec3 feet,
                           EntityDimensions dimensions, boolean horizontalPose, boolean flying,
                           boolean riding, boolean swimmingBefore, boolean swimmingNow,
                           boolean crawlingBefore, PlayerAuthInputData[] inputActions, Vec3 view) {
        this.inputDimensions = dimensions;
        this.inputAabb = copy(inputAabb);
        this.inputHorizontalPose = horizontalPose;
        wasSwimming = swimmingBefore;
        wasCrawling = crawlingBefore;
        swimAmount = ProtocolFluidPrediction.nextSwimAmount(swimAmount, wasSwimming || wasCrawling);
        Box inputBox = inputAabb != null && inputAabb.box().isValid()
                ? inputAabb.at(feet)
                : liveBox.isValid() && dimensions.width() == liveDimensions.width()
                && dimensions.height() == liveDimensions.height() ? liveBox : dimensions.getBoxAt(feet);
        this.inputBox = inputBox.clone();
        liquids = LiquidPhysics.sample(world, inputBox, flying, world.dimension());
        wasInWater = liquids.selectedType() == FluidState.Type.WATER;
        float headY = feet.y + (horizontalPose ? 0.4F : dimensions.eyeHeight());
        int headX=(int)Math.floor(feet.x), headBlockY=(int)Math.floor(headY), headZ=(int)Math.floor(feet.z);
        FluidState headFluid = world.fluidAt(headX,headBlockY,headZ,world.dimension());
        float headSurface = headFluid.type()==FluidState.Type.WATER
                ? headBlockY+1.0F-((headFluid.effectiveFlowDecay()+1.0F)/9.0F-1.0F/9.0F)
                : headBlockY;
        headInWater = headFluid.type()==FluidState.Type.WATER && headY < headSurface;
        breathingInAir = world.isAirAt(headX,headBlockY,headZ,world.dimension());
        breathingInLiquid = headFluid.type()!=FluidState.Type.EMPTY;
        boolean start = contains(inputActions, PlayerAuthInputData.START_SWIMMING);
        boolean stop = contains(inputActions, PlayerAuthInputData.STOP_SWIMMING);
        swimming = resolveSwimming(swimmingNow, wasSwimming, headInWater, flying, riding,
                breathingInAir, liquids.water().touching(), wasInWater, start, stop, view);
        waterTravel=!flying&&wasInWater;
    }


    public void sampleTravelLiquids(CompensatedWorld world, Box actor, boolean flying) {
        liquids = LiquidPhysics.sample(world, actor, flying, world.dimension());
        waterTravel = !flying && wasInWater;
    }

    private static boolean resolveSwimming(boolean swimming, boolean wasSwimming, boolean headInWater,
                                            boolean flying, boolean riding, boolean breathingInAir,
                                            boolean touchingWater, boolean wasInWater, boolean start,
                                            boolean stop, Vec3 view) {
        if (start && !wasSwimming) {
            boolean accepted = headInWater && !flying && !riding
                    && ((!breathingInAir && touchingWater) || view != null && view.y < 0.15F);
            return accepted && swimming;
        }
        if (!swimming) return false;
        if (!stop && wasInWater && breathingInAir && view != null && view.y > 0) {
            float horizontalSquared = view.x * view.x + view.z * view.z;
            float angle = (float) Math.acos(MathUtil.clamp(horizontalSquared, 0, 1))
                    * 57.295776F;
            stop = angle > 45.0F;
        }
        return !stop && !riding;
    }

    private static boolean contains(PlayerAuthInputData[] actions, PlayerAuthInputData value) {
        if(actions==null)return false;
        for(PlayerAuthInputData action:actions)if(action==value)return true;
        return false;
    }

    public Frame snapshot() {
        return new Frame(swimAmount,wasSwimming,wasCrawling,wasInWater,waterTravel,headInWater,
                breathingInAir,breathingInLiquid,copy(liquids),inputDimensions,
                inputBox == null ? Box.EMPTY : inputBox.clone(),inputHorizontalPose,swimming,copy(inputAabb));
    }

    public void restore(Frame frame) {
        if(frame==null){reset();return;}
        swimAmount=frame.swimAmount();wasSwimming=frame.wasSwimming();wasCrawling=frame.wasCrawling();
        wasInWater=frame.wasInWater();waterTravel=frame.waterTravel();headInWater=frame.headInWater();
        breathingInAir=frame.breathingInAir();breathingInLiquid=frame.breathingInLiquid();
        liquids=copy(frame.liquids());
        inputDimensions=frame.inputDimensions();
        inputBox=frame.inputBox()==null?Box.EMPTY:frame.inputBox().clone();
        inputHorizontalPose=frame.inputHorizontalPose();
        swimming=frame.swimming();
        inputAabb=copy(frame.inputAabb());
    }

    public void reset() {
        swimAmount=0;wasSwimming=wasCrawling=swimming=wasInWater=waterTravel=headInWater=false;
        breathingInAir=breathingInLiquid=false;liquids=LiquidPhysics.Result.EMPTY;
        inputDimensions=null;inputBox=Box.EMPTY;inputAabb=null;inputHorizontalPose=false;
    }

    public void resetMovement() {
        reset();
    }

    private static LiquidPhysics.Result copy(LiquidPhysics.Result value) {
        if(value==null)return LiquidPhysics.Result.EMPTY;
        return new LiquidPhysics.Result(copy(value.water()),copy(value.lava()),value.selectedType(),
                value.selectedPush()==null?Vec3.ZERO:value.selectedPush().clone());
    }

    private static MovementAabbSnapshot copy(MovementAabbSnapshot value) {
        return value == null ? null : new MovementAabbSnapshot(value.dimensions(), value.position(),
                value.box(), value.resizeRevision());
    }

    private static LiquidPhysics.Sample copy(LiquidPhysics.Sample value) {
        if(value==null)return LiquidPhysics.Sample.EMPTY;
        return new LiquidPhysics.Sample(value.touching(),value.surfaceHeight(),value.downwardFlow(),
                value.accumulatedFlow()==null?Vec3.ZERO:value.accumulatedFlow().clone(),
                value.appliedPush()==null?Vec3.ZERO:value.appliedPush().clone(),
                value.queryBox()==null?Box.EMPTY:value.queryBox().clone());
    }

    public record Frame(float swimAmount,boolean wasSwimming,boolean wasCrawling,boolean wasInWater,
                        boolean waterTravel,boolean headInWater,boolean breathingInAir,
                        boolean breathingInLiquid,LiquidPhysics.Result liquids,
                        EntityDimensions inputDimensions,Box inputBox,boolean inputHorizontalPose,
                        boolean swimming,MovementAabbSnapshot inputAabb) {
        public Frame {
            inputBox=inputBox==null?Box.EMPTY:inputBox.clone();
            liquids=copy(liquids);
            inputAabb=copy(inputAabb);
        }
        @Override public Box inputBox(){return inputBox==null?Box.EMPTY:inputBox.clone();}
        @Override public LiquidPhysics.Result liquids(){return copy(liquids);}
        @Override public MovementAabbSnapshot inputAabb(){return copy(inputAabb);}
    }

    public float swimAmount(){return swimAmount;} public boolean wasSwimming(){return wasSwimming;}
    public boolean swimming(){return swimming;}
    public boolean wasCrawling(){return wasCrawling;} public boolean wasInWater(){return wasInWater;}
    public boolean waterTravel(){return waterTravel;} public boolean headInWater(){return headInWater;}
    public boolean breathingInAir(){return breathingInAir;} public boolean breathingInLiquid(){return breathingInLiquid;}
    public LiquidPhysics.Result liquids(){return liquids;}
}
```

```java
 public static final class Diagnostics {

 }
 public static final class PredictionTeleports implements Teleports {
  private final SessionState session;PredictionTeleports(SessionState s){session=s;}
  public boolean isTeleporting(){return session.teleports().isTeleporting();}
  public void rewind(long tick){session.player().requestRewind(tick);}
  public List<Vec3> getTeleportStartVelocities(long tick){return session.teleportStartVelocities(tick);}
 }
    public Vec3 jump(Vec3 vec3) {
        if (this.getFlagTracker().isFlying()) return vec3;

        if (ClimbableBlockPhysics.isJumping(this)) {
            final Vec3 swimmingJump = FluidMovement.swimmingJump(vec3, this.fluidPrediction.wasInWater,
                    this.isPredictionSwimming(), this.fluidPrediction.headInWater,
                    this.fluidPrediction.swimAmount);
            if (swimmingJump != null) {

                return swimmingJump;
            }
        }
        final Vec3 blockJump = ClimbableBlockPhysics.applyBlockJump(this, vec3, this.onClimbable());
        if (blockJump != null) return blockJump;




        boolean autoJumping = this.getInputData().contains(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData.AUTO_JUMPING_IN_WATER);
        boolean jumping = this.getInputData().contains(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData.JUMPING);

        boolean canJumpInWater = this.fluidPrediction.wasInWater, canJumpInLava = this.isInLava();
        if ((jumping || autoJumping) && (canJumpInWater || canJumpInLava)) {

            final Vec3 liquidJump = FluidMovement.liquidJump(vec3, canJumpInWater, canJumpInLava,
                    true, false);

            vec3 = liquidJump;

        } else if (this.climbJumpDelay == 0 && this.onGround
                && this.getInputData().contains(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData.START_JUMPING)) {
            vec3 = this.jumpFromGround(vec3);
        }

        return vec3;
    }

    private Vec3 jumpFromGround(Vec3 vec3) {
        float f = this.getJumpPower();
        if (f <= 1.0E-5f) {
            return vec3;
        }
        vec3 = new Vec3(vec3.x, Math.max(f, vec3.y), vec3.z);
        if (this.isPredictionSprinting()) {
            vec3 = SprintJumpPhysics.apply(vec3, this.yaw);
        }

        return vec3;
    }

    public float getBlockJumpFactor() {
        float f = this.compensatedWorld.getBlockState(CompensatedWorldImpl.blockPosition(this.position), 0).getJumpFactor();
        float g = this.compensatedWorld.getBlockState(this.getBlockPosBelowThatAffectsMyMovement(), 0).getJumpFactor();
        return f == 1.0 ? g : f;
    }

    public org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector3i getBlockPosBelowThatAffectsMyMovement() {
        return CompensatedWorldImpl.blockPosition(position.down(0.1F));
    }


}
```

```java
    public void traceTransaction(InventoryTransactionPacket packet, String source, String result) {
        if (session.player().worldDiagnostics() == null) return;
        var type = packet.getTransactionType();
        if (type != InventoryTransactionType.ITEM_USE && type != InventoryTransactionType.ITEM_RELEASE) return;
        traceUse("item_use_transaction", fields(
                "source", source, "result", result, "type", type.name(), "action", packet.getActionType(),
                "claimedSlot", packet.getHotbarSlot(), "claimedItem", describeItem(packet.getItemInHand()),
                "actionCount", packet.getActions().size()));
    }

    private void traceUse(String event, Map<String, Object> details) {
        var trace = session.player().worldDiagnostics();
        if (trace == null) return;
        try {
            int slot = session.inventory().heldItemSlot;
            var pending = session.inventoryResponseSync().pending().stream()
                    .filter(entry -> entry.slot() == slot)
                    .filter(entry -> switch (entry.type()) {
                        case HOTBAR, HOTBAR_AND_INVENTORY, INVENTORY -> true;
                        default -> false;
                    })
                    .map(entry -> fields("requestId", entry.requestId(), "count", entry.count(), "stackId", entry.stackId()))
                    .toList();
            details.put("heldSlot", slot);
            details.put("cachedItem", describeItem(session.inventory().inventoryContainer.getHeldItemData()));
            details.put("backendItem", describeItem(session.backendInventories().slot(0, slot)));
            details.put("pendingIdentity", pending);
            details.put("usedItem", describeItem(tracker.getUsedItem()));
            details.put("dirtyUsing", tracker.getDirtyUsing().name());
            details.put("usingItem", usingItemFlag());
            details.put("serverUsingItem", serverUsing);
            details.put("awaitingMetadata", tracker.isAwaitingMetadataStartConfirmation());
            details.put("slowdown", tracker.getPredictionItemSlowdownFactor());
            trace.event(event, details);
        } catch (RuntimeException ignored) {

        }
    }

    private static Map<String, Object> describeItem(ItemData item) {
        if (item == null) return null;
        var definition = item.getDefinition();
        return fields("identifier", definition == null ? null : definition.getIdentifier(),
                "runtimeId", definition == null ? null : definition.getRuntimeId(),
                "count", item.getCount(), "damage", item.getDamage());
    }

    public void observeMetadata(SetEntityDataPacket packet){
        if(session.player().vehicleData!=null)return;
        if(packet.getRuntimeEntityId()!=session.player().runtimeId() || !ac.navro.proxy.util.EntityMetadataUtil.hasBaseFlags(packet.getMetadata()))return;
        boolean using=packet.getMetadata().getFlag(EntityFlag.USING_ITEM);serverUsing=using;
        tracker.onMovementMetadataSent(using);
        session.player().queueAcknowledgment(packet,()->{
            tracker.onMovementMetadataAcknowledged(using);


        });
    }
    public void beginInput(PlayerAuthInputPacket packet){
        if(!flags.has(-1))sinceTridentUse=0;
        boolean start=packet.getInputData().contains(PlayerAuthInputData.START_USING_ITEM);
        var before = tracker.getDirtyUsing();
        float previousSlowdown = tracker.getPredictionItemSlowdownFactor();
        String decision = "no_start_edge";
        var iterator=packet.getInputData().iterator();
        while(iterator.hasNext()){
            var action=iterator.next();if(action!=PlayerAuthInputData.START_USING_ITEM)continue;
            ItemData item=nativeItem(session.inventory().inventoryContainer.getHeldItemData());
            if (NativeItemDecoder.usesBackendDefinition(session.player().protocolVersion(), item)) {
                decision = "backend_item";
                break;
            }
            if(tracker.getDirtyUsing()==ItemUseTracker.DirtyUsing.NONE){
                if(tracker.resumeLatchedUse(item)){
                    decision = "resumed";
                    break;
                }
                decision = "no_pending_use";
                iterator.remove();continue;
            }
            if(isNull(item)){
                decision = "cached_item_empty";
                iterator.remove();continue;
            }
            tracker.use(item,nativeItemId(item),true);
            boolean await=tracker.isAwaitingMetadataStartConfirmation();tracker.applyPredictedUseStart();
            if(!await)tracker.setDirtyUsing(ItemUseTracker.DirtyUsing.NONE);
            decision = await ? "waiting_for_metadata" : "started";
        }
        tracker.finishAuthInput(start);
        var dirty=tracker.getDirtyUsing();
        if(dirty!=ItemUseTracker.DirtyUsing.NONE && dirty==ItemUseTracker.DirtyUsing.METADATA && !flags.has(-1)){
            flags.set(-1,false);tracker.setDirtyUsing(ItemUseTracker.DirtyUsing.NONE);
        }
        tracker.snapshotPredictionUseState();
        if (session.player().worldDiagnostics() != null
                && (start || previousSlowdown != tracker.getPredictionItemSlowdownFactor())) {
            traceUse("item_use_input", fields("inputTick", packet.getTick(), "decision", decision,
                    "startReceived", start, "startKept", packet.getInputData().contains(PlayerAuthInputData.START_USING_ITEM),
                    "dirtyBefore", before.name(), "previousSlowdown", previousSlowdown,
                    "motion", String.valueOf(packet.getMotion()), "rawMoveVector", String.valueOf(packet.getRawMoveVector())));
        }
        tracker.preTick();
    }
    public void finishInput(){tracker.postTick();}
}
```
