```java
package ac.navro.proxy.prediction.ticker.base;

import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.live.PredictionContext;


import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Mutable;
import ac.navro.proxy.collision.Collider;
import ac.navro.proxy.compensated.world.CompensatedWorldImpl;
import ac.navro.proxy.data.block.NavroBlockState;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.StickyBlockPhysics;

import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.engine.data.VectorType;
import ac.navro.proxy.collision.CollisionShapeEntry;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.MathUtil;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;


public class EntityTicker {
    protected final PredictionContext player;
    public EntityTicker(PredictionContext player){this.player=player;}

    public void tick() {
        this.baseTick();
    }

    public void baseTick() {
        player.inBlockState = null;

    }

    protected void applyEffectsFromBlocks() {
        if (player.onGround) {

            final org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector3i lv = player.compensatedWorld.getStandingBlockPosition(player.boundingBox);
            player.compensatedWorld.getBlockState(lv, 0).onSteppedOn(player, lv);
        }

        org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector3i min = org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector3i.from((int) Math.floor(player.boundingBox.minX + 0.001D), (int) Math.floor(player.boundingBox.minY + 0.001D), (int) Math.floor(player.boundingBox.minZ + 0.001D));
        org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector3i max = org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector3i.from((int) Math.floor(player.boundingBox.maxX - 0.001D), (int) Math.floor(player.boundingBox.maxY - 0.001D), (int) Math.floor(player.boundingBox.maxZ - 0.001D));

        final Mutable mutable = new Mutable();
        for (int i = min.getX(); i <= max.getX(); ++i) {for (int j = min.getY(); j <= max.getY(); ++j) {for (int k = min.getZ(); k <= max.getZ(); ++k) {
            mutable.set(i, j, k);

            final NavroBlockState state = player.compensatedWorld.getBlockState(i, j, k, 0);
            if (!state.isHoneyBlock()) state.entityInside(player, mutable);
        }}}



        if (!player.noClip()) {
            player.velocity = ac.navro.proxy.prediction.ProtocolBlockEffects.applyBubble(player.velocity, ac.navro.proxy.prediction.ProtocolBlockEffects.bubbleContacts(player.session.world(),player.boundingBox,player.session.world().dimension()));
        }


        for (int x = (int) Math.floor(player.boundingBox.minX);
                x <= (int) Math.floor(Math.nextDown(player.boundingBox.maxX)); x++) {
            for (int y = (int) Math.floor(player.boundingBox.minY);
                    y <= (int) Math.floor(Math.nextDown(player.boundingBox.maxY)); y++) {
                for (int z = (int) Math.floor(player.boundingBox.minZ);
                        z <= (int) Math.floor(Math.nextDown(player.boundingBox.maxZ)); z++) {
                    final NavroBlockState state = player.compensatedWorld.getBlockState(x, y, z, 0);
                    if (state.isHoneyBlock()) state.entityInside(player, mutable.set(x, y, z));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public final void doSelfMove(Vec3 vec3) {

        player.bounceGravityCorrection = null;
        player.movementCollisionEntries = java.util.List.of();
        if (player.noClip()) {
            player.setResolvedMovement(player.boundingBox.offset(vec3), true);
            player.horizontalCollision = player.verticalCollision = player.onGround = false;
            player.beforeCollision = player.afterCollision = vec3.clone();
            return;
        }

        if (player.stuckSpeedMultiplier.lengthSquared() > 1.0E-7) {
            vec3 = vec3.multiply(player.stuckSpeedMultiplier);
            player.stuckSpeedMultiplier = Vec3.ZERO;
            player.velocity = Vec3.ZERO.clone();
        }

        final boolean wasOnGround = player.onGround;
        Vec3 oldVec3 = vec3.clone();
        player.lavaSampler.stage("beforeEdgeBackoff");
        player.ceilingSampler.stage("beforeEdgeBackoff");
        player.collisionSampler.stage("beforeEdgeBackoff");
        player.trapdoorSampler.stage("beforeEdgeBackoff");
        player.movementSampler.stage("beforeEdgeBackoff");
        final var edge = Collider.backOffFromEdge(player, vec3);
        player.velocity = edge.applyVelocity(player.velocity);
        final var solved = Collider.collideAndUpdateMove(player, vec3 = edge.movement());
        Vec3 vec32 = solved.movement;
        player.lavaSampler.edgeBackoff(oldVec3, vec3, vec32);
        player.ceilingSampler.edgeBackoff(oldVec3, vec3, vec32);
        player.collisionSampler.edgeBackoff(oldVec3, vec3, vec32);
        player.trapdoorSampler.edgeBackoff(oldVec3, vec3, vec32);
        player.movementSampler.edgeBackoff(oldVec3, vec3, vec32);
        player.setResolvedMovement(solved.aabb, true);

        boolean bl = !MathUtil.equal(vec3.x, vec32.x);
        boolean bl2 = !MathUtil.equal(vec3.z, vec32.z);
        player.horizontalCollision = bl || bl2;
        player.verticalCollision = vec3.y != vec32.y;

        player.onGround = player.verticalCollision
                ? vec3.y < 0.0F
                : vec3.y == 0.0F && wasOnGround;



        if (vec3.y == 0 && player.bestPossibility.getVelocity().y == 0 && player.bestPossibility.getType() == VectorType.VELOCITY && !MathUtil.equal(player.lastTickFinalVelocity.y, 0)) {
            player.verticalCollision = Collider.collide(player, player.lastTickFinalVelocity.clone()).y != player.lastTickFinalVelocity.y;
            player.onGround = player.verticalCollision && player.lastTickFinalVelocity.y < 0;
        }

        final StickyBlockPhysics.Restitution restitution = StickyBlockPhysics.restitute(
                player.boundingBox, player.movementCollisionEntries, player.velocity, vec3, vec32,
                bl, player.verticalCollision, bl2,
                player.getFlagTracker().has("SNEAKING"));
        player.velocity = restitution.velocity();
        player.bounceGravityCorrection = restitution.gravityCorrection();

        player.beforeCollision = vec3.clone();
        player.afterCollision = vec32.clone();
        player.lavaSampler.stage("afterCollision");
        player.ceilingSampler.stage("afterCollision");
        player.collisionSampler.stage("afterCollision");
        player.trapdoorSampler.stage("afterCollision");
        player.movementSampler.stage("afterCollision");

    }

}
```

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.prediction.ticker.impl;

import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.live.PredictionContext;


import ac.navro.proxy.collision.ScaffoldingCollision;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.ClimbableBlockPhysics;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.RiptidePhysics;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.engine.base.PredictionEngine;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.engine.impl.GlidingPredictionEngine;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.engine.impl.GroundAndAirPredictionEngine;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.engine.impl.fluid.LavaPredictionEngine;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.engine.impl.fluid.WaterPredictionEngine;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.ticker.base.EntityTicker;

import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.engine.data.VectorType;
import ac.navro.proxy.collision.CollisionShapeEntry;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Box;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;

import java.util.List;

public class LivingTicker extends EntityTicker {
    public LivingTicker(PredictionContext player) {
        super(player);
    }

    @Override
    public void tick() {
        super.tick();

        player.velocity = RiptidePhysics.applyImpulse(player, player.velocity);

        this.aiStep();
    }

    public void aiStep() {


        player.velocity.x = Math.abs(player.velocity.x) < 1.0E-8 ? 0 : player.velocity.x;
        player.velocity.y = Math.abs(player.velocity.y) < 1.0E-8 ? 0 : player.velocity.y;
        player.velocity.z = Math.abs(player.velocity.z) < 1.0E-8 ? 0 : player.velocity.z;

        this.applyInput();

        player.velocity = ScaffoldingCollision.applyAcceptedDescend(player, player.velocity);
        ClimbableBlockPhysics.recordAcceptedJump(player);

        player.swimDebug.stage("BDS_JUMP_INPUT");
        player.velocity = player.jump(player.velocity);
        player.swimDebug.stage("BDS_JUMP_RESULT");
        player.lavaSampler.stage("afterJump");
        player.ceilingSampler.stage("afterJump");

        player.cachedOnPos = null;

        Box oldBox = player.boundingBox.clone();

        this.travelRidden();

        this.applyEffectsFromBlocks();

        if (player.autoSpinAttackTicks > 0) {
            --player.autoSpinAttackTicks;
            this.checkAutoSpinAttack(oldBox, player.boundingBox);
        }

        ClimbableBlockPhysics.refreshFlags(player);
    }

    protected final void checkAutoSpinAttack(Box aABB, Box aABB2) {
        Box aABB3 = aABB.union(aABB2);

        List<ac.navro.proxy.compensated.cache.entity.EntityCache> list = player.compensatedWorld.getEntities().values().stream().toList();
        if (!list.isEmpty()) {
            for (ac.navro.proxy.compensated.cache.entity.EntityCache entity : list) {
                if (entity.getCurrent() == null) {
                    continue;
                }

                if (!entity.getCurrent().getBoundingBox().intersects(aABB3)) {
                    continue;
                }

                player.dirtySpinStop = true;


                break;
            }
        } else if (player.horizontalCollision) {
            player.stopRiptide();
        }

        if (player.autoSpinAttackTicks <= 0) {
            player.stopRiptide();
        }
    }

    protected void travelRidden() {









        this.travel();
    }

    public void applyInput() {
        player.input = player.input.multiply(0.98F);
    }

    protected void travel() {

        if (player.isInLava() || player.fluidPrediction.waterTravel) {
            this.travelInFluid();
        } else if (player.getFlagTracker().has("GLIDING")) {






            player.velocity = new GlidingPredictionEngine(player).travel(player.velocity);
            this.doSelfMove(player.velocity.clone());
        } else {
            travelInAir();
        }
    }

    private void travelInAir() {
        final PredictionEngine engine = new GroundAndAirPredictionEngine(player);

        player.velocity = engine.travel(player.velocity);
        player.ceilingSampler.stage("afterAirTravel");

        this.doSelfMove(player.velocity.clone());
        engine.finalizeMovement();
        player.ceilingSampler.stage("afterAirDragAndGravity");

    }

    private void travelInFluid() {
        float d = player.position.y;
        final PredictionEngine engine;
        if (player.isInLava()) {
            engine = new LavaPredictionEngine(player);
        } else {
            engine = new WaterPredictionEngine(player);
        }

        player.velocity = engine.travel(player.velocity);
        player.lavaSampler.stage("afterFluidTravel");
        player.ceilingSampler.stage("afterFluidTravel");

        this.doSelfMove(player.velocity.clone());
        engine.finalizeMovement();
        player.lavaSampler.stage("afterFluidDragAndGravity");
        player.ceilingSampler.stage("afterFluidDragAndGravity");

        Vec3 vec33 = player.velocity;
        if (player.horizontalCollision && player.doesNotCollide(vec33.x, vec33.y + 0.6f - player.position.y + d, vec33.z)) {
            player.velocity.y = 0.3F;
        }
        player.lavaSampler.stage("afterFluidWallExit");
        player.ceilingSampler.stage("afterFluidWallExit");
    }
}
```

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.prediction.ticker.impl;

import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.live.PredictionContext;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.live.NativeIds;


import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.SneakInputPhysics;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.engine.base.PredictionEngine;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.fluid.FluidMovement;

import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.engine.data.VectorType;
import ac.navro.proxy.collision.CollisionShapeEntry;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;

import java.util.Map;

public class PlayerTicker extends LivingTicker {
    public PlayerTicker(PredictionContext player) {
        super(player);
    }

    @Override
    public void applyInput() {
        player.swimDebug.stage("MOVEMENT_INPUT_SCALE_BEFORE","movementInput",
                player.input.toVector3f(),
                "slowdownTicks",player.ticksSinceCanSlowdown);
        player.lavaSampler.stage("beforeInputScaling");
        player.ceilingSampler.stage("beforeInputScaling");
        player.itemUseDebug.stage("INPUT_SCALE_BEFORE");
        player.input = scaleMovementInput(player, player.input, true);
        player.itemUseDebug.stage("INPUT_SCALE_AFTER");
        player.lavaSampler.stage("afterInputScaling");
        player.ceilingSampler.stage("afterInputScaling");
        player.swimDebug.stage("MOVEMENT_INPUT_SCALE_AFTER","movementInput",
                player.input.toVector3f(),
                "slowdownTicks",player.ticksSinceCanSlowdown);
    }


    public static Vec3 scaleMovementInput(final PredictionContext player, final Vec3 rawInput, final boolean commit) {
        Vec3 input = rawInput;
        input = input.multiply(0.98F);
        boolean swiftSneak = false;
        if (SneakInputPhysics.shouldScale(player) && player.ticksSinceCanSlowdown >= 2) {
            final Map<Integer, Integer> enchantments = ac.navro.proxy.compensated.CompensatedInventory.getEnchantments(
                    player.nativeItem(player.compensatedInventory.armorContainer.get(2).getData()));
            final Integer enchantment = NativeIds.Enchantment.getEnchantment(NativeIds.Enchantment.ID_SWIFT_SNEAK);
            swiftSneak = enchantment != null && enchantments.containsKey(enchantment);
        }
        input = SneakInputPhysics.scale(player, input, swiftSneak, commit);
        if (player.getItemUseTracker().hasPredictionItemSlowdown()) {
            input = input.multiply(player.getItemUseTracker().getPredictionItemSlowdownFactor());
        }
        return input;
    }

    @Override
    public void aiStep() {

        player.lavaSampler.stage("beforeFluidPush");
        player.ceilingSampler.stage("beforeFluidPush");
        player.velocity = FluidMovement.prepareVelocity(player, player.velocity);
        player.lavaSampler.stage("afterFluidPush");
        player.ceilingSampler.stage("afterFluidPush");

        super.aiStep();
    }

    @Override
    protected void travel() {
        player.swimDebug.stage("SWIM_CONTROL_BEFORE");
        player.velocity = FluidMovement.swimControl(player, player.velocity);
        player.swimDebug.stage("SWIM_CONTROL_AFTER");

        super.travel();

    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/protocol/BackendAdvertisement.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.protocol;

import io.netty.bootstrap.Bootstrap;
import io.netty.buffer.Unpooled;
import io.netty.channel.*;
import io.netty.channel.socket.nio.NioDatagramChannel;
import org.cloudburstmc.netty.channel.raknet.RakChannelFactory;
import org.cloudburstmc.netty.channel.raknet.RakPing;
import org.cloudburstmc.netty.channel.raknet.RakPong;
import java.net.InetSocketAddress;
import java.util.concurrent.ScheduledFuture;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;


public final class BackendAdvertisement extends SimpleChannelInboundHandler<RakPing> implements AutoCloseable {
    private final long guid;
    private volatile byte[] advertisement;
    private Channel queryChannel;
    private ScheduledFuture<?> polling;

    public BackendAdvertisement(long guid) { this.guid = guid; }

    public void attach(Channel server) {
        server.pipeline().addBefore("rak-server-tail-handler", "backend-advertisement", this);
    }

    public void start(EventLoopGroup group, InetSocketAddress backend) throws InterruptedException {
        queryChannel = new Bootstrap().group(group)
                .channelFactory(RakChannelFactory.client(NioDatagramChannel.class))
                .handler(new SimpleChannelInboundHandler<RakPong>() {
                    @Override protected void channelRead0(ChannelHandlerContext ctx, RakPong pong) {
                        if (!backend.equals(pong.getSender())) return;
                        var data = pong.getPongData();
                        byte[] bytes = new byte[data.readableBytes()];
                        data.getBytes(data.readerIndex(), bytes);
                        advertisement = bytes;
                    }
                }).bind(0).sync().channel();
        polling = queryChannel.eventLoop().scheduleAtFixedRate(
                () -> queryChannel.writeAndFlush(new RakPing(System.currentTimeMillis(), backend)),
                0, 5, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
    }

    @Override protected void channelRead0(ChannelHandlerContext ctx, RakPing ping) {
        byte[] bytes = advertisement;
        if (bytes != null) ctx.writeAndFlush(ping.reply(guid, Unpooled.wrappedBuffer(bytes)));
    }

    @Override public void close() {
        if (polling != null) polling.cancel(false);
        if (queryChannel != null) queryChannel.close();
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/protocol/FloodgateForwarding.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.protocol;

import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.util.ChainValidationResult;
import org.jose4j.jws.AlgorithmIdentifiers;
import org.jose4j.jws.JsonWebSignature;
import org.jose4j.jwt.JwtClaims;
import org.jose4j.jwt.NumericDate;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.net.InetSocketAddress;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.security.GeneralSecurityException;
import java.security.KeyFactory;
import java.security.PublicKey;
import java.security.interfaces.ECPrivateKey;
import java.security.spec.PKCS8EncodedKeySpec;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.Base64;

public final class FloodgateForwarding {
    private final ECPrivateKey signingKey;

    private FloodgateForwarding(ECPrivateKey signingKey) {
        this.signingKey = signingKey;
    }

    public static FloodgateForwarding load(Path path) throws IOException, GeneralSecurityException {
        String pem = Files.readString(path).strip();
        String begin = "-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----";
        String end = "-----END PRIVATE KEY-----";
        if (!pem.startsWith(begin) || !pem.endsWith(end)) {
            throw new GeneralSecurityException("Expected an unencrypted PKCS#8 PEM Floodgate forwarding key");
        }
        byte[] der = Base64.getDecoder().decode(pem.substring(begin.length(), pem.length() - end.length())
                .replaceAll("\\s", ""));
        var key = (ECPrivateKey) KeyFactory.getInstance("EC").generatePrivate(new PKCS8EncodedKeySpec(der));
        if (key.getParams().getCurve().getField().getFieldSize() != 384) {
            throw new GeneralSecurityException("Floodgate forwarding requires a P-384 key");
        }
        return new FloodgateForwarding(key);
    }

    String token(ChainValidationResult verifiedChain, InetSocketAddress address, PublicKey backendKey) throws Exception {
        LoginIdentity identity = LoginIdentity.fromVerifiedChain(verifiedChain);
        var data = verifiedChain.identityClaims().extraData;
        String xuid = data.xuid;
        if (xuid == null || !xuid.matches("[1-9][0-9]{0,19}")) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing or invalid verified Bedrock XUID");
        }
        Long.parseUnsignedLong(xuid);

        long now = Instant.now().getEpochSecond();
        var claims = new JwtClaims();
        claims.setAudience("urn:navro:floodgate-forwarding:1");
        claims.setIssuedAt(NumericDate.fromSeconds(now));
        claims.setExpirationTime(NumericDate.fromSeconds(now + 30));
        claims.setStringClaim("cpk", Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(backendKey.getEncoded()));
        claims.setStringClaim("xid", xuid);
        claims.setStringClaim("xname", identity.displayName());
        claims.setStringClaim("leguuid", identity.uuid().toString());
        claims.setStringClaim("mid", data.minecraftId == null ? "" : data.minecraftId);
        claims.setStringClaim("ipt", address.getAddress().getHostAddress().split("%", 2)[0]);

        var signature = new JsonWebSignature();
        signature.setAlgorithmHeaderValue(AlgorithmIdentifiers.ECDSA_USING_P384_CURVE_AND_SHA384);
        signature.setKey(signingKey);
        signature.setPayload(claims.toJson());
        return signature.getCompactSerialization();
    }
}
```

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.protocol;

import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.util.ChainValidationResult;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.UUID;


public record LoginIdentity(UUID uuid,String displayName) {
    public static LoginIdentity fromVerifiedChain(ChainValidationResult chain){
        if(!chain.signed())throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsigned Bedrock identity");
        var data=chain.identityClaims().extraData;
        return new LoginIdentity(Objects.requireNonNull(data.identity,"Missing Bedrock identity"),
                Objects.requireNonNull(data.displayName,"Missing Bedrock display name"));
    }
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/protocol/LosslessAvailableCommandsSerializer.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.protocol;

import io.netty.buffer.ByteBuf;
import it.unimi.dsi.fastutil.longs.LongObjectPair;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.codec.BedrockCodecHelper;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.codec.v898.serializer.AvailableCommandsSerializer_v898;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.codec.v898.Bedrock_v898;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.codec.v975.Bedrock_v975;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.command.*;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.AvailableCommandsPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.common.util.*;
import java.util.*;




public final class LosslessAvailableCommandsSerializer extends AvailableCommandsSerializer_v898 {
    private static final class LegacyParameters extends Bedrock_v898 {
        static TypeMap<CommandParam> parameters() { return COMMAND_PARAMS; }
    }
    private static final class ModernParameters extends Bedrock_v975 {
        static TypeMap<CommandParam> parameters() { return COMMAND_PARAMS; }
    }
    public LosslessAvailableCommandsSerializer(int protocol) {
        super(protocol >= 975 ? ModernParameters.parameters() : LegacyParameters.parameters());
    }
    @Override
    public void serialize(ByteBuf buffer, BedrockCodecHelper helper, AvailableCommandsPacket packet) {
        SequencedHashSet<String> enumValues = new SequencedHashSet<>();
        SequencedHashSet<String> subCommandValues = new SequencedHashSet<>();
        SequencedHashSet<String> postFixes = new SequencedHashSet<>();
        SequencedHashSet<CommandEnumData> enums = new SequencedHashSet<>();
        SequencedHashSet<ChainedSubCommandData> subCommandData = new SequencedHashSet<>();
        SequencedHashSet<CommandEnumData> softEnums = new SequencedHashSet<>();
        SequencedHashSet<LongObjectPair<Set<CommandEnumConstraint>>> enumConstraints = new SequencedHashSet<>();


        for (CommandData data : packet.getCommands()) {
            if (data.getAliases() != null) {
                enumValues.addAll(data.getAliases().getValues().keySet());
                enums.add(data.getAliases());
            }

            for (ChainedSubCommandData subcommand : data.getSubcommands()) {
                if (subCommandData.contains(subcommand)) {
                    continue;
                }

                subCommandData.add(subcommand);
                for (ChainedSubCommandData.Value value : subcommand.getValues()) {
                    if (!subCommandValues.contains(value.getFirst())) {
                        if (value.getFirst() != null) subCommandValues.add(value.getFirst());
                    }

                    if (!subCommandValues.contains(value.getSecond())) {
                        if (value.getSecond() != null) subCommandValues.add(value.getSecond());
                    }
                }
            }

            for (CommandOverloadData overload : data.getOverloads()) {
                for (CommandParamData parameter : overload.getOverloads()) {
                    CommandEnumData commandEnumData = parameter.getEnumData();
                    if (commandEnumData != null) {
                        if (commandEnumData.isSoft()) {
                            softEnums.add(commandEnumData);
                        } else {
                            enums.add(commandEnumData);
                            int enumIndex = enums.indexOf(commandEnumData);
                            commandEnumData.getValues().forEach((key, constraints) -> {
                                enumValues.add(key);
                                if (!constraints.isEmpty()) {
                                    int valueIndex = enumValues.indexOf(key);
                                    enumConstraints.add(LongObjectPair.of(LongKeys.key(valueIndex, enumIndex), constraints));
                                }
                            });
                        }
                    }

                    String postfix = parameter.getPostfix();
                    if (postfix != null) {
                        postFixes.add(postfix);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        helper.writeArray(buffer, enumValues, helper::writeString);
        helper.writeArray(buffer, subCommandValues, helper::writeString);
        helper.writeArray(buffer, postFixes, helper::writeString);

        this.writeEnums(buffer, helper, enumValues, enums);
        helper.writeArray(buffer, subCommandData, (buf, value) -> this.writeSubCommand(buffer, helper, subCommandValues, value));

        helper.writeArray(buffer, packet.getCommands(), (buf, command) -> {
            this.writeCommand(buffer, helper, command, enums, softEnums, postFixes, subCommandData);
        });

        helper.writeArray(buffer, softEnums, helper::writeCommandEnum);

        helper.writeArray(buffer, enumConstraints, this::writeEnumConstraint);
    }


    @Override protected void writeSubCommand(ByteBuf buffer, BedrockCodecHelper helper,
                                             List<String> values, ChainedSubCommandData data) {
        helper.writeString(buffer, data.getName());
        helper.writeArray(buffer, data.getValues(), (buf, value) -> {
            VarInts.writeUnsignedInt(buf, value.getFirst() == null ? -1 : values.indexOf(value.getFirst()));
            VarInts.writeUnsignedInt(buf, value.getSecond() == null ? -1 : values.indexOf(value.getSecond()));
        });
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/protocol/MovementPredictionSyncSerializer.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.protocol;

import ac.navro.proxy.packets.input.ClientMovementPredictionSyncPacket;
import io.netty.buffer.ByteBuf;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.codec.BedrockCodecHelper;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.codec.BedrockPacketSerializer;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.MovementPredictionSyncPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.common.util.VarInts;

import java.util.HashSet;

public final class MovementPredictionSyncSerializer implements BedrockPacketSerializer<MovementPredictionSyncPacket> {
    private final int protocol;

    public MovementPredictionSyncSerializer(int protocol) {
        this.protocol = protocol;
    }

    @Override
    public void deserialize(ByteBuf buffer, BedrockCodecHelper helper, MovementPredictionSyncPacket packet) {
        var flags = new HashSet<Integer>();
        int encodedByteIndex = 0;
        int value;
        do {
            value = buffer.readUnsignedByte();
            for (int bit = 0; bit < 7; bit++) {
                if ((value & (1 << bit)) != 0) flags.add(encodedByteIndex * 7 + bit);
            }
            if (++encodedByteIndex > 32) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Actor flags VarInt is too large");
        } while ((value & 0x80) != 0);
        ((ClientMovementPredictionSyncPacket) packet).captureFlags(flags);
        packet.setBoundingBox(helper.readVector3f(buffer));
        packet.setSpeed(buffer.readFloatLE());
        packet.setUnderwaterSpeed(buffer.readFloatLE());
        packet.setLavaSpeed(buffer.readFloatLE());
        packet.setJumpStrength(buffer.readFloatLE());
        packet.setHealth(buffer.readFloatLE());
        packet.setHunger(buffer.readFloatLE());
        packet.setUnknown1(protocol >= 975 ? buffer.readFloatLE() : 0F);
        packet.setUnknown2(protocol >= 975 ? buffer.readFloatLE() : 0F);
        packet.setUnknown3(protocol >= 975 ? buffer.readFloatLE() : 0F);
        packet.setUniqueEntityId(VarInts.readLong(buffer));
        packet.setFlying(protocol >= 786 && buffer.readBoolean());
    }

    @Override
    public void serialize(ByteBuf buffer, BedrockCodecHelper helper, MovementPredictionSyncPacket packet) {
        var flags = ClientMovementPredictionSyncPacket.copyFlags(packet);
        int highest = flags.stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).max().orElse(0);
        if (highest >= 224) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Actor flags VarInt is too large");
        int byteCount = highest / 7 + 1;
        for (int byteIndex = 0; byteIndex < byteCount; byteIndex++) {
            int value = byteIndex + 1 < byteCount ? 0x80 : 0;
            for (int bit = 0; bit < 7; bit++) {
                if (flags.contains(byteIndex * 7 + bit)) value |= 1 << bit;
            }
            buffer.writeByte(value);
        }
        helper.writeVector3f(buffer, packet.getBoundingBox());
        buffer.writeFloatLE(packet.getSpeed());
        buffer.writeFloatLE(packet.getUnderwaterSpeed());
        buffer.writeFloatLE(packet.getLavaSpeed());
        buffer.writeFloatLE(packet.getJumpStrength());
        buffer.writeFloatLE(packet.getHealth());
        buffer.writeFloatLE(packet.getHunger());
        if (protocol >= 975) {
            buffer.writeFloatLE(packet.getUnknown1());
            buffer.writeFloatLE(packet.getUnknown2());
            buffer.writeFloatLE(packet.getUnknown3());
        }
        VarInts.writeLong(buffer, packet.getUniqueEntityId());
        if (protocol >= 786) buffer.writeBoolean(packet.isFlying());
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/protocol/PrivateBackendLogin.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.protocol;

import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.auth.*;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.LoginPacket;
import org.jose4j.jws.JsonWebSignature;
import org.jose4j.json.JsonUtil;
import java.security.KeyPair;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.*;

public final class PrivateBackendLogin {
    private PrivateBackendLogin(){ }
    public static LoginPacket encode(int protocol,LoginIdentity verified,Map<String,Object> claims,
                                     byte[] verifiedClientData,KeyPair backendKey)throws Exception{
        String cpk=Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(backendKey.getPublic().getEncoded());
        long now=Instant.now().getEpochSecond();
        Map<String,Object> payload=new LinkedHashMap<>();
        payload.put("nbf",now-21600);payload.put("exp",now+21600);payload.put("iat",now);
        payload.put("aud","api://auth-minecraft-services/multiplayer");
        payload.put("cpk",cpk);payload.put("xname",verified.displayName());
        payload.put("leguuid",verified.uuid().toString());



        Object xuid=claims.get("xid");
        if(!(xuid instanceof String)&&claims.get("extraData") instanceof Map<?,?> extra)xuid=extra.get("XUID");
        payload.put("xid",xuid instanceof String value?value:"");payload.put("ipt","");
        payload.put("mid",claims.get("mid") instanceof String value?value:"");
        payload.put("tid",claims.get("tid") instanceof String value?value:"");
        return packet(protocol,sign(JsonUtil.toJson(payload),backendKey,cpk),verifiedClientData,backendKey);
    }
    static LoginPacket packet(int protocol,String token,byte[] verifiedClientData,KeyPair backendKey)throws Exception{
        String cpk=Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(backendKey.getPublic().getEncoded());
        var login=new LoginPacket();login.setProtocolVersion(protocol);
        login.setAuthPayload(new TokenPayload(token,AuthType.SELF_SIGNED));
        login.setClientJwt(sign(new String(verifiedClientData,StandardCharsets.UTF_8),backendKey,cpk));
        return login;
    }
    private static String sign(String payload,KeyPair key,String cpk)throws Exception{
        var jws=new JsonWebSignature();jws.setAlgorithmHeaderValue("ES384");jws.setHeader("x5u",cpk);
        jws.setPayload(payload);jws.setKey(key.getPrivate());return jws.getCompactSerialization();
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/protocol/RakNetBackendEncryption.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.protocol;

import com.google.gson.JsonParser;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.BedrockClientSession;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.ClientToServerHandshakePacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.LoginPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.util.ChainValidationResult;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.util.EncryptionUtils;
import org.jose4j.jws.JsonWebSignature;

import javax.crypto.SecretKey;
import java.net.InetSocketAddress;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.security.KeyPair;
import java.util.Base64;
import java.util.Map;

public final class RakNetBackendEncryption {
    private final KeyPair keys = EncryptionUtils.createKeyPair();

    public LoginPacket login(int protocol, LoginIdentity identity, Map<String, Object> claims,
                             byte[] verifiedClientData) throws Exception {
        return PrivateBackendLogin.encode(protocol, identity, claims, sanitize(verifiedClientData), keys);
    }

    public LoginPacket forwardedLogin(int protocol, ChainValidationResult verifiedChain, byte[] verifiedClientData,
                                      InetSocketAddress address, FloodgateForwarding forwarding) throws Exception {
        return PrivateBackendLogin.packet(protocol, forwarding.token(verifiedChain, address, keys.getPublic()),
                sanitize(verifiedClientData), keys);
    }

    private static byte[] sanitize(byte[] verifiedClientData) {
        var clientData = JsonParser.parseString(new String(verifiedClientData, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)).getAsJsonObject();
        clientData.remove("Waterdog_IP");
        clientData.remove("Waterdog_XUID");
        return clientData.toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
    }

    public void complete(BedrockClientSession backend, String jwt) throws Exception {
        backend.enableEncryption(sessionKey(jwt));
        backend.sendPacketImmediately(new ClientToServerHandshakePacket());
    }

    SecretKey sessionKey(String jwt) throws Exception {
        var handshake = new JsonWebSignature();
        handshake.setCompactSerialization(jwt);
        if (!"ES384".equals(handshake.getAlgorithmHeaderValue())) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid backend handshake algorithm");
        }
        var publicKey = EncryptionUtils.parseKey(handshake.getHeader("x5u"));
        handshake.setKey(publicKey);
        if (!handshake.verifySignature()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid backend handshake signature");
        var salt = JsonParser.parseString(handshake.getPayload()).getAsJsonObject().get("salt");
        if (salt == null || !salt.isJsonPrimitive() || !salt.getAsJsonPrimitive().isString()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing backend handshake salt");
        }
        byte[] token = Base64.getDecoder().decode(salt.getAsString());
        if (token.length != 16) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid backend handshake salt");
        return EncryptionUtils.getSecretKey(keys.getPrivate(), publicKey, token);
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/state/MovementMetadata.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.state;

import ac.navro.anticheat.data.EntityDimensions;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.fluid.FluidMovement;
import ac.navro.proxy.player.data.tracker.FlagTracker;
import ac.navro.proxy.util.EntityMetadataUtil;
import java.util.Set;


public final class MovementMetadata {
    private MovementMetadata() { }





    public interface Context<I> extends FluidMovement.Context, FlagTracker.Context<I> {
        FlagTracker<I> getFlagTracker();
        void setServerSprinting(boolean sprinting);
        I compensatedChest();
        boolean isNull(I item);
        int nativeItemId(I item);
        void stage(String name, Object... values);
    }

    public static <I> void applyClientVisibleMovementMetadata(Context<I> player, final Float width, final Float height, final Float scale,
                                                  final Set<Integer> flags,
                                                  boolean hasBaseFlags, boolean hasExtendedFlags) {
        player.stage("POSE_METADATA_BEGIN","width",width,"height",height,"scale",scale,
                "baseFlagsPresent",hasBaseFlags,"extendedFlagsPresent",hasExtendedFlags,
                "metadataFlags",flags == null ? null : flags.stream().sorted().toList());
        final var physicalBeforeMetadata = player.snapshotAabb();
        final boolean crawlingSizeBefore = FluidMovement.hasCrawlingSizeRequest(player);
        if (flags != null) {
            final boolean canClimb = player.getFlagTracker().has(19);

            final Set<Integer> clientVisibleFlags = EntityMetadataUtil.mergeFlags(
                    player.getFlagTracker().cloneFlags(), flags, hasBaseFlags, hasExtendedFlags);
            final boolean metadataSwimming = clientVisibleFlags.contains(57);
            final boolean metadataSprinting = clientVisibleFlags.contains(3);











            if (hasBaseFlags) {
                clientVisibleFlags.remove(FlagTracker.USING_ITEM);
                if (clientVisibleFlags.contains(4)) {
                    clientVisibleFlags.add(FlagTracker.USING_ITEM);
                }
            }
            player.getFlagTracker().set(player, clientVisibleFlags);
            player.getFlagTracker().set(19, canClimb);




            if (hasBaseFlags) {
                player.setServerSprinting(metadataSprinting);
                player.setClientSwimming(metadataSwimming);
                player.getFlagTracker().set(1,
                        clientVisibleFlags.contains(1));
            }



            if (hasBaseFlags) {
                syncGlidingFlag(player, clientVisibleFlags.contains(32));
            }
            FluidMovement.updatePoseForMetadata(player);

        }

        if (width != null) {




            updateWidth(player, width);
        }
        if (height != null) {


            updateHeight(player, height);
        }
        if (scale != null) {
            updateScale(player, scale);
        }
        if (FluidMovement.finishMetadataPose(player, physicalBeforeMetadata, crawlingSizeBefore, width, height, scale,
                flags != null && (hasBaseFlags || hasExtendedFlags))) {
            player.stage("POSE_METADATA_END","requestStaged",true);
            return;
        }
        if (height != null && Float.isFinite(height) && height > 0F
                || scale != null && Float.isFinite(scale) && scale > 0F) {
            FluidMovement.acknowledgeDimensions(player);
        } else if (width != null && Float.isFinite(width) && width > 0F) {
            FluidMovement.acknowledgeWidth(player);
        }
        player.stage("POSE_METADATA_END","requestStaged",false);
    }

    public static <I> boolean hasElytraEquipped(Context<I> player) {
        final I chest = player.compensatedChest();
        return chest != null && !player.isNull(chest) && player.nativeItemId(chest) == 444;
    }

    public static <I> void syncGlidingFlag(Context<I> player, final boolean requestedGliding) {
        player.getFlagTracker().set(32, requestedGliding && hasElytraEquipped(player));
    }

    private static void updateWidth(Context<?> player, final float width) {
        if (!Float.isFinite(width) || width <= 0F) {
            return;
        }

        player.applyDimensions(EntityDimensions.fixed(width, player.dimensions().height())
                .withEyeHeight(player.dimensions().eyeHeight()));
    }

    private static void updateHeight(Context<?> player, final float height) {
        if (!Float.isFinite(height) || height <= 0F) {
            return;
        }

        player.applyDimensions(EntityDimensions.fixed(player.dimensions().width(), height)
                .withEyeHeight(eyeHeightFor(height)));
    }

    private static void updateScale(Context<?> player, final float scale) {
        if (!Float.isFinite(scale) || scale <= 0F) {
            return;
        }

        player.applyDimensions(player.dimensions().hardScaled(scale));
    }

    private static float eyeHeightFor(final float height) {




        if (Math.abs(height - 0.2F) <= 1.0E-3F) {
            return 0.2F;
        }
        if (Math.abs(height - 0.625F) <= 1.0E-3F) {
            return 0.42F;
        }
        if (Math.abs(height - 0.6F) <= 1.0E-3F) {
            return 0.42F;
        }
        if (Math.abs(height - 1.49F) <= 1.0E-3F
                || Math.abs(height - 1.65F) <= 1.0E-3F) {
            return 1.26F;
        }
        if (Math.abs(height - 1.5F) <= 1.0E-3F) {
            return 1.27F;
        }
        return 1.62F;
    }

}
```

```java
        String key=info.type().isEmpty()?info.name():info.name()+"-"+info.type();
        if(type==ac.navro.proxy.check.impl.badpackets.BadPacketsC.class
                &&disabledChecks.contains("BadPacketsC"))return false;
        return !disabledChecks.contains(key);
    }

    public void advanceInputClock(PlayerAuthInputPacket input) {
        if(input.getTick()<0)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Negative client frame");
        previousTick=tick;
        tick++;
        simulationFrame=input.getTick();
        long now=System.currentTimeMillis();
        lastAuthInputGapMs=now-sinceAuthInput;
        sinceAuthInput=now;
        sinceLoadingScreen++;
        clockedInput=input;
    }

    public void apply(StartGamePacket packet) {
        predictionSync.clear();
        uniqueId = packet.getUniqueEntityId();
        runtimeId = packet.getRuntimeEntityId();
        dimension = packet.getDimensionId();
        if (packet.getRotation() != null) {
            var rotation = packet.getRotation();
            rawInputRotation = new WireVec3(rotation.getX(), rotation.getY(), rotation.getY());
            previousInputRotation = rawInputRotation;
        }
        if (packet.getPlayerPosition() != null) {
            position = new Vec3(packet.getPlayerPosition());
            previousPosition=position.clone();
            unvalidatedPosition = position.clone();
            previousUnvalidatedPosition = position.clone();
            setBoundingBox(position);
        }
    }

    public void apply(AddEntityPacket packet) {
        if (packet.getRuntimeEntityId() == runtimeId) {
            runtimeId = packet.getRuntimeEntityId();
            uniqueId = packet.getUniqueEntityId();
            if (packet.getPosition() != null) setServerPosition(WireVec3.of(packet.getPosition()));
            if (packet.getMotion() != null) serverVelocity = new Vec3(packet.getMotion());
            applyMetadata(packet.getMetadata());
            applyAttributes(packet.getAttributes());
        }
    }

    public void apply(PlayerAuthInputPacket packet, CompensatedWorld world, ProtocolFluidStateTracker fluidState) {
        apply(packet, world, fluidState, 0);
    }

    public void apply(PlayerAuthInputPacket packet, CompensatedWorld world, ProtocolFluidStateTracker fluidState,
                      float inputYOffset) {
        beginPoseInput();

        if(clockedInput!=packet)advanceInputClock(packet);
        clockedInput=null;
        rawInputPosition = WireVec3.of(packet.getPosition());
        previousInputRotation = rawInputRotation;
        rawInputRotation = WireVec3.of(packet.getRotation());
        rawInputDelta = WireVec3.of(packet.getDelta());
        rawInputMotion = WireVec2.of(packet.getMotion());
        rawMoveVector = WireVec2.of(packet.getRawMoveVector());
        cameraOrientation = WireVec3.of(packet.getCameraOrientation());
        interactRotation = WireVec2.of(packet.getInteractRotation());
        inputData = packet.getInputData() == null ? Set.of() : Set.copyOf(new HashSet<>(packet.getInputData()));
        inputMode = packet.getInputMode();
        previousInteractionModel = interactionModel;
        interactionModel = packet.getInputInteractionModel();
        playMode = packet.getPlayMode();
        predictedVehicle = packet.getPredictedVehicle();
        input = ProtocolInputMath.normalize(rawMoveVector, rawInputMotion, doingInventoryAction);
        if (rawInputPosition != null) {
            captureInputPosition(packet, inputYOffset);
        }
        if(predictionInputProcessing)predictionInputHandler.accept(packet);
        inputData=Set.copyOf(packet.getInputData());
        if (!predictionInputProcessing) {

            for (PlayerAuthInputData action : packet.getInputData()) {
                switch (action) {
                    case START_SPRINTING -> setPredictionSprintingAction(input.z > 0);
                    case STOP_SPRINTING -> setPredictionSprintingAction(false);
                    case START_SNEAKING -> setPredictionFlag(EntityFlag.SNEAKING, true);
                    case STOP_SNEAKING -> setPredictionFlag(EntityFlag.SNEAKING, false);
                    case START_SWIMMING -> applySwimmingAction(true);
                    case STOP_SWIMMING -> applySwimmingAction(false);
                    case START_CRAWLING -> setPredictionFlag(EntityFlag.CRAWLING, true);
                    case STOP_CRAWLING -> setPredictionFlag(EntityFlag.CRAWLING, false);
                    case START_GLIDING -> setPredictionFlag(EntityFlag.GLIDING, true);
                    case STOP_GLIDING -> setPredictionFlag(EntityFlag.GLIDING, false);
                    case START_FLYING -> setFlying(abilities.contains(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.Ability.MAY_FLY)
                            || abilities.contains(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.Ability.FLYING));
                    case STOP_FLYING -> setFlying(false);
                    default -> { }
                }
            }
            horizontalCollision = inputData.contains(PlayerAuthInputData.HORIZONTAL_COLLISION);
            verticalCollision = inputData.contains(PlayerAuthInputData.VERTICAL_COLLISION);
            updateInputPose();
        }
        predictionSprinting = serverSprinting;
        predictionSwimming = clientSwimming;
        predictionCrawling = clientCrawling;
        if (world != null && fluidState != null) {
            prepareFluidInput(world, fluidState, position);
        }
    }


    public void prepareFluidInput(CompensatedWorld world, ProtocolFluidStateTracker fluidState, Vec3 feet) {
        EntityDimensions inputSize = pose.inputDimensions == null ? dimensions : pose.inputDimensions;
        boolean inputHorizontal = pose.inputDimensions == null ? pose.horizontalPoseApplied : pose.inputHorizontalPoseApplied;
        fluidState.beginInput(world, pose.inputAabb, boundingBox, dimensions, feet, inputSize, inputHorizontal,
                flying(), vehicleData != null, pose.wasSwimming, clientSwimming, pose.wasCrawling,
                inputData.toArray(PlayerAuthInputData[]::new), inputView(rawInputRotation));
        setClientSwimming(fluidState.swimming());
        predictionSwimming = clientSwimming;
        updateInputPose();
    }

    private static Vec3 inputView(WireVec3 rotation) {
        if (rotation == null || !rotation.finite()) return null;
        return ac.navro.anticheat.util.MathUtil.getRotationVector(rotation.x(), rotation.y());
    }

    public void apply(MovePlayerPacket packet) {
        if (packet.getRuntimeEntityId() != runtimeId || packet.getMode() == MovePlayerPacket.Mode.HEAD_ROTATION) return;
        setServerPosition(WireVec3.of(packet.getPosition()));

        lastCorrectionTick = packet.getTick();
    }

        if (packet.getPosition() != null) {
            Vec3 target = new Vec3(packet.getPosition());
            previousPosition = position;
            position = target;
            unvalidatedPosition = target.clone();
            serverPosition = target.clone();
            setBoundingBox(target);
        }
    }

        if (runtimeId >= 0 && packet.getRuntimeEntityId() != runtimeId) return;
        if (packet.getMotion() != null) {
            serverVelocity = new Vec3(packet.getMotion());
            velocity = serverVelocity.clone();
        }
    }

    public void apply(SetEntityDataPacket packet) {
        if (runtimeId >= 0 && packet.getRuntimeEntityId() != runtimeId) return;
        if (vehicleData != null) return;
        queuePoseMetadata(packet.getMetadata(), packet.getTick());
    }

    public void apply(UpdateAttributesPacket packet) {
        if (runtimeId >= 0 && packet.getRuntimeEntityId() != runtimeId) return;
        applyAttributes(packet.getAttributes(), packet.getTick());
    }

    public void apply(MobEffectPacket packet) {
        if (runtimeId >= 0 && packet.getRuntimeEntityId() != runtimeId) return;
        switch (packet.getEvent()) {
            case ADD, MODIFY -> effects.put(packet.getEffectId(),
                    new StatusEffect(packet.getEffectId(), packet.getAmplifier(), packet.getDuration()));
            case REMOVE -> effects.remove(packet.getEffectId());
        }
    }

    public void addEffect(int effectId, int amplifier, int duration) {
        if (!ac.navro.proxy.data.vanilla.NativeStatusEffects.contains(effectId)) return;
        effects.put(effectId, new StatusEffect(effectId, amplifier, duration));
    }

    public void removeEffect(int effectId) {
        effects.remove(effectId);
    }

    public void apply(MovementEffectPacket packet) {
        if (runtimeId >= 0 && packet.getEntityRuntimeId() != runtimeId) return;
        if (packet.getEffectType() == org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.MovementEffectType.GLIDE_BOOST) {
            glideBoostTicks = packet.getDuration()==Integer.MAX_VALUE?1:Math.max(1, packet.getDuration() / 2);
        }
    }

    private void applyMetadata(EntityDataMap update) { applyMetadata(update, -1); }
    private void applyMetadata(EntityDataMap update, long sourceTick) {
        if (update == null) return;
        ac.navro.proxy.util.EntityMetadataUtil.copyProperties(update, metadata);
        var flags = ac.navro.proxy.util.EntityMetadataUtil.copyFlags(update);
        boolean base = ac.navro.proxy.util.EntityMetadataUtil.hasBaseFlags(update);
        boolean extended = ac.navro.proxy.util.EntityMetadataUtil.hasExtendedFlags(update);
        Float width = ac.navro.proxy.util.EntityMetadataUtil.getFloat(update, org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.entity.EntityDataTypes.WIDTH);
        Float height = ac.navro.proxy.util.EntityMetadataUtil.getFloat(update, org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.entity.EntityDataTypes.HEIGHT);
        Float scale = ac.navro.proxy.util.EntityMetadataUtil.getFloat(update, org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.entity.EntityDataTypes.SCALE);


        if (nativeSprintSynchronization && base && sourceTick >= 0 && lastSprintActionTick > sourceTick && flags != null) {
            flags = new HashSet<>(flags);
            if (serverSprinting) flags.add(3); else flags.remove(3);
        }
        if (predictionInputProcessing && movementMetadataContext != null) {
            MovementMetadata.applyClientVisibleMovementMetadata(movementMetadataContext, width, height, scale, flags, base, extended);
        } else {

            var before = snapshotAabb();
            boolean crawlingBefore = ac.navro.proxy.prediction.fluid.FluidMovement.hasCrawlingSizeRequest(this);
            if (flags != null) {
                trackedFlags.restoreFlags(ac.navro.proxy.util.EntityMetadataUtil.mergeFlags(trackedFlags.cloneFlags(), flags, base, extended));
                if (base) { serverSprinting = trackedFlags.has(3); setClientSwimming(trackedFlags.has(57)); }
                ac.navro.proxy.prediction.fluid.FluidMovement.updatePoseForMetadata(this);
            }
            if (width != null) updateWidth(width);
            if (height != null) updateHeight(height);
            if (scale != null) updateScale(scale);
            if (!ac.navro.proxy.prediction.fluid.FluidMovement.finishMetadataPose(this, before, crawlingBefore, width, height, scale, flags != null)) {
                if (height != null && height > 0 || scale != null && scale > 0) ac.navro.proxy.prediction.fluid.FluidMovement.acknowledgeDimensions(this);
                else if (width != null && width > 0) ac.navro.proxy.prediction.fluid.FluidMovement.acknowledgeWidth(this);
            }
        }
        clientCrawling = trackedFlags.has(114);
        spinAttack = trackedFlags.has(56);
        if (nativeSprintSynchronization && base && sourceTick >= lastSprintActionTick && sourceTick >= 0) {
            rememberSprint(sourceTick, serverSprinting);
        }
    }

    public long queuePoseMetadata(EntityDataMap update) {
        return queuePoseMetadata(update, -1);
    }
    public long queuePoseMetadata(EntityDataMap update, long sourceTick) {
        if (update == null || update.isEmpty()) return poseMetadataRevision;
        EntityDataMap copy = ac.navro.proxy.util.EntityMetadataUtil.copy(update);
        long revision = ++poseMetadataRevision;
        pendingPoseMetadata.addLast(new PendingPoseMetadata(revision, copy, sourceTick));
        poseMetadataAwaitingAcknowledgment = true;
        if (worldDiagnostics != null) worldDiagnostics.movementMetadata("movement_metadata_queued", revision, copy, sourceTick);
        return revision;
    }

    public long latestPoseMetadataRevision() {
        return poseMetadataRevision;
    }

    public long acknowledgedPoseMetadataRevision() {
        return acknowledgedPoseMetadataRevision;
    }

    private void applyAttributes(Iterable<AttributeData> values) { applyAttributes(values, -1); }
    private void applyAttributes(Iterable<AttributeData> values, long sourceTick) {
        if (values == null) return;
        for (AttributeData attribute : values) {
            AttributeInstance state = attributes.computeIfAbsent(attribute.getName(), ignored -> new AttributeInstance(attribute.getDefaultValue()));
            if (nativeSprintSynchronization && "minecraft:movement".equals(attribute.getName()) && sourceTick >= 0) {



                float base = attribute.getValue() / (sprintAt(sourceTick) ? 1.3F : 1.0F);
                state.clearModifiers();state.setBaseValue(base);state.setValue(base);
                sprintModifier(state, serverSprinting);
                continue;
            }


            state.clearModifiers();
            state.setBaseValue(attribute.getDefaultValue());
            state.setValue(attribute.getValue());
        }
    }

    private void setServerPosition(WireVec3 value) {
        if (value == null || !value.finite()) return;
        serverPosition = new Vec3(value.x(), value.y(), value.z());
    }

    public void acceptPosition(Vec3 value) {
        previousPosition = position;
        position = value;
        unvalidatedPosition = value.clone();
        setBoundingBox(value);
    }


    public void captureInputPosition(PlayerAuthInputPacket packet, float yOffset) {
        InputPosition observation = InputPosition.capture(packet.getPosition(), yOffset);
        restoreInputObservation(observation, packet.getDelta() == null ? Vec3.ZERO : new Vec3(packet.getDelta()));
    }

    public void restoreInputObservation(InputPosition observation, Vec3 delta) {
        previousUnvalidatedPosition = unvalidatedPosition.clone();
        inputPosition = observation;
        unvalidatedPosition = observation.decoded();
        unvalidatedTickEnd = delta.clone();
    }

    public Vec3 inputPositionResidual(Vec3 physical) {
        return inputPosition == null ? unvalidatedPosition.subtract(physical) : inputPosition.residual(physical);
    }

    public float inputPositionDistance(Vec3 physical) { return inputPositionResidual(physical).length(); }

    public boolean usesVehiclePosition() {
        return predictionInputProcessing ? vehicleData != null : predictedVehicle != 0;
    }

    public Vec3 inputPositionTarget() {
        Vec3 physical = !usesVehiclePosition() && boundingBox.isValid() ? boundingBox.feetCenter() : position;
        return inputPosition == null ? unvalidatedPosition.clone() : inputPosition.physicalTarget(physical);
    }

    public void setResolvedPosition(Vec3 value, Box solved, boolean previous) {
        setResolvedPosition(value, solved, previous, usesVehiclePosition());
    }


    public void setResolvedPosition(Vec3 value, Box solved, boolean previous, boolean trackedVehicle) {
        if (previous) previousPosition = position;
        position = value;
        if (!trackedVehicle) boundingBox = solved.clone();
    }

    public void setResolvedMovement(Box solved, boolean previous) {
        setResolvedPosition(solved.feetCenter(), solved, previous);
    }

    public void rebasePosition(Vec3 value, boolean previous) {
        Box translated = boundingBox.offset(value.subtract(position));
        if (!boundingBox.isValid()) {
            if (previous) previousPosition = position;
            position = value;
            setBoundingBox(value);
        } else setResolvedPosition(value, translated, previous);
    }

    public void acceptInputPosition(Vec3 value, java.util.List<Box> collisions) {
        if (boundingBox.isValid()) {
            if (usesVehiclePosition()) setResolvedPosition(value, boundingBox, false, true);
            else setResolvedMovement(ac.navro.anticheat.collision.AcceptedPositionPhysics.synchronize(boundingBox, value, collisions), false);
        } else {
            position = value;
            setBoundingBox(value);
        }
        collisionPhysics.acceptClientPosition();
    }

    public void acceptObservedInputPosition(java.util.List<Box> collisions) {
        acceptInputPosition(inputPositionTarget(), collisions);
    }


    public void acceptTeleport(Vec3 footPosition, boolean ground) {
        collisionPhysics.reset();
        movementCollisionEntries = java.util.List.of();
        finishInputPose();
        previousPosition = position;
        position = footPosition.clone();
        unvalidatedPosition = footPosition.clone();
        previousUnvalidatedPosition = footPosition.clone();
        inputPosition = null;
        serverPosition = footPosition.clone();
        velocity = Vec3.ZERO.clone();
        afterCollision = Vec3.ZERO.clone();
        serverVelocity = Vec3.ZERO.clone();
        onGround = ground;
        horizontalCollision = false;
        verticalCollision = false;
        collisionPenetratingFrames = 0;
        oneWayCollision = false;
        poseMetadataAwaitingAcknowledgment = !pendingPoseMetadata.isEmpty();
        setBoundingBox(footPosition);
    }

    public void applyDimensions(EntityDimensions value) {
        boolean resized = dimensions.width() != value.width() || dimensions.height() != value.height();
        dimensions = value;
        if (resized || !boundingBox.isValid()) refreshPoseBoundingBox();
    }

    public void refreshPoseBoundingBox() {
        if (usesVehiclePosition()) return;
        float feet = boundingBox.isValid() ? boundingBox.minY : position.y;
        setBoundingBox(new Vec3(position.x, feet, position.z));
    }

    private void setBoundingBox(Vec3 value) {
        boundingBox = dimensions.getBoxAt(value);
        aabbResizeRevision++;
    }

    private void beginPoseInput() { ac.navro.proxy.prediction.fluid.FluidMovement.beginInput(this); }
    public void updateInputPose() { ac.navro.proxy.prediction.fluid.FluidMovement.updatePose(this); }
    public void applySwimmingAction(boolean swimming) { ac.navro.proxy.prediction.fluid.FluidMovement.applySwimmingAction(this, swimming); }
    private void finishInputPose() { ac.navro.proxy.prediction.fluid.FluidMovement.finishInput(this); }

    private void updateWidth(float width) {
        if (Float.isFinite(width) && width > 0) applyDimensions(EntityDimensions.fixed(width, dimensions.height())
                .withEyeHeight(dimensions.eyeHeight()));
    }

    private void updateHeight(float height) {
        if (Float.isFinite(height) && height > 0) applyDimensions(EntityDimensions.fixed(dimensions.width(), height)
                .withEyeHeight(eyeHeightFor(height)));
    }

    private void updateScale(float scale) {
        if (Float.isFinite(scale) && scale > 0) applyDimensions(dimensions.hardScaled(scale));
    }

    private static float eyeHeightFor(float height) {
        if (Math.abs(height - 0.2F) <= 1.0E-3F) return 0.2F;
        if (Math.abs(height - 0.625F) <= 1.0E-3F || Math.abs(height - 0.6F) <= 1.0E-3F) return 0.42F;
        if (Math.abs(height - 1.49F) <= 1.0E-3F || Math.abs(height - 1.65F) <= 1.0E-3F) return 1.26F;
        if (Math.abs(height - 1.5F) <= 1.0E-3F) return 1.27F;
        return 1.62F;
    }

    public void restoreAabb(MovementAabbSnapshot saved, Vec3 target) {
        if (saved == null || target == null) return;
        dimensions = saved.dimensions();
        boundingBox = saved.box().offset(target.subtract(saved.position()));
        position = target.clone();
        aabbResizeRevision = saved.resizeRevision();
    }


    public void prepareReplayAabb(MovementAabbSnapshot start, long precedingResizeRevision) {
        if (start == null) return;
        boolean resized = dimensions.width() != start.dimensions().width()
                || dimensions.height() != start.dimensions().height();
        applyDimensions(start.dimensions());
        if (!resized && start.resizeRevision() != precedingResizeRevision) refreshPoseBoundingBox();
        aabbResizeRevision = start.resizeRevision();
    }


    public void restoreInputPose(WireTickSnapshot frame) {
        if (frame == null) return;
        pose.inputDimensions = frame.inputDimensions();
        pose.inputAabb = frame.inputAabb();
        pose.inputHorizontalPoseApplied = frame.inputHorizontalPoseApplied();
        pose.inputStandingDimensions = frame.inputStandingDimensions();
        pose.inputNonCrawlingHorizontal = frame.inputNonCrawlingHorizontal();
        pose.wasCrawling = frame.inputWasCrawling();
        pose.wasSwimming = frame.inputWasSwimming();
        pose.inputReadyPoseDimensions = frame.inputReadyPoseDimensions();
        pose.inputReadyPoseBeforeMovement = frame.inputReadyPoseBeforeMovement();
        pose.horizontalPoseApplied = pose.inputHorizontalPoseApplied;
        pose.dimensionsBeforeHorizontalPose = pose.inputStandingDimensions;
        pose.inputActive = true;
        pose.pendingPoseDimensions = null;
        pose.readyPoseDimensions = pose.inputReadyPoseDimensions;
        pose.readyPoseBeforeMovement = pose.inputReadyPoseBeforeMovement;
    }


    public void restoreReplayInput(WireTickSnapshot frame, long precedingResizeRevision) {
        tick = frame.tick();
        simulationFrame = frame.simulationFrame();
        clockedInput=null;
        previousTick = frame.previousTick();
        inputMode = frame.inputMode();
        interactionModel = frame.interactionModel();
        previousInteractionModel = frame.previousInteractionModel();
        playMode = frame.playMode();
        rawInputPosition = frame.inputPosition();
        rawInputRotation = frame.inputRotation();
        previousInputRotation = frame.previousInputRotation();
        rawInputDelta = frame.inputDelta();
        inputPosition = frame.observedPosition();
        rawInputMotion = frame.inputMotion();
        rawMoveVector = frame.rawMoveVector();
        cameraOrientation = frame.cameraOrientation();
        interactRotation = frame.interactRotation();
        inputData = frame.inputData();
        predictedVehicle = frame.predictedVehicle();
        doingInventoryAction = frame.doingInventoryAction();
        sneakingAttributeModifier = frame.sneakingAttributeModifier();
        input = frame.input() == null ? Vec3.ZERO.clone() : frame.input();
        previousPosition = position.clone();
        previousUnvalidatedPosition = unvalidatedPosition.clone();
        unvalidatedPosition = frame.unvalidatedPosition();
        unvalidatedTickEnd = frame.unvalidatedTickEnd();
        clientSprinting = frame.clientSprinting();
        serverSprinting = frame.serverSprinting();
        predictionSprinting = frame.predictionSprinting();
        clientSwimming = frame.clientSwimming();
        predictionSwimming = frame.predictionSwimming();
        clientCrawling = frame.clientCrawling();
        predictionCrawling = frame.predictionCrawling();
        spinAttack = frame.spinAttack();
        trackedFlags.restoreFlags(frame.trackedFlags());
        attributes.clear();
        frame.attributes().forEach((name, value) -> attributes.put(name, value.clone()));

        effects.clear();
        frame.effects().forEach((id, value) -> effects.put(id, value.copy()));
        flying = frame.flying();
        wasFlying = frame.wasFlying();
        abilities = frame.abilities();
        glideBoostTicks = frame.glideBoostTicks();
        prepareReplayAabb(frame.inputAabb(), precedingResizeRevision);
        restoreInputPose(frame);
        pose.inputAabb = snapshotAabb();
    }

    public void finishInput() {
        finishInputPose();
    }

    public void acknowledgePoseMetadata(long revision) {
        acknowledgedPoseMetadataRevision = Math.max(acknowledgedPoseMetadataRevision, revision);
        while (!pendingPoseMetadata.isEmpty()
                && pendingPoseMetadata.peekFirst().revision() <= acknowledgedPoseMetadataRevision) {
            var pending = pendingPoseMetadata.removeFirst();
            applyMetadata(pending.metadata(), pending.sourceTick());
            if (worldDiagnostics != null) worldDiagnostics.movementMetadata("movement_metadata_applied", pending.revision(), pending.metadata(), pending.sourceTick());
        }
        poseMetadataAwaitingAcknowledgment = !pendingPoseMetadata.isEmpty();
    }

        final int flight = Math.max(1, nativeFlight);
        final int provisionalMaxLifetime = 10 * (flight + 1) + 11;
        if (expectsNativeRocket) nukkitGlideBoostPending = true;
        glideBoostTicks = Math.max(glideBoostTicks, provisionalMaxLifetime);
    }

                        value.revision(), value.metadata(), value.sourceTick())).toList(), collisionPhysics.snapshot(), movementCollisionEntries, wasFlying, abilities, afterCollision, trackedFlags.cloneFlags(), pose.wasSwimming,
                new SprintSynchronization(lastSprintActionTick, sprintHistory), simulationFrame);

    public void restore(WireTickSnapshot snapshot, ProtocolFluidStateTracker fluidState) {
        if (snapshot == null) return;
        var sprintState = snapshot.sprintSynchronization();
        if (sprintState != null) {
            lastSprintActionTick = sprintState.lastActionTick();
            sprintHistory.clear();sprintHistory.putAll(sprintState.history());
        }
        collisionPhysics.restore(snapshot.collisionState());
        movementCollisionEntries = snapshot.movementCollisionEntries();
        flying = snapshot.flying();
        wasFlying = snapshot.wasFlying();
        abilities = snapshot.abilities();
        tick = snapshot.tick();
        simulationFrame = snapshot.simulationFrame();
        clockedInput=null;
        previousTick = snapshot.previousTick();
        inputMode = snapshot.inputMode();
        interactionModel = snapshot.interactionModel();
        previousInteractionModel = snapshot.previousInteractionModel();
        playMode = snapshot.playMode();
        rawInputPosition = snapshot.inputPosition();
        rawInputRotation = snapshot.inputRotation();
        previousInputRotation = snapshot.previousInputRotation();
        rawInputDelta = snapshot.inputDelta();
        inputPosition = snapshot.observedPosition();
        rawInputMotion = snapshot.inputMotion();
        rawMoveVector = snapshot.rawMoveVector();
        cameraOrientation = snapshot.cameraOrientation();
        interactRotation = snapshot.interactRotation();
        inputData = snapshot.inputData();
        predictedVehicle = snapshot.predictedVehicle();
        doingInventoryAction = snapshot.doingInventoryAction();
        sneakingAttributeModifier = snapshot.sneakingAttributeModifier();
        input = snapshot.input() == null ? Vec3.ZERO : snapshot.input().clone();
        position = snapshot.position() == null ? Vec3.ZERO : snapshot.position().clone();
        previousPosition = snapshot.previousPosition() == null ? Vec3.ZERO : snapshot.previousPosition().clone();
        unvalidatedPosition = snapshot.unvalidatedPosition() == null ? Vec3.ZERO : snapshot.unvalidatedPosition().clone();
        previousUnvalidatedPosition = snapshot.previousUnvalidatedPosition() == null ? Vec3.ZERO : snapshot.previousUnvalidatedPosition();
        unvalidatedTickEnd = snapshot.unvalidatedTickEnd() == null ? Vec3.ZERO : snapshot.unvalidatedTickEnd();
        velocity = snapshot.velocity() == null ? Vec3.ZERO : snapshot.velocity().clone();
        afterCollision = snapshot.afterCollision();
        serverPosition = snapshot.serverPosition() == null ? null : snapshot.serverPosition().clone();
        serverVelocity = snapshot.serverVelocity() == null ? null : snapshot.serverVelocity().clone();
        onGround = snapshot.onGround();
        horizontalCollision = snapshot.horizontalCollision();
        verticalCollision = snapshot.verticalCollision();
        clientSprinting = snapshot.clientSprinting();
        serverSprinting = snapshot.serverSprinting();
        predictionSprinting = snapshot.predictionSprinting();
        clientSwimming = snapshot.clientSwimming();
        predictionSwimming = snapshot.predictionSwimming();
        clientCrawling = snapshot.clientCrawling();
        predictionCrawling = snapshot.predictionCrawling();
        spinAttack = snapshot.spinAttack();
        pose.horizontalPoseApplied = snapshot.horizontalPoseApplied();
        pose.dimensionsBeforeHorizontalPose = snapshot.dimensionsBeforeHorizontalPose();
        pose.pendingPoseDimensions = snapshot.pendingPoseDimensions();
        pose.readyPoseDimensions = snapshot.readyPoseDimensions();
        pose.readyPoseBeforeMovement = snapshot.readyPoseBeforeMovement();
        pose.inputDimensions = snapshot.inputDimensions();
        MovementAabbSnapshot savedInputAabb = snapshot.inputAabb();
        pose.inputAabb = savedInputAabb == null ? null : new MovementAabbSnapshot(savedInputAabb.dimensions(),
                savedInputAabb.position(), savedInputAabb.box(), savedInputAabb.resizeRevision());
        pose.inputHorizontalPoseApplied = snapshot.inputHorizontalPoseApplied();
        pose.inputStandingDimensions = snapshot.inputStandingDimensions();
        pose.inputNonCrawlingHorizontal = snapshot.inputNonCrawlingHorizontal();
        pose.inputActive = snapshot.inputPoseActive();
        pose.wasCrawling = snapshot.inputWasCrawling();
        pose.wasSwimming = snapshot.inputWasSwimming();
        pose.inputReadyPoseDimensions = snapshot.inputReadyPoseDimensions();
        pose.inputReadyPoseBeforeMovement = snapshot.inputReadyPoseBeforeMovement();
        poseMetadataAwaitingAcknowledgment = snapshot.poseMetadataAwaitingAcknowledgment();
        poseMetadataRevision = snapshot.poseMetadataRevision();
        acknowledgedPoseMetadataRevision = snapshot.acknowledgedPoseMetadataRevision();
        pendingPoseMetadata.clear();
        for (WireTickSnapshot.PoseMetadata value : snapshot.pendingPoseMetadata()) {
            pendingPoseMetadata.addLast(new PendingPoseMetadata(value.revision(), value.toEntityDataMap(), value.sourceTick()));
        }
        dimensions = snapshot.dimensions();
        boundingBox = snapshot.boundingBox() == null ? Box.EMPTY : snapshot.boundingBox().clone();
        aabbResizeRevision = snapshot.aabbResizeRevision();
        collisionPenetratingFrames = snapshot.collisionPenetratingFrames();
        oneWayCollision = snapshot.oneWayCollision();
        glideBoostTicks = snapshot.glideBoostTicks();
        entityTolerance = snapshot.entityTolerance() == null
                ? new ProtocolEntityTolerance.Tolerance(false, false, 0, 0, 0)
                : snapshot.entityTolerance();
        enforceBoatStep = snapshot.enforceBoatStep();
        attributes.clear();
        snapshot.attributes().forEach((name, value) -> attributes.put(name, value == null ? null : value.clone()));
        effects.clear();
        snapshot.effects().forEach((id, value) -> effects.put(id, value == null ? null : value.copy()));
        metadata.clear();
        metadata.putAll(snapshot.entityMetadata());
        trackedFlags.restoreFlags(snapshot.trackedFlags());
        if (fluidState != null) fluidState.restore(snapshot.fluidState());
    }
```

```java
    private static EntityDataMap copyEntityDataMap(EntityDataMap source) {
        EntityDataMap copy = new EntityDataMap();
        if (source != null) {
            source.forEach((type, value) -> copy.put(type, copyMetadataValue(value)));
        }
        return copy;
    }

    private static Object copyMetadataValue(Object value) {
        if (value instanceof java.util.EnumMap<?, ?> enumMap) return enumMap.clone();
        if (value instanceof byte[] bytes) return bytes.clone();
        if (value instanceof int[] ints) return ints.clone();
        if (value instanceof long[] longs) return longs.clone();
        return value;
    }

    public record PoseMetadata(long revision, Map<EntityDataType<?>, Object> values, long sourceTick) {
        public PoseMetadata(long revision, Map<EntityDataType<?>,Object> values) { this(revision, values, -1); }
        public PoseMetadata {
            if (values == null || values.isEmpty()) {
                values = Map.of();
            } else {
                java.util.Map<EntityDataType<?>, Object> copy = new java.util.HashMap<>();
                values.forEach((type, value) -> copy.put(type, copyMetadataValue(value)));
                values = Map.copyOf(copy);
            }
        }

        @Override public Map<EntityDataType<?>, Object> values() {
            java.util.Map<EntityDataType<?>, Object> copy = new java.util.HashMap<>();
            values.forEach((type, value) -> copy.put(type, copyMetadataValue(value)));
            return Map.copyOf(copy);
        }

        @SuppressWarnings({"rawtypes", "unchecked"})
        public EntityDataMap toEntityDataMap() {
            EntityDataMap map = new EntityDataMap();
            values.forEach((type, value) -> map.put((EntityDataType) type, copyMetadataValue(value)));
            return map;
        }

        public static PoseMetadata from(long revision, EntityDataMap metadata) {
            return from(revision,metadata,-1);
        }
        public static PoseMetadata from(long revision, EntityDataMap metadata, long sourceTick) {
            java.util.Map<EntityDataType<?>, Object> values = new java.util.HashMap<>();
            metadata.forEach(values::put);
            return new PoseMetadata(revision, values, sourceTick);
        }
    }
}
```

```java
public record WireVec2(float x, float y) {
```
