`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/teleport/PredictionRewind.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.teleport;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;
import ac.navro.proxy.SessionState;
import ac.navro.proxy.collision.Collider;
import ac.navro.proxy.collision.ProtocolEntityTolerance;
import ac.navro.proxy.data.input.TickData;
import ac.navro.proxy.diagnostics.WorldCollisionDiagnostics;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.PredictionRunner;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.RiptidePhysics;
import ac.navro.proxy.protocol.BackendType;
import ac.navro.proxy.teleport.data.RewindData;


public final class PredictionRewind {
    private PredictionRewind() { }

    public static void process(SessionState session, RewindData correction) {
        var wire = session.player();
        if (session.teleports().isTeleporting() || wire.vehicleData != null) return;
        long liveTick = wire.tick();
        if (correction.inputTick() >= liveTick) return;
        if (wire.isMovementExempted()) {
            session.authInputPackets().processExemptedMovement();
            return;
        }
        var history = session.teleports().getAuthInputHistory();
        TickData source = history.get(correction.inputTick());
        long distance = liveTick - correction.inputTick();
        if (source == null || distance > session.rewindHistorySize()
                || history.subMap(correction.inputTick(), false, liveTick, false).size() != distance - 1) {
            trace(session, "prediction_rewind_missing_history", correction, 0);
            session.teleports().teleport(correction.getPosition());
            return;
        }

        var prediction = session.authInputPackets();
        var context = prediction.context();
        var liveInput = wire.snapshot(session.fluidState());
        var liveItemUse = prediction.itemUse().getItemUseTracker().snapshot();
        var liveRiptide = RiptidePhysics.snapshot(context);

        prediction.velocityPackets().consumeBdsCorrectedExternalMotion(
                correction.externalMotionSequence(), correction.tick());
        restoreBaseline(session, correction, source);
        long precedingResize = wire.aabbResizeRevision();
        int replayed = 0;
        try {
            for (long tick = correction.inputTick() + 1; tick < liveTick; tick++) {
                var input = history.get(tick);
                wire.restoreReplayInput(input.state(), precedingResize);
                prediction.itemUse().getItemUseTracker().restore(input.itemUseSnapshot());
                RiptidePhysics.restore(context, input.riptideStartState());
                context.begin();


                new PredictionRunner(context).run(tick, input.state().collisionState());
                context.syncWire();
                acceptHistoricalPrediction(session, tick);
                wire.completePredictionInput();
                precedingResize = input.endAabb() == null
                        ? wire.aabbResizeRevision() : input.endAabb().resizeRevision();
                replayed++;
            }
        } finally {


            wire.restoreReplayInput(liveInput, precedingResize);
            prediction.itemUse().getItemUseTracker().restore(liveItemUse);
            RiptidePhysics.restore(context, liveRiptide);
        }
        if (session.backendType() == BackendType.BDS) session.teleports().startCorrectionCooldown();

        trace(session, "prediction_rewind_applied", correction, replayed);
    }

    private static void restoreBaseline(SessionState session, RewindData correction, TickData source) {
        var wire = session.player();
        var context = session.authInputPackets().context();
        wire.collisionPhysics.restore(source.state().collisionState());
        wire.setCollisionPenetratingFrames(source.state().collisionPenetratingFrames());
        session.fluidState().restore(source.state().fluidState());
        context.fallDistance = source.fallDistance();
        context.fluidPrediction.swimSpeedMultiplier = source.swimSpeedMultiplier();
        context.fluidPrediction.waterDrag = source.waterDrag();
        context.bounceGravityCorrection = null;
        RiptidePhysics.restore(context, source.riptideEndState());
        float sourceOffset = source.state().observedPosition() == null
                ? session.playerYOffset() : source.state().observedPosition().yOffset();
        correction.restoreAabb(wire, source.endAabb(), sourceOffset);
        wire.setVelocity(correction.tickEnd());
        wire.setCollisionResult(false, false, correction.isOnGround());
        wire.resetCorrectionObservation();
        session.cacheRewindBaseline(correction.inputTick(), correction.yOffset(sourceOffset),source.state().simulationFrame());
    }

    private static void acceptHistoricalPrediction(SessionState session, long tick) {
        var wire = session.player();
        var context = session.authInputPackets().context();
        var tolerance = session.sampleEntityTolerance().tolerance();
        if (tolerance.collided() && !context.collisionPhysics.pushedByBlock()) {
            Vec3 target = ProtocolEntityTolerance.clampAccepted(
                    context.position, context.unvalidatedPosition, tolerance);
            Vec3 motion = ProtocolEntityTolerance.clampAccepted(
                    context.velocity, context.unvalidatedTickEnd, tolerance);
            wire.rebasePosition(target, false);
            wire.setVelocity(motion);
            wire.collisionPhysics.acceptClientPosition();
            session.cacheRewindBaseline(tick, session.playerYOffset());
        } else if (!tolerance.collided()) {
            if (context.velocity.distanceTo(context.unvalidatedTickEnd) < context.maxOffset)
                wire.setVelocity(context.unvalidatedTickEnd);
            if (wire.inputPositionDistance(wire.position()) < context.maxOffset)
                Collider.acceptInputPosition(wire, session.collisionWorld(), wire.inputPositionTarget());
        }
        if (wire.inputPositionDistance(wire.position()) > context.maxOffset) wire.resetCorrectionObservation();
    }

    private static void trace(SessionState session, String event, RewindData correction, int replayed) {
        var diagnostics = session.player().worldDiagnostics();
        if (diagnostics != null) diagnostics.event(event, WorldCollisionDiagnostics.fields(
                "sourceTick", correction.tick(), "replayedInputs", replayed,
                "backendType", session.backendType().name(),
                "includedMotionSequence", correction.externalMotionSequence(),
                "position", session.player().position().toVector3f(),
                "velocity", session.player().velocity().toVector3f()));
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/teleport/ProtocolTeleportMotion.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.teleport;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.BdsTrigMath;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.MathUtil;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;


public record ProtocolTeleportMotion(long inputTick, float x, float y, float z,
                                     boolean generatedHorizontalImpulse) {
    public static ProtocolTeleportMotion fromConfirmation(long confirmationTick, Vec3 delta,
                                                          Vec3 expectedHorizontalImpulse) {
        if (delta == null || !Float.isFinite(delta.x) || !Float.isFinite(delta.y)
                || !Float.isFinite(delta.z) || delta.x == 0 && delta.y == 0 && delta.z == 0) return null;
        boolean generated = expectedHorizontalImpulse != null
                && Float.isFinite(expectedHorizontalImpulse.x) && Float.isFinite(expectedHorizontalImpulse.z)
                && (expectedHorizontalImpulse.x != 0 || expectedHorizontalImpulse.z != 0)
                && delta.x == expectedHorizontalImpulse.x && delta.z == expectedHorizontalImpulse.z;
        return new ProtocolTeleportMotion(confirmationTick + 1, delta.x, delta.y, delta.z, generated);
    }

    public List<Vec3> velocitiesForTick(long tick) {
        if (tick != inputTick) return List.of();
        List<Vec3> result = new ArrayList<>(2);
        if (y != 0) result.add(new Vec3(0, y, 0));
        if (generatedHorizontalImpulse) result.add(new Vec3(x, y, z));
        return List.copyOf(result);
    }

    public static Vec3 sprintJumpImpulse(float yaw) {
        float radians = yaw * MathUtil.DEGREE_TO_RAD;
        return new Vec3(-BdsTrigMath.sin(radians) * 0.2F, 0,
                BdsTrigMath.cos(radians) * 0.2F);
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/teleport/TeleportSender.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.teleport;

import ac.navro.proxy.SessionState;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.BedrockServerSession;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.MovePlayerPacket;
import java.util.function.BooleanSupplier;


public final class TeleportSender {
    private final BedrockServerSession client;
    private final SessionState state;
    private final BooleanSupplier available;
    public TeleportSender(BedrockServerSession client,SessionState state,BooleanSupplier available){
        this.client=client;this.state=state;this.available=available;
    }
    public void teleportToLastValid(){
        var loop=client.getPeer().getChannel().eventLoop();
        Runnable action=()->{if(ready())state.teleports().teleport(state.teleports().getLastKnowValid());};
        if(loop.inEventLoop())action.run();else loop.execute(action);
    }
    private boolean ready(){return available.getAsBoolean()&&client.isConnected()&&client.getPeer().isConnected()
            &&state.player().getEntityBatchEncoder()!=null;}
    public boolean sendMotion(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.SetEntityMotionPacket packet){
        if(!ready())return false;
        client.sendPacket(packet);return true;
    }
    public boolean send(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.CorrectPlayerMovePredictionPacket packet) {
        if(!ready())return false;
        var encoder=state.player().getEntityBatchEncoder();
        var acknowledgment=state.onProxyPredictionCorrection(packet);
        try { client.sendPacket(packet);return true; }
        catch(RuntimeException|Error e){
            encoder.discard(packet);
            if(state.teleports().removePendingCorrection(acknowledgment))state.teleports().finishCorrectionCooldown();
            throw e;
        }
    }
    public boolean send(MovePlayerPacket packet){
        if(!ready())return false;
        var encoder=state.player().getEntityBatchEncoder();
        var data=state.onProxyTeleport(packet);
        try { client.sendPacket(packet);return true; }
        catch(RuntimeException|Error e){encoder.discard(packet);if(data!=null)state.teleports().getQueuedTeleports().remove(data);throw e;}
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/teleport/TeleportUtil.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.teleport;

import ac.navro.proxy.ack.types.MovementCorrectionAck;
import ac.navro.proxy.ack.types.TeleportAcceptAck;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;
import ac.navro.proxy.teleport.data.TeleportData;
import ac.navro.proxy.teleport.data.CorrectionResetData;
import ac.navro.proxy.teleport.data.RewindData;
import ac.navro.proxy.teleport.data.RewindHistory;
import ac.navro.proxy.compensated.world.base.CompensatedWorld;
import org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector3f;
import org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector3i;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.MovePlayerPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.CorrectPlayerMovePredictionPacket;
import java.util.function.Function;
import java.util.Queue;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentLinkedQueue;
import java.util.function.Consumer;

public final class TeleportUtil {
    private static final int MIN_CHUNK_AGE_FOR_BLOCK_SYNC = 200;
    public interface Context {
        long runtimeEntityId();
        Vec3 rotation();
        boolean sendPacket(MovePlayerPacket packet);
        void movementEvent(String name,Object... values);
        void swimStage(String name,Object... values);
        void itemUseStage(String name,Object... values);
    }
    private final Context player;
    private volatile Vec3 lastKnowValid=Vec3.ZERO;
    private final Queue<TeleportData> queuedTeleports=new ConcurrentLinkedQueue<>();
    private MovementCorrectionAck pendingCorrection;
    private boolean correctionCooldown;
    private Vec3 interpolationTarget;
    private int interpolationTicks;
    public TeleportUtil(Context player){this.player=player;}
    public Vec3 getLastKnowValid(){return lastKnowValid;}
    public void setLastKnowValid(Vec3 value){lastKnowValid=value;}
    public Queue<TeleportData> getQueuedTeleports(){return queuedTeleports;}
    public boolean isTeleporting(){return !queuedTeleports.isEmpty() || interpolationTicks > 0;}
    public boolean hasPendingCorrection() { return pendingCorrection != null; }
    public boolean isCorrectionCooldown() { return correctionCooldown; }
    public boolean canAcceptClientMovement() {
        return !isTeleporting() && !hasPendingCorrection() && !isCorrectionCooldown();
    }
    public MovementCorrectionAck addPendingCorrection(long tick) {
        if (hasPendingCorrection()) throw new IllegalStateException("Movement correction already pending");
        pendingCorrection = new MovementCorrectionAck(tick);
        startCorrectionCooldown();
        return pendingCorrection;
    }
    public void startCorrectionCooldown() { correctionCooldown = true; }
    public boolean removePendingCorrection(MovementCorrectionAck acknowledgment) {
        if (pendingCorrection != acknowledgment) return false;
        pendingCorrection = null;
        return true;
    }
    public void finishCorrectionCooldown() {
        if (!hasPendingCorrection()) correctionCooldown = false;
    }
    public void resetCorrection() {
        pendingCorrection = null;
        correctionCooldown = false;
    }
    public boolean isHardTeleporting(){return queuedTeleports.stream().anyMatch(CorrectionResetData.class::isInstance);}
    public boolean hasPendingBackendRewind(){return queuedTeleports.stream().anyMatch(RewindData.class::isInstance);}
    public void supersedeHardCorrection(TeleportData backendMove) {
        if (!backendMove.isAccepted() || !queuedTeleports.contains(backendMove)) return;
        for (var queued : queuedTeleports) {
            if (queued == backendMove) return;
            if (queued instanceof CorrectionResetData reset && queuedTeleports.remove(reset)) {
                if (backendMove instanceof RewindData rewind) {
                    player.movementEvent("hard_correction_superseded", "sourceTick", reset.sourceTick(),
                            "backendRewindTick", rewind.tick());
                } else {
                    player.movementEvent("hard_correction_superseded", "sourceTick", reset.sourceTick(),
                            "backendTeleportTarget", backendMove.getPosition().toVector3f());
                }
            }
        }
    }
    public Vec3 pendingTeleportPosition() {
        Vec3 target = null;
        for (var data : queuedTeleports) {
            if (!(data instanceof CorrectionResetData) && !(data instanceof RewindData) && !data.isAccepted())
                target = data.getPosition();
        }
        return target;
    }
    public void startInterpolation(Vec3 target) {
        interpolationTarget = target.clone();
        interpolationTicks = 3;
    }
    public void clearInterpolation() {
        interpolationTarget = null;
        interpolationTicks = 0;
    }
    public Vec3 stepInterpolation(Vec3 origin) {
        if (interpolationTicks == 0) return null;
        if (interpolationTicks == 1) {
            Vec3 target = interpolationTarget;
            clearInterpolation();
            return target;
        }
        float steps = interpolationTicks--;
        return origin.add(interpolationTarget.subtract(origin).multiply(1F / steps));
    }
    private final java.util.NavigableMap<Long, ac.navro.proxy.data.input.TickData> authInputHistory =
            new java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentSkipListMap<>();
    public java.util.NavigableMap<Long, ac.navro.proxy.data.input.TickData> getAuthInputHistory(){return authInputHistory;}
    public void pollAuthInputHistory(int capacity){while(authInputHistory.size()>capacity)authInputHistory.pollFirstEntry();}
    public void teleport(final Vec3 vec3){
        if(this.isTeleporting())return;
        var packet = positionPacket(vec3, false);
        player.movementEvent("anticheatTeleportRequested","wireTarget",vec3.toVector3f(),"mode",packet.getMode().ordinal());
        player.swimStage("CORRECTION","wireTarget",new float[]{vec3.x,vec3.y,vec3.z},"mode",packet.getMode().ordinal(),"onGround",false);
        player.itemUseStage("CORRECTION","wireTarget",new float[]{vec3.x,vec3.y,vec3.z},"mode",packet.getMode().ordinal(),"onGround",false);
        player.sendPacket(packet);
    }
    public void correct(RewindHistory frame, boolean vehicle,
                        Function<CorrectPlayerMovePredictionPacket, Boolean> send) {
        if (isTeleporting() || hasPendingCorrection()) return;
        var packet = frame.createPacket(vehicle);
        if (!vehicle) packet.setPosition(frame.position().up(0.001F).toVector3f());
        send.apply(packet);
    }
    public void syncBlocks(CompensatedWorld world, Vec3 feet, long tick, Consumer<Vector3i> sync) {
        int minX = (int) Math.floor(feet.x - .05F), maxX = (int) Math.ceil(feet.x + .05F);
        int minY = (int) Math.floor(feet.y - .05F), maxY = (int) Math.ceil(feet.y + .05F);
        int minZ = (int) Math.floor(feet.z - .05F), maxZ = (int) Math.ceil(feet.z + .05F);
        for (int chunkX = minX >> 4; chunkX <= maxX >> 4; chunkX++) {
            for (int chunkZ = minZ >> 4; chunkZ <= maxZ >> 4; chunkZ++) {
                var chunk = world.getChunk(chunkX, chunkZ);
                if (chunk == null || chunk.loadedTick() < 0 || tick - chunk.loadedTick() < MIN_CHUNK_AGE_FOR_BLOCK_SYNC)
                    return;
            }
        }
        for (int blockX = minX; blockX <= maxX; blockX++) {
            for (int blockY = minY; blockY <= maxY; blockY++) {
                for (int blockZ = minZ; blockZ <= maxZ; blockZ++) sync.accept(Vector3i.from(blockX, blockY, blockZ));
            }
        }
    }
    public MovePlayerPacket hardCorrectionPacket(CorrectionResetData reset) {
        return positionPacket(reset.getPosition(), reset.isOnGround());
    }
    private MovePlayerPacket positionPacket(Vec3 position, boolean onGround){
        final MovePlayerPacket packet=new MovePlayerPacket();
        packet.setRuntimeEntityId(player.runtimeEntityId());
        packet.setPosition(position.toVector3f());
        Vec3 rotation=player.rotation();
        packet.setRotation(Vector3f.from(rotation.x,rotation.y,rotation.z));
        packet.setOnGround(onGround);packet.setMode(MovePlayerPacket.Mode.TELEPORT);
        packet.setTeleportationCause(MovePlayerPacket.TeleportationCause.BEHAVIOR);
        return packet;
    }
    public void queue(final TeleportData data,final Consumer<Runnable> sendAcknowledgment){
        queuedTeleports.add(data);
        if(player!=null)player.movementEvent("teleportQueued","id",Integer.toHexString(System.identityHashCode(data)),
                "type",data.getClass().getSimpleName(),"target",data.getPosition().toVector3f(),"mode",data.getMode(),"ground",data.isOnGround());
        var acknowledgment = new TeleportAcceptAck(data);
        sendAcknowledgment.accept(()->{
            if (!queuedTeleports.contains(acknowledgment.data())) return;
            acknowledgment.data().accept();
            if(player!=null)player.movementEvent("teleportLatencyAccepted","id",Integer.toHexString(System.identityHashCode(data)));
        });
    }

    public void drainReadyTeleports(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.PlayerAuthInputPacket input,Consumer<TeleportData> process){
        drainReadyTeleports(input, true, process);
    }
    public void drainReadyTeleports(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.PlayerAuthInputPacket input,boolean onFoot,Consumer<TeleportData> process){
        drainReadyTeleports(input,onFoot,input.getTick(),process);
    }
    public void drainReadyTeleports(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.PlayerAuthInputPacket input,boolean onFoot,long inputTick,Consumer<TeleportData> process){
        TeleportData data;
        while((data=queuedTeleports.peek())!=null && (data instanceof CorrectionResetData reset ? reset.confirmedBy(input)
                : data.isAccepted() && (data instanceof RewindData rewind ? rewind.inputTick() < inputTick : onFoot))){
            queuedTeleports.poll();process.accept(data);
        }
    }

    public void drainAcceptedTeleports(Consumer<TeleportData> process){
        TeleportData data;
        while((data=queuedTeleports.peek())!=null&&data.isAccepted()){
            queuedTeleports.poll();process.accept(data);
        }
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/teleport/data/CorrectionResetData.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.teleport.data;

import ac.navro.anticheat.data.input.InputPosition;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.PlayerAuthInputPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData;


public final class CorrectionResetData extends TeleportData {
    private final long sourceTick;
    private final float yOffset;
    private final Vec3 physicalTarget;
    private final Vec3 setbackVelocity;
    private volatile boolean motionSent;
    private long externalMotionSequence = -1;
    private ac.navro.proxy.prediction.engine.data.Vector includedExternalImpulse;

    public void bindExternalMotion(long sequence, ac.navro.proxy.prediction.engine.data.Vector impulse) {
        externalMotionSequence = sequence;
        includedExternalImpulse = impulse;
    }

    public long externalMotionSequence() { return externalMotionSequence; }
    public ac.navro.proxy.prediction.engine.data.Vector includedExternalImpulse() { return includedExternalImpulse; }

    public CorrectionResetData(final RewindHistory source) {
        this(source, null);
    }

    public Vec3 setbackVelocity() { return setbackVelocity == null ? null : setbackVelocity.clone(); }

    public void motionSent() { motionSent = true; }

    public Vec3 deliveredVelocity() { return motionSent ? setbackVelocity() : null; }

    public CorrectionResetData(final RewindHistory source, final Vec3 velocity) {
        super(source.position(), source.onGround());
        setbackVelocity = velocity == null || !Float.isFinite(velocity.x) || !Float.isFinite(velocity.y)
                || !Float.isFinite(velocity.z) || velocity.lengthSquared() == 0 ? null : velocity.clone();
        sourceTick = source.tick();
        yOffset = source.yOffset();


        physicalTarget = source.position().down(yOffset);
    }

    public long sourceTick() { return sourceTick; }
    public Vec3 nativeTargetFoot() { return physicalTarget.clone(); }

    public boolean confirmedBy(final PlayerAuthInputPacket packet) {
        return packet.getTick() >= 0 && matchesConfirmation(new Vec3(packet.getPosition()),
                packet.getInputData().contains(PlayerAuthInputData.HANDLE_TELEPORT));
    }


    public Vec3 confirmedFoot(final PlayerAuthInputPacket packet) {
        if (!confirmedBy(packet)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Correction target has not been confirmed");
        return InputPosition.capture(packet.getPosition(), yOffset).physicalTarget(physicalTarget);
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/teleport/data/RewindData.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.teleport.data;

import ac.navro.anticheat.data.MovementAabbSnapshot;
import ac.navro.anticheat.data.input.InputPosition;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;
import ac.navro.proxy.state.WirePlayerState;


public final class RewindData extends TeleportData {
    private final long tick;
    private long inputTick;
    private final Vec3 tickEnd;
    private final RewindHistory frame;
    private final float fallbackOffset;
    private final long externalMotionSequence;

    public RewindData(long tick, Vec3 position, Vec3 tickEnd, boolean ground,
                      RewindHistory frame, float fallbackOffset) {
        this(tick, position, tickEnd, ground, frame, fallbackOffset, -1);
    }

    public RewindData(long tick, Vec3 position, Vec3 tickEnd, boolean ground,
                      RewindHistory frame, float fallbackOffset, long externalMotionSequence) {
        this(tick,position,tickEnd,ground,frame,fallbackOffset,externalMotionSequence,tick);
    }
    public RewindData(long tick, Vec3 position, Vec3 tickEnd, boolean ground,
                      RewindHistory frame, float fallbackOffset, long externalMotionSequence,long inputTick) {
        super(position, ground);
        this.inputTick=inputTick;
        this.externalMotionSequence = externalMotionSequence;
        this.tick = tick;
        this.tickEnd = tickEnd.clone();
        this.frame = frame != null && frame.simulationFrame() == tick && frame.matches(position, tickEnd, ground) ? frame : null;
        this.fallbackOffset = fallbackOffset;
    }
    @Override public boolean isHard() { return false; }
    public long tick() { return tick; }
    public long inputTick() { return inputTick; }
    public void observeInputFrame(long internalTick,long clientFrame) {
        if(inputTick<0 && clientFrame==tick)inputTick=internalTick;
    }
    public Vec3 tickEnd() { return tickEnd.clone(); }
    public long externalMotionSequence() { return externalMotionSequence; }
    public float yOffset() { return yOffset(fallbackOffset); }
    public float yOffset(float fallback) { return frame == null ? fallback : frame.yOffset(); }
    public void restoreAabb(WirePlayerState player, MovementAabbSnapshot history) {
        restoreAabb(player, history, fallbackOffset);
    }
    public void restoreAabb(WirePlayerState player, MovementAabbSnapshot history, float sourceOffset) {
        if (frame != null && frame.aabb() != null) {
            player.restoreAabb(frame.aabb(), frame.aabb().position());
        } else {
            var observation = InputPosition.capture(getPosition().toVector3f(), yOffset(sourceOffset));
            if (history == null) player.rebasePosition(observation.decoded(), false);
            else player.restoreAabb(history, observation.physicalTarget(history.box().feetCenter()));
        }
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/teleport/data/RewindHistory.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.teleport.data;

import ac.navro.proxy.data.input.PredictionData;
import ac.navro.anticheat.data.MovementAabbSnapshot;
import ac.navro.proxy.prediction.live.PredictionContext;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;
import org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector2f;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.CorrectPlayerMovePredictionPacket;


public record RewindHistory(long tick, Vec3 position, PredictionData data,
                            MovementAabbSnapshot aabb, float yOffset, boolean onGround,long simulationFrame) {
    public RewindHistory {
        position = position.clone();
        data = copy(data);
    }

    public RewindHistory(long tick, Vec3 position, PredictionData data) {
        this(tick, position, data, null, 0, data.before().y != data.after().y && data.before().y < 0,tick);
    }
    public RewindHistory(long tick,Vec3 position,PredictionData data,MovementAabbSnapshot aabb,float yOffset,boolean onGround) {
        this(tick,position,data,aabb,yOffset,onGround,tick);
    }

    private static PredictionData copy(PredictionData value) {
        return new PredictionData(value.before().clone(), value.after().clone(), value.tickEnd().clone());
    }

    @Override public Vec3 position() { return position.clone(); }
    @Override public PredictionData data() { return copy(data); }

    public static RewindHistory capture(final PredictionContext player, final long tick, final float yOffset) {
        return capture(player, tick, yOffset, player.predictionResult);
    }

    public static RewindHistory capture(final PredictionContext player, final long tick, final float yOffset,
                                        final PredictionData data) {
        final boolean physicalActor = player.vehicleData == null && player.boundingBox.isValid();
        final Vec3 physical = physicalActor ? player.boundingBox.feetCenter() : player.position.clone();
        final MovementAabbSnapshot aabb = physicalActor ? new MovementAabbSnapshot(player.dimensions,
                physical, player.boundingBox, player.aabbResizeRevision()) : null;
        return new RewindHistory(tick, physical.up(yOffset), data, aabb, yOffset, player.onGround,player.wire.simulationFrame());
    }

    public boolean matches(final Vec3 wirePosition, final Vec3 delta, final boolean ground) {
        return same(position, wirePosition) && same(data.tickEnd(), delta) && onGround == ground;
    }

    private static boolean same(final Vec3 first, final Vec3 second) {
        return first.x == second.x && first.y == second.y && first.z == second.z;
    }

    public CorrectPlayerMovePredictionPacket createPacket(final boolean vehicle) {
        final CorrectPlayerMovePredictionPacket packet = new CorrectPlayerMovePredictionPacket();
        packet.setPosition(position.toVector3f());
        packet.setDelta(data.tickEnd().toVector3f());
        packet.setOnGround(onGround);
        packet.setTick(simulationFrame);
        packet.setVehicleRotation(Vector2f.ZERO);
        packet.setPredictionType(vehicle ? org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PredictionType.VEHICLE
                : org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PredictionType.PLAYER);
        return packet;
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/teleport/data/TeleportData.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.teleport.data;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;



public class TeleportData {
    private final Vec3 position;
    private final boolean onGround;
    private final int mode;
    private boolean accepted;

    public TeleportData(final Vec3 position) {
        this(position, false);
    }

    public TeleportData(final Vec3 position, final boolean onGround) {
        this(position, onGround, 2);
    }

    public TeleportData(final Vec3 position, final boolean onGround, final int mode) {
        this.position = position.clone();
        this.onGround = onGround;
        this.mode = mode;
    }

    public Vec3 getPosition() { return position; }
    public boolean isOnGround() { return onGround; }
    public int getMode() { return mode; }
    public boolean isAccepted() { return accepted; }
    public boolean isHard() { return true; }

    public void accept() {
        this.accepted = true;
    }


    public boolean matchesConfirmation(final Vec3 clientNetworkPosition, final boolean handled) {
        if (mode == 1) {
            final double dx = (double) clientNetworkPosition.x - position.x;
            final double dy = (double) clientNetworkPosition.y - position.y;
            final double dz = (double) clientNetworkPosition.z - position.z;
            return Double.isFinite(dx) && Double.isFinite(dy) && Double.isFinite(dz)
                    && dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz <= 0.1D;
        }
        final float distance = position.distanceTo(clientNetworkPosition);
        return handled && Float.isFinite(distance) && distance <= 1.0E-3F;
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/util/EntityBatchEncoder.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.util;

import io.netty.buffer.ByteBuf;
import io.netty.channel.Channel;
import io.netty.channel.ChannelHandlerContext;
import io.netty.channel.ChannelOutboundHandlerAdapter;
import io.netty.channel.ChannelPromise;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.BedrockSession;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.netty.BedrockBatchWrapper;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.netty.BedrockPacketWrapper;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.netty.codec.compression.CompressionCodec;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.BedrockPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.NetworkStackLatencyPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.common.util.VarInts;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.IdentityHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong;


public final class EntityBatchEncoder extends ChannelOutboundHandlerAdapter implements AutoCloseable {
    private static final AtomicLong LATENCY_ID_COUNTER = new AtomicLong();
    private final BedrockSession session;
    private final LatencyUtil latency;
    private final Map<BedrockPacket, List<Runnable>> staged = new IdentityHashMap<>();
    private final Map<BedrockBatchWrapper, List<Marker>> prepared = new IdentityHashMap<>();
    private final List<Runnable> pending = new ArrayList<>();
    private final Set<Long> ownMarkers = new HashSet<>();
    private boolean closed;
    private boolean flushScheduled;

    private EntityBatchEncoder(BedrockSession session, LatencyUtil latency) {
        this.session = session;
        this.latency = latency;
    }

    public static EntityBatchEncoder install(BedrockSession session, LatencyUtil latency) {
        Channel channel = session.getPeer().getChannel();
        if (!channel.eventLoop().inEventLoop()) throw new IllegalStateException("Install on the session event loop");
        EntityBatchEncoder encoder = new EntityBatchEncoder(session, latency);
        channel.pipeline().addBefore(CompressionCodec.NAME, "navro-ack-publish", encoder.new Publisher());
        channel.pipeline().addAfter(CompressionCodec.NAME, "navro-ack-batch", encoder);
        return encoder;
    }

    public synchronized void track(BedrockPacket packet, Runnable task) {
        if (closed) throw new IllegalStateException("Batch ACK transport closed");
        staged.computeIfAbsent(packet, ignored -> new ArrayList<>()).add(task);
    }

    public synchronized void discard(BedrockPacket packet) { staged.remove(packet); }

    public synchronized void markPending(Runnable task) {
        if (closed) return;
        pending.add(task);
        if (!flushScheduled) {
            flushScheduled = true;
            session.getPeer().getChannel().eventLoop().execute(() -> {
                synchronized (EntityBatchEncoder.this) {
                    flushScheduled = false;
                    if (closed || pending.isEmpty()) return;
                }
                keepalive();
            });
        }
    }

    public synchronized boolean hasPending() {
        return !staged.isEmpty() || !pending.isEmpty() || !prepared.isEmpty();
    }

    public void keepalive() {
        synchronized (this) {
            if (closed) return;
            long id = nextLatencyId();
            ownMarkers.add(id);
            NetworkStackLatencyPacket marker = new NetworkStackLatencyPacket();
            marker.setTimestamp(id);
            marker.setFromServer(true);

            session.sendPacket(marker);
        }
    }

    private static long nextLatencyId() {
        return Math.floorMod(LATENCY_ID_COUNTER.getAndIncrement(), 999_999_999L) + 1L;
    }

    @Override public synchronized void write(ChannelHandlerContext ctx, Object msg, ChannelPromise promise) throws Exception {
        if (closed || !(msg instanceof BedrockBatchWrapper batch)) {
            ctx.write(msg, promise);
            return;
        }
        List<Marker> wireMarkers = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Runnable> tasks = new ArrayList<>();
        boolean gameData = false;
        for (BedrockPacketWrapper wrapper : batch.getPackets()) {
            BedrockPacket packet = wrapper.getPacket();
            List<Runnable> attached = staged.get(packet);
            if (attached != null) tasks.addAll(attached);
            if (packet instanceof NetworkStackLatencyPacket marker) {
                long id = marker.getTimestamp();
                wireMarkers.add(new Marker(id, ownMarkers.contains(id), null));
            } else gameData = true;
        }
        tasks.addAll(pending);
        if (gameData || !tasks.isEmpty()) {
            long id = nextLatencyId();
            NetworkStackLatencyPacket marker = new NetworkStackLatencyPacket();
            marker.setTimestamp(id);
            marker.setFromServer(true);
            ByteBuf frame = ctx.alloc().buffer();
            ByteBuf augmented = null;
            try {
                int packetId = session.getCodec().getPacketDefinition(NetworkStackLatencyPacket.class).getId();
                VarInts.writeUnsignedInt(frame, packetId);
                session.getCodec().tryEncode(session.getPeer().getCodecHelper(), frame, marker);
                ByteBuf raw = batch.getUncompressed();
                augmented = ctx.alloc().buffer(raw.readableBytes() + 5 + frame.readableBytes());
                augmented.writeBytes(raw, raw.readerIndex(), raw.readableBytes());
                VarInts.writeUnsignedInt(augmented, frame.readableBytes());
                augmented.writeBytes(frame, frame.readerIndex(), frame.readableBytes());
                batch.setUncompressed(augmented);
                augmented = null;
                batch.modify();
                List<Runnable> snapshot = List.copyOf(tasks);
                wireMarkers.add(new Marker(id, true, () -> {
                    for (Runnable task : snapshot) {
                        if (closed) return;
                        try { task.run(); } catch (Throwable ignored) { }
                    }
                }));
            } finally {
                frame.release();
                if (augmented != null) augmented.release();
            }
        }
        prepared.put(batch, wireMarkers);
        ChannelPromise completion = promise.unvoid();
        completion.addListener(future -> {
            if (!future.isSuccess()) {
                synchronized (EntityBatchEncoder.this) { prepared.remove(batch); }
            }
        });
        ctx.write(msg, completion);
    }

    private final class Publisher extends ChannelOutboundHandlerAdapter {
        @Override public void write(ChannelHandlerContext ctx, Object msg, ChannelPromise promise) {
            synchronized (EntityBatchEncoder.this) {
                if (msg instanceof BedrockBatchWrapper batch) {
                    List<Marker> markers = prepared.remove(batch);
                    if (markers != null) {

                        for (BedrockPacketWrapper packet : batch.getPackets()) staged.remove(packet.getPacket());
                        pending.clear();
                        for (Marker marker : markers) {
                            ownMarkers.remove(marker.id());
                            latency.queue(marker.id(), marker.ours(), marker.task());
                        }
                    }
                }
                ctx.write(msg, promise);
            }
        }
    }

    @Override public synchronized void close() {
        closed = true;
        staged.clear();
        prepared.clear();
        pending.clear();
        ownMarkers.clear();
        latency.close();
    }

    private record Marker(long id, boolean ours, Runnable task) { }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/util/EntityMetadataUtil.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.util;

import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.entity.EntityDataMap;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.entity.EntityDataType;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.EnumMap;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.entity.EntityFlag;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.entity.EntityDataTypes;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.codec.v2193.Bedrock_v2193;


public final class EntityMetadataUtil {


    private static final class FlagIds extends Bedrock_v2193 {
        static int id(EntityFlag flag) { return ENTITY_FLAGS.getId(flag); }
        static EntityFlag flag(int id) { return ENTITY_FLAGS.getTypeUnsafe(id); }
    }

    public static int nativeFlagId(EntityFlag flag) { return FlagIds.id(flag); }

    public static EntityFlag nativeFlag(int id) { return FlagIds.flag(id); }

    public static Set<Integer> copyFlags(EntityDataMap metadata) {
        if (metadata == null || metadata.getFlags() == null) return null;
        Set<Integer> flags = new HashSet<>();
        metadata.getFlags().forEach((flag, value) -> {
            int id = nativeFlagId(flag);
            if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(value) && id >= 0 && id < 128) flags.add(id);
        });
        return hasBaseFlags(metadata) || hasExtendedFlags(metadata) ? flags : null;
    }

    public static boolean hasBaseFlags(EntityDataMap metadata) { return hasFlagWord(metadata, 0); }
    public static boolean hasExtendedFlags(EntityDataMap metadata) { return hasFlagWord(metadata, 1); }

    private static boolean hasFlagWord(EntityDataMap metadata, int word) {


        return metadata != null && metadata.getFlags() != null && metadata.getFlags().keySet().stream()
                .mapToInt(EntityMetadataUtil::nativeFlagId).anyMatch(id -> id >= word * 64 && id < (word + 1) * 64);
    }

    public static void writeFlags(EntityDataMap metadata, Set<Integer> flags) {
        EnumMap<EntityFlag, Boolean> values = new EnumMap<>(EntityFlag.class);
        for (int id = 0; id < 128; id++) {
            EntityFlag flag = FlagIds.flag(id);
            if (flag != null) values.put(flag, flags.contains(id));
        }
        metadata.putFlags(values);
    }

    public static EntityDataMap copy(EntityDataMap source) {
        EntityDataMap copy = new EntityDataMap();
        source.forEach((type, value) -> copy.put(type,
                value instanceof EnumMap<?, ?> flags ? flags.clone()
                        : value instanceof byte[] bytes ? bytes.clone()
                        : value instanceof int[] ints ? ints.clone()
                        : value instanceof long[] longs ? longs.clone() : value));
        return copy;
    }

    public static void copyProperties(EntityDataMap source, EntityDataMap target) {
        source.forEach((type, value) -> {
            if (type != EntityDataTypes.FLAGS && type != EntityDataTypes.FLAGS_2) target.put(type, value);
        });
    }
    public interface Metadata {
        boolean exists(int nativeKey);
        float getFloat(int nativeKey);
        long getLong(int nativeKey);
    }
    private EntityMetadataUtil() {
    }

    public static Float getFloat(EntityDataMap metadata, EntityDataType<Float> key) {
        if (metadata == null || !metadata.containsKey(key)) return null;
        float value = metadata.get(key, Float.class);
        return Float.isFinite(value) ? value : null;
    }

    public static Float getFloat(final Metadata metadata, final int key) {
        if (metadata == null || !metadata.exists(key)) {
            return null;
        }

        final float value = metadata.getFloat(key);
        return Float.isFinite(value) ? value : null;
    }

    public static Set<Integer> copyFlags(final Metadata metadata) {
        if (metadata == null) {
            return null;
        }

        final boolean hasBaseFlags = metadata.exists(0);
        final boolean hasExtendedFlags = metadata.exists(92);
        if (!hasBaseFlags && !hasExtendedFlags) {
            return null;
        }

        final Set<Integer> flags = new HashSet<>();
        if (hasBaseFlags) {
            copyBits(flags, metadata.getLong(0), 0);
        }
        if (hasExtendedFlags) {
            copyBits(flags, metadata.getLong(92), Long.SIZE);
        }
        return flags;
    }

    public static boolean hasFlag(final Metadata metadata, final int flag) {
        if (metadata == null || flag < 0) {
            return false;
        }

        if (flag < Long.SIZE) {
            return metadata.exists(0)
                    && (metadata.getLong(0) & (1L << flag)) != 0;
        }

        final int extendedBit = flag - Long.SIZE;
        return extendedBit < Long.SIZE
                && metadata.exists(92)
                && (metadata.getLong(92) & (1L << extendedBit)) != 0;
    }


    public static Set<Integer> mergeFlags(final Set<Integer> current, final Set<Integer> update,
                                          boolean hasBaseFlags, boolean hasExtendedFlags) {
        final Set<Integer> flags = new HashSet<>(current);
        flags.removeIf(flag -> flag >= 0 && (flag < Long.SIZE ? hasBaseFlags
                : flag < 2 * Long.SIZE && hasExtendedFlags));
        for (int flag : update) {
            if (flag >= 0 && (flag < Long.SIZE ? hasBaseFlags
                    : flag < 2 * Long.SIZE && hasExtendedFlags)) flags.add(flag);
        }
        return flags;
    }

    private static void copyBits(final Set<Integer> flags, final long rawFlags, final int offset) {
        for (int bit = 0; bit < Long.SIZE; bit++) {
            if ((rawFlags & (1L << bit)) != 0) {
                flags.add(offset + bit);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/util/Hash.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.util;

import org.cloudburstmc.nbt.NbtMap;
import org.cloudburstmc.nbt.NbtUtils;
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.TreeMap;


public final class Hash {
    private Hash() { }

    public static int hashBlock(NbtMap state) {
        String name = state.getString("name");
        if ("minecraft:unknown".equals(name)) return -2;
        NbtMap properties = state.getCompound("states");
        var sortedProperties = NbtMap.builder();
        sortedProperties.putAll(new TreeMap<>(properties));
        NbtMap canonical = NbtMap.builder().putString("name", name)
                .putCompound("states", sortedProperties.build()).build();
        try {
            ByteArrayOutputStream bytes = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
            try (var writer = NbtUtils.createWriterLE(bytes)) { writer.writeTag(canonical); }
            return fnv1a32(bytes.toByteArray());
        } catch (IOException error) { throw new IllegalStateException(error); }
    }

    public static int fnv1a32(byte[] bytes) {
        int hash = 0x811c9dc5;
        for (byte value : bytes) { hash ^= value & 0xff; hash *= 0x01000193; }
        return hash;
    }
}
```

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.util;

import com.google.gson.JsonParser;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.ItemData;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;


public final class ItemUtil {
    private static final Map<String, Set<String>> LOCAL_ITEM_TAGS = Map.of(
            "minecraft:bundles", Set.of(
                    "minecraft:bundle",
                    "minecraft:white_bundle", "minecraft:orange_bundle", "minecraft:magenta_bundle",
                    "minecraft:light_blue_bundle", "minecraft:yellow_bundle", "minecraft:lime_bundle",
                    "minecraft:pink_bundle", "minecraft:gray_bundle", "minecraft:light_gray_bundle",
                    "minecraft:cyan_bundle", "minecraft:purple_bundle", "minecraft:blue_bundle",
                    "minecraft:brown_bundle", "minecraft:green_bundle", "minecraft:red_bundle",
                    "minecraft:black_bundle"
            ),
            "minecraft:candles", Set.of(
                    "minecraft:candle",
                    "minecraft:white_candle", "minecraft:orange_candle", "minecraft:magenta_candle",
                    "minecraft:light_blue_candle", "minecraft:yellow_candle", "minecraft:lime_candle",
                    "minecraft:pink_candle", "minecraft:gray_candle", "minecraft:light_gray_candle",
                    "minecraft:cyan_candle", "minecraft:purple_candle", "minecraft:blue_candle",
                    "minecraft:brown_candle", "minecraft:green_candle", "minecraft:red_candle",
                    "minecraft:black_candle"
            ),
            "minecraft:noteblock_top_instruments", Set.of(
                    "minecraft:skeleton_skull", "minecraft:wither_skeleton_skull",
                    "minecraft:zombie_head", "minecraft:player_head", "minecraft:creeper_head",
                    "minecraft:dragon_head", "minecraft:piglin_head"
            )
    );

    private static final Map<String, Set<String>> NATIVE_ITEM_TAGS = loadTags();
    private ItemUtil() { }

    private static Map<String, Set<String>> loadTags() {
        var stream = ItemUtil.class.getResourceAsStream("/navro/item_tags.json");
        if (stream == null) throw new AssertionError("Unable to load Navro item_tags.json");
        try (var reader = new InputStreamReader(stream, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
            Map<String, Set<String>> result = new HashMap<>();
            for (var entry : JsonParser.parseReader(reader).getAsJsonObject().entrySet()) {
                Set<String> items = new HashSet<>();
                for (var item : entry.getValue().getAsJsonArray()) items.add(item.getAsString());
                result.put(entry.getKey(), Set.copyOf(items));
            }
            return Map.copyOf(result);
        } catch (java.io.IOException error) { throw new IllegalStateException(error); }
    }

    public static String identifier(ItemData item) {
        return item == null || item.getDefinition() == null ? null : item.getDefinition().getIdentifier();
    }

    public static int runtimeId(ItemData item) {
        return item == null || item.getDefinition() == null ? Integer.MIN_VALUE : item.getDefinition().getRuntimeId();
    }

    public static boolean sameDefinition(ItemData predicted, ItemData claimed) {
        if (predicted == null) return true;
        if (claimed == null) return false;
        String predictedId = identifier(predicted), claimedId = identifier(claimed);
        if (predictedId == null || claimedId == null) return true;
        if (!StringUtil.sanitizePrefix(predictedId).equalsIgnoreCase(StringUtil.sanitizePrefix(claimedId))) return false;
        int predictedRuntimeId = runtimeId(predicted), claimedRuntimeId = runtimeId(claimed);
        if (predictedRuntimeId == Integer.MIN_VALUE || claimedRuntimeId == Integer.MIN_VALUE) return true;
        return predictedRuntimeId == claimedRuntimeId;
    }

    public static boolean hasTag(ItemData item, String tag) {
        String identifier = identifier(item);
        if (identifier == null) return false;
        String normalizedIdentifier = identifier.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        Set<String> items = NATIVE_ITEM_TAGS.get(tag);
        if (items != null && items.stream().anyMatch(value -> value.equalsIgnoreCase(normalizedIdentifier))) return true;
        return LOCAL_ITEM_TAGS.getOrDefault(tag.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT), Set.of()).contains(normalizedIdentifier);
    }

    public static boolean isBundle(ItemData item) { return hasTag(item, "minecraft:bundles"); }

    public static ItemData copy(ItemData item) {
        if (item == null) return ItemData.AIR;
        return item.toBuilder().tag(copyTag(item.getTag()))
                .canPlace(item.getCanPlace() == null ? null : item.getCanPlace().clone())
                .canBreak(item.getCanBreak() == null ? null : item.getCanBreak().clone()).build();
    }

    public static org.cloudburstmc.nbt.NbtMap copyTag(org.cloudburstmc.nbt.NbtMap tag) {
        if (tag == null) return null;
        var copy = org.cloudburstmc.nbt.NbtMap.builder();
        for (String name : tag.keySet()) copy.put(name, copyNbt(tag.get(name)));
        return copy.build();
    }

    @SuppressWarnings({"rawtypes", "unchecked"})
    private static Object copyNbt(Object value) {
        if (value instanceof org.cloudburstmc.nbt.NbtMap map) return copyTag(map);
        if (value instanceof org.cloudburstmc.nbt.NbtList<?> list) {
            var copy = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
            for (Object element : list) copy.add(copyNbt(element));
            return new org.cloudburstmc.nbt.NbtList(list.getType(), copy);
        }
        return org.cloudburstmc.nbt.NbtUtils.copy(value);
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/util/LatencyUtil.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.util;

import ac.navro.proxy.check.api.holder.CheckHolder;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Deque;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentLinkedDeque;


public final class LatencyUtil {
    private final CheckHolder checks;
    private boolean detectionEnabled;
    private final ThreadLocal<Long> dispatchingAck = new ThreadLocal<>();
    public Long currentAcknowledgmentId() { return dispatchingAck.get(); }
    private final Deque<Latency> sentQueue = new ConcurrentLinkedDeque<>();
    public volatile Latency prevAcceptedLatency;
    public volatile long prevAcceptedTime = System.currentTimeMillis();

    public LatencyUtil(CheckHolder checks) {
        this.checks = checks;
    }

    public Deque<Latency> sentQueue() { return sentQueue; }

    public synchronized void queue(long id, boolean ours) {
        queue(id, ours, null);
    }

    public synchronized void queue(long id, boolean ours, Runnable task) {
        Latency latency = new Latency(id, System.currentTimeMillis(), System.nanoTime(), ours,
                ours ? new ArrayList<>() : null);
        if (task != null) latency.addTask(task);
        sentQueue.add(latency);
    }

    public void queue(Runnable runnable) {
        synchronized (this) {
            Latency target = sentQueue.peekLast();
            if (target != null) {
                target.addTask(runnable);
                return;
            }
        }
        runnable.run();
    }

    public synchronized boolean hasPending(long id, boolean ours) {
        return sentQueue.stream().anyMatch(latency -> latency.id() == id && latency.ours() == ours);
    }

    public boolean onResponse(long id) {
        List<Latency> released = new ArrayList<>();
        Latency match;
        synchronized (this) {
            match = sentQueue.stream().filter(latency -> latency.id() == id).findFirst().orElse(null);
            if (match == null) return false;
            Latency head;
            do {
                head = sentQueue.removeFirst();
                released.add(head);
            } while (head != match);
        }
        for (Latency latency : released) accept(latency);
        return match.ours();
    }

    public boolean onOrderedResponse() {
        Latency latency;
        synchronized (this) {
            latency = sentQueue.pollFirst();
        }
        if (latency == null) return false;
        accept(latency);
        return latency.ours();
    }

    private void accept(Latency latency) {
        Long previous=dispatchingAck.get();dispatchingAck.set(latency.id());
        try { latency.run(); } finally { if(previous==null)dispatchingAck.remove();else dispatchingAck.set(previous); }
        try {
            onLatencyAccepted(latency);
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {
        }
        prevAcceptedTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
        prevAcceptedLatency = latency;
    }

    public void setDetectionEnabled(boolean enabled) { detectionEnabled = enabled; }

    public void onLatencyAccepted(Latency latency) {
        if (!detectionEnabled || checks == null) return;
        for (final ac.navro.proxy.check.api.Check check : checks.values()) {
            if (!checks.enabled(check.getClass()) || !(check instanceof ac.navro.proxy.check.api.impl.PingBasedCheck pingBasedCheck)) continue;
            pingBasedCheck.onLatencyAccepted(latency);
        }
    }

    public synchronized void close() { sentQueue.clear(); }

    public static final class Latency {
        private final long id, ms, ns;
        private final boolean ours;
        private List<Runnable> tasks;

        public Latency(long id, long ms, long ns, boolean ours, List<Runnable> tasks) {
            this.id = id;
            this.ms = ms;
            this.ns = ns;
            this.ours = ours;
            this.tasks = tasks;
        }

        public long id() { return id; }
        public long ms() { return ms; }
        public long ns() { return ns; }
        public boolean ours() { return ours; }

        public synchronized void addTask(Runnable task) {
            if (tasks == null) tasks = new ArrayList<>();
            tasks.add(task);
        }

        public void run() {
            List<Runnable> pending;
            synchronized (this) {
                pending = tasks;
                tasks = null;
            }
            if (pending == null) return;
            for (Runnable task : pending) {
                try {
                    task.run();
                } catch (Throwable ignored) {
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/util/block/BlockActions.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.util.block;

import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.PlayerAuthInputPacket;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerAuthInputData;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerActionType;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.PlayerBlockActionData;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;


public final class BlockActions {
    private BlockActions() { }

    public static List<PlayerBlockActionData> read(PlayerAuthInputPacket packet) {

        return packet.getPlayerActions().stream().map(action -> action == null ? null : copy(action))
                .collect(java.util.stream.Collectors.toCollection(ArrayList::new));
    }


    public static List<PlayerBlockActionData> read(Map<PlayerActionType, PlayerBlockActionData> actions) {
        final var map = new LinkedHashMap<>(actions);
        map.entrySet().removeIf(e -> e.getValue() == null || e.getKey() != e.getValue().getAction());
        final List<PlayerBlockActionData> ordered = new ArrayList<>();
        final var finish = map.remove(PlayerActionType.BLOCK_PREDICT_DESTROY);
        final var start = map.get(PlayerActionType.START_BREAK);


        if (finish != null && start != null && Objects.equals(start.getBlockPosition(), finish.getBlockPosition())) {
            ordered.add(map.remove(PlayerActionType.START_BREAK));
        }
        if (finish != null) ordered.add(finish);
        final var abort = map.remove(PlayerActionType.ABORT_BREAK);
        if (abort != null) ordered.add(abort);
        ordered.addAll(map.values());
        return ordered;
    }


    public static List<PlayerBlockActionData> write(PlayerAuthInputPacket packet,
                                                   List<PlayerBlockActionData> actions) {
        var snapshot = actions.stream().map(BlockActions::copy).toList();
        packet.getPlayerActions().clear();
        packet.getPlayerActions().addAll(snapshot);
        if (actions.isEmpty()) packet.getInputData().remove(PlayerAuthInputData.PERFORM_BLOCK_ACTIONS);
        return actions;
    }

    private static PlayerBlockActionData copy(PlayerBlockActionData action) {
        var result = new PlayerBlockActionData();
        result.setAction(action.getAction());
        result.setBlockPosition(action.getBlockPosition());
        result.setFace(action.getFace());
        return result;
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/util/block/BlockCorrectionSender.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.util.block;

import ac.navro.proxy.ProtocolDefinitions;
import ac.navro.proxy.state.WirePlayerState;
import org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector3i;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.BedrockServerSession;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.UpdateBlockPacket;

import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.function.BooleanSupplier;
import java.util.function.Consumer;


public final class BlockCorrectionSender {
    private final BedrockServerSession client;
    private final ProtocolDefinitions definitions;
    private final WirePlayerState player;
    private final BooleanSupplier available;
    private final Consumer<UpdateBlockPacket> observe;

    public BlockCorrectionSender(BedrockServerSession client, ProtocolDefinitions definitions,
                                 WirePlayerState player, BooleanSupplier available,
                                 Consumer<UpdateBlockPacket> observe) {
        this.client = Objects.requireNonNull(client);
        this.definitions = Objects.requireNonNull(definitions);
        this.player = Objects.requireNonNull(player);
        this.available = Objects.requireNonNull(available);
        this.observe = Objects.requireNonNull(observe);
    }


    public void restoreCorrectBlock(Vector3i position, int layerZeroNetworkId, int layerOneNetworkId) {
        if (position == null) return;
        execute(() -> BlockUtil.restoreCorrectBlock(this::send, position,
                definitions.blockDefinition(layerZeroNetworkId), definitions.blockDefinition(layerOneNetworkId)));
    }


    public void restoreCorrectBlock(Vector3i position, int networkId) {
        if (position == null) return;
        execute(() -> BlockUtil.restoreCorrectBlock(this::send, position, definitions.blockDefinition(networkId)));
    }

    private void execute(Runnable task) {
        var loop = client.getPeer().getChannel().eventLoop();
        Runnable guarded = () -> {
            if (!available.getAsBoolean() || !client.isConnected() || !client.getPeer().isConnected()) return;
            if (player.getEntityBatchEncoder() == null)
                throw new IllegalStateException("Block corrections require the installed batch ACK transport");
            task.run();
        };
        if (loop.inEventLoop()) guarded.run();
        else loop.execute(guarded);
    }

    private void send(UpdateBlockPacket packet) {
        var encoder = player.getEntityBatchEncoder();
        try {
            observe.accept(packet);

            client.sendPacket(packet);
        } catch (RuntimeException | Error failure) {
            encoder.discard(packet);
            throw failure;
        }
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/util/block/BlockReachUtil.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.util.block;

import ac.navro.proxy.state.WirePlayerState;
import ac.navro.proxy.data.inventory.NativeItemDecoder;
import ac.navro.proxy.data.inventory.NativePredictionItems;
import ac.navro.proxy.data.vanilla.GameType;
import org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector3i;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.ItemData;
import java.util.Locale;


public final class BlockReachUtil {
    private static final String BLOCK_INTERACTION_RANGE="minecraft:block_interaction_range";
    private static final String LEGACY_BLOCK_INTERACTION_RANGE="block_interaction_range";
    private BlockReachUtil() { }
    public static boolean inVehicle(WirePlayerState player) { return player.vehicleData!=null; }
    public static double maxReach(WirePlayerState player) {
        double attribute=attributeValue(player,BLOCK_INTERACTION_RANGE);
        if(Double.isFinite(attribute)&&attribute>0.0D)return attribute;
        return player.gameType()==GameType.CREATIVE?13.0D:7.0D;
    }
    public static double distanceSquared(WirePlayerState player,Vector3i position) {
        var feet=player.position();
        if(feet==null||position==null)return Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
        double minimum=Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
        for(float eyeHeight:possibleEyeHeights(player)) {
            double eyeX=feet.x,eyeY=feet.y+eyeHeight,eyeZ=feet.z;
            double closestX=clamp(eyeX,position.getX(),position.getX()+1.0D);
            double closestY=clamp(eyeY,position.getY(),position.getY()+1.0D);
            double closestZ=clamp(eyeZ,position.getZ(),position.getZ()+1.0D);
            double dx=eyeX-closestX,dy=eyeY-closestY,dz=eyeZ-closestZ;
            minimum=Math.min(minimum,dx*dx+dy*dy+dz*dz);
        }
        return minimum;
    }
    public static boolean isFar(WirePlayerState player,Vector3i position) {
        return distanceSquared(player,position)>maxReach(player)*maxReach(player);
    }
    public static String describe(WirePlayerState player,Vector3i position) {
        return String.format(Locale.ROOT,"distance=%.3f,max=%.3f,pos=%d,%d,%d",
                Math.sqrt(distanceSquared(player,position)),maxReach(player),position.getX(),position.getY(),position.getZ());
    }
    public static String distanceDetail(String detail) {
        int start=detail.indexOf("distance=");if(start<0)return "";
        start+="distance=".length();int end=detail.indexOf(',',start);
        return String.format(Locale.ROOT,"distance=%.2f",Double.parseDouble(detail.substring(start,end<0?detail.length():end)));
    }
    public static boolean isPlaceable(int protocol,ItemData item) {
        if(item==null||item.getCount()<=0||NativePredictionItems.resolve(protocol,item).positiveNull())return false;
        var properties=NativeItemDecoder.placement(protocol,item);
        return properties.canBePlaced()&&properties.blockId()!=0&&properties.blockId()!=420;
    }
    private static double attributeValue(WirePlayerState player,String name) {
        var instance=player.attributes().get(name);
        if(instance==null&&BLOCK_INTERACTION_RANGE.equals(name))instance=player.attributes().get(LEGACY_BLOCK_INTERACTION_RANGE);
        return instance==null?Double.NaN:instance.getValue();
    }
    private static float[] possibleEyeHeights(WirePlayerState player) {
        float current=player.dimensions().eyeHeight();
        if(Math.abs(current-1.62F)<1.0E-4F)return new float[]{current,1.26F,.42F};
        if(Math.abs(current-1.26F)<1.0E-4F)return new float[]{current,1.62F,.42F};
        if(Math.abs(current-.42F)<1.0E-4F)return new float[]{current,1.62F,1.26F};
        return new float[]{current};
    }
    private static double clamp(double value,double min,double max) { return Math.max(min,Math.min(max,value)); }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/util/block/BlockUtil.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.util.block;

import org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector3i;
import ac.navro.proxy.data.block.NativeBlockProperties;
import ac.navro.proxy.data.block.NetworkBlockState;
import ac.navro.proxy.data.vanilla.GameType;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.definitions.BlockDefinition;
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.UpdateBlockPacket;
import java.util.function.Consumer;


public final class BlockUtil {
    private BlockUtil() { }


    public static void restoreCorrectBlock(Consumer<UpdateBlockPacket> player, Vector3i vector, BlockDefinition state) {
        restoreCorrectBlock(player, vector, state, 0);
    }


    public static void restoreCorrectBlock(Consumer<UpdateBlockPacket> player, Vector3i vector,
                                            BlockDefinition layerZero, BlockDefinition layerOne) {
        if (player == null || vector == null) return;
        restoreCorrectBlock(player, vector, layerZero, 0);
        restoreCorrectBlock(player, vector, layerOne, 1);
    }

    private static void restoreCorrectBlock(Consumer<UpdateBlockPacket> player, Vector3i vector,
                                             BlockDefinition state, int layer) {
        if (player == null || vector == null || state == null) return;
        final UpdateBlockPacket packet = new UpdateBlockPacket();
        packet.setBlockPosition(vector);
        packet.setDefinition(state);


        packet.getFlags().add(UpdateBlockPacket.Flag.NEIGHBORS);
        packet.getFlags().add(UpdateBlockPacket.Flag.NETWORK);
        packet.getFlags().add(UpdateBlockPacket.Flag.UNUSED);
        packet.setDataLayer(layer);
        player.accept(packet);
    }

    public static boolean determineCanBreak(final GameType gameType, final NativeBlockProperties.Properties state) {
        int id = state.blockId();
        if (id == 0 || id == 10 || id == 11 || id == 8 || id == 9) {
            return false;
        }

        float destroyTime = (float) state.hardness();
        return destroyTime != -1 || gameType == GameType.CREATIVE;
    }

    public static boolean determineCanBreak(final GameType gameType, final NetworkBlockState state) {
        return determineCanBreak(gameType, NativeBlockProperties.forState(state));
    }

    public static Vector3i getBlockPosition(Vector3i blockPos, int face) {
        return switch (face) {
            case 0 -> blockPos.sub(0, 1, 0);
            case 1 -> blockPos.add(0, 1, 0);
            case 2 -> blockPos.sub(0, 0, 1);
            case 3 -> blockPos.add(0, 0, 1);
            case 4 -> blockPos.sub(1, 0, 0);
            case 5 -> blockPos.add(1, 0, 0);
            default -> blockPos;
        };
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/util/reach/CameraCandidates.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.util.reach;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.Pair;

import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Box;
import java.util.ArrayDeque;





public final class CameraCandidates {
    private CameraCandidates() { }
    private static final double EPS = 1e-8;
    public static final int NODE_LIMIT = 512;
    public record Point(double x, double y, double z) { }
    public record Witness(double alpha, Point origin, Point targetPoint, double distance) { }
    public record Result(String verdict, String conditionalVerdict, String reason,
                         int nodes, Witness witness, double verticalFovDegrees,
                         double aspect, double rollDegrees, double maxDistance,
                         boolean coverageProven, boolean visibilityChecked) { }


    public static Result assess(PlacementCameraSnapshot camera, Pair<Vec3, Vec3> positions,
                                float eyeHeight, Box target, double maxDistance) {
        return solve(camera, positions, eyeHeight, target, maxDistance, 110, 16.0 / 9, NODE_LIMIT);
    }

    private static Result solve(PlacementCameraSnapshot camera, Pair<Vec3, Vec3> positions,
                                float eyeHeight, Box target, double maxDistance,
                                double fov, double aspect, int maxNodes) {
        if (camera == null || !finite(camera.forward()) || positions == null
                || !finite(positions.a()) || !finite(positions.b()) || !Float.isFinite(eyeHeight)
                || target == null || !target.isValid()
                || !Double.isFinite(fov) || fov <= 0 || fov >= 180
                || !Double.isFinite(aspect) || aspect <= 0
                || !Double.isFinite(maxDistance) || maxDistance <= 0) {
            return result("UNKNOWN", "invalid_or_missing_camera_geometry", 0, null, fov, aspect, maxDistance);
        }
        var b = target;
        double[] low = {0, b.minX - .1, b.minY - .1, b.minZ - .1};
        double[] high = {1, b.maxX + .1, b.maxY + .1, b.maxZ + .1};
        for (int i = 1; i < 4; i++) {
            if (!Double.isFinite(low[i]) || !Double.isFinite(high[i]) || high[i] - low[i] <= .2)
                return result("UNKNOWN", "invalid_target", 0, null, fov, aspect, maxDistance);
        }
        double[] f = vector(camera.forward());
        if (!normalize(f)) return result("UNKNOWN", "invalid_camera_vector", 0, null, fov, aspect, maxDistance);
        double[] right = Math.hypot(f[0], f[2]) < 1e-12 ? new double[]{1, 0, 0} : new double[]{f[2], 0, -f[0]};
        normalize(right);
        double[] up = {f[1]*right[2]-f[2]*right[1], f[2]*right[0]-f[0]*right[2], f[0]*right[1]-f[1]*right[0]};
        normalize(up);
        double tv = Math.tan(Math.toRadians(fov) / 2), th = tv * aspect;
        double[] start = vector(positions.a()), end = vector(positions.b());
        start[1] += eyeHeight; end[1] += eyeHeight;
        double[] delta = {end[0]-start[0], end[1]-start[1], end[2]-start[2]};
        double originTravel = Math.sqrt(dot(delta, delta));
        double[][] planes = new double[5][3];
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            planes[0][i] = -f[i];
            planes[1][i] = -right[i]-th*f[i]; planes[2][i] = right[i]-th*f[i];
            planes[3][i] = -up[i]-tv*f[i]; planes[4][i] = up[i]-tv*f[i];
        }
        var pending = new ArrayDeque<double[][]>();
        pending.push(new double[][]{low, high});
        int nodes = 0; boolean unresolved = false;
        while (!pending.isEmpty()) {
            if (nodes >= Math.min(NODE_LIMIT, Math.max(0, maxNodes)))
                return result("UNKNOWN", "node_budget", nodes, null, fov, aspect, maxDistance);
            double[][] domain = pending.pop(); low = domain[0]; high = domain[1]; nodes++;
            boolean outside = false;
            for (double[] n : planes) {
                double[] c = {-dot(n, delta), n[0], n[1], n[2]};
                if (lower(c, low, high, -dot(n, start)) > EPS) { outside = true; break; }
            }
            if (outside) continue;
            double distanceLower = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                double[] c = {-delta[i], 0, 0, 0}; c[i+1] = 1;
                double lo = lower(c, low, high, -start[i]);
                double hi = -lower(negate(c), low, high, start[i]);
                double gap = Math.max(0, Math.max(lo, -hi));
                distanceLower = Math.nextDown(distanceLower + Math.nextDown(gap*gap));
            }
            if (distanceLower > (maxDistance+EPS)*(maxDistance+EPS)) continue;
            double alpha = (low[0]+high[0])*.5;
            double[] origin = new double[3], point = new double[3], v = new double[3];
            for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                origin[i] = start[i]+alpha*delta[i]; point[i] = (low[i+1]+high[i+1])*.5;
                v[i] = point[i]-origin[i];
            }
            double depth = dot(v, f), distance = Math.sqrt(dot(v, v));
            if (depth >= -EPS && distance <= maxDistance-EPS
                    && Math.abs(dot(v, right)) <= th*depth-EPS
                    && Math.abs(dot(v, up)) <= tv*depth-EPS) {
                return result("POSSIBLE", "candidate_found", nodes,
                        new Witness(alpha, point(origin), point(point), distance), fov, aspect, maxDistance);
            }
            int axis = 0; double width = (high[0]-low[0])*originTravel;
            for (int i = 1; i < 4; i++) if (high[i]-low[i] > width) { axis = i; width = high[i]-low[i]; }
            double mid = (low[axis]+high[axis])*.5;
            if (width <= 1e-7 || mid == low[axis] || mid == high[axis]) { unresolved = true; continue; }
            double[] leftHigh = high.clone(), rightLow = low.clone();
            leftHigh[axis] = mid; rightLow[axis] = mid;
            pending.push(new double[][]{rightLow, high}); pending.push(new double[][]{low, leftHigh});
        }
        return result(unresolved ? "UNKNOWN" : "MISS", unresolved ? "unresolved_boundary" : "all_domains_pruned",
                nodes, null, fov, aspect, maxDistance);
    }

    private static Result result(String conditional, String reason, int nodes, Witness witness,
                                  double fov, double aspect, double distance) {
        return new Result("UNKNOWN", conditional, reason, nodes, witness, fov, aspect, 0, distance, false, false);
    }
    private static double lower(double[] c, double[] low, double[] high, double constant) {
        double sum = constant;
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) sum = Math.nextDown(sum + Math.nextDown(Math.min(c[i]*low[i], c[i]*high[i])));
        return sum;
    }
    private static double[] negate(double[] v) { return new double[]{-v[0], -v[1], -v[2], -v[3]}; }
    private static boolean finite(Vec3 v) { return v != null && Float.isFinite(v.x) && Float.isFinite(v.y) && Float.isFinite(v.z); }
    private static double[] vector(Vec3 v) { return new double[]{v.x, v.y, v.z}; }
    private static double dot(double[] a, double[] b) { return a[0]*b[0]+a[1]*b[1]+a[2]*b[2]; }
    private static boolean normalize(double[] v) {
        double length = Math.sqrt(dot(v, v));
        if (!Double.isFinite(length) || length < 1e-10) return false;
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) v[i] /= length;
        return true;
    }
    private static Point point(double[] v) { return new Point(v[0], v[1], v[2]); }
}
```

`src/main/java/ac/navro/proxy/util/reach/PositionInterpolator.java`:

```java
package ac.navro.proxy.util.reach;

import ac.navro.proxy.compensated.cache.entity.state.CachedEntityState;
import ac.navro.anticheat.util.math.Vec3;

public class PositionInterpolator implements Cloneable {
    private final CachedEntityState entity;
    private final int lerpDuration;

    private Vec3 targetPos;
    private int step;

    public Vec3 getTargetPos() { return targetPos; }
    public int getStep() { return step; }

    public PositionInterpolator(CachedEntityState entity) {
        this.entity = entity;
        if (entity.getEntity() == null) {
            this.lerpDuration = 3;
        } else {
            this.lerpDuration = entity.getEntity().isPlayerEntity() ? 3 : 6;
        }
    }

    public void refreshPositionAndAngles(Vec3 pow) {
        if (this.lerpDuration == 0) {
            this.entity.setPos(pow);
            this.clear();
            return;
        }

        this.targetPos = pow;
        this.step = lerpDuration;
    }

    public boolean isInterpolating() {
        return this.step > 0;
    }

    public void tick() {
        if (!this.isInterpolating()) {
            this.clear();
            return;
        }

        if (this.step > 0 && this.targetPos != null) {
            float x = this.entity.getPos().x + (this.targetPos.x - this.entity.getPos().x) / this.step;
            float y = this.entity.getPos().y + (this.targetPos.y - this.entity.getPos().y) / this.step;
            float z = this.entity.getPos().z + (this.targetPos.z - this.entity.getPos().z) / this.step;
            this.entity.setPos(new Vec3(x, y, z));

            --this.step;
        }
    }

    private void clear() {
        this.step = 0;
        this.targetPos = null;
    }

    @Override
    public PositionInterpolator clone() {
        final PositionInterpolator clone = new PositionInterpolator(this.entity);
        clone.targetPos = this.targetPos;
        clone.step = this.step;
        return clone;
    }
}
```
